Principal Responsibilities

  • Handle all Int’l main trade finance transactions for DBS clients including import/export L/Cs, Bank Guarantee etc.

处理星展银行客户的所有国际贸易融资业务包括进出口信用证，银行保函等业务。

  • Back up handle all trade finance transactions for DBS clients including OA Finance and Draft transactions.

候补处理星展银行客户的所有应收应付账款融资业务和票据融资业务。

  • Support bank’s project management of the trade service product processing optimization, especially AI projects UR analysis, design, testing & launch

支持银行贸易服务产品及流程及系统优化项目，重点支持AI项目相关的需求分析、设计测试，上线等环节。

  • Check supporting docs according to bank’s guidance/trade finance procedure and ensure applications compliance with internal control requirement as well as compliance requirement.

根据银行的操作指引以及贸易融资的操作流程审核相关证明文件，以确保交易申请符合银行内控和合规要求。

  • Checking trade finance documents according to UCP/URDG/ISBP/URR and other international trade finance practice.

根据相关国际惯例审核贸易融资单据。

  • Booking trade finance and relevant funds disbursement in banking system and make data information verification. Process cash margin, BAD/CAD pledge on transactional basis.

将相关贸易融资以及资金的转移收付录入银行系统并确保数据准确性, 根据流程处理交易层面的客户保证金和质押票据的收付。

  • Conduct post checking/monitoring of trade related supporting documents which shall be align with “3 measures & 1 guideline”.

根据”3个办法一个指引” 的要求进行贷后文件的跟踪和审核。

  • Handle DBS client inquiry on trade finance related transactions.

处理星展客户关于贸易融资业务的查询/咨询。

  • Make sure any deviations/irregulars were raised to Team head, and obtain proper DOA approval on exceptions.

确保任何异常交易被上报给部门主管，并且在处理异例前得到相应的授权。

  • Conduct regulatory, MIS and other internal/external reporting for trade finance business i.e.SAFE/UPRR/RCPMIS/FTZMIS etc.

及时提交对内对外相关报表。

  • Assist team head to improve/maintain internal and external audit score, and make sure no significant finding during assessment.

协助部门主管/经理共同达到集团内部审计和外部审计的评定要求，并在规定时间内完成整改要求。

  • Participate in bank’s training if necessary.

积极参与银行相关培训。

Education And Relevant Experience

  • Bachelor degree holder or above. 本科学历或以上。
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in Trade Finance operations including import/export trade finance, OA Finance and Draft etc. 3年以上银行贸易融资国际结算操作部门经验, 包括进出口贸易融资结算业务、应收/应付融资业务、票据融资业务等。
  • CDCS certificate/CSDG certificate 信用证单证专家证书（国际商会）或者保函备用证专家证书(国际商会)。
  • Good knowledge on trade finance related products, rules and regulations, International practice 熟识贸易融资业务和产品，以及相关规则, 国际惯例等。
  • Basic knowledge of accounting 熟悉会计基础知识。
  • Proficient in commonly used data analysis software e.g., Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, R, Python, etc. 熟悉常用的数据分析软件，例如：Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, R, Python 等。
  • Good data visualization skills: Ability to create clear, concise, and insightful charts and reports 具备良好的数据可视化能力，能够创建清晰易懂的图表和报告。
  • Good PC skills and good command of English and Mandarin. 熟练的电脑操作能力, 精通英语和普通话。
  • Good communication skill and problem solving skill. 良好的沟通技巧和解决问题的能力。
  • Capable to work effectively under pressure and tight deadline 工作效率高，愿意在压力下工作。

Location:

PRC - Shanghai

Job:

Operations

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

ln:4462917760.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The role holder will spearhead the stressed and distressed loan trading strategy of the Loan Trading, East desk within Credit Trading. This person will be responsible for making sure that proper risk analyses are done prior to risk proposals, and that relevant risk approvals are in place. Therefore, the role holder will need to be highly experienced and skilled/proven across all aspects of stressed and distressed loan trading to be convincingly effective in conveying clear, accurate ideas and the correct risk picture in securing relevant approvals and limits. In summary, the role holder will diligently manage a risk book designed to book stressed / distressed loans and secondarily trade par loans opportunistically with profitable churn within ageing limits.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • To grow meaningfully the secondary trading franchise of fixed income assets – IG, HY & Financials of issuers in Greater China (“China Credit”) for Global Credit Trading.
  • Work with Sales, e-Sales, e-Trading, Research, Capital Markets, Technology and Syndication to execute initiatives to grow the broader Global Credit franchise.
  • Awareness and understanding of the strategy and business model of the larger Trading Group and Global Credit, as appropriate to the role.
  • Ensuring effective end to end client identification, risk management, service and infrastructure.
  • Work in conjunction with other partners to ensure SCB has a best-in-class offering for the EM credit asset class especially China Local Currency Credit.
  • Assistant in sending market colour / comments to sales on daily basis and promoting China onshore flow business.
  • Providing timely updated credit analysis/ profiles on China credit names for trading desk and to sales
  • Facilitate smooth deal execution including deal detail check and help to centralize booking instruction when necessary.
  • Helping sales translate specific clients’ needs into specific bonds.
  • Deliver training and education on products to internal and external audiences (sales and clients)
  • Ensure the stability, long-term sustainability, and reputation of the Bank.
  • Identifying areas of concern on matters of appropriateness/suitability and raising them to senior team members.
  • Provide timely support on credit bonds both at the trade idea origination level and at execution time
  • Generate/providing market watch and generic trade ideas to sales force, provide support on documentation review and drafting, deliver marketing support and product explanation to sales and to clients when necessary.
  • Analysing, assessing and propose specific credit bonds based on specific client needs, liaise with sales/trading/legal/MO and other related support functions to transform idea to trade.

Business

  • Increase SCB’s visibility by driving commercial, competitive pricing of credit trading for our clients.
  • Help manage the implementation of flow credit trading specific strategies and ensure that performance objectives and revenue goals are met and RWA targets managed.
  • Active performance monitoring – spot areas of underperformance and take corrective action.

Processes

  • Ensure adherence to all internal and external regulations.
  • To embed Operational Risk monitoring as an integral part of the business process. Towards this, to effectively carry out the assigned role, if any, under Compliance Risk Management and Operational Risk Management Assurance.
  • Ensure that the business meets its obligations the prevention of money laundering under the Group Policy and Standards and under local laws and regulations.
  • Help ensure that there are appropriate and documented internal controls and procedures in place. Help monitor the operation of such procedures and controls and regularly review them to ensure that they reflect any changes in products, systems, policy and regulations.

People & Talent

  • Build a transparent and collaborative culture in which incentives are based on support of Client Income with specific performance metrics on the Bank’s values.
  • To work in partnership with Credit Flow teams across to ensure that the flow trading product is value additive for clients and the bank.

Risk Management

  • Identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group. Also, an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.
  • Embed operational risk management and reporting as an integral part of the business process.
  • Ensure that adequate and appropriate systems and controls are in place to comply with Group and Business policies, procedures, standards, and codes.
  • Monitor all major risk issues and concentrations. Where appropriate, direct remedial action and/or ensure adequate reporting to Risk Committees.
  • Comply with guidelines as outlined in the annual Trader Mandate.

Governance

  • Promote an environment where compliance with internal control functions and external regulatory framework is a central priority of the business.
  • Establish, maintain, and supervise the framework to ensure business functions under my area of responsibility comply with internal policies, procedures, codes and applicable external laws and regulations and adhere to the expected high standards set out in the FM Code of Conduct.
  • Ensure the overall targets relating to budget are cascaded to teams with appropriate product targets and performance delivery on targets is proactively managed.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Adhere to any applicable regulators prescribed responsibilities.

Key stakeholders

Internal

  • Credit Flow Sales, e-Sales
  • Credit Research, Syndication, Capital Markets
  • Credit Solutions and other teams in Credit Trading
  • Support and Control functions
  • Modelling and Analytics Group

External

  • As and when necessary

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in CIB Markets; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

Skills And Experience

  • In-depth knowledge of the distressed credit landscape in APAC, covering illiquid, stressed/distressed debt, and special situations
  • Trading & analysis experience across a wide spectrum of loans: in varying credit rating qualities, structures, tenor, jurisdictions, and industries over many years
  • Track record of risk managing loan assets, including stressed/distressed, and distributing risk
  • Sharp business acumen, including ability to assess risk and commensurate level of RoRWA / RoTE

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in top universities in related majors
  • Strong interest in credit trading/sales business
  • Strong mathematical and numerical skills
  • Proficiency in data collection and analysis
  • Excellent research and writing abilities
  • Thorough understanding of credit market and financial analysis
  • Interpersonal skills and the ability to work under pressure
  • A team player who can work independently
  • [CFETS] Interbank Market CNY Product Trading License
  • [CFTC & National Futures Association & SEC] Authorized Associated Person Registration - SEC AAP registered.
  • [SEC] 15a-6 registered.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4462922722.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The Product Owner (PO) is a sole person (not a committee), who is responsible for owning the end-to-end customer journeys and product vision & lifecycle. They have delegated authority and empowerment to prioritize the product backlog to maximize the value of our products or services for both our customers and our business. Their core ethos is to make informed decisions to ensure each investment decision results in the maximum (as measured by OKRs) outcome balancing both short-medium- and long-term horizons. The Product Owner is responsible for maximizing the value of digital products and ensuring that digital journeys meet global standards for consistency, scalability, and customer outcomes. The Mobile Capability Lead is a strategic and technical leader responsible for driving mobile development excellence across the organization. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with leadership in capability building, stakeholder engagement, and organizational alignment.

Key Responsibilities

Their responsibilities can be classified as:

  • Product Leadership, Engagement & Strategy
  • Product Discovery & Experimentation
  • Product Delivery & Execution
  • Product Analytics
  • Technical Capabilities & Excellence

Product Leadership, Engagement & Strategy

  • Empowered with necessary business leaders to influence real outcomes.
  • Own the product vision and lifecycle, ensuring alignment with Digital Chapter standards for consistent channel experience, reusability, and scalability.
  • Own the mobile build strategy, ensuring robust architecture, scalability, and performance.
  • Define “what good looks like” for mobile/online journeys.
  • Inspire and coach the squad to embrace mobile-first principles and global standards.
  • Foster a culture of trust, psychological safety, and collaboration.

Job Description

Job Summary

  • Manage the Product control function for China across Business
  • Provide strong oversight of the integrity, accuracy and timely reporting of China trading revenues, balance sheet positions and valuation adjustments, ensuring that financial results are appropriately controlled and understood.
  • Establish and maintain a China-specific Product Control and Valuation Control framework that meets local regulatory requirements while remaining aligned with the bank’s global policies, standards and risk appetite.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance and Operations to support sustainable business growth by providing independent challenge, identifying emerging financial and valuation risks, and enabling informed commercial decision-making.
  • Strengthen the local control environment through effective governance, clear ownership, high-quality management information and the development of capable China-based Product Control and Valuation Control resources.
  • Manage the Valuation Control deliverables as applicable for China regulatory requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead a China-based Product Control and Valuation Control team, while also acting as a hands-on subject matter expert. The role combines people leadership with significant individual contribution, particularly in resolving complex control, valuation, accounting and regulatory matters.
  • Oversee the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of daily and monthly P&L, balance sheet substantiation, valuation adjustments, independent price verification and other core Product Control and Valuation Control activities for the China business.
  • Establish and maintain an effective China-specific control framework that meets local regulatory expectations and is aligned with the bank’s global Product Control and Valuation Control policies, methodologies and governance standards.
  • Coordinate extensively with global and regional Product Control and Valuation Control teams to obtain technical input, clarify policy requirements, resolve methodology differences and ensure consistent application of global standards within the China business.
  • Provide independent review and challenge of trading results, valuation methodologies, reserves, model inputs, adjustments and balance sheet positions. Ensure material issues are identified, investigated, escalated and resolved within agreed timelines.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to support new products, business growth and regulatory initiatives, ensuring that appropriate financial controls and valuation processes are in place before implementation.
  • Support the China business by providing clear analysis of revenue performance, valuation uncertainty, balance sheet risks, control weaknesses and emerging issues, enabling informed management and commercial decision-making.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Allocate work, set priorities, review outputs and develop the capability of the local team. Ensure clear accountability, appropriate segregation of duties, adequate documentation and effective backup arrangements.
  • Drive improvements in processes, reporting, data quality and automation, reducing manual adjustments and recurring breaks while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.
  • Maintain effective governance over material issues, exceptions and control breaches, with clear ownership, action plans, escalation thresholds and reporting to relevant China, regional and global committees.
  • The role holder is accountable for both the day-to-day effectiveness of the local Product Control and Valuation Control function and the successful coordination of China requirements with the wider global control organisation.

People and Talent

  • Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  • Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
  • Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, where local requirements may differ from global standards and require careful interpretation, escalation and practical implementation.
  • Resolving valuation, P&L and balance sheet issues involving incomplete data, methodology differences, manual processes or unclear ownership across local, regional and global teams.
  • Building a credible and sustainable local Product Control and Valuation Control framework while working with limited resources, competing priorities and significant dependency on global subject-matter experts.
  • Managing periods of heightened regulatory, audit or senior-management scrutiny, requiring timely responses, clear evidence of control effectiveness and disciplined delivery of remediation commitments.
  • Challenging senior business and functional stakeholders on valuation assumptions, manual adjustments, control weaknesses and financial risks, while maintaining constructive relationships and supporting business objectives.
  • Driving long-term process and control improvements where solutions require coordination across multiple teams, changes to systems or data, and sustained follow-through rather than short-term fixes.
  • Developing and retaining a small local team capable of handling complex issues independently, while maintaining delivery quality during periods of change, pressure or increased business activity.

Skills and Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Product Control and Valuation Control understanding
  • Financial Markets and Trading Products
  • China Regulatory awareness

Other Skills

  • Control Framework and risk management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Valuation knowledge – IPV/FVA/PVA

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience leading complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure

Certifications/Qualifications

  • CICPA & CFA is preferred

Languages

  • Chinese and English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

  • Proactively manage a complex portfolio of clients, becoming a trusted advisor to lead strategic dialogues with clients at a portfolio level through the understanding of specific business requirements and delivering creative and flexible customer solutions
  • To hand over customer relationship properly to their relationship managers after closing sales
  • To provide excellent services to customers and ensure all enquiries and complaints are accurately and effectively resolved to customers' satisfaction
  • To participate actively in team building activities to share information/ideas while contributing suggestions for work improvement
  • Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

  • University degree or above (recognized by the state)
  • Strong interpersonal skills and effective presentation skills
  • Well-developed service and sales attitude with ability to work under pressure
  • Presentable, Outgoing and Persuasive
  • Good oral and written English is preferable

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  • Knowledge of the constantly changing laws/regulations governing banks/finance industry, consumer trends, competitor offerings, economic and foreign currency markets

  • Objection handling techniques and work under pressure

ln:4464319794.descriptionHtml:
GCOO - Asia & Middle East COO

Our GCOO organisation is critical for HSBC. This team partners closely with business teams to drive simplification and deliver exceptional customer outcomes in Asia and the Middle East region which covers 26 markets, 600+ offices and branches, and more than 140,000 employees. By strengthening our control environment and enhancing risk management, we drive operational excellence and enable the bank to deliver focused and sustainable growth in this super-region.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Document management - disseminating information, drafting presentations and documents file and document management
  • Data processing - data entry, basic data analysis
  • Record administration – maintaining records, information resources and data sources
  • Co-ordination - coordinating activities, arranging resources, meetings, services and supplies
  • Research - carrying out non-specialist research
  • Control - gatekeeper or primary point of contact roles for an area
  • Assisting with the execution of business initiatives and activities in support of business or geographic area aims.
  • Support in business planning activities which may include financial, technological and resource planning.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor or Master degree graduates
  • One to three years working experience
  • Proficient in Chinese and English Language, both written and spoken. Good presentation skills.
  • To meet customers’ expectations by delivering excellent services.
  • Good business acumen, customer-oriented attitude, strong analytic and reasoning skills
  • Good potential on management and decision making skills
  • Good communication skills and has the ability to build relationship and work with a wide range of organizations and individuals.
  • Strong implementation ability and influencing others cross-functionally to deliver on results.
  • Ability to think broadly and still achieve a high attention to details.

Principal responsibilities

  • Work on client strategic reviews for priority clients, which include discussions with different product partners to prepare follow-ups and achieve the client plan
  • Work with relationship managers (RMs) to create pitch decks for client meetings, one-pagers, and tailored content for specific sectors
  • Work on deals by understanding client needs, running internal deal profitability tools as required, and coordinating with internal teams such as credit, risk, onboarding etc for deal execution
  • Prepare client portfolio analyses focused on returns against plan, with breakdowns by products, regions, and sectors to provide insights for senior management
  • Negotiate client documents such as NDAs, ISDAs, GMRAs, and others by coordinating with internal teams such as legal, treasury, and risk
  • Undertake thought leadership projects by working on client-relevant themes and preparing pitch books to help RMs originate business
  • Demonstrate working knowledge of data concepts like data quality, basic statistics/visualization and AI concepts with the ability to use approved tools to support day-to-day work
  • Understand and ensure compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations, and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business

Will Also Be Required To

  • Undergo continuous learning and enhance job-specific skills over time
  • May be required to travel overseas as per business needs
  • Proactively suggest and design improvements in process workflows, where applicable
  • Take ownership of work and demonstrate high execution capabilities

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Support peers in managing day-to-day workstreams as required
  • Become a subject matter expert in respective client sectors
  • Act as a role model for our Group Values and Behaviors, supporting colleagues and customers
  • Support the achievement of team objectives and participate in the development of cohesive teams
  • Contribute to the creation of a supportive work environment driven by people-centric values
  • Build professional relationships with colleagues in other areas

Requirements

  • Exceptionally qualified MBAs and CAs with Big 4 (EY, PwC, Deloitte, KPMG) experience
  • Ability to establish rapport with team members and product partners
  • Excellent quantitative and analytical skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills, coupled with the ability to succeed within a matrix management structure and build and maintain global team relationships
  • Highly proficient in Excel, PowerPoint and Word
  • Good at multitasking
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Highly motivated; strong work ethic; thrives under pressure, confident, team player

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

 Business: Equities & X Asset Fin Tech

Job ID: 58966

Principal Responsibilities

  • Work with the product owner and Back Office Dev Lead to ensure that development work on GCP platform is well communicated, managed and delivered on time and with quality.
  • Lead the software development on GCP platform and ensure that high levels of automation are implemented and maintained for build, deploy, test and release.
  • Accountable for ensuring compliance of the GCP applications and services with mandatory and regulatory requirements, control objectives in the risk and control framework and technical currency (in line with published standards and guidelines) and, with the architecture function, implementation of the business imperatives.

  • Accountable for maintaining and enhancing our GCP platform continously, ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of our data analytics.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Proficient Java programming skills and GCP working experience.
  • Extensive experience designing, implementing, and optimizing ETL workflows using BigQuery.
  • Hands-on experiences on GCP auto build and deployment pipelines and autorelease processes.
  • Deep understanding of data warehousing principles and practices.
  • Experience with SQL query optimization and performance tuning in BigQuery
  • Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and the ability to leverage GCP services for data processing and analysis
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex data issues.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, IT architect, and business stakeholders. Fluent oral and written English is required.

ln:4462955892.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • Designs and implements robust technical solutions that enable critical business operations and enhance customer experience. Ensures system reliability, security, and performance standards are met while driving innovation and operational efficiency. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures that support the bank's digital transformation objectives.

Key Responsibilities

We are seeking a talented and motivated senior JAVA software engineer to join a high performing Scrum team to roll out new digital solution for customers. The candidate must be a skilled professional who has high availability software development experience with a desire to work on an Agile, dynamic and flat organisational structure

  • Design and develop the business logic and backend systems of the product
  • Work closely with frontend developers to design and develop functional, performing and complete APIs
  • Decipher existing companies’ software systems and be able to hook in application to applicable data sources
  • Write both unit and integration tests, and develop automation tools for daily tasks
  • Develop high quality, well documented, and efficient code
  • Challenge ideas and opinions to avoid pitfalls and inefficient solutions
  • Collaborate with product managers and other tech leads to ensure applications meet functional requirements and strategic objectives.
  • Perform code reviews to guarantee quality and promote a culture of technical excellence in Java development.

Skills And Experience

  • Java
  • Spring/SpringBoot
  • Restful API
  • Docker/K8s
  • Postgre/DB2/Oracle
  • Maven/Gradle
  • DevOps/ADO

Motivations

  • Environment: Collaborative, matrix environments where building relationships across functions is essential for success Dynamic settings with competing priorities that require strong organizational and time management skills Inclusive team cultures that value diverse perspectives and encourage open dialogue
  • Outcomes: Delivering high-quality solutions that directly impact business objectives and client satisfaction Contributing to process improvements that enhance team efficiency and reduce operational risk Building sustainable systems and practices that create long-term organizational value]
  • Challenges: Complex problem-solving that requires both analytical thinking and creative approaches Stakeholder management situations requiring influence without direct authority Technical challenges that push the boundaries of current capabilities and require continuous learning
  • Growth: Opportunities to develop both technical depth and business breadth Mentoring and knowledge-sharing that contributes to team capability building Exposure to emerging technologies and industry best practices

Qualifications

  • We are seeking a talented and motivated senior JAVA software engineer to join a high performing Scrum team to roll out new digital solution for customers. The candidate must be a skilled professional who has high availability software development experience with a desire to work on an Agile, dynamic and flat organisational structure.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or related field, with preference given to advanced degrees.
  • Minimum experience of 5 years in Java application development.
  • Proficient in RESTful API, SOAP, JDK, SpringBoot 3.x, k8s, JUnit.
  • Should have knowledge on Relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and/or No-SQL Databases and ability to write basic SQL queries.
  • Preferred to have knowledge on API Gateways, API security, SSL, OAuth 2, etc.
  • Develop and maintain messaging services using JMS/Solace/Kafaka.
  • Should be independently able to manage CICD tasks using Git, Azure DevOps (ADO), Maven, Ansible, and Helm Charts
  • Experienced in Container Infrastructure such as Docker, Linux, Kubernetes, OCP or AWS EKS or Azure AKS. Implement microservices architecture to ensure scalability and maintainability.
  • Have a high enthusiasm for programming and new technology learning, have a strong learning ability.
  • Fluent English speaking/listening/reading/writing. Mandarin or Cantonese language ability will be an advantage.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4462929717.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

We are seeking for an experience AI Platform Engineer to design, develop and maintain hybrid AI Platform across multi-cloud and on-premises. Build an AI platform that enables real time machine learning and GenAI at scale along with governance and security frameworks.

Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Responsible for designing and delivering hybrid AI Platform
  • Ensure AI platform delivery and services meet security and risk requirements and operational SLA

Business

  • Awareness how AI Platform works for the bank

Processes

  • Responsible for developing new feature for AI Platform, ensure high availability of the platform

People & Talent

  • Experience for designing, managing and maintaining Cloud and On-Premises Platform
  • Experience on working with implementing AI Platform on physical servers e.g. Dell, HP etc.
  • Hands on experience on working AWS, Azure Cloud Platforms
  • Hands on experience on infrastructure as a code tools like Terraform, Bicep, Cloud Formation, ARM Templates etc
  • Hands on experience in AWS EKS / Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
  • Deep Understanding of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning concepts.
  • Hands-on Experience on implementing MLOps and LLMOps frameworks
  • Hands-on experience on managing Databricks Platform
  • Hand-on experience on integrating open-source libraries like Unity Catalog, MLFlow, KubeFlow
  • Finetuning and Optimizing usage of GPU accelerated machine learning algorithms.
  • Designing and developing Ray Clusters whilst optimizing GPU usage
  • Experience for implementing data pipelines using tools like Apache Airflow or equivalent.
  • Experience for programming languages like Python\Golang.

Risk Management

  • The ability to identify key issue and develop new feature for the platform.

Governance

  • Ensure AI platform delivery and services meet security and risk requirements and operational SLA

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholders

  • TTO Management Team

  • Drive adoption of best practices in code quality, testing, and deployment
  • Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning

Development & Implementation

  • Build robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies
  • Implement secure, efficient database designs and optimize query performance
  • Develop event-driven architectures using messaging systems (Solace, Kafka)
  • Integrate with third-party systems and external APIs following banking industry standards
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with front-end developers, SRE, QA, BA, product managers, and business stakeholders
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Lead technical discussions and facilitate knowledge sharing sessions
  • Participate in technical interviews and contribute to team building initiatives

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure all backend systems comply with banking regulations and security standards
  • Implement comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and methodologies
  • Maintain high standards of documentation for systems and processes
  • Support production systems and participate in on-call rotations when required

Skills And Experience

  • Java (Spring Boot)
  • Relational DB
  • MQ
  • Logging, Monitoring and Alerts
  • Design Pattern
  • API

Qualifications

Technical Expertise

  • 5-8 years of experience in backend development with strong Java expertise
  • Proficiency in Spring Framework (Spring Boot)
  • Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (Redis)
  • Extensive experience with messaging systems (Solace, Apache Kafka)
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with API design and development (REST, GraphQL)

Professional Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking capabilities
  • Experience working in agile development environments
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to explain complex technical concepts

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • Banking or financial services domain knowledge advantageous

  • Knowledge of performance optimization and system scalability techniques
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack)

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

Origination

  • Identify prospect and convert in line with Bank’s appetite.
  • Ensure quality of the sales pitch and lead them with the clients. Also review the Term sheets before delivering to clients.
  • Engagement and Coordination of Product Partners for marketing efforts and deal structuring.
  • Work with CA and obtain all pre-deal clearances.
  • Effectively use RM Workbench for managing a healthy pipeline and also a record of client calls and discussions.
  • Drive client events / entertainments by coordinating with internal stakeholders and with client(s).
  • Oversee ARM to ensure smooth on-boarding of client after thorough completion of documentation and other processes.
  • Senior client calling and briefing on a regular basis for account maintenance and deal negotiation. Responsible for preparing briefing notes for senior management calls. Also engage senior internal stakeholders for marketing, credit and any other pertinent issues.
  • Internal coordination for cross / up selling.

  • Identify prospect and convert in line with Bank’s appetite.

  • Drive client events / entertainments by coordinating with internal stakeholders and with client(s).
  • Oversee ARM to ensure smooth on-boarding of client after thorough completion of documentation and other processes.
  • Senior client calling and briefing on a regular basis for account maintenance and deal negotiation. Responsible for preparing briefing notes for senior management calls. Also engage senior internal stakeholders for marketing, credit and any other pertinent issues.
  • Internal coordination for cross / up selling.

Processes

Client on-boarding & deal excecution

  • Work closely with CA, product partners, GAM / FAM and analyze:
  • Wallet size;
  • Determine appropriateness of the product and deal structuring; and
  • Work out a comprehensive account plan.
  • Successfully negotiate and close out pricing and other deal dynamics with client.
  • Oversee the quality & turnaround of credit proposal and ensure faster delivery. Work with CA for resolving credit queries, reviewing & supporting BCAs.
  • Oversee the ARM to ensure all documentation and security creation are completed on time to ensure smooth execution of transaction.
  • Liaising with client / legal / external counsel / CDU / CRC in preparation and execution of non standard complex transactions along with product partners.
  • Work with CDD team leader to ensure the proper completion of eCDDs.

Account Management & portfolio quality

  • Along with the product partner, push for line utilization of complex and structured transactions. Oversee the ARM in ensuring high utilization of regular working capital facilities.
  • Work with CA to monitor lending RWA and overall RoRWA at account level.
  • Review failed trade status, EAR, ASTAR, CCRT, etc with the CA to ensure discipline and quality in portfolio.
  • Review the excess/past due situation with ARM to ensure they are regularized and also facilitate approvals wherever required.
  • Review and monitor the client profitability to ensure there are no revenue leakages.
  • Attend various internal or external sales / non sales meetings like EAR, MTM calls, Portfolio Review Meeting etc. and convene the consortium meetings where we are the lead bank.
  • Overall responsible and accountable for the credit quality of the assigned / acquired portfolio.
  • Ensuring timely exit of clients, RoRWA monitoring and tail management.
  • Front internal and external auditing and oversee CA and ARM to follow up audit issues.
  • Overall responsible and accountable for Working Capital Loan and Fixed Asset Loan post drawdown monitoring.
  • Achieve individual sales targets on revenue, asset and liability footing while contributing towards team’s overall budget by:
  • Effectively generating new business – identify prospects and convert in line with the Bank’s appetite
  • Strategically formulating account plan – provide clients needs-based solutions, structure appropriate credit facility, and execute various banking transactions
  • Proactively building trusted client relationships – maintain a portfolio of active and growing customers

Adhoc projects, duties, assignment

  • From time to time, due to exigencies of service, you may be required to take on additional duties, projects or assignments as determined by your supervisor.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Excellent financial analysis skills
  • Sound product knowledge
  • Decent command of English as a language
  • Client origination capability

ln:4462945658.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • An experienced skilled technology expert who manages the technical delivery, works with multiple squads or hives to deliver complex features, epics and releases.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Develop and drive application strategy and roadmap in collaboration with the Domain Tech Lead.
  • Ensure the technical consistency of solutions in the Hive with the business architecture, technology architecture and enterprise technology standards.
  • Execute the Hive’s product vision with the Hive Leads.
  • Collaborate with Hive Lead and DTL on technology roadmap.
  • Communicate technical feasibility and constraints, articulate clear explanation of technical issues to stakeholders.

Business

  • Support business in appropriate sequencing of the backlog, refinement, and rationalization through a technical lens.
  • Perform solution sizing, design detailed technological solutions for platforms, applications, or collections of applications.
  • Deliver solution intent (SI) and application designs, produce clear and comprehensive design and solution intent documents.
  • Collaborate with IT Change and Release Managers to develop strategic delivery and release plans with technical dependencies.
  • Proactively identify cross-hive or squad dependencies and risks, and develop mitigation plans to address them without waiting for formal planning sessions.
  • Develop change implementation, release plans, and run books with technical dependencies, aligning all partners with support from the squad and architect.

Technical Leadership

  • Influence prioritization for technology backlog and strategic initiatives.
  • Incorporate considerations of technical debt into the roadmap alongside customer outcomes, ensuring a balanced approach to long-term sustainability.
  • Align detailed technical solutions with strategic roadmaps, long-term architecture and product/platform vision and with overall organization's technology direction and standards.
  • Support the squad in clearly slice the back log into independently shippable experience for customers and responsible for technical delivery and technical excellence across the squads.
  • Identify and address technical and design dependencies to enhance the speed and quality of delivery, ensuring smooth delivery.
  • Accountable to work with technical counterparts to mitigate technical debt and balance risk, and regulatory items with new features, functionality, or changes to keep the cost of change low.
  • Responsible to work in partnership with technology to ensure a balance of functional and non-functional requirements are represented in the backlog and that there is an approach to mitigate or avoid technical debt.
  • Lead the squad in defining both functional and non-functional requirements, ensuring critical aspects like API response times and overall system performance are met.
  • Act as an expert for resolving technical and design issues.
  • Drive an accountable and sensible technical direction to build reusable, scalable and interoperable solutions that integrate with existing investments.

Processes

  • Regularly reviews squad metrics in regard to Predictability, Quality, Squad Sentiment and supports the team to better value delivery.
  • Work with chapters to promote quality engineering, technical craftsmanship and drive solution standardization and service reusability.

People & Talent

  • Contribute to technical innovation and share knowledge within the engineering community.
  • Stay updated on emerging technologies, lead internal workshops and seminars, encourage team participation in innovation initiatives.

Vendor Management

  • Collaborate with vendors to integrate vendor deliverables with internal systems and resolve any issues impacting delivery.
  • Drive POC or RFP and vendor evaluation exercise along with PO to ensure SCB technical standards are evaluated.

Governance

  • Oversee the implementation of microservices architecture where applicable.
  • Design APIs and ensure they are secure, scalable, and well-documented according to standards.
  • Manage and mitigate technical risks in the delivery.
  • Present Solutions to the architecture review forum.
  • Align with technology architects on the target solution design to minimize technical debt.
  • Align technical solutions and the applications with established security control requirements, ensuring compliance and risk mitigation to avoid potential penalties.
  • Collaborate with Security Champions to identify and implement the necessary security controls tailored to the specific delivery or process.
  • Identify Applicable Security controls by engaging with Security Champs
  • Review and approve the chapter 1, 2 & 3 of the Solution Intent within the eSDLC framework before it proceeds to Domain or Country Architect approval.
  • Comply with System Delivery controls and attest for it with every (technical) release to production.
  • Complete comprehensive security impact assessments to ensure compliance with governance requirements and mitigate potential risks.
  • Ensure compliance with bank compliance guidelines & standards (e.g., data protection), address tech compliance (ESDLC) requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • API & Microservices
  • Container Platforms (OpenShift, Kubernetes)
  • Database Technologies (SQL, NoSQL)
  • Integration Technologies
  • Agile Methodologies, Lean Framework
  • DevOps Engineering

Qualifications

  • Graduation or Post-Graduation in Computer Science Engineering
  • Experience in the software development using Agile methodologies
  • Knowledge & Experience in practising Agile & Lean framework
  • Knowledge & Experience in the API & Microservices
  • Knowledge & Experience in J2EE and good understanding of OOA and OOP
  • Knowledge & Experience in Integration technologies – MQ, Kafka, Solace
  • Knowledge / Experience in Container platform and Cloud technologies
  • Knowledge / Experience in DevOps & SRE
  • Experiences with relational databases and NOSQL databases
  • More than 10+ years’ experience in software development domain
  • Proven experience in solution management, business development, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of the software development life cycle and experience with agile methodologies
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with clients and partners
  • Strong project management skills and experience leading cross-functional teams
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong understanding of technology and the ability to learn new technologies quickly

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4462938666.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Scope of Role:

To lead BDE team to achieve the team sales target by maximizing existing customers/acquisition/referral opportunities and providing quality customer service.

职责范围：

领导BDE团队开拓新客户，并通过提供优质客户服务进行交叉销售最终实现团队销售目标。

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities/Challenges:

  • To manage the day-to-day planning, operations and problem-solving of Salesperson
  • To ensure that Salespersons achieve specified sales targets and service standards.
  • To conduct staff meetings and provide support / updates for sales promotion and activities, procedural changes, management directives, etc.
  • To ensure Salesperson meets with internal control, compliance and audit standards.
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties.
  • To train and develop new sales staff.
  • To develop action plans to improve team performance.
  • To provide coaching and mentoring to Salesperson to facilitate staff retention.
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control
  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of the event over which the employee has the duties of management and/or leadership
  • Be responsible for significant losses due to failure of effectiveness of internal control

主要职责/挑战：

  • 管理销售人员的日常计划、运营和问题解决
  • 确保销售人员达到规定的销售目标和服务标准。
  • 召开员工会议，为促销和活动、程序变更、管理指令等提供支持/更新。
  • 确保销售人员符合内部控制、合规和审计标准。
  • 在履行职责时负责执行和遵守反洗钱要求。
  • 培训和培养新的销售人员。
  • 制定行动计划以提高团队绩效。
  • 为销售人员提供指导，以促进员工的稳定性。
  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。
  • 正确履行管理职责，并确保内控的效率；
  • 对负有管理和/或领导责任的事项引起或相关的违反监管规定事件或风险，承担相应责任。

Key Responsibilities

As a Product Owner in our cross-functional squads, the candidate will drive the outcomes of the squad to deliver on their objectives and key results. You will build and prioritise the product backlog to achieve business goals and manage stakeholder relationships to align expectation, prioritisation and overall product roadmap.

Strategy

  • The primary purpose of this position is to develop and transform Capital Markets Products & Solutions (CMPS) product capability to provide digital channels for both clients and internal users across Private Banking and Retail Banking.
  • The Bank is aiming to grow product capability through digital and self-direct channels. This Product Owner (PO) role is to drive the agile technology projects to establish a robust price discovery and execution platform. It is also required to build system interface with upstream systems (e.g. client information check) and downstream systems (e.g. booking trades into core banking platforms) to streamline operation flow and improve users (including clients) experience and frontline productivity.
  • As PO, you will develop and maintain a vision for agile technology projects and be responsible for communicating the vision to the scrum team. Be responsible for agile technology projects and features from concept to final implementation. In particular,
  • Have a good understanding of wealth management products, it's processes and relevance to clients.
  • Define and own the strategic digital product vision and roadmap for the wealth management product suite.
  • Align product strategy with business goals, market trends, and client needs.
  • Develop a competitive product strategy across relevant asset classes (such as FX, equities, fixed income, structured products, OTC derivatives, funds, and insurance.)
  • Monitor market dynamics and regulatory changes, ensuring products remain competitive and compliant.
  • As PO you will work with architects, business stakeholders and development teams to ensure that business, quality and functional goals are met with each release. Be responsible for the design, usability, quality and delivery of agile technology projects and features.
  • As the subject matter expert, this role is to determine business requirements, review technology project plans from the business perspective, and ensure new technology capabilities are embedded in business processes to deliver benefits. Ensure smooth execution on the ground, and communicate the changes delivered to relevant stakeholders including front office.

Business

  • Review and understand key business policies and processes in Wealth Management in offering CMPS products and services to both private banking and retail banking clients. Identify critical pain-points and articulate how planned / in-flight technology projects will solve them.
  • As Product Owner (PO), specialized in Digital platforms, should be familiar with the development of CMPS order management/ execution platforms and ensure that it is properly interfaced with multiple downstream booking systems.
  • The PO should have strong technical knowhow to improve front office systems performance and expand product penetration according to the business development.

Processes

  • The PO is the key decision maker on priorities and design decisions, and work to ensure that all stakeholders are aligned at each stage of the agile development lifecycle (when a new project is created). The PO also needs to understand both the engineering and business side of releases and be ultimately responsible for representing the end user’s needs.
  • Provide business input on requirements to the technology project teams. Work with subject-matter experts in product teams, front office and operations on requirements (e.g., a new electronic workflow to simplify layers of checking, or to auto-populate repeated fields in client forms). Prioritise “must have” items vs. “good to have”.
  • Review technology plans and design specifications, to ensure business requirements are met and that benefits will be delivered. Identify impact on critical processes within the Bank’s operational risk framework and work with process owners and project teams to ensure robust controls.
  • Work with technology project teams to develop test plans. Co-ordinate business users to test new platforms or technology features that are developed. Ensure final delivery meets user needs.
  • Work with stakeholders in the front, middle and back offices to ensure successful “go live” of projects, from the business perspective. Develop training material, co-ordinate briefings, design and execute communication plans. Gather feedback post-implementation, and track benefits captured.
  • Participate in project review meetings and identify/highlight any potential issue that may impact project’s cost, timeline and/or scope and work with concerned stakeholders for its early resolution to bring back the project on track.
  • Conduct periodic briefings to senior management on progress of technology projects, from the business perspective. Highlight issues that require resolution.

People & Talent

  • Work towards strengthening the performance culture and reinforcement of accountabilities in products. Sharing the technical skills and experience with other team members.

Risk Management

  • Embed a risk culture that supports the Bank’s strategy and philosophy for the management of risk.
  • Ensure that effective arrangements are in place within WM in the region for the prevention of money laundering in line with the Group Policy and Standards, respective country regulatory guidelines and local legal requirements. In particular, ensure that the obligations on reporting suspicious activities are met.
  • Ensure that Risk Management matters that are brought to the job holder’s attention are subject to direct remedial action and/or ensure adequate reporting to the relevant Risk Committees

Governance

  • At all times have an awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Lead the business to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Regional and Country Wealth Management Heads and WM Product Managers.
  • Key markets Segment Heads, IAs and RMs
  • Market/Credit/Operational Risk, Legal, Compliance, Middle Office and COO team

Other Responsibilities

  • Perform other responsibilities assigned by Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • To achieve other business and non-financial objectives
  • To drive the Bank’s strategy and franchise development
  • To ensure that the business is conducted in an operationally robust environment
  • To ensure compliance with regulations and controls as set by the Bank and external regulatory authorities

Skills And Experience

  • Strong risk evaluation experience in Capital Markets / Wealth Management products
  • An ideal candidate should have 5 years of experience in technology & business
  • Extensive knowledge in financial market products

Qualifications

  • Education: Relevant degree from reputable university
  • Training: Project Management / System Development or equivalent mandatory & developmental – role specific and regulatory/compliance bank wide specific
  • Language: Proficient English
  • Minimum of 5-8 years of experience in wealth management, investment banking, or financial services.
  • Good understanding of wealth management products and asset classes (example FX, equities, fixed income, structured products, OTC derivatives, funds, and insurance.)
  • Relevant knowledge of regulatory and operational frameworks in wealth management.
  • Preferred: Understanding of global wealth management market trends.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

About the Role

BBVA is seeking an experienced corporate loan professional to support the growth of its Corporate Lending franchise in China. Based in Shanghai, the successful candidate will play a pivotal role in accelerating the origination, structuring, and execution of corporate lending transactions across Mainland China.

Position level (VP or SVP) will be determined based on the selected candidate’s depth of experience and interview assessment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Originate corporate lending opportunities across Mainland China, including syndicated, club, bilateral, sustainable, and event-driven financings.
  • Structure bespoke financing solutions tailored to clients’ strategic objectives, capital structures, and risk profiles.
  • Prepare high-quality pitch books, proposals, and marketing materials to secure mandates and convert opportunities into executed transactions.
  • Negotiate commercial terms, covenants, and security packages with clients.
  • Draft, review, and finalize loan documentation and syndication materials, including term sheets, mandate letters, facility agreements, information memoranda, bank meeting presentations and financial models.
  • Prepare and present comprehensive transaction proposals to business and credit committees, clearly articulating deal structures, key risks, and lending considerations.
  • Take ownership of day-to-day transaction execution, coordinating closely with internal teams (Client Coverage, Loan Syndicate & Sales, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Tax, Sustainable Finance, Markets, and Operations) and external stakeholders (clients, partner banks, and legal counsel) to ensure seamless delivery.
  • Work with senior team members and coach junior team members, fostering high-performance deal execution capabilities and a collaborative team environment.



Qualification & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics or a related discipline
  • Minimum of 8+ years of corporate loan origination, structuring and execution experience


Knowledge & Skills

  • Track Record: Proven history of originating, negotiating and executing complex syndicated and bilateral loan mandates in the Chinese market.
  • Technical Expertise: Advanced credit analysis, debt structuring, financial modeling and loan documentation skills.
  • Regulatory & Market Knowledge: Sound understanding of China’s corporate debt market (both onshore and offshore), and relevant regulatory frameworks.
  • Soft Skills: Collaborative team player with outstanding interpersonal and presentation abilities; highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multi-stream transactions under tight timeframes.


Language

  • Native or professional fluency in both Mandarin and English (written and spoken) is required
