ln:4458598512.descriptionHtml:
About The Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 31 December 2026

Job Description

Title SI Solutions - Senior Analyst

Department Asset Management CAO

Location Dalian

Level: 3

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

About Your Team

Asset Management CAO team is responsible front to back, for the operational and supporting capabilities across investment management. The Investment Management Solutions team is a cross asset delivery & support function driving collaboration, consistency & execution across the global asset management platform. The team drives strategic initiatives, provide support services enabling our investment team, and partners with our investment leaders to strengthen oversight, risk controls & regional regulatory engagement. Within the IM Solutions function the Sustainable Investing Solutions team is responsible for supporting global FIL’s proxy voting activities as well as core governance & reporting activates underpinning FIL’s sustainable investment approach.

About Your Role

As the SI Solutions - Senior Analyst you will be responsible for maintaining documentation, executing core reporting responsibilities, designing & developing automated tools & capability to reduce manual processes for more efficiency and higher accuracy, and provide technical support on database management and business analysis. This role will support FIL’s investment, client services & workplace investing teams to produce reporting, analysis and data used to understand, describe & demonstrate FIL’s approach to sustainable investing.

About You

The successful candidate will be expected to develop a deep understanding of our current & future capabilities, FIL’s product & operational platform. The role will execute a variety of reporting-based deliveries across a broad stakeholder base, actively monitor the overall status of documentation, and proactively prepare & renew essential authorization documents. With the growing understanding on Sustainable Investing reporting functions, the role is expected to work with related stakeholders to deliver technical deliverables on different types of data warehouse related requirements and automation requirements. As data sets & global regulations focused on Sustainable Investing continues to rapidly develop, you will be expected to learn, adapt & evolve deliverables to meet evolving requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collate information and data from voting platforms, internal records, and some from third-parties to produce voting and engagement reports.
  • Production of public voting activity disclosure reporting to meet regulations and local stewardship codes.
  • Produce climate reporting & quarterly reporting for Global Platform Solutions.
  • Identify automation opportunities and lead implementation where needed.
  • Support on database development, management, processing and optimizing.
  • Coordinate communications from the investment team and client services on sustainable reporting.
  • Assist on fund screening, bespoke exclusion reporting, and maintenance of supporting processes.
  • Produce data & reports as well as other administrative tasks required to integrate client facing vendor platforms
  • Assist on general ESG reporting projects and requirements.
  • Maintaining POA documentation and take end to end ownership of all processes.
  • Develop & maintain consolidated, auditable process documentation library.
  • Identify, drive and contribute to continuous process improvement.

Experience And Qualifications Required

  • Data analytical and automation skills - Python, SQL, PowerBI is required, experience of developing automation tool based on business requirement is highly preferred.
  • Experience with data management tool and database platoform - Snowflake, Azure, etc. is preferred
  • Highly efficient English communication skills in both writing and speaking. Japanese Language skills is preferred.
  • Background in finance related functions or business data reporting & support management is required.
  • Highly sufficient skills in Microsoft Excel, PPT is required.
  • Experience or qualifications within Sustainable Investment subject matters preferred.
  • Experience as Project Manager, Business Analyst, SME is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated learning ability and interest in Investment knowledge. CFA related certificate is highly preferred.
  • Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail and dedication to manage tight deadlines
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, and highly developed teamwork skills
  • Global stakeholder management and global collaboration model experience is highly preferred.
  • A good team player with open-minded, flexible and positive attitude for changes.
  • Self-disciplined and self-motivated to drive business result with a clear career plan.
  • Able to manage stakeholder and deliver high quality work under pressure.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

The team drives strategic initiatives, provide support services enabling our investment team, and partners with our investment leaders to strengthen oversight, risk controls & regional regulatory engagement. Within the IM Solutions function the Sustainable Investing Solutions team is responsible for supporting global FIL’s proxy voting activities as well as core governance & reporting activates underpinning FIL’s sustainable investment approach.

About Your Role

As the SI Solutions - Senior Analyst, you will play a key role in supporting the firm’s stewardship activities. Your responsibilities will include analyzing shareholder meeting agendas, providing insightful voting recommendations, and executing high‑quality, timely proxy votes in alignment with the firm’s policies and fiduciary duties. You will also contribute to policy development and ongoing process improvements. In this role, you will collaborate closely with investment teams, Sustainable Investing analysts, and proxy service providers to strengthen the firm’s governance framework and enhance our stewardship outcomes.

About You

The successful candidate will be a detail‑oriented governance professional with demonstrated expertise in applying in‑house voting policies and conducting precise research on investee AGM/EGM agendas. This role requires performing accurate analysis in complex or non‑standard voting scenarios and consistently delivering timely, high‑quality voting instructions. With a growing understanding of Sustainable Investing functions, the candidate is expected to operate with strong process discipline, overseeing end‑to‑end vote execution, quality assurance, and pipeline management. As the global regulations related to Sustainable Investing continue to evolve rapidly, the candidate must be able to learn, adapt, and refine deliverables to meet emerging requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze FIL Investee companies’ global shareholder meeting agendas, focusing on complex corporate governance, remuneration, and ESG related proposals.
  • Conduct researches and FIL voting policy application by leveraging FIL’s research capabilities, in-house voting policy, and external research resources to make thorough and informed voting recommendations for Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team.
  • Assist Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team in engagement activities with investee companies on governance and sustainability topics.
  • Handle end-to-end vote execution processes to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on proxy voting and corporate governance, oversee and support non-standard and client-specific voting requirements, resolving complex voting instructions, operational exceptions and market-specific issues while maintaining appropriate controls and audit trails.
  • Coordinate with external proxy advisors, custodians, and voting platforms to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
  • Contribute to periodic reviews and updates of proxy voting policies and procedures. Monitor regulatory and market developments in governance, stewardship, and ESG.
  • Support the preparation of stewardship reports, respond to client inquiries, and complete regulatory disclosures.
  • Drive continuous improvement, data analytics and automation initiatives across proxy voting processes. Leverage Python, SQL, Power BI, AI tools or other technologies where appropriate to streamline workflows, strengthen controls and generate actionable insights.
  • Lead or contribute to the design and implementation of new operating models and controls, identifying opportunities to improve quality, scalability, risk management and operational efficiency.
  • Develop & maintain consolidated, auditable process documentation library.

Experience And Qualifications Required

  • Education in Finance, Business, Economics, Sustainability Investment or related field. Master degree is preferred.
  • Experience in researches and analysis in proxy voting, corporate governance, stewardship, ESG or Sustainable Investing is a strong plus.
  • Strong analytical and research skills with the ability to interpret corporate filings and governance documents.
  • Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and excellent attention to detail and accuracy in a high volume, deadline driven environment.
  • Data analytical and automation skills (Python/SQL/PowerBI), experience of developing automation for business processes is highly preferred.
  • Experience contributing to or leading projects, process improvements, business analysis or change initiatives. Experience acting as a Project Manager, Business Analyst or Subject Matter Expert is a strong advantage.
  • Proficient in using AI tools to improve efficiency, ensure accuracy, and solve business problems.
  • Highly efficient English communication skills, both written and verbal is mandatory.
  • Strong interest in investment management, corporate governance, stewardship and sustainable investing, with a commitment to maintaining and developing relevant market knowledge. CFA, FRM, CFA Institute Sustainable Investing Certificate or other relevant professional qualifications are advantageous.
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated experience working effectively within a global, cross-functional and collaborative operating model.
  • Global stakeholder management and global collaboration model experience is required. Proven record to manage stakeholder and deliver high quality work under pressure.
  • A good team player with open-minded, flexible and positive attitude for changes.
  • Self-disciplined and self-motivated to drive business result with a clear career plan.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

 Business: Fin, Supervision and TR Tech

Job ID: 57388

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own CCR input data quality end-to-end: sourcing, preparation, mapping, enrichment, and validation for trades, collateral, agreements/netting sets, counterparty reference data, and market data.
  • Translate business outcomes into clear technical requirements (definitions, assumptions, acceptance criteria, control totals, and signoffs).
  • Design and run data controls: completeness, consistency, timeliness, reconciliation, and explainability of exposure movements.
  • Partner with stakeholders (Traded Risk, XVA/Finance, Front Office, Collateral, etc.) to resolve breaks, agree “source of truth”, and deliver at pace.
  • Drive modernization: support migration to microservices, Kafka/event-driven patterns, and improved observability (logs/metrics/traces), across GCP and on‑prem.
  • Support production stability: incident triage, root-cause analysis, runbooks, cut-off management (EOD/intraday), and controlled releases.
  • Work closely with developers and quants integrating Java/Python services with in-house C++ analytics libraries.
  • Identify and deliver AI use cases across CCR IT processes (e.g., data quality triage, automated breaks classification, exposure movement explanation drafts, control optimization), prioritizing those with clear risk reduction and efficiency gains.
  • Build and embed “AI-assisted operations” into BAU:
  • auto-summarization of incidents and change requests,
  • faster root-cause hypothesis generation using logs/metrics/traces,
  • automated runbook recommendations and knowledge-based upkeep.
  • Apply ML / statistical techniques for proactive controls such as anomaly detection on feed volumes, data drifts, reconciliation breaks, unexpected exposure movements, and limit breaches (with transparent thresholds and human override).
  • Enable safe, controlled GenAI usage for technical and non-technical outputs: requirements drafting, test-case generation, release notes, reconciliation commentary, stakeholder updates—ensuring correctness, auditability, and appropriate approvals.
  • Partner with engineering, data, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions are compliant and production-ready (model monitoring, change control, access controls, traceability, and clear ownership).
  • Measure value and outcomes: define KPIs (time-to-triage, break backlog, control failure rates, manual effort saved) and continuously improve solutions based on evidence.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Strong experience in risk/finance technology with a focus on data pipelines and controls (trade + reference + market data).
  • Good working knowledge of CCR fundamentals: exposure/PFE concepts, collateral & CSA terms, close-out netting, and how results aggregate (trade → netting set → counterparty/group).
  • Experience clarifying requirements with senior stakeholders and communicating clearly in writing (decisions, assumptions, impact).
  • Hands-on engineering ability in Java and/or Python, plus solid SQL and data analysis skills.
  • Production mindset: troubleshooting, incident management, and building observable and auditable systems.
  • Practical experience applying AI to workflows (not just theory): automation of repetitive analysis, operational processes, or decision-support in a controlled environment.
  • Strong Python for AI-enabled engineering: working with notebooks and/or services, prompt engineering basics, and integrating AI components via APIs into existing systems/processes.
  • Ability to validate AI outputs: establishing human-in-the-loop checks, quality gates, evaluation metrics, and clear audit trails so outputs are explainable and trustworthy.
  • Structured problem-solving mindset: can translate messy operational pain points into automatable steps (process mapping, control points, data requirements).

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Experience with SA‑CCR implementation/support and/or CVA/XVA (including sensitivities).
  • Familiarity with Kafka, microservices patterns, schema versioning, and replay/idempotency.
  • Experience operating on GCP (and hybrid on‑prem/cloud setups).
  • Exposure to stress testing and regulatory reporting.
  • Experience with ML anomaly detection / time-series analysis for operational monitoring and data quality (e.g., drift, outlier detection, reconciliation break prediction).
  • Experience building internal tooling (e.g., workflow automation, ticket enrichment, knowledge search, runbook copilots) that improves team throughput.
  • Familiarity with model risk / AI governance concepts (e.g., monitoring, versioning, controlled rollout, documentation).

Job Board Tags

 /WX

/51

/LP

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；

审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；

持续关注市场变化和行业趋势，力争产品创新。

协助系统整合和升级，以确保高效运作。

根据当地法规要求和集团政策，持续检测和升级现有产品的功能、服务和工作流程，以改善客户体验。

Global Private Banking & Wealth

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. HSBC Private Banking helps high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients manage, grow, and preserve their wealth for generations to come. Our network of global experts helps clients access investment opportunities around the world, plan for future with wealth and succession planning, manage their portfolio with tailored solutions, and find the right support for their philanthropy.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Establish new private banking relationships and manage existing relationships in order to grow Assets Under Management and Revenue
  • Monitor clients’ portfolios on a regular basis to identify additional business opportunities and revenue growth potential
  • Work closely with other HSBC departments, including International Wealth and P remier Banking, Corporate and Institution Banking and Global Banking and Markets, to identify cross-selling opportunities and bring all of HSBC’s relevant products and services to our clients
  • Leverage HSBC’s channels, network and brand to pursue business development activities with a focus on International Private Wealth clients
  • Ensure strict compliance with HSBC’s internal control standards, including areas of risk, regulatory compliance and financial crime compliance

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

    • At least 8 years ’ relationship management experience, ideally in private banking, commercial banking or investment banking sectors
    • Proven track record in asset gathering, asset growth and revenue generation
    • Excellent communication and negotiation skills
    • Strong focus on client servicing
    • Excellent understanding of financial markets and wealth management products
    • Attention to detail and the ability to think creatively to solve problems
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID: 53995

Principal Responsibilities

Design and Develop ETL Processes:

  • Lead the design and implementation of ETL processes using all kinds of batch/streaming tools to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into GCP, and ETL technologies as Control-M, Datastage, Shell Scripting, Python are an added advantage for cloud migration projects.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and ensure that ETL solutions meet business needs.

Data Pipeline Optimization

  • Optimize data pipelines for performance, scalability, and reliability, ensuring efficient data processing workflows.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot ETL processes, proactively addressing issues and bottlenecks.

Data Integration And Management

  • Integrate data from diverse sources, including databases, APIs, and flat files, ensuring data quality and consistency.
  • Manage and maintain data storage solutions in GCP (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud Storage) to support analytics and reporting.

GCP Dataflow Development

  • Write Apache Beam based Dataflow Job for data extraction, transformation, and analysis, ensuring optimal performance and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with data analysts and data scientists to prepare data for analysis and reporting.

Automation And Monitoring

  • Implement automation for ETL workflows using tools like Apache Airflow or Cloud Composer, enhancing efficiency and reducing manual intervention.
  • Set up monitoring and alerting mechanisms to ensure the health of data pipelines and compliance with SLAs.

Data Governance And Security

  • Apply best practices for data governance, ensuring compliance with industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) and internal policies.
  • Collaborate with security teams to implement data protection measures and address vulnerabilities.

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of industry experience in data engineering or ETL development, with a strong focus on Data Stage and GCP.
  • Proven experience in designing and managing ETL solutions, including data modeling, data warehousing, and SQL development.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of GCP services (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub) and their application in data engineering.
  • Experience of cloud-based solutions, especially in GCP, cloud certified candidate is preferred.
  • Experience and knowledge of Bigdata data processing in batch mode and streaming mode, proficient in Bigdata eco systems, e.g. Hadoop, HBase, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka, Flink, Spark, etc.
  • Familiarity with Java & Python for data manipulation on Cloud/Bigdata platform.

Analytical Skills

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to analyze complex data sets and derive meaningful insights.

/WX

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director Software Engineering.

 Business: GTS Technology

Job ID: 57393

Principal Responsibilities

The role will be owning end-to-end delivery of change initiatives, ensuring scope, time, cost, quality, and risk are actively managed. Leads cross-functional teams to deliver measurable outcomes, removes blockers at pace, and provides clear governance, reporting, and stakeholder communication. Strong technical skills is preferred according to the complicate integrations among systems.

Delivery Leadership

  • Lead and manage the end-to-end delivery of engineering projects, ensuring alignment with business goals, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to define project scope, priorities, and deliverables.
  • Ensure delivery excellence by implementing best practices in software development, agile methodologies, and project management.

DORA Metrics Management

  • Monitor, analyze, and improve DORA metrics to measure and optimize software delivery performance.
  • Drive initiatives to enhance Deployment Frequency, reduce Lead Time for Changes, lower Change Failure Rate, and minimize Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR).
  • Identify bottlenecks in the delivery pipeline using data insights and implement solutions to improve efficiency and reliability.

Business Collaboration

  • Act as the primary interface between engineering teams and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment of technical solutions with business needs.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable engineering plans and ensure timely communication of progress, risks, and outcomes.
  • Provide regular updates to business leaders on delivery performance, including insights from DORA metrics and improvement initiatives.

Agile Practices

  • Champion agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) to foster a culture of continuous improvement and iterative delivery.
  • Facilitate agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, retrospectives, and stand-ups to ensure smooth team operations.

Team Leadership

  • Mentor and guide engineering teams to achieve delivery excellence and operational efficiency.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and innovation within the engineering organization.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Job ID: 51584

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design and develop cloud native software systems that are resilient, secure, fast, easy to manage, and scalable in modern, dynamic environments such as public cloud.

  • Optimize performance of complex systems

  • Work with business users for support or development queries

  • Provide estimates for development efforts from design documents

  • Possess a proven track record of driving strategic transformation initiatives, effectively translating strategy into actionable plans and ensuring successful implementation and adoption.

  • Good understanding of design on micro-service and containerization.
  • Strong experience delivering scalable solutions in finance industry area.

ln:4458711007.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Proactively manage a complex portfolio of clients, becoming a trusted advisor to lead strategic dialogues with clients at a portfolio level through the understanding of specific business requirements and delivering creative and flexible customer solutions
  • To hand over customer relationship properly to their relationship managers after closing sales
  • To provide excellent services to customers and ensure all enquiries and complaints are accurately and effectively resolved to customers' satisfaction- To participate actively in team building activities to share information/ideas while contributing suggestions for work improvement
  • Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University degree or above (recognized by the state)
  • Strong interpersonal skills and effective presentation skills
  • Well-developed service and sales attitude with ability to work under pressure- Presentable, Outgoing and Persuasive
  • Good oral and written English is preferable

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

CIB - Global Payments Solutions (GPS)

Global Payment Solutions (GPS) is made up of almost 10,000 colleagues across 58 countries and territories. This business is uniquely positioned to help clients make payments across borders, currencies and regulations, quickly and efficiently with dedicated in-country and regional support. Our expertise in this area is repeatedly recognised by the industry’s most prominent publications and associations with numerous global, regional, and country awards.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • To assist develop new corporate customer opportunities within your assigned region. Manage outbound initiatives to penetrate new markets and expand our footprint. Actively promote GPS products (A/R, A/P, Liquidity, Channel Management) to address specific client pain points, positioning HSBC as the partner of choice for cross-border transactional needs.
  • To track pipeline progress rigorously and analyze sales data to help with comprehensive account planning. Provide accurate forecasts and insights into leadership, ensuring alignment with regional sales targets and strategic goals.
  • To organize and execute high-impact events and marketing activities to elevate the GPS brand within the cash management business. Build and maintain long-term, trusted relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and retention.
  • To engage in sales playbooks, case studies, and industry insights with the wider GPS sales network to elevate team performance. Coordinate internal resources to meet tight deadlines and specific expectations.
  • To cross-team collaborate with GPS Product and Client Management teams to deliver tailored solutions. Act as the bridge between client needs and internal capabilities to ensure seamless service delivery.
  • To support other business-related tasks and admin stuff as required.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years related working experience, of which at least 3 years are related to transactional banking business or corporate relationship management, LC/MME client experience is a plus
  • Proactive, innovative and creative thinking
  • Strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills
  • Well organized and good attention to details
  • Self-motivated, desire to learn independently and work under high pressure
  • Good command of spoken and written English and Mandarin

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

 Business: Fin, Supervision and TR Tech

Job ID: 57390

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design, build and deliver AI solutions for prioritised business and technology use cases, from prototype through to production.
  • Partner with business and technology SMEs to translate processes into agent workflows, including decision points, approval gates, exception handling, and evidence requirements.
  • Build natural language interfaces that enable users to query, summarise, and explore risk data safely, accurately, and with appropriate controls; integrate AI agents with risk platforms and services.
  • Define and implement evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, explanation quality, hallucination risk, control effectiveness, task completion, latency, and cost.
  • Support production deployment and ongoing operations, including monitoring, observability, prompt/version control, regression testing, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure solutions comply with technology standards and relevant requirements across data privacy, information security, model risk, operational risk, and audit.
  • Coach and support other engineers, helping to uplift AI engineering standards and practices across the department.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, Software Engineering, or a related discipline; AI/ML-focused education is preferred.
  • Demonstrable hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying end-to-end AI-powered applications, including prompt engineering, tool/function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and structured outputs.
  • Strong grounding in machine learning fundamentals (supervised/unsupervised learning, evaluation methods, bias/variance trade-offs, and feature engineering).
  • Practical experience with model selection and deployment strategies (open-source vs hosted models), and fine-tuning approaches where appropriate.
  • Strong software engineering capability in Python and Java and/or TypeScript, with 5+ years’ experience delivering, operating, and supporting production systems.
  • Solid understanding of MLOps practices, including CI/CD, containerisation, automated testing, model registries, experiment tracking, and reproducible builds.
  • Experience with data engineering and feature engineering on large datasets, including metadata management, data lineage, and data quality controls.
  • Product mindset with strong stakeholder collaboration skills; able to translate business processes into agent workflows with clear, measurable outcomes (e.g., cycle time reduction, improved accuracy, higher containment).
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, particularly when dealing with ambiguous data issues and non-deterministic LLM behaviour; able to diagnose issues using logs, traces, and evaluation results.
  • Working knowledge of model risk management and Responsible AI, including prompt governance, AI observability, LLM evaluation, and operational risk considerations.

/LP

Job Summary

We are seeking a talented and motivated senior JAVA software engineer to join a high performing Agile team to roll out new digital solution for customers. The candidate must be a skilled professional who has high availability software development experience with a desire to work on an Agile, dynamic and flat organisational structure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop the business logic and backend systems of the product
  • Work closely with frontend developers to design and develop functional, performing and complete APIs
  • Decipher existing companies’ software systems and be able to hook in application to applicable data sources
  • Write both unit and integration tests, and develop automation tools for daily tasks
  • Develop high quality, well documented, and efficient code
  • Challenge ideas and opinions to avoid pitfalls and inefficient solutions
  • Collaborate with product managers and other tech leads to ensure applications meet functional requirements and strategic objectives.
  • Perform code reviews to guarantee quality and promote a culture of technical excellence in Java development.

Strategy

  • Responsible for the quality of the code repository where applicable.

Business

  • Deliver outputs that make a significant contribution to the organization's strategic goals.

Processes

  • Responsible in the preparation of production outputs and their planning in alignment to ESDLC standards.

People & Talent

  • Work on upskilling of technical expertise in line with latest market trend.

Risk Management

  • Mitigate delivery risks and issues, and ensure quality, affordability, and scope of delivery.

Governance

  • Ensure all artefacts and assurance deliverables are as per the required standards and policies

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Chapter Lead
  • Engineering Lead
  • Release Manager
  • Domain Architect
  • Business Leads / Product owners
  • Production Support

Skills And Experience

  • Spring Boot
  • Spring Framework
  • Hibernate / MyBatis
  • RESTful API
  • Problem Resolving
  • Container – OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes
  • DB2 / Oracle / PostgreSQL
  • Messaging – Queue, Topic
  • DevOps / ADO

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, with preference given to advanced degrees.
  • Minimum experience of 5 years in Java application development.
  • Proficient in RESTful API, SOAP, JDK, SpringBoot 3.x, k8s, JUnit.
  • Should have knowledge on Relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and/or No-SQL Databases and ability to write basic SQL queries.
  • Preferred to have knowledge on API Gateways, API security, SSL, OAuth 2, etc.
  • Develop and maintain messaging services using JMS/Solace/Kafaka.
  • Should be independently able to manage CICD tasks using Git, Azure DevOps (ADO), Maven, Ansible, and Helm Charts
  • Experienced in Container Infrastructure such as Docker, Linux, Kubernetes, OCP or AWS EKS or Azure AKS. Implement microservices architecture to ensure scalability and maintainability.
  • Have a high enthusiasm for programming and new technology learning, have a strong learning ability.
  • Fluent English speaking/listening/reading/writing. Mandarin or Cantonese language ability will be an advantage.
  • Language: English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4458171271.descriptionHtml:
Corporate and Institutional Banking

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

  • Drive inbound revenue by originating and deepening relationships with multinational corporations investing and expanding into mainland China.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of the assigned portfolio within the Global Network Banking unit of Corporate & Institutional Banking unit of Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) in China. Under the guidance of ling manager, assume responsibility for strategy execution, P&L and balance sheet management, funding, liquidity, risk control, and performance delivery, operating within the Group's defined risk appetite and strategic framework.
  • Act as the primary liaison for key overseas sites, facilitating the onboarding and banking support for global clients entering the China market. Champion the Global Network Banking proposition by coordinating with international HSBC teams to capture Foreign Direct Investment opportunities.
  • Formulate and execute business strategies to acquire new-to-bank overseas corporations with presence in China, while broaden existing relationships with multinational subsidiaries in China to ensure sustainable growth and support the Group's ambition to scale the CIB Banking franchise.
  • Collaborate closely with global/regional/Local product partners and Banking leaders to ensure a coordinated approach in targeting inbound investors, with a clear focus on maximizing business opportunities and returns.
  • Deliver best-in-class client experience to multinational corporations entering China, ensuring their cross-border banking needs are fully understood and met through strategic and complex financial solutions.
  • Maintain high-quality credit standards across the portfolio, safeguard the Bank against potential losses, uphold portfolio integrity, ensure full regulatory compliance, and mitigate operational, credit and other risks.
  • Achieve assigned key performance indicators, including revenue target, profitability, asset and liability balances, and Return on Risk Weighted Assets (RORWA).
  • Ultimately accountable for the risk profile of the assigned Global Network Banking portfolio, acting as the first line of defend in managing credit, compliance and financial crime risks.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Proven track record of progressive business development, sales, and credit experience or equivalent.
  • Extensive knowledge of, and proven business success with, banking products and services. Good knowledge of world class standards across the industry.
  • Possesses an entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset; optimises commercial opportunities to enhance value and returns; strong negotiation skills
  • Strong navigating skills including understanding of the strategic direction, ability of translating strategy into action, aligning and prioritising direction for self and team.
  • Relationship management experience.
  • Strong client engagement skills.
  • Understanding and experience with managing Multinational Corporates.
  • Strong strategic thinking, and organisational, analytical, negotiation, and influencing skills. A team player.
  • Excellent spoken and written English skill. Proficient in other languages will be an advantage.
  • Progressive banking experience, preferably within corporate banking or multinational corporate coverage.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4456874513.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Job Scope

  • SABRE (Standard Chartered Analytics Booking and Risk Engine) is the bank’s strategic platform for Financial Markets Risk and Valuations. It is entirely developed in house. SABRE is also the central data repository for all Financial Markets transactions providing information for regulatory and non-regulatory trade reporting purposes.
  • This role involves extending SABRE, which is a core component of the strategic architecture, to build a future-proof front to back strategic FM platform with an aim to migrate off legacy, obsolete and fragmented architecture to the new target platform to support the growing needs of FM business including regulatory reporting.

Job Purpose

  • Building strong, effective relationships with both the business and technology teams, across global offices.
  • Collaborating with trade platform teams, project teams and control functions to gather requirements, solve business problems by proposing relevant, innovative solutions.
  • Working as part of an agile team including Business Analysts, Developers and Testers and being able to identify business implications of technical design decisions and influence them accordingly.
  • Being a creative source of proposals and channelling user aspiration towards sustainable and future proof solutions.
  • Deliver functional consistency across the various projects by influencing architecture and design decisions.
  • Translating and documenting business requirements.
  • Working across asset classes of FX, ALM, Rates, Credits and Commodities.
  • Preferably strong expertise in confirmations / post trade space.

Diversity & Inclusion

  • Standard Chartered is committed to diversity and inclusion. We believe that a work environment which embraces diversity will enable us to get the best out of the broadest spectrum of people to sustain strong business performance and competitive advantage. By building an inclusive culture, each employee can develop a sense of belonging, and have the opportunity to maximize their personal potential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand user requirements and study the feasibility. Propose solutions that align to the strategic roadmap. Cleary document and agree on assumptions, shortfalls and timelines to resolve the known constraints and dependencies.
  • Pro-actively highlight risk and issues. Engage, manage and build strong relationships with both business and technology stakeholders.
  • Translate solutions into detailed, unambiguous, business and functional requirements.
  • Ensure the overall quality of business requirements, functional specifications and other supporting documents meet the bank’s standards.
  • Work proactively with fellow BAs and other team members, ensuring work is proportionally distributed and targets are met.
  • Ensure documents such as functional specs support the development of practical technology solutions and suitable test cases.
  • Work as part of a combined cross-functional agile team and support the on-going build as required e.g., drafting/reviewing of test cases, closing out developers open issues/questions, contributing to solution design etc.

ln:4458201659.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Proactively manage a complex portfolio of clients, becoming a trusted advisor to lead strategic dialogues with clients at a portfolio level through the understanding of specific business requirements and delivering creative and flexible customer solutions
  • To hand over customer relationship properly to their relationship managers after closing sales
  • To provide excellent services to customers and ensure all enquiries and complaints are accurately and effectively resolved to customers' satisfaction
  • To participate actively in team building activities to share information/ideas while contributing suggestions for work improvement
  • Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University degree or above (recognized by the state)
  • Strong interpersonal skills and effective presentation skills
  • Well-developed service and sales attitude with ability to work under pressure
  • Presentable, Outgoing and Persuasive
  • Good oral and written English is preferable

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website./NA

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Lead the development and implementation of the client strategy for the designated portfolio as identified through the Account Planning process
  • Accountability for delivering financial performance objectives (revenues, costs, RoRWA, etc)
  • Accountability for all other objectives for the management and development of client relationships, specifically compliance (AML, CDD) and credit risk.

Business

  • Actively originate new business and grow the franchise by capitalising on bank competitive attributes, whilst selectively developing new relationships where required.
  • Engage senior management and decision makers of key clients to improve the quality of dialogue with clients, promoting a move away from ‘transactional’ reactive client coverage to consistent value added partner /trusted advisor status. Anticipate clients’ needs and provide strategic advice, bringing in the relevant product and industry partners as appropriate.
  • Maximise the profitable revenue to the Bank whilst maintaining focus on client outcomes, strengthening and deepening existing relationships both at the most senior level as well as at the operating level in the clients in the designated portfolio.
  • Professionally represent Standard Chartered at the highest levels within region and internationally.
  • Bring strategic thought and vision as to how the corporate landscape regionally/globally is changing and where areas of international growth lie.
  • Ensure that industry and product knowledge is continually developed personally and within the team.
  • Stay abreast and anticipate the developments of the Industries in which our clients operate

Processes

  • Proactively manage the designated client portfolio to ensure:
  • Close ties exist with key stakeholders eg. Financial Markets, Transaction Banking, Corporate Finance Risk, Country CEOs, Service Delivery, etc.
  • Risks are appropriately identified and managed.
  • The team is suitably trained with respect to an understanding of the regulatory environment, keeping up to date with applicable changes and Group policies with ability to contribute and, where possible, influencing policy formulation
  • Key regulatory risks and concerns are raised into the governance framework throughout the IC team
  • All sales disciplines are adhered in accordance with Group standards ie Account Planning, Call Reports, Deal Pipeline Management
  • Develop opportunities through attendance at key Industry events as necessary.

People & Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Take the initiative regarding regulatory, reputational and ethical matters, taking the initiative for providing proactive advice to clients as identified. Coach and manage the team in these matters and ensure they are adequately trained in and cognisant of regulatory, reputational and ethical risks
  • Ensure that key regulatory risks and concerns are raised into the governance framework throughout the Corporate/LCMM teams

Governance

  • Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas
  • Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
  • Responsible for delivering ‘effective governance’; capability to challenge fellow executives effectively; and willingness to work with any local regulators in an open and cooperative manner.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Exercise authorities delegated by the Board of Directors and act in accordance with Articles of Association (or equivalent)

Skills And Experience

  • Client Relationship Management
  • Sales Tasks and Activities
  • Customer Analysis
  • Financial Risk Management
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Cross-Selling

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor or degree above
  • Certifications: CFA or CPA is preferred, but not mandatory
  • Languages: English and Chinese

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Strategy

  • Lead the development and implementation of the client strategy for the designated portfolio as identified through the Account Planning process
  • Accountability for delivering financial performance objectives (revenues, costs, RoRWA, etc)
  • Accountability for all other objectives for the management and development of client relationships, specifically compliance (AML, CDD) and credit risk.

Business

  • Actively originate new business and grow the franchise by capitalising on bank competitive attributes, whilst selectively developing new relationships where required.
  • Engage senior management and decision makers of key clients to improve the quality of dialogue with clients, promoting a move away from ‘transactional’ reactive client coverage to consistent value added partner /trusted advisor status. Anticipate clients’ needs and provide strategic advice, bringing in the relevant product and industry partners as appropriate.
  • Maximise the profitable revenue to the Bank whilst maintaining focus on client outcomes, strengthening and deepening existing relationships both at the most senior level as well as at the operating level in the clients in the designated portfolio.
  • Professionally represent Standard Chartered at the highest levels within region and internationally.
  • Bring strategic thought and vision as to how the corporate landscape regionally/globally is changing and where areas of international growth lie.
  • Ensure that industry and product knowledge is continually developed personally and within the team.
  • Stay abreast and anticipate the developments of the Industries in which our clients operate

Processes

  • Proactively manage the designated client portfolio to ensure:
  • Close ties exist with key stakeholders eg. Financial Markets, Transaction Banking, Corporate Finance Risk, Country CEOs, Service Delivery, etc.
  • Risks are appropriately identified and managed.
  • The team is suitably trained with respect to an understanding of the regulatory environment, keeping up to date with applicable changes and Group policies with ability to contribute and, where possible, influencing policy formulation
  • Key regulatory risks and concerns are raised into the governance framework throughout the IC team
  • All sales disciplines are adhered in accordance with Group standards ie Account Planning, Call Reports, Deal Pipeline Management
  • Develop opportunities through attendance at key Industry events as necessary.

People & Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Take the initiative regarding regulatory, reputational and ethical matters, taking the initiative for providing proactive advice to clients as identified. Coach and manage the team in these matters and ensure they are adequately trained in and cognisant of regulatory, reputational and ethical risks
  • Ensure that key regulatory risks and concerns are raised into the governance framework throughout the Corporate/LCMM teams

Governance

  • Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas
  • Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
  • Responsible for delivering ‘effective governance’; capability to challenge fellow executives effectively; and willingness to work with any local regulators in an open and cooperative manner.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Client Relationship Management
  • Sales Tasks and Activities
  • Customer Analysis
  • Financial Risk Management
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Cross-Selling

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor or Degree Above

Certifications

  • CFA OR CPA is preferred, but not mandatory

Languages

  • English & Chinese

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

This role could be based in China or Hong Kong. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.

Strategy

  • Support management of Markets’ consumption of SCB’s binding Balance Sheet Metrics including LCR, NSFR, RWA and Intragroup Large exposure
  • Identity and facilitate Balance Sheet Optimisation initiatives
  • Be informed of existing and new rules and regulations on Capital, Liquidity and Margining and understand impact on Markets business
  • Within the business mandate, support unique funding asks which TM may be unable to provide, to better serve our clients

Business

  • Support Markets’ balance sheet planning by actively communicates with Markets Trading Desks and Sales to manage Market’s funding pipeline and work with Treasury and FRM to better manage Markets’ funding ask.
  • Facilitate liquidity profile optimisation for Markets business within risk limit and MAT
  • Support Markets’ overall balance sheet management and helps Markets to minimize regulatory liquidity and capital cost.
  • Consistently works with the business and Treasury to optimize liquidity, balance sheet and inventory

Processes

  • Manage daily funding activities in China within the country’s overall Markets funding framework; partner with Treasury China to simplify and streamline process/policy for robust governance and reporting
  • Arrange funding transactions according to Markets internal funding booking model including derivatives collateral margining funding
  • Facilitate optimisation of funding mix including swap funding and other hedging as required, operating within market risk and any other related risk metrics

People and Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.

Risk Management

  • Responsible to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.
  • Responsible to manage market risk and pnl arising from funding and corresponding hedging transactions including FX and interest rate derivatives. Ensure to operate within dealing mandate and all relevant risk limit.

Governance

  • Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group's arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory and Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills and Experience

  • Dealing experience in financial instruments e.g. FX swaps, interest rate swaps
  • Competency in analysing market risk and PNL on trading positions
  • Knowledge and understanding of key balance sheet metrics (LCR, NSFR, leverage ratio, RWA etc)

Qualifications

  • Graduate qualifications (or conversions): Post-Graduate qualifications such as MBA, CFA, Chartered Accountancy, Mathematics/ Statistics, Qualified Lawyer
  • Over 2 to10 years (Analyst to Director) of relevant experience in the banking and financial services industry with hands on experience of underwriting, managing, and recovering credit exposures across both developing and developed jurisdictions
  • Good knowledge of Global Markets businesses and balance sheet management; including market and regulatory dynamics
  • Experience in funding activities related derivatives trading and related PnL and market risk management

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Software Engineer.

Business: IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mobile components, libraries, and reference applications, using the latest technology to tackle cross cutting technical and non-functional concern. Document the knowledge and best practices appropriately.
  • Design, develop and deploy applications capable of meeting the anticipated load, performance, availability, security and resilience requirements.
  • Design and develop software with a focus on automation of build, testing and deployment process on all environments to minimize variation and ensure predictable high quality code and data.
  • Ensuring compliance with all relevant controls and standards including relevant Service Management Standard. Ensure high data quality exists in Service Management systems of record.
  • Responsible for automating the continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline within a DevOps Product/Service team driving a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Keep up to date and have expertise on current tools, technologies and areas like cyber security and regulations pertaining to aspects like data privacy, consent, data residency etc. that are applicable

Requirements

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or related disciplines, or equivalent
  • Development experience with capacity in defining mobile architecture and technology roadmap
  • Native Android development experience (Android SDK) with solid hands-on development experience in Kotlin and Java
  • Multi-threading
  • Data storage
  • Remote Data via REST and JSON
  • Third-Party Libraries and APIs
  • Proficiency developing with modern programming languages and web technologies, and ability to rapidly develop proof-of-concepts
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile development life cycle
  • Ability to work with geographically distributed and cross-functional teams
  • Hands-on experience with Design pattern (MVP, MVVM, Redux), Framework-based development, Unit & UI testing, and Networking is desired
  • Experience building highly available, secure, distributed systems
  • Experience with Jenkins or other CI or CD pipeline (Git, Sourcetree, Jenkin)

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***
