ln:4457314137.descriptionHtml:
Job Objective

Group Technology enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, resilient, and scalable technology platform through a strategic focus on engineering excellence, delivery quality, innovation, and operational discipline.

This role will lead the design, architecture, and delivery of Digital Channels and Shared Services for the Corporate Internet Banking Platform (CIBP). The role is responsible for Mobile Engineering, UI Engineering, Business Analysis, and Shared Platform Services that support multiple business domains across the Corporate Banking franchise.

The successful candidate will combine deep banking domain expertise, modern software engineering leadership, mobile and digital channel architecture experience, and proven capability in building and leading high-performing engineering and business analysis teams.

The role will drive consistent engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, AI-enabled software delivery practices, and seamless customer experiences across Web and Mobile channels.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead engineering delivery for Corporate Internet Banking Digital Channels including Web, Mobile and Shared Platform Services supporting multiple business domains.
  • Define and drive the Mobile Engineering strategy covering Android, iOS and HarmonyOS platforms, ensuring secure, scalable and consistent customer experiences across all mobile channels.
  • Lead UI Engineering capability across the organization, driving Angular-based architecture, Micro Frontend (MFE) adoption, reusable component frameworks, enterprise design systems and digital channel standards.
  • Lead and manage Business Analysis teams, ensuring business requirements are clearly documented, traceable, implementation-ready and aligned with target business outcomes.
  • Partner closely with business stakeholders, product managers and operations teams to understand strategic objectives and translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
  • Drive architecture standards and engineering practices across Mobile, UI, Shared Services and Digital Channel platforms.
  • Establish and enforce enterprise engineering standards covering architecture, API design, microservices, event-driven systems, security, observability, testing, release management and AI-enabled software delivery.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through architecture reviews, solution reviews, code reviews, design governance and production readiness assessments.
  • Lead the development and governance of shared engineering capabilities including:
  • Design Systems and UI Component Libraries
  • Test Automation Platforms
  • AI Engineering Platforms and Development Accelerators
  • Observability and Monitoring Platforms
  • Developer Experience (DevEx) Platforms
  • Engineering Governance and Quality Frameworks
  • Lead engineering teams across DBS Technology China and vendor partners while ensuring high-quality delivery and predictable execution.
  • Drive DevSecOps and engineering excellence initiatives including CI/CD, automated testing, performance engineering, resiliency testing, observability and production support practices.
  • Champion adoption of AI-enabled software engineering practices and development accelerators across engineering and business analysis functions.
  • Establish governance and controls for AI engineering tools to ensure compliance with architecture, security, risk and regulatory standards.
  • Mentor Engineering Leads, Mobile Leads, UI Leads, Architects, Business Analysts and Shared Services teams while developing long-term organizational capabilities.


    • Education And Relevant Experience

    Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.

    Minimum 10 years of software engineering experience with at least 8 years leading large-scale banking technology programmes.

    Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale Corporate Internet Banking, Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments, Digital Banking or Corporate Banking platforms.

    Strong understanding of banking products and processes including:

    • Payments and Cash Management
    • Trade Finance
    • Accounts and Deposits
    • Entitlements and Access Control
    • Approval Workflows and Maker-Checker Processes
    • Customer Notifications and Alerts
    • Regulatory, Audit and Risk Controls

    Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise platforms using:

    • Microservices Architecture
    • Event-Driven Architecture
    • Domain Driven Design (DDD)
    • API-First Architecture
    • Cloud-Native Design Patterns
    • Micro Frontend (MFE) Architecture
    • Mobile-First Architecture

    Strong hands-on experience with:

    • Java
    • Angular
    • TypeScript
    • Spring Boot
    • Spring Cloud
    • REST APIs
    • Kafka, AMQ or Event Streaming Platforms
    • SQL and NoSQL Databases
    • Docker
    • Kubernetes

    Strong experience leading Digital Channel Engineering including:

    Mobile Technologies

    • Native Android Development (Kotlin)
    • Native iOS Development (Swift)
    • HarmonyOS / HarmonyOS Next
    • Mobile Application Security
    • Mobile Authentication and Authorization
    • Mobile Performance Engineering
    • Mobile CI/CD and Release Management
    • Enterprise Mobile Architecture

    UI Technologies

    • Angular
    • TypeScript
    • JavaScript
    • HTML5 and CSS3
    • Responsive and Adaptive Design
    • Micro Frontends
    • Design Systems
    • UI Component Libraries
    • Accessibility Standards

    Strong understanding of:

    • DevSecOps
    • CI/CD
    • Application Security
    • Secure Coding Practices
    • Observability and Monitoring
    • Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
    • Performance and Scalability Engineering

    Demonstrated ability to review complex architectures, technical designs and codebases while guiding teams toward high-quality engineering outcomes.

    Proven experience leading:

    • Mobile Engineering Teams
    • UI Engineering Teams
    • Business Analysis Teams
    • Shared Services Engineering Teams
    • Multi-vendor Delivery Teams
    • Cross-location Engineering Organizations

    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to engage senior business, operations, risk and technology leaders.

    Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software engineering tools and modern development accelerators including:

    • Claude Code
    • Gemini CLI
    • GitHub Copilot
    • Agentic AI Development Platforms
    • AI-assisted Testing and Code Review Tools

    Demonstrated experience establishing governance and controls for AI-generated code and AI-assisted software delivery.

    Experience working in Agile delivery environments using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe and DevOps operating models.

    Cloud, Architecture, Security, Agile or AI Engineering certifications will be an added advantage.

    Location:

    Guangzhou (DTC)

    Job:

    Technology

    Schedule:

    Regular

    Employee Status:

    Full time

ln:4456222422.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

INVESTMENT BANKING

Investment Banking works on some of the most complex financial challenges and transactions in the market today. Whether advising on a merger, providing financial solutions for an acquisition, or structuring an initial public offering, we handle projects that help clients at major milestones. We work with corporations, pension funds, financial sponsors, and governments and are team of strong analytical thinkers, who have a passion for producing out-of-the-box ideas.

The China Advisory team are committed to providing the world-class services to our clients from China. Our bankers play an important role in building relationships and executing transactions. The team, based out of Beijing and Hong Kong, encompasses a wide range of industry coverage, including Consumer Retail, Healthcare, Industrials, Natural Resources, Real Estate, and Technology, Media and Telecom.

YOUR IMPACT

Are you passionate about the financial services industry? We’re looking for an Analyst to join our China Advisory team based in Beijing who wants to be a part of our Investment Banking business and use their skills and ideas to make an impact to the success of the business at Goldman Sachs.

Responsibilities

Our Analysts and Associates play an important role in developing and strengthening our client relationships, participating on our advisory teams and in structuring and executing a full range of financial transactions. Their responsibilities include creating and analyzing financial models, organizing and preparing client presentations, helping manage transaction processes, and assisting in structuring transactions. They will gain exposure to the firm’s businesses and expand their knowledge of the investment banking industry, as they develop key analytical, communications and marketing skills.

Analysts and Associates develop financial models, perform customized company valuation analysis, and are actively involved in mergers and acquisitions (M&A) transactions and fixed income and equity issuances. They organize and prepare presentations, which explain industry trends, assess clients’ situations to provide the necessary financial advice, and recommend strategies to meet client goals. Additionally, Associates coordinate teams of tax advisors, attorneys, and bankers for various transactions; lead due diligence processes and actively participate in the negotiations of legal documentation. From maintaining client communication to helping Goldman Sachs structure client transactions, our Associates are a vital part of Goldman Sachs’ banking team’s investments.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 1-3 years of prior work experience
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through
  • Strong ability to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines
  • Team player with positive attitude and strong work ethic
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to adapt quickly to a variety of industries and businesses
  • Ability to self-direct, analyze and evaluate and form independent judgments
  • Ability to effectively interact and build relationships with senior management and global stakeholders
  • Commercially savvy with ability to exercise discretion with respect to highly confidential/sensitive information
  • Integrity, ethical standards and sound judgment

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Principal Data Engineer Data Technology.

 Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID ： 57085

The Role

As Principal Engineer for the Data Technology Platform you will set technical strategy, architecture and engineering standards across core enterprise data capabilities. The platform estate spans Enterprise Data Assets (EDA), Reference Data, Big Data and Movement and Data Decisioning engineering that underpin data democratisation, AI enablement, customer insight and regulatory compliance. You will shape how distributed data platforms are designed, built and run in hybrid cloud environments so they remain enterprise-ready and future-fit. This role combines deep hands-on engineering direction with influence across product and delivery teams in a global matrixed organisation. Success means clear reference engineering standards, consistent platform patterns and measurable improvements in scalability, observability and cost. You will also strengthen the developer experience so teams can discover, adopt and build on shared data services at pace.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve reference engineering standards for core data provisioning platforms aligned to Group Data Strategy and Data Future State Architecture
  • Set technical direction across Enterprise Data Assets (EDA) including APIs for standardised data provisioning
  • Establish engineering approaches for Reference Data Services including golden source alignment and hierarchy management
  • Oversee architecture and engineering patterns for big data ingestion, streaming and transformation at scale
  • Shape decisioning infrastructure including real-time feature stores and orchestration
  • Govern peer reviews to improve consistency, reusability and compliance with enterprise standards
  • Champion DevSecOps, CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code across engineering teams
  • Advance observability, performance engineering, cost optimisation and scalability in hybrid cloud environments
  • Guide teams on data pipelines, APIs, metadata-driven controls and automated testing frameworks
  • Represent the domain in cross-platform technology councils and architecture forums

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bring substantial hands-on experience in data platform engineering, architecture or software development in a scaled enterprise environment
  • Build large-scale data pipelines, APIs and event-driven systems using modern frameworks and technologies such as Spring, Kafka and Spark
  • Apply strong architectural knowledge of data mesh, data lakehouse and real-time customer-facing operational and analytics platforms
  • Use cloud platforms including AWS and GCP alongside containerisation and infrastructure-as-code tooling
  • Implement modern development tooling and automation for modelling, observability, resilience and governance patterns
  • Create reusable platform services that accelerate delivery for data consumers and AI and ML initiatives
  • Communicate complex technical decisions clearly to engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders to align outcomes to strategic objectives

/LP/WX

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist.

Business: Group Functions Technology

Job ID: 51026

Principal Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Define and lead the chaos engineering strategy, roadmap, and operating model for Treasury Technology.
  • Establish best practices, guardrails, and standards for safe and effective chaos engineering across the technology estate.
  • Design, review, and execute chaos experiments to validate resilience across infrastructure, platforms, applications, and service dependencies.
  • Identify resilience weaknesses, single points of failure, recovery gaps, and operational risks before they lead to production incidents.
  • Drive remediation by working closely with engineering and platform teams to resolve issues identified through experiments.
  • Ensure chaos experiments are measurable, controlled, and aligned to service resilience objectives and business criticality.
  • Define resilience metrics, reporting, and evidence to track maturity and demonstrate improvement over time.
  • Embed resilience-by-design principles into engineering practices, delivery processes, and operational readiness, including running Gamdays to rehearse failure scenarios, validate runbooks/alerting/on-call readiness, and strengthen a resilience culture across teams.
  • Partner with architecture, SRE, DevOps, infrastructure, security, and support teams to align resilience activities with wider engineering priorities.
  • Coach and guide engineers in resilience thinking, experiment design, and chaos engineering practices to build team capability.
  • Communicate technical findings, resilience risks, and improvement priorities clearly to senior stakeholders and decision makers.

Requirements

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University Degree (or above) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English.
  • Strong experience in a technical leadership role within platform engineering, site reliability engineering, cloud engineering, resilience engineering, or related discipline.
  • Proven track record in designing and implementing chaos engineering, fault injection, or resilience testing practices in complex enterprise environments.
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes, including deployment behaviour, failure handling, scaling, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience with GCP and cloud-native platforms, including operational and resilience considerations.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, failure modes, system recovery, and service resilience patterns.
  • Experience working across modern technology stacks, including microservices, APIs, platform services, and cloud-based applications.
  • Strong understanding of observability, including metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and service health monitoring.
  • Experience with automation, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering tooling to support scalable resilience practices.
  • Strong problem-solving capability, with the ability to diagnose detailed technical issues and drive practical solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across engineering teams and senior management.
  • Demonstrated resilience mindset, with a strong focus on proactive risk reduction and continuous improvement.

Corporate and Institutional Banking

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Drive inbound revenue by originating and deepening relationships with multinational corporations investing and expanding into mainland China.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of the assigned portfolio within the Global Network Banking unit of Corporate & Institutional Banking unit of Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) in China. Under the guidance of ling manager, assume responsibility for strategy execution, P&L and balance sheet management, funding, liquidity, risk control, and performance delivery, operating within the Group's defined risk appetite and strategic framework.
  • Act as the primary liaison for key overseas sites, facilitating the onboarding and banking support for global clients entering the China market. Champion the Global Network Banking proposition by coordinating with international HSBC teams to capture Foreign Direct Investment opportunities.
  • Formulate and execute business strategies to acquire new-to-bank overseas corporations with presence in China, while broaden existing relationships with multinational subsidiaries in China to ensure sustainable growth and support the Group's ambition to scale the CIB Banking franchise.
  • Collaborate closely with global/regional/Local product partners and Banking leaders to ensure a coordinated approach in targeting inbound investors, with a clear focus on maximizing business opportunities and returns.
  • Deliver best-in-class client experience to multinational corporations entering China, ensuring their cross-border banking needs are fully understood and met through strategic and complex financial solutions.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist (GenAI Agent Platforms).

Business: CTO Platforms (AI Platforms)

Location: Guangzhou / Xi'an / Shenzhen

Job ID: 45919

Principal Responsibilities

  • GenAI Agent platform engineering: design and develop the agent runtime, orchestration, tool/function calling, prompt and workflow management, memory/state handling, and integration patterns—leveraging frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph (where appropriate) while avoiding unnecessary vendor/framework lock-in.
  • Continuously monitor and optimise platform performance in production, including model selection, prompt/agent tuning, retrieval quality, caching, throughput, and resilience; drive root-cause analysis and preventative improvements.
  • Embed security, privacy and compliance by design & development: ensure controls for data handling, access management, encryption, auditability, model risk considerations, and safe tool use; align to internal governance and relevant regulatory expectations.
  • Maintain platform documentation and enablement: publish reference design, APIs/SDKs, templates, testing, and developer guidance to accelerate adoption and consistent delivery across teams.
  • Track and evaluate emerging GenAI/agent capabilities (e.g., new orchestration patterns, evaluation methods, safety techniques, model/tooling advances) and translate them into pragmatic platform enhancements with clear value, risk and cost trade-offs.

Requirements

  • Education & English: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science/Engineering (or related);
  • Software Engineering: 2+ years’ handon coding practice, strong Python or Java or Golang, with usage of at least one major cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP); ability to deploy and operate services in production (Docker/Kubernetes preferred).
  • Demonstrates an AI-native mindset by applying AI-driven approaches, including coding assistants, to improve productivity, quality, and engineering best practices
  • GenAI / LLM Delivery: knowledge with any one in GenAI, LLMs, MCP, RAG agentic workflows, tool/function calling will be a plus

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Corporate Banking provides international financial services solutions that support businesses ranging from mid-market enterprises to large corporates across industries and sectors. Leveraging the strength, scope, and expertise of our global product network, Corporate Banking is positioned as an essential partner to firms seeking to maximise their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

  • Contribute to Global Markets sales revenue generation, return targets set by business performance and objectives
  • To ensure offering of full range of Markets product suite to corporate clients and to achieve increase in market penetration
  • To maintain meaningful relationship with clients and explore new customers base for Global Markets in Guangdong Province and nearby areas with quality customer marketing

  • Identify and keep close updated of regulatory and market risks. Keep the clients and stakeholders up to date with specific news flow and regulatory changes
  • Support the alignment process with corporate to effectively cross-sell Markets products and solutions
  • Where applicable, contribute to the successful cross-selling of products of other business units within the Bank
  • Maintain sound credit quality and in compliance with both internal guidelines and external regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrate high professionalism and trustful image in client interaction
  • Understand, follow and demonstrate full compliance with all relevant internal and external regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of Global Markets Trading business, also in line with HSBC Code of Conduct
  • Conduct and support ad hoc projects where applicable

  • Bachelor's or equivalent University degree, minimum 5 years' relevant experience in the banking industry.
  • Well versed with relevant Global Markets products, local regulations, regulatory requirements, market practices and business trends
  • Experienced in handling and dealing with local commercial banking or corporate clients in China will be preferred
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with very strong people interaction ability

  • Business Travels will be required

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review and Retrospective.
  • Coach teams on Agile/Scrum principles and continuously improve team maturity and delivery effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business processes, pain points and strategic priorities.
  • Conduct analysis and documentation of business requirements, user journeys and system/process impacts.
  • Translate business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications.
  • Partner with Product Owner and delivery teams to prioritize backlog items based on business value and dependencies.
  • Identify delivery risks, impediments and blockers; drive timely resolution and escalation where required.
  • Support UAT planning, test scenario definition and quality assurance alignment with business expectations.
  • Track and report sprint and release metrics (velocity, burn-down, cycle time, delivery predictability, quality indicators).
  • Build and maintain strong communication channels across business and technical teams to ensure transparency and alignment.
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization and propose practical, data-driven improvements.
  • Support change management, user enablement and post-implementation adoption activities.
  • Own end-to-end project management activities including project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring/control and closure.
  • Define and manage project scope, timeline, milestones, resource plan and budget to ensure on-time and within-budget delivery.
  • Establish and maintain RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), governance cadence and escalation framework.
  • Drive cross-team/vendor coordination and dependency management across technology, operations and business units.
  • Prepare management reporting and steering committee updates on project health, delivery progress and decision points.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational standards, SDLC controls and audit/regulatory requirements where applicable.
  • Manage release readiness and implementation planning, including cutover, communication and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Support benefits tracking and realization against approved business case/objectives.

Requirements

  • University degree or above.
  • Minimum 10+ years of relevant working experience in technology/digital delivery, including proven experience in Scrum Master, Business Analyst, Project Manager, or hybrid delivery roles.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery framework, SDLC and project management methodologies (Agile/Waterfall/Hybrid).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Experience in requirement elicitation, process mapping, story writing and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Hands-on experience in project planning, dependency mapping, financial/budget tracking and resource management.
  • Experience with Agile and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Office, Power BI, MS Project).
  • High customer-centric mindset with commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to influence diverse stakeholders and drive outcomes under pressure.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to balance strategic and tactical priorities.
  • Experience in governance reporting, risk/issue management, and senior stakeholder/SteerCo communication.
  • Relevant certification(s) such as CSM/PSM, PMI-ACP, CBAP/CCBA, PMP/PRINCE2 would be an advantage.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID：54484

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design and Develop ETL Processes:
  • Lead the design and implementation of ETL processes using all kinds of batch/streaming tools to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into GCP.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and ensure that ETL solutions meet business needs.
  • Data Pipeline Optimization:
  • Optimize data pipelines for performance, scalability, and reliability, ensuring efficient data processing workflows.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot ETL processes, proactively addressing issues and bottlenecks.
  • Data Integration and Management:
  • Integrate data from diverse sources, including databases, APIs, and flat files, ensuring data quality and consistency.
  • Manage and maintain data storage solutions in GCP (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud Storage) to support analytics and reporting.
  • GCP Dataflow Development:
  • Write Apache Beam based Dataflow Job for data extraction, transformation, and analysis, ensuring optimal performance and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with data analysts and data scientists to prepare data for analysis and reporting.
  • Automation and Monitoring:
  • Implement automation for ETL workflows using tools like Apache Airflow or Cloud Composer, enhancing efficiency and reducing manual intervention.
  • Set up monitoring and alerting mechanisms to ensure the health of data pipelines and compliance with SLAs.
  • Reliability Strategy: Develop and implement strategies to improve the reliability and performance of applications and infrastructure, focusing on service level objectives (SLOs) and service level indicators (SLIs).
  • Incident Management: Oversee incident response processes, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and minimizing downtime. Conduct post-mortem analyses to identify root causes and implement preventive measures.
  • Automation and Tooling: Drive the automation of operational tasks and processes, leveraging tools and technologies to enhance efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
  • Monitoring and Alerting: Establish comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems to proactively identify and address performance issues, ensuring system health and availability.
  • Documentation: Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation of systems, processes, and procedures to facilitate knowledge sharing and compliance.
  • Security and Compliance: Ensure that all systems and processes adhere to security best practices and regulatory requirements, collaborating with security teams as needed.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and lead initiatives to enhance the overall reliability and performance of systems and services.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in designing and managing ETL solutions, including data modeling, data warehousing, and SQL development.
  • Proven experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or a related field, with a strong understanding of system architecture and cloud technologies.
  • Experience of cloud-based solutions, especially in GCP, cloud certified candidate is preferred.
  • Experience and knowledge of Bigdata data processing in batch mode and streaming mode, proficient in Bigdata eco systems, e.g. Hadoop, HBase, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka, Flink, Spark, etc.
  • Familiarity with Java & Python for data manipulation on Cloud/Bigdata platform.
  • Experience with incident management and response, including post-mortem analysis and root cause identification.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Proven experience in AI and machine learning, preferably in the banking or financial services industry

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
  • GenAI prompt engineering, Infra as code, containerization and orchestration, IAM, compliance awareness, design for scalability, cost optimization, multi-cloud and hybrid strategies.
  • Cloud certifications (GCP Professional Data Engineer / Cloud Architect) are a plus.
  • Experience the IT application controls & compliance requirements
  • Experience with Vertex AI, model deployment, feature stores, vector search, embeddings.
  • Experience with streaming (Dataflow/Beam, Kafka) and container platforms (GKE/Cloud Run).
  • Experience with open-source Iceberg, Trino, etc. and evaluation tooling.
  • Experience with vibe coding to solve business problem.

/WX

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

  • AI/ML technology evolution focus: stays current on applied Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) and identifies practical opportunities to embed AI into data and engineering workflows (e.g., intelligent automation, improved observability, developer productivity), while maintaining engineering quality.
  • Lead and coach engineers; set clear expectations, development plans, and a strong Engineering driven culture.

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications：

  • 10+ years of experience in relevant technologies.
  • Data Engineering (Python, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Hadoop, NiFi/Kafka, RDBMS), Cloud SQL,
  • Good understanding on GCP console, BQ/GCS/Git, Jenkins, Airflow, Pub/Sub/Kafka, CI/CD
  • Practical experience with Vertex AI (preferred) or equivalent managed LLM services, including deploying/consuming endpoints
  • Demonstrable hands-on delivery of at least one LLM-enabled capability, such as:
  • RAG data preparation pipelines, embeddings pipelines, vector indexing, or LLM evaluation telemetry.
  • Delivered one or more critical data products/pipelines with measurable improvements in reliability, latency, and data quality.

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Experience with Vertex AI, model deployment, feature stores, vector search, embeddings.
  • Experience with streaming (Dataflow/Beam, Kafka) and container platforms (GKE/Cloud Run).
  • Familiarity with governance patterns for GenAI (model risk, auditability, explainability, content safety).
  • Experience with open-source vector DBs (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, Weaviate) and evaluation tooling.
  • Cloud certifications (GCP Professional Data Engineer / Cloud Architect) are a plus.

Job Description

2027 China Seasonal Internship Program - Asset Management – Research Analyst (all asset classes, including quantitative research)

What We Do

J.P. Morgan Asset Management (“JPMAM”) is a leading investment manager for institutions, financial intermediaries and individual investors worldwide. It offers investment management across all major asset classes including equities, fixed income, alternatives, multi-asset and money market funds.

Join this program, you will support various senior analysts in their sector coverage responsibilities as they generate high quality and actionable investment insights. The role is intended to be a development position for future senior covering analysts.

What You Can Expect

As an intern in the 2027 China Seasonal Internship Program – Asset Management – Research Analyst, you will work as an analyst from one asset class as listed below:

Equity research: analyze stocks to help portfolio managers make better-informed investment decisions. Equity researchers employ problem-solving skills, data interpretation, and various other tools to understand and predict a given security's behavioral outlook.

  • Fixed Income research: Develop investment recommendations through the study of market fundamentals and technical research and maintain constant dialogue with our PMs discussing market color and research results.
  • AMS Research: Conduct research on investment strategies and asset allocation process through fundamental and quantitative frameworks. Analyze major asset classes, and underlying investment strategies and vehicles to help inform investment decisions.
  • Quantitative research: Work with large data sets to predict and test statistical market patterns and conceptualize valuation strategies, develop and continuously improve mathematical models. (Considering the differences in programming requirements, if you are applying for a quantitative research position, please specifically note your application for this direction on your attached CV)

Our program kicks off with training and orientation to our businesses and you'll gain the technical and practical knowledge so you can make an impact from the start.

The program is an opportunity to take your career to the next level through hands-on experience, relevant skills training and valuable professional networking. Based on your individual performance and achievements, you may receive an offer of full-time employment upon completion of the internship program.

More Information On Intern Role

  • Undertake qualitative and quantitative analysis of industries and companies in support of the research activities of senior analysts.
  • Forecast income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow items for near-term and normalized periods to facilitate valuation analysis.
  • Work closely with Analysts, Portfolio Managers and the Directors of Research to translate research insights into investment decisions.
  • Assist the Directors of Research with recurring and ad-hoc market and portfolio analysis, management of analyst-driven portfolios and in communication with stakeholders.
  • Communicate and collaborate proactively with the global network of JPMAM Analysts and Portfolio Managers.

About You

A strong interest in finance and asset management is essential, as are logical thinking and quantitative skills, flexibility, teamwork, excellent attention to detail, strong interpersonal skills and the ability to handle pressure and enjoy a collaborative environment. A well-rounded academic background is important. You certainly don't need a degree in Economics or Finance, but a good level of numeracy is required.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Organizational skills and project management skills
  • Ability to multitask and be proactive
  • Strong initiative, energy and confidence
  • Good judgment and discretion working with confidential information
  • Final year student with expected graduation of December 2027 through July 2028

Be able to work for at least 3 working days per week and last for 6 months from July – December 2027

Holding the permanent right to work in Mainland China is required

Relocation assistance for flight and accommodation will not be provided

Highly proficient in programming (Quantitative research)

But beyond that, what we're most interested in are the things that make you, you: the personal qualities, outside interests and achievements beyond academia that demonstrate the kind of person you are and the difference you could bring to the team.

Program Period

Early July 2027 – Late December 2027

Application Deadline

December 31, 2026 (23:59 Beijing time)

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We strongly encourage you to submit your application as early as possible as programs will close once positions are filled.

What's Next?

Help us learn about you by submitting a complete and thoughtful application, which includes your resume. Your application and resume is a way for us to initially get to know you, so it's important to complete all relevant application questions so we have as much information about you as possible.

  • After you confirm your application, we will review it to determine whether you meet certain required qualifications.
  • If progressed, you will receive an email invitation to complete a video interview, powered by HireVue. This is your opportunity to further bring your resume to life and showcase your experience for our recruiting team and hiring managers.
  • Your application will not be considered for further review until you have completed HireVue. We strongly encourage that you apply and complete all required elements as soon as possible, since programs will close as positions are filled.
  • Complete the online application form, attach your resume and cover letter – please indicate your preferred working location and available working days per week in your resume. Once you submit your application, you will not be able to make changes to your application information.

JPMorgan Chase is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that respects all people for their unique skills, backgrounds and professional experiences. We strive to hire qualified, diverse candidates, and we will provide reasonable accommodations for known disabilities.

Visit jpmorganchase.com/careers for upcoming events, career advice, our locations and more.

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Work with Product Owners, business users, operations, and technology teams to analyze business needs and translate them into clear requirements, user stories, functional specifications, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
  • Facilitate requirement walkthroughs, impact assessments, and solution discussions across business, technology, testing, risk, and control stakeholders.
  • Support Core Banking and Payments delivery by clarifying scope, managing requirement traceability, analyzing dependencies, resolving requirement queries, and ensuring delivery teams have a shared understanding of expected outcomes.
  • Partner with architects, developers, QA, DevOps, and support teams to ensure solutions are feasible, supportable, scalable, and aligned with operational and control expectations.
  • Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, release readiness, operational handover, and post-implementation review to ensure delivered solutions meet business needs.
  • Proactively identify requirement gaps, process issues, risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities, and drive timely clarification or resolution.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation, including BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process maps, data/interface requirements, decision records, and stakeholder updates.
  • Act as a trusted Senior Business Analyst for Core Banking and Payments stakeholders, bringing clarity, structure, and delivery focus to complex business and technology change.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, Business Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • 6+ years of experience in business analysis, technology delivery, product analysis, or banking system implementation, preferably in financial services.
  • Strong knowledge of Core Banking and Payments domains, including business flows, operational processes, system integration, transaction lifecycle, reconciliation, exception handling, and risk/control considerations.
  • Proven experience translating business needs into BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process flows, data/interface requirements, acceptance criteria, and impact assessments.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, testing lifecycle, release management, production support, and banking technology governance.
  • Experience supporting SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, release readiness, operational handover, and post-implementation review.
  • Strong understanding of system integration, APIs, batch processing, file interfaces, data flows, and upstream/downstream dependencies.
  • Technical awareness of IBM iSeries/AS400, Java, Python, SQL, APIs, or enterprise banking platforms would be an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to bridge business, technology, operations, risk, and senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive ownership mindset, with the ability to identify gaps, risks, dependencies, control issues, and improvement opportunities early.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4446712669.descriptionHtml:
International Wealth and Premier Banking

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening

up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Act as a senior subject matter expert in insurance planning, delivering insurance-led wealth and succession solutions to High Net Worth Individuals, with a strong focus on Asian clients, particularly from China.
  • Provide strategic advice on life insurance, legacy and estate liquidity planning, business succession funding, asset protection, and risk management as part of holistic wealth planning engagements.
  • Partner closely with Relationship Managers to identify client needs and originate planning opportunities, positioning insurance as a core advisory tool within broader wealth and succession planning discussions.
  • Design, structure, and implement complex insurance solutions tailored to clients’ personal, family, and business objectives, including intergenerational wealth transfer and long-term legacy planning.
  • Lead succession planning engagements, facilitating client and family discussions around protection planning, estate equalisation, liquidity needs, and philanthropic objectives.
  • Work collaboratively with internal partners, underwriting teams, and external specialists to deliver seamless end-to-end insurance advisory and execution.
  • Monitor wealth planning market developments, regulatory changes, and best practices across relevant jurisdictions, translating insights into compliant and effective client solutions.
  • Collaborate with Private Banking and Group affiliates to strengthen the Bank’s insurance proposition, support client acquisition, and deepen existing client relationships.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with insurers, brokers, and intermediaries across the insurance and wealth planning ecosystem, positioning the Bank as a trusted advisory partner.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in insurance advisory, wealth planning, or private banking, with a strong focus on insurance-led solutions for High Net Worth Individuals.
  • Proven track record in structuring and delivering complex insurance solutions or legacy planning.
  • Travelling is required on need basis
  • Strong interpersonal, advisory, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage senior clients and family members.
  • Able to work independently with minimal supervision; highly detail-oriented, disciplined, and execution-focused.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Head of AI Software Development .

Business: CTO Platforms

Job ID ： 37152

Principal Responsibilities

As a Director of AI Software Development, you will be a key technical leader responsible for executing the transformation of how the group develops software from inception to completion. You will lead and a grow a team of engineers to augment, transform and automate engineering product with AI capabilities that can be leveraged at scale by engineers across the group, fostering an engineering culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence.

Your role will involve collaborating with product managers and cross-functional teams to shape strategy, define goals, and deliver engineering solutions. You'll be instrumental in problem-solving, making critical technical decisions, quality assurance, and evaluating emerging technologies to improve software development processes and outcomes.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

 Key Experience:

To be successful in this role you should have proven experience within the Technology sector with knowledge of the following:

  • L eading an engineering organisation, recruiting, inspiring and empowering developers with world-class technology, practice, and organisational enablement.
  • Transformation of developer products across the software development lifecycle, partnering with existing teams to embed AI within our products, in order to uplift both the engineering experience and productivity of our teams.
  • Strong Technical Background: In-depth knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and system architecture.
  • Experience with application of AI to software development patterns and processes to transform the way teams build products at scale
  • Evaluation and integrating: Evaluating AI proof of concepts in a standardised way, and iterating use cases through pilot phases to integrate with production products.
  • Product and Project Management: Experience in managing software development products and projects, including planning, resource allocation, and delivery.
  • Budgets and financial management: Ability to deliver to financial and commercial performance and hands-on experience of managing budgets and costs.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex technical challenges effectively.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical concepts at all levels of the organisation.
  • Decision-Making: Demonstrated ability to make critical technical decisions and trade-offs while considering project constraints and business objectives.
  • Collaboration: Strong teamwork and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

Key Technical Skills

  • Programming Languages: Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, Golang, JavaScript or Ruby.
  • Software Architecture: Strong knowledge and experience in designing scalable, maintainable, and modular software architectures.
  • Deep technical and hands-on expertise with cloud platform technologies e.g., GCP, AWS, Alibaba cloud.
  • AI: Demonstrable experience of developing with AI, and using agents to augment and transform the software development process at scale
  • Controls: Demonstratable experience of working with IT controls, and automation of control compliance within products.
  • Audit: Build relationships and communicate with risk stewards, infosec and compliance partners to ensure close and continuous management of AI related change and risk factors

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Impact on the Business/Function

  • Support the achievement of Country AOP
  • Achieve agreed Key Performance Indicator objectives by development of existing and new relationships
  • Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
  • Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advice them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
  • Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and

WPB performance

  • Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
  • Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand
  • Monitor and act on daily sales activity management information and other internal information tools, using them to coach the wider Branch team in support of business goals
  • Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
  • Fully utilise and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date

Customers / Stakeholders

  • Own the client relationship with HSBC
  • Maintain a deep understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services available from Group sources and elsewhere in order to provide the best solutions for clients and maximise revenues for Global Wealth and the Group
  • Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio - Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
  • Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements
  • Work with the broader branch, support and direct teams to ensure achievement of the business performance measures by delivering differentiated products and services to the client
  • Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

Leadership & Teamwork

  • To work as part of an integrated branch management team to ensure, standards and are met and operating models delivered
  • Proactively support others through direct and indirect actions beyond activities particular to this role
  • Collaborate with the wider team to deliver the Branch WPB Performance measures and plan to support the multi channel client journey
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues in the wider WPB businesses and others as appropriate to service client needs

Operational Effectiveness & Control

  • Ensuring that sales and operations are undertaken in accordance with HSBC Bank plc FIM, BIM and Credit Policy Manual appropriate lending guidelines
  • Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority (RAA)
  • Manage operational risk, by using relevant Management Information to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimise loss
  • Adhere to selling process and sales quality requirements

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

Knowledge & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of three years proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
  • Evidence of strong sales results in insurance and investment products
  • Relationship management experience with high net worth clients
  • Strong technical skills in wealth management
  • Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills
  • Strong sales orientation, networking and portfolio management skills
  • Sound knowledge of financial services products and services and the client relationship management system
  • Understanding of business banking client segment and products and services
  • Local regulatory & license requirements - job holder should possess valid licenses with accreditation on wealth management and qualification as required by HBCN
  • Clear view on how to work with Compliance, Credit & Risk and Internal Control to ensure a balanced risk operating environment
  • Able to communicate well in English and local languages

Accreditations

  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
  • Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Job Description

Network Services (NS), part of Infrastructure Platforms (IP), provides connectivity for clients across the firm that all people and systems connect smoothly and securely, enabling the transport and sharing of data. Corporate Network provides best-in-class, scalable, reliable, and resilient network connectivity for data, voice, video and wireless at all corporate office locations globally.

Job Description / Responsibilities

As a Corporate Network Engineer, you will work in a team environment to provide support including:

  • Perform highly technical network software and hardware configurations.
  • Engineer, or review and approve new configurations prior to implementation, and interact with engineering and support teams during project turnover to ensure adherence to standards compliance.
  • Collaborate with clients, implementation, and operations personnel.
  • Be apprised of and recommend the implementation of new network technologies to improve stability, supportability, and performance within the network.
  • Interact with developers and implementers of new applications to better understand enterprise impact of new traffic streams. Continually evaluate current state of configuration to identify ways to improve service to our users and customers.
  • Communicate findings to performance engineering / architecture within Network Services and the LOB (Line of Business).
  • Creating and communicating service delivery procedures and run-books.
  • Provide 4th level escalation support in Severity 1 networking problems.
  • Perform internal formal and informal training of network support and engineering staff including Operations.
  • Perform duties following all JPMC standards regarding engagement, change management and escalations.
  • Evening/weekend work a requirement.

Qualifications / Experience

  • Equivalent of a B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical/Electronic Engineering.
  • 7-10 years of experience of LAN/WAN engineering including implementing production solutions .
  • Extensive knowledge of class Cisco Routers and layer 2/3 Switches, load balancers, VPNs, firewalls, NAT, Spanning Tree, Multicast, MPLS, Frame Relay, QOS and TCP/IP routing including EIGRP, OSPF, BGP a must.
  • Experience with Cisco Native IOS and current routing/switching hardware platforms.
  • Knowledge of legacy protocols, RSRB, DLSW, IPX, SNA, caching, and IDS a bonus
  • CCIE, Written CCIE, or on the CCIE Track
  • Cisco IP Telephony, project management, firewall experience, technical writing is a plus.
  • Broadcom Proxy, F5, Arista and Juniper experience a bonus.
  • Trading floor, financial industry and international experience is a plus and highly desired.

About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

Corporate Network provides best-in-class, scalable, reliable, and resilient network connectivity for data, voice, video and wireless at all corporate office locations globally.
Job Description / Responsibilities
As a Corporate Network Engineer, you will work in a team environment to provide support including:
- Perform highly technical network software and hardware configurations.
- Engineer, or review and approve new configurations prior to implementation, and interact with engineering and support teams during project turnover to ensure adherence to standards compliance.
- Collaborate with clients, implementation, and operations personnel.
- Be apprised of and recommend the implementation of new network technologies to improve stability, supportability, and performance within the network.
- Interact with developers and implementers of new applications to better understand enterprise impact of new traffic streams. Continually evaluate current state of configuration to identify ways to improve service to our users and customers.
- Communicate findings to performance engineering / architecture within Network Services and the LOB (Line of Business).
- Creating and communicating service delivery procedures and run-books.
- Provide 4th level escalation support in Severity 1 networking problems.
- Perform internal formal and informal training of network support and engineering staff including Operations.
- Perform duties following all JPMC standards regarding engagement, change management and escalations.
- Evening/weekend work a requirement.
Qualifications / Experience
- Equivalent of a B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical/Electronic Engineering.
- 7-10 years of experience of LAN/WAN engineering including implementing production solutions .
- Extensive knowledge of class Cisco Routers and layer 2/3 Switches, load balancers, VPNs, firewalls, NAT, Spanning Tree, Multicast, MPLS, Frame Relay, QOS and TCP/IP routing including EIGRP, OSPF, BGP a must.
- Experience with Cisco Native IOS and current routing/switching hardware platforms.
- Knowledge of legacy protocols, RSRB, DLSW, IPX, SNA, caching, and IDS a bonus
- CCIE, Written CCIE, or on the CCIE Track
- Cisco IP Telephony, project management, firewall experience, technical writing is a plus.
- Broadcom Proxy, F5, Arista and Juniper experience a bonus.
- Trading floor, financial industry and international experience is a plus and highly desired.
About The Team
Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

 Business: CLIENT SERVICES

Principal Responsibilities

  • You will be working closely with the CIB Client Services Engineering Leadership team, leading the engineering transformation across our Customer Due Diligence application.
  • You will be designing and building solutions using microservice architecture, working closely with the product team to understand requirements and impact of changes being made.
  • You will be expected to lead by example, delivering solutions at high cadence for the build out of both new functionality and the replacement of legacy systems whilst also supporting other teams to achieve the same.
  • You will be working to release change to production every day, owning requirements through discussions with the business through to development, testing, release to and support of production.
  • You will be leading engineering excellence and the development of a strong engineering culture across our teams – influencing behaviours and removing barriers within the teams.
  • AI Solutions Development: Develop AI/machine learning solutions, ensuring they align with business objectives and meet performance metrics

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on backend or frontend development experience (or both!).
  • Practical exposure to GenAI (LLMs, RAG, document intelligence, agents) is a positive.
  • Comfortable breaking down business requirements and shipping iteratively; bonus for Kubernetes CI/CD tooling and framework-light microservices (no SpringBoot).
  • Extensive experience building applications using non-breaking principles, particularly in developing RESTful APIs.Extensive experience developing microservices using highly iterative methods to deliver change to production regularly.

  • Experience with building and supporting tooling for CI/CD on Kubernetes is a plus.

ln:4455640209.descriptionHtml:
Job Type

Full Time

Job Reference #

327174BR

City

Shanghai

Key Responsibilities

Join a high-performance team building ultra-low latency trading systems where nanoseconds matter. You’ll design and implement a trading rules engine for real-time controls using a hybrid of FPGA hardware and high-performance C++, enabling deterministic execution and rapid interaction with the markets.

  • Design and implement real-time trading rules and risk checks using FPGA (Verilog/VHDL) or C++.
  • Architect cycle-accurate FPGA designs and high-speed network interfaces (10/25/40/100GbE, RoCEv2) is preferred.
  • Build simulation and verification frameworks for FPGA reliability.
  • Drive full FPGA design flow (synthesis, place & route, timing closure).
  • Interface C++ applications with FPGA hardware for real-time orchestration.
  • Implement lock-free data structures and concurrency control in Linux.
  • Build low-latency network apps using kernel bypass (e.g., Rivermax).
  • Analyze system performance and resolve latency bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate with global IT, Quants, and Traders across asset classes.
  • Provide Level 3 support for production systems.

The team

You’ll be part of the Algorithmic Trading Team based out of Shanghai within the Execution Services, delivering latency-sensitive infrastructure for Algorithmic Execution, Smart Order Routing, Internalization, and Real-time Controls across global markets.

Your Skills And Experience

  • 7+ years in FPGA (Verilog/VHDL) or low-latency C++ development.
  • Expert in C++17/20/23, Linux system programming, concurrency.
  • Deep knowledge of FPGA toolchains (Vivado, Quartus), timing closure.
  • Experience with high-speed networking and hardware acceleration.
  • Strong background in shared memory IPC and lock-free systems.
  • Familiarity with market microstructure and trading protocols (FIX, ITCH) is a plus.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
  • Performance-obsessed and precision-driven.
  • A hands-on engineer who thrives in fast-paced environments.
  • A collaborative communicator.
  • Self-motivated with a passion for solving complex technical challenges.

About Us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

Join us

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.

Contact Details

UBS Business Solutions SA

UBS Recruiting

Disclaimer / Policy statements

UBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering (Knowledge & RAG Platform Engineering Lead).

Business: CTO Platforms (AI Platforms)

Job ID: 56078

Location: Guangzhou / Xi'an

Principal Responsibilities

  • Senior technical IC leadership for knowledge intelligence: Act as a hands-on senior technical expert in knowledge intelligence and knowledge management, shaping architecture, technical direction, and implementation approach for an enterprise-grade knowledge platform.
  • Knowledge platform architecture & delivery ownership: Lead the design and build of scalable platform capabilities across ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification, knowledge asset management, discovery, reuse, governance, and controlled downstream consumption.
  • Industry best practice adoption & engineering standards: Evaluate knowledge management, knowledge engineering, ontology/taxonomy, graph, and AI-assisted curation practices, and translate them into engineering standards, reusable patterns, reference architectures, APIs/SDKs, and runbooks.
  • Knowledge refinement & intelligence workflows: Lead workflows that extract, refine, summarize, classify, deduplicate, consolidate, and contextualize fragmented information into trusted, structured, traceable, and business-aligned knowledge assets.
  • Knowledge graph & semantic layer leadership: Architect and evolve ontology/taxonomy management, entity/relation extraction, entity resolution, graph modeling, graph traversal, lineage-aware context assembly, and graph-based reasoning support for AI and search scenarios.
  • Knowledge lifecycle, governance & self-checking: Establish mechanisms for ownership, validation, versioning, publishing, freshness monitoring, deprecation, retention, rollback, quality scoring, duplication/contradiction detection, and citation/provenance validation.
  • Optimisation & operational readiness: Define SLOs/SLAs, observability, alerting, capacity planning, cost controls, incident response, troubleshooting playbooks, resilience patterns, and continuous production improvement for knowledge platform services.
  • Cross-team influence & enablement: Partner with AI engineering, data platforms, cybersecurity, architecture, product, and domain SMEs to drive adoption, mentor engineers, review designs, unblock complex issues, and communicate trade-offs to senior stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Management, Data Engineering, AI, or a related technical discipline; 7+ years of hands-on engineering experience in backend, data, AI, knowledge, search, or enterprise information platforms.
  • Proven experience as a senior technical IC or platform technical lead, owning architecture, engineering standards, design review, implementation quality, optimisation, and production readiness for complex platform capabilities.
  • Deep knowledge of knowledge intelligence and management practices, including taxonomy/ontology design, metadata standards, knowledge refinement, lifecycle management, governance, lineage, and enterprise content operations.
  • Hands-on experience with knowledge graph, semantic search, RAG, agentic AI, or data enrichment systems, plus strong engineering foundations in distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, observability, CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Strong security, compliance, production, and stakeholder mindset, with the ability to adopt industry best practices, mentor engineers, influence cross-functional teams, and apply AI-native approaches to improve quality, productivity, and decision-making.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***
