ln:4446767409.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering (Guardrail Platform AI Safety Track).

Business: CTO Platform (AI Platforms)

Job ID: 53435

Location: Guangzhou / Xi'an

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and productionise AI safety detectors for enterprise AI applications, including prompt injection and jailbreak detection, personally identifiable information and sensitive data detection, data leakage prevention, content safety and harmful content detection, policy violation checks, system prompt leakage detection, and agent or tool-use risk controls.
  • Build detector pipelines using a multiple approaches, including rule-based detection, pattern matching, NLP / ML classifiers, embedding base models, LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators, and hybrid detection strategies with clear interfaces, confidence scoring and policy-driven actions.
  • Develop and optimize detector models and evaluation workflows for guardrails, including test sets creation, data labeling strategies, fine-tuning, model validation, threshold calibration, precision / recall optimization, regression testing, and continuous improvement based on production feedback.
  • Evaluate and integrate industry and open-source AI safety solutions, including detector frameworks, safety models and third-party services; perform build-vs-buy analysis, bechmarking, integration, and production readiness assessment.
  • Design end-to-end AI safety protection patterns across enterprise AI workloads, including RAG system, coding assistants, conversational AI and agent application covering input, retrieval, generation, output, logging and tool execution layers.
  • Build AI Safety observability and governance capabilities, including detector telemetry, tracing, dashboards, evaluation metrics, audit trails, feedback loops and operational controls to monitor safety effectiveness.
  • Partner with AI platform, infrastructure, security and application teams to productionise safety solution, including performance optimization, scalability improvement, detector lifecycle management and reliable rollout strategies.

Requirements

  • Experience developing first-party detectors for AI safety detectors, including prompt injection, jailbreak, personally identifiable information, data leakage, toxicity, policy violation or agent safety detection.
  • Experience building fine-tuning pipelines for safety-oriented large language models or small language models, including dataset curation, labelling strategy, training workflow implementation, evaluation design, and production validation.
  • Experience identifying, evaluating, integrating and productionising third-party or open-source detector solutions, with clear judgement on quality, latency, cost, operational fit and governance requirements.
  • Experience making sound build-versus-buy decisions for detector capabilities, and taking either internally developed or externally sourced solutions through evaluation, integration, rollout and ongoing operation in production.
  • Experience with AI evaluation or observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize, Phoenix or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with data loss prevention, secret scanning, document classification or enterprise information protection tooling.
  • Experience with adversarial testing, red teaming or continuous attack simulation for AI systems.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. /WX

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4427910528.descriptionHtml:
Direct Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the marketing and sales of Macro products to primarily, but not limited to, Chinese financial institutional clients in China, including Banks, Fund Managers, Securities Houses and Insurance companies.
  • Promote the firm's brand, products, and services to new and existing clients.
  • Deliver business strategies and to be in coordination with Macro GBL’s both regionally and globally.
  • Endeavor to ensure the quality of the Bank's portfolio remains sound and healthy.
  • Internal Stakeholders: Global Markets Staff, FIG, LTMG, GRM, Back- and Middle-office, Compliance

Key Result Areas

  • Product sponsor for all macro products to build up bigger presence across financial institutions in China, increase client’s trade volume to generate client contribution and broaden coverage of clients.
  • Ensure good teamwork and coordination within team and with other internal stakeholders, make sure of good information flow and sharing among team members and with other key functions
  • Responsible for the business aspects of Global Markets business such as ISDA, CSA negotiation, technical advisory etc to internal and external clients.
  • Responsible for client onboarding and client KYC alongside relevant support function
  • Carry out client’s instructions to execute transactions with BNPP trading professionals and book client side in trade capture system.
  • Work with operational support functions to facilitate/monitor the settlement process.
  • Provide analysis and modelling expertise and support new product development.
  • Provide clients with market data, market prices, and validated comments and analyses generated by the firm, e.g., market, sector or company research.
  • Ensure compliance with all legal and regulatory authorities, audit requirements and established bank approved risk procedures.

Risk Management

  • Ensure systematic client tiering, risk scenario.
  • Attend relevant training courses to maintain appropriate regulatory, product and technical skills.
  • Maintain open communication with team and direct line management to fulfil firm notification requirements and pass on client concerns.
  • Watching out for potential fraud or market abuse via close management and by responding, effectively and comprehensively, to escalation signals coming from Middle-Office / Back-Office staff

Contributing Responsibilities

  • Promote the firm's brand, products, and services to new and existing clients.
  • Responsible for the implementation of operational permanent control policies and procedures in day-to-day business activities, such as Control Plan
  • Responsible for complying with regulatory requirements and internal guidelines.
  • Responsible for reporting all incidents according to the Incident Management System
  • Ensure audit recommendations are resolved within the specific timeline.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID:50269

Principal Responsibilities

  • Test Leadership:

Lead as a hands-on Test Lead, owning overall test strategy, planning, and execution across one or more delivery teams.

Mentor QA engineers and SDETs, driving best practices in test design, test automation, and defect management.

Establish quality standards, test governance, and release quality gates across the SDLC.

  • Quality Engineering and Delivery:

Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and risk-based test plans.

Own end-to-end testing for new initiatives and major releases, from test approach definition to production sign-off.

Ensure high product quality through functional, integration, regression, and non-functional testing.

  • Test Architecture and Implementation:

Design and implement scalable test automation frameworks for API, UI, and service integration testing.

Define and maintain test data, test environments, and traceability from requirements to test evidence.

Drive shift-left quality practices, including static checks, early test design, and continuous feedback loops.

  • DevOps and Tooling:

Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support rapid and reliable releases.

Use cloud and container-based test environments to improve test consistency, scalability, and speed.

Track and report quality metrics such as test coverage, defect leakage, flaky test rate, and release readiness.

  • Collaboration and Communication:

Work closely with product managers, developers, operations, and security teams to ensure quality objectives are met.

Communicate quality status, key risks, and mitigation plans clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Lead defect triage, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

  • At least 8 years of hands-on experience in software testing/quality engineering.
  • Strong experience in 5 or more of the following areas:
  • Test strategy and test planning
  • API testing and automation (e.g., REST-assured, Postman/Newman)
  • UI automation (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright)
  • Performance testing (e.g., JMeter, Gatling)
  • CI/CD and test pipeline integration (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
  • SQL/NoSQL data validation
  • Cloud-based testing (e.g., AWS)
  • Containerized testing environments (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker)

/WX

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own the technical direction, architecture and engineering roadmap for the financial-planning platform in partnership with Product, Business and Architecture teams.
  • Lead by example through hands-on design, development, code review, debugging and resolution of complex production issues.
  • Design and deliver scalable, secure and resilient microservices and AI capabilities, including APIs, event-driven integration, AI agents, tool use, retrieval and orchestration.
  • Apply AI and agentic workflows across requirements, development, testing, documentation and release processes to improve delivery speed, quality, automation and cost efficiency.
  • Establish engineering and AI-development standards covering automated testing, CI/CD, evaluation, guardrails, observability, security and responsible use of AI.
  • Own delivery from requirements clarification to production, managing priorities, dependencies, technical debt, risks and stakeholder expectations.
  • Coach engineers, build a strong engineering culture and create reusable patterns and guidelines that help other teams adopt emerging technologies effectively.

Requirements

  • Deep hands-on expertise in either Java or Python, with substantial experience designing and delivering production-grade software. Java expertise should include modern Java and Spring Boot; Python expertise should include building enterprise applications or AI solutions.
  • Proven technical leadership experience, including setting technical direction, leading complex delivery and developing engineers in a global team environment.
  • Practical experience with generative AI or agentic systems, such as LLM integration, RAG, tool use, orchestration, evaluation and guardrails. Experience with LangChain or a comparable framework is preferred.
  • Experience applying AI-enabled development practices to achieve measurable improvements in engineering productivity, quality or automation.
  • Strong knowledge of microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, PostgreSQL, automated testing and CI/CD.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into incremental production outcomes and clearly communicate technical options, risks and trade-offs to business and technology stakeholders.
  • A growth mindset and the ability to evaluate emerging technologies, turn experiments into production capabilities and balance innovation with security, resilience and regulatory controls.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

ln:4456458621.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Impact on the Business/Function

  • Provide high quality sales support to a team of PRMs mainly focused on getting appointment for PRMs and supporting PRMs in servicing their clients.
  • Reduce the time spent on process and administrative tasks by PRM to increase PRM’s capacity.
  • Support PRMs to manage client contact and service, including, in the absence of PRMs, answering client calls, resolving client enquiries on transactional needs and facilitating a smooth hand-off to the correct channels where appropriate, and managing key event reminders to maintain active client contact.
  • Provide sales support to PRMs including preparing and completing sales documents, managing data input and report generation, and liaising with support functions to follow through client purchase process requirement.

Customers / Stakeholders

  • Handle client’s enquiries relating to the PRM’s portfolio in a positive, timely, and appropriate manner. Aim to resolve the customer’s queries at the first point of contact and minimise referrals to the PRM for routine transactions.
  • Has strong knowledge of the PRM’s portfolio of clients with the support of CRMS and analytical tools.
  • Proactively responds to client in face-to-face and/or telephone settings, updating client profile screens with details of client contact.
  • Maintains a basic understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services.
  • Support PRMs to execute suitable solutions for product areas responsible for with clients to fulfil their needs and ensure efficient follow up.
  • Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets.

Operational Effectiveness & Control

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID:50271

Principal Responsibilities

  • Engage with the CIB Chief Data Office (CDO), business users, and relevant subject matter experts to understand, clarify, and prioritise business requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into deliverable solution approaches, functional requirements, and high-level design documentation.
  • Contribute to the technical and logical design of key components, producing required design artefacts and interface specifications.
  • Communicate functional solutions to the development team and provide ongoing support as needed.
  • Work closely with the production support team to ensure requirements and delivered solutions are well understood and readily supportable.
  • Promote solution architecture principles, best-practice techniques, standards, and tools.
  • Provide recommendations and roadmaps for proposed solutions.
  • Document and share best-practice knowledge for new solutions.
  • Advocate for process improvements and support the development of solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership to the team throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Participate in proof-of-concept (PoC) and technical validation activities to assess feasibility and risks, and recommend suitable approaches.
  • Participate in design reviews and solution/code walkthroughs, providing constructive feedback and driving issues to closure.
  • Manage design activities within own scope during agile iterations, delivering in line with product and delivery timelines.
  • Identify and document key technical risks, dependencies, and technical debt, and drive alignment with stakeholders on remediation plans.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise, Platform, and other architecture roles to align direction and continuously improve existing solutions within agreed frameworks.
  • Support delivery coordination activities as required (e.g., requirements clarification, plan alignment, and cross-team communication).

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience working as a Solution Architect within a large organisation.
  • Strong logical thinking with the ability to abstract architectural patterns from technical solutions.
  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to articulate, present, and drive approval of solutions at the appropriate level for both IT and business audiences.
  • Experience with streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink, Pub/Sub).
  • Knowledge of database technologies (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL/data integration.
  • Operating systems and scripting: Linux, shell scripting, PowerShell.
  • Experience with at least one cloud platform (GCP, Azure, AWS).
  • Experience with big data platforms (BigQuery, Hadoop, Spark, Databricks).
  • Experience in data modelling, with a solid understanding of data model design.
  • Proven analytical skills with the ability to challenge designs and decisions.
  • Experience managing and resolving complex issues using strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to quickly get up to speed with the current data landscape 5and apply analysis and data skills to new contexts and approaches.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong virtual communication (conference calls, video conferencing).
  • Strong planning, organisation, and time management skills, with a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines.
  • Self-aware, with the confidence to work independently.

/WX

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. ln:4456329868.descriptionHtml:
Job Objective

Group Technology enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group Technology, we digitalise majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels.

We are seeking a highly experienced and hands-on technology leader to drive the next generation of digital banking capabilities across customer onboarding, relationship management, workflow automation, data intelligence and Agentic AI platforms.

The role requires a leader who is equally comfortable engaging senior business stakeholders, defining technology architecture, managing engineering delivery, and coaching high-performing teams.

Principal Responsibilities

Technology Leadership

  • Lead the architecture, design and delivery of strategic digital banking platforms supporting customer acquisition, account opening, servicing, workflow automation and relationship management.
  • Define and execute technology roadmaps covering Generative AI, Agentic AI, advanced analytics, big data and intelligent automation capabilities.
  • Drive modern engineering practices, platform modernization and cloud-native architecture adoption.
  • Establish technical standards, governance frameworks and engineering best practices across the portfolio.

AI, Data & Analytics

  • Lead the design and implementation of GenAI and Agentic AI solutions to improve customer experience, operational efficiency and employee productivity.
  • Drive adoption of enterprise AI platforms, knowledge management solutions, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration frameworks and conversational AI capabilities.
  • Build and scale data-driven capabilities leveraging big data platforms, advanced analytics, machine learning and decision intelligence.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to identify and prioritize high-impact AI and analytics use cases.

Delivery & Engineering Management

  • Lead multiple engineering squads across distributed locations and functions.
  • Manage engineering leads, developers, data engineers and platform specialists.
  • Own delivery outcomes including scope, quality, stability, security, scalability and operational performance.
  • Drive Agile and DevSecOps practices, ensuring timely and predictable delivery of strategic initiatives.

Business & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner closely with business, operations, product, architecture, risk and compliance teams.
  • Translate complex business requirements into scalable and maintainable technology solutions.
  • Communicate effectively with senior management, steering committees and executive stakeholders.
  • Manage delivery in a matrix organisation involving multiple departments, countries and vendor partners.

People Leadership

  • Recruit, develop and retain high-performing technology talent.
  • Provide coaching, mentorship and career development for engineering managers and technical specialists.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Experience

Education and Relevant Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant technology experience, with significant experience in banking or financial services.
  • Proven experience managing engineering teams and delivering large-scale enterprise platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience operating in multinational organisations with matrix reporting structures.
  • Track record of delivering mission-critical customer-facing platforms and digital transformation programmes.
  • Exposure to commercial, corporate, SME, wealth management or transaction banking platforms.
  • Experience evaluating and implementing emerging technology solutions.
  • Strong understanding of risk, security, data governance and regulatory requirements in financial institutions.
  • Experience leading AI transformation programmes within banking.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technology strategy at senior leadership level.
  • Passion for innovation, continuous learning and talent development.

Domain Expertise

Strong experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Generative AI and Agentic AI
  • Data Analytics and Business Intelligence
  • Big Data Platforms and Data Engineering
  • Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
  • Digital Customer Onboarding
  • Account Opening Platforms
  • Workflow and Business Process Management Systems
  • Customer Service and Case Management Platforms

Technical Capability

Deep knowledge and practical experience in:

  • Enterprise architecture and solution design
  • Distributed systems and microservices
  • APIs and event-driven architectures
  • Cloud platforms and container technologies
  • Data platforms, data lakes and analytics ecosystems
  • AI/ML platforms and GenAI deployments
  • System integration and enterprise workflow orchestration
  • Software engineering lifecycle, DevSecOps and CI/CD practices

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Ability to lead through complexity in a matrix environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working with teams across multiple geographies and cultures.
  • Professional working proficiency in English and Mandarin, with the ability to engage effectively with regional stakeholders, business partners and technology teams.

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
  • Relevant certifications in cloud, data, AI, architecture or Agile delivery would be advantageous.

Location:

Guangzhou (DTC)

Job:

Technology

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

ln:4456322914.descriptionHtml:
Job Objective

Group Technology enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group Technology, we digitalise majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels.

This role will lead the design and delivery of large-scale digital banking capabilities across multiple business domains under the Institutional Banking Group, ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with the bank’s strategic objectives. The successful candidate will combine strong banking domain expertise with deep hands-on engineering knowledge, modern software architecture experience, and proven leadership of large engineering organizations.

Principal Responsibilities

The core responsibilities for this role involve providing technical leadership and strategic direction for the Corporate Internet Banking Platform and driving high standards in engineering practices.

  • Technology Vision & Strategic Leadership
    • Define and drive the technology vision, engineering strategy, and architecture roadmap for the Corporate Internet Banking Platform.
    • Ensure consistent adoption of platform design principles, including Domain-Driven Design, API-first development, event-driven integration, microservices architecture, and cloud-native engineering practices.
  • Engineering Delivery & Technical Leadership
    • Lead engineering delivery across business domains such as Payments, Trade Finance, Accounts, Entitlements, Approvals, Notifications, Reporting, Dashboard, and Shared Services.
    • Provide hands-on technical leadership through architecture reviews, solution reviews, code reviews, design governance, and production readiness assessments.
    • Lead engineering teams across workstreams and vendor partners, ensuring high-quality delivery and predictable execution.
  • Architecture & Engineering Standards
    • Drive solution architecture, technology selection, engineering standards, and development practices across the platform.
    • Establish and enforce enterprise engineering standards covering architecture, API design, microservices, event-driven systems, security, observability, testing, and release management.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering & Governance
    • Champion the adoption of AI-enabled software engineering practices and development accelerators across the engineering organization.
    • Establish and enforce governance and controls for the use of AI engineering tools to ensure compliance with architecture, security, risk, and regulatory standards.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Talent Development
    • Partner closely with business stakeholders to understand strategic objectives and translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
    • Mentor Engineering Leads, Architects, Senior Engineers, and Domain Leads, building long-term technology capabilities within the organization.
  • Engineering Excellence & DevSecOps
    • Drive DevSecOps and engineering excellence initiatives, including CI/CD, automated testing, performance engineering, resiliency testing, observability, and production support practices.
  • Brand Enhancement
  • Collaborate with other DTC teams to continuously improve our Tech branding and service quality in China.
Education And Relevant Experience

To be considered for this role, candidates must meet the following minimum qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or an equivalent field.
  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 15 years in software engineering, with at least 8 years leading large-scale banking technology programs.
    • Proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale platforms in areas such as Corporate Internet Banking, Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Trade Finance, Payments, Digital Banking, or Corporate Banking.
    • Experience leading technology organizations distributed across multiple countries, vendors, and development
Technical Expertise

Candidates should possess strong hands-on experience and a deep understanding of the following:

  • Architectural Design & Principles:
    • Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise platforms using:
      • Microservices Architecture
      • Event-Driven Architecture
      • Domain Driven Design (DDD)
      • API-First Architecture
      • Cloud-Native Design Patterns
      • Micro Frontend (MFE) Architecture
    • Demonstrated ability to review complex architectures, technical designs, and codebases, guiding teams towards high-quality engineering outcomes.
  • Core Technologies:
    • Java
    • Angular
    • Spring Boot, Spring Cloud
    • REST APIs
    • Kafka, AMQ, or other Event Streaming Platforms
    • SQL and NoSQL Databases
    • Docker, Kubernetes
  • DevOps & Engineering Practices:
    • Strong understanding of:
      • DevSecOps, CI/CD
      • Application Security, Secure Coding Practices
      • Observability and Monitoring
      • Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
      • Performance and Scalability Engineering
    • AI-Assisted Software Engineering:
      • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software engineering tools and modern development accelerators, including:
        • Claude Code
        • Gemini CLI
        • GitHub Copilot
        • Agentic AI Development Platforms
        • AI-assisted Testing and Code Review Tools
      • Demonstrated experience establishing governance and controls for AI-generated code and AI-assisted software delivery.
Domain Knowledge

A strong understanding of banking products and processes is essential, including:

  • Payments and Cash Management
  • Trade Finance
  • Accounts and Deposits
  • Entitlements and Access Control
  • Approval Workflows and Maker-Checker Processes
  • Customer Notifications and Alerts
  • Regulatory, Audit, and Risk Controls

Leadership & Agile Practices

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, and DevOps operating models.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage senior business, operations, risk, and technology leaders.

Certifications (Added Advantage)

Cloud, Architecture, Security, Agile, or AI Engineering certifications.

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

ln:4455612268.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

As a Relationship Manager, you will build trusted relationships with Priority Banking and Priority Private Banking clients, helping them achieve their wealth goals through tailored investment and portfolio solutions. Supported by specialists in investment, insurance, products, and treasury, you’ll deliver comprehensive strategies that drive long-term growth and stability.

This role gives you the opportunity to demonstrate your expertise in relationship management, sales, and client engagement, while advancing your career across Wealth and Retail Banking or other client segments.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our clients in achieving their financial goals as they progress through their career and life-stages.
  • Build long-term relationships by understanding clients’ financial needs and aspirations and delivering tailored wealth and investment solutions.
  • Share timely market insights and investment updates from the Chief Investment Office (CIO) to help clients make informed decisions.
  • Leverage digital tools such as myWealth to create customised portfolios and monitor performance based on CIO guidance.
  • Deliver exceptional client experiences through proactive engagement and personalised service.

Skills And Experience

  • Financial skills
  • Analytical skills

Qualifications

  • Relevant experience with a minimum of two years in client acquisition, relationship management, and retail banking.
  • Technical expertise in consumer banking products, including treasury, equities, funds, and insurance.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective client relationships.
  • Proactive and collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, international environment.
  • Local market knowledge with established client networks and understanding of regional dynamics.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4454976788.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

As a Relationship Manager, you'll be responsible for managing and developing relationships with clients of Priority Banking & Priority Private Banking to drive business growth and meet the bank's strategic objectives. You’ll help clients set wealth goals, manage investments, and create portfolios for long-term growth and stability. You’ll be supported by specialists in the areas of investment, insurance, products and treasury to provide clients with comprehensive solutions.

This is an opportunity for you to demonstrate your relationship management, sales, customer service and communications skills. Our Relationship Managers can advance their careers across client segments or explore roles across Wealth and Retail Banking.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

We service more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment which encompasses Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, and our deep local presence and international network enables us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product propositions span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our clients to meet their financial needs, as they progress through their career and life-stages.
  • Build relationships for the long-term and understand clients’ financial needs and aspirations to grow, manage and protect their wealth, with appropriate investment solutions.
  • Stay ahead of the market and get regular market updates and investment insights from our Chief Investment Office (CIO) to share with clients.
  • Leverage myWealth digital and help clients to create custom portfolios, check performance and asset allocation based on CIO’s advice.
  • Provide outstanding client experiences.

Skills And Experience

  • Financial skills
  • Analytical skills

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 2 years of experience in client acquisition, relationship management and retail banking.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise in consumer banking products (i.e. Treasury, Equities, Funds, Insurance, etc.).
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship building skills.
  • Self-starter and team player who enjoys working in an international environment.
  • Local language skills, client networks and experience.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4456311305.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Business Analyst.

Business: HK Global IWPB COO

Req ID: 56634

Location: Guangzhou, TKH

Principal Responsibilities

  • Content heavy role –Business Analysts must demonstrate strong business knowledge and sound business sense, and stay abreast of the industry, business-wise and technology-wise.
  • Stakeholder complexity –Business Analysts will often need gather requirements and agree designs across business stakeholders, dealing with different interests and resolving disagreements and conflicts, and sometimes needing to challenge poor requirements and design decisions. They will often attend and lead these meetings or workshops with no GCD supervision.
  • Multi-disciplinary –Business Analysts need to be able to shape business requirements and solution designs
  • Employs an improvement mind-set to identify and define issues or problems that are less obvious; participates actively and constructively in brainstorming meetings where problems are discussed and/or resolved
  • Brings structure and order to undefined problems and/or large scale problems, making them easier to address and solve
  • Uses systemic thinking and creativity in devising solution options
  • Evaluates relative costs, benefits and obstacles of potential solutions before implementing
  • Defines requirements management processes and designs detailed business solutions and structures based on business requirements; challenges business intent in a constructive manner
  • Identifies areas of impact on the target operating model and designs activities to mitigate impact
  • Manages requirements traceability through design and delivery

Requirements

  • Ability to read/type and speak in English and Chinese(Both Mandarin and Cantonese are needed) are crucial.
  • Domain knowledge of Insurance.
  • Knowledge of AI.
  • Good understanding of Global Change Delivery Business Transformation Frameworks and best practice techniques
  • A thorough understanding of the purpose, values, culture and fundamentals of Global Change Delivery
  • Outstanding understanding of HSBC Group structures, processes and objectives
  • Very strong knowledge of the external environment –regulatory, political, competitors etc.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. /WX

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Business

  • Financial Markets Middle Office was set up in 2016 to deliver first class trade support, business enablement and accurate / timely trade representation in order to meet obligations to clients, counterparties and regulators. We are product and process subject matter experts aligned to the Global Financial Markets business providing follow the sun support, a continuous improvement mindset and industry connectivity.

Processes

  • Trade capture, coordination and life-cycling for Financing products (loans), vanilla Credit and Structured Credit products.
  • Understanding and manage query remediation, trade life-cycling and other day-to-day processing, ensuring timely escalation, in order to minimise risk
  • New business enablement and solutions, partner to deliver strategic FM initiatives and drive Operational readiness
  • Local management of:
  • Hubs: Drive global alignment and consistency, Follow The Sun support
  • Local Market: standardize where applicable, tailored processes/controls
  • Challenge vendor costs / services across the lifecycle
  • Operations representation for Sales and Trading, primary point of contact of local business teams
  • Operations representation for external/internal and regulator scheduled audits:
  • Ensure Audit points are addressed within timelines
  • Drive continuous improvement and innovate:
  • Partner with Technology to deliver transformation
  • Work with FM and FMO stakeholders to identify booking model improvements and drive efficiency
  • Be up to date and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements
  • Adherence to Ops Risk Framework standards of implementation and process management.
  • Periodic review of DOI, process note, daily check-list to ensure complete and accurate recording of process procedure

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • FM, FMO, Product Control, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operational Risk

Skills and Experience

  • Vanilla Credit products knowledge – Bond, CDS, Repo, TRS, Loans.
  • Structured Credit products knowledge – TRCLN, BOLN, Bond TRS, Loan TRS, Structured Repo, Structured Rate Loan.
  • Understanding of Risk and P&L
  • System knowledge – Murex, Bloomberg, APEX, Clear Par, Loan IQ.

Qualifications

  • University degree preferred, with minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in the Middle Office function and performing relevant support activities with strong relevant product knowledge.
  • Expert knowledge of Financial Markets Credit Derivatives & Financing products.
  • Understanding of products front to back operation process.
  • Analytical mindset
  • Strong inter-personal skills:
  • Confident communicator - able to adapt style to Front Office and offshore colleagues
  • Demonstrate strong teamwork with internal and external groups
  • Thrive on working in fast paced environment while maintaining attention to detail
  • Fast learner with the ability to think out of the box and provide solutions
  • Proficient in Excel (pivots, lookups and basic VBA an advantage)
  • 5+ years of relevant Middle Office function experience

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Profile Description

Standard Chartered Bank

ln:4454972062.descriptionHtml:
Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking is a leading global financial institution that provides advisory, investment banking, financing, corporate banking and capital markets services to corporations, financial institutions, financial sponsors and sovereign and supranational organizations worldwide.


Our teams of experts in close to 30 countries advise clients on their strategic development, helping them to grow and transform their businesses, and maximize their positive impact. Natixis CIB is committed to aligning its financing portfolio with a carbon neutrality path by 2050 while helping its clients reduce the environmental impact of their business.


As part of Groupe BPCE, the second largest banking group in France through the Banque Populaire and Caisse d’Epargne retail networks, Natixis CIB benefits from the Group’s financial strength and solid financial ratings (Standard & Poor's: A+, Moody's: A2, Fitch: A+, R&I: A+).


Main Responsibilities:


  • Support the execution of sales strategies for EQD products, aiming to meet the division's business objectives and revenue targets.
  • Assist in Sales at documents including all master agreements, distribution agreement, termsheet with a diverse range of clients, including financial institutions, PB, EAM, Family office, and WM platform, providing them with market insights and economic trends.
  • Collaborate with product specialists and traders to gain a deep understanding of EQD markets, product offerings, and client needs.
  • Participate in the creation of client presentations and marketing materials, helping to communicate complex product features and market opportunities in a clear and effective manner.
  • Contribute to market research and analysis, supporting the team in identifying market trends, client needs, and potential sales opportunities.
  • Engage in ongoing professional development to build expertise in FX and rates products, market dynamics, and sales techniques.
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and internal policies in all sales activities and client interactions.


Required Skills:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • A strong interest in financial markets, particularly in FX & Rates, with a keen desire to develop a career in global markets sales.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with clients and team members.
  • Basic analytical skills, with the ability to understand and interpret market data and financial information.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent in English and Chinese, with additional language skills considered an advantage.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with a willingness to learn and use financial market analysis tools and platforms.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Lead Recruiter.

Business: People

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end emerging talent recruitment for GCIO and Global Capability Network China (Analyst/Associate/Graduate/Intern), delivering a consistent, high-quality candidate experience.
  • Run structured role intakes with hiring managers to confirm demand, requirements, assessment approach, timelines and selection criteria.
  • Deliver attraction, sourcing and (where applicable) campus engagement activity in partnership with Attraction/Marketing and sourcing teams, building targeted talent pools for recurring and hard-to-fill demand.
  • Design and coordinate selection activity (screening, tests, interviews, assessment centres), ensuring assessors are briefed/trained where required and appropriately representative.
  • Facilitate selection governance (briefings, wash-ups, documentation and compliance) and drive timely stakeholder feedback to reduce candidate drop-off.
  • Manage offers end-to-end (approvals, generation, policy-aligned negotiation and acceptance) and ensure a smooth handover to onboarding/operations, including compliance steps (right-to-work, screening, visa/immigration where applicable).
  • Track and use MI (pipeline health, conversion, time-to-fill, offer acceptance, source effectiveness and YoY trends) to recommend improvements, share best practice globally, and strengthen stakeholder relationships through understanding of technology priorities and skills demand.

Requirements

  • Delivered Emerging Talent hiring campaigns end-to-end, from demand/requirements gathering through offer management and onboarding handover.
  • High-volume early careers recruitment experience (300+ hires) across graduates, interns, analysts and associates within Operations or Technology (Global Capability Centres or equivalent).
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, influencing outcomes in a matrix organisation and translating workforce plans into delivery.
  • Effective cross-geo collaborator, comfortable with change and able to drive continuous improvement and transformation.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and virtual hiring tools; experienced with ATS/HR systems, maintaining strong data accuracy, approvals/audit trails, and awareness of recruitment risk, controls and relevant employment legislation (plus internship conversion and assessment/calibration where applicable).

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business: Asia & Middle East Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end engineering delivery within a DevOps POD/team: design, build, test, release and production support.
  • Own technical solutioning for key modules/services: translate business requirements into secure, scalable designs and implementation plans.
  • Drive engineering standards: clean code, code reviews, testing strategy, CI/CD discipline, observability, and secure-by-design practices.
  • Build and evolve backend services using Java/Spring in a microservices/API-led architecture; ensure API consistency, performance and security.
  • Improve reliability and resilience: fault tolerance, graceful degradation, DR readiness, capacity/performance tuning, and operational runbooks.
  • Champion automation: CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, environment readiness, and operational tooling to reduce toil and improve MTTR.
  • Collaborate across boundaries: product managers, architects, QA, SRE/ops, security, risk & controls, and dependent engineering teams.
  • Support governance and controls expected in a regulated environment: documentation, traceability, approvals, and audit-ready evidence where required.
  • Coach and grow engineers: mentoring, pairing, technical guidance, and contributing to hiring/interviewing.

Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience in Java (11+) and Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security).
  • Proven experience designing and delivering microservices and RESTful APIs, including API security (OAuth2, JWT, mTLS/cert-based patterns where applicable).
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency, latency, idempotency, retries, circuit breakers, and asynchronous processing.
  • Experience with databases (RDBMS such as Oracle/PostgreSQL/MySQL) and strong SQL skills; exposure to NoSQL is a plus.
  • Practical experience with CI/CD and DevOps ways of working (e.g., Jenkins/GitLab/GitHub Actions), plus automated testing practices.
  • Experience with containerisation and cloud-native delivery (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift; cloud exposure is beneficial).
  • Strong production mindset: monitoring/alerting, log analysis, incident handling, RCA, and continuous improvement.
  • Confident communicator who can influence stakeholders, manage dependencies, and drive decisions in ambiguous situations.
  • Experience working in banking/financial services or other regulated environments is strongly preferred.

Job Summary

As a Relationship Manager, you'll be responsible for managing and developing relationships with clients of Priority Banking & Priority Private Banking to drive business growth and meet the bank's strategic objectives. You’ll help clients set wealth goals, manage investments, and create portfolios for long-term growth and stability. You’ll be supported by specialists in the areas of investment, insurance, products and treasury to provide clients with comprehensive solutions.

This is an opportunity for you to demonstrate your relationship management, sales, customer service and communications skills. Our Relationship Managers can advance their careers across client segments or explore roles across Wealth and Retail Banking.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

We service more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment which encompasses Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, and our deep local presence and international network enables us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product propositions span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our clients to meet their financial needs, as they progress through their career and life-stages.
  • Build relationships for the long-term and understand clients’ financial needs and aspirations to grow, manage and protect their wealth, with appropriate investment solutions.
  • Stay ahead of the market and get regular market updates and investment insights from our Chief Investment Office (CIO) to share with clients.
  • Leverage myWealth digital and help clients to create custom portfolios, check performance and asset allocation based on CIO’s advice.
  • Provide outstanding client experiences.

Skills And Experience

  • Financial skills
  • Analytical skills

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 2 years of experience in client acquisition, relationship management and retail banking.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise in consumer banking products (i.e. Treasury, Equities, Funds, Insurance, etc.).
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship building skills.
  • Self-starter and team player who enjoys working in an international environment.
  • Local language skills, client networks and experience.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4454974805.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

As a Relationship Manager, you will build trusted relationships with Priority Banking and Priority Private Banking clients, helping them achieve their wealth goals through tailored investment and portfolio solutions. Supported by specialists in investment, insurance, products, and treasury, you’ll deliver comprehensive strategies that drive long-term growth and stability.

This role gives you the opportunity to demonstrate your expertise in relationship management, sales, and client engagement, while advancing your career across Wealth and Retail Banking or other client segments.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our clients in achieving their financial goals as they progress through their career and life-stages.
  • Build long-term relationships by understanding clients’ financial needs and aspirations and delivering tailored wealth and investment solutions.
  • Share timely market insights and investment updates from the Chief Investment Office (CIO) to help clients make informed decisions.
  • Leverage digital tools such as myWealth to create customised portfolios and monitor performance based on CIO guidance.
  • Deliver exceptional client experiences through proactive engagement and personalised service.

Skills And Experience

  • Financial skills
  • Analytical skills

Qualifications

  • Relevant experience with a minimum of two years in client acquisition, relationship management, and retail banking.
  • Technical expertise in consumer banking products, including treasury, equities, funds, and insurance.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective client relationships.
  • Proactive and collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, international environment.
  • Local market knowledge with established client networks and understanding of regional dynamics.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

  • 确保客户投诉的时效与管理；

  • Proactive and collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, international environment.
  • Local market knowledge with established client networks and understanding of regional dynamics.

  • Sound knowledge of financial products and services and banking procedures, equities markets, unit trusts and other personal investment services are preferred.
  • Good investment counseling and analytical skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to deal with all levels of people, often in complex and difficult situations.
  • Team player who shows initiative and assertiveness.
  • Self-motivator who is keen to upgrade, improve personal knowledge and skills to meet job requirements.
  • Good command of both spoken and written English and Mandarin

  • 大学本科学历。

  • 熟悉理财业务活动及理财产品销售相关的法律法规
  • 熟悉银行产品、服务、银行程序、股票市场、单位信托以及其它个人投资服务。
