Job Summary

As a Relationship Manager, you'll be responsible for managing and developing relationships with clients of Priority Banking & Priority Private Banking to drive business growth and meet the bank's strategic objectives. You’ll help clients set wealth goals, manage investments, and create portfolios for long-term growth and stability. You’ll be supported by specialists in the areas of investment, insurance, products and treasury to provide clients with comprehensive solutions.

This is an opportunity for you to demonstrate your relationship management, sales, customer service and communications skills. Our Relationship Managers can advance their careers across client segments or explore roles across Wealth and Retail Banking.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

We service more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment which encompasses Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, and our deep local presence and international network enables us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product propositions span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our clients to meet their financial needs, as they progress through their career and life-stages.
  • Build relationships for the long-term and understand clients’ financial needs and aspirations to grow, manage and protect their wealth, with appropriate investment solutions.
  • Stay ahead of the market and get regular market updates and investment insights from our Chief Investment Office (CIO) to share with clients.
  • Leverage myWealth digital and help clients to create custom portfolios, check performance and asset allocation based on CIO’s advice.
  • Provide outstanding client experiences.

Skills And Experience

  • Financial skills
  • Analytical skills

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 2 years of experience in client acquisition, relationship management and retail banking.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise in consumer banking products (i.e. Treasury, Equities, Funds, Insurance, etc.).
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship building skills.
  • Self-starter and team player who enjoys working in an international environment.
  • Local language skills, client networks and experience.

ln:4453671125.descriptionHtml:
About The Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 31 October 2026

Job Description

Title Assistant Manager / Manager - Global Tax CoE

Department Global Tax CoE

Location Dalian, China

Reports To Senior Manager - Global Tax CoE

Level 5

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our Business Finance team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.

As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

About The CFO Group

The CFO Group is a global corporate function at Fidelity International, operating across all 27 countries and bringing together Finance, Business Consulting, Procurement, Treasury and Corporate Property Services.

The CFO Group exists to actively partner with the business, providing financial clarity, constructive challenge and leadership so that decisions are well governed and value is created across the enterprise. Through the Finance Fast Forward programme, the function is evolving towards a more modern, commercially focused and insight‑led model, strengthening its use of data, automation and judgement to support high‑quality decision‑making, robust control and sustainable outcome.

About Your Role

As an Assistant Manager / Manager in the Global Tax CoE team, you will play a key role in supporting FIL entities across Japan and selected jurisdictions, ensuring the effective delivery of tax compliance, tax accounting, tax reporting and tax risk management activities.

You will be responsible for managing end-to-end tax activities, including statutory tax filings, tax reporting, tax accounting and reconciliations, tax audits and enquiries, tax authority interactions and tax technical analysis. The role requires the application of sound professional judgement to ensure compliance with local regulatory requirements and FIL’s internal control framework.

Working within a global operating model, you will collaborate closely with onshore and offshore stakeholders across Finance, Tax and other corporate functions to deliver high-quality outcomes, strengthen tax governance, and support continuous process improvements across multiple jurisdictions.

About You

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensure timely and accurate tax filings in compliance with local regulations and internal policies
  • Coordinate with external tax advisors on annual tax compliance activities and other tax- related matters
  • Lead and respond to tax audits, inspections, and inquiries from authorities
  • Perform tax account reconciliations and ensure accurate booking of tax-related nominal accounts
  • Provide timely analysis and resolution of tax issues identified during operations or audits
  • Prepare supporting documentation for tax filings, including schedules, reports, and reconciliations ensuring completeness and accuracy
  • Provide tax advisory and ad hoc support to internal stakeholders on tax-related matters
  • Collaborate closely with the APAC Tax and finance teams, and local stakeholders to support the effective delivery of tax activities
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with tax authorities and support interactions on tax-related matters
  • Drive process improvements, standardization, and automation initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of tax activities

Experience and Qualifications Required:

  • Strong experience in tax or finance roles with exposure to Japan entities, preferably within a multinational or shared services environment
  • Good understanding of Japan tax regulations and compliance requirements
  • Experience supporting tax compliance, tax reporting, and tax audit activities
  • Ability to analyze tax issues and apply practical solutions
  • Strong attention to details and the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting tight deadlines
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to work effectively across different functions, locations, and cultures
  • Experience driving process improvements and automation initiatives
  • Proactive, accountable, and solution-oriented mindset
  • Fluent English and Japanese (essential)
  • Professional accounting or tax qualification (e.g., CPA, CTA) is preferred

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

ln:4452799513.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • We are seeking an Agile Product Owner to lead a cross-functional team in designing, developing, and deploying AI solutions for our wealth and retail banking sectors. You will bridge business stakeholders, users, and technical teams to ensure AI solutions deliver maximum value and align with strategic goals.
  • The ideal candidate should understand AI concepts, technologies, and practical applications. Experience in LLM platforms & API integrations, customer experience optimization, managing RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pipelines, model calibration, and model evaluation is essential. You will work on models across English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese languages.
  • Key responsibilities include defining and communicating the product vision and strategy for AI solutions, developing language models and collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and prioritize features. You will maintain the product backlog, lead sprint planning, and ensure the team understands tasks and objectives.
  • You will oversee the design, development, and deployment of AI solutions, ensuring they meet quality standards and deliver value. Writing clear user stories, focusing on customer experience optimization, and ensuring seamless platform integration are crucial. Tracking and analysing product performance metrics to make informed decisions is also essential.
  • Prior experience in Generative AI, Predictive Analytics & Machine Learning, Natural Language processing (NLP) and emerging technologies, running proofs of concepts, driving pilots, and product evaluations using innovative client engagement technology shall be a huge plus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Owns the product journey, vision across the entire product life cycle, from inception, validation, build, delivery, run & iteration.
  • Maintains a commercial lens over the product, understand and communicate with relevant stakeholders on the commercial performance metrics and viability of products, and drive its adoption.
  • Creates a transparent, clear, and easy to understand product vision.
  • Owns the ‘WHY’ and ensure all members of the squad understand and embrace the vision & mission. The why should be closely aligned to the organization’s overall goals and ambitions.
  • Inspires the squad to continuously thrive in a growth mindset.
  • Sets goals for the squad and create actions plans to target for timely delivery.
  • Owns, maintains & constantly optimizes the product roadmap & product backlog.

Business

  • Act as an agile Product Owner to develop new AI solutions to drive key wealth and retail banking strategic objectives.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including technology, design, and business stakeholders, to deliver innovative AI solutions.
  • Using tools like ADO to own and manage the product backlog, prioritize features based on business value, and ensure seamless delivery in an Agile environment.
  • Constantly take feedback, iterate, and improve platform and its adoption.
  • Previously defined product requirements and development roadmap based on functional expertise.
  • Strong communication skills to synchronize tasks, clarify requirements and delivery expectations with stakeholders.
  • Conducts pre-go-live demos for stakeholders and align necessary support functions to ensure a smooth transition and go-live.
  • Conducts regular retrospective and review sessions to embed a growth mindset where the squad is constantly looking for ways to improve the way we deliver products. Take learnings and share with the wider PO community.
  • Research vendor offerings, evaluate and make best recommendations.

Processes

  • Clearly aligns squad OKRs & KPIs with stakeholders and senior management, ensure these objectives and targets are well understood and aligned to the nature of your product.
  • Communicates and embed the OKRs and KPIs into every aspect of the product life cycle.
  • Identifies and maps the data sources required to validate and measure the performance of the features.
  • Performs post implementation review with squad, define measurement windows and prepare necessary data & metrics.
  • Translate data insights into prioritized product improvements.

People & Talent

  • Coaches & mentor squad members to continuously uplift capability.
  • Fosters a culture based on trust, psychological safety & collaboration.
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people.
  • Responsibility to review team capacity plans to ensure capabilities are released as per agreement with stakeholders.

Risk Management

  • Awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.
  • Is accountable for ensuring compliance and risk adherence of products and services, engage with stakeholders to ensure necessary controls are adhered to and approvals are obtained.
  • Identifies all risks and issues that may impact project viability. Track, manage and report them as per the Bank’s standards.

Governance

  • Adherence to policies and control standards, ensuring compliance and operation within risk tolerance and risk appetite
  • Maintain awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Bank operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
  • Responsible for delivering ‘effective governance’ within the deliverables and possessing the ability to constructively challenge relevant stakeholders and teams effectively.
  • Ability and willingness to work through details with relevant control functions in an open and collaborative manner to achieve the desired governance outcome within the bank’s risk appetite.
  • Work with global teams in Risk, Compliance and COO Office to ensure adherence to the Bank’s Risk framework, in the identification, assessment, mitigation, control and monitoring of risk.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Investment Advisors, Team Heads, Relationship Managers, (PvB and Retail)
  • Global WM Product Teams
  • Global and Country Technology teams
  • Product Owners across Digital Advisory and Client Journey
  • Country WM Product Heads
  • Group, Regional and Country WM COO teams

Other Responsibilities

  • Do the right thing: Be brave, be the change; Think client; Live with integrity
  • Never Settle: Continuously improve and innovate; Simplify; Learn from your successes and failures
  • Better together: See more in others; How can I help? Build for the long term

Skills And Experience

  • Agile Product Owner
  • Business Analysis
  • Customer Experience design and user experience principle
  • Scrum or similar Agile development methodology

Qualifications

  • The ideal candidate has a strong background in retail banking, wealth management, and Agile product management, with expertise in digital solutions, data analytics, and AI/ML. You should be data-driven, customer-centric, and skilled at navigating complex banking ecosystems.
  • 5 to 10 years of experience in digital and technology implementations, preferably within large wealth management organizations, managing complex projects.
  • 4 to 8 years of experience as an Agile Product Owner (or a similar role), with strong skills in maintaining and prioritizing a backlog.
  • Proven experience in AI/ML projects, including model development, deployment, and lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML tools and frameworks, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive AI/ML innovation and integration within banking products and services.
  • Experience with emerging technologies, proofs of concepts, driving pilots, and product evaluations using innovative client engagement technology is a plus.
  • Deep understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle, enabling effective communication across technical, functional, and business contexts with key product users, including data analytics teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Data Scientists, Data Analysts, and Data Translators in a banking context.
  • Strong understanding of industry trends and client needs, with the ability to create a compelling value proposition and squad vision.
  • Proven track record of leading teams to successfully deliver objectives.
  • Experience in coaching and mentoring team members, providing regular feedback sessions.

Skills

  • Strong intellect with superior analytical, problem solving and decision-making skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate with multi-functional, multi-cultural, multi-product teams to achieve superior results.
  • Strong communication skills – oral, written and presentation to explain complex or technical issues for a broad audience.
  • Strong ability to map the client requirements into functional specifications.
  • Experienced with designing customer journeys.
  • Experienced with design and delivery of Digital applications such as Mobile applications.
  • Experienced with innovative projects / Proof of Concepts (PoC) using Analytics, AI and NLP technologies.
  • Experienced with managing delivery with scrum masters, technical developers, and architects.
  • Ability to manage the effective planning, implementation, evaluation, and sustainment of product backlogs, to ensure the achievement of anticipated benefits, using Agile methodology.
  • Experience in Financial services applications especially around Wealth Advisory, Agent Assist, Contact Centre and KYC applications would be big plus.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4453687123.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist (SRE)

Business: Business Banking UK Technology

Job ID ：55914

Principal Responsibilities

  • Build and manage robust CI/CD pipelines on Google Cloud Platform for APIs, databases, messaging, storage, and compute
  • Create and manage Kubernetes workloads, including pod definitions, tagging, labelling, scaling, and auto-scaling
  • Support production stability, availability, and reliability of applications and platform services
  • Handle production incidents, including triage, impact assessment, service restoration, escalation, and follow-up actions
  • Troubleshoot complex cross-platform production issues across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, application services, networking, databases, CI/CD pipelines, and integrations
  • Perform root cause analysis for incidents and recurring issues, and drive permanent fixes and continuous improvement
  • Define and improve SLOs/SLIs, observability, and monitoring capabilities across engineering teams
  • Engage early in new features and platform changes to improve quality, operability, and release readiness
  • Contribute to automation, performance, and reliability improvements that reduce operational toil

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience in GCP (Google Cloud Platform) or similar cloud technologies
  • Strong experience in microservices and APIs
  • Strong experience with DevOps and platform tools such as Jenkins, Helm, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes, JIRA, and DataDog
  • Experience managing source control, branching, merging, tagging, and release versioning using tools such as GitHub
  • Experience defining and supporting development, test, release, update, and support processes for DevOps operations
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, automation, cloud identity and access, and Linux-based infrastructure
  • Scripting skills in Shell, Python, or Ruby for automation, monitoring, and operational support
  • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills
  • Strong incident handling and production support experience, with the ability to manage high-severity service issues calmly and effectively
  • Experience in root cause analysis, issue resolution, and driving preventive actions for recurring incidents
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, and alerting tools
  • Working knowledge of open-source technologies and modern reliability engineering practices
  • Awareness of critical Agile principles and experience working in Agile / SCRUM environments
  • Familiarity with Agile team management tools such as JIRA and Confluence
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineering teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders
  • Proactive team player, comfortable working in multi-disciplinary, self-organized teams
  • Professional knowledge of English
  • Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer certification is desirable

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Experience on banking / HSBC and understanding of how change drives benefits for HSBC, its customers and other stakeholders will be an advantage.
  • Experience on HSBC business banking system knowledge will be an advantage.

/WX/

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Tech SME.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

Architecture Strategy & Roadmaps:

  • Define target and transitional architectures for Private Banking CRM and related ecosystems (Java services, Power Platform, data, integration, security).
  • Produce and maintain architectural roadmaps, capability maps, and evolution plans aligned to business outcomes and regulatory mandates.
  • Conduct option analyses (cost, risk, scalability, extensibility) and present clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Solution Design & Governance

  • Lead end-to-end solution architecture for new initiatives: context, container/service decomposition (C4), integration contracts, data flows, non-functional requirements.
  • Establish and enforce architecture standards (API versioning, event & data modeling, security patterns, resilience, observability).
  • Run design reviews and govern adherence to reference architectures, technical policies, and regulatory controls (data residency, audit, entitlements).

Integration & API Architecture

  • Define integration patterns (REST, event-driven, messaging, microservices boundaries) and ensure consistent application across squads.
  • Oversee API portfolio lifecycle: classification, reuse, deprecation, performance, and security posture; drive optimization (latency, throughput, error budgets).
  • Guide interoperability between Java services, Power Platform components (custom connectors, Dataverse schemas), and legacy/external systems.

Power Platform Architectural Oversight

  • Architect governance for environments, solution segmentation, Dataverse data models, connector design, and ALM alignment with enterprise standards.
  • Ensure secure, scalable low-code integrations that complement engineered services without duplicative logic or data silos.

Non-Functional Engineering & Risk Mitigation

  • Define and validate non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, resilience, security, observability).
  • Champion threat modeling, secure design, data classification handling, and compliance traceability.
  • Drive architectural risk identification, mitigation planning, and escalation where residual risk exceeds thresholds.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Advise engineering leads on design trade-offs, refactoring strategies, and modernization sequencing.

ln:4454022209.descriptionHtml:
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Supporting tasks to assist in maintaining and strengthening distribution channel relationships, whilst coordinating the relevant business initiatives.
  • Deliver one-on-one coaching to help relationship managers translate knowledge into practical skills, enhance insurance sales capabilities, and achieve sustained performance growth.
    • Train core competencies across the full sales process, implementing insurance sales competency development, including execution of phone appointments, in-depth KYC, case solution and closing.
    • Train and coach RM to how complete Policy Review and analyse Policy Review Reports to customers
    • Participate in customer events and training sessions, assist with pre-event preparations, provide on-site support, and conduct post-event evaluations and follow-ups.
  • Support relationship managers in analyzing and diagnosing client needs, designing tailored solutions, and preparing for client meetings. Enhance practical capabilities through role-play and rehearsals focused on solution presentation and deal closing.
  • Provide coaching on sales strategies for INSH proprietary products, building on the foundational training delivered by Business Development Managers. Help relationship managers improve practical product skills, including aligning product features with client needs and integrating relevant service resources.
  • Analyze market trends and competitor products to identify and articulate the core strengths of INSH products. Develop sales strategies aligned with client profiles, incorporating sales logic and applicable scenarios. Continuously refine strategies through case reviews to improve sales effectiveness
  • Deliver one-on-one coaching to help relationship managers translate knowledge into practical skills, assisting RM to complete pre-case/pre-meeting.
  • Supporting the development and execution of channel development plans and strategies, continuously optimizing existing cooperation models.
  • Collaborating with stakeholders, which may include relationship managers and product team, to maximise empowerment for distribution channels.
  • Assisting in execution of compliance review processes and due diligence to ensure all operations adhere to risk control requirement.
  • 协助建立并维护与分支行及相关业务部门的良好合作关系，确保合作顺畅及内部服务体验。
  • 负责提供一对一教练式的陪跑辅导，实现知识向技能转化，提升保险销售能力，以实现绩效持续稳定的增长。
    • 训练全销售流程的核心技能，实施保险销售能力养成，包含电话约访、深度KYC、解决方案呈现及成交等。
    • 培训并指导客户经理如何完成保单检视，并指导如何为客户分析保单检视报告。
    • 参与行所沙龙及内部培训等活动，配合做好活动前相关准备工作，提供现场赋能支持，并做好活动后的评估及活动效果的跟进。
  • 协助客户经理完成客户需求分析与诊断，设计解决方案；并做好相应面谈准备，通过演练、预演递交解决方案及成交过程，提升客户经理的实战作业能力。
  • 负责产品强化训练辅导，针对INSH自有产品在由业务发展经理完成的销售资质培训基础上开展产品销售策略的训练辅导，帮助客户经理提升产品相关的实战能力，包含产品功能与客户需求的匹配分析，以及与产品功能相关的服务资源整合。
  • 负责市场及同业产品对比分析，通过分析提炼INSH产品核心优势，结合销售逻辑及应用场景，整理与客户概貌相匹配的产品销售策略，并通过典型案例复盘持续优化策略，提升销售有效性。
  • 支持制定并执行新业务拓展计划与策略，持续优化现有合作模式。
  • 与产品部门、客户经理及相关团队保持紧密协作，最大化赋能合作渠道。
  • 严格协助执行相关客户尽职调查及合规审查工作，做好风险控制。
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Reasonable experience in sales force (5 years )
  • Possess board-based knowledge of the Insurance business and China practices
  • Good influential skills – able to influence people of different cultures and backgrounds
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and Chinese. Must be able to communicate effectively in Putonghua.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills – excellent customer relationship management
  • Able to lead, inspire, motivate and develop the teams to deliver business performance and a team player.
  • 具备5年以上销售或业务相关工作经验，有银行渠道或金融机构合作经验者优先
  • 熟悉保险业务及金融产品，了解国内银行渠道业务模式及监管要求
  • 具备良好的沟通协调能力及影响力，能够与不同层级的银行人员建立有效合作
  • 中英文口头与书面沟通能力优秀，必须能流利使用普通话进行商务沟通
  • 具备较强的客户服务意识及关系维护能力，能妥善处理渠道合作中的各项事务
  • 具备团队协作精神，能配合内部团队共同推动业务发展，达成整体目标

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Company relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Life Insurance Company Limited

ln:4454015068.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Global Head of SSv Product Solutions Technology

Business: SecSvcs & Digital Assets Tech

Job ID：55992

Securities Services (SSv) is a profitable, scalable, capital-light business at the heart of the Group’s transaction banking, institutional client and wealth ambitions. SSv Technology is a 1,000+ strong global engineering organisation partnering with SSv and colleagues across HSBC to deliver resilient, secure, and industry-leading technology services.

We’re seeking an accomplished technology executive to join as Global Head of SSv Product Solutions Technology, accountable for setting strategy, leading global delivery, and driving measurable outcomes across our product solutions portfolio.

This role is suited to a hands-on, engineering focused technologist with a strong product mindset and a passion for building high-quality products and services for clients, customers and colleagues. You will bring a pragmatic, outcomes-led approach to engineering, architecture and design, and will be comfortable solving complex challenges at scale within a large, global organisation. You will also champion open, collaborative engineering practices.

Reporting to the Global Securities Services Technology CIO, you’ll set direction and lead global delivery for Product Solutions Technology. You’ll build and inspire a high-performing, multi-disciplinary organisation of delivery managers, solution architects, data analysts and full-stack engineers across Hong Kong, Guangzhou, Bangalore, Pune and London. Working closely with business, operations, cyber security, risk and architecture partners, you’ll drive measurable outcomes—modernising platforms, improving reliability and controls, and accelerating time-to-market—while developing talent and strengthening our engineering culture.

What You’ll Do (principal Accountabilities)

Drive measurable outcomes through technology

  • Deliver business value as quickly and as safely as possible, balancing pace with resilience and long-term sustainability.
  • Own and actively manage a well-defined roadmap, including internal and external dependencies, ensuring transparent prioritisation and delivery governance.
  • Coordinate planning across multiple value streams and teams, optimising plans to maximise benefits and minimise risk.
  • Define performance measures that track delivery outcomes, client adoption/engagement and service health, and act decisively where outcomes aren’t being met.

Build great digital products, journeys and new capabilities

  • Scale reusable technology foundations across digital, data and innovation to increase adoption, accelerate delivery and strengthen cross-team collaboration.
  • Define a target-state architecture that incorporates existing and future technologies to balance pace and disruption, aligned to HSBC architectural principles.
  • Lead the design, delivery and implementation of technology change impacting platforms—from bug-fix through to major enhancements and re-engineering.
  • Establish a strong client and stakeholder feedback loop, ensuring deliverables are accepted and lessons learned are captured through formal retrospectives.

Scale AI, automation and modern engineering practices

  • Innovate using emerging technologies including AI/ML, cloud, big data, APIs and DLT, translating opportunities into tangible business value.
  • Scale an AI and automation approach that improves client experience, operational efficiency and developer productivity, with appropriate governance and controls.
  • Champion engineering excellence and continuous improvement, uplifting capability across the organisation through modern practices (e.g., Agile, DevSecOps) and a strong learning culture.
  • Promote high-cadence delivery into production and remove barriers when throughput slows—working with team leads, IT leadership and business partners to improve flow.

Strengthen resilience, risk management and service quality

  • Put stability at the heart of delivery: ensure services are designed to operate, observable, supportable and resilient.
  • Drive consistent uplift in monitoring, alerting and operational automation to reduce avoidable incidents and improve recovery.
  • Anticipate and manage risks, issues and interdependencies; provide timely, clear reporting and constructive challenge to ensure problems are surfaced early and addressed.

Lead value creation and financial stewardship

  • Act as a visible change leader with business sponsors—owning outcomes, benefits and adoption.
  • Develop and manage business cases (investment, benefits and financial linkage) and ensure benefits realisation through to implementation and transition.
  • Manage budgets with strong control and transparency; act on variance and manage to the value proposition.
  • Identify and remove barriers to success, addressing difficult topics directly and constructively in HSBC’s best interests.

Build a high-performing, inclusive global team

  • Identify and manage resource requirements to build effective international, multi-disciplinary teams; source talent balancing cost, quality and internal capability.
  • Set clear objectives and responsibilities; ensure strong induction, orientation and ongoing coaching.
  • Build a performance-led culture that improves efficiency and outcomes, including active management of underperformance.
  • Promote an environment of inclusion, diversity, collaboration and trust, role-modelling HSBC values and ways of working.

Experience

  • Proven experience leading engineering teams (e.g., squad/feature teams) with accountability for delivery outcome.
  • Strong hands-on software engineering background (or relevant engineering discipline) with experience shipping production systems in a complex, global, business-critical programmes and/or systems at pace.
  • Experience making and influencing technical decisions (system design, integration patterns, data flows).
  • Track record of improving engineering practices (quality, CI/CD, testing, reliability, observability).
  • Stakeholder and Business Sponsor management experience being able to translate between technical detail and business impact.
  • Direct experience mobilising and managing change and/or technology in a complex, multinational environment.
  • Ability to make key strategic decisions that are pragmatic and grounded in practical solutions.
  • Demonstrable experience leading delivery of AI/ML and/or GenAI-enabled capabilities in a regulated enterprise environment, from use-case selection through to production rollout and benefits realisation.
  • Strong commercial focus with financial acumen (business cases, budgeting, benefits realisation).

Knowledge and capabilities

  • Excellent understanding of enterprise technology practices (including open-source engineering approaches).
  • Knowledgeable on external technology trends and the regulatory environment.
  • Clear communication and ability to translate complexity into plain language.
  • Strong planning, governance, reporting and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proactive risk and issue management; practical and pragmatic decision-making.
  • Delivery at pace, collaboration, innovation and idea management.
  • Proficient in any programming language; comfortable engaging with engineering teams on technical detail.
  • Experience working with remote development teams and multiple development lifecycle methodologies; exposure to Agile.

- Promote high-cadence delivery into production and remove barriers when throughput slows—working with team leads, IT leadership and business partners to improve flow.
Strengthen resilience, risk management and service quality
- Put stability at the heart of delivery: ensure services are designed to operate, observable, supportable and resilient.
- Drive consistent uplift in monitoring, alerting and operational automation to reduce avoidable incidents and improve recovery.
- Anticipate and manage risks, issues and interdependencies; provide timely, clear reporting and constructive challenge to ensure problems are surfaced early and addressed.
Lead value creation and financial stewardship
- Act as a visible change leader with business sponsors—owning outcomes, benefits and adoption.
- Develop and manage business cases (investment, benefits and financial linkage) and ensure benefits realisation through to implementation and transition.
- Manage budgets with strong control and transparency; act on variance and manage to the value proposition.
- Identify and remove barriers to success, addressing difficult topics directly and constructively in HSBC’s best interests.
Build a high-performing, inclusive global team
- Identify and manage resource requirements to build effective international, multi-disciplinary teams; source talent balancing cost, quality and internal capability.
- Set clear objectives and responsibilities; ensure strong induction, orientation and ongoing coaching.
- Build a performance-led culture that improves efficiency and outcomes, including active management of underperformance.
- Promote an environment of inclusion, diversity, collaboration and trust, role-modelling HSBC values and ways of working.
Experience
- Proven experience leading engineering teams (e.g., squad/feature teams) with accountability for delivery outcome.
- Strong hands-on software engineering background (or relevant engineering discipline) with experience shipping production systems in a complex, global, business-critical programmes and/or systems at pace.
- Experience making and influencing technical decisions (system design, integration patterns, data flows).
- Track record of improving engineering practices (quality, CI/CD, testing, reliability, observability).
- Stakeholder and Business Sponsor management experience being able to translate between technical detail and business impact.
- Direct experience mobilising and managing change and/or technology in a complex, multinational environment.
- Ability to make key strategic decisions that are pragmatic and grounded in practical solutions.
- Demonstrable experience leading delivery of AI/ML and/or GenAI-enabled capabilities in a regulated enterprise environment, from use-case selection through to production rollout and benefits realisation.
- Strong commercial focus with financial acumen (business cases, budgeting, benefits realisation).
Knowledge and capabilities
- Excellent understanding of enterprise technology practices (including open-source engineering approaches).
- Knowledgeable on external technology trends and the regulatory environment.
- Clear communication and ability to translate complexity into plain language.
- Strong planning, governance, reporting and stakeholder management skills.
- Proactive risk and issue management; practical and pragmatic decision-making.
- Delivery at pace, collaboration, innovation and idea management.
- Proficient in any programming language; comfortable engaging with engineering teams on technical detail.
- Experience working with remote development teams and multiple development lifecycle methodologies; exposure to Agile.

  • Drive engineering excellence: code reviews, reusable dbt macros/patterns, standards for testing (dbt tests + Python), and release discipline.
  • Leverage GenAI-enabled delivery responsibly: improve documentation quality, accelerate analysis and test creation, and streamline incident triage—while ensuring human review, data confidentiality, and secure usage.
  • Partner with Architecture/Platform/Security/Controls to align with enterprise standards and governance.
  • People leadership: hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, performance management, and career development in an inclusive way.
  • Communicate clearly in English (and collaborate effectively with local stakeholders; Cantonese preferred): design docs, decision papers, status updates, and stakeholder comms.

Requirements

  • Lead end-to-end ETL delivery: requirements, design, build, test, release and production support
  • Strong RDBMS/SQL capability: complex SQL, data analysis, performance tuning and troubleshooting
  • Hands-on Python for data processing and automation (clean, maintainable, production-ready code)
  • Experience enabling analytics/BI delivery, ideally with Apache Superset (dashboards, datasets, performance tuning, stakeholder iteration).
  • Confident in Linux & Shell scripting for job automation, scheduling and incident diagnosis

  • Partner with Architecture/Platform/Security/Controls to align with enterprise standards and governance.
  • People leadership: hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, performance management, and career development in an inclusive way.
  • Communicate clearly in English (and collaborate effectively with local stakeholders; Cantonese preferred): design docs, decision papers, status updates, and stakeholder comms.

Requirements

  • Lead end-to-end ETL delivery: requirements, design, build, test, release and production support
  • Strong RDBMS/SQL capability: complex SQL, data analysis, performance tuning and troubleshooting
  • Hands-on Python for data processing and automation (clean, maintainable, production-ready code)
  • Experience enabling analytics/BI delivery, ideally with Apache Superset (dashboards, datasets, performance tuning, stakeholder iteration).
  • Confident in Linux & Shell scripting for job automation, scheduling and incident diagnosis

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist.

Business: Group Functions Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Support the design and delivery of a prevention-first, intelligence-led Financial Crime technology architecture.
  • Take an end-to-end view across Financial Crime journeys, including prevention, detection, decisioning, alerting, investigation, regulatory reporting, data, and feedback loops.
  • Translate business needs into clear, practical technology solutions and phased delivery plans.
  • Help modernise legacy applications into cloud-hosted, API-driven, event-enabled, and data-led platforms.
  • Identify and shape appropriate AI/ML use cases, such as intelligent triage, real-time risk assessment, decision support, search, summarisation, workflow automation, and operational insights.
  • Assess AI/ML opportunities based on business value, user need, data readiness, technical feasibility, control effectiveness, explainability, operational adoption, and governance.
  • Encourage reusable capabilities, common integration patterns, and real-time data services that can be used across Financial Crime domains.
  • Work with engineering, architecture, security, data, infrastructure, and operations teams to ensure solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, and supportable.
  • Drive good engineering practices across architecture, delivery quality, CI/CD, testing, observability, automation, release controls, and production readiness.
  • Provide technical challenge and support to delivery teams, helping resolve blockers and maintain momentum.
  • Coach engineers and technical leads, raising capability in modern engineering, cloud, data, DevOps, and AI-assisted delivery.
  • Build strong working relationships across global teams and help align stakeholders around delivery priorities and architecture decisions.

Requirements

Technology and solution capability

  • Broad technical understanding across modern application architecture, APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, cloud platforms, data, DevOps, security, and automation.
  • Ability to engage credibly with engineers and architects, review solution designs, identify risks, and challenge technical decisions constructively.
  • Experience contributing to technology modernisation, cloud migration, application integration, or platform transformation initiatives.
  • Working understanding of data platforms, data quality, real-time and batch integration, and how data supports decisioning and analytics.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, containerisation, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, observability, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Awareness of AI/ML solution patterns, including machine learning, LLM-based applications, RAG, agentic workflows, and AI-assisted engineering.
  • Understanding of the principles behind MLOps or LLMOps, including controlled deployment, monitoring, governance, and operational support.
  • Experience in Agile delivery environments, with exposure to tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Jenkins, Terraform, or equivalent.

Business and Financial Crime acumen

  • Ability to connect technology choices to business value, customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and control effectiveness.
  • Good understanding of Financial Crime, fraud, risk, compliance, or regulated operational environments. Experience in banking is preferred.
  • Ability to think across an end-to-end business journey rather than focus only on a single application or process step.
  • Curiosity about how AI/ML, data, and automation can improve Financial Crime outcomes in a responsible and practical way.
  • Ability to balance innovation with security, governance, resilience, delivery feasibility, and operational sustainability.

Leadership and collaboration

  • Demonstrated ability to drive change in a complex organisation, influence stakeholders, and turn strategic direction into practical delivery.
  • Strong communication skills, able to explain complex technology and AI/ML concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative and pragmatic approach, with the confidence to challenge constructively and align teams around decisions.
  • Strong ownership mindset: proactive, delivery-focused, and accountable for outcomes.
  • Ability to work effectively across global, multicultural, and matrixed teams.
  • Interest in mentoring others and helping build sustainable engineering and technology capability.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Principal Engineer (Application Platform)

Business: CTO

Job ID：53372

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Role

As a Principal Engineer, Application Platforms in CTO Platform Engineering & Architecture you’ll shape technical strategy and provide architecture oversight for next-generation application and AI platforms. The role focuses on accelerating time-to-market for a major platform while improving resilience and reducing operational overhead through integrated controls and open-source solutions. You’ll play a key role in progressing Kubernetes-as-a-Service (KaaS) by defining target architectures, setting technical direction and aligning plans across multiple teams. You’ll act as the senior technical authority for early product onboarding ensuring solutions are production-ready from day one across security resilience performance and operability. Success means consistent platform patterns across delivery teams faster safer releases and reduced rework and operational risk. You’ll also partner closely with developer platform teams to deliver coherent integration and a joined-up developer experience. The outcomes support application rewrite and decommissioning programmes reduced run-the-bank (RTB) cost and platform capability integration across estates.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Shape platform standardisation and simplification aligned to strategic objectives including application rewrite and decommissioning duplication reduction and RTB efficiency
  • Provide technical direction across the organisation aligned to platform strategy engineering standards and a consistent developer experience
  • Define and own reference architectures designs technical roadmaps and golden paths for onboarding workloads to KaaS
  • Embed an open-source-based engineering stack ensuring reference patterns and platform capabilities integrate cleanly and sustainably
  • Establish reusable engineering patterns components and reference implementations to improve delivery speed and consistency
  • Accelerate KaaS and related hosting products by setting key technical decisions removing architectural constraints and aligning delivery across multiple teams
  • Establish non-functional requirements as enforceable engineering guardrails such as policy-as-code secure-by-default templates and automated compliance evidence
  • Govern early product onboarding as senior technical authority ensuring production readiness and proportionate technical governance while reducing rework risk

What We're Looking For

  • Bring significant experience operating as a Principal Engineer or senior technical authority in large-scale enterprise environments
  • Demonstrate hands-on platform engineering experience delivering shared services used by multiple product and application teams
  • Apply deep Kubernetes and container platform expertise including multi-tenant design cluster operations security controls and reliability considerations for KaaS
  • Establish production readiness across resilience observability security performance and operability with clear non-functional expectations
  • Show experience guiding MVP onboarding or early lifecycle platform adoption with a focus on sustainable solutions and reduced rework
  • Accelerate delivery through pragmatic technical decision-making that balances target architecture with execution realities
  • Influence across organisational boundaries managing complex dependencies and senior stakeholders without direct authority
  • Partner effectively with developer platform teams to improve developer experience through standard interfaces tooling and patterns

Platform engineering that ships

This role is a chance to set the technical direction for Kubernetes-as-a-Service and help teams move workloads to production quickly consistently and safely. You’ll shape reference architectures and guardrails that make platforms easier to adopt and simpler to operate. You’ll also work across teams to remove friction in delivery and strengthen production-grade outcomes from day one. If you want to build platform foundations that reduce toil and improve resilience at scale we’d like to hear from you.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. /LP

ln:4341785962.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Seeking a Java Developer with extensive experience and understanding of the asset management investment business to join our Investment Technology team.

As a Development Manager in the Investment Technology team, you will be responsible for requirements research and analysis, system design, development, system go-live, changes and maintenance of the investment research platform.

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the project management and development of the core modules of the company's investment research platform;
  • Promote the company's financial technology work, keep up with the development of Fin-tech, continuously absorb and introduce new technology systems, empower business, and improve the company's competitiveness
  • Formulate technical routes and overall framework to quickly break through technical difficulties encountered during the development process
  • Communicate with business users on demand and complete demand analysis, system design, coding development and project management;
  • Responsible for continuously tracking the progress of the project, clearly understanding and submitting the results of each stage, identifying the risks in the project, evaluating and eliminating risks, and ensuring the quality of the project;
  • Assist in the development of system specifications, and be responsible for checking suppliers and self-developed codes in accordance with the specifications.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Full-time bachelor degree or above in computer-related majors, with 3 years of software development experience and independent complete project development experience
  • Experience in building Fintech projects in the asset management industry, such as portfolio management, simulated portfolios, real-time valuation, real-time positions, knowledge graphs, etc.
  • Proficient in Software development life cycle
  • Proficient in Java development and micro service technology system, familiar with Spring boot, Spring cloud and other frameworks
  • Familiar with front-end development technologies, such as Vue, React, Bootstrap, Jquery and other open source frameworks
  • Proficient in Oracle database and object-oriented analysis and modeling
  • Strong system architecture ability, clear thinking, quick thinking, fast learning ability and communication and coordination ability
  • Have a deep understanding of the fund industry's investment research related business, and have experience in the development of specific investment, research, performance attribution are preferred

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

ln:4452795603.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

We are looking for a Full-stack Specialist, responsible for the development and maintenance of in-house applications. You will be working alongside and managing other Engineers and Developers working on different layers of the Applications. Therefore, a commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and the creation of quality products is essential.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Java
  • SpringBoot
  • RDBMS
  • Maven/Gradle
  • ReactJS (or EmberJS)
  • JavaScript, NodeJS
  • DevOps CICD (ADO)
  • Kubernetes, EKS, OCP, ECS etc.
  • Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure)

Qualifications

  • Minimum experience of 6 years in IT industry with at least 4 years of relevant experience
  • Proficient in RESTful API, SpringBoot 3.x, SpringBatch
  • Should have knowledge on Relational and/or No-SQL Databases
  • Preferred to have knowledge on API Gateways, API security, OAuth 2, OIDC etc.
  • Should be independently able to manage CICD tasks using Azure ADO, Maven & Helm Charts
  • Experienced in Container Infrastructure such as Kubernetes, OCP or AWS EKS.
  • Experienced working in an Agile environment with globally distributed teams.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4452787615.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Scope of Role:

Affluent City Manager is responsible for

  • Providing city-wide (imply to the number of branches that one has oversight) strategic direction, guidance and leadership to the formulation and deployment of branch banking strategy.
  • To ensure delivery of superior financial performance for Branch Banking and work closely with other sales & service teams to manage & deliver specific sales, service, governance & risk KPIs.
  • Coordinate/engage with City GM to better enhance governance.
  • Responsible for Micro-Marketing performance at City Branch Banking level.

Take overall responsibilities at the city including: achieve sales target, develop new customers and maintain customer relationships; operations and compliance management at the city; team management and promotion of team work.

工作范围：

分行网络部城市经理主要负责

  • 制定该城市（该城市经理所掌管的支行）的战略方向，指导和领导支行战略的制定和部署
  • 确保为分支行提供卓越的财务绩效，并与其他销售和服务团队密切合作，管理和交付特定的销售、服务、治理和风险关键绩效指标
  • 与城市总经理密切合作，以更好的加强对分支行的管理
  • 对城市层面的微营销活动负责

全面管理城市各项工作，包括：完成销售目标，开发新客户，维护客户关系；城市各项运营及合规管理；团队管理，促进团队合作。

Key Responsibilities

General

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review;
  • Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control;
  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of the event over which the employee has the duties of management and/or leadership;
  • Be responsible for significant losses due to failure of effectiveness of internal control.

总则

  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查;
  • 正确履行管理职责，并确保内控的效率；
  • 对负有管理和/或领导责任的事项引起或相关的违反监管规定事件或风险，承担相应责任;
  • 为内控失效造成的重大损失负责。

Strategy Formulation & Execution and Financial Management

  • Deliver overall budgeted financials and KPIs for covered City and Branches
  • Formulate and deliver City level branch strategy, optimized across segments
  • Align Branch Banking with Segment initiatives and contribute towards country financials and KPIs
  • Responsible for business development through typical activities like formulate/implement/monitor branch banking strategies, regional sales plans and Micro Marketing activities to acquire new customers, deepen existing relationships in the branch network, and align these with the business goals
  • Develop an infrastructure of efficiency and effectiveness throughout the branch banking business through resource optimization, process re-engineering and cost/capacity management across value streams and functions

战略制定、执行与财务管理

  • 为所管理的城市和分支机构提供总体预算财务状况和关键绩效指标
  • 制定和传达城市分行战略，实现跨部门优化
  • 使分行业务与客群管理部的倡议相一致，为全国的财务状况和绩效指标做出贡献
  • 通过制定/实施/监控银行战略、区域销售计划和微观营销活动等来获取新客户，深化分行网络中的现有关系，并使其与业务目标保持一致
  • 通过资源优化在整个分行业务中开发高效的基础设施，跨价值流和功能的流程重新设计和成本/容量管理

Customer Experience & Relationship Management

  • Manage the branch banking customer portfolio for profitable growth by deepening and widening the customer relationship through customer contact and cross sell programs
  • Build a sustained Customer-centric culture where employees outserve our customers with insights on their needs and lead the market on Customer Satisfaction
  • Set/Monitor/Manage service delivery in the branch banking network to the highest competitive standards
  • Manage sales and service operations efficiency & efficacy for branches
  • Create right culture and direction that match the Bank’s overall strategy
  • Migrate best practices among branches

客户体验与关系管理

  • 通过客户联系和交叉销售计划深化和扩大客户关系，管理银行客户，实现盈利增长
  • 建立一种持续的以客户为中心的文化，在这种文化中，员工通过对客户需求的洞悉来更好的服务客户，引领客户满意市场
  • 将银行网络提供的服务设置/监控/管理为最高竞争标准
  • 管理支行的销售和服务运营效率
  • 创造符合银行整体战略的正确文化和方向
  • 在支行间分享最好的做法

Leadership, People & Community Development

  • Build a motivated workforce with bench strength and strong local talent pipeline for future business growth and continuity
  • Coach, guide and manage direct reports of so that they deliver ambitious performance in line with country strategy /aspirations
  • Work to improve quality and depth of management talent across the board in Branch Banking
  • Manage sales & service workforces within branch - capacity, scorecard

领导能力、人员和团体发展

  • 为了未来的业务增长和持续性发展建设一支充满活力的团队，并提供强大的本地人才渠道
  • 培训、指导和管理直接下属，以便他们实现符合业务战略的更好的绩效
  • 努力提高分支行管理人才的素质和深度
  • 管理分支行内销售与运营人员的业务能力和平衡计分卡

Risk Management & Control

  • Control and periodic check operational risks and work flows. Review key operational risks and efficiency indicators to ensure healthy business growth
  • Ensure the business and external risks are anticipated and managed robustly with controls and the business is Fit for Growth
  • Ensure strict compliance with all regulations and controls as set by the Bank and external regulatory authorities by all staff. Ensure that effective controls are in place for the prevention of money laundering in line with Group Policy and Standards, and local legal and regulatory requirements
  • Represents the Bank, with respect to the area of responsibility, acting as an interface with regulatory and government bodies where necessary
  • Achieve KPIs set for operational, credit, people and risk parameters
  • Recognize and exercise sound commercial judgment & respond and resolve issues appropriately
  • Sound knowledge of all aspects of general banking, retail operations and credit operations / deposit and lending products / inspection and audit requirements, as applicable
  • Strictly follow and ensure endeavors by the sub-branch comply with PRC laws and regulations and with current and forthcoming regulations, ordinances and provisions issued by CBRC and other regulatory authorities;
  • Strictly follow and ensure endeavors by the sub-branch comply with current and forthcoming internal rules and with the code of conduct issued by the Company and SCB Group;
  • Must comply with their respective Money Laundering Prevention Procedures and be alert at all times to unusual or possibly suspicious customer activity, and should report any suspicious activity to AML Surveillance Team and line manager as well as directly to the Country MLPO in urgent or exceptional circumstances;
  • Ensure team awareness of all relevant regulations and internal Risk & Compliance policies and procedures; ensure all Regulatory, Group Policies are adhered to in the sub-branch and proper risk controls are in place;
  • Under the leadership of the City General Manager: to manage and coordinate the implementation of AML and fraud risk control measures at sub-branch level as required, ensuring that these control measures will be put in place and operated in an effective manner and that staff’s awareness on AML and fraud will be enhanced through regular trainings.
  • Under the leadership of the City General Manager: to support and provide assistance in any AML and fraud prevention related program, staff training or any other AML and fraud prevention related activities that may be required.
  • Under the leadership of the City General Manager: to escalate and report any significant AML issues and fraud incidents to senior management including the Head, FCR/Country MLPO for investigation, mitigation and resolution, and to report AML suspicious transactions in the first instance to relevant business MLPO and Country MLPO.

风险管理与控制

  • 定期检查操作风险和工作流程。审查关键运营风险和效率指标，确保业务健康增长
  • 确保业务和外部风险是可预测的，通过控制进行可靠管理，并且该业务适合增长
  • 确保所有员工严格遵守银行和外部监管机构制定的所有法规和控制措施。确保根据集团政策和标准以及当地法律和监管要求，对防止洗钱采取有效的控制措施
  • 在责任范围内代表银行，在必要时作为与监管机构和政府机构的接口
  • 实现针对运营、信贷、人员和风险参数设置的关键绩效指标
  • 识别和运用合理的商业判断，适当地回应和解决问题
  • 全面了解银行业务、零售业务和信贷业务/存款和贷款产品/检查和审计要求（如适用）
  • 严格遵守和确保支行遵守中国法律法规和银监会及其他监管机构颁布的现行和即将颁布的规章、条例和规定
  • 严格遵守和确保支行符合现行和即将颁布的内部规则以及公司和SCB集团颁布的行为准则
  • 必须遵守洗钱预防程序，随时警惕异常或可能可疑的客户活动，并应在紧急情况下向AML监控团队和直线经理以及直接向国家MLPO报告任何可疑活动，特殊情况除外
  • 确保团队了解所有相关法规和内部风险与合规政策和程序；确保支行遵守所有监管、集团政策，并制定适当的风险控制措施
  • 在城市总经理的领导下：根据需要管理和协调支行层面的反洗钱和欺诈风险控制措施的实施，确保这些控制措施的落实和有效运行，并确保员工对反洗钱和欺诈风险控制措施的意识。通过定期培训加强反洗钱和欺诈意识。
  • 在城市总经理的领导下：支持和协助任何反洗钱和欺诈预防相关计划、员工培训或任何其他可能需要的反洗钱和欺诈预防相关活动。
  • 在城市总经理的领导下：将任何重大AML问题和欺诈事件上报高级管理层，包括负责人、FCR/国家MLPO，以进行调查、缓解和解决，第一时间向相关业务MLPO和国家MLPO报告AML可疑交易

主要职责：

Key Measurable

  • City Affluent performance
  • Business drivers, including productivity measures (cost savings, revenue per $ cost, KPIs) specific to channel process improvements
  • Customer experience performance (including NPS, # active customers, PPC, complaints, TAT improvement, sales controllable errors, bundling)
  • People management (frontline attrition, My Voice, Training plan & execution for each job family, including certification)
  • Effective people development across the board and succession planning of key positions
  • Monitor and drive tight control framework
  • Quality and effectiveness of:
  • Deployment of Affluent strategy
  • Coaching and development of direct reports
  • Developing a top 1st and 2nd line management
