ln:4471420237.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4469725167.descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.Morgan Stanley Investment Management China (MSIM China) strives to provide diverse investment management services to a full spectrum of clients across both individual and institutional investors. Established as a joint venture in 2008, MSIM China became fully owned by Morgan Stanley Investment Management in 2023.

Position Overview

This position will sit in Compliance Department in SZ office of MSIM China, serving as 2L Compliance officer. This role is expected to work closely with control functions (LCD/Risk) and business functions (1L), as well as regional/global teams, engaging in compliance management activities (compliance advisory/review/monitoring/training/testing/reporting) to continuously keep the business activities to be conducted under the compliance framework to avoid risks due to breach of regulatory requirements as well as Firm Standard.

What You'll Do

  • Licensing:

This role will perform personnel licensing management tasks to ensure the employees obtain and maintain appropriate licenses for supporting them conduct professional activities. The licensing management includes but is not limited to policy and procedure building, qualification review, regulatory registration/filing, ongoing training coordination, regulatory reporting, information disclosure and other related tasks. During this process, this role will work together with various functions and regional licensing compliance team.

  • Information disclosure:

To fulfill local obligations to make sure the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of fund information disclosure, this role is expected to review the proposed fund information disclosure documents (ad-hoc/regular fund reports, fund prospectus and key fact sheets）, work together with Tech team to continuously explore the work automation by leveraging Tech resources, provide advice/interpretation on regulatory requirements, provide compliance input and review, manage disclosure-related liaison activities.

  • Compliance monitoring, surveillance and testing:

This role will deeply participate in compliance monitoring, surveillance and testing projects, acting as an independent challenge function, support BU to identify internal control deficiencies, take remediations and make improvements. This role will lead or participate in projects of personal trading/OBI and instant messaging tool management.

Also, the role will collaborate with regional compliance team to co-conduct some of compliance testing projects as planned.

  • Policy & Procedure building and integration:

This role will help enhance compliance policies and procedures in terms of conflict-of-interest avoidance, personal trading/OBI, employee code of conduct etc.

This role will guide or help other functions to establish new policies and procedures or revisit existing ones accordingly where there is new regulatory requirement or new business initiative from 2L perspective.

This role is expected to help revisit the current Compliance policies and procedures against Firm Standard from time to time; and make necessary localization to ensure the implementation of the Firm Standard.

  • Compliance Training & Culture:

This role is expected to contribute to compliance culture construction by delivering compliance training, circulating compliance notice/reminder as assigned.

Also, this role will collaborate with regional/global compliance teams to develop compliance training programs for all employees by fully leveraging regional/global training platforms and resources.

  • Compliance Advisory & Review:

This role will contribute to reviewing on new products, investment instruments, business initiatives, marketing and sales materials etc.

This role will contribute to providing advice to BU.

  • Ongoing integration:

This role will participate in ongoing Compliance Integration projects, which aim to leverage best practice from the Firm, integrate MSIM China into wider MSIM group, continuously support local team to strengthen internal control and streamline the process.

  • Other BAU work:

Regular/ad-hoc compliance related reports and translation.

Other tasks as assigned from time to time.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor's or above degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or a related field. A relevant professional qualification (e.g., PRC BAR, CPA, CFA, FRM, or equivalent compliance certification) is preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in compliance, internal audit, risk management, operation within a financial institution or experience from reputable accounting firm or law firm.
  • Strong willingness and capabilities in teamwork and collaboration. High sense of responsibility.
  • Good capacities of issue-resolving and being open minded.
  • Highly self-motivated, with the initiative to do the right thing persistently.
  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the proven ability to influence and build trust with people/teams with different backgrounds.
  • Fluency in English is required.

Reporting Line

This role directly reports to Head of Compliance Department, under oversight and performance review of MSIM China CCO.

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo

ln:4471407193.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Scope of Role:

To accelerate Affluent Acquisition’s transformation in driving the implementation of key strategic initiatives. Acquisition HO.

Key Responsibilities

  • Based on the goals, establish regional channel portfolio, to drive business growth
  • Drive Acquisition Partnership signing, activation and productivity management
  • Work closely with BDE team to improve channel relationship and high value client’s referral
  • Track pipeline and channel performance
  • Scale effective channel practices across regions
  • Work closely with the Head, Acquisition Excellence to implement transformation strategies
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control
  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of the event over which the employee has the duties of management and/or leadership
  • Be responsible for significant losses due to failure of effectiveness of internal control

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for Liquidity risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Channel Development
  • Partnership Management

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • Associate degree or above, major in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, or related fields preferred.
  • More than 5 years of work experience, with practical experience in marketing, project management, and data analysis; experience in banking is preferred.
  • Strong strategic project support and execution abilities, excellent business acumen.
  • Highly motivated, strong interpersonal skills, with outstanding collaboration and coordination abilities.
  • Strong personal integrity and compliance awareness, with no past disciplinary records, and a deep understanding and commitment to banking industry regulations and internal control requirements.
  • Good credit assessment and marketing skills, able to analyze financial information.
  • Optimistic, strong stress resistance, able to maintain high-quality and stable output in fast-paced strategic projects.

选择标准：

  • 大专或以上学历，商业管理、市场营销、金融或相关专业优先。
  • 5年以上工作经验，需兼具市场营销、项目管理、数据分析实践经验，有银行相关工作经验者优先。
  • 具备良好的战略项目支持与执行力，优秀的业务敏锐度。
  • 积极性强，人际交往能力强，具有优秀的合作协调能力。
  • 具备极强的个人诚信与合规意识，过往无任何违纪记录，深刻理解并承诺遵金融行业的监管与内控要求。
  • 良好的信用评估和营销技能，能够分析金融信息
  • 乐观，抗压能力强，能够在快节奏的战略项目中保持高校与稳定的输出。

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Summary
Scope of Role:
To accelerate Affluent Acquisition’s transformation in driving the implementation of key strategic initiatives. Acquisition HO.
Key Responsibilities
- Based on the goals, establish regional channel portfolio, to drive business growth
- Drive Acquisition Partnership signing, activation and productivity management
- Work closely with BDE team to improve channel relationship and high value client’s referral
- Track pipeline and channel performance
- Scale effective channel practices across regions
- Work closely with the Head, Acquisition Excellence to implement transformation strategies
- Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
- Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control
- Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of the event over which the employee has the duties of management and/or leadership
- Be responsible for significant losses due to failure of effectiveness of internal control
Strategy
- Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.
Business
- Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates
Processes
- Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.
- Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
- Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
- Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
- Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
- Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
- Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.
Risk Management
- Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
- All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for Liquidity risk.
Governance
- Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
- Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
- Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
- Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Skills And Experience
- Channel Development
- Partnership Management
Qualifications
Selection Criteria:
- Associate degree or above, major in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, or related fields preferred.
- More than 5 years of work experience, with practical experience in marketing, project management, and data analysis; experience in banking is preferred.
- Strong strategic project support and execution abilities, excellent business acumen.
- Highly motivated, strong interpersonal skills, with outstanding collaboration and coordination abilities.
- Strong personal integrity and compliance awareness, with no past disciplinary records, and a deep understanding and commitment to banking industry regulations and internal control requirements.
- Good credit assessment and marketing skills, able to analyze financial information.
- Optimistic, strong stress resistance, able to maintain high-quality and stable output in fast-paced strategic projects.
选择标准：
- 大专或以上学历，商业管理、市场营销、金融或相关专业优先。
- 5年以上工作经验，需兼具市场营销、项目管理、数据分析实践经验，有银行相关工作经验者优先。
- 具备良好的战略项目支持与执行力，优秀的业务敏锐度。
- 积极性强，人际交往能力强，具有优秀的合作协调能力。
- 具备极强的个人诚信与合规意识，过往无任何违纪记录，深刻理解并承诺遵金融行业的监管与内控要求。
- 良好的信用评估和营销技能，能够分析金融信息
- 乐观，抗压能力强，能够在快节奏的战略项目中保持高校与稳定的输出。
Together We

ln:4471192726.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • The role is responsible for managing pan China overall CMPS business, including FX and Structured products and sales advisory team.
  • The role requires to have practical experience in sales, sales management / planning in banking industry; sound knowledge of banking products and services and banking procedures, FX market & products, and other personal investment services and strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to deal with all levels of stakeholders in complicated situations.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Drive profitable growth through leadership of the team with a clearer and more strategic oversight on SD space and SME FX hedging.
  • Expand more segment and industries to explore business opportunities.
  • Build a more professional and efficient sales team to provide higher-end service to the clients
  • With reference to the overall Wealth Solutions China Strategy, develop full range of CMPS products within country regulatory framework.
  • Collaborate with key Country, Regional and Group office stakeholders in Wealth Solutions, WRB, Technology and Operations to bring the best values to our customers
  • Strategize, plan and execute the long term strategic CMPS plans and tactical plans to take advantage of the business opportunities within the footprint of WRB

Business

  • Manage and deliver financial objectives. This will include constant monitoring of financial performance and metrics to stay on track.
  • Spearhead our digital initiatives including Wealth FX and digital Structured Deposits.
  • Cover FX and Structured Product strategy, Retail customer value proposition, go to market strategy, new product introduction, systems and processes.

Processes

  • Ensure all CMPS products have the necessary CAs, Product Approval and DOI.
  • Adherence to laws and regulations, internal risk and compliance policies (including anti-money laundry, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption and relevant FCC risks) and the Group Code of Conduct
  • Monitor and manage the systematic and non-systematic risk of the product portfolios

People & Talent

  • Well trained and certified team to perform CMPS product management, dealing and sales activities
  • Team to display exemplary conduct and live by the bank’s Values and Code of Conduct.

Risk Management

  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties.
  • Comply with the respective Money Laundering Prevention Procedures and be alert at all times to unusual or possibly suspicious customer activity and should report any suspicious activity to AML Surveillance Team and line manager as well as directly to the Country MLPO in urgent or exceptional circumstances.
  • Mitigation of risks and resolution of issues in a timely manner including developing suitable controls and measuring their effectiveness.
  • Proactive identification and reporting of risks and concerns.

Governance

  • Adherence to laws and regulations, internal risk and compliance policies (including anti-money laundry, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption and relevant FCC risks) and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Timely completion of all mandatory risk and compliance training, including e-learning by the set deadlines.
  • Fully understand the importance of consumer rights protection, prevent damage to consumer’s best interest, implement regulatory requirements related to consumer rights protection, ensure to complete relevant trainings and to always embed consumer rights protection mindset when performing daily work.
  • Fully understand the importance of fraud prevention, prevent fraud risks, maintain safe and steady operation of the position, implement regulatory requirements of fraud prevention, strictly execute DOIs of the department, ensure to complete relevant trainings and embed fraud prevention in daily work

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Wealth Solutions, WS COO, HR, Legal, CFCR, Operation Risk, Finance, Operations, Technology, Affluent, SME, Segments, Marketing, Group Product Owners, Regulators, Counterparties

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in China CMPS Team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

Skills And Experience

  • Products and Processes
  • Regulatory Framework and Requirements (SIF)

Qualifications

The role should be a technical expert who can develop strong product solutions and differentiated product proposition including best-in-class digital initiatives (Wealth FX and digital Structured Deposits), retail customer value proposition, go-to-market strategy, new product introduction, systems, and processes.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do

Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits

A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4471409031.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

This role could be based in Malaysia and China Guangzhou. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.

Key Responsibilities

As a Product Owner in our cross-functional squads, the candidate will drive the outcomes of the squad to deliver on their objectives and key results. You will build and prioritise the product backlog to achieve business goals and manage stakeholder relationships to align expectation, prioritisation and overall product roadmap.

Strategy

  • The primary purpose of this position is to develop and transform Capital Markets Products & Solutions (CMPS) product capability

to provide digital channels for both clients and internal users across Private Banking and Retail Banking.

  • The Bank is aiming to grow product capability through digital and self-direct channels. This Product Owner (PO) role is to drive

the agile technology projects to establish a robust price discovery and execution platform. It is also required to build system interface

with upstream systems (e.g. client information check) and downstream systems (e.g. booking trades into core banking platforms) to

streamline operation flow and improve users (including clients) experience and frontline productivity.

  • As PO, you will develop and maintain a vision for agile technology projects and be responsible for communicating the vision to the

scrum team. Be responsible for agile technology projects and features from concept to final implementation. In particular,

  • have a good understanding of wealth management products, it's processes and relevance to clients.
  • Define and own the strategic digital product vision and roadmap for the wealth management product suite.
  • Align product strategy with business goals, market trends, and client needs.
  • Develop a competitive product strategy across relevant asset classes (such as FX, equities, fixed income, structured products, OTC derivatives, funds, and insurance.)
  • Monitor market dynamics and regulatory changes, ensuring products remain competitive and compliant.
  • As PO you will work with architects, business stakeholders and development teams to ensure that business, quality and functional

goals are met with each release. Be responsible for the design, usability, quality and delivery of agile technology projects and features.

  • As the subject matter expert, this role is to determine business requirements, review technology project plans from the business

perspective, and ensure new technology capabilities are embedded in business processes to deliver benefits. Ensure smooth

execution on the ground, and communicate the changes delivered to relevant stakeholders including front office.

Business

  • Review and understand key business policies and processes in Wealth Management in offering CMPS products and services to

both private banking and retail banking clients. Identify critical pain-points and articulate how planned / in-flight technology projects will solve them.

  • As Product Owner (PO), specialized in Digital platforms, should be familiar with the development of CMPS order management/

execution platforms and ensure that it is properly interfaced with multiple downstream booking systems.

  • The PO should have strong technical knowhow to improve front office systems performance and expand product penetration according to the business development.

Processes

  • The PO is the key decision maker on priorities and design decisions, and work to ensure that all stakeholders are aligned at each

stage of the agile development lifecycle (when a new project is created). The PO also needs to understand both the engineering and

business side of releases and be ultimately responsible for representing the end user’s needs.

  • Provide business input on requirements to the technology project teams. Work with subject-matter experts in product teams,

front office and operations on requirements (e.g., a new electronic workflow to simplify layers of checking, or to auto-populate

repeated fields in client forms). Prioritise “must have” items vs. “good to have”.

  • Review technology plans and design specifications, to ensure business requirements are met and that benefits will be delivered.

Identify impact on critical processes within the Bank’s operational risk framework, and work with process owners and project teams to ensure robust controls.

  • Work with technology project teams to develop test plans. Co-ordinate business users to test new platforms or technology features that are developed. Ensure final delivery meets user needs.
  • Work with stakeholders in the front, middle and back offices to ensure successful “go live” of projects, from the business

perspective. Develop training material, co-ordinate briefings, design and execute communication plans. Gather feedback post-implementation, and track benefits captured.

  • Participate in project review meetings and identify/highlight any potential issue that may impact project’s cost, timeline and/or

scope and work with concerned stakeholders for its early resolution to bring back the project on track.

  • Conduct periodic briefings to senior management on progress of technology projects, from the business perspective. Highlight issues that require resolution.

People & Talent

  • Work towards strengthening the performance culture and reinforcement of accountabilities in products. Sharing the technical skills and experience with other team members.

Risk Management

  • Embed a risk culture that supports the Bank’s strategy and philosophy for the management of risk.
  • Ensure that effective arrangements are in place within WM in the region for the prevention of money laundering in line with the

Group Policy and Standards, respective country regulatory guidelines and local legal requirements. In particular, ensure that the obligations on reporting suspicious activities are met.

  • Ensure that Risk Management matters that are brought to the job holder’s attention are subject to direct remedial action and/or ensure adequate reporting to the relevant Risk Committees

Governance

  • At all times have an awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across

Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

  • Lead the business to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Regional and Country Wealth Management Heads and WM Product Managers.
  • Key markets Segment Heads, IAs and RMs
  • Market/Credit/Operational Risk, Legal, Compliance, Middle Office and COO team

Other Responsibilities

  • Perform other responsibilities assigned by Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • To achieve other business and non-financial objectives
  • To drive the Bank’s strategy and franchise development
  • To ensure that the business is conducted in an operationally robust environment
  • To ensure compliance with regulations and controls as set by the Bank and external regulatory authorities

Skills And Experience

  • Strong risk evaluation experience in Capital Markets / Wealth Management products
  • An ideal candidate should have 5 years of experience in technology & business
  • Extensive knowledge in financial market products

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5-8 years of experience in wealth management, investment banking, or financial services.
  • Good understanding of wealth management products and asset classes (example FX, equities, fixed income, structured products, OTC derivatives, funds, and insurance.)
  • Relevant knowledge of regulatory and operational frameworks in wealth management.
  • Preferred: Understanding of global wealth management market trends.
  • Relevant degree from reputable university
  • Project Management / System Development or equivalent
  • mandatory & developmental – role specific and regulatory/compliance bank wide specific
  • Proficient English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4469719538.descriptionHtml:
Principal Responsibilities

  • Develop and customize Avaloq components to meet business requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement solutions that enhance our financial products.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices in software development.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to the Avaloq platform.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
  • Mentor junior developers and share your expertise in Avaloq development.

Requirements

Education and Relevant Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business:CTO Platforms

Principal Responsibilities

  • Track, monitor, and evidence compliance for key IT controls and KCIs across IDAM, SDLC, Deployment (DEPL), Cyber, Operational Resilience, and other applicable Group control requirements for Group AI Platform Service Management.
  • Own and manage GRAS metrics for the area, ensuring accurate status, clear ownership, and timely progression/closure of actions.Maintain high-quality dashboards, trackers, and reporting packs that provide transparent visibility of compliance status, risks, overdue actions, and upcoming deadlines for senior stakeholders.
  • Drive action management: ensure action owners understand requirements and evidence expectations, follow up regularly, remove blockers, and escalate where actions are at risk or overdue.
  • Represent the function in control governance forums and KCI/control discussions; provide constructive feedback, challenge where needed, and drive favourable outcomes aligned to the Group control framework.
  • Engage regularly with Group IAM, Risk & Control leads, control owners, CCO Tech, Risk Advocates, IT/Business Service Owners, and Service Quality Managers to align expectations and close outstanding items.Prepare and present compliance status, key risks, trends, and mitigation plans for CTO/CIO/SLR and other senior governance forums.
  • Track and ensure timely closure of audit issues/findings/actions related to IT controls, ensuring evidence quality is audit-ready and traceable. Identify and deliver continuous improvement opportunities (process improvements, playbooks, training/awareness sessions) to strengthen control performance and operational discipline.
  • Share IT Service Owner (ITSO) responsibilities for nominated Group AI Platform services, supporting service governance and service health oversight (e.g., incidents/problems awareness, change risk, operational risk management, service reviews).
  • Ensure service documentation remains current and fit for purpose (e.g., service profiles, support models, key contacts, runbooks, DR artefacts) and that control requirements are embedded into service operations.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in IT control compliance tracking, KCI/KPI reporting, and action management in a regulated environment.
  • Strong organisational and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, challenge, and escalate appropriately to drive closure.
  • Working knowledge of Cybersecurity controls, SDLC, deployment/change controls, and Identity & Access Management concepts.
  • Experience producing dashboards and senior management reporting (e.g., Excel/Power BI or equivalent), with strong attention to detail and evidence quality.
  • Experience supporting IT Service Ownership / Service Management activities for critical services (service reviews, operational risk management, and service stability/resilience focus).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to communicate effectively with senior IT and business stakeholders. Ability to work independently, take ownership, and drive global functional teams towards common objectives.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4471465407.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of VP - CRM.

Principal responsibilities

  • The role is responsible for the management of all customer information and provision of analytical and data science deliverables for customer and banking initiatives and to support AMH activities. The individual is also expected to identify key trends that arise from the insights of customer data and work with other areas in AMH to ensure they are taken account of.
  • The suitable candidate should be a self-driven person and a leader by nature in taking full ownership of the deliverables. One should be technically profound and fully loaded with business acumen and communication skills. One will work hands-on with the Enterprise Data Warehouse and Jupyter environment for data and modeling process, and are required to deliver the results in a logical and ethical way to the stakeholders.
  • Design, formulate, and implement relevant solutions for the identified analytics project and convert analytical findings/solutions that will lead to achieving business goals (revenue growth, anti-attrition, and increasing customer engagement, etc.). During the process, closely collaborate with relevant teams/parties to obtain the supports required for these tasks. Elevate CRM capabilities to tailor make messaging strategies and journeys that best meet GC customer needs and deliver business outcomes.
  • Use company provided software tools to extract, collect, manipulate (e.g. subset and merge) raw data to prepare for further analysis. Then apply the appropriate analytics frameworks, statistic procedures or machine learning algorithms to analyze the data in order to provide actionable analysis findings. Interpret and present quantitative information as well as the findings in proper context so as to help in the investigations and decision making of the business.
  • To design and develop robust, relevant data mining solutions – descriptive or predictive, the incumbent should flexibly and innovatively apply diverse modelling methods including (but not limited to): decision tree, clustering, logistic regression, gradient boosting, neural network, random forest, support vector machine etc. Mobilise and optimize CRM resources to support the development and ongoing monitoring of GC contact strategies based on customers’ needs (right message at the right time through the right channel), ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and HSBC standards, with the ambition to lead the market.
  • Drive the improvement of cross border communications via feedback to the GC governance team to maximise customer contact for efficiency and effectiveness
  • Manage the timely delivery of output and effectively communicate with all stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor (minimum with 6+ year experience) or Master degree in relevant quantitative disciplines such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, Physics or a related discipline with a focus on use of analytics and optimization to influence business decisions.
  • Excellent hands-on analytical skills with proven ability to analyse complex data, identify key trends and opportunities, putting forward hypotheses and delivering recommendations.
  • Mature and independent professional to drive analytics workstream with minimal oversight
  • Train non-analyst stakeholders, teams and audiences to better use our digital analytics suite of tools.
  • Able to work independently with guidance from remote teams.
  • Excellent communication skills. Be able to understand the background of the audience and be able to communicate the message in an effective manner.
  • Proven knowledge and experience of SQL, Python and other Database/Data Manipulation tools (eg max-compute, BI).
  • Experience in data visualization tools and techniques – previous experience in Qliksense, Tableau or similar.
  • Good experience and knowledge of one of analytics tools – Python/R/SAS/SPSS/STATA.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Engineering Lead for COS.

 Business: Wealth & Prem Solutions Tech IWPB Technology

Job ID ： 61283

The Role

As Engineering Lead for Customer Onboarding Solutions (COS) you’ll own the technical direction and end-to-end delivery of our customer onboarding engineering capabilities across frontend, mobile, backend and integration services. This role is accountable for engineering excellence, predictable delivery and production stability in a highly regulated financial services environment. You’ll translate product and business priorities into executable delivery plans and ensure each sprint produces measurable, deployable outcomes. You’ll set the standard for secure, resilient and scalable onboarding journeys and reusable platform capabilities that support multiple products, markets and customer journeys. Success means safer releases, stronger reliability in production and simpler customer journeys built on consistent engineering patterns.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own engineering delivery across the build-test-release-run lifecycle from design through production operation
  • Shape delivery plans with clear scope, milestones, dependencies, risks and target dates aligned to business priorities
  • Establish measurable sprint outcomes that result in usable and deployable customer or platform capabilities
  • Coordinate dependencies across Product, Operations, Architecture, Platform, control functions and downstream engineering teams
  • Set technical direction for COS web and mobile journeys, backend microservices and integration services with Architecture and Principal Engineers
  • Govern API-first development including API lifecycle management, backward compatibility and contract testing
  • Embed engineering standards for coding, code review, testing and release practices aligned to enterprise frameworks
  • Strengthen production operability through monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards and runbooks plus clear SLIs/SLOs for critical services
  • Guide incident response and root-cause analysis and ensure permanent corrective actions are implemented
  • Ensure secure SDLC practices and evidence, controls and documentation to support governance and regulatory review

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bring proven experience managing and coaching cross-functional engineering teams delivering enterprise-scale customer systems
  • Demonstrate full-lifecycle delivery experience in Agile and continuous delivery environments across build-test-release-run
  • Show a track record translating business objectives into structured engineering plans with milestones, dependencies, risks and outcomes
  • Bring strong knowledge of modern frontend and mobile engineering alongside enterprise backend technologies such as Java/Spring Boot, .NET or Node.js
  • Demonstrate expertise in REST APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures and distributed integration patterns
  • Apply strong software engineering fundamentals including OO design, SOLID principles, design patterns, automated testing and performance engineering
  • Bring hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and engineering quality gates
  • Demonstrate cloud-native engineering capability including observability, incident management and SLI/SLO-based reliability practices
  • Show experience designing and operating highly available, resilient enterprise applications in regulated environments
  • Communicate technical complexity, delivery risks and trade-offs clearly to technical and business stakeholders while managing cross-team dependencies

/LP/WX

ln:4471468331.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of International Propositions Manager.

Principal responsibilities

  • Build and maintain performance measurement frameworks for proposition initiatives (funnels, cohorts, conversion, retention, referral, etc.) and ensure consistent cross-market definitions.
  • Develop scalable reporting and dashboards (self-serve where possible) to track KPIs, campaign effectiveness, and customer journeys; automate recurring insight packs.
  • Present insights confidently to senior stakeholders; turn complex analysis into simple narratives, recommendations, and decision-ready materials.
  • Deliver regular market, competitor and customer trend updates (macro/micro, segment behaviours, channel performance) with clear “so what / now what” actions.
  • Provide test-and-learn support: design experiments, evaluate results, quantify incremental impact, and recommend optimisation actions.
  • Partner with data owners and engineering/BI teams to improve data availability, lineage and quality; document assumptions and logic to - prevent inconsistent reporting.
  • Participate in data discovery to determine the most appropriate usage of data to fulfill the requirements
  • End to end project management with cross team (cross location) collaboration
  • Participate in forums, meetings or events to share insights with business stakeholders for campaign evaluations
  • Maintain the highest level of output quality to minimize any occurence of incidents

Requirements

We seek highly motivated specialists who have the following experience and qualifications to join our dynamic organi-zation

  • Minimum 6 years’ experience in one or multiple skills in business analytics or contact and communication design and operation in the financial or digital domains. Or similar experience in analytics consulting or managing digital products.
  • Proven experience in one or more of: customer segmentation, portfolio analytics, pricing analytics, digital mar-keting, data science, use of open-source data in analyses.
  • Familiarity with analytics/visualization tools such as Python, SQL/BigQuery. Tableau/QlikSense/Looker studio, hands-on experience on cloud environments such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a plus.
  • Ability to communicate with impact, with the capacity to ensure complex information is articulated in a meaningful way to a wide and varied audience.
  • Good problem solving skills, exhibit self-motivated, self-starter behaviors.
  • Great sense of ownership and servicing mind-set to ensure efficient and effective customer service delivery
  • Strong team player; able to work with members of different skills and experiences. Comfortable to operate in a complex matrix structure with multiple stakeholders.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4471465589.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening

up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.In this role, you will:

  • Accurately identify customer needs and assist customers in completing transactions/services in a timely, accurate and professional manner through appropriate channels (including but not limited to: digital banking, call center, etc.)
  • Assist branches in providing efficient, high-quality customer service and a satisfying customer experience.
  • Perform KYC (know your customer) and comply with relevant laws and regulations to reduce operational risks. Be vigilant about potential risks associated with services and transactions (e.g. fraud, etc.), report and/or escalate risks and issues in a timely manner, if needed.
  • Based on customers’ needs, identify sales opportunities and refer customers to sales personnel with the relevant qualifications for further discussion, portfolio/product review and service. Assist the bank in achieving its sales targets and wealth management strategies.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or above (recognized by the state).
  • Has strong sense of responsibility for work and excellent learning ability.
  • Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills.
  • Has organizational and coordination skill as well as strong self-motivation skill.
  • Able to communicate well both in English and Chinese.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4471488636.descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities

Credit analysis

  • Conduct credit analysis for corporate counterparts by preparing concise, critical and well-argued credit proposals on new request and renewals of credit facilities.
  • Evaluate and make recommendation on credit limits requested from coverage team and business lines based on bank’s risk appetite and client’s credit profile.
  • Conduct regular and timely annual reviews and credit facility renewals.
  • Review and assess client’s obligor rating at least annually, or as driven by special events and maintain valid ratings in the Bank’s rating tool.
  • Continue to improve credit file productivity and processing efficiency and respond in timely manner to credit requests.
  • Expedite and manage the credit approval process by liaising with relevant approvers and RISQ officers.
  • Report significant business events, financial trends, industry developments and other relevant issues relating to financial position of clients
  • Back up and support other credit analysts.
  • Assist in special projects or assignments as requested by team head.

Reporting

  • Support for week deal flow generation, annual review tracking and monitoring, credit volume statistics and portfolio analytics. Also act as a back-up support to our data analyst within CPM.
  • Assist other credit analysts to monitor credit exposure/overshoots, concentration risk, financial covenants and credit conditions; verify data and support reporting requirements related to these areas.

Profile required

  • Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized university (MBA or other professional qualifications such as CFA or CPA , FRM or equivalent is preferred)
  • Previous experience in a role of credit risk analysis or assistant corporate relationship manager is a plus
  • Solid accounting, corporate finance, and credit analysis skills
  • Strong problem-solving ability with analytical thinking
  • Good knowledge in data analytics and related field
  • Quick learner and ability to multi-task
  • Attention to detail and ability to self-check
  • Basic knowledge of different bank products, particularly commercial banking/transaction banking products, treasury products
  • Basic knowledge of regulatory and business environment in Greater China
  • Well versed in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, VBA, Microsoft Access, PowerPoint, Copilot is a must)
  • Good communication skills. Fluent English and Mandarin Chinese language skills (both speaking and writing) are mandatory to facilitate transactions with Chinese speaking clients. French language skill is a plus.

Behavioral Skills

  • Client - Risk: I strive to satisfy clients while taking into account risks for the company
  • Team Spirit - Collective mindset: I favour the team’s interest over my own results
  • Innovation - Technology: I adopt new technologies in the solutions and projects I work on
  • Commitment - Sustainability: I strive to develop my skills and knowledge
  • Responsibility - Accountability: I make decisions in my scope of responsibilities
  • Responsibility - Performance: I strive for high performance

Business insight

Our Culture:

At Societe Generale, we live by our 4 core values of commitment, responsibility, team spirit and innovation. We are engaged and demonstrate consideration for others. We act ethically and with courage. We focus our talent and energy on collective success. We experiment and propose new ideas. This way, we maximize our ability to serve client needs and anticipate market changes. Societe Generale is committed to strengthening bonds with colleagues, communities, and the world in which we live, because relationships are at the heart of how we operate. Please visit our APAC career website: https://www.societegenerale.asia/en/careers/building-your-career-with/ for more information.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DE&I):

Our mission: Recruit, develop, advance, and retain a diverse workforce that is united in our efforts to enhance our competitive position and deliver innovative solutions to our clients.

Our vision:

  • Engaged workforce that is demographically diverse in a way that reflects the communities in which we operate
  • Inclusive culture and workplace that recognizes employees' unique needs and utilizes their diverse talents
  • Engage our community and marketplace, and position the organization to meet the needs of all its clients

Check out our DE&I initiatives: https://www.societegenerale.asia/en/careers/diversity-equity-inclusion-dei/

Company Description

Societe Generale is a top tier European bank with more than 160 years of expertise supporting economic development and helping corporates, financial institutions, and individuals bring their projects to life.

With over 40 years of presence in China, Societe Generale serves as a bridge between China and international markets across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Americas, and Africa. The bank offers a broad range of capabilities in Global Markets, Financing & Advisory, and Payments and Cash Management.

A recognized leader in equity derivatives, structured products, structured finance, natural resources financing, and leasing, Societe Generale combines deep sector expertise with a strong international network to provide tailored advisory, financing, investment, and risk management solutions to its clients.

Diversity and Inclusion

We are an equal opportunities employer and we are proud to make diversity a strength for our company. Societe Generale is committed to recognizing and promoting all talents, regardless of their beliefs, age, disability, parental status, ethnic origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, membership of a political, religious, trade union or minority organisation, or any other characteristic that could be subject to discrimination.

Share

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage NTB Affluent clients via leads sourced from varies channels;
  • A well thought-through, creative approach to satisfy customers, improve competitive advantage and improve performance;
  • Actively cross-sell the bank other products / services and ensure annual financial budget is met;
  • To provide quality, efficient before and after sales services;
  • To prepare and consolidate accurate reports on sales activities;
  • Based on a “shared sense” of purpose and approach within CB;
  • Based on a clear division of roles (and no duplication of effort) within MD;
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

Skills And Experience

  • Strong competencies in client acquisition and sophisticated account management, particularly with High Net Worth (HNW) individuals.
  • Expertise in region-specific languages and established local networks (highly valued).
  • Technical knowledge of consumer banking products (Treasury, Equities, Funds, and Insurance).
  • A university degree is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in customer service or sales is an advantage; however, applications from fresh graduates who possess the required skills and qualifications will also be considered.

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • Bachelor degree or above;
  • 1 year working experience or above in financial or mortgage / real estate Industry is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in banking experience is preferred
  • Good knowledge of bank products, policies, and business strategy
  • Good credit appraisal and marketing skills with the ability to interpret financial information
  • Strong personal integrity with zero disciplinary record in any previous job
  • Good communication and presentation skills
  • Presentable, good personality with good business etiquette

职位要求：

  • 本科及以上学历。
  • 一年以上金融或房贷或房产行业工作经验优先。
  • 有相关银行行业销售经验者优先
  • 了解银行产品、政策及经营策略。
  • 良好的信用评价与营销技能，对金融市场有敏锐触角。
  • 良好的个人诚信，无任何纪律处分纪录
  • 良好的沟通，表达及学习能力。
  • 优良的个性品质，勇于销售及解决业务过程中的问题。
  • Other then above roles, job holder should follow other job duties and responsibilities assigned by line manager from time to time.

除上述工作职责外，员工应遵循直属经理随时指派的任何工作职责和任务。

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

  • 跟进销售机会，开发新客户；
  • 以周全、创新的方法使客户满意，提升竞争优势及业绩表现；
  • 主动销售银行其它产品和服务，确保达到年度销售业绩指标；
  • 提供高质量、高效的售前和售后服务；
  • 编写和维护有关销售活动的准确报告；
  • 负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；

  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Credit Appraisal and Marketing Skills

Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree or above;
  • 1 year working experience or above in financial or mortgage / real estate Industry is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in banking experience is preferred
  • Good knowledge of bank products, policies, and business strategy
  • Good credit appraisal and marketing skills with the ability to interpret financial information
