ln:4473750638.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Diversity & Inclusion Statement

  • Standard Chartered is committed to diversity and inclusion. We believe that a work environment which embraces diversity will enable us to get the best out of the broadest spectrum of people to sustain strong business performance and competitive advantage. By building an inclusive culture, each employee can develop a sense of belonging and have the opportunity to maximise their personal potential.

Job Description

  • Group Internal Audit (GIA) is looking for an experienced and dynamic audit professional with a solid background and strong knowledge around the key risks and controls in the Finance, Property and Treasury functions.
  • The role-holder will be an integral part of the Finance, Property (East) and Treasury (East) Audit team. The team provides independent assessments of risk management and internal control environment of the Finance, Property and Treasury functions globally.
  • We pride ourselves in being auditors of the future, forward-looking and agile with a keen focus on smarter auditing. When you join us, you will enter a role that challenges the status quo and moves mindsets and be a part of the future of banking.
  • This role currently reports to Head of Audit Vietnam, Australia and Finance, Property (East) and Treasury (East).

Key Responsibilities

  • To act as Team Lead/ Team Member, as necessary, and take responsibility for contributing to the delivery of high-quality Finance, Property and Treasury function audits, the performance of which cause minimal disruption to the business.
  • To role model the valued behaviours and develop an environment in which positive behaviours are celebrated and poor culture is challenged.
  • To execute assigned audit work, as well as the work carried out by the team, in an efficient and effective manner, within the given budget and timelines, and in line with GIA methodology standards.
  • To clearly identify the risks and impact of issues during issue writing, agreeing these issues with management and obtaining quality management action plans to mitigate the risks raised.
  • To support GIA audit teams by providing product knowledge and expertise for their audits relating to the individual’s area of responsibility.
  • Issue validation: All audit issue action plans agreed during audit fieldwork should be tracked through to completion in accordance with methodology requirements.
  • To prepare and provide information for various country reports for submission to the regulator or management as required by the Country Head of Audit.

Strategy

  • Audits assigned to the individual in the GIA audit plan should address the key risks identified in the detailed risk assessment and in the audit planning process and meet relevant regulatory requirements and expectations that are required to be covered by GIA.
  • Ensure that audit team operates in line with the Audit Charter during engagements, remains independent from management and free from interference.

Business

  • Effectively manage the cost of assigned audits within the allocated budget for their areas within audit engagements

Processes

  • To act as Team Lead/ Team Member on assigned audit work across the Group.
  • When Team Leading to provide clear guidance, detailed review and supervision of the audit team’s work so that audit deliverables meet quality standards and timelines in line with the GIA methodology.
  • When Team Leading to provide guidance on business/audit technical knowledge and management skills to team members to enable them to effectively deliver their assigned contributions for an audit.
  • Provide technical input and challenge on audit work being undertaken within the scope of assigned product area of responsibility. This will include working with the audit team to produce outputs of high quality which address the areas of greatest risk.
  • Support adherence to the GIA methodology in all areas of the audit engagement, as well as raising awareness and understanding of the methodology.
  • Demonstrate sound knowledge of both business/technical areas and expert knowledge in the audit process, including the GIA system, so that audit work is carried out to a high standard that meets all methodology and GIA system requirements.
  • Monitor the implementation/delivery of the agreed issues/audit plans for the audits assigned, understanding the key risks arising, provide advice on resolution of issues to auditees/action plan owners and escalate audit findings that remain unresolved.

People & Talent

  • Share knowledge to increase specialism within the function.
  • Influence change within the department by highlighting potential enhancements.
  • Identify growth areas on an ongoing basis and identify how best to develop them.
  • When Team leading provide performance feedback, as appropriate at the end of an audit.
  • Identify and successfully complete key internal training for self-development.
  • Facilitate the development of audit team members by providing on the job training and recommending formal training to support GIA activities

Risk Management

  • Assist in the update of the assigned Continuous Risk Assessment on a regular basis to identify changes in risk profiles and document these in a timely manner, proposing changes to the assigned audit plan, as appropriate.
  • Promote early identification and escalation of risks, issues, trends and developments to relevant stakeholders. Be prepared to raise issues/concerns outside the normal audit process.
  • Adopt an anticipatory approach to risk assessment through stakeholder engagement and monitoring of the external environment to improve audit planning; and
  • Review MI and reports regularly to keep up-to-date with key trends within the business and audit deliverables

Governance

  • Manage the relevant portfolio stakeholders and establish good working relationships to help the businesses improve the control environment and keep updated with changes in the business impacting their risk profile.
  • Use networks and relationships to build engagement and achieve results.
  • Escalate delays in the execution of audit work, both to auditee management and GIA Management.

  • contribute in the formulation or amendment of audit, risk control and accountability policies;

Qualifications

  • Experience in audit, governance, risk or in a business environment.
  • Professional audit certification preferred.
  • Professional accounting or finance certification (CPA, CFA, etc) preferred.
  • Good communicator, both written and verbal, with an ability to influence and an ability to gain the respect of senior management, regional stakeholders, peers and their teams.
  • Confident and courageous to raise/escalate issues in a pro-active, professional and timely manner.
  • Self-directed and able to work with minimum supervision.
  • Demonstrate understanding of and commitment to the Group’s core values.

Skills And Experience

  • In-depth understanding of Finance and Treasury risk management, processes and associated control requirements;

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Development Lead to join our technology team and play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable trading control systems that power Standard Chartered's digital banking platform. The successful candidate will lead technical initiatives, build platform 0-1, and contribute to architectural decisions that with major business impact to our global financial market business.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Design and develop high-performance, scalable backend services and APIs using modern technologies
  • Implement microservices architecture patterns and distributed system design principles
  • Ensure system reliability, performance, and security across all backend services
  • Drive adoption of best practices in code quality, testing, and deployment
  • Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning

Development & Implementation

  • Build robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies
  • Implement secure, efficient database designs and optimize query performance
  • Develop event-driven architectures using messaging systems (Solace, Kafka)
  • Integrate with third-party systems and external APIs following banking industry standards
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with DEV, SRE, QA, BA, product managers, and business stakeholders
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Lead technical discussions and facilitate knowledge sharing sessions
  • Participate in technical interviews and contribute to team building initiatives

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure all backend systems comply with banking regulations and security standards
  • Implement comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and methodologies
  • Maintain high standards of documentation for systems and processes
  • Support production systems and participate in on-call rotations when required

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Application Design, Architecture
  • Software Development
  • Leadership

Other Skills

  • AI

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • 8+ years of experience in development with strong Java expertise, with at least 5+ years in a leadership role.
  • Proficiency in Spring Framework (Spring Boot)
  • Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (Redis)
  • Extensive experience with messaging systems (Solace, Apache Kafka)
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with API design and development (REST, GraphQL)
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to mentor and lead a team of engineers, fostering an environment of innovation and continuous learning.

Certifications / Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

Languages

  • English

ln:4472309809.descriptionHtml:
Citi Commercial Bank offers its clients the convenience, a global banking network, thought leadership and global financial capabilities of Citi. We deliver extensive industry knowledge, local expertise and dedicated service support to Mid-Market companies, with an international footprint. We are focused on providing banking and financial solutions to our clients across 5 key growth industries - Business & Professional Services, Industrials, Digital, Technology & Communications, Consumer and Healthcare.

The primary responsibility of the Associate will be, in cooperation with the Senior Relationship Managers, servicing the banking & financing needs of international Mid-Market clients, deepening existing client relationships and acquiring & onboarding new commercial banking clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Build relationships with Citi network and operational teams, becoming one of the key contacts for clients’ requests, internal requests/escalation and resolution.
  • Support Senior Relationship manager in management of assigned portfolio of clients.
  • Work closely with Senior Relationship Managers to ensure we provide a 'Client First' approach and help to deliver outstanding day to day banking & operational support to our Mid-Market clients.
  • In cooperation with Senior Relationship Manager calls on clients and maximise ‘One Citi’ client experience, by proactively leveraging and sharing Citi’s market leading insights, global network and solutions.
  • Monitor and support products’ implementation processes, clients on-boarding process and manage sales CRM platform.
  • Liaise with Relationship Associate to ensure adherence to global KYC (Know Your Customer) standards during the onboarding process and, on an ongoing basis, ensuring the appropriate compliance deliverables are met.
  • Develops and maintains strong ties with Commercial Banking teams across the globe, in particular CCB colleagues working across the same sector vertical, CCB colleagues supporting subsidiary businesses overseas (Commercial Subsidiaries Group). Collaborate and work closely with various product teams (cash sales, trade finance, markets, corporate finance), Underwriting / Risk teams.
  • Work with Senior Relationship Managers to analyse client relationships, risks & opportunities, assists with credit application write-up, financial spreading, deal structuring, returns calculation, documentation review & preparation. Administrate the credit relationship of clients, ensuring the proper application of policies and institutional processes.
  • Understand key commercial banking processes & solutions, including Transactional Banking, FX, Trade, Treasury, Working Capital and Lending products.
  • Support Senior Relationship Managers on solutioning assessment, preparation of pitch books and meeting materials, assists with new clients’ acquisition.
  • Work collaboratively with key internal stakeholders across CCB, share best practice across teams in order to deliver 'best in class' relationship management to new and existing clients.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

  • 5-8 years of experience
  • Previous banking experience
  • Working within Commercial/Corporate banking is desirable.
  • Experience in a Client Relationship role or client facing role.
  • Sales, presentation and communication skills. Focus on first class service quality.
  • Analytical and credit skills
  • High level of self-motivation
  • Knowledge of general banking processes, general understanding of commercial banking solutions
  • Ability to build & develop strong client relationships.
  • Effective collaboration skills with Senior Relationship Managers and Commercial Banking partners
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft and CRM applications

Education:

  • Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience

ln:4473927637.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Manager - Data and Analytics.

Principal responsibilities

The scope of work will include but may not be limited to:

Impact on the Business

  • Commercialize business analytics to support business strategy and create business outcome.
  • Provide comprehensive innovative and analytical solutions capitalizing advanced data and analytics capabilities.
  • Design and develop data products that business/ frontline/ customer can consume directly to drive commercial outcome.
  • End to end project management with cross team collaboration.

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Support to drive customer-centric leads perfor-mance with test and learn culture embedded to de-liver commercial outcomes.
  • Use analytics to drive communication design and enable deployment of advanced communication toolkits for personal and relevant communications.
  • Collaborate across all internal (Data & Analytics cross tribe) and external (e.g. cross market) stakeholders to embed data-driven insights and business decisions.
  • Actively participate and enable key initiatives for AMH RBW.

Operational Effectiveness & Control

  • Execute industrialized processes to serve busi-ness analytics and customer communications.
  • Adopt tools to optimize resource vs activities.
  • Adopt best practices and standards of analytics and communications.
  • Align governance and controls towards Group’s standards in a progressive approach.

Requirements

We seek highly motivated specialists who have the following experience and qualifications to join our dynamic organi-zation

  • Minimum 6 years’ experience in one or multiple skills in business analytics or contact and communication design and operation in the financial or digital domains. Or similar experience in analytics consulting or managing digital products.
  • Proven experience in one or more of: customer segmentation, portfolio analytics, pricing analytics, digital mar-keting, data science, use of open-source data in analyses.
  • Familiarity with analytics/visualization tools such as Python, SQL/BigQuery. Tableau/QlikSense/Looker studio, hands-on experience on cloud environments such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a plus.
  • Knowledge of relevant AI/ GenAI tool and experience in applying to data & analytics would be a plus.
  • Ability to communicate with impact, with the capacity to ensure complex information is articulated in a meaningful way to a wide and varied audience.
  • Good problem solving skills, exhibit self-motivated, self-starter behaviors.
  • Great sense of ownership and servicing mind-set to ensure efficient and effective customer service delivery.
  • Strong team player; able to work with members of different skills and experiences. Comfortable to operate in a complex matrix structure with multiple stakeholders.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Operational Effectiveness & Control
- Execute industrialized processes to serve busi-ness analytics and customer communications.
- Adopt tools to optimize resource vs activities.
- Adopt best practices and standards of analytics and communications.
- Align governance and controls towards Group’s standards in a progressive approach.
Requirements
We seek highly motivated specialists who have the following experience and qualifications to join our dynamic organi-zation
- Minimum 6 years’ experience in one or multiple skills in business analytics or contact and communication design and operation in the financial or digital domains. Or similar experience in analytics consulting or managing digital products.
- Proven experience in one or more of: customer segmentation, portfolio analytics, pricing analytics, digital mar-keting, data science, use of open-source data in analyses.
- Familiarity with analytics/visualization tools such as Python, SQL/BigQuery. Tableau/QlikSense/Looker studio, hands-on experience on cloud environments such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a plus.
- Knowledge of relevant AI/ GenAI tool and experience in applying to data & analytics would be a plus.
- Ability to communicate with impact, with the capacity to ensure complex information is articulated in a meaningful way to a wide and varied audience.
- Good problem solving skills, exhibit self-motivated, self-starter behaviors.
- Great sense of ownership and servicing mind-set to ensure efficient and effective customer service delivery.
- Strong team player; able to work with members of different skills and experiences. Comfortable to operate in a complex matrix structure with multiple stakeholders.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

ln:4472335080.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • To ensure accurate calculation and posting entries in relation to valuation including management fee, expenses, performance fee…etc in accordance with Service Level Memorandum, and as appropriate the Fund Offering Memorandum and related documents such as fund’s SLM.
  • To ensure accurate capturing of trades / prices / Corporate Actions/ FX rates data and relevant accounting entries for the purpose of providing accurate Net Asset Value calculation.
  • Responsible for the daily maintenance of full accounting and client records of several investment funds books including general ledgers, cash positions, distribution records, investment records and pricing records of investments and support in fund administration related matters, such as recording and processing transactions, obtaining and verification of relevant documentation thereof and ensuring that investments are correctly recorded and priced, and accounted for Purchase and sale of listed or unlisted securities, Corporate Actions, Forward FX deals, OTC deals (Swaps, Options etc) and relevant accounting entries for the purpose of providing accurate Net Asset Value calculation.
  • Perform detailed review of the reports to CPC/clients including: Verification trades to relevant supporting, Ensure valuation of investments being checked to third party sources, Ensure appropriate accounting for complex investment, Ensure compliance with internal investment restrictions, external regulations and international accounting standards, if applicable. Identify issues and report to senior/supervisor with suggested solutions.
  • Responsible for fundamental cash monitoring for the assigned clients, i.e. monitoring cash positions of clients and prepare cash projection reports.
  • To be responsible for daily activities, cash & trade reconciliation.
  • Preparing Portfolio Valuations, investment compliance reports or other reporting, as required.
  • To calculate the Net Asset Value (on a daily, weekly, monthly or other basis as agreed) and deliver service / reports to CPC/clients in accordance with requirement and timeline as agreed in Services Level Memorandum.
  • To ensure proper and accurate calculation and posting of management fee, expenses, performance fee…etc in accordance with Service Level Memorandum, and as appropriate the Fund Offering Memorandum.
  • Recording and disbursing dividends either by payment or re-investment.
  • Calculating and disbursing payments of fees to the investment manager/advisor, custodian, administrator and other service providers as required.
  • To ensure fund administration services fees are settled by the client on timely manner.
  • Communicate with CPC and other relevant parties on daily operational issue (under appropriate supervision of Senior/Manager) and regular services review.
  • To ensure clear and smooth communication with Fund Accounting Team, Transfer Agency Team, Fund Compliance Team, Custody Team and other operations team for timely updating / maintenance of client records.
  • To support Senior Manager/Head, handle and delivery assigned ad hoc project within the cutoff
  • Manage and avoid risks to clients, Bank/Group by ensuring prompt and accurate reporting to clients/management, timely rectification and /or monitoring of any discrepancies.
  • To provide accurate statistics relating to Key Risk Indicator (KRI) and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) to help measuring and meet division objectives.
  • To ensure all control/operating procedure and documentations are properly followed.
  • To ensure daily working volumes to be recorded accuracy and timely

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Awareness and understanding of the Group's business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Awareness and understanding of the wider business, securities markets in which the FMO operates

Processes

  • Responsible for ensuring the accuracy of Net Asset Value of the fund in each valuation

People & Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.

Risk Management

  • The ability to interpret the reconciliation breaks, prices fluctuations, ledger imbalances, valuation checking exception, identify key issues or potential risk based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures.

Governance

  • Responsible for complying to the group’s governance requirement, oversight and controls in the business

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholders

  • Onshore business partner
  • Client
  • Upstream teams ( GRU, CDMG, CS, Settlement, CA)

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in China / Fiduciary and Fund Services Team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Support group’s operation transformation roadmap.

Skills And Experience

  • Accounting
  • Financial Market
  • Fund Operation
  • MS Office Suite

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree
  • Certifications: Certification in accounting or finance is a plus
  • Languages: English, Mandarin

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

The KYC Operations Analyst 2 is an intermediate-level position responsible for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) monitoring, governance, oversight and regulatory reporting activities in coordination with the Compliance and Control team. The overall objective of this role is to develop and manage a dedicated internal KYC (Know Your Client) program at Citi.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct client profile reviews for customer accounts
  • Review all information and documentation ensuring compliance with local regulation and Citi standards
  • Update KYC forms and client profiles according to policy requirements
  • Follow up with clients to ensure information is received before due dates
  • Perform KYC tasks, including monitoring and tracking of the KYC records and Appendix approval process, assisting with the development and execution of action planning for expiring records, and ensuring records are not past due
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications

  • 2 years+ of relevant experience
  • Experience in banking operations, preferably in the client account opening and pre-requirements process


Education

  • Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience


Job Family Group

Operations - Services

Job Family

Business KYC

Time Type

Full time

Most Relevant Skills

Business Acumen, Credible Challenge, Laws and Regulations, Management Reporting, Policy and Procedure, Program Management, Referral and Escalation, Risk Controls and Monitors, Risk Identification and Assessment, Risk Remediation.

Other Relevant Skills

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.

View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster.

Job Summary

This role could be based in Singapore or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop-down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you only select a country where the role is based

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
  • Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
  • Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
  • Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
  • Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.

Business

  • Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
  • Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
  • Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
  • Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
  • Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.

People & Talent

  • Collaborate effectively with engineering peers and contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture.
  • Share knowledge, learn continuously, and support skill development through strong technical contribution and example.
  • Demonstrate self-driven ownership, curiosity, and a strong can-do attitude.
  • Work constructively with others to solve hard technical problems and deliver against commitments.

Governance

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 6+ years experience in software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
  • Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
  • Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
  • Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
  • Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
  • Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
  • Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Software Engineering
  • Software Development
  • Application Design
  • Architecture

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

Responsibilities

  • Product & Market Knowledge:
    • To promote SG’s investment and hedging solution franchise to China corporate clients with focus on investment products
    • To bring in new client relationship with focus on the asset side business diversifying the current client portfolio
    • Be able grow current client base with more FX option penetration or some cross assets solutions
    • Familiar with onshore regulation framework and able to provide solutions to client
  • Sales Talent & Efforts:
    • Strong sales and communication skills, pro-active and passionate in marketing existing and new clients
    • Able to effectively and timely to deal execution for various FX flow products from vanilla to structured
  • Market Intelligence: Knows both onshore and offshore market activities with corporates, further improve and strengthen SG China corporate franchise especially in investment.
  • Teamwork & Cooperation:
    • Work closely and back-up other team members to ensure client business continuity, ensure effective team work within local but also global teams, as well as with other departments in the group.
    • Make necessary meetings to introduce and leverage our Traders, Research and other product partners (including support functions such as MO, BO, compliance, legal, IT etc.), strong Sales & Trading Alignment, develop dialogue with other sales in all centers regionally & globally to facilitate information sharing and to foster cross selling and client referral.
    • Able to work with team member to strengthen the SG China corporate franchise
    • Fit in well with rest of team and into SG’s culture and strong durability and frustration self-managing.
  • Client sector target: Chinses corporates, TMT and POE focused
Required

 Profile required

  • At least 5 years sales related working experience in banks with relevant product & market knowledge, including trade execution skills, and client base; keep abreast of the latest business knowledge
  • Strong sales and communication skills in both English and Chinese
  • High result orientation and working capacities
  • Ability to present the business at senior level both externally and internally
  • To be a team player
  • To be able to work under pressure
  • To demonstrate transparency, Honesty & Integrity at all times

Behavioral Skills

  • Client - Sales and Marketing Strategy: I contribute to adapt our offer to our clients'/internal partners' needs
  • Client - Client focus: I put long term relationship with our clients at the center of my actions, whatever my position
  • Client - Understanding and Respect: I listen to clients and colleagues in order to understand and anticipate their needs
  • Team Spirit - Open mindset: I listen and share my views and my expertise in an open mode
  • Team Spirit - Conflict Management: I deal with conflicts proactively and in a positive mode
  • Innovation - Thinking out of the box/Creativity: I propose new ideas and solutions

Business insight

Our Culture:

At Societe Generale, we live by our 4 core values of commitment, responsibility, team spirit and innovation. We are engaged and demonstrate consideration for others. We act ethically and with courage. We focus our talent and energy on collective success. We experiment and propose new ideas. Responsibilities

Based in Beijing, the Communications Lead for Societe Generale China is responsible for defining and executing the communication strategy for the Corporate & Investment Banking activities across Mainland China.

Working in close alignment with the Asia-Pacific Communications team and local management, the role drives Societe Generale’s corporate profile, supports business priorities, and ensures consistent, compliant and impactful communications across all channels.

Key Responsibilities

Communication Strategy & Execution

  • Define and implement the communication roadmap for Mainland China, aligned with regional strategy and business priorities
  • Contribute to regional communication initiatives and strategic planning
  • Enhance Societe Générale’s visibility and positioning across key audiences (clients, media, employees, regulators)

Content, Digital & Brand

  • Develop and deliver high-quality editorial content highlighting business expertise and corporate culture
  • Manage local digital platforms (including WeChat and website), ensuring effective content distribution and engagement
  • Ensure strict application of brand guidelines across all materials and campaigns
  • Support regional campaigns and local advertising initiatives

Events & Partnerships

  • Lead the organization of client, corporate and internal events in collaboration with business lines
  • Identify and manage local partnerships aligned with SG’s brand (e.g., culture, sports, inclusion)

Media Relations & External Engagement

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key media and journalists
  • Support and prepare local spokespeople for media interactions
  • Drive proactive media engagement to promote the Bank’s activities and expertise

Governance, Budget & Coordination

  • Manage the local communications budget
  • Monitor and report on communication performance and impact
  • Ensure compliance with Group communication policies and governance framework
  • Coordinate closely with APAC communications teams and external agencies

Required

 Profile required

  • 5years or above experience in corporate communications, ideally within financial services
  • Strong writing and content development skills in Chinese and English
  • Solid understanding of digital ecosystems in China (incl. WeChat)
  • Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders in a matrix environment
  • Proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented with strong team spirit
  • High level of integrity, adaptability, and attention to detail

Behavioral Skills

  • Client - Sales and Marketing Strategy: I develop innovative strategies adapted to our clients/internal partners
  • Client - Understanding and Respect: When communicating with our clients/internal partners I listen in order to understand and anticipate their needs
  • Team Spirit - Open mindset/Respect: I listen and share my views and my expertise in an open mode
  • Innovation - Simplification: I make things & ideas simple
  • Responsibility - Courage: I express my convictions and make decisions with courage in line with the Group's strategy
  • Commitment - Exemplarity: I embody the Group’s values

Our Culture:

At Societe Generale, we live by our 4 core values of commitment, responsibility, team spirit and innovation. We are engaged and demonstrate consideration for others. Responsibilities

Credit analysis

  • Conduct credit analysis for corporate counterparts by preparing concise, critical and well-argued credit proposals on new request and renewals of credit facilities.
  • Evaluate and make recommendation on credit limits requested from coverage team and business lines based on bank’s risk appetite and client’s credit profile.
  • Conduct regular and timely annual reviews and credit facility renewals.
  • Review and assess client’s obligor rating at least annually, or as driven by special events and maintain valid ratings in the Bank’s rating tool.
  • Continue to improve credit file productivity and processing efficiency and respond in timely manner to credit requests.
  • Expedite and manage the credit approval process by liaising with relevant approvers and RISQ officers.
  • Report significant business events, financial trends, industry developments and other relevant issues relating to financial position of clients
  • Back up and support other credit analysts.
  • Assist in special projects or assignments as requested by team head.

Reporting

  • Support for week deal flow generation, annual review tracking and monitoring, credit volume statistics and portfolio analytics. Also act as a back-up support to our data analyst within CPM.
  • Assist other credit analysts to monitor credit exposure/overshoots, concentration risk, financial covenants and credit conditions; verify data and support reporting requirements related to these areas.

Required

 Profile required

  • Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized university (MBA or other professional qualifications such as CFA or CPA , FRM or equivalent is preferred)
  • Previous experience in a role of credit risk analysis or assistant corporate relationship manager is a plus
  • Solid accounting, corporate finance, and credit analysis skills
  • Strong problem-solving ability with analytical thinking
  • Good knowledge in data analytics and related field
  • Quick learner and ability to multi-task
  • Attention to detail and ability to self-check
  • Basic knowledge of different bank products, particularly commercial banking/transaction banking products, treasury products
  • Basic knowledge of regulatory and business environment in Greater China
  • Well versed in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, VBA, Microsoft Access, PowerPoint, Copilot is a must)
  • Good communication skills. Fluent English and Mandarin Chinese language skills (both speaking and writing) are mandatory to facilitate transactions with Chinese speaking clients. French language skill is a plus.

Behavioral Skills

  • Client - Risk: I strive to satisfy clients while taking into account risks for the company
  • Team Spirit - Collective mindset: I favour the team’s interest over my own results
  • Innovation - Technology: I adopt new technologies in the solutions and projects I work on
  • Commitment - Sustainability: I strive to develop my skills and knowledge
  • Responsibility - Accountability: I make decisions in my scope of responsibilities
  • Responsibility - Performance: I strive for high performance

Societe Generale is a top tier European bank with more than 160 years of expertise supporting economic development and helping corporates, financial institutions, and individuals bring their projects to life.

With over 40 years of presence in China, Societe Generale serves as a bridge between China and international markets across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Americas, and Africa. The bank offers a broad range of capabilities in Global Markets, Financing & Advisory, and Payments and Cash Management.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities :

  • Prepare and submit China regulatory reports; act as maker; ensure data quality and deadline compliance.
  • Prepare and submit connected transaction regulatory reports via NFRA governance platform, EAST and 1104; perform data validation and reconciliation.
  • Support identification and periodic update of connected party lists; support connected party checking tool data maintenance.
  • Coordinate with Finance, Risk and Business units; support regulatory inquiries, audits and inspections on connected transaction.
  • Participate in reporting automation and system enhancement projects (logic definition, UAT).
  • Perform data controls, documentation and comply with applicable regulations and mandatory training.
  • Support the operation of the Connected Transaction Control Committee (CTCC), including preparing meeting schedules;collect and meeting materials from relevant stakeholdersand; prepare accurate and timely meeting minutes, maintain committee records, ensuring effective governance processes.
  • Track and follow up on action items arising from CTCC Committee meetings, coordinate with responsible parties, and monitor progress until closure.
  • Conduct periodic review and update of the CTCC Committee Charter to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements, corporate governance standards, and organizational changes.
  • Coordinate CT disclosure matters，ensuring the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of reporting information.
  • Support the submission of annual Connected Transaction reports through applicable regulatory reporting platforms.
  • Support other regulatory and/or corporate governance matters as assigned.

Required

 Profile required

Profile Requirements:

  • Academic Background: Bachelor or Master degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or related fields.
  • Working Experience /Technical Skills & Know how: Experience in regulatory reporting, finance, risk, compliance or corporate governance within financial institutions; experience with connected transaction reporting is a plus.
  • Skills & Competencies: Strong regulatory reporting and data analysis skills; solid risk and control mindset; good coordination and communication skills.
  • Language Skills: Fluent in Chinese and English.

ln:4473104729.descriptionHtml:
Description

BBVA’s Corporate Lending Asia team is seeking a motivated corporate banking professional to support the origination, structuring, and execution of corporate loan transactions across the Asia-Pacific region. Based in Hong Kong or Shanghai, this role is embedded within the regional platform and plays an integral part in delivering live deals across the full transaction lifecycle.


Working closely with senior originators and key stakeholders, the successful candidate will cover syndicated loans,acquisition financings, sustainable finance, and bespoke credit solutions. Primary market coverage is China, with scope to expand regionally over time.


This position offers deep exposure to complex credit transactions and progressive career growth within a dynamic, expanding business.


Key Responsibilities:

▪ Support corporate lending transactions across all stages of the deal lifecycle, including credit analysis, pitch preparation, term sheet development, loan structuring, and documentation, contributing to high-quality deal delivery

▪ Conduct market, industry, and company research to generate insights that support credit, pricing, and structuring decisions

▪ Maintain and analyze precedent and comparable transaction data to support market intelligence, deal origination and strategic decisions

▪ Prepare and present proposals to business and credit committees for deal approvals

▪ Draft, review, and coordinate loan and syndication documentation, including term sheets, mandate letters, facility agreements, fee letters, and information memoranda

▪ Collaborate closely with internal teams – including Coverage, Risk, Loan Syndicate and Sales, Legal, Compliance, Tax, Sustainable Finance, Operations – as well as external stakeholders such as clients, partner banks and legal counsel to ensure smooth and timely transaction execution

▪ Manage transaction closings, including documentation execution, internal loan booking, and the

preparation of internal and external case studies and post-deal analyses

▪ Prepare management presentations and pipeline activity reports

▪ Ensure compliance with internal policies, audit standards, filing requirements, and documentation

procedures for all completed transactions


Qualifications

▪ Bachelor degree in Finance, Economics or a related discipline

▪ Minimum 2-4 years of relevant experience in corporate loan origination, debt structuring, or loan

syndication within corporate or investment banking.


Knowledge & Skills

▪ Demonstrated experience in corporate loan origination, debt structuring, and end-to-end deal

execution.

▪ Strong corporate credit analysis, financial modeling, debt capacity assessment, and risk management

capabilities.

▪ Highly organized self-starter capable of managing multiple live deal tracks under tight deadlines with high precision.

▪ Excellent analytical, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with a strong client focus.

▪ Proficient in MS Office, Bloomberg, and Refinitiv (LoanConnector)


Language

▪ Fluent in spoken and written English and Mandarin

Job Summary

  • Manage the Product control function for China across Business

  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance and Operations to support sustainable business growth by providing independent challenge, identifying emerging financial and valuation risks, and enabling informed commercial decision-making.
  • Strengthen the local control environment through effective governance, clear ownership, high-quality management information and the development of capable China-based Product Control and Valuation Control resources.
  • Manage the Valuation Control deliverables as applicable for China regulatory requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead a China-based Product Control and Valuation Control team, while also acting as a hands-on subject matter expert. The role combines people leadership with significant individual contribution, particularly in resolving complex control, valuation, accounting and regulatory matters.
  • Oversee the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of daily and monthly P&L, balance sheet substantiation, valuation adjustments, independent price verification and other core Product Control and Valuation Control activities for the China business.
  • Establish and maintain an effective China-specific control framework that meets local regulatory expectations and is aligned with the bank’s global Product Control and Valuation Control policies, methodologies and governance standards.
  • Coordinate extensively with global and regional Product Control and Valuation Control teams to obtain technical input, clarify policy requirements, resolve methodology differences and ensure consistent application of global standards within the China business.
  • Provide independent review and challenge of trading results, valuation methodologies, reserves, model inputs, adjustments and balance sheet positions. Ensure material issues are identified, investigated, escalated and resolved within agreed timelines.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to support new products, business growth and regulatory initiatives, ensuring that appropriate financial controls and valuation processes are in place before implementation.
  • Support the China business by providing clear analysis of revenue performance, valuation uncertainty, balance sheet risks, control weaknesses and emerging issues, enabling informed management and commercial decision-making.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Allocate work, set priorities, review outputs and develop the capability of the local team. Ensure clear accountability, appropriate segregation of duties, adequate documentation and effective backup arrangements.
  • Drive improvements in processes, reporting, data quality and automation, reducing manual adjustments and recurring breaks while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.
  • Maintain effective governance over material issues, exceptions and control breaches, with clear ownership, action plans, escalation thresholds and reporting to relevant China, regional and global committees.
  • The role holder is accountable for both the day-to-day effectiveness of the local Product Control and Valuation Control function and the successful coordination of China requirements with the wider global control organisation.

People and Talent

  • Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  • Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
  • Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, where local requirements may differ from global standards and require careful interpretation, escalation and practical implementation.
  • Resolving valuation, P&L and balance sheet issues involving incomplete data, methodology differences, manual processes or unclear ownership across local, regional and global teams.
  • Building a credible and sustainable local Product Control and Valuation Control framework while working with limited resources, competing priorities and significant dependency on global subject-matter experts.
  • Managing periods of heightened regulatory, audit or senior-management scrutiny, requiring timely responses, clear evidence of control effectiveness and disciplined delivery of remediation commitments.
  • Challenging senior business and functional stakeholders on valuation assumptions, manual adjustments, control weaknesses and financial risks, while maintaining constructive relationships and supporting business objectives.
  • Driving long-term process and control improvements where solutions require coordination across multiple teams, changes to systems or data, and sustained follow-through rather than short-term fixes.
  • Developing and retaining a small local team capable of handling complex issues independently, while maintaining delivery quality during periods of change, pressure or increased business activity.

Skills and Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Product Control and Valuation Control understanding
  • Financial Markets and Trading Products
  • China Regulatory awareness

Other Skills

  • Control Framework and risk management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Valuation knowledge – IPV/FVA/PVA

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience leading complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure

Certifications/Qualifications

  • CICPA & CFA is preferred

Languages

  • Chinese and English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Summary

The role is accountable for tactical support for production services, across one or more areas of specific platform/domain.

  • To ensure maximum service quality and stability through fast and effective response to technical incidents, and to be a catalyst for change via analysis and identification of continual service improvement opportunities. Depending on the area of technical specialisation, in addition to incident resolution and prevention, it may also be involved in a control capacity to ensure that new changes to the technology estate do not introduce instability.

  • Fully accountable in incident, problem, change and risk management which relates to the production application/system.

  • Create, Review and update Production Support documentation. Update of contingency (DR/BCP) documentation and processes

  • Provide inputs to management for monthly dashboard that provide information on incident and problem trends along with SIP and RCA Action Items.

ln:4476136629.descriptionHtml:
In Asia Pacific, BNP Paribas is one of the best-positioned international financial institutions with an uninterrupted presence since 1860. Currently with over 20,000 employees* and a presence in 13 markets, BNP Paribas provides corporates, institutional and private investors with product and service solutions tailored to their specific needs. It offers a wide range of financial services covering corporate & institutional banking, wealth management, asset management, insurance, as well as retail banking and consumer financing through strategic partnerships.

Worldwide, BNP Paribas has a presence in 64 markets with more than 180,000 employees. It has key positions in its three main activities: Domestic Markets and International Financial Services (whose retail-banking networks and financial services are covered by Retail Banking & Services) and Corporate & Institutional Banking, which serves two client franchises: corporate clients and institutional investors. Asia Pacific is a key strategic region for BNP Paribas and it continues to develop its franchise in the region.

  • excluding partnerships

BNP Paribas offers you an exciting career in an international business environment that is fast-paced, diverse and focuses on creating high-value relationships with our clients. We offer competitive salary and benefits, as well as a working environment where you’re valued as part of the team.

https://careers.apac.bnpparibas/

2027 APAC Graduate Programme – RISK - China

Our two-year graduate programme has been designed to give you the support and development you need to start a successful career in financial services. You can join us in one of several business areas or support functions, and take on real responsibility from day one. Depending on your qualifications and experience, you can apply to join us as either an analyst or an associate.

For

Final year students or recent graduates with a bachelor’s or master’s degree in any disciplines from a recognized university

Duration

24 months

Start Date

July 2027

Location:

China

Candidates with more than one application will not be processed - You are encouraged to review the different business lines and working locations before applying.

We encourage you to apply for your programme of choice as soon as possible, as we recruit on a rolling basis and may close applications before the advertised date, if all vacancies are filled.

Who can apply?

To Be Considered For The Placement, You Will

  • Possess GPA of 3.3 out of 4.0 or above (or equivalent) in any discipline
  • Have to be fluent in spoken and written English (additional languages are an advantage)
  • Demonstrate methodical, logical, solution-driven initiatives, with commercial awareness and a keen interest in latest finance topics as well as market trends

What you can expect?

Induction

You will start off with a comprehensive induction, where you will be immersed in group training and discover more about the BNP Paribas Group.

Training

Then you will start your business specific technical and financial training, alongside personal skills development aimed at equipping you with the knowledge you need to get you the best possible start in your career. On-the-job training will be delivered throughout your two-year programme, taking you along a tailored development path to build your expertise and broaden your base of skills. You will also have the chance to experience other parts of the business through cross-entity projects, which will help you understand how we approach complex work and give you the chance to develop a strong internal network.

Mentor & Buddy

Throughout the programme, you will be mentored by experienced managers and team members, as well as pairing with a buddy from previous cohorts who will make sure you are getting everything you need to grow.

What will you do?

RISK is an independent control function within BNP Paribas Group, serving as the second line of defense in risk management. It oversees credit, counterparty, market, funding, liquidity, interest rate, foreign exchange, insurance, operational, and environmental risks. RISK partners with businesses to support sustainable development while ensuring compatibility with the Group’s Risk Appetite and strategy.

RISK Project Management supports RISK through strategic projects and transformation efforts.

The RISK APAC Project Manager is based in Hong Kong. The role will support transversal projects across APAC territories and will be working closely with APAC CRO and RISK APAC Chief of Staff.

The RISK APAC Graduate Programme is a two-year structured development programme designed to equip graduates with a strong foundation across the key domains of risk management within a leading global financial institution.

Throughout the 24 months, graduates will receive comprehensive technical, professional, and on-the-job training, combined with rotational exposure across different risk disciplines. This immersive approach enables graduates to develop a broad understanding of Risk while progressively building depth in specific areas aligned with business needs and individual strengths.

At the end of the programme, graduates will be permanently assigned to a dedicated RISK Stream (e.g. RISK Corporate, RISK MFI, RISK Operational Risk Management, RISK Wealth Management,…), allowing them to transition into a long-term role with clear development and career progression opportunities within RISK APAC.

As a RISK APAC Graduate, You Will

  • Support day-to-day risk management activities, analyses, and reporting within your assigned teams and rotations
  • Contribute to the assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks across business activities, portfolios, or processes
  • Assist in the preparation of risk dashboards, management reports, regulatory or internal deliverables
  • Participate in projects and initiatives aimed at improving risk frameworks, controls, methodologies, and governance
  • Collaborate closely with front office, finance, compliance, IT, and other control functions to support sound risk decision-making
  • Apply analytical, quantitative, and qualitative skills to investigate risk issues and propose solutions
  • Adhere to internal policies, governance standards, and regulatory expectations
  • Continuously develop technical knowledge, professional skills, and commercial awareness through training and hands-on experience

Specifically For Each Domain

As a Credit Risk Analyst, you will:

  • Review and assess credit proposals produced by the business credit analyst, checking and challenging if the credit terms are in accordance with the Bank’s norms and policies;
  • Handle credit data and produce statistical analysis for management reporting purposes;
  • Attend credit committees and write meeting minutes;
  • Learn how to form a risk opinion as recommendation to credit committees.

As a Data Protection Analyst, You Will

  • Develop data incident recording, classification, remediation and reporting of operational incidents internally;
  • Prepare regulatory materials;
  • Work on data protection governance initiatives including committee presentations;
  • Examine operational incidents pertaining to personal data;
  • Conduct gap analysis on group control plans and new laws in the region;
  • Input risk assessments for new projects involving personal data;
  • Be involved in information mapping and control testing for data protection topics.

As a Liquidity Risk Analyst, You Will

  • Identify, quantify and control Market Risk and Liquidity Risk of ALMT activities;
  • Develop and improve tools to help further automatate and enhance risk analysis and monitoring;
  • Contribute to the review of Liquidity Risk metrics (internal and regulatory) used by ALMT, and perform regular checks that existing local assumptions and parameters are still relevant, as well as verifying the compliance of ALMT activities to the Banking Laws Framework;
  • Participate in the monitoring of operational risk profiles and material exposure to losses, and provide appropriate reporting. Contribute to RCSAs, historical and potential incident processing, independent reviews and control testing in the aim of continuously enhancing the risk management framework of our APAC activities.

As a Market Risk Analyst, You Will

  • Identify, analyze and monitor Market and Liquidity Risks;
  • Measure and monitor these risks, develop monitoring tools, and report to Business and Senior Management;
  • Work on Valuation Adjustments, which consists of all processes related to Valuation Adjustments (FVR, PVA and IPV) among all asset classes and across all locations. This includes:
    • Valuation adjustment methodologies
    • Data analysis related to valuation adjustments
    • Valuation adjustments monitoring and production
    • Any projects related to valuation adjustment
As An Operational Risk Analyst, You Will

About DBS Bank

DBS is a leading financial services group in Asia, committed to making banking joyful and impactful for customers. We are transforming the future of banking through innovation and technology, empowering individuals and businesses to thrive in the digital economy.

About the Team:

The Global Financial Markets (GFM) team is at the forefront of driving innovation within financial markets. We are seeking a skilled java developer to drive the development in front office technology. This role requires deep technical expertise, strong domain knowledge in trading system. You will collaborate closely with trading desks, quants, and technology teams to ensure our systems are cutting-edge, resilient, and high performing.

Job Responsibilities:

As an Application Developer within Global Financial Markets, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and implementing innovative software solutions. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Software Development: Development of high-performance, low-latency trading systems.
  • System Performance & Resilience: Drive optimizations for latency, scalability, and fault tolerance.
  • DevOps and CI/CD: Implementing and maintaining Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to automate software delivery processes, ensuring efficient and reliable deployments.
  • Collaboration: Partner with traders, quantitative analysts, and infrastructure teams to enhance system capabilities.

Requirements:

  • Experience: 1-5 years for Associate and 5-8 years for Sr Associate
  • Technical Expertise: Proficiency in Java for high-performance systems.
  • Market Knowledge: Understanding order management, and risk management.
  • Performance Optimization: Experience in low-latency architectures, multithreading, and high-throughput systems.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with cloud platforms, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Education: Bachelor's/Master’s degree in CS, Engineering, or related field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior professional experience in FinTech, top-tier brokerages, investment banks, or quantitative hedge funds.

Location:

Guangzhou (DTC)

Job:

Technology

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time
