ln:4476184378.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and optimization of high-performance, scalable Java-based applications and microservices.
  • Architect and maintain AWS cloud-native solutions, ensuring reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Drive technical excellence by conducting code reviews , mentoring engineers, and enforcing best practices in Java, databases (SQL), and Redis caching .
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, DevOps, QA) to deliver robust, low-latency systems.
  • Research and implement emerging technologies (e.g., RAG, AI integration ) to enhance product capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain Python-based scripts or services for automation/data processing.

Requirements

  • Core Java Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on Java development, deep knowledge of JVM, concurrency, Spring Boot/Cloud, and modern Java features (Streams, Lambdas).
  • LangChain/Spring AI Knowledge: Familiarity with LangChain or Spring AI frameworks as a necessary condition for the role.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Proven experience with AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) and cloud architecture best practices.
  • Database & Caching: Strong skills in relational databases (Oracle/PostgreSQL) and Redis (clustering, performance tuning).
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to troubleshoot distributed systems, optimize bottlenecks, and make data-driven decisions.
  • CI/CD & IaC: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Agile & Collaboration: Comfortable in Scrum/Kanban environments and working with remote teams.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited Xian Branch***

Principal Responsibilities

As an Application Developer within Institutional Bank Group, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and implementing innovative software solutions. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Software Development: Developing, testing, and deploying high-quality, scalable, and resilient applications, utilizing modern programming languages and frameworks.
  • Generative AI and Machine Learning: Engaging in the development and integration of Generative AI (GenAI) and Machine Learning (ML) models into financial applications, contributing to advanced analytical and predictive capabilities. This may involve working with GenAI/ML platforms and leveraging services.
  • System Design and Architecture: Participating in the architectural design of new and existing systems, ensuring they meet business requirements and adhere to best practices in terms of performance, security, and scalability.
  • DevOps and CI/CD: Implementing and maintaining Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to automate software delivery processes, ensuring efficient and reliable deployments.
  • Collaboration: Working closely with product managers and product owners to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Troubleshooting and Support: Providing technical support and troubleshooting for production issues, ensuring high availability and performance of critical applications.
  • Documentation: Creating and maintaining comprehensive technical documentation for applications and systems.
  • Innovation: Staying abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, particularly in areas like AI/ML, cloud computing, and financial technology, to drive continuous improvement and innovation within the team.

Education And Relevant Experience

  • 5+ years of working experience with Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in Java, familiar with Python.
  • Proven experience in software development, preferably within the financial services industry.
  • Solid understanding of relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with middle ware service like Kafka, RocketMQ etc.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP, OCP) and cloud-native application development.
  • Experience with DevOps principles and CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
  • Experience with scripting languages like Bash, sh, etc. Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments.
  • Knowledge of financial markets products and processes is highly desirable.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in an agile, fast-paced, and collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Front-end development experience (e.g., Angular, JavaScript, React) is a plus for full-stack roles.
  • Prior professional experience in FinTech, Top tier banking industry

Location:

Guangzhou (DTC)

Job:

Technology

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of IWPB Global Transformation Centre Lead, Guangzhou and Xian.

 Business: Global IWPB Change Execution

Job ID ： 62560

The Role

As IWPB Global Transformation Center Lead - Guangzhou and Xian you’ll set direction for HSBC’s China-based offshore Change team delivering outcomes for Hong Kong, the rest of Asia, HASE, China and multiple multi-market value streams. The role partners closely with senior business and delivery stakeholders to align roadmaps, priorities and capacity while ensuring delivery remains anchored to IWPB strategic objectives. You’ll be accountable for end-to-end non-Technology delivery across global and regional programmes bringing re-usable common capabilities to markets. Success means strengthening delivery capability across the GTC and creating a consistent approach to ways of operating including Agile and DevOps principles aligned to FIM. You’ll also own the site’s people agenda including recruitment, onboarding, engagement and talent development across a large team. This is a senior role operating in a fast-moving environment where clear decision-making and strong stakeholder alignment matter.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Oversee the China-based offshore Change organisation across Guangzhou and Xian including delivery for multiple markets and value streams
  • Shape delivery roadmaps, milestones, priorities and supply in partnership with senior business stakeholders and value stream leadership
  • Deliver global and regional programmes with accountability for end-to-end non-Technology outcomes across markets and delivery teams
  • Establish a cross-functional delivery approach across IT, Digital, Channels, Operations, enabling functions and third-party providers
  • Embed consistent ways of operating (WOO) across teams including Agile delivery practices and DevOps principles aligned to FIM
  • Strengthen delivery capability through continuous improvement, coaching, mentoring, training and sharing best practice across markets
  • Govern adherence to the Change Management Framework and intervene early to resolve delivery risks, issues and dependencies
  • Manage vendor and service provider relationships including commercial negotiations, resourcing, performance expectations and quality tracking

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bring proven experience running large-scale, multi-market change programmes in digital banking and delivering measurable outcomes
  • Demonstrate substantial experience establishing or managing a large Change organisation and strengthening delivery capability at scale
  • Show practical working knowledge of Agile practices and methodologies and experience embedding new ways of operating
  • Apply established understanding of HSBC Change Framework and experience executing programmes in line with defined frameworks and controls
  • Partner effectively with senior executives across business, technology and functions to align priorities and secure decisions on trade-offs
  • Manage delivery across matrix structures, multiple geographies and time zones including multicultural teams
  • Resolve complex delivery conflicts through structured negotiation and stakeholder alignment across cross-functional teams
  • Hold SAFe, Scrum Master, Managing Successful Programmes, Change Management or equivalent certification or bring equivalent demonstrable experience

Building IWPB change at scale

This role is a chance to shape how IWPB delivers change from Guangzhou and Xian across markets and value streams. You’ll set a clear delivery approach that supports both immediate business priorities and long-term strategy. By strengthening capability, governance and ways of working you’ll help teams deliver consistent outcomes in a dynamic environment. If you’re ready to take accountability for delivery at scale and partner closely with senior stakeholders across the business and technology join us at HSBC.

ln:4475175079.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • Drive technology initiatives and enhancements for the Custody Operations environment, including client implementations, technology deployments and regulatory/mandatory changes.
  • Translate business requirements into robust, stable and scalable technical solutions in partnership with Technology, Product and Operations.
  • Provide hands-on senior development expertise across Java/J2EE, Scala, data platforms and integration technologies, while supporting implementation readiness, release delivery and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Senior Data Development and Solution Delivery

  • Produce/review BRDs, FRDs and user stories; coordinate and/or perform UAT; coordinate implementation; design robust, stable and scalable solutions; and ensure solutions are documented and communicated to impacted parties.
  • Support release planning, execution and post-implementation review; ensure Operations readiness; collaborate to improve processes; manage stakeholder relationships across Product, Technology and Risk; assess operational impact of new deals; meet tight deadlines/budgets; and take ownership during crisis situations.

Skills And Experience

  • Java/J2EE & Scala Development
  • Data Engineering & Hadoop Ecosystem (Hadoop, Hive, HBase, Spark, SQL/NoSQL)
  • Integration & Messaging (Kafka, SFTP, Web Services, JMS/MQ)
  • DevOps & Containers (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Rundeck)
  • Custody Operations & Trade Settlement
  • Business Analysis, Requirements & UAT
  • Stakeholder Management, Communication & Problem Solving

Motivations

  • Solving complex technical and operational problems and turning business requirements into reliable, scalable solutions.
  • Collaborating across Technology, Product, Operations and Risk to deliver client, regulatory and business outcomes.
  • Continuously improving, simplifying and innovating while learning from both successes and failures.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years Hadoop platform development; relevant Custody Operations / Business Analysis / Project Management experience; strong Custody and trade settlement knowledge; proven analytical/problem-solving capability; experience with cost-saving and/or risk-mitigation initiatives.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Information Technology Engineering or closely related field, or equivalent education/experience. Source JD also states: PG - Any Postgraduate in Any Specialization.
  • Languages: English, Chinese

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Description

Job Summary

  • Work in PCVC team to manage the Product control activities for China across Business
  • Provide strong oversight of the integrity, accuracy and timely reporting of China trading revenues, balance sheet positions and valuation adjustments, ensuring that financial results are appropriately controlled and understood.
  • Support Team Head to establish and maintain a China-specific Product Control and Valuation Control framework that meets local regulatory requirements while remaining aligned with the bank’s global policies, standards and risk appetite.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance and Operations to support sustainable business growth by providing independent challenge, identifying emerging financial and valuation risks, and enabling informed commercial decision-making.
  • Strengthen the local control environment through effective governance, clear ownership, high-quality management information and the development of capable China-based Product Control and Valuation Control resources.
  • Manage the Valuation Control deliverables as applicable for China regulatory requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Key contributor to China-based Product Control and Valuation Control team, acting as a hands-on subject matter expert. The role combines teamwork and significant individual contribution, particularly in resolving complex control, valuation, accounting and regulatory matters.
  • Oversee the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of daily and monthly P&L, balance sheet substantiation, valuation adjustments, independent price verification and other core Product Control and Valuation Control activities for the China business.
  • Support team leader to establish and maintain an effective China-specific control framework that meets local regulatory expectations and is aligned with the bank’s global Product Control and Valuation Control policies, methodologies and governance standards.
  • Coordinate extensively with global and regional Product Control and Valuation Control teams to obtain technical input, clarify policy requirements, resolve methodology differences and ensure consistent application of global standards within the China business.
  • Provide independent review and challenge of trading results, valuation methodologies, reserves, model inputs, adjustments and balance sheet positions. Ensure material issues are identified, investigated, escalated and resolved within agreed timelines.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to support new products, business growth and regulatory initiatives, ensuring that appropriate financial controls and valuation processes are in place before implementation.
  • Support the China business by providing clear analysis of revenue performance, valuation uncertainty, balance sheet risks, control weaknesses and emerging issues, enabling informed management and commercial decision-making.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Key contributor to achieve improvements in processes, reporting, data quality and automation, reducing manual adjustments and recurring breaks while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.
  • Maintain effective governance over material issues, exceptions and control breaches, with clear ownership, action plans, escalation thresholds and reporting to relevant China, regional and global committees.
  • The role holder is responsible for both the day-to-day effectiveness of the local Product Control and Valuation Control function and the successful coordination of China requirements with the wider global control organisation.

Skills and Experience

  • Product Control and Valuation Control understanding
  • Financial Markets and Trading Products
  • China Regulatory awareness
  • Control Framework and risk management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Valuation knowledge – IPV/FVA/PVA

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, where local requirements may differ from global standards and require careful interpretation, escalation and practical implementation.
  • Resolving valuation, P&L and balance sheet issues involving incomplete data, methodology differences, manual processes or unclear ownership across local, regional and global teams.
  • Building a credible and sustainable local Product Control and Valuation Control framework while working with limited resources, competing priorities and significant dependency on global subject-matter experts.
  • Managing periods of heightened regulatory, audit or senior-management scrutiny, requiring timely responses, clear evidence of control effectiveness and disciplined delivery of remediation commitments.
  • Challenging senior business and functional stakeholders on valuation assumptions, manual adjustments, control weaknesses and financial risks, while maintaining constructive relationships and supporting business objectives.
  • Driving long-term process and control improvements where solutions require coordination across multiple teams, changes to systems or data, and sustained follow-through rather than short-term fixes.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience dealing complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure
  • CICPA & CFA is preferred
  • Languages: Chinese and English

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

This role could be based in China or Hong Kong. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.

Strategy

  • Support management of Markets’ consumption of SCB’s binding Balance Sheet Metrics including LCR, NSFR, RWA and Intragroup Large exposure
  • Identity and facilitate Balance Sheet Optimisation initiatives
  • Be informed of existing and new rules and regulations on Capital, Liquidity and Margining and understand impact on Markets business
  • Within the business mandate, support unique funding asks which TM may be unable to provide, to better serve our clients

Business

  • Support Markets’ balance sheet planning by actively communicates with Markets Trading Desks and Sales to manage Market’s funding pipeline and work with Treasury and FRM to better manage Markets’ funding ask.
  • Facilitate liquidity profile optimisation for Markets business within risk limit and MAT
  • Support Markets’ overall balance sheet management and helps Markets to minimize regulatory liquidity and capital cost.
  • Consistently works with the business and Treasury to optimize liquidity, balance sheet and inventory

Processes

  • Manage daily funding activities in China within the country’s overall Markets funding framework; partner with Treasury China to simplify and streamline process/policy for robust governance and reporting
  • Arrange funding transactions according to Markets internal funding booking model including derivatives collateral margining funding
  • Facilitate optimisation of funding mix including swap funding and other hedging as required, operating within market risk and any other related risk metrics

People and Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.

Risk Management

  • Responsible to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.
  • Responsible to manage market risk and pnl arising from funding and corresponding hedging transactions including FX and interest rate derivatives. Ensure to operate within dealing mandate and all relevant risk limit.

Governance

  • Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group's arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory and Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills and Experience

  • Dealing experience in financial instruments e.g. FX swaps, interest rate swaps
  • Competency in analysing market risk and PNL on trading positions
  • Knowledge and understanding of key balance sheet metrics (LCR, NSFR, leverage ratio, RWA etc)

Qualifications

  • Graduate qualifications (or conversions): Post-Graduate qualifications such as MBA, CFA, Chartered Accountancy, Mathematics/ Statistics, Qualified Lawyer
  • Over 2 to10 years (Analyst to Director) of relevant experience in the banking and financial services industry with hands on experience of underwriting, managing, and recovering credit exposures across both developing and developed jurisdictions
  • Good knowledge of Global Markets businesses and balance sheet management; including market and regulatory dynamics
  • Experience in funding activities related derivatives trading and related PnL and market risk management

ln:4475419861.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of SR. ASSOCIATE DIRECTOR, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end engineering delivery for lending products/platform capabilities, from discovery through build, release, and production support (APIs, backend services, data, background processing, and operational tooling).
  • Bring a strong business/product mindset: understand customer and business outcomes, challenge requirements constructively, propose product/technical options, and shape solutions that balance value, time-to-market, risk, and cost.
  • Translate business requirements into architecture and technical direction, working closely with Product Owners, BAs, QA, SRE/Operations, and Risk/Compliance partners.
  • Design modern cloud-first architectures (microservices/event-driven where appropriate) with clear trade-offs, focusing on maintainability, security-by-design, and operational simplicity.
  • Own performance engineering: define NFRs, run performance analysis, identify bottlenecks, and drive performance tuning across application, database, messaging, and infrastructure.
  • Build for extreme resilience: design and implement robust patterns such as timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breakers, bulkheads, rate limiting, idempotency, graceful degradation, and strong fallback strategies.
  • Engineer production-ready services with deep observability: structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and SLO-oriented monitoring; ensure self-diagnosis and “self-issue reporting” patterns where feasible.
  • Drive cost-effective delivery: make pragmatic technology choices, optimise cloud and runtime costs, right-size services, reduce waste, and continually improve cost-to-serve (FinOps mindset).
  • Ensure operational excellence end-to-end including: housekeeping (data retention, archiving, cleanup jobs), scaling strategies, capacity planning, DR considerations, and production readiness reviews.
  • Own incident learning loops: lead RCA, implement preventative controls, and reduce repeat incidents through reliability improvements and automation.
  • Lead engineering practices and standards: coding quality, security, architecture guardrails, documentation, and mentoring/coaching across the team.
  • Support modernisation (monolith-to-microservices where justified, platform upgrades, API standardisation, data/event-driven patterns) with measurable outcomes.

Requirements

  • Strong product/engineering leadership: able to influence priorities, propose solution options, and align stakeholders on trade-offs (scope/cost/risk/time).
  • Cost mindset / value engineering: demonstrated ability to deliver outcomes with cost control (cloud cost optimisation, licensing/runtime trade-offs, reducing operational overhead).
  • Modern architecture capability: hands-on experience designing cloud-ready systems with clear NFR ownership (performance, resilience, scalability, security).
  • Strong hands-on Java experience (Java 11+; Java 17 preferred) building enterprise-grade services and APIs.
  • Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC/WebFlux, Spring Security) and API design (REST, OpenAPI/Swagger; versioning/backward compatibility).
  • Microservices and distributed systems patterns: service decomposition, configuration, resiliency patterns, idempotency, consistency models, and safe evolutionary design.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business: IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test and maintain production-grade software and AI-enabled applications.
  • Translate lending business requirements and operational challenges into practical technology solutions.
  • Work with AI engineers, software engineers, architects, product owners, data specialists and lending subject-matter experts.
  • Develop reliable APIs, services, data pipelines and application components.
  • Support the integration of machine learning and generative AI capabilities into lending platforms, subject to appropriate risk, security and governance controls.
  • Apply software engineering best practices, including clean code, automated testing, version control, continuous integration and continuous delivery.
  • Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and design through implementation, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure solutions meet applicable standards for resilience, security, privacy, model risk management and regulatory compliance.
  • Investigate incidents, identify root causes and implement sustainable fixes.
  • Document technical designs, operational procedures and key decisions.
  • Share knowledge across locations and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.
  • Support the responsible adoption of AI by considering explainability, human oversight, data quality, bias, security and appropriate use of outputs.

Requirements

  • Experience as a software engineer, developer or technology professional within WPS Lending or a closely related lending technology environment.
  • Good understanding of lending products, processes, platforms or customer journeys.
  • Strong programming experience in Java and/or Python.
  • Experience building and supporting production applications, services or APIs.
  • Understanding of software engineering principles, including:
    • Object-oriented design
    • Automated testing
    • Version control
    • CI/CD
    • Secure coding
    • Observability and monitoring
  • Experience working with relational or non-relational databases and data-oriented applications.
  • Ability to analyse complex problems and communicate solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working effectively in distributed, cross-location teams.
  • Willingness to learn and apply AI engineering practices, including model and prompt evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, orchestration, monitoring and responsible AI controls.
Desirable experience

  • Experience delivering AI, machine learning, generative AI or automation solutions.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and containerised applications, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures, microservices or distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of lending decisioning, credit processes, servicing, collections, risk or customer onboarding.
  • Experience with data engineering, data quality, feature engineering or model integration.
  • Familiarity with MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring or AI application evaluation.
  • Experience working in a regulated financial services environment.
  • Practical understanding of secure development, identity and access management, encryption and data protection.

  • Proven record in strategy execution on mass retail banking business with strong understanding of customer behaviours and needs related to banking and wealth.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to engage stakeholders across businesses and functions with ability to influence senior teams.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

This role could be based in China or Hong Kong. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.

Strategy

  • Support management of Markets’ consumption of SCB’s binding Balance Sheet Metrics including LCR, NSFR, RWA and Intragroup Large exposure
  • Identity and facilitate Balance Sheet Optimisation initiatives
  • Be informed of existing and new rules and regulations on Capital, Liquidity and Margining and understand impact on Markets business
  • Within the business mandate, support unique funding asks which TM may be unable to provide, to better serve our clients

Business

  • Support Markets’ balance sheet planning by actively communicates with Markets Trading Desks and Sales to manage Market’s funding pipeline and work with Treasury and FRM to better manage Markets’ funding ask.
  • Facilitate liquidity profile optimisation for Markets business within risk limit and MAT
  • Support Markets’ overall balance sheet management and helps Markets to minimize regulatory liquidity and capital cost.
  • Consistently works with the business and Treasury to optimize liquidity, balance sheet and inventory

Processes

  • Manage daily funding activities in China within the country’s overall Markets funding framework; partner with Treasury China to simplify and streamline process/policy for robust governance and reporting
  • Arrange funding transactions according to Markets internal funding booking model including derivatives collateral margining funding
  • Facilitate optimisation of funding mix including swap funding and other hedging as required, operating within market risk and any other related risk metrics

People and Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.

Risk Management

  • Responsible to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.
  • Responsible to manage market risk and pnl arising from funding and corresponding hedging transactions including FX and interest rate derivatives. Ensure to operate within dealing mandate and all relevant risk limit.

Governance

  • Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group's arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory and Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills and Experience

  • Dealing experience in financial instruments e.g. FX swaps, interest rate swaps
  • Competency in analysing market risk and PNL on trading positions
  • Knowledge and understanding of key balance sheet metrics (LCR, NSFR, leverage ratio, RWA etc)

Qualifications

  • Graduate qualifications (or conversions): Post-Graduate qualifications such as MBA, CFA, Chartered Accountancy, Mathematics/ Statistics, Qualified Lawyer
  • Over 2 to10 years (Analyst to Director) of relevant experience in the banking and financial services industry with hands on experience of underwriting, managing, and recovering credit exposures across both developing and developed jurisdictions
  • Good knowledge of Global Markets businesses and balance sheet management; including market and regulatory dynamics
  • Experience in funding activities related derivatives trading and related PnL and market risk management

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Profile Description

Standard Chartered Bank

Job Description

Job Summary

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;

理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；

审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；

配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

当作为带人经理时，带领团队拓展产品发行，维持以及开拓交易对手方关系，积极与 Product & Segment部门、资金产品销售和其他销售人员合作，不断改进和创新，以开发更好的产品咨询解决方案。

  • Keep refreshed mindset on market change and industry trend to ensure product innovation.

持续关注市场变化和行业趋势，力争产品创新。

Processes

  • Assist in system integration and implementation in order to ensure the streamlining and increase in productivity.

协助系统整合和升级，以确保高效运作。

根据当地法规要求和集团政策，持续检测和升级现有产品的功能、服务和工作流程，以改善客户体验。

对资金产品销售和其他销售人员进行培训，以提高其产品知识和市场知识。

  • Established professional code and communication skills when collaborating with other teams.

与其他团队进行专业地合作和沟通。

在履行职责时执行和遵守反洗钱要求。

遵守预防洗钱的规定，随时警惕异常或可疑的客户活动，并应向反洗钱监督小组和直线经理报告任何可疑活动，在紧急或特殊情况下应直接向国家反洗钱办公室报告。

制定适当的风险控制措施并衡量其有效性，缓解风险，解决问题。

主动识别和报告风险问题

及时完成所有风险和合规强制性培训，包括在规定的截止日期前进行e-learning课程。

充分理解消费者权益保护的重要性，防止损害消费者的最佳利益，执行与消费者权益保护相关的监管要求，确保完成相关培训，并在日常工作中始终嵌入消费者权益保护意识。

  • Fully understand the importance of fraud prevention, prevent fraud risks, maintain safe and steady operation of the position, implement regulatory requirements of fraud prevention, strictly execute DOIs of the department, ensure to complete relevant trainings and embed fraud prevention in daily work.

充分认识防欺诈的重要性，防范欺诈风险，维护岗位安全稳定运行，落实防欺诈监管要求，严格执行部门管理文件，确保完成相关培训，将防欺诈融入日常工作。

正确履行管理职责，并确保内控的效率；

对负有管理和或领导责任的事项引起或相关的违反监管规定事件或风险，承担相应责任.

为内控失效造成的重大损失负责。

  • Microsoft Word

  • 2+ years of people leader experience

- Consistently review and upgrade existing product features, services, workflows to improve client experiences and make sure full compliance with local regulatory requirements and group policy.
根据当地法规要求和集团政策，持续检测和升级现有产品的功能、服务和工作流程，以改善客户体验。
- Conduct training to Treasury Specialist and Sales team to enhance product knowledge and market sense.
对资金产品销售和其他销售人员进行培训，以提高其产品知识和市场知识。
- Established professional code and communication skills when collaborating with other teams.
与其他团队进行专业地合作和沟通。

在履行职责时执行和遵守反洗钱要求。
- Comply with the respective Money Laundering Prevention Procedures and be alert at all times to unusual or possibly suspicious customer activity and should report any suspicious activity to AML Surveillance Team and line manager as well as directly to the Country MLPO in urgent or exceptional circumstances.
遵守预防洗钱的规定，随时警惕异常或可疑的客户活动，并应向反洗钱监督小组和直线经理报告任何可疑活动，在紧急或特殊情况下应直接向国家反洗钱办公室报告。
- Mitigation of risks and resolution of issues in a timely manner including developing suitable controls and measuring their effectiveness.
制定适当的风险控制措施并衡量其有效性，缓解风险，解决问题。
- Proactive identification and reporting of risks and concerns.
主动识别和报告风险问题

及时完成所有风险和合规强制性培训，包括在规定的截止日期前进行e-learning课程。

充分理解消费者权益保护的重要性，防止损害消费者的最佳利益，执行与消费者权益保护相关的监管要求，确保完成相关培训，并在日常工作中始终嵌入消费者权益保护意识。
- Fully understand the importance of fraud prevention, prevent fraud risks, maintain safe and steady operation of the position, implement regulatory requirements of fraud prevention, strictly execute DOIs of the department, ensure to complete relevant trainings and embed fraud prevention in daily work.
充分认识防欺诈的重要性，防范欺诈风险，维护岗位安全稳定运行，落实防欺诈监管要求，严格执行部门管理文件，确保完成相关培训，将防欺诈融入日常工作。
Accountable for Consumer Rights Protection Requirements (CN required)
- Fully comply with all the regulatory requirements related to Consumer Rights Protection, uphold the robust mindset of Consumer Rights Protection, complete the Consumer Rights Protection themed training and workshop in due course, prevent the potential infringements of consumer rights, participate the public education, EV or other activities to uplift the public awareness about Consumer Rights Protection
- Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
- Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
- Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Key stakeholders
- WRB/SME/WS Product 产品部
- WRB/SME/WS Segment 客群部
- WRB/SME/WS HO 总部
- WRB/SME/WS Process team 政策及流程部
- WRB/SME/WS Business Finance 财务部
- WRB/SME/WS Operation team 营运部
- OR 操作风险部
- BORM 业务风险管控部
- Legal & Compliance 法务部和合规部
- CMPS Treasury Specialist Team 资金产品销售团队
- WRB/SME/WS Sales 零售银行和中小企业银行销售团队
- WFX and CNSD Project Team WFX和CNSD项目团队
- External Counterparties for SD 结构性存款产品交易对手方
- FM金融市场部
Other Responsibilities
跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控;
配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。
- Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control.
正确履行管理职责，并确保内控的效率；
- Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of the event over which the employee has the duties of management and/or leadership.
对负有管理和或领导责任的事项引起或相关的违反监管规定事件或风险，承担相应责任.
- Be responsible for significant losses due to failure of effectiveness of internal control.
为内控失效造成的重大损失负责。

- Microsoft Excel
- Microsoft PowerPoint
- Microsoft Word
- Capital Markets Products Skills

- 2+ years of people leader experience

- Languages: Excellent written and spoken English and Mandarin.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Offshore Investment Product Team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats).

  • Microsoft Office
  • English
  • Banking Products and Services Development
  • Product Development Strategy
  • Customer/Market focus
  • Regulatory Environment - Financial Services

Qualifications

  • Licenses: AMAC License for Fund Practitioners
  • Languages: English, Chinese

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Profile Description

Standard Chartered Bank

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

Origination

  • Identify prospect and convert in line with Bank’s appetite.
  • Ensure quality of the sales pitch and lead them with the clients. Also review the Term sheets before delivering to clients.
  • Engagement and Coordination of Product Partners for marketing efforts and deal structuring.
  • Work with CA and obtain all pre-deal clearances.
  • Effectively use RM Workbench for managing a healthy pipeline and also a record of client calls and discussions.
  • Drive client events / entertainments by coordinating with internal stakeholders and with client(s).
  • Oversee ARM to ensure smooth on-boarding of client after thorough completion of documentation and other processes.
  • Senior client calling and briefing on a regular basis for account maintenance and deal negotiation. Responsible for preparing briefing notes for senior management calls. Also engage senior internal stakeholders for marketing, credit and any other pertinent issues.
  • Internal coordination for cross / up selling.

Business

  • Identify prospect and convert in line with Bank’s appetite.
  • Ensure quality of the sales pitch and lead them with the clients. Also review the Term sheets before delivering to clients.
  • Engagement and Coordination of Product Partners for marketing efforts and deal structuring.
  • Work with CA and obtain all pre-deal clearances.
  • Effectively use RM Workbench for managing a healthy pipeline and also a record of client calls and discussions.
  • Drive client events / entertainments by coordinating with internal stakeholders and with client(s).
  • Oversee ARM to ensure smooth on-boarding of client after thorough completion of documentation and other processes.
  • Senior client calling and briefing on a regular basis for account maintenance and deal negotiation. Responsible for preparing briefing notes for senior management calls. Also engage senior internal stakeholders for marketing, credit and any other pertinent issues.
  • Internal coordination for cross / up selling.

Processes

Client on-boarding & deal excecution

  • Work closely with CA, product partners, GAM / FAM and analyze:
  • Wallet size;
  • Determine appropriateness of the product and deal structuring; and
  • Work out a comprehensive account plan.
  • Successfully negotiate and close out pricing and other deal dynamics with client.
  • Oversee the quality & turnaround of credit proposal and ensure faster delivery. Work with CA for resolving credit queries, reviewing & supporting BCAs.
  • Oversee the ARM to ensure all documentation and security creation are completed on time to ensure smooth execution of transaction.
  • Liaising with client / legal / external counsel / CDU / CRC in preparation and execution of non standard complex transactions along with product partners.
  • Work with CDD team leader to ensure the proper completion of eCDDs.

Account Management & portfolio quality

  • Along with the product partner, push for line utilization of complex and structured transactions. Oversee the ARM in ensuring high utilization of regular working capital facilities.
  • Work with CA to monitor lending RWA and overall RoRWA at account level.
  • Review failed trade status, EAR, ASTAR, CCRT, etc with the CA to ensure discipline and quality in portfolio.
  • Review the excess/past due situation with ARM to ensure they are regularized and also facilitate approvals wherever required.
  • Review and monitor the client profitability to ensure there are no revenue leakages.
  • Attend various internal or external sales / non sales meetings like EAR, MTM calls, Portfolio Review Meeting etc. and convene the consortium meetings where we are the lead bank.
  • Overall responsible and accountable for the credit quality of the assigned / acquired portfolio.
  • Ensuring timely exit of clients, RoRWA monitoring and tail management.
  • Front internal and external auditing and oversee CA and ARM to follow up audit issues.
  • Overall responsible and accountable for Working Capital Loan and Fixed Asset Loan post drawdown monitoring.
  • Achieve individual sales targets on revenue, asset and liability footing while contributing towards team’s overall budget by:
  • Effectively generating new business – identify prospects and convert in line with the Bank’s appetite
  • Strategically formulating account plan – provide clients needs-based solutions, structure appropriate credit facility, and execute various banking transactions
  • Proactively building trusted client relationships – maintain a portfolio of active and growing customers

Adhoc projects, duties, assignment

  • From time to time, due to exigencies of service, you may be required to take on additional duties, projects or assignments as determined by your supervisor.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills and Experience

  • Excellent financial analysis skills
  • Sound product knowledge
  • Decent command of English as a language
  • Client origination capability

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before.   • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

The role offers exposure to a broad range of financing, fixed income derivatives and capital markets products, including secured lending, special situations investments, structured notes transactions and SPV debt issuance platforms. With other team members, provide legal representation predominantly to the Asia Special Situations business, the Structuring and Client Solutions teams in Japan, Hong Kong and Singapore, Asia FX Sales and Trading, and Asia Rates Sales.

Responsibilities:

  • Advise on secured lending and other structured financing transactions across Asia-Pacific, likely in a special situations context.
  • Support the structuring, negotiation and execution of complex financing transactions, including those involving distressed, event-driven and opportunistic investment strategies.
  • Provide legal advice in relation to debt issuance transactions, including structured notes, credit-linked products, repackagings and other funding or risk-transfer structures issued through SPV or issuer programmes.
  • Partner with business teams to develop, launch and support new products and transaction structures while identifying and managing legal, regulatory and reputational risks.
  • Provide legal advice to Asia Fixed Income Sales and Trading businesses on a broad range of trading, documentation, technology, platform and client solutions initiatives.
  • Over time, support facility-linked hedging transactions, deal-contingent hedges, total return swaps and related risk-management products.
  • Advise on applicable legal and regulatory developments affecting financing, derivatives, structured products and capital markets activities in Asia.
  • Coordinate with external counsel, internal control partners and business stakeholders in connection with transaction structuring, negotiation and execution.
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives, product development and cross-business projects across the Asia Fixed Income platform.

Required Skills:

  • We are looking for a versatile financing lawyer with a strong secured lending, leveraged finance, structured financing or other financing transactions background and preferably experience supporting special situations transactions.
  • Experience advising on structured products or securitized fixed income derivatives is beneficial but not required, provided the candidate is adaptable and willing to develop expertise in these areas.
  • Around 5-10 years of post-qualification experience at a leading law firm, financial institution or comparable organization is desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex transactions and deliver practical, risk-based legal advice in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong drafting, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn new products, regulatory frameworks and business lines.
  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions in Asia Pacific is advantageous.
  • Ideally based in Hong Kong, but flexible across the key Asia Pacific financial centers.

Job Summary

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;

理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；

  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;

跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；

  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;

审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；

  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;

对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；

  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Coverage of CMPS products (structured products) to deliver the proper solutions under the framework of Business Strategy to meet the needs across from Retail Banking and Business Banking clients.

覆盖资本市场产品及解决方案部的产品（结构性产品），在业务战略框架下提供适当的解决方案，以满足零售银行和中小企业银行客户的需求。

  • Manage and develop strong product solutions and smooth workflow to deliver differentiated product proposition and brand identity. 开发并管理强大的产品解决方案和顺畅的工作流程；提供独特的产品主张和品牌标识。
  • To develop and manage the full range of structured products with reference to the overall Wealth Solution Strategy.
  • Manage and maintain the development of the strong and differentiated product proposition and brand identity.

Business

  • Collaborate with Wealth Management and [Retail/Business] Banking to bring the best values to our clients through: 与财富管理和零售银行/中小企业部门合作，通过以下方式为客户带来最佳价值：
  • Product ideation and innovation产品构思与创新
  • Product pipeline planning产品受众规划
  • Provision of best execution for CMPS products资本市场产品及解决方案部的产品的最佳执行
  • Infrastructure implementation to ensure a seamless workflow基础架构的维护与执行
  • To manage end to end structured product business and drive digital adoption
  • Deliver new products to market to grow customer base and revenue
  • Collaborate with key country stakeholders in Wealth Management, Retail Banking, Technology and Operations to deliver the best value to our customers
  • Actively work with Product & Segment, Treasury Specialist and Sales to make continuous improvement and innovation to develop better product advisory solutions.

积极与 Product & Segment部门、资金产品销售和其他销售人员合作，不断改进和创新，以开发更好的产品咨询解决方案。

  • Keep refreshed mindset on market change and industry trend to ensure product innovation.

持续关注市场变化和行业趋势，力争产品创新。

Processes

  • Assist in system integration and implementation in order to ensure the streamlining and increase in productivity.

协助系统整合和升级，以确保高效运作。

  • Consistently review and upgrade existing product features, services, workflows to improve client experiences and make sure full compliance with local regulatory requirements and group policy.

根据当地法规要求和集团政策，持续检测和升级现有产品的功能、服务和工作流程，以改善客户体验。

People & Talent

  • Conduct training to Treasury Specialist and Sales team to enhance product knowledge and market sense.

对资金产品销售和其他销售人员进行培训，以提高其产品知识和市场知识。

  • Established professional code and communication skills when collaborating with other teams.

与其他团队进行专业地合作和沟通。

Risk Management

  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties.

在履行职责时执行和遵守反洗钱要求。

  • Comply with the respective Money Laundering Prevention Procedures and be alert at all times to unusual or possibly suspicious customer activity and should report any suspicious activity to AML Surveillance Team and line manager as well as directly to the Country MLPO in urgent or exceptional circumstances.

遵守预防洗钱的规定，随时警惕异常或可疑的客户活动，并应向反洗钱监督小组和直线经理报告任何可疑活动，在紧急或特殊情况下应直接向国家反洗钱办公室报告。

  • Mitigation of risks and resolution of issues in a timely manner including developing suitable controls and measuring their effectiveness.

制定适当的风险控制措施并衡量其有效性，缓解风险，解决问题。

  • Proactive identification and reporting of risks and concerns.

主动识别和报告风险问题

Governance

  • Adherence to laws and regulations, internal risk and compliance policies (including anti-money laundry, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption and relevant FCC risks) and the Group Code of Conduct.

遵守法律法规、内部风险和合规政策（包括反洗钱、制裁、反贿赂和腐败以及相关的FCC风险）和集团行为准则。

  • Timely completion of all mandatory risk and compliance training, including e-learning by the set deadlines.

及时完成所有风险和合规强制性培训，包括在规定的截止日期前进行e-learning课程。

  • Fully understand the importance of consumer rights protection, prevent damage to consumer’s best interest, implement regulatory requirements related to consumer rights protection, ensure to complete relevant trainings and to always embed consumer rights protection mindset when performing daily work.

充分理解消费者权益保护的重要性，防止损害消费者的最佳利益，执行与消费者权益保护相关的监管要求，确保完成相关培训，并在日常工作中始终嵌入消费者权益保护意识。

  • Fully understand the importance of fraud prevention, prevent fraud risks, maintain safe and steady operation of the position, implement regulatory requirements of fraud prevention, strictly execute DOIs of the department, ensure to complete relevant trainings and embed fraud prevention in daily work.

充分认识防欺诈的重要性，防范欺诈风险，维护岗位安全稳定运行，落实防欺诈监管要求，严格执行部门管理文件，确保完成相关培训，将防欺诈融入日常工作。

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • WRB/SME/WS Product 产品部
  • WRB/SME/WS Segment 客群部
  • WRB/SME/WS HO 总部
  • WRB/SME/WS Process team 政策及流程部
  • WRB/SME/WS Business Finance 财务部
  • WRB/SME/WS Operation team 营运部
  • OR 操作风险部
  • BORM 业务风险管控部
  • Legal & Compliance 法务部和合规部
  • CMPS Treasury Specialist Team 资金产品销售团队
  • WRB/SME/WS Sales 零售银行和中小企业银行销售团队
  • WFX and CNSD Project Team WFX和CNSD项目团队
  • External Counterparties for SD 结构性存款产品交易对手方
  • FM金融市场部

Other Responsibilities

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies.

理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；

  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities.

跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控;

  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank.
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections.

对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；

  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

  • Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control.

正确履行管理职责，并确保内控的效率；

  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of the event over which the employee has the duties of management and/or leadership.

对负有管理和或领导责任的事项引起或相关的违反监管规定事件或风险，承担相应责任.

  • Be responsible for significant losses due to failure of effectiveness of internal control.

为内控失效造成的重大损失负责。

Skills And Experience

  • Education: University graduate with 5+ years of working experience in banking and related financial institutions. Deep understanding of structured products pricing; familiar with derivatives with underlying of equity, fixed income and currency;
  • Certifications: Post-graduate degree holder or CFA are preferred.
  • Languages: Excellent written and spoken English and Mandarin.

Qualifications

  • Microsoft Excel
  • Microsoft PowerPoint
  • Microsoft Word
  • Capital Markets Products Skills

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4475451848.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The Executive Director will lead engineering for Fund Administration and Transfer Agency platforms within Securities Services. The role will drive platform strategy, architecture, and execution to build scalable, resilient, and future-ready solutions supporting global investor servicing, operational efficiency, and emerging asset classes including tokenized assets.

Technology Strategy & Architecture

  • Define and execute multi-year technology strategy for Fund Administration and Transfer Agency platforms
  • Architect scalable, modular, API-driven platforms supporting high-volume investor servicing
  • Drive modernization towards event-driven, real-time architectures
  • Establish strong data architecture for investor records, NAV, transactions, and reporting

Platform Delivery & Execution

  • Own end-to-end delivery across fund accounting, transfer agency, and investor servicing
  • Lead large-scale transformation programs with clear execution discipline and outcomes
  • Ensure high availability, resilience, and regulatory compliance
  • Embed engineering best practices including DevSecOps, automation, and testing frameworks

Vendor & Platform Expertise

  • Lead architecture and integration across key industry platforms, including:
  • SS&C Technologies (Geneva, Advent)
  • FIS (InvestOne and related platforms)
  • Temenos (wealth/TA integrations where relevant)
  • Tata Consultancy Services BaNCS (custody/TA modules)
  • Drive the right balance between vendor platforms and in-house builds, minimizing heavy customization

Key Responsibilities

Operating Model Transformation

  • Partner with Operations to design optimized and scalable operating models
  • Leverage automation, data, and AI to reduce manual processing and improve turnaround times
  • Enable straight-through processing across investor lifecycle and fund servicing

Client & Business Alignment

  • Support onboarding of new client segments (institutional, HNI, alternatives)
  • Align technology roadmap to evolving investor needs and regulatory requirements
  • Partner with business to enable product innovation and growth in AUC

Digital Assets & Tokenization

  • Provide strategic direction on tokenization of real-world assets (RWA) and digital-native assets
  • Build readiness for:
  • Tokenized fund administration
  • Transfer agency for tokenized units
  • Integration with digital custody models
  • Enable hybrid platforms supporting traditional + digital assets

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead and scale large engineering teams based in Bangalore, with global delivery responsibility
  • Engage with senior stakeholders across business, operations, risk, and compliance
  • Drive strong collaboration across custody, wealth, and markets businesses
  • Build a culture of ownership, execution excellence, and innovation

Risk Management

  • Proactive in seeking regular assurance that the CIB -FSS are performing to an acceptable risk and control standard.
  • Act quickly and decisively when any risk and control weakness become apparent and ensure they are addressed within an appropriate timeframe and escalated through the relevant committees.
  • As required, act as the risk control owner under the Group’s risk management framework at the appropriate level.
  • Balance business performance delivery and cost management constraints with risk and control matters to ensure that they do not materially threaten the Group’s ability to remain within risk appetite.
  • Engage with local regulators across Europe where required

Governance

  • Attend FSS VAT and Tech Council as required, ensuring compliance with Architecture Principles and adherence to the Architecture Roadmap.
  • Embed the Group’s values and code of conduct in the FM Technology Team to ensure that adherence with the highest standards of ethics and compliance with relevant policies, processes and regulations among employees form part of the culture.
  • Ensure compliance with all salient SCB governance frameworks where there are direct touchpoints with them or any subsequent downstream influence from the FM Technology and In Country teams.
  • Ensure compliance with the highest standards of regulatory and business conduct and compliance practices as defined by internal and external requirements. This includes compliance with local banking laws and anti-money laundering regulations and guidelines.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Lead the Transformation, FM Team to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: FM Code of Conduct
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Keep abreast of local regulatory standards and ensure teams are compliant.

Key stakeholders

  • FSSMT
  • CIB Platform Technology Leadership Team
  • ITO Finance
  • FSS Operations
  • FSS Products
  • CIB architecture /TSA organisation
