Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business: Group Functions Technology

Principal Responsibilities

Software Engineering & Delivery

  • Design, build, and ship production-quality services in line with technology standards, governance, and business controls.
  • Assist with the Design, iteration, and optimisation of prompts for a wide range of LLM use cases—instruction following, structured output generation, classification, summarisation, code generation, and reasoning tasks.
  • Build and manage prompt libraries and versioning strategies, treating prompts as first-class engineering artefacts.
  • Collaborate with product and domain teams to translate business requirements into precise, well-structured prompt specifications.

Agentic AI & LLM Integration

  • Support and drive the implementation, and maintenance of agentic systems—autonomous agents, multi-agent pipelines, tool-use workflows, planning loops, and memory-augmented reasoning.
  • Implement LLM observability (logging, tracing, evaluation pipelines, and guardrails) to maintain quality and reliability in production AI systems.
  • Advise on responsible AI deployment, including output validation, human-in-the-loop design, and risk mitigation for agentic workflows.

Team Leadership, Product/Agile Partnership & Global Engagement

  • Serve as part of the local team engineering leadership, helping set direction, priorities, and delivery standards for the engineering pods within Fincrime Investigations valuestream - with functional and entity management responsibilities.
  • Partner closely with Product Management to clarify value, scope, and success measures; contribute to discovery, solution options, and delivery plans.
  • Work day-to-day with agile delivery partners (e.g., Scrum Masters/Delivery Leads) to maintain a healthy delivery cadence, manage dependencies, and ensure transparent reporting of progress, risks, and blockers.
  • Establish a strong operating rhythm locally (planning, showcases, retros, release readiness), ensuring delivery is predictable and aligned to outcomes.
  • Act as a key bridge between local and global teams, aligning on roadmaps, dependencies, architectural decisions, and delivery milestones across time zones.
  • Represent the local team in relevant global forums (engineering community, architecture reviews, delivery governance, platform/enablement sessions), ensuring local requirements are understood and actioned.
  • Drive effective cross-boundary collaboration: clarify ownership, manage hand-offs, and remove blockers to keep delivery moving at pace.
  • Promote consistent engineering practices across locations—coding standards, SDLC controls, CI/CD patterns, observability, and production readiness—while adapting ways of working to local context.
  • Support incident and resilience processes (on-call/major incident participation where applicable), ensuring clear communications, timely escalation, and robust post-incident learning.
  • Coach and mentor colleagues through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing, raising capability in modern software delivery and applied AI.

Requirements

Full-Stack Engineering

  • Strong proficiency in Java / Spring Boot—REST APIs, event-driven services, security, and performance optimisation.
  • Solid React development skills and API integration.
  • Experience with relational and in-memory databases (PostgreSQL, Redis).
  • Messaging and streaming platforms—Kafka (or equivalent).

Prompt Engineering

  • Demonstrable, hands-on experience engineering prompts for production LLM applications (not just prototypes).
  • Understanding of tokenisation, context limits, temperature tuning, and model-specific behaviours across major LLM providers.
  • Experience structuring prompts for tool/function calling, structured JSON output, and multi-turn conversations.

DevOps & Infrastructure

  • Kubernetes—deployments, services, ingress, Helm, Kustomize, HPA, and RBAC.
  • CI/CD pipelines—GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent.
  • Infrastructure as code—Terraform.
  • Cloud platforms—AWS, AliCloud,GCP, or Azure.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Deputy Operation Manager.

Principal responsibilities

  • The role operates within a HSBC WPB Contact Centre. This is a high profile, highly regulated environment and the role holder must have the ability to react quickly to changing priorities by being flexible, proactive and cooperative at all times.
  • The operating conditions for the role are to meet local needs aligned to global objectives by thinking strategically and working in collaboration and partnership across the group.

Requirements

  • Balancing the needs of all stakeholders fairly and equitably.
  • The nature of the role requires the adherence to highly effective resource management techniques to ensure optimal operational efficiency across a wide variety of processes.
  • Staff retention will be a significant challenge due to the increasingly competitive nature of the Contact Centre related services market and the flat management structures. It is essential that the management team is able to lead and motivate staff with widely differing aspirations working in a high-pressure, productivity-based environment where deadlines are critical. Job satisfaction through rotation is a key requirement to aid retention therefore effective training and resource management is essential. Effective people management skills are essential to run this operation.
  • Effective operational risk management and contingency planning will be crucial in developing a climate of trust and confidence.
  • Flexibility and agility are required to deal with any unexpected problems or incidents.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Build adoption accelerators (Golden Path delivery)
  • Implement and maintain Golden Path templates, reusable patterns, and reference implementations aligned to app.hsbc ways of working.
  • Produce worked examples from real HSBC projects (not toy apps), designed to double as reusable accelerators and adoption “media”.
  • Contribute code, pipelines, and automation that reduce friction in onboarding and repeatable delivery.
  • Self-service onboarding at HSBC scale (no “white glove by default”)
  • Improve self-service onboarding journeys so teams can progress without 1:1 handholding (the org is too large; self-serve must work “from day 1”).
  • Create and maintain onboarding guides, operational guidance, and runbook-style content that helps teams reach production confidently.
  • Help reduce bespoke onboarding by standardising workflows and improving automation.
  • Developer experience advocacy (actionable, not advisory)
  • Participate in feedback channels (office hours, champions networks, Teams/email/in‑app ratings where available).
  • Triage issues and pain points into:

items DevRel can build/fix directly, and

items to be driven to the owning pillar/team with clear acceptance criteria.

  • Track to closure; “Not our team” isn’t a resolution—DevRel ensures the right team is engaged and progress is visible.
  • Documentation as a core deliverable
  • Write and maintain high-quality documentation content for our platform docs including onboarding, how‑tos, troubleshooting, and reference material.
  • Ensure new/updated assets ship with documentation as part of “Definition of Done” and release readiness expectations.
  • Keep content fresh and discoverable; propose improvements to doc structure, navigation, and “time to answer”.
  • Developer enablement and narrative support (delivery-focused)
  • Support internal communications and technical engagement: short talks, show-and-tells, workshops, mob programming sessions.
  • Help maintain clear adoption pathways and migration guidance (in partnership with product/engineering/architecture).
  • Contribute to comms that make developers confident about what exists, what’s coming, and how to get value quickly.

Requirements

  • Proficiency in Java, Kotlin or Node JS
  • Proficient communicator to all levels of seniority
  • Solid understanding of production readiness fundamentals (security, resilience, observability, supportability) sufficient to build credible examples and guidance.
  • Strong hands-on engineering experience delivering production-grade systems. If experience delivering app platforms that would be a plus but not necessary
  • Practical experience improving developer experience via standardisation, automation, and “make the easy thing the right thing”.
  • Comfortable working across teams (product, engineering, architecture, risk/control) to make guidance accurate and usable.

- Proficient communicator to all levels of seniority
- Solid understanding of production readiness fundamentals (security, resilience, observability, supportability) sufficient to build credible examples and guidance.
- Strong hands-on engineering experience delivering production-grade systems. If experience delivering app platforms that would be a plus but not necessary
- Practical experience improving developer experience via standardisation, automation, and “make the easy thing the right thing”.
- Comfortable working across teams (product, engineering, architecture, risk/control) to make guidance accurate and usable.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Deputy Operation Manager.

Principal responsibilities

  • The role operates within a HSBC WPB Contact Centre. This is a high profile, highly regulated environment and the role holder must have the ability to react quickly to changing priorities by being flexible, proactive and cooperative at all times.
  • The operating conditions for the role are to meet local needs aligned to global objectives by thinking strategically and working in collaboration and partnership across the group.

Requirements

  • Balancing the needs of all stakeholders fairly and equitably.
  • The nature of the role requires the adherence to highly effective resource management techniques to ensure optimal operational efficiency across a wide variety of processes.
  • Staff retention will be a significant challenge due to the increasingly competitive nature of the Contact Centre related services market and the flat management structures. It is essential that the management team is able to lead and motivate staff with widely differing aspirations working in a high-pressure, productivity-based environment where deadlines are critical. Job satisfaction through rotation is a key requirement to aid retention therefore effective training and resource management is essential. Effective people management skills are essential to run this operation.
  • Effective operational risk management and contingency planning will be crucial in developing a climate of trust and confidence.
  • Flexibility and agility are required to deal with any unexpected problems or incidents.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

ln:4479517246.descriptionHtml:
CIB - Global Payments Solutions (GPS)

Global Payment Solutions (GPS) is made up of almost 10,000 colleagues across 58 countries and territories. This business is uniquely positioned to help clients make payments across borders, currencies and regulations, quickly and efficiently with dedicated in-country and regional support. Our expertise in this area is repeatedly recognised by the industry’s most prominent publications and associations with numerous global, regional, and country awards.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Basic Job Expectations:

  • Field and resolve complex service inquiries; ensuring timely response and proactive communications until the client’s expectations are met.
  • Proven ability to evaluate options for resolution of complex queries, weigh pros/cons of approaches and escalate challenges when needed.
  • Accountability for client escalations; business-as-usual escalations as well as global service escalations, inquiries and/or projects. Coordinate remediation of issues and the communication to clients/internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor client case type/activity to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement. Proactively identify risks and issues as part of complex query oversight.
  • Oversee local client-initiated projects; facilitate local completion of global client-initiated projects.
  • Engage with Global counterparts for maintenance request, client queries and escalations.
  • Identify and action red flags before they become client-identified issues.
  • Develop and maintain internal and external contact list.

Customer Engagement

  • Analyse client inquiry activity (case types) and interface with their clients to identify opportunities to:
    • Reduce service case volumes and drive digital adoption.
    • Efficient use of existing/new products
    • Improve time to service.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Experience in working within a fast-paced service-oriented environment with continually changing priorities. The incumbent must have 3-5 years of relevant experience.
  • Analytical mindset and a desire to solve problems for others.
  • Desire to identify and meet customer needs through matching a broad range of products and services.
  • Time management and organization skills with the ability to manage multiple time sensitive tasks.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills with experience in interacting cross functional lines and building relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Empathy.
  • Experience of working in an International Global Banking environment
  • Knowledge of day-to-day workings of a Corporate Treasury environment, foreign exchange, intercompany loans, payroll, and payments.
  • Basic knowledge of HSBC Group companies and product ranges.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4478443290.descriptionHtml:
Key Responsibilities

Processes

  • Manage and/or resolve alerts/cases.
  • Follow the Screening DOI to process risk events in line with Assess, Analyse, Act (AAA) process.
  • Do further analysis and escalations using knowledge about complex products

People & Talent

  • Promote and embed a culture of openness, trust and risk awareness, where ethical, legal, regulatory and policy compliant conduct is the norm.

Risk Management

  • Analyse significant financial crime risk events (e.g. non-compliant transactions, production orders) to ensure that all connected parties, particularly cross-border are identified and reported at the appropriate levels internally across all relevant jurisdictions.
  • Apply Group and FCC policies and processes (AML surveillance, client screening, risk assessment) to manage risks.

Governance

  • In the event of serious regulatory breaches, or where risk tolerances have been breached, ensure senior management are informed and that actions are taken quickly to remediate and/or activities are ceased.
  • Support all control checks undertaken by FCC under the Operational Risk Framework (ORF).

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholders

  • China FCC Controls representatives in group and country.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in FCSO.
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

Skills And Experience

  • Compliance Policies and Standards
  • Compliance Advisory
  • Surveillance (Screening)
  • Compliance Risk Assessment

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree and above
  • Languages: English, Mandarin

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4478446128.descriptionHtml:
Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • To achieve business objectives and sales target through outbound and inbound calls customer contacts.

Business

  • To handle sales-related enquiries during the outbound activities
  • To handle sales-related enquiries during the inbound call
  • To handle in-bank cross team referral

Processes

  • To obtain documents from customers and ensure its relevancy according to credit policy
  • To explain product features / charges to customers
  • To negotiate “count-offer” with customers and handle objections on pricing, approved loan amounts and tenors etc.
  • To confirm drawdown details with customers
  • To handle customer complaints
  • To provide customer centric financial advice and to offer tailor-made customer solutions

People & Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and ensure all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for the roles

Risk Management

  • To comply with the control requirements in the Procedures Manual relevant to respective job responsibilities in Unsecured Lending Centre.
  • To comply with all applicable money laundering prevention procedures and, in particular, report any suspicious activity to the Unit Money Laundering Prevention Officer and line manager
  • To comply with all relevant policies and procedures covering regulatory, local and group requirements.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Lead the CCPL Sales, Hong Kong to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: [Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.]
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Product Team
  • Sales Support Team
  • Operation Team
  • Branches
  • Clients

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in CCPL Sales, Hong Kong; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats);
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求.
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities 根据本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控.
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力.
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任.
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Skills And Experience

  • Leadership Competencies
  • Spot Opportunities
  • Solve Problems
  • Take the Lead
  • Build Resilience
  • Collaborate
  • Communicate
  • Deliver Sustainably
  • Achieve Results
  • Technical Competencies
  • Manage Conduct
  • Manage Risk
  • Manage People

Qualifications

  • 大专以上学历；
  • 流利的广东话，基本的英语读写能力；
  • 良好的沟通技巧，能理解客戶的需求；
  • 具备客户服务或销售工作经验优先；
  • 积极向上，能承受工作压力；
  • 勇于接受挑战完成公司销售业务指标；
  • 工作細心並具备团队合作精神；

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

ln:4478444179.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • Conduct investigations into concerns allegations or risk events involving criminal conduct, dishonesty or deliberate breaches of policies or regulations.
  • Ensure investigations align with relevant laws, regulations, and Group standards, including escalation, case management, data capture, evidence management, electronic evidence review, reporting, interviewing, and attending internal disciplinary panels.
  • Prioritize multiple investigations, tasks, projects, and responsibilities while maintaining positive stakeholder relationships.
  • Keep relevant stakeholders and appropriate senior management informed of relevant investigative developments.
  • Assist in regulatory and government investigations, including data source identification and extraction.
  • Develop and disseminate data analytics, providing relevant management information to stakeholders.
  • Maintain relationships with law enforcement and coordinate the provision of responses to search warrants, local production orders, court orders, request for information from regulators or law enforcement agencies, and attend Court as required.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • To manage the conduct of appropriate investigations in order to minimise financial losses, reputational and regulatory risks, and operational risk events involving criminal conduct, dishonesty or deliberate breaches of policies or regulations.

Business

  • Provide reports and other Management Information in agreed and standardised format.
  • Coordinate identification of themes, trends and lessons learnt from investigations in China to support the continuous improvement of the Bank’s conduct and control environment.

Processes

  • Conduct and manage non-government investigations against the Bank and/or with employees that have potential material impact on the Bank from either a reputational, regulatory, financial or litigation perspective (or any combination of the same).
  • As required, investigate data leakage cases escalated for China and assist in promoting awareness of the importance of confidentiality of bank information. Support management and promote Speaking Up in country with assistance from Regional investigative team.
  • Adopt a flexible approach in supporting other areas within the Group Investigations structure (and in seeking inbound support when necessary) to promote effective and efficient allocation of investigative resources.

People & Talent

  • Establish, develop and maintain close collaboration with key internal functional stakeholders. including Legal, Compliance, Audit, Risk, FCC and HR, to fully embed the Group Investigations framework including the formalisation of policies, procedures, processes and controls.

Risk Management

  • Maintain close interaction with those Risk Owners to whom responsibility is delegated to ensure resolution of system and control improvements identified through the Group Investigations process. Ensure Head, Shared Investigative Services, China, is fully informed of all key risks and issues in area of responsibility and reported in line with Bank’s operational risk process.

Governance

  • Reinforce an effective and exemplary risk and control culture and further strengthen the control environment.
  • Act to minimise operational loss and audit failures and take proactive measures to respond to matters arising.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholders

  • Business and function representatives
  • HR
  • Compliance
  • Legal
  • Financial Crime Compliance
  • Audit
  • Risk

Skills And Experience

  • Interview
  • Investigation

Qualifications

Required

  • 8-10 years investigative, compliance, intelligence, consulting or audit experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to run end-to-end investigations, audits or relevant reviews.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Relevant degree holder, or comparable experience.
  • Native speaker fluency in Mandarin.
  • Business proficient English language speaking and writing skills.
  • Excellent judgement. Excellent collaborative and team playing skills. Diplomacy, empathy and a ‘can-do attitude’. Politeness, sensitivity and the ability to gently, but professionally stand your ground when needed.
  • An inquisitive approach to practices, procedures and specific transactions. Personal authority and integrity. Independence, creativity, resourcefulness and resilience.
  • Must possess ability to assess risk, strong leadership qualities, excellent interpersonal skills and multi-cultural awareness and sensitivity.

Desirable

  • Knowledge of banking systems.
  • Knowledge of law enforcement practices.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4479700655.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Job Responsibility

Ensure that risk exposure is minimized by relevant controls. Perform the 2nd level of control using appropriate tools.

  • Monitor and track an exhaustive list of risks alerts that might impact company's financial situation and image.
  • Verify regularly evolution of portfolios: consistency of the performances with regard to the portfolios management targets, to the market fluctuations, to the liquidity constraints, etc and be attentive to any poor performance with regards to the portfolio management targets.
  • Make sure the fast corrective measures are taken in case of risk or in case of breaches.

Communicate and Reporting

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with business front lines.
  • Participate to the production of independent and exhaustive assessment of investment risk and counterparty risk issues. Guarantee the reliability and the exhaustiveness of the risk reports that he or she sends to his or her management.
  • Recommend improvement measures concerning risks to the management.
  • Follow-up corrective action plan and information to his or her risk hierarchy of implementation progresses. Inform immediately the management of any worrisome issue.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related discipline
  • Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in risk or credit analysis
  • Strong quantitative ability in analyzing and interpreting financial statements
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication in English, required to collaborate effectively with local teams and global stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented, deadline-driven, and self-motivated
  • Ability to work proactively and independently, as well as in a team environment

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

ln:4478485053.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • Provide subject matter expertise and drive initiatives and enhancements across the Custody Operations environment.
  • Partner with Technology, Product, Client Implementations and the Business to deliver robust, stable and scalable solutions, including client implementations, technology deployments and regulatory/mandatory changes.
  • Bridge business requirements and technical delivery through requirements documentation, solution communication, testing/implementation coordination and operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery, Solution & Change

  • Produce/review BRDs and FRDs / User Stories; coordinate and/or perform UAT and coordinate implementation of new developments.
  • Work with technology and product colleagues to develop robust, stable and scalable solutions; ensure solutions are appropriately documented and communicated to impacted parties.
  • Assist Operations with release planning, execution and post-implementation review, and ensure core Operations staff readiness for implementation.
  • Participate in Operations Readiness / Transformation activities to collaborate, innovate, identify synergies and improve the business.
  • Manage relationships with Product, Technology, Risk and other internal stakeholders to ensure operational constraints, risks and needs are understood and addressed in a controlled risk environment.
  • Engage in Product Reviews and new/prospective deal review discussions to assess operational impact.
  • Adapt to evolving business requirements and changing circumstances, using change as an opportunity to improve service.
  • Provide leadership and ownership in seeking solutions during crisis situations; manage to tight deadlines and budget commitments.
  • Keep abreast of regulatory and industry changes and assess their impact on clients and operational teams.
  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct; identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters collaboratively.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Java / J2EE
  • Hadoop, Spark and Scala
  • SQL, NoSQL, HBase and Hive

Other Skills

  • Kafka and Messaging Integration
  • DevOps: Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes and Rundeck
  • Business Analysis, BRD/FRD and User Stories
  • Custody Operations and Trade Settlement

Motivations

  • Solving complex operational and technology problems and improving services through collaboration, innovation and transformation.
  • Delivering robust, stable and scalable solutions while working to tight deadlines in a controlled risk environment.
  • Building trusted partnerships with clients, senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, with a strong client-service orientation.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • 6+ years of development experience on Hadoop platforms.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant Custody Operations, Business Analysis or Project Management experience, and/or proven large-team leadership experience in a dynamic regional environment.
  • Experience producing or reviewing BRDs, FRDs and user stories; coordinating or performing UAT; and implementing new developments.
  • Experience with release planning, execution and post-implementation review.
  • Experience establishing trust with clients and senior leaders and leading cost-saving and/or risk-mitigation initiatives.

Certifications / Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Information Technology Engineering or a closely related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Postgraduate qualification in any specialisation is identified as applicable in the source job description.
  • No mandatory professional certification or licence is specified in the source job description.

Languages

  • No specific language is stated in the source job description. Excellent communication skills are required, including the ability to understand business requirements and explain them to technical solution teams.

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

ln:4478813301.descriptionHtml:
The Cash & Trade Proc Intmd Analyst is an intermediate level role responsible for ensuring transactions are processed accurately and on time in coordination with the Transaction Services team. The overall objective is to research, conduct analyses, and resolve issues.

Responsibilities:

  • Create customized transaction services reports based on data analysis
  • Monitor and research errors to ensure adherence to audit and control policies
  • Resolve transaction services issues and use technical expertise/ judgment to conduct complex analysis
  • Anticipate and respond to requests for transaction deliverables from internal and external clients and vendors
  • Develop and recommend strategic decisions based off in-depth comprehension of how the Cash & Trade operations team interacts with others business unites in accomplishing objectives
  • Assist with providing informal guidance or on-the-job-training to new team members as required
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

  • 2-5 years of experience in a related role within trade / cash operations management
  • Effective verbal and written skills
  • Effective communication and analytical skills
  • Effective relationship management skills
  • Expert level proficiency in Windows, MS Project, and MS Office Suite

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

ln:4478840273.descriptionHtml:
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments and individuals from more than 747 offices in 42 countries. As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values based on integrity, excellence and giving back. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.

Morgan Stanley established a new Futures Brokerage business with location in Beijing. The entity trades in commodity futures products as listed in the China exchanges.

What You’ll Do In The Role

  • Manage trading system limits and their changes. The BCU role will own and administer all control parameters (single-order size, day-trading limits and position limits) and process changes as exchanges adjust rules.
  • Manage trading limits and client trading risk controls, including abnormal-trading rule controls, e.g., self-trade / self-crossing, frequent placement and cancellation of orders, and placement and cancellation of large orders.
  • Provide onshore advisory BCU support to MSFC, including serving as an independent risk management check within the 1LOD.
  • Oversee day-to-day and long-term trading system changes in respect to minimizing operational risks.
  • Engage with regulators during inquiries and inspections.

What You'll Bring To The Role

  • Certification of Futures Practitioner from China Futures Association and familiar with relevant laws and regulatory requirements on PRC futures business in PRC.
  • The preferred candidate will have 8+ years of experience in risk, controls, or front-office aligned roles.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment and exercise sound judgment and demonstrated ownership mindset, with ability to manage responsibilities independently and drive outcomes
  • An understanding of and strong focus on the mechanics of a control environment, with ability to identify and escalate issues effectively and appropriately.
  • Strong project management skills, including managing competing priorities, influencing senior stakeholders, and delivering sustainable outcomes across functions and regions.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across varying level of seniority
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask between various ad-hoc queries, projects, and daily business activities and highly self-motivated, with a desire to help improve processes and work together in a team
  • Fluent in Chinese Mandarin and English with solid written and verbal communication skills.

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please visit https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

About DBS Bank

DBS is a leading financial services group in Asia, committed to making banking joyful and impactful for customers. We are transforming the future of banking through innovation and technology, empowering individuals and businesses to thrive in the digital economy.

About the Team:

The Global Financial Markets (GFM) team is at the forefront of driving innovation within financial markets. We are seeking a skilled java developer to drive the development in front office technology. This role requires deep technical expertise, strong domain knowledge in trading system. You will collaborate closely with trading desks, quants, and technology teams to ensure our systems are cutting-edge, resilient, and high performing.

Job Responsibilities:

As an Application Developer within Global Financial Markets, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and implementing innovative software solutions. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Software Development: Development of high-performance, low-latency trading systems.
  • System Performance & Resilience: Drive optimizations for latency, scalability, and fault tolerance.
  • DevOps and CI/CD: Implementing and maintaining Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to automate software delivery processes, ensuring efficient and reliable deployments.
  • Collaboration: Partner with traders, quantitative analysts, and infrastructure teams to enhance system capabilities.

Requirements:

  • Experience: 1-5 years for Associate and 5-8 years for Sr Associate
  • Technical Expertise: Proficiency in Java for high-performance systems.
  • Market Knowledge: Understanding order management, and risk management.
  • Performance Optimization: Experience in low-latency architectures, multithreading, and high-throughput systems.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with cloud platforms, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Education: Bachelor's/Master’s degree in CS, Engineering, or related field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior professional experience in FinTech, top-tier brokerages, investment banks, or quantitative hedge funds.

Location:

Guangzhou (DTC)

Job:

Technology

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

  • Lead the engineering design and delivery of technology solutions aligned to business strategy, architecture standards, and engineering principles.

  • Provide mentorship, coaching, and performance support to engineers and junior leaders, building capability and a strong engineering culture.
  • Ensure quality deliverables are produced on time and within budget, with clear accountability for outcomes.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities to improve client experience, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Support department objectives and strategic initiatives as required.

  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken), with the ability to influence and align senior stakeholders.

  • Strong domain knowledge in investment products, including funds, discretionary/managed portfolios, alternatives, and related services.
  • Experience working in a global set-up across time zones with distributed, multicultural teams.
  • Strong ownership mindset with clear accountability for engineering outcomes, delivery quality, and risk/control adherence.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Significant experience in a PMO, programme management, project management or portfolio management environment.
  • Experience supporting complex, large-scale technology or transformation programmes.
  • Strong understanding of programme governance, planning, RAID management, financial control and management reporting.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders across multiple functions, locations or business areas.
  • Demonstrable experience analysing complex information and presenting clear recommendations.
  • Experience managing competing priorities in a fast-paced and changing environment.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with project, portfolio or reporting tools is desirable.
  • Experience in financial services, banking or a highly regulated environment is desirable.
  • Relevant professional qualification, such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, MoP, P3O or equivalent, is desirable.

Requirements

Programme and Portfolio Governance

  • Establish and maintain appropriate governance structures, controls and reporting routines for programmes and portfolios.
  • Coordinate programme governance forums, including preparation of agendas, papers, minutes, actions and decision logs.
  • Ensure that programme documentation is complete, current and aligned with HSBC standards.
  • Monitor adherence to agreed delivery methodology, governance requirements and control frameworks.
  • Support the preparation of executive-level updates and portfolio reviews.

Planning and Delivery Management

  • Maintain integrated programme plans, milestones, dependencies and critical paths.
  • Track delivery progress against scope, schedule, budget, benefits and quality objectives.
  • Identify slippage, delivery risks and cross-team dependencies, escalating matters through the appropriate channels.
  • Coordinate planning activities across technology, business, operations, risk, finance and other control functions.
  • Support programme mobilisation, delivery transitions, closure and lessons-learned activities.

Risk, Issue and Dependency Management

  • Maintain programme-level RAID logs covering risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies.
  • Facilitate regular reviews with workstream leads and ensure actions have clear owners and due dates.
  • Assess the potential impact of risks and issues on delivery, customers, colleagues, controls and regulatory commitments.
  • Escalate material concerns in a timely and concise manner, with practical recommendations.
  • Track mitigation plans through to completion and challenge overdue or ineffective actions.

Financial and Resource Management

  • Support budget planning, forecasting, tracking and variance analysis.
  • Monitor vendor, supplier and external resource costs where applicable.
  • Coordinate resource planning across workstreams and identify capacity or capability gaps.
  • Provide accurate financial and resource information for governance meetings and management decisions.
  • Work with Finance and delivery leads to ensure that financial data is timely, complete and appropriately evidenced.

Management Information and Reporting

  • Produce clear, accurate and insightful status reports for senior stakeholders.
  • Consolidate data from multiple workstreams and validate key information before publication.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, KPIs and delivery metrics.
  • Highlight trends, exceptions and emerging concerns rather than simply reporting activity.
  • Ensure reporting is tailored to the audience, from detailed working-level information to concise executive summaries.

Stakeholder and Team Collaboration

  • Build effective relationships with senior stakeholders and delivery teams across business and technology functions.
  • Coordinate cross-boundary activities and promote consistent ways of working.
  • Facilitate workshops and working sessions to resolve planning, governance and delivery matters.
  • Provide guidance and coaching to PMO analysts and less experienced colleagues.
  • Encourage constructive challenge, transparency and shared accountability across the programme.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design robust, resilient and scalable IT solutions and lead full stack engineers to develop and implement IT solutions to meet business users’ requirements.
  • Continuously enhance and transform the system to improve system observability, stability and scalability.
  • Establish best practices, guardrails, and standards for safe and effective engineering across the technology estate.

  • Keep up to date and have expertise on current tools, technologies and areas like cyber security and regulations pertaining to aspects like data privacy, consent, data residency etc. that are applicable.

  • Deep hands-on knowledge of container technology Kubernetes/Docker, including deployment behavior, failure handling, scaling, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems (spark or equivalent),failure modes, system recovery, and service resilience patterns.
  • Practical delivery and DevOps capability: hands-on with CI/CD and automation tools such as Jenkins and Ansible, plus Agile toolsets including Jira, Confluence, and GitHub.
  • Proven leadership in execution: experience leading developers and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, sustainable changes that measurably improve business outcomes.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management: fluent spoken and written English, strong documentation, with the ability to influence across engineering teams and key stakeholders
  • Demonstrated resilience mindset, with a strong focus on proactive risk reduction and continuous improvement.

ln:4479814820.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Product Director, Document Intelligence

Role Purpose

The Product Director, Document Intelligence will own the strategy, roadmap and outcomes for HSBC’s enterprise Document Intelligence proposition. The role will establish a coherent, reusable set of capabilities that enables value streams to ingest, understand and act on information contained in documents at scale.

Reporting to the Group Head of Product, Enterprise AI Tooling & Digital Experience, the role will work closely with Group AI Platform and value-stream teams to shape a broader enterprise proposition spanning Document Studio and other document-processing capabilities. It will create one strategic destination for common capabilities, reducing duplication while preserving flexibility for genuinely specialised business requirements.

The Product Director will actively promote the Document Intelligence platforms, build and own the prioritisation of a pipeline of high-value, document-heavy use cases, and lead value streams from discovery through onboarding and scaled adoption using clear self-service, co-build and higher-touch delivery paths.

The role will ensure the proposition can deliver the accuracy, resilience, capacity and economics required at Group scale, with transparent measures of performance, consumption and value enablement. Value streams will remain accountable for realised business and financial outcomes.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Product strategy and roadmap — Define the vision, target experience and sequenced roadmap for enterprise Document Intelligence, balancing business priorities, reusable capabilities, platform maturity, dependencies and economics.
  • Demand, prioritisation and engagement — Promote the platforms, build and own a transparent pipeline of high-value use cases, and establish a single intake process that assesses value, reuse potential, capability fit, complexity, controls and effort before routing demand through self-service, co-build or higher-touch delivery.
  • Workflow transformation and adoption — Partner with value streams to define the problem, baseline and value hypothesis; validate feasibility early; redesign end-to-end workflows; and embed solutions into live journeys with the controls, integration, communications, training and change needed for sustained adoption.
  • Reusable capabilities and ecosystem integration — Prioritise reusable document capabilities and ensure they are consumable through appropriate interfaces, APIs and integrations with Group AI Platform, model services, RAG and knowledge capabilities, Agent Hub, orchestration and downstream systems.
  • Portfolio convergence and operating model — Set clear boundaries and decision rights between the enterprise platform and value streams; lead evidence-based reuse, co-build, extend or retire decisions; and enable approved services and reusable innovations to be consumed or contributed without creating parallel platforms.
  • Quality, controls and continuous improvement — Set evaluation and acceptance criteria across accuracy, latency, resilience, cost and user outcomes; embed human review and feedback loops; and ensure privacy, security, records, model risk, explainability, accessibility, auditability and responsible AI requirements are built into the product lifecycle.
  • Scale, performance and value — Ensure the proposition delivers the capacity, accuracy, resilience and economics required at Group scale; monitor service, quality, consumption and unit economics; and provide value streams with evidence to assess benefits while they retain accountability for realised outcomes.
  • Cross-functional leadership — Align business, operations, product, engineering, architecture, AI and control teams; resolve trade-offs and ambiguity; and maintain momentum from discovery through scaled adoption.

Qualifications

Experience

Essential

  • Significant product leadership experience owning an enterprise AI, data, automation, document-processing or workflow platform from strategy through scaled adoption and measurable value.
  • Demonstrated success engaging business and value-stream teams to identify, shape, prioritise and onboard high-value use cases through clear intake, self-service, co-build and higher-touch delivery paths.
  • Strong understanding of intelligent document processing, including ingestion, OCR, classification, extraction, configuration, evaluation, human review and downstream workflow integration.
  • Solid knowledge of, and product experience in, applying AI to automate end-to-end document processing, including large language models (LLMs), intelligent OCR, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agentic document-processing workflows.
  • Demonstrated success redesigning document-heavy journeys and translating user and process insight into reusable capabilities, roadmaps and sustained adoption.
  • Experience leading platform convergence across internal and third-party capabilities, including disciplined reuse, build, buy, extend and retire decisions.
  • Technical and architectural credibility across APIs, orchestration, model and prompt lifecycle, evaluation, observability, release controls and integrations.
  • Experience delivering in a large, regulated organisation, embedding privacy, security, records, auditability, responsible AI and human accountability.
  • Commercial and analytical acumen across investment cases, consumption economics, baselining, benefits attribution and outcome measurement.
  • Proven ability to align senior business, operations, product and technology stakeholders across geographies through influence.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience launching or scaling Document Intelligence, intelligent document processing, OCR or AI-enabled operations across a large enterprise.
  • Experience with document-heavy banking or regulated workflows, such as onboarding, KYC, underwriting, payments, trade, legal, audit or operations.
  • Experience designing federated platform models that balance enterprise reuse with value-stream autonomy.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn rapidly and stay current with emerging industry trends, technologies and market developments in intelligent document processing
  • Experience establishing quality frameworks covering accuracy, precision and recall, human review, feedback loops and continuous learning.

Essential Capabilities

Strategic Mindset and Innovation: Defines a coherent enterprise strategy and sequences capability and use-case investment toward measurable outcomes.

Customer and Value-Stream Focus: Turns operational pain points and user needs into priority solutions, sustained adoption and durable partnerships.

Commercial and Outcome Orientation: Directs investment toward reusable capabilities with the strongest evidence of enterprise value and transparent performance and consumption economics.

Manages Complexity and Ambiguity: Distinguishes reusable platform needs from business-specific requirements and makes transparent trade-offs.

Collaborates and Persuades: Builds alignment across platform and value-stream teams and resolves ownership and convergence decisions with evidence.

Action Oriented and Accountable: Moves rapidly from discovery to delivery and holds teams accountable for quality, controls, adoption and value.

Builds Effective Teams: Creates a strong multidisciplinary culture with clear roles and decision rights.

Drives Vision and Purpose: Builds commitment to one coherent Document Intelligence proposition that accelerates delivery without duplicating common capabilities.

- Strong understanding of intelligent document processing, including ingestion, OCR, classification, extraction, configuration, evaluation, human review and downstream workflow integration.
- Solid knowledge of, and product experience in, applying AI to automate end-to-end document processing, including large language models (LLMs), intelligent OCR, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agentic document-processing workflows.
- Demonstrated success redesigning document-heavy journeys and translating user and process insight into reusable capabilities, roadmaps and sustained adoption.
- Experience leading platform convergence across internal and third-party capabilities, including disciplined reuse, build, buy, extend and retire decisions.
- Technical and architectural credibility across APIs, orchestration, model and prompt lifecycle, evaluation, observability, release controls and integrations.
- Experience delivering in a large, regulated organisation, embedding privacy, security, records, auditability, responsible AI and human accountability.
- Commercial and analytical acumen across investment cases, consumption economics, baselining, benefits attribution and outcome measurement.
- Proven ability to align senior business, operations, product and technology stakeholders across geographies through influence.
Strongly Preferred
- Experience launching or scaling Document Intelligence, intelligent document processing, OCR or AI-enabled operations across a large enterprise.
- Experience with document-heavy banking or regulated workflows, such as onboarding, KYC, underwriting, payments, trade, legal, audit or operations.
- Experience designing federated platform models that balance enterprise reuse with value-stream autonomy.
- Demonstrated ability to learn rapidly and stay current with emerging industry trends, technologies and market developments in intelligent document processing
- Experience establishing quality frameworks covering accuracy, precision and recall, human review, feedback loops and continuous learning.
Essential Capabilities
Strategic Mindset and Innovation: Defines a coherent enterprise strategy and sequences capability and use-case investment toward measurable outcomes.
Customer and Value-Stream Focus: Turns operational pain points and user needs into priority solutions, sustained adoption and durable partnerships.
Commercial and Outcome Orientation: Directs investment toward reusable capabilities with the strongest evidence of enterprise value and transparent performance and consumption economics.
Manages Complexity and Ambiguity: Distinguishes reusable platform needs from business-specific requirements and makes transparent trade-offs.
Collaborates and Persuades: Builds alignment across platform and value-stream teams and resolves ownership and convergence decisions with evidence.
Action Oriented and Accountable: Moves rapidly from discovery to delivery and holds teams accountable for quality, controls, adoption and value.
Builds Effective Teams: Creates a strong multidisciplinary culture with clear roles and decision rights.
Drives Vision and Purpose: Builds commitment to one coherent Document Intelligence proposition that accelerates delivery without duplicating common capabilities.

IWPB Chief Operating Office (IWPB COO)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking, we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra-high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers look after their day-to-day finances and manage, protect and grow their wealth. The International Wealth and Premier Banking Chief Operating Office supports the business to deliver exceptional customer journeys and increase efficiency across our global network. We support the business through effective governance, financial and risk management, transformation, and operational management, ensuring that all International Wealth and Premier Banking business units and markets have the right capabilities and procedures to compete effectively and grow safely. We work in an agile manner and at pace, partnering with teams in Technology and Digital Business Services to bring innovative, digital-first solutions to our customers.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • 负责监督财富产品的日常交易、登记与结算操作及监管报表工作，确保其准确性与合规性
  • 在直线经理的指导下，担任团队内部项目的主要联系人，参与/协调团队成员完成项目实施和系统上线等安排
  • 确保监管报表报送的及时性、准确性、完整性、合规性。遵守各监管机构发布的相关统计及会计政策和条例。准确及时完成统计资料归档。
  • 通过实际工作经验积累以及培训或教育背景补充，具备在特定专业领域或职能方面扎实的能力。
  • 严格遵守集团的各项规章制度和合规政策，时刻保持对合规风险/操作风险的高度警惕，防范并降低该类风险的发生

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

所需知识：

  • 丰富的银行运营操作知识
  • 理财产品相关知识
  • 相关合规与监管要求

所需技能：

  • 问题解决能力
  • 能够激励团队士气，以应对在时间压力下高业务量的工作
  • 良好的英语听说读写能力
  • 优秀的沟通能力

主要挑战：

  • 在有限时间内处理多个复杂客户指令；
  • 协调团队成员，以达到高标准的服务质量和工作效率；
  • 在资源有限的情况下，承受工作压力并保持高效运作。

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
