ln:4480504821.descriptionHtml:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the architectural design, technical direction planning, and implementation of systems related to China Local Regulatory Reporting (CNLRR).
  • Ensure system designs adhere to best practices in security, scalability, performance, and throughput, meeting the stringent requirements of Chinese financial regulatory bodies.
  • Actively promote and implement DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and modern software delivery practices within the China Regulatory Reporting projects.
  • Lead the engineering team through all phases of software delivery: design, development, testing, deployment, and support, ensuring projects are completed on time and to a high quality.
  • Translate business requirements and reporting mandates from Chinese regulatory authorities into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
  • Mentor junior engineers and foster a high-performance engineering culture, enhancing the overall technical capabilities of the team.
  • Collaborate closely with internal audit, compliance, and risk management teams to ensure all systems and processes comply with regulations from Chinese regulatory bodies (e.g., PBOC, CBIRC, SAFE).

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in a team management or technical leadership role.
  • Strong programming skills, proficient in Java, Rest APIs, and microservices architecture.
  • Experience in handling large-scale data, batch processing, and real-time data streams; a deep understanding of data warehousing and data lake technologies is a plus.
  • Experience with cloud-native platforms (e.g., Kubernetes) is a plus.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • In-depth knowledge and practical experience in the financial industry, especially regarding China's financial market regulatory reporting (e.g., YBT, EAST, 1104 Client, RCPMIS, AML 300).
  • Proven experience building low-latency, high-throughput platforms in a financial institution or FinTech company.
  • Experience in liaising with Chinese regulatory bodies or participating in the development of regulatory reporting systems is a plus.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or machine learning to optimize report generation or data quality.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems, high-availability architecture, and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Experience with project management or Agile development practices (Scrum/Kanban).

Location:

Guangzhou (DTC)

Job:

Technology

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

我们正在寻找充满激情、热爱创新、具备扎实技术功底的年轻科技人才加入我们的技术创新及数字化转型之旅。本次招募涵盖组织及机构银行科技部、财富管理科技部、环球金融市场科技部、中台科技部、新兴科技部、核心银行科技部等6个部门，招聘职级从Analyst 到Associate，面向2-5年开发经验的科技人才。

在星展科技，您将参与负责核心业务系统的设计、开发与交付；编写高质量代码，参与代码评审与自动化部署；协同跨国跨团队推进业务落地，保障系统的高可用与稳定性。

开放岗位方向：

  • Java Developer（后端开发工程师）
  • React/Angular Developer（前端开发工程师）
  • Full Stack Developer（全栈开发工程师）
  • Data Developer（数据开发工程师）

具体岗位职责和要求

  • Java Developer（后端开发工程师）

岗位职责：

  • 负责基于 Java (Spring Boot / Spring Cloud) 的核心业务微服务与高性能 API 的设计与研发。
  • 参与系统架构演进、微服务治理与稳定性建设，保障线上系统的高可用与高吞吐。
  • 负责业务数据模型设计与存储层优化，持续攻坚性能瓶颈与复杂工程问题。

任职要求：

  • 计算机相关专业本科及以上，具备扎实的数据结构与算法功底及良好的复杂度分析能力。
  • 扎实的 Java 核心功底，理解并发编程与底层机制；熟练掌握 Spring 微服务技术栈与契约化 API 设计。
  • 深入掌握 MySQL / PostgreSQL 等关系型数据库，具备严谨的数据建模能力与深度 SQL 调优经验。
  • React/Angular Developer（前端开发工程师） 岗位职责：
  • 负责使用 React 或 Angular 构建高性能、响应式的现代化 Web 应用与客户交互平台。
  • 将 UI/UX 设计转化为高质量、可复用的前端组件，并与设计师，后端 API 进行安全对接。

岗位要求：

  • 精通 HTML5、CSS3 及现代 JavaScript (ES6+/TypeScript)。
  • 熟练掌握主流前端框架：React.js（Hooks/Redux）或 Angular (RxJS/NgRx），熟悉前端工程化工具 ( Webpack, Vite, Git, npm)。
  • 持续优化前端页面加载性能，渲染速度，内存占用及用户交互体验。
  • Full Stack Developer（全栈开发工程师）

岗位职责：

  • 负责端到端的应用开发，兼顾后端微服务（Java / Spring Boot / Spring Cloud）与前端交互界面（Rea面（React/Angular）的实现。
  • 统筹前后端联调、接口设计及系统集成测试。

岗位要求：

  • 具备全栈开发能力，熟练掌握后端（Java & Spring Boot）及前端（如 React / Angular）主流技术，至少一项达到中级标准。
  • 具备良好的系统架构思维，能够独立负责模块的端到端交付。
  • Data Developer（数据开发工程师）

岗位职责：

  • 负责数据平台的设计、开发与架构实现。
  • 使用 Java,Scala,Python + Spark进行数据处理服务、管道及底层平台的开发
  • 构建高效的数据清洗、转换和加载（ETL）流程，保障海量数据吞吐与存储性能。

岗位要求：

  • 熟练掌握 Java,Scala,Python编程开发，具备良好的后端或数据服务开发能力
  • 扎实的 SQL 基础及数据处理经验，熟悉主流数据库,大数据平台(Hadoop Ecosystem),大数据计算引擎(Spark)。

我们期待这样的您：

  • 统招本科及以上学历，计算机相关专业优先。
  • 有2-5年在互联网IT或金融科技领域相关开发经验。
  • 对技术充满热情，勇于应对快节奏环境下的技术挑战。
  • 具备优秀的沟通协作能力、问题解决能力和中英文沟通能力。
  • 认同星展的“PRIDE!”核心价值观（Purpose-driven, Relationship-led, Innovative, Decisive, Everything with fun）。

Guangzhou (DTC)

ln:4480543048.descriptionHtml:
Ready to evolve HPS from chat to agentic productivity at global scale?

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Role

This Director level role oversees the engineering organisation for HSBC Productivity Suite (HPS) - a portfolio of AI-enabled productivity solutions used by colleagues across the bank. You’ll own delivery, operational performance and the technical evolution of HPS including the transition from a primarily chat-based solution towards more agentic and autonomous capabilities. The role covers around 50 engineers across the UK, China, India and Poland with around 6-7 team leads reporting directly. Working in partnership with Product and the wider Technology organisation you’ll translate roadmap priorities into secure, scalable and well controlled production outcomes. Success means valuable personal-agent capabilities delivered for colleagues alongside stronger engineering pace, quality and operational performance in a regulated environment.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Oversee delivery of the HPS engineering roadmap in partnership with Product and wider Technology
  • Steer the transition of HPS towards personal-agent and agentic AI capabilities
  • Set technical direction across applications, AI and Agentic AI, platforms, architecture, data, APIs and developer tooling
  • Deliver secure, scalable, reliable and resilient production systems with strong support, monitoring and incident management
  • Embed engineering practices across design, testing, automation, DevSecOps and observability to improve pace and quality while managing cost
  • Maintain robust technology, privacy, model-risk, cyber, compliance and operational controls
  • Build and sustain an inclusive global engineering organisation across the UK, China, India and Poland including team structure and ways of working
  • Develop technical talent through coaching, role modelling and clear expectations for engineering standards and delivery outcomes
  • Make technology choices that remain relevant as the AI landscape evolves balancing innovation with responsible AI and production standards

What We're Looking For

  • Bring substantial hands-on software engineering experience turning concepts into enterprise-grade products
  • Show proven experience delivering and operating large-scale AI-enabled production systems including GenAI applications
  • Demonstrate expertise in LLM-based applications, personal agents, agentic workflows and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Apply practical experience with model evaluation, safety guardrails and responsible AI in production
  • Use hands-on engineering skills across Python, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud platforms, containers and Kubernetes
  • Establish DevSecOps, automated testing, observability and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices for reliable production operations
  • Set architecture, engineering standards and technical direction for complex systems with clear trade-offs and operational accountability
  • Manage delivery across distributed, multi-country engineering teams and partner with Product Owners on roadmaps and measurable outcomes

Building Agentic Productivity at HSBC

HPS is on a clear journey from chat-based assistance to personal-agent capabilities that help colleagues get more done with less friction. This role shapes the engineering direction and delivery that makes that transition real and safe at scale. You’ll work closely with Product to turn priorities into robust production outcomes while strengthening engineering pace, quality and operational performance. If you want to build agentic AI capabilities that are secure, well controlled and genuinely useful for colleagues we’d welcome your application.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic background or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please get in touch with our Recruitment Helpdesk via hsbc.recruitment@hsbc.com .

Job Description

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible for managing and developing core module projects for the operation platform;
  • Promote the company's financial technology work, keep up with the development of Fin tech, continuously absorb and introduce new technology systems, empower business, and enhance the company's competitiveness
  • Develop technical roadmap and overall framework, solve technical difficulties encountered during the development process, and quickly break through
  • Communicate requirements with business users, complete requirement analysis, system design, coding development, and project management work;
  • Responsible for continuously tracking project progress, clearly understanding and submitting the results of each stage, identifying risks in the project, evaluating and eliminating risks, and ensuring project quality;
  • Assist in developing standards for the system and fulfill the responsibility of inspecting suppliers and self-developed code in accordance with the standards.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Full time undergraduate degree or above in computer related majors, with 3 years or more of software development experience and independent and complete project development experience
  • Experience in Fintech project construction in the asset management industry, including TA, FA, and operational processes;
  • Proficient in software development lifecycle;
  • Proficient in Java development and microservice technology system, familiar with frameworks such as Spring boot and Spring cloud;

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

ln:4479630630.descriptionHtml:
The Treasury Risk Officer is a strategic professional who stays abreast of developments within own field and contributes to directional strategy by considering their application in own job and the business. Recognized technical authority for an area within the business. Requires basic commercial awareness. There are typically multiple people within the business that provide the same level of subject matter expertise. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Significant impact on the area through complex deliverables. Provides advice and counsel related to the technology or operations of the business. Work impacts an entire area, which eventually affects the overall performance and effectiveness of the sub-function/job family.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for risk reporting and analysis for Citi Treasury, working closely with the Treasury Portfolio Managers, Treasury Risk Managers, and Treasury Finance and O&T.
  • Partners with members of Treasury, Risk Management, and Finance to establish reporting requirements, develop the tools, analysis and reporting necessary to proactively identify and manage risk with respect to portfolios and products, and continuously update the reporting process to reflect the current business structure.
  • Supervises the team responsible for the reporting and analysis of interest rate and other market risks.
  • Conducts daily, weekly, and or monthly reporting of Interest Rate Exposure, DV01, duration, convexity, VaR, and MTM. Monthly reporting requirements include computation of Economic Value Sensitivity, Economic Risk Capital, and numerous stress scenarios.
  • Develops a high level of expertise in the various systems Treasury Risk uses to generate Risk information such as DP and Yield Book.
  • Leads testing and implementing a new Treasury Risk Management system, including establishing data standards and controls as well as coordinating and performing ongoing projects and testing.
  • Works with members of the various disciplines to identify ways to streamline and automate process flows in order to create more accurate and timely results, as well as improving efficiency.
  • Responsible for handling day-to-day staff management issues, including resource management and allocation of work within the team/project.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

  • 6-10 years relevant experience

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred

------------------------------------------------------

Job Family Group:

Risk Management

------------------------------------------------------

Job Family:

Finance Risk

------------------------------------------------------

Time Type:

Full time

------------------------------------------------------

Most Relevant Skills

Analytical Thinking, Credible Challenge, Financial Analysis, Governance, Policy, Procedure, and Regulation, Risk Management Lifecycle.

------------------------------------------------------

Other Relevant Skills

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

------------------------------------------------------

Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.

View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster.

We want to hear from you if…

You are in your penultimate year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline from a top academic institution (graduating between Dec 2027 - June 2028)

Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit...

A dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring professionals who have a global perspective on the future of banking, and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you. We'll also be looking for the following:

  • Commitment to personal growth and career development, a strong desire to learn, and success in team environments
  • Strong communication, planning, and organizational skills
  • Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry
  • Unquestioned commitment to integrity and ethical decision-making


We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The Summer Analyst Program runs for 10 weeks and begins with initial classroom based training, followed by ongoing training sessions throughout the length of the program, as well as a series of networking and social events. Analysts will complete two rotations across different teams within the Corporate Banking group. Incoming Summer Analysts have the opportunity to be considered for a position on the following year’s full-time Analyst Program.

Your time here will look something like this...

  • Provide advice: this involves working with our clients to develop and execute their strategic objectives. We advise them on a number of areas including whether to buy or sell companies or assets, how to restructure finances, and where and how to invest capital
  • Work with Capital Markets: we work very closely with the Citi CMO team (Capital Markets Origination) to help our clients raise capital in the equity and debt capital markets


You're the brains behind our work.

You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can’t come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team, and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when. Citi is looking for Summer Interns to join the Corporate Banking team in Asia Pacific. Citi’s Corporate Bank is a leading provider of financial services to top-tier multi-national clients around the globe, serving the financial needs of the world's preeminent corporations and financial institutions. The Corporate group advises corporate clients who want to raise funds in capital markets and who need strategic support in financial transactions. Initiatives you may be working on with clients include mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, financial restructurings, underwriting, and distributing equity, debt, and derivative securities. As a Summer Analyst, you will join an intensive ten-week program where you will receive in-depth education on a variety of these topics to learn the fundamentals of the Analyst role and introduce you to Citi’s culture.

We encourage early applications as we recruit on a rolling basis. Each applicant can apply to maximum of 3 summer internship programs in APAC region.

Job Family Group

Institutional Banking

Job Family

Corporate Banking

Time Type

Full time

Most Relevant Skills

Please see the requirements listed above.

Other Relevant Skills

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.

View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster.

ln:4480942367.descriptionHtml:
GCOO - Asia & Middle East COO

Our GCOO organisation is critical for HSBC. This team partners closely with business teams to drive simplification and deliver exceptional customer outcomes in Asia and the Middle East region which covers 26 markets, 600+ offices and branches, and more than 140,000 employees. By strengthening our control environment and enhancing risk management, we drive operational excellence and enable the bank to deliver focused and sustainable growth in this super-region.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Control Ownership & Governance
    • Local Compliance: Ensure all local Business Continuity (BC) and Operational Resilience (OR) controls operate in strict accordance with local laws, regulations, and HSBC global standards.
    • Risk Oversight: Partner with regional teams to guide local Risk Owners (GB/GI), ensuring they clearly understand control appropriateness and effectiveness.
    • Monitoring & Reporting: Execute rigorous risk and control monitoring, manage identified issues with prioritised mitigation, and deliver high-quality control reporting to meet group and regulatory requirements.
  • Business Continuity Management (BCM)
    • Lifecycle Management: Own the planning and execution of a fit-for-purpose annual BC lifecycle, ensuring all analysis, planning, and exercise obligations are met.
    • Tool & System Excellence: Ensure high-quality usage of the Business Continuity Planning Tool and Emergency Notification System, setting mechanisms to review metrics and drive remediation where gaps exist.
    • Crisis Readiness: Oversee local contingency site provisions and support Real Estate Services as a BCIM advisor.
  • Major Incident Management (MIM)
    • Crisis Capability: Ensure mandated Major Incident Group (MIG) controls are active, including the facilitation of training and exercises for HBCN.
    • Threat Monitoring: Perform proactive threat monitoring and provide timely escalation to the MIG Chair, regional teams, and key stakeholders.
    • Incident Response: Lead the team in executing emergency notifications, managing local MIG invocations, and conducting post-incident reviews in line with Group standards.
  • Operational Resilience (OR)
    • Entity Level Coordination & Steering: Orchestrate activities at entity level to ensure timely delivery of key milestones, through active tracking, monitoring, review & challenge, reporting, and escalation.
    • Continuous Improvement: Drive simplification in processes, challenge the status quo, and leverage new tools to enhance resilience capabilities.
  • Stakeholder Management & Leadership
    • Trusted Advisor: Build and maintain strong relationships with local Heads of GB/GI, senior management, and regulators.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the local face of BCIM/OR, advocating for resilience priorities and fostering an exchange culture across HSBC entities in China.
    • Team Leadership: Lead by example, building a motivated, engaged, and diverse local team. Champion integrity, accountability, and collaboration.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

    • Proven Expertise: Significant experience in risk or control management, with a deep track record in managing Business Continuity and Operational Resilience lifecycles.
    • Crisis Leadership: Demonstrated experience in managing major incidents, training senior executives, and facilitating high-stakes crisis exercises.
    • Regulatory Knowledge: A deep understanding of global and local requirements related to BCIM and OR. Professional certification (e.g., CBCP, MBCI) is a significant advantage.
    • Strategic Agility: The ability to translate global and regional priorities into effective local actions, balancing competing demands to find the best solutions.
    • Decision Making: A confident decision-maker who can act decisively under pressure and within tight deadlines.
    • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
    • Global Mindset: Experience working within highly regulated, complex international organisations.
    • Language Skills: Fluency in English and the local language (Mandarin) is a prerequisite.
    • Values : High ethical standards, innovative thinking, and a commitment to "We Succeed Together."
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4480946272.descriptionHtml:
CIB - Markets

Global Markets is part of our HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking division, a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Our Markets business is one of the largest of its kind in the world. It combines sophisticated 24-hour global coverage with a detailed knowledge of local markets. Our services are offered both online and offline in 58 countries and territories. We specialise in foreign exchange, credits and rates, structured derivatives, equities and debt, equity and equity-linked capital markets.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Pricing and risk management of the FX Options business in Mainland China
  • Drives the development of business initiatives with regard to the development of technical trading tools.
  • Generate ideas and solutions to increase revenue generation, market share and hit ratios.
  • Provides timely and accurate dealing services for clients in the assigned area of FXO trading expertise.
  • Manages the firm’s inventory and trading risk under supervision and as assigned in compliance with all applicable regulation within a given business area and within desk limit structure.
  • Deliver fair outcomes for customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets.
  • Provides consistent pricing and market making to sales force and target clients
  • Executes firm and customers' trades in accordance with desk Volcker designation and may contribute to the formulation of trading strategies.
  • Ensures all trades are booked to front office position keeping system on the day they are executed
  • Reconciles daily and/or monthly reports, as assigned.
  • Ability to work efficiently with members of the FX team.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with other stakeholders.
  • Increase brand equity & build internal network of contacts
  • Oversee development of monitoring and relevant reconciliation tools to ensure effective controls.
  • Help input controls to mitigate operational losses
  • Ensure full understanding of products and how to book them

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Prior G10 and/or EM trading knowledge (pricing & risk management).
  • Degree in a numerical/quantitative subject.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, influencing and collaboration skills.
  • Mindset and track record challenging the status quo and improving operational efficiency.
  • Track record working in global team and dealing with a diverse group of stakeholders.
  • Computer literate, Python coding skills is optional but advantageous.
  • Fluency in English and second language is preferable

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4479961518.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Standard Chartered is a leading international bank operating in some of the most dynamic markets in the world, in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our successful and sustainable business is built on doing tangible, long term good for our people, our customers and the communities we serve. Retail, WM & PvB program of work covers treasury, Securities, Investment and Portfolio product sets in 32+ countries.

Wealth Management Team is seeking Quality Assurance engineer to join the high-performing team. The candidate must be a skilled professional with E2E software QA experience with a desire to work in an Agile, dynamic and flat organizational structure. As a Quality Assurance engineer, you would be required to analyze, design build, document and execute QA required tasks in all Consumer Bank segments (Retail, SME, and Priority & Private).

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and own testing process & delivery for various application streams
  • Develop automation test strategy & test scripts
  • Engage with stakeholders including Product Owners, Project Managers, Dev teams and downstream teams
  • Assess impact of changes, build functional test strategy and plan
  • Work closely with the application development and dev-ops to improve performance, scalability and resiliency of the system
  • Development of automation framework, common tools and utilities

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

Technical Skills (Mandatory):

  • Strong development skills in Core Java.
  • Experience in API Testing (manual and automation).
  • Experience in test case Design, Review, Execution, Defect reporting & tracking
  • Framework design and customization
  • Agile practices (Scrum, TDD, BDD) a must.
  • Continuous Integration evangelist
  • Familiar with testing and automation tools – Postman, GIT, Confluence, ADO

Technical Skills (Preferred)

  • Knowledge of BDD testing framework like Cucumber
  • Knowledge of containerized and cloud environment, such as Docker, k8s/OpenShift, AWS, etc.
  • Functional knowledge in Payments, Collections, Trade
  • Experience in API testing
  • Experience in performance testing using JMeter/LoadRunner

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Computer Science or exceptional relevant experience.
  • 8 years of experience in automation testing
  • Precise and critical thinker with attention to detail
  • Fast learner
  • Strong analytical & trouble shooting skills
  • Open & trustworthy communication skills in both English and Mandarin
  • Courageous to critique and suggest improvements
  • Team-based ethics but independent thinker

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4479972049.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

A highly skilled and experienced for Wealth Solutions Operations (i.e WSO). This role requires a responsible and detail-oriented professional with experience in operational project management, supporting business products/processes development and effectively managing operational risks and controls in WSO team. Support LM deliver the task/agenda according to the objective pre-set.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Support LM to drive transformation of WS operation teams to align with WRB Client Journeys in the market. Oversee the innovation and continuous improvement projects relating to WS ops and be responsible for outcomes with related business stakeholders and 2nd lines.
  • Support LM to develop and sustain a compliance culture, ensure flawless execution and compliance to timely identify and address arising risks and control gaps if any.
  • Engage key stakeholders and within the broader business partners to ensure alignment across governance/control/conduct agendas.

Processes

  • Drive and deliver WSO process simplification and Project implementation by working with WS process owners and related stakeholders.
  • Lead and oversee WS ops related platform to support WS digitization journey and initiatives delivery and ensuring the effectiveness of related project delivery in a coherent and seamless way and the consistency of functionality and control design across the platforms.
  • Lead and drive to identify and achieve WSO operations excellence and efficiency to be aligned with country, business, function strategy goals.

Risk Management

  • Reinforce the risk management, conduct and governance discipline, and driving alignment/streamlining of key operation processes by working with WS process owners and related stakeholders.
  • Support the WS business to deliver the business priorities through continuously improving on process productivity and efficiency, meeting regulatory and internal policy requirements and driving a standardization agenda for the business as well as representation at the relevant risk/conduct/governance committees and forums by working with WS process owners and related stakeholders.
  • Drive WSO data management framework implementation quality in function, manages data quality improvement project and new data elements collection from product/ other biz & regulatory requirements, and accountable for functional data leverage in business revenue driven/ risk monitoring/ processing automation. In addition, can provide support to LM to take the ownership and deliver the task/agenda according to the objective pre-set.

Governance

  • Ensure compliance with the highest standards of regulatory conduct and compliance standards as defined by internal and external requirements as well as ensure that identified risks are subject to appropriate remedial action.
  • Engage with key stakeholders to ensure alignment across governance / control / conduct agendas.
  • Ensure proper governance on data, systems, GBS and third parties as the business, operation and domain owner in accordance to regulations and bank policies.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Establish and implement a stable and reliable world class operating sales platform and control environment by working with WS process owners, WRB BRM and related stakeholders.
  • Actively manage and remediate any breaches and deviations from global / local standards by working with WS process owners, WRB BRM and related stakeholders

Accountable For Consumer Rights Protection Requirements (CN Required)

  • Fully understand the importance of consumer rights protection, prevent damage to consumer’s best interest, implement regulatory requirements related to consumer rights protection, ensure to complete relevant trainings and to always embed consumer rights protection mindset when performing daily work.

Accountability (CN Required)

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；

Job Description

Job Summary

  • Manage the Product control function for China across Business
  • Provide strong oversight of the integrity, accuracy and timely reporting of China trading revenues, balance sheet positions and valuation adjustments, ensuring that financial results are appropriately controlled and understood.
  • Establish and maintain a China-specific Product Control and Valuation Control framework that meets local regulatory requirements while remaining aligned with the bank’s global policies, standards and risk appetite.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance and Operations to support sustainable business growth by providing independent challenge, identifying emerging financial and valuation risks, and enabling informed commercial decision-making.
  • Strengthen the local control environment through effective governance, clear ownership, high-quality management information and the development of capable China-based Product Control and Valuation Control resources.
  • Manage the Valuation Control deliverables as applicable for China regulatory requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead a China-based Product Control and Valuation Control team, while also acting as a hands-on subject matter expert. The role combines people leadership with significant individual contribution, particularly in resolving complex control, valuation, accounting and regulatory matters.
  • Oversee the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of daily and monthly P&L, balance sheet substantiation, valuation adjustments, independent price verification and other core Product Control and Valuation Control activities for the China business.
  • Establish and maintain an effective China-specific control framework that meets local regulatory expectations and is aligned with the bank’s global Product Control and Valuation Control policies, methodologies and governance standards.
  • Coordinate extensively with global and regional Product Control and Valuation Control teams to obtain technical input, clarify policy requirements, resolve methodology differences and ensure consistent application of global standards within the China business.
  • Provide independent review and challenge of trading results, valuation methodologies, reserves, model inputs, adjustments and balance sheet positions. Ensure material issues are identified, investigated, escalated and resolved within agreed timelines.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to support new products, business growth and regulatory initiatives, ensuring that appropriate financial controls and valuation processes are in place before implementation.
  • Support the China business by providing clear analysis of revenue performance, valuation uncertainty, balance sheet risks, control weaknesses and emerging issues, enabling informed management and commercial decision-making.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Allocate work, set priorities, review outputs and develop the capability of the local team. Ensure clear accountability, appropriate segregation of duties, adequate documentation and effective backup arrangements.
  • Drive improvements in processes, reporting, data quality and automation, reducing manual adjustments and recurring breaks while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.
  • Maintain effective governance over material issues, exceptions and control breaches, with clear ownership, action plans, escalation thresholds and reporting to relevant China, regional and global committees.
  • The role holder is accountable for both the day-to-day effectiveness of the local Product Control and Valuation Control function and the successful coordination of China requirements with the wider global control organisation.

People and Talent

  • Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  • Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
  • Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, where local requirements may differ from global standards and require careful interpretation, escalation and practical implementation.
  • Resolving valuation, P&L and balance sheet issues involving incomplete data, methodology differences, manual processes or unclear ownership across local, regional and global teams.
  • Building a credible and sustainable local Product Control and Valuation Control framework while working with limited resources, competing priorities and significant dependency on global subject-matter experts.
  • Managing periods of heightened regulatory, audit or senior-management scrutiny, requiring timely responses, clear evidence of control effectiveness and disciplined delivery of remediation commitments.
  • Challenging senior business and functional stakeholders on valuation assumptions, manual adjustments, control weaknesses and financial risks, while maintaining constructive relationships and supporting business objectives.
  • Driving long-term process and control improvements where solutions require coordination across multiple teams, changes to systems or data, and sustained follow-through rather than short-term fixes.
  • Developing and retaining a small local team capable of handling complex issues independently, while maintaining delivery quality during periods of change, pressure or increased business activity.

Skills and Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Product Control and Valuation Control understanding
  • Financial Markets and Trading Products
  • China Regulatory awareness

Other Skills

  • Control Framework and risk management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Valuation knowledge – IPV/FVA/PVA

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience leading complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure

Certifications/Qualifications

  • CICPA & CFA is preferred

Languages

  • Chinese and English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business: CTO Platforms

Principal Responsibilities

  • Define and govern architecture for the AI Platform: reference architectures, standards, guardrails, patterns and roadmaps across cloud and also on‑prem environments.
  • Provide technical direction and design authority for engineering teams, including solution reviews, design approvals, and delivery oversight.
  • Lead vendor/product evaluation and adoption (e.g. GPU platforms, Kubernetes distributions, storage and networking solutions, observability stacks), ensuring fit with HSBC infrastructure requirements, support models, and lifecycle management.
  • Partner closely with other HSBC platform teams on on‑prem platform development, integration with existing data center capabilities, and operational readiness.
  • Design and guide implementation of infrastructure for AI/ML workloads (capacity planning, scheduling, tenancy/isolation, performance, reliability, cost controls).
  • Embed security, compliance, and operational controls by design, working with Cyber Security, Data, Model Risk Management (MRM), and other stakeholders (e.g., identity, encryption, logging, vulnerability management, auditability).
  • Ensure production-grade non-functionals: availability, disaster recovery, monitoring/alerting, SLOs, incident readiness, and automation (IaC, CI/CD enablement where relevant).

Requirements

  • Proven architecture leadership for large-scale platforms, including defining reference architectures, standards, guardrails, and roadmaps across cloud and on‑prem.
  • Proven ability to produce clear, practical designs that translate business and technical requirements into secure, scalable, reusable and maintainable platform solutions.
  • Hands-on experience building and delivering platform capabilities across both cloud and on-premises environments, with a strong understanding of production engineering and operational considerations.
  • Good knowledge of one or more major cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or Alibaba Cloud, including core services, data, networking, identity, and security principles.
  • Experience with modern platform engineering practices, including APIs, containerisation, Kubernetes, CI/CD, automation, and observability.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code, policy as code, and reusable platform patterns.
  • Experience evaluating and adopting vendor products/services (e.g., Kubernetes distributions, GPU solutions, observability tooling) and aligning them to enterprise support, lifecycle, and operational models.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills: able to build trusted relationships with engineering, product, and control functions; translate complex requirements into pragmatic platform designs.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Technology Management.

Business: CIB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

Regional incident management

  • Lead the coordination and management of major and high-priority incidents during time-zone coverage.
  • Act as the regional point of contact for incident response, ensuring timely engagement of technical teams, service owners, business stakeholders and leadership.
  • Establish clear incident command, ownership, communications and escalation paths.
  • Ensure incidents are assessed, prioritized, progressed and resolved in line with agreed service management processes and service-level expectations.
  • Coordinate effective handovers between other global operating regions.
  • Provide concise, timely and accurate updates to stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle.
  • Support post-incident reviews, ensuring root-cause analysis, lessons learned and remedial actions are completed.
  • Identify recurring issues and trends, and work with relevant teams to reduce repeat incidents and improve service resilience.

Change assurance

  • Lead or support change assurance activities across department.
  • Review planned changes for risk, impact, implementation readiness, testing, rollback arrangements and stakeholder communication.
  • Work with Change Advisory Boards, Change owners and technical teams to ensure changes meet required governance standards.
  • Monitor change outcomes, including failed, unauthorized or emergency changes, and drive corrective actions where required.
  • Promote a balanced approach that enables delivery while protecting service stability, regulatory obligations and customer outcomes.

ITSM practices

  • Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of ITSM processes, standards and controls.
  • Ensure service management activities are appropriately documented, evidenced and aligned with internal risk and compliance requirements.
  • Maintain effective governance over incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, service level and configuration management practices, as applicable.
  • Prepare management information, risk reporting and service performance insights for regional and global stakeholders.
  • Track control actions, audit findings, process exceptions and remediation activities through to closure.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Audit, Technology Control and service management teams to support reviews and regulatory commitments.
  • Contribute to operational resilience, service continuity and control improvement initiatives.

Global stakeholder and team coordination

  • Build strong working relationships with technology teams, service owners, business representatives and leadership across regions.
  • Coordinate activities across geographically distributed teams, encouraging consistent processes and clear accountability.
  • Represent the region in global ITSM forums, governance meetings and service reviews.
  • Facilitate communication between operational teams and senior stakeholders, translating technical issues into clear business impact and actions.
  • Encourage knowledge sharing and consistent adoption of ITSM standards across regions.

Requirements

  • Significant experience in IT service management, service operations or technology risk and control environments.
  • Proven experience leading major incident management in a complex, enterprise or regulated organisation.
  • Practical experience with change management, change assurance and ITSM governance.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL principles and service management best practice; ITIL certification is desirable.
  • Experience working with global, virtual and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to engage senior leaders during high-pressure situations.
  • Ability to assess operational risk, prioritise competing demands and make clear, timely decisions.
  • Experience producing service metrics, risk reporting, control evidence and management information.
  • Strong organisational skills, with a disciplined approach to action tracking and governance.
  • Ability to work primarily within regional operating hours, with occasional flexibility for significant global incidents or governance activities.

Desirable Qualifications

  • ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
  • Experience with recognized ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent.
  • Experience in financial services, banking or another highly regulated industry.
  • Knowledge of operational resilience, technology risk, audit and regulatory control frameworks.
  • Experience leading post-incident reviews and service improvement programmes.
  • Familiarity with Agile, DevOps or technology delivery models.

Key competencies

  • Incident leadership: Calm, decisive and structured under pressure.
  • Risk-based judgement: Able to balance delivery needs with control, resilience and compliance obligations.
  • Collaboration: Builds effective relationships across teams, regions and organisational boundaries.
  • Communication: Provides clear, audience-appropriate updates and escalations.
  • Accountability: Owns outcomes, follows through on actions and makes responsibilities explicit.
  • Continuous improvement: Uses data, trends and lessons learned to improve services and controls.
  • Influence: Gains commitment without relying solely on formal authority.

Success measures

Success In This Role Will Be Measured Through

  • Effective and timely management of regional major and high-priority incidents.
  • Quality and consistency of global incident handovers and stakeholder communications.
  • Improved incident resolution, recurrence and post-incident action performance.
  • Strong compliance with change assurance and ITSM governance requirements.
  • Timely closure of control actions, audit findings and process exceptions.
  • Improved service stability, operational resilience and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Consistent adoption of ITSM standards across the department.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Business: CIB Technology

Delivery/Compliance

Principal responsibilities

  • Lead the risk & control agenda for the CCM and FRM Technology.
  • Lead the delivery of risk & control projects and programmes for the value stream.
  • Assist service owners in responding appropriately and effectively to firm-wide risk, cyber and corporate control initiatives.
  • Partner with service owners and Value Stream/Sub-Value Stream leads and head to identify and assess controls, determine mitigating actions and remediation activities, and understand the overall risk profile.
  • Partner with CIB Tech. RCOs to ensure departmental requirements are considered.
  • Advocate and support initiatives to improve accuracy across all Enterprise Golden Source data repositories.
  • Provide technical knowledge to support secure development of applications and remediation programs.
  • Provide visibility of status of action plans and external/internal audit issues.
  • Drive ownership and accountability for Risk Issue and Action Plan Ownership within Value stream.
  • Challenge where appropriate, decisions made on control implementation.
  • Review allocation of issues to Value stream and agree categorization of high/medium/low.
  • Approve the raising and closure of issues, action plans, but look to automate process.
  • Triage the issue/risk acceptance process.
  • Supporting the assessment and articulation of residual risk in Value Stream or at CIB Tech business based on global issues impacting the Technology control environment.
  • Managing ongoing Control Effectiveness via Control KCI data across Value stream.
  • Act as a gatekeeper in collection of artefacts and / or evidence for control remediation related audit or regulatory assessment.
  • Support Control remediation agenda for CIB Technology and ensure compliance at value stream level.

Stakeholder Management/Governance

  • Partner with the CIB Tech central teams – CCO Tech, Cyber Sec, Service Mgmt. team and Risk Functions to promote and provide guidance to relevant policies, standards and governance within CIB Technology.
  • Provide stakeholder updates with respect to global Technology Control uplift programs.
  • Lead IT engagement with internal / external / client audit and Regulatory Exams, including oversight of field work, collation of artefacts and partnership with CCO Tech to remediate issues.
  • Attend relevant governance forums and where applicable provide appropriate MI.
  • Communicate residual risk through reporting, business/technology governance processes and forums.

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Lead by example, demonstrating core behaviours and values including teamwork, focus, drive and determination.
  • Cultivate an environment that supports diversity and reflects the HSBC brand.
  • Influences greater effective and open team communication and collaboration.
  • Developing, aligning and translating strategies and plans to achieve business and functional goals.
  • Act in a manner that transparently promotes the organisations values and delivers in an aligned manner.

Requirements

  • Minimum 12 years IT/Technology - Risk and Control experience.
  • Experience in managing IT/Technology risk and control framework.
  • Hands on experience on risk and control management tools and process.
  • Good communication skills be able to talk to a variety of stakeholders include senior people.
  • Flexible and adaptable being able to manage and prioritise competing demands in a demanding environment.
  • Solid English language communication skills to be able influence and challenge stakeholders, “Bilingual Proficiency” level desirable, “Professional Proficiency/Fluent” level minimum.
  • Strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
  • High level of attention to detail, and ability to lead activities.
  • Expertise in non-financial risk management, governance, and frameworks.
  • Proficient with using Excel, Macros, Confluence, JIRA, PowerPoint and AI tools.
  • Desirable – CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, COBIT, or ITIL are desirable.

ln:4480983109.descriptionHtml:
Corporate and Institutional Banking

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Impact on the Business/Function:

  • Support the execution of the Outbound strategy, including strategy paper, initiatives formulation, driving actions and track the deliverables.
  • Help drive the in-country execution of the Group's Outbound strategy to deliver revenues and achieve the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets.
  • Support customer account strategies and liaise with Regions/Branches assigning prospects and opportunities to HBCN Coverage Banker/Global Network Banking (GNB) RMs.
  • Develop metrics and reporting mechanisms that monitor execution of the Outbound strategy.
  • Interpret and communicate any global GNB and regulatory developments and ensure timely training and familiarization for frontline teams is delivered.
  • Support the execution of tactical projects to ensure that market firsts are attained for key products and market trends.
  • Work on strategy papers and presentations to raise Outbound and international awareness/knowledge for front-line colleagues.

Customers / Stakeholders

  • Build working level relationships with trade bodies, business councils and commercial chambers. Support capturing ODI opportunities.
  • Participate in meetings with Outbound clients and prospects, to provide guidance, pitch for new business, resolve any issues, and facilitate smooth operations and services, thus building loyalty and client satisfaction.
  • Help establish the agenda for internal education (e.g. workshops and seminars) and external marketing (client forums and summits).
  • Deepen customer relationships through championing business co-operation with key stakeholders including Global Business, Global Products and Global Functions, to contribute to Outbound strategy.
  • Support with planning workshops, forums, seminars, roadshows and presentations.
  • Work with in-country stakeholders where required to remove any blockages for transactions and coordinate escalation to resolve matters in a timely and efficient manner.

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Work closely with Global Businesses, Global Products and Global Functions to support on preparing content, papers and presentations related to execution of a comprehensive strategy for the China Outbound proposition.
  • Build network with Group offices (including global CIB, GNB and CDMs) to enhance profile and cooperation with China.
  • Help with managing CDM proposition/governance and support periodical review on CDM structure to align with China CIB and GNB management. Coordinate feedback to GNB teams on CDM performance and provide support on people management matters.

Operational Effectiveness & Control

  • Continually assess operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructuring and the impact of new technology.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

Essential

  • Proven and progressive business development, sales management, and credit experience or equivalent.
  • Adaptability and mobility. The role may require the jobholder to frequently travel throughout China and work abroad on short term assignments.
  • Extensive knowledge and proven sales success with the Bank's products and services, or equivalent
  • Good understanding and knowledge of GNB and experience with working with multinational corporates.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders in a global environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills including organizational, analytical, negotiation, communication, teamwork and influencing skills.
  • Ability to set and manage own agenda, while ensuring alignment with stakeholder priorities.
  • Excellent spoken and written Mandarin and English.

Desired

  • University graduate degree in business related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Understanding of local operating markets and their corresponding span(s) of control within assigned region.
  • Experience of driving strategic change in a matrix environment.

Group Leadership Capabilities - the following capabilities have been identified as essential for this role:

  • Navigating - Anticipating future needs of stakeholders, reconciling opposing stakeholder needs, ensuring the vision is understood by all stakeholders and translating Group Strategy into immediate business/function.
  • Aspiring - Knowledge of standards in leading global organizations, driving performance against leading global standards, competing successfully and actively improving capability.
  • Driving - Enabling others to take the lead, courageously taking on stretching challenges, thriving under pressure, seeking opportunities to transform immediate business/function and set stretching goals.
  • Mobilizing - Inspiring relevant stakeholders, championing diversity and inclusion within immediate business/function, fully leveraging the matrix, maximizing employee engagement, creating a high-performance culture, optimizing the pace of delivery.
  • Sustaining - Championing respect and fairness in dealings with others, enhancing the brand of HSBC, and championing HSBC Values and Culture.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4479988370.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

We're looking for a Business Development Executive to drive business growth within our Affluent Banking business. You’ll play a key role in acquiring new clients, strengthening relationships, and delivering personal financial advice. Your day-to-day will involve planning strategies to meet sales targets, sharing market insights, and supporting promotional activities such as campaigns and seminars. You’ll also ensure smooth after-sales service and identify opportunities to cross-sell relevant products.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused environment and is passionate about helping people achieve their financial goals.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source and engage individual prospects to acquire new business.
  • Conduct professional, consultative financial analysis sessions with customers.
  • Identify and articulate customers’ specific financial needs and objectives, offering targeted solutions.
  • Foster and deepen client relationships by providing regular market updates and financial product trend analysis (both local and international).
  • Participate in marketing and promotional activities aimed at successful customer acquisition.

Skills And Experience

  • Strong competencies in client acquisition and sophisticated account management, particularly with High Net Worth (HNW) individuals.
  • Expertise in region-specific languages and established local networks (highly valued).
  • Technical knowledge of consumer banking products (Treasury, Equities, Funds, and Insurance).
  • A university degree is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in customer service or sales is an advantage; however, applications from fresh graduates who possess the required skills and qualifications will also be considered.

Qualifications

  • Essential professional qualifications: HKSI Paper 1, 7, 8 and IIQE Paper 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Job Summary

We're looking for a Business Development Executive to drive business growth within our Affluent Banking business. You’ll play a key role in acquiring new clients, strengthening relationships, and delivering personal financial advice. Your day-to-day will involve planning strategies to meet sales targets, sharing market insights, and supporting promotional activities such as campaigns and seminars. You’ll also ensure smooth after-sales service and identify opportunities to cross-sell relevant products.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused environment and is passionate about helping people achieve their financial goals.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source and engage individual prospects to acquire new business.
  • Conduct professional, consultative financial analysis sessions with customers.
  • Identify and articulate customers’ specific financial needs and objectives, offering targeted solutions.
  • Foster and deepen client relationships by providing regular market updates and financial product trend analysis (both local and international).
  • Participate in marketing and promotional activities aimed at successful customer acquisition.

Skills And Experience

  • Strong competencies in client acquisition and sophisticated account management, particularly with High Net Worth (HNW) individuals.
  • Expertise in region-specific languages and established local networks (highly valued).
  • Technical knowledge of consumer banking products (Treasury, Equities, Funds, and Insurance).
  • A university degree is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in customer service or sales is an advantage; however, applications from fresh graduates who possess the required skills and qualifications will also be considered.

Qualifications

  • Essential professional qualifications: HKSI Paper 1, 7, 8 and IIQE Paper 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.
