ln:4480480699.descriptionHtml:
The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The VP Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as a strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Assume significant levels of responsibility for the various phases of project and transaction execution, new business development and overall growth of the firm
  • Work closely with clients on financing transactions and guide them through the capital raising process, including leading due diligence and drafting sessions and preparing them for an equity or debt offering
  • Work with clients, senior-level team members and outside professional advisors on M&A and special situation transactions
  • Responsible for drafting situation analyses, pitch materials, information memoranda, investor and management presentations and oversee work being performed by analysts & associates assigned to projects

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 6-10 years of experience
  • Experience in the Financial Services industry, specifically within Banking
  • Degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration
  • MBA or Master's Degree in Business preferred
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the corporate banking business and its related products, pertinent regulations and lending and credit approval processes
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience with large corporate clients, capital markets products, derivatives, credit, cash management, trade, finance and securities products
  • Series 7 and 63 preferred

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

  • Engage in defining and optimizing investment banking quality control standard and framework, including policies and procedures, deal process and system
  • Review and assess investment banking transactions with respect to business selection and internal review standards and requirements
  • Perform QC review of the materials and documents submitted/filed/disclosed by deal teams to make sure the compliance with relevant rules and regulations, CSRC / stock exchange requirements and self-regulatory body rules
  • Monitor and assess whether the deal team have diligently performed due diligence duties
  • Perform necessary onsite inspection and issue explicit onsite inspection opinion when material risks are identified
  • Manage and supervise post-issuance continuous supervision and bond entrustment management responsibilities
  • Guide and review the deal teams to complete working paper archiving in accordance with relevant requirements
  • Carry out policy and regulation research and provide advice on transaction execution
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for firm’s reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practice, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency
  • Familiarity with CSRC/Exchanges/SAC rules
  • Secure and maintain all necessary CSRC licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities
  • Preference for HK SFC Type 6 licenses / qualifications
  • Solid accounting, legal and financial knowledge, familiar with A-share investment banking transaction process

ln:4480480603.descriptionHtml:
The Research Analyst is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits. Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsibilities include: building financial models, writing research reports, conducting macroeconomic analysis on the global energy industry, communicating our team's ideas to institutional investors, conducting due diligence and working with Citi's product team to identify trends in the space.
  • Self-starter; used to working in a team environment and who has the ambition to progress his/her career within equity research
  • Conduct analysis
  • Make Investment Recommendations
  • Interact with Institutional Clients
  • Arrange company visits and regular management contact for investing clients and due diligence purposes
  • Attend industry conferences and speak to industry contacts
  • Track company events and earnings
  • Develop financial models and valuation techniques
  • Establish yourself as an expert
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 5-8 years previous experience
  • Distill research into an investable thesis and write report/note Market ideas to internal constituents and clients via phone calls and client marketing trips Help facilitate direct corporate access for investors Provide independent (regulatory controlled)
  • Secure and maintain applicable licenses.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

ln:4480488618.descriptionHtml:
The Corporate Salesperson is a strategic professional who stays abreast of developments within own field and contributes to directional strategy by considering their application in own job and the business. Recognized technical authority for an area within the business. Requires basic commercial awareness. There are typically multiple people within the business that provide the same level of subject matter expertise. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Significant impact on the area through complex deliverables. Provides advice and counsel related to the technology or operations of the business. Work impacts an entire area, which eventually affects the overall performance and effectiveness of the sub-function/job family.

Responsibilities:

  • Sell separate account services or finance products directly to Corporate clients
  • Will help team to service clients in the buying and selling of securities, derivatives, FX and commodities
  • Help drive the team's developed strategy across specified product lines
  • Aid to achieve specified goals in both market and wallet share for the identified client franchise
  • Originate and execute meaningful and landmark transactions
  • Will independently and/or jointly work within business product to achieve the strategic growth and market share we are aiming for
  • Partner closely with other key businesses and functions to ensure proper product deployment based on understanding of client
  • Help foster an environment of collaboration through interfacing with appropriate internal partners to enhance share of mind with clients, increase dialogue and to deliver on expertise
  • Understand and analyze clients’ businesses and exposures to provide best suited sales solutions in full coordination with all relevant business partners
  • Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
  • Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
  • Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation.
  • Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 6-10 years of experience
  • Previous experience in client-facing roles with proven track record on growing and maintaining relationships through value added service and commercial skills
  • An entrepreneurial approach for business origination and developing new relationships
  • Demonstrated interpersonal skills

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred

The Trader is a senior level position responsible for overseeing a trading book and managing book risk, in coordination with the Trading team. The overall objective of this role is to ensure book trades deliver on budgeted revenues, and to coordinate with key stakeholders to develop the trading franchise.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee a trading book and generate revenues and manage risk for the respective business
  • Coordinate with Sales, Research and other organizations across broader business
  • Trade a book and deliver on budgeted revenues and manage book risk
  • Establish and maintain key relationships to deliver trades to the desk
  • Anticipate client demand in each respective product/market
  • Coordinate with desk analysts as needed and with sales to develop the franchise
  • Leading strong governance and controls:
  • Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
  • Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
  • Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation.
  • Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services
  • Adhere to all policies and procedures as defined by your role which will be communicated to you
  • Obtain and maintain all registrations/licenses which are required for your role, within the appropriate timeframe
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

  • 6-10 years of experience in a related role
  • Knowledge of respective products and clients
  • Required CSRC licensing and registrations as applicable
  • Advance analytical and numerical competency
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Effective interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to analyze and pitch situations and determine suitable counterparties
  • Knowledge of Bloomberg, booking systems, trading protocol, closing technicalities

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred

ln:4480487462.descriptionHtml:
We want to hear from you if...

You are in your penultimate year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline from a top academic institution (graduating between Dec 2027 – June 2028).

Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit...

Work experience is not a requirement, but dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring Analysts who have a global perspective on the future of banking and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you.

We'll also be looking for the following:

  • Enthusiasm, competency, and innovation
  • Someone with a global outlook
  • Interest in working with local SME
  • Results-oriented and a good team player
  • Someone who is highly numerate with first-class analytical skills

We encourage early applications as we recruit on a rolling basis. Each applicant can apply to maximum of 3 summer internship programs in Asia cluster.

We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

We're committed to teaching you the ropes. The Summer Analyst Program trains and cultivates key pipeline for our Full-time Analyst Program. Summer Analysts will be part of a 10-week program will be assigned in Citi's key businesses or functions allowing them to work on project for an in-depth and immersive experience. Summer Analysts will also go through trainings that will provide essential skills knowledge as well as a comprehensive orientation to Citi's culture. To support your growth, you will also participate in buddy programs, networking events, speaker series, and other structured development opportunities.

The Corporate group advises corporate clients who want to raise funds in capital markets and who need strategic support in financial transactions. Initiatives you may be working on with clients include mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, financial restructurings, underwriting, and distributing equity, debt, and derivative securities. ln:4480490489.descriptionHtml:
You're the brains behind our work.

You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the workplace, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success comes with growth. Our program equips you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility—career growth is not a question of if, but when.

What is Services?

Citi’s Services organization plays a crucial role in supporting institutional clients through a wide range of innovative solutions, enabling them to navigate complex financial landscapes. Our business provides integrated cash management and trade finance solutions to help multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations optimize liquidity, working capital, and streamline transactions globally. Our business also delivers custody, fund administration, collateral management, and performance analytics, helping asset managers, institutional investors, and financial institutions efficiently manage and safeguard assets. With our global reach, including presence in over 90 countries, cutting-edge technology, and client-first approach, we provide seamless solutions that drive business success in an evolving financial world.

In this rapidly evolving landscape, we are increasingly leveraging advanced analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance our offerings, improve efficiency, and provide deeper insights to our clients. This includes utilizing AI-powered tools for predictive analytics, automation of routine tasks, and generating actionable insights from vast datasets to inform strategic decisions across our services portfolio.

We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

The Citi Services 10-week Summer Analyst Program gives entry-level employees hands-on experience through training sessions and real, on-the-job learning. Summer Analysts work closely with their teams, owning projects that drive meaningful impact. After an initial week of training and a placement process based on your interests and our needs, you’ll be assigned to a team where you’ll focus on financial analysis, business development, client engagement, and market research.

Your time here will look something like this:

  • Conduct market research to assess industry trends and the impact of macroeconomic factors.
  • Develop materials that support business development, product commercialization, and revenue growth.
  • Assist with process optimization initiatives to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk.
  • Analyze client data to identify opportunities and improve service offerings.
  • Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Participate in networking events, training sessions, and leadership discussions to strengthen your personal and professional development.

We want to hear from you if…

  • You are a junior in college, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028, with a preferred GPA of 3.5 or above.
  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Excel (e.g., data analysis, lookups, basic modeling) and have working knowledge of PowerPoint and Outlook.
  • You have an interest in financial services and a drive to learn.

Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit…

We’re looking for motivated individuals who are eager to start their careers at a global organization, tend to think strategically, have an innovative approach to business, and value diversity as much as we do. We know that anyone—not just those with business degrees—can have a knack for business, so we’re open to all disciplines. We’ll also be looking for:

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • A high level of accuracy, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Solid organizational skills and ability to work autonomously – self-starter.
  • A high level of personal integrity, commitment to excellence, and a strong desire to learn.
  • Resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • A sense of urgency and the ability to execute quickly and efficiently.

Your future at Citi

Successful Summer Analysts may be invited to return as full-time Analysts upon graduation. During the program, you will have access to mentorship, career development sessions, and networking opportunities with senior leaders and professionals across Citi. This experience is designed to provide you with a strong foundation to launch a long-term career within the firm, preparing you for a future where technology and AI play an increasingly central role. You will develop skills that are not only relevant today but are also essential for navigating the evolving landscape of AI-driven financial services.

Join us and take the first step toward shaping the future of Citi!

We encourage early applications as we recruit on a rolling basis. Each applicant can apply to maximum of 3 summer internship programs in APAC region.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: HASE Technology

Job ID: 64017

Principal Responsibilities

  • Provide IT project delivery, and assist project manager on project planning, stakeholder communication, development, testing, release and so on.
  • Lead or assist teammate to provide business & technical solution fit for business need.
  • Accountability for a product or service, identifying and developing the most appropriate technology solutions to meet customer needs as part of the Customer Journey.
  • Liaise with other teams, include architects, business stakeholders and so on to understand and drive the product or service’s direction.
  • Conduct end-to-end system tests, user acceptance tests and provide support on system implementation.
  • Ensure a high quality standard of deliverables according to HSBC standards and best practices.
  • Prepare project-related documentation and provide support on compliance and audit checking.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years rich hands-on experience in development.
  • Experience of delivering high quality and complex system solutions.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Java, Spring, Spring Boot and Spring Cloud.
  • Familiar with Linux and Shell script, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 and CSS3.
  • Knowledge of testing frameworks and best practices for back-end testing.
  • Solid experience in CI/CD tools, such as GitHub, Maven, Groovy, Nexus, Jenkins.
  • Knowledge and experience with Distributed systems, Micro-service architecture and APIs.
  • Knowledge and experience with relational database.
  • Knowledge of DevOps (CI/CD pipelines, test automation and toolings, etc).
  • Able to work in Agile working model.
  • Strong passion for technology and engineering.

/WX/LP

- Provide IT project delivery, and assist project manager on project planning, stakeholder communication, development, testing, release and so on.
- Lead or assist teammate to provide business & technical solution fit for business need.
- Accountability for a product or service, identifying and developing the most appropriate technology solutions to meet customer needs as part of the Customer Journey.

- 8+ years rich hands-on experience in development.
- Experience of delivering high quality and complex system solutions.
- Excellent written and spoken communication skills.
- Proven hands-on experience with Java, Spring, Spring Boot and Spring Cloud.
- Familiar with Linux and Shell script, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 and CSS3.
- Knowledge of testing frameworks and best practices for back-end testing.
- Solid experience in CI/CD tools, such as GitHub, Maven, Groovy, Nexus, Jenkins.
- Knowledge and experience with Distributed systems, Micro-service architecture and APIs.
- Knowledge and experience with relational database.
- Knowledge of DevOps (CI/CD pipelines, test automation and toolings, etc).
- Able to work in Agile working model.
- Strong passion for technology and engineering.

ln:4481567703.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Manager - Data and Analytics.

Principal responsibilities

  • Collaborate with business, work independently to perform customer analysis, design customer journey and develop different data solutions with business impact.
  • Highly sensitive to state of business and anticipative of business problems and priorities.
  • Explore the data and Conduct quantitative analysis to ascertain root cause of business' issues, identifies opportunities and effective targeting for business growth potential.
  • Through data analytics, design end-to-end customer engagement journey with omni-channel strategy to drive target business outcome.
  • Collaborate with different teams to ensure the successful implementation of analytic solutions/customer journey with well defined performance measurement.
  • Ensure timely and quality analytics deliverables to satisfy business needs effectively under the dynamic business environment.
  • Sharing knowledge and good practice, working collaboratively with different parties to create a productive, diverse and supportive working environment.
  • Adhere to policy, procedures and control requirements applicable to day-to-day working, exceptional and project activities.

Requirements

  • University degree in in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems or other related discipline.
  • Minimum 2 years' working experience in data analytics, customer research or performance marketing.
  • Proven experience in driving analytics strategy and business results.
  • Knowledge of various analytics tools/languages, such as SQL, Data Engineering, Visualisation tool, and Python. Knowledge of Big Query, Google Cloud is a plus.
  • Ability to communicate with impact, with the capacity to ensure complex information is articulated in a meaningful way to a wide and varied audience.
  • Effective communication, interpersonal, organizational, problem solving, presentation skill and strong business acumen.
  • Solid knowledge of advanced analytics and ML techniques, experience in digital and channel data is an advantage.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4481772768.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

 Responsibility:

  • In accordance with regional sales tasks and targets assigned by the branch, assist the Regional Director in developing sales plans and implementation roadmaps for the territory, drive execution, and ensure delivery of sales targets.
  • Align with the company's overall channel strategy and channel management objectives of the Regional Sales Center. Responsible for the development, establishment and maintenance of regional channels including secondary branches, key sub-branches and core outlets; assist in drafting channel cooperation proposals and provide ongoing business support to channels.
  • Build and maintain the regional channel marketing platform, communicate the company's brand philosophy and value, and facilitate brand penetration and promotion within the territory.
  • Under the guidance of the regional lead, design and execute marketing campaigns for key regional channels; deliver training and communications for channels and clients, provide professional services, and strengthen stickiness of channels and clients.
  • Collect, update, organize and analyze information on regional markets, channels and clients, to ensure timeliness, integrity and validity of channel data.
  • 根据分区下达的区域销售任务与目标，协助区域总监制定辖区销售方案及落地执行计划并推进实施，保障销售目标达成。
  • 依据公司整体渠道策略及区域销售中心渠道管理目标，负责辖区渠道（二级分行、重点支行、核心网点）的拓展、建设与维护；协助拟定渠道合作方案，为渠道提供持续业务支持。
  • 搭建并维护辖区渠道营销平台，传递公司品牌理念与价值，实现品牌在区域内落地与推广。
  • 在区域负责人指导下，策划并落地辖区重点渠道各类市场推广活动；开展渠道与客户培训、沟通工作，输出专业服务，提升渠道及客户粘性。
  • 收集、更新、整理并分析辖区市场、渠道、客户信息，保障渠道数据及时、完整、有效。

Requirement：

  • Minimum 3 years of working experience in fund, securities, bank investment advisory or client manager roles is preferred.
  • Solid expertise in finance, sound understanding of the current landscape of China's public fund industry, and recognition of the company's corporate culture and values.
  • Capable of public roadshow presentations, with excellent communication and cross-party coordination skills, and ability to work under high pressure.
  • Strong team player with risk & compliance awareness, self-motivation and focus.
  • Prior channel working experience in Guangdong region is preferred.
  • Hold AMAC Fund Practitioner Qualification Certificate.
  • 3年及以上基金、证券、银行投顾/客户经理相关金融从业经验优先；
  • 扎实的金融专业功底，熟悉国内公募基金行业发展现状，认同公司企业文化与价值观；
  • 具备公开路演宣讲能力，优秀的表达能力、内外部跨方协调能力，可承受较强工作压力；
  • 富有团队协作意识，具备风险合规意识，自驱力强、做事专注；
  • 拥有广东地区渠道工作经验优先；
  • 持有AMAC基金从业资格证书。

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

ln:4481791145.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

The Wholesale KYC Operation (WKO) team is a global team with locations in major locations such as New York, Delaware, London, Bournemouth, Hong Kong, Singapore and China. The team owns the end to end onboarding and periodic record renewals process which involves working closely with internal stakeholders to serve as a single point. The team functions in close partnership with Sales, Operations, Credit, Legal and Compliance to ensure efficient and timely on boarding/record renewal. WKO plays a critical role in introducing new clients to our organization as well as ensuring full due diligence is done with respect to new and existing relationships. This team is responsible for the enforcement of controls associated with Know Your Client (KYC) and Anti Money Laundering (AML) regulatory requirements.

The role is with WKO team at J.P. Morgan Securities (China) Company Limited based in Shanghai, and will consolidate the KYC profile and will ensure that all KYC and AML policies are adhered to and will be responsible for conducting reviews of client's documentation stored in internal repositories and publicly available information, initiating the necessary screening against relevant search engines and sanction lists and communicate any additional deficiencies back to the business.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the end to end onboarding process, delivering a high level of client service and relationship management.

The chosen individual will be the single point of contact for the Client during their onboarding and renewals process. They will effectively manage internal stakeholders, prioritize the pipeline through to completion, and facilitate operational performance reviews and metrics to continue to improve the client's experience with JPM.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the client on-boarding and renewal process
  • Reviews KYC records submitted by KYC Analyst for accuracy / completeness / compliance with AML, Local and Corporate Due Diligence requirements.
  • Identifies and communicates outstanding requirements or potential issues to KYC Analyst in a timely manner.
  • Review and validate documents supporting evidence to the KYC record in the system.
  • Liaises with Quality Assurance and Compliance during the Onboarding process.
  • Provide guidance and oversight to Onboarding team with respect to policies, priorities and procedures
  • Liaise with team leads within country and region to facilitate knowledge sharing
  • Identify and execute process improvements and provide support on key process and technology initiatives
  • Supports Onboarding Manager's overall LOB engagement strategy by working with a specific Front Office sub-LOB to develop strong partnerships, escalate issues, and eliminate roadblocks.
  • Coordinates case prioritization, capacity planning, and assign cases to team members. Includes organizing engagement with Front Office by client families, across new onboardings and renewals.
  • Teamwork with other supporting areas such as Legal, Compliance, Internal Controls, Technology, Client Services, as well as with other Regional and Global Client Onboarding teams. Provide operational support to supply audit/compliance/regulatory with documentation/analysis.
  • Identify and apply regulatory requirements of the different applicable jurisdictions and internal procedures.
  • Calls and respective escalation of issues, prioritization of closures by risk and due date.
  • General understanding of and execute AML (Anti money laundering) policies and internal procedures, in accordance with local and global principles. Study of legal and commercial documents, in order to understand client´s activity, structure, and risk associated.
  • Ensure Standard Operating Procedures are updated reflecting the latest procedures.
  • Prepare data or reports as required by regulatory and senior management needs related to clients.

Requirements

  • Candidates must hold Securities Practitioner Qualification Certificate or have passed Securities Qualification Examination.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English and Mandarin.
  • University graduate with minimum 5-10 years relevant banking/ finance industry experience.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, ability to partner with internal stakeholders, influencing and negotiating effectively with business heads and senior managers.
  • Sound knowledge on KYC / client onboarding, familiar with corporate and regulatory developments on AML.

About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

ln:4482035561.descriptionHtml:
在国际财富中心设立阶段

根据国际财富中心设立的要求，与相关内部部门进行紧密的合作，跟进国际财富中心设立、外勤和内勤支持的资源规划和招聘方面等问题。

业务展开

审计和合规监控

  • 确保完全符合内部政策、标准、准则和规程（尤其是当地分支机构的运营规程）及由当地监管机构做出的规则和规定。
  • 领导、教育员工，通过实时监控和有效的补救措施提高销售团队运营的控制和合规质量。
  • 配合审计、合规以及相关监管部门对于销售团队的审计或者检查。
  • 根据国际财富中心负责人的要求，对于审计以及合规检查中发现的相关问题进行整改，并对整改的结果进行及时的汇报。
  • 根据公司规定，对于发现的各项合规问题，及时上报。
  • 销售管理和业务开发
  • 领导和推动以团队为基础的销售业绩，以达成分配给销售团队的整体销售目标。
  • 制定销售战略和业务计划，并根据总部的相关策略进行战略的调整。
  • 对各项销售指标进行监控，以及对于销售团队的提出相关的保持或者改进方法。
  • 高效地利用分支机构的销售资源，根据销售人员的技能差距来分配销售目标，以提高生产力。
  • 保持业务和社会联络，以促进业务推广、提高渗透率和扩展客户基础。
  • 向国际财富管理中心负责人及个人银行业务区域总监反映客户反馈和竞争情况并提出建议。
  • 人才管理和开发
  • 通过有效的招聘、资源规划和人力调度来确保充分的员工配备，以优化日常销售和运营生产力。
  • 高效管理团队，保证团队的稳定性。根据各项表现，以及总部career roadmap或者考评要求，培养优秀的团队人员。
  • 分辨员工的能力差距和缺点，推荐培训发展计划并跟踪培训后改进情况。
  • 督导员工的日常工作表现并维持员工纪律。
  • 与员工保持明确和即时沟通，提供激励和支持，以鼓励他们达成指标。
  • 建立团队成员相互信任的氛围，提高士气，公平地处理员工问题。
  • 客户体验管理
  • 达到在多个客户满意度调查/跟踪计划中（例如神秘顾客和电话服务调查）的预设满意度水平。
  • 督导员工的日常服务质量和分支机构的环境，达到符合银行要求的标准。
  • 对客户的特别要求提供快速的回应，确保客户的口头和书面投诉可以按照内部准则得到及时地处理和解决。
  • 保证销售团队能够在日常工作中保持一定的服务质量，并同国际财富中心内的服务团队合作，满足客人的合理请求。
  • 积极配合总部各项客户体验管理项目，就所属销售团队的情况提出相关的意见或建议。
  • 对于重要的投诉，做到及时上报。并与国际财富管理中心负责人，COO部门合作进行投诉处理与解决。

Location:

PRC - Beijing

Job:

Relationship Management

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

- 配合审计、合规以及相关监管部门对于销售团队的审计或者检查。
- 根据国际财富中心负责人的要求，对于审计以及合规检查中发现的相关问题进行整改，并对整改的结果进行及时的汇报。
- 根据公司规定，对于发现的各项合规问题，及时上报。
- 销售管理和业务开发
- 领导和推动以团队为基础的销售业绩，以达成分配给销售团队的整体销售目标。
- 制定销售战略和业务计划，并根据总部的相关策略进行战略的调整。
- 对各项销售指标进行监控，以及对于销售团队的提出相关的保持或者改进方法。
- 高效地利用分支机构的销售资源，根据销售人员的技能差距来分配销售目标，以提高生产力。
- 保持业务和社会联络，以促进业务推广、提高渗透率和扩展客户基础。
- 向国际财富管理中心负责人及个人银行业务区域总监反映客户反馈和竞争情况并提出建议。
- 人才管理和开发
- 通过有效的招聘、资源规划和人力调度来确保充分的员工配备，以优化日常销售和运营生产力。
- 高效管理团队，保证团队的稳定性。根据各项表现，以及总部career roadmap或者考评要求，培养优秀的团队人员。
- 分辨员工的能力差距和缺点，推荐培训发展计划并跟踪培训后改进情况。
- 督导员工的日常工作表现并维持员工纪律。
- 与员工保持明确和即时沟通，提供激励和支持，以鼓励他们达成指标。
- 建立团队成员相互信任的氛围，提高士气，公平地处理员工问题。
- 客户体验管理
- 达到在多个客户满意度调查/跟踪计划中（例如神秘顾客和电话服务调查）的预设满意度水平。
- 督导员工的日常服务质量和分支机构的环境，达到符合银行要求的标准。
- 对客户的特别要求提供快速的回应，确保客户的口头和书面投诉可以按照内部准则得到及时地处理和解决。
- 保证销售团队能够在日常工作中保持一定的服务质量，并同国际财富中心内的服务团队合作，满足客人的合理请求。
- 积极配合总部各项客户体验管理项目，就所属销售团队的情况提出相关的意见或建议。
- 对于重要的投诉，做到及时上报。并与国际财富管理中心负责人，COO部门合作进行投诉处理与解决。
Location:
PRC - Beijing
Job:
Relationship Management
Schedule:
Regular
Employee Status:
Full time

ln:4480752988.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Lead the global Prime, Clearing & Collateral Services technology organisation responsible for enabling Clearing Services capabilities across OTC and ETD markets, supporting CCP onboarding and expansion initiatives, and delivering Margin Management platforms that underpin clearing and collateral activities across Financial Markets.

  • Own the strategy, architecture and delivery roadmap for Prime Brokerage, Clearing and Collateral technology services, including CCP connectivity, clearing workflows, margin processing, collateral management and post-trade risk mitigation capabilities supporting global Markets businesses..
  • Drive platform modernisation, application simplification, AI-enabled engineering, automation and observability to improve resiliency, time-to-market, control effectiveness and cost discipline.
  • Provide senior engineering leadership across a global team, ensuring architecture, security, data, risk and operational design choices translate into measurable business and client outcomes.
  • Act as the senior technology partner for Product, Markets COO, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Architecture and Markets Technology leadership on Prime, Clearing and Collateral strategy and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

The role is accountable for strategic direction, delivery outcomes, technology risk management, stakeholder alignment and talent development across the Prime, Clearing & Collateral Services technology organisation.

  • Platform ownership and business outcomes: Lead technology delivery supporting new CCP onboarding, clearing expansion opportunities and regulatory market infrastructure changes, ensuring scalable and resilient integration with global clearing ecosystems. Partner with Prime Brokerage, Clearing Services, Operations, Markets COO and Product Owners teams to support business growth through expansion of clearing capabilities, onboarding of new CCPs, optimisation of margin utilisation and enhancement of collateral servicing capabilities.
  • Architecture and modernisation: Simplify legacy application estates and lead modernisation across PaCman, ION XTP and related integration, margin/collateral and clearing workflows, while managing obsolescence and technical debt.
  • AI engineering and automation: Embed AI engineering, intelligent automation and predictive analytics across clearing operations and collateral workflows to improve operational efficiency, control effectiveness and client service outcomes.
  • Controls, risk and regulatory readiness: Strengthen preventive and detective controls, data lineage, entitlement governance, audit readiness, cybersecurity remediation, exchange or CCP driven changes and regulatory obligations across the portfolio.
  • Strategy and transformation: Define and execute the multi-year technology strategy for Prime, Clearing & Collateral Services, aligned to Markets Technology, Post Trade Services, business growth, regulatory priorities and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Financial and portfolio governance: Partner with Finance, Portfolio, Product Owners and Technology leadership to prioritise investment, manage run and change spend, support budget submissions, and provide transparent executive reporting.
  • Stakeholder engagement: Engage senior stakeholders across Markets Trading, Prime Product, Markets COO, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Architecture, Cyber Security, Finance and Enterprise Technology to align priorities and resolve complex trade-offs.
  • Global people leadership: Lead a global team across key delivery locations, create clear accountabilities, coach senior leads, strengthen succession, and build a culture of engineering excellence, teamwork, inclusion and pro-business delivery.

People and Talent

  • Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  • Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
  • Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Prime Brokerage, Clearing & Collateral Management Domain Expertise
  • AI Engineering & Emerging Technologies
  • Technical Architecture & Platform Modernisation

Other Skills

  • Risk, Control and Compliance
  • Talent Development & Organisation Leadership
  • Strategic Business Partnership
  • Data & Integration Engineering

Motivations

This role is energised by solving complex cross-functional problems that combine deep technology, control rigour and business impact.

  • Building world-class engineering teams and creating a culture where high standards, collaboration and accountability are non-negotiable.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in client outcomes, resilience, risk reduction and time-to-market through modern engineering practices.
  • Shaping future-ready platforms by combining technical innovation, AI engineering and pragmatic delivery discipline.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • 15+ years of Financial Markets technology experience with significant leadership responsibility across Prime Brokerage, Clearing Services and Collateral Management. Demonstrated experience delivering CCP onboarding programmes, clearing connectivity solutions, margin transformation initiatives and large-scale post-trade technology modernisation.
  • Demonstrable experience in AI Engineering, including production-grade implementation or delivery of AI-enabled engineering outcomes.
  • Strong technical background with credibility to challenge architecture decisions, engage engineering teams deeply and translate technical choices into business outcomes.
  • Minimum 15 years of relevant business domain experience in Financial Markets technology, ideally including Prime Services, Clearing, Collateral, or broader post-trade environments.
  • Proven ability to lead global teams, cultivate engineering excellence, collaborate across functions and deliver pro-business outcomes in a controlled environment.

Certifications / Qualifications

  • Graduate degree required. Relevant certifications in Cloud, Cyber Security, Data, AI/ML or agile delivery are advantageous.

Languages

  • English required. Additional regional language capability is beneficial for global team and stakeholder engagement.

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Job Summary

Lead the global Settlements technology organisation, owning post-trade settlement capabilities across asset classes, including settlement processing, payment accuracy, settlement instruction integration, netting, exception management, controls and regulatory readiness.

  • Own the strategy, architecture and delivery roadmap for resilient, standardised and scalable settlement platforms, ensuring consistent processing from trade enrichment and instruction generation through payment, settlement status, accounting and exception resolution.
  • Drive platform modernisation, application simplification, data quality improvement, AI-enabled engineering, automation and observability to increase straight-through processing, reduce manual intervention and settlement risk, and improve resilience and cost discipline.
  • Provide senior engineering leadership across a global team, ensuring architecture, security, data, risk and operational design decisions translate into accurate, timely and controlled settlement outcomes.
  • Act as the senior technology partner for Markets Product, Markets COO, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Architecture and Markets Technology leadership on settlement strategy, transformation, service performance and regulatory delivery.

Key Responsibilities

The role holder leads others and is accountable for strategic direction, delivery outcomes, technology risk management, stakeholder alignment and talent development across the global Settlements technology organisation.

  • Strategy and transformation: Define and execute the multi-year settlement technology strategy across asset classes, aligned to Markets Technology, Post Trade Services, regulatory priorities and enterprise architecture standards.
  • End-to-end capability ownership: Own settlement processing from trade enrichment and settlement instruction integration through netting, payment generation, accounting, status management, exception handling and completion, with clear accountability for accuracy, timeliness and control.
  • Platform ownership and business outcomes: Lead resilient, standardised and scalable settlement platforms and integrations, improving straight-through processing, payment accuracy, capacity, stability, release quality and service performance.
  • Architecture and modernisation: Simplify legacy estates and drive convergence toward strategic settlement capabilities, including RATAN, GPTM, SSI+, LCM-CLS, FMSWIFTGATEWAY and related integration with upstream trade-processing and downstream payment, messaging, accounting and reporting services.
  • Controls, risk and regulatory readiness: Strengthen preventive and detective controls, settlement instruction quality, entitlement governance, data lineage, payment controls, audit readiness, cyber remediation and delivery of market, country and regulatory change.
  • Automation, AI and observability: Apply intelligent automation, AI engineering, workflow management and end-to-end monitoring to reduce exceptions and manual intervention, accelerate root-cause identification and improve operational outcomes.
  • Portfolio governance: Partner with Portfolio and Technology leadership to prioritise investment, manage run and change spend, address obsolescence and technical debt, and provide transparent executive reporting.
  • Stakeholder and people leadership: Partner with Product, Markets COO, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Architecture, Cyber Security and Enterprise Technology; lead a global team with clear accountabilities, strong succession and a culture of engineering excellence, inclusion and pro-business delivery.

  • Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  • Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
  • Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Cross-Asset Settlements Domain Expertise
  • Technology Strategy, Innovation and AI Enablement
  • Technology Platform and Engineering Leadership

Other Skills

  • Settlement Risk, Controls and Regulatory Readiness
  • People Leadership and Team Culture
  • Strategic Stakeholder and Portfolio Management
  • Operational Resilience and Service Management

Motivations

This role is energised by solving complex, cross-asset settlement challenges that combine deep technology, operational resilience, control rigour and measurable business impact.

  • Building high-performing global engineering teams and creating a culture where payment accuracy, resilience, collaboration and accountability are non-negotiable.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in settlement timeliness, straight-through processing, payment accuracy, operational resilience, risk reduction and time-to-market.
  • Shaping future-ready settlement platforms by combining standardisation, intelligent automation, AI engineering, strong controls and pragmatic delivery discipline.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • 15+ years of Financial Markets technology experience with significant leadership responsibility across cross-asset settlement and payment platforms. Demonstrated experience delivering settlement transformation, payment and instruction integration, netting, controls, regulatory change, resilience improvement and large-scale post-trade technology modernisation.
  • Demonstrable experience applying AI engineering, intelligent automation or advanced analytics to production technology and operational workflows, with clear control and business outcomes.
  • Strong technical background with credibility to challenge architecture and integration decisions across settlement processing, payment flows, messaging, data and controls, and translate technical choices into business outcomes.
  • Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in Financial Markets technology, ideally including cross-asset settlements, payments or broader post-trade environments.
  • Proven ability to lead global teams, cultivate engineering excellence, partner effectively with Operations and Product, and deliver resilient, controlled and scalable settlement outcomes.

Certifications / Qualifications

  • Graduate degree required. Relevant certifications in AI/ML delivery are advantageous.

Languages

  • English required. Additional regional language capability is beneficial for global team and stakeholder engagement.

Demonstrated experience delivering settlement transformation, payment and instruction integration, netting, controls, regulatory change, resilience improvement and large-scale post-trade technology modernisation.
- Demonstrable experience applying AI engineering, intelligent automation or advanced analytics to production technology and operational workflows, with clear control and business outcomes.

ln:4480773168.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Product Specialist is the driver of solution to the business requirement or user journey. The job holder has sound understanding on the product capabilities of the system/platform and able to drive solution with product owner, architect, vendor and supporting technology team. The job holder possesses deep product knowledge with strong technical skills to work on product innovation along with team and product vendors (IBM ODM). They work with product owner to derive product/system roadmap to deliver fit for purpose capabilities. This person should also be committed to the discovery and development of innovative solutions in an ever-changing digital landscape in banking industry.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Execution of functional standards and best practices
  • Acts as a conduit for the wider domain strategy, for example technical standards.
  • Prioritises and makes available capacity for technical debt.

Business

  • Development & Implementation: Build, test, and deploy well-designed, efficient, and reliable Java Spring Boot microservices as defined by the team's technical leads and architects.
  • Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code (unit, integration). Participate actively in code reviews to share knowledge and ensure adherence to team standards.
  • Feature Delivery: Work within an Agile squad to deliver user stories, tasks, and bug fixes, contributing to the regular release of new functionality.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with other developers, QA engineers, Engineering Lead and Product Owner to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Modernizations Support: Actively contribute to the migration of business rules and logic from the legacy IBM ODM system into the new services.
  • Monitoring & Support: Assist in monitoring the health of services in production and participate in the team's support, investigating and resolving issues.

Processes

  • Adopt and embed the Change Delivery Standards throughout the lifecycle of the product / service.
  • Follows the chapter operating model to ensure a system exists to continue to build capability and performance of the chapter.

Risk Management

  • Follows the standards with respect to risk management as applicable to their chapter domain.
  • Adheres to common practices to mitigate risk in their respective domain.

Governance

  • Ensure all artefacts and assurance deliverables are as per the required standards and policies (e.g., SCB Governance Standards, ESDLC etc.).

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholders

  • Architect, Engineering Leads.
  • Global Wealth Management Digital Owners, for business priority and initiatives.
  • Business & Technology Managers, for solution design and delivery.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Wealth Journey squad;
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures

Skills And Experience

  • Software Product Business Knowledge
  • Strong understanding of Wealth Journey and WM Sales Governance processes (onboarding New to Wealth customers, risk profiling, pre/post trade compliance check, portfolio performance and etc)
  • Software Product Technical Knowledge
  • Strong understanding of Wealth Journey Platform architecture, functionality, and capabilities, with hands-on experience in solution design, configuration, customisation, and integration.
  • Application servers – IBM WebSphere, JBOSS
  • Databases – Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL
  • Container Platform – OCP, AKS, EKS
  • Agile Methodologies
  • Software Change Request Management
  • Application Delivery Process
  • Technical Troubleshooting

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree, or higher, in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in backend development with a strong focus on Java.
  • Hands-on experience with the Spring Boot framework. You are comfortable building RESTful APIs and understand core Spring concepts.
  • Practical understanding of microservices architecture and API design.
  • Experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and writing efficient SQL.
  • Familiarity with version control (Git), and build tools like Maven or Gradle.
  • A solid foundation in software testing principles (e.g., JUnit, Mockito).
  • A keen interest in learning modern technologies and best practices.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills in English. You must be able to articulate ideas and collaborate effectively within your team.
  • A team-oriented mindset with a proactive and positive attitude.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have)

  • Any exposure to, or academic understanding of, IBM ODM, Drools, or other business rules engines.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • An interest in the financial services sector, particularly wealth management or investment products.
  • Experience working in a CI/CD environment.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4478995231.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Job Summary

  • The relevant IT risk and outsourcing regulations require the bank to retain effective internal IT management, including IT project initiation and management, and prohibit outsourcing of IT management responsibilities and other core IT capabilities. They also require formal processes for project prioritisation, initiation, approval and control, with major project progress reported to the IT Management Committee.
  • The local PMO is the governance mechanism through which China demonstrates these controls. This role leads a team responsible for country investment demand governance, the Country Project Governance Forum, reporting to CITGF and EXCO, localisation of Group project standards, and oversight of major programmes including ATLAS, SCPay, Catalyst and CIPS.
  • The role therefore provides local regulatory accountability and control rather than simply project delivery capacity.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Responsible for the overall management and governance of change initiatives run in China, ensuring business and strategic priorities and effective delivery of the work;
  • Support Country CTOO for the management of assigned new and enhanced product/projects throughout their development life cycle and on-going maintenance within China;
  • Represent Country CTOO to provide signoff on all aspects for assigned Project Implementation within China;
  • Represent Country CTOO to governance and control changes on ATLAS applications

Business

  • Leading a team to run Program Management Office (PMO) in China;
  • Leading a team to run Project Management (PM) in China;
  • To ensure Regional, Group and regulatory standards for project management and implementation are properly complied with and all the projects risks and issues are escalated and managed effectively;
  • Support the needs of the China Exco, and Regional MT in their duties with regards Project Governance Compliance for China;
  • Support China Business and Functional stakeholder requirement with respect to Project Investment Portfolio;
  • Support the needs and actions of the respective Quarterly Performance Review (QPR) with respect to China change initiated by country’s Business and Functions;
  • Provide supports to Ops-BAU functions for production problems, whenever necessary;
  • Team BAU Actual can be fully recovered from initiatives / projects.

Processes

  • Project Management (PM) – leading a team of PM to:
  • manage and to control project scope, duration, budget and risk within the appropriate methodology and with a view to quick scaling up of capacity while reconciling with the business and financial needs of the product programs;
  • ensure the business requirements for assigned products have been translated into specific functional and capability attributes;
  • provide appropriate level of project cost and resourcing estimates, starting at a high level during early definition and ultimately with the accuracy necessary for investment initiative and product program;
  • manage the end-to-end project plan, coordinating activities across all resources necessary to deliver projects and change management activities;
  • ensure integration of project architecture, process and procedure with overall SCB environment;
  • ensure all the documentation are in place with proper signoff & approval, follow Project Management Standards (PMS), New ways of Working Investment Management Standard (nWOWs) and System Delivery Framework (SDF) / Enterprise system delivery lifecycle framework (E-SDLC) to compliance with Bank’s Change Governance Policy;
  • ensure the project closure and handover to the BAU is completed successfully
  • achieve of project rollout targets and budget
  • Change Management (ATLAS) – as consultant to:
  • support analyzing the development requirements and requests from Business, Functions & Ops, assessing the impact of changes and validating the solutioning, throughout the e2e change delivery;
  • guide user acceptance testing (UAT) and user verification testing (UVT), recommend testing scenario / requirement and clarifying solutioning;
  • support BAU functions, perform feasibility study, investigation & reconciliation, identify solutions & conduct fixes for production problems, whenever necessary.
  • Program Management Office (PMO) -- leading a team of PMO to:
  • oversight of status of projects impacting China not originated by the China team, specifically including:
  • liaising with Group and Regional project teams in identifying, raising and resolving risks as they relate to China;
  • ensuring ‘One Bank’ approach to support successful implementation of those projects;
  • support local business and functional teams develop their project priorities;
  • support the local business and functional teams adhere to necessary project governance for project approval and delivery;
  • support local project managers via providing training, support and ad-hoc assistance to maintain required levels of governance;
  • support refresh and implementation of the Project Management Standards (PMS), New ways of Working Investment Management Standard (nWOWs) and System Delivery Framework (SDF)/ Enterprise system delivery lifecycle framework (E-SDLC) to compliance with Bank’s Change Governance Policy;
  • monitoring the progress of the portfolio of projects within China;
  • provide strategic direction and guidance to projects;
  • allocation of resources across projects to optimise usage;
  • ensure that the required approval for the project is obtained at each stage;
  • help steer project into the organisation by harnessing and managing the appropriate business support and ensuring there is proper information on flow to all stakeholders;
  • creating a centre of expertise of project management standards and best practices in China;
  • assist in removing project obstacles that may arise and help remediate project issues and risks;
  • provide quality assurance through monitoring the project’s progress, stakeholder’s commitment and quality of the results achieved;
  • control the overall project scope and oversee expenditure of project funds.

Risk Management

  • Balance business performance delivery and cost management with risk and control matters in projects to ensure that it does not materially threaten the Group, remaining within risk appetite;
  • Act quickly and decisively when any risk and control weakness become apparent in projects and ensure they are addressed within an appropriate timeframe and escalated through the relevant committees

Governance

  • Ensure awareness and full compliance of all laid down rules, regulations, policies, guidelines, procedures, practices and code of conduct imposed by the Group;
  • Ensure Business System in compliance with Audit, Securities, Operation Guidelines;

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Lead team to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: [Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.] *
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • NFRA/ PBOC / SAFE and other local Regulators in China.

Accountability

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review;
  • Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control;
  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of the event over which the employee has the duties of management and/or leadership;
  • Be responsible for significant losses due to failure of effectiveness of internal control

Other responsibility

  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures

People and Talent

  • Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  • Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
  • Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.
  • Coach team members through effective communication/coaching to deliver business goal;
  • Motivate team members to ensure a high morale and positive attitude to implement projects

Skills and Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Action Oriented
  • Collaborates
  • Courage
  • Instils Trust
  • Nimble Learning
  • Project Management

Other Skills

  • Decision Quality
  • Develops Talent
  • Drives Vision & Purpose
  • Gives Clarity and Guidance

Motivations

  • In China, navigating local regulatory complexities and market dynamics requires aligning global priorities with local business needs. The involvement in critical transformation programmes deliver measurable strategic value rather than just operational outputs.
  • Ensuring robust frameworks, processes, and governance structures that bring clarity, predictability, and efficiency to complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Fostering a high-performance culture and empowering teams across diverse, functional and geographic boundaries for better collaboration and greater efficiency.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Minimum of 10+ year experience in Banking field, with proven track record in leadership role under Project Management & Change Management, or Project Portfolio Governance Management

Certifications/Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree from a reputable university
  • A project management qualification is preferable (PMP, PRINCE2, PO, SCRUM Master)
  • Ability to work in a matrix organisation, working with resources across the organisation to complete deliverables and maintain effective working relationship
  • Strong analytical skills and project management skills
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Strong influencing skills with strong team orientation
  • Able to handle multi-tasks, manage time effectively and perform under pressure
  • Able to work at flexible hours and travel

Languages

  • Good command of spoken and written Chinese and English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Profile Description
