ln:4482955376.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • Oversee end-to-end banking regulatory reporting process including data collection and organization, understanding regulatory requirements, completing and submitting SCB China and branches regulatory reports. Ensure accurate, complete and on-time submission of all regulatory returns.
  • Support to identify and mitigate potential regulatory risks related to reporting errors, delays, or non-compliance, and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Support to act as the key liaison with external regulators, providing updates, responding to queries, and representing the company in regulatory discussions and inspections.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, work closely with legal, finance, risk, and IT departments to ensure consistency and completeness of data used in regulatory submissions and to address any compliance-related issues.
  • Support to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of reporting systems and tools to enhance efficiency and reduce manual processes through automation

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle regulatory (NFRA, PBOC, SAFE, the Bureau of Finance, the Bureau of Statistics etc.) returns preparation and submission, ensures that all regulatory submissions are accurate, complete, and submitted on time, as well as regulatory reporting instruction changes interpretation and implementation.
  • Support line manager to maintain robust quality control procedures to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all regulatory submissions, and reporting issues escalated through agreed governance channels.
  • Support PPG and China CA review and system upgrade project including end to end accounting flow review, upgrade the reporting logic, UAT support, regulatory reporting impact analysis to ensure compliance, accuracy and completeness.
  • Maintain good relationships with relevant internal departments, assist the line manager in coordinating with the finance department and other internal functional departments for discussions, such as establishing reporting procedures for new reporting requirements, and promptly and properly resolving related regulatory reporting issues.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Support line manager to drive process and system optimisation improvements in processes, reporting, data quality through reporting automation while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Solid knowledge of banking accounting and regulatory reporting rules
  • Hands-on experience in end-to-end regulatory reporting process
  • Strong data analysis and problem-solving abilities

Other Skills

  • High attention to detail and strict regulatory risk awareness
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Strong accountability and ability to work under high pressure

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, very stringent regulatory environment casts great pressure on regulatory reporting including tight local reporting deadline, continuous changing reporting requirements, energized by the fast-paced, deadline-driven nature of regulatory reporting, motivated by the challenge of meeting tight deadlines under pressure while maintaining accuracy and compliance.
  • Motivated by the opportunity to streamline regulatory reporting processes, reduce errors, and enhance efficiency, driven by outcomes such as improved reporting accuracy, more efficient reporting process, reduced compliance risks etc.
  • Performs best in environments that encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing, and professional growth, motivated by working with cross-functional teams build a strong, capable regulatory reporting function.
  • Continuous learning and adaptability required, motivated by the need to stay current with regulatory changes, emerging technologies, and industry best practices, enjoy learning and applying new automation tools and methodologies to improve reporting systems and outcomes.
  • Driven by a commitment to ethical standards and accountability, motivated by the responsibility to uphold the organization’s reputation and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience dealing complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure

Certifications/Qualifications

  • CICPA & ACCA is preferred

Languages

  • Chinese and English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

ln:4483723596.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Principal Engineer (Group AI Platforms)

Why join us?

The Group AI Platforms team sits within CTO Platforms, part of HSBC’s Chief Technology Office (CTO). We build shared AI foundations that enable teams across the Bank to deliver AI solutions faster, more safely and at scale.

Our platform provides a “paved road” for AI delivery, bringing together seamless access to AI models and infrastructure, a consistent Agent HUB to build, deploy and manage production-ready AI agents, reusable AI capabilities (such as knowledge management and document intelligence), and built-in controls including guardrails, evaluation and monitoring to support responsible adoption.

We’re a global team with an established footprint across Asia (Hong Kong, Mainland China, India) and Europe (Poland, UK), and we continue to expand to support delivery across regions. Joining the team means working at the centre of HSBC’s AI enablement—partnering with multiple lines of business and functions across regions to turn AI capabilities into reliable, repeatable services that deliver measurable business value.

Demonstrates an AI-native mindset, applying AI-driven approaches to improve productivity, quality, and decision-making.

The Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer in Group AI Platforms, you’ll shape the technical strategy and provide architecture oversight for HSBC’s next-generation AI platform. You’ll help establish the engineering foundations that enable AI capabilities to be delivered reliably, securely and at scale across the Bank.

The role will focus on strengthening the resilience, scalability, performance and operability of core AI platform services, including the AI Gateway, security guardrails, model hosting and related foundation services. These capabilities are designed to provide dependable, always-on access to AI models and services across business applications—much like essential electricity infrastructure: consistently available when needed and capable of supporting high levels of demand.

You’ll help define the target architecture and engineering standards for a unified gateway ecosystem spanning LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway and Agent Gateway, alongside Guardrails as a Service. You’ll also identify and adopt relevant advances in AI and cloud-native engineering to ensure the platform remains secure, efficient and fit for the evolving needs of the Bank.

As a senior technical authority, you’ll establish engineering best practice, drive adoption across platform delivery teams and raise the standard for production readiness. You’ll champion AI-native development practices that improve delivery efficiency, software quality and engineering decision-making—while ensuring that human accountability, security, resilience and responsible use remain central.

What You Will Need To Succeed In The Role

  • Significant experience operating as a Principal Engineer or senior technical authority in a large-scale enterprise technology environment.
  • Extensive experience designing, building or operating shared platforms used by multiple product and application teams.
  • Strong experience with gateway platforms, service control planes, API mediation layers, service meshes or comparable enterprise integration platforms.
  • Experience designing platforms that support high availability, high concurrency, low latency, traffic management, rate limiting, routing, authentication and policy enforcement.
  • Practical understanding of security controls for AI systems, including: policy enforcement and access control; data protection and secure integration; auditability and traceability; model and capability governance; and runtime guardrails and monitoring.
  • Strong knowledge of production readiness, including non-functional requirements for resilience, observability, security, performance, scalability, operability and recoverability.
  • Working knowledge of Golang and/or Python for platform tooling, service integration, experimentation or adjacent production development.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native production systems, including deployment patterns, networking, scaling, service discovery, resilience and incident troubleshooting.
  • Experience implementing modern delivery practices such as automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, canary deployment, progressive delivery, A/B testing and automated rollback.
  • Familiarity with LLM gateways, MCP-based integrations, agent platforms or comparable emerging AI infrastructure is desirable.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A collaborative leadership style and a commitment to knowledge sharing, coaching and raising engineering standards across a global team.

Job Description

Job responsibilities

  • Responsible for the overall planning, construction, and operation management of the company's cloud platforms (private cloud, virtualization platform, and public cloud resources), ensuring the stable and highly available operation of business systems;
  • Designed the company's cloud network architecture, dedicated line and VPN connections, VPC and subnet division, DNS, outbound and NAT, cloud routing, as well as isolation of production and testing network environments to meet regulatory requirements;
  • Design cloud platform account and resource hierarchies, identity and access management, tags and naming standards, formulate and implement full lifecycle cloud resource management strategies, covering resource application, approval, delivery, monitoring, capacity planning, and recovery, promoting standardization and automation of resource delivery;
  • Build and maintain an automation foundation, enabling infrastructure as code, configuration management, and autonomous delivery, lead the construction and operation of container cloud platforms (Kubernetes, Docker), and promote cloud migration and cloud-native architecture transformation;
  • Capacity planning and management of cloud platforms, version management of each component, and patch updates ensure platform stability and security;
  • Responsible for cloud platform security and compliance, implementing regulatory requirements for Cybersecurity Classified Protection 3.0, data security, and personal information protection, and cooperating with internal and external audits and regulatory inspections;
  • Continuously conduct cloud cost analysis and optimization, establish resource utilization efficiency evaluation mechanisms, and reasonably control IT operating costs;
  • Establish and improve systems, processes, and SOP documents related to cloud platform operation and maintenance, and manage third-party suppliers and cloud service providers related to the platform;
  • Maintain close collaboration with the Group's IT team to implement the Group's global cloud security standards, technical specifications, and management requirements within the company;
  • Track technological development trends in the cloud computing field, assess the application value of new technologies to company business, and provide professional advice for IT architecture evolution.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, software engineering, network engineering, or related fields;
  • Over 8 years of experience in cloud platform planning, construction, or operations and maintenance; candidates with background in fund companies, securities firms, banks, or other financial institutions are preferred;
  • Proficient in mainstream virtualization technologies such as VMware vSphere, familiar with OpenStack architecture or mainstream private cloud platforms, and familiar with at least one public cloud (Alibaba Cloud, AWS, or Azure) architecture and product architecture;
  • Familiar with container technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker, with experience in container platform production environment operations and maintenance, proficient in Linux operating system, and proficient in at least one scripting or development language in Python, Shell, or Go;
  • Familiar with basic IaaS principles, including computing virtualization, distributed storage, virtual networks, load balancing, imaging, snapshots, elastic scaling, and other basic cloud components; familiar with and able to build cloud platform monitoring systems;
  • Familiar with TCP/IP networking, storage, and backup disaster recovery technologies; knowledgeable about IaC (Terraform, Ansible); able to develop scripts and automate integration based on cloud platform APIs;
  • Capable of cloud platform capacity assessment, performance tuning, complex fault troubleshooting, as well as solution writing and cross-team project advancement;
  • Familiar with cloud security systems, understanding the Cybersecurity Law, Data Security Law, Personal Information Protection Law, and regulatory requirements of the securities and fund industry;
  • Fluent in English, able to work as a working language, able to communicate effectively with the Global team;
  • Excellent communication, coordination, documentation, and problem-solving abilities; meticulous and meticulous work experience, strong sense of responsibility, team spirit, and certain team leadership abilities.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Holds cloud computing certifications such as Alibaba Cloud ACP/ACE, AWS, Azure, etc.;
  • Experience in cloud platform maintenance and management for securities and fund companies;

ln:4483701318.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

ob Description

KYC Quality Control is a process that is independent from the sales/relationship management channel and assists the LOB/Customer KYC Owner in ensuring their KYC records meet the requirements of the firm's policies, standards, and guidelines, and the LOB-specific KYC procedures.

Responsibilities

As part of the Quality Control team, the core functional responsibilities and expectations include, but are not limited to, as followings:

  • Understanding the firm's KYC requirements when reviewing documentation inclusive of Customer Identification Program (CIP), Standard Due Diligence (SDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), Local Due Diligence (LDD), Specialized Due Diligence (SpDD) and Product Due Diligence requirements (PDD)
  • Reviewing KYC information and documentation for new customers, periodic reviews and ad hoc activities
  • Ensuring consistency among and within the various KYC documents
  • Verifying the accuracy of information provided, including confirming that information and documents are current and unexpired, as applicable
  • Identifying and assessing red flags and any other potentially concerning information and evaluating the appropriateness of the assigned AML risk rating.
  • Ensuring the review task is completed before the due date and within SLA requirement
  • Communicating/escalating issues to management when applicable
  • Being part of the holistic client review team to follow up on outstanding alignment items within various LOBs and/or GFCC to close loop on the alignment
  • Being flexible to work on other migration/remediation projects including Screening resolution, other LOB holistic alignment or Quality Assurance

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree and/or above
  • Fluent English is mandatory, both written and verbally
  • Proficient PC skills including Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  • Excellent communication skills both written and verbal
  • Relentless and versatile learner with an aptitude for assimilating new industry, company, product or technical knowledge
  • Highly organized, proactive and motivated with strong prioritization skills, innovation and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated, consistent professional presence with the ability to adapt to evolving needs and situations
  • Sense of urgency/ability to work well under pressure and tight deadlines
  • Demonstrates flexibility and willingness to accept new assignments and challenges in a rapidly changing environment, as well as handling multiple tasks and changing priorities on a daily basis
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in the Financial Services industry with a demonstrated track-record of delivery and/or relevant experience in Compliance and KYC
  • Ability to identify risks and issues and successfully navigate through to completion
  • Self-reliance and willingness to "own" problems and creatively find solutions
  • Ability to multi-task in a constantly changing, global, virtual team environment.
  • Comfortable liaising with onshore teams and other remote Team members
  • Able to critically challenge with the goal of identifying control issues and process improvement opportunities.
  • Flexible and willing to stretch.

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

The Corporate Salesperson is a strategic professional who stays abreast of developments within own field and contributes to directional strategy by considering their application in own job and the business. Recognized technical authority for an area within the business. Requires basic commercial awareness. There are typically multiple people within the business that provide the same level of subject matter expertise. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Significant impact on the area through complex deliverables. Provides advice and counsel related to the technology or operations of the business. Work impacts an entire area, which eventually affects the overall performance and effectiveness of the sub-function/job family.

Responsibilities

  • Sell separate account services or finance products directly to Corporate clients
  • Will help team to service clients in the buying and selling of securities, derivatives, FX and commodities
  • Help drive the team's developed strategy across specified product lines
  • Aid to achieve specified goals in both market and wallet share for the identified client franchise
  • Originate and execute meaningful and landmark transactions
  • Will independently and/or jointly work within business product to achieve the strategic growth and market share we are aiming for
  • Partner closely with other key businesses and functions to ensure proper product deployment based on understanding of client
  • Help foster an environment of collaboration through interfacing with appropriate internal partners to enhance share of mind with clients, increase dialogue and to deliver on expertise
  • Understand and analyze clients’ businesses and exposures to provide best suited sales solutions in full coordination with all relevant business partners
  • Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
  • Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
  • Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation.
  • Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Recommended Qualifications

  • 6-10 years of experience
  • Previous experience in client-facing roles with proven track record on growing and maintaining relationships through value added service and commercial skills
  • An entrepreneurial approach for business origination and developing new relationships
  • Demonstrated interpersonal skills


Education

  • Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Be responsible for successful implementation of Premier Acquisition strategies
  • Acquire new-to-bank customers via central or self-generated leads.
  • In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to complete simple retail sales.
  • Development of strong working relationships with relevant business areas (e.g., WPB, Marketing, etc)
  • Delivery high standard customer service to meet customer satisfactory
  • 负责中高端客户的开发，发掘关于银行服务的需求并发展为汇丰客户

  • 为客户提供优良的服务，完成基本的零售销售指标
  • 与相关业务领域建立牢固的工作关系（如：财富管理及个人银行业务部，市场部）
  • 提供高标准的客户服务，提高客户满意度

Qualifications - External

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of one year proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
  • Sound knowledge of various forms of deposits, WEM product, mortgage, etc.
  • Knowledge of the constantly changing laws/regulations governing banks/finance industry, consumer trends, competitor offerings, economic and foreign currency markets
  • Strong presentation and sales skills
  • Objection handling techniques and work under pressure
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Customer service orientation
  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
  • Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN
  • 本科以上或同等学历
  • 至少一年金融服务或零售经验，或同等工作经验

  • 对行业法规，消费趋势，竞争对手的产品，经济和外汇市场趋势有较好的了解
  • 较好的演讲和销售技巧
  • 较好的异议处理技巧，能在高压下工作
  • 良好的人际交往和沟通能力
  • 以客户服务为导向
  • 根据市场要求获得适当的专业和监管资格

ln:4483606371.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

We are seeking a talented and motivated senior JAVA software engineer to join a high performing Scrum team to roll out new digital solution for customers. The candidate must be a skilled professional who has high availability software development experience with a desire to work on an Agile, dynamic and flat organisational structure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop the business logic and backend systems of the product
  • Work closely with frontend developers to design and develop functional, performing and complete APIs
  • Write both unit and integration tests, and develop automation tools for daily tasks
  • Develop high quality, well documented, and efficient code
  • Challenge ideas and opinions to avoid pitfalls and inefficient solutions
  • Collaborate with product managers and other tech leads to ensure applications meet functional requirements and strategic objectives.

Strategy

  • Responsible for the quality of the code repository where applicable.

Business

  • Deliver outputs that make a significant contribution to the organization's strategic goals.

Processes

  • Responsible in the preparation of production outputs and their planning in alignment to ESDLC standards.

People & Talent

  • Work on upskilling of technical expertise in line with latest market trend.

Risk Management

  • Mitigate delivery risks and issues, and ensure quality, affordability, and scope of delivery.

Governance

  • Ensure all artefacts and assurance deliverables are as per the required standards and policies

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Chapter Lead
  • Engineering Lead
  • Release Manager
  • Business Leads / Product owners
  • Production Support

Skills And Experience

  • Spring Boot
  • Spring Framework
  • Hibernate / MyBatis
  • RESTful API
  • Problem Resolving
  • Container – OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes
  • DB2 / Oracle / PostgreSQL
  • Messaging – Queue, Topic
  • DevOps / ADO

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, with preference given to advanced degrees.
  • Minimum experience of 3 years in Java application development.
  • Have a high enthusiasm for programming and new technology learning, have a strong learning ability.
  • Proficient in RESTful API, SOAP, JDK, SpringBoot 3.x, k8s, JUnit.
  • Should have knowledge on Relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and/or No-SQL Databases and ability to write basic SQL queries.
  • Should be independently able to manage CICD tasks using Git, Azure DevOps (ADO), Maven, Ansible, and Helm Charts
  • Experienced in Container Infrastructure such as Docker, Linux, Kubernetes, OCP or AWS EKS or Azure AKS. Implement microservices architecture to ensure scalability and maintainability.
  • Fluent English speaking/listening/reading/writing. Mandarin or Cantonese language ability will be an advantage.
  • Language: English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Job Type

Full Time

Job Reference #

342439BR

City

Shanghai

Key Responsibilities

UBS Evidence Lab is looking for a web mining engineer to join its Execution team. The teams’ focus is building scalable frameworks and services used to analyse large datasets in the context of financial analysis and alternative data. They leverage well-established engineering processes and techniques pioneered by giants in the tech industry. Projects span general pipelining to collecting valuable data from various sources and helping develop robust and sustainable data pipeline.

Responsibilities:

  • develop data collecting scripts to be leveraged by clients, internally and externally
  • maintain existing projects and ensure its robustness, acceptable performance and reliability
  • maintain a high standard of code quality within the broader Execution team
  • adapt the latest data processing and infrastructure techniques to our growing stack

The team

You'll be working in the Evidence Lab team in UBS Shanghai office.

Diversity helps us grow, together. That’s why we are committed to fostering and advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion. It strengthens our business and brings value to our clients.

Your Skills And Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

  • formal education in Computer Science or related quantitative field
  • fluent English communication skill
  • second-nature knowledge of SQL
  • solid programming skill in JavaScript or Python
  • knowledge of networking basics
  • knowledge of algorithms and data structures
  • Basic understanding of the financial market and/or financial analysis

Preferred Qualifications:

  • experience with web scraping
  • experience with website frontend and backend design
  • experience with agile development
  • experience with Apache Spark
  • experience with vibe coding
  • excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

About Us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

Join us

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. ln:4484074253.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系

根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门

配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline

At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳

至少5年以上客户经理经验

具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系

具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣

成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧

普通话及英语流利

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. ln:4484062406.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Business Design and Capabilities Associate.

Principal responsibilities

  • Gather and analyse business requirements to design and develop technical solutions with fast turnaround times.
  • Build, test, and deploy applications and tools that support Risk & Compliance 2LOD activities.
  • Standardise and automate common capabilities to deliver efficiency, scalability, and consistency.
  • Collaborate with IT, financial engineering, and operational risk teams to ensure solutions meet business needs and internal standards.
  • Maintain strong governance and documentation standards, ensuring compliance with internal controls, audit, and risk policies.
  • Support the conversion of EUC solutions into enterprise-grade applications, ensuring control, resilience, and efficiency.

Requirements

  • 5+ years’ experience in software/application development in a large corporate or regulated environment.
  • Proven expertise in rapid prototyping and tactical tool development; proficiency in Python is required.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and supervisory expectations for risk and compliance processes, data quality, and model governance.
  • Strong understanding of Risk & Compliance processes, preferably within financial services.
  • Ability to manage and prioritise multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4483618968.descriptionHtml:
Key Responsibilities

This role could be based in China or Hong Kong. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.

Strategy

Set CPM Markets’ global funding and resource optimisation strategy, including delivery of the CFD mandate, to improve FM revenues and returns within funding, liquidity and regulatory constraints.

Develop CPM Markets’ CFD function as FM’s central funding utility, with clear priorities, targets, management information and governance.

Shape FM’s Funds Transfer Pricing policy and framework with Treasury, Finance and Markets, aligning funding, liquidity and balance-sheet costs with business decisions.

Translate capital, liquidity and margin developments into strategic priorities, management information and system requirements for FM and CIB.

Own the Client Term Deposits (CTD) product strategy and roadmap, aligning its proposition with FM priorities and Treasury Markets’ funding and liquidity requirements.

Business

Lead FM funding and regulatory-cost (LCR/ NSFR) management, balancing growth, profitability and resource constraints.

Partner with Repo and Structuring to raise cash through money markets, ABCP and structured notes, minimising funding and regulatory P&L drag.

Align Sales, Trading, CPM, Treasury, Finance and governance forums on FM funding, liquidity, Corporate Plan and balance-sheet priorities.

Partner with Sales to deliver the CTD strategy and commercial agenda, originating and executing solutions that meet Treasury Markets’ funding and stress liquidity needs.

Processes

Manage FM’s daily cash funding and leverage requirements within approved limits.

Monitor funding costs, liquidity usage and regulatory constraints, escalating emerging risks and recommending appropriate mitigation.

Mark CFD asset and liability funding curves and maintain the funding pipeline.

Manage FM intragroup exposures within approved limits.

Execute funding, inventory and collateral optimisation to reduce regulatory and P&L drag and redeploy leverage to higher-returning assets.

Implement regulatory and policy changes through fit-for-purpose processes, management information and systems.

Provide guidance to Product Management and Technology on the CTD roadmap, enhancing the product experience and enabling seamless delivery for Sales.

People & Talent

Set clear expectations and foster a collaborative, accountable and inclusive culture.

Communicate CPM Markets’ vision, CFD priorities and progress clearly.

Build team capability through coaching, knowledge-sharing and continuous improvement.

Risk Management

Identify and manage the principal risks arising from FM funding and resource optimisation.

Operate within the dealer mandate, risk appetite, limits and applicable policies.

Escalate material risks and control issues promptly and complete required attestations and training.

Manage risk and P&L of a trading book

Governance

Assess governance and control effectiveness and oversee remediation.

Discharge responsibilities in line with regulatory obligations and Group standards.

Provide effective challenge, speak up on breaches and engage openly with regulators and control functions.

Skills And Experience

Dealing experience in financial instruments e.g. FX swaps, interest rate swaps

Competency in analysing market risk and PNL on trading positions

Knowledge and understanding of key balance sheet metrics (LCR, NSFR, leverage ratio, RWA etc)

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.

CFA, FRM, CPA or similar professional qualification would be advantageous but not mandatory.

Experience in Markets, Treasury, ALM, Funding, Liquidity Management, Product Control, Market Risk, or Financial Resource Management.

Exposure to trading products such as: FX swaps, Money Markets, Repo / Reverse Repo, Bonds, Structured Deposits and Securities Financing Transactions

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4483634593.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Customer sales and service

职责范围：

客户销售与服务

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.
  • Deliver allocated performance targets for various product VSs;
  • Maintain relationship with customers and deliver superior customer service to ensure customers’ needs are met;
  • Enhance bank-customer relationships by expanding existing customers’ portfolio holdings;
  • Actively participate in Priority Banking / other Bank’s marketing and promotional activities to acquire NTB customers, as well as cross-selling to existing customers;
  • Proactively engage with Personal Clients hidden affluent and advise to approach bank with complex investment needs;
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
  • Ensure compliance of Management Manual, Operating Manuals and Bank’s laid down knowledge of the various products offered by all departments;
  • Learn and understand all relevant regulations and internal Risk & Compliance policies and procedures;
  • Keep updated on the events in the financial industry;
  • Participate actively in training programs, meetings, briefings organized by the bank and ensure skills & knowledge acquired is applied to daily work;
  • Ensure timeliness & managing customer’s complaint;

主要工作职责/挑战：

  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。
  • 实现领导安排的各个产品的业绩指标；
  • 维护与客户的关系并提供卓越的客户服务以确保满足客户需求；
  • 通过扩大现有客户的投资组合加强客户与我行的关系；
  • 积极参与优先理财/其它银行营销项目，以获取新客户。另外，向现有客户进行交叉销售；
  • 主动发现具有“优先理财”资质的个人理财客户, 并发掘其投资理财需求；
  • 负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
  • 遵循银行的管理手册，操作手册和所有部门相关产品的既定政策；
  • 学习并了解一切相关条例以及内部风险与合规的政策与程序；
  • 保持对金融行业相关动向的敏感；
  • 积极参与银行组织的培训项目，会议和简报会，并保证将学习到的技能和知识运用到日常工作中；
  • 确保客户投诉的时效与管理；

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Financial skills
  • Analytical skills

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • Full time Bachelor’s degree, or AMAC Fund Qualification Certificate Holder.
  • 1 year or above working experience in financial industry, acting in good faith and professional ethics. Have a good command of knowledge about wealth management sales activities related regulations
  • Sound knowledge of financial products and services and banking procedures, equities markets, unit trusts and other personal investment services are preferred.
  • Good investment counseling and analytical skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to deal with all levels of people, often in complex and difficult situations.
  • Team player who shows initiative and assertiveness.
  • Self-motivator who is keen to upgrade, improve personal knowledge and skills to meet job requirements.
  • Good command of both spoken and written English and Mandarin

职位要求：

  • 全日制大学本科学历，或持有基金从业资格证书。
  • 从事金融工作1年以上，具备良好的诚信记录及职业操守
  • 熟悉理财业务活动及理财产品销售相关的法律法规
  • 熟悉银行产品、服务、银行程序、股票市场、单位信托以及其它个人投资服务。
  • 具备良好的投资咨询和分析技巧。
  • 出色的人际关系能力和沟通能力，能在复杂场合应付自如。
  • 具有团队意识，主动坚定。
  • 有上进心，能自我激励，不断提高人际交流能力和技巧，以满足工作要求。

Coverage Banking Internship Programme 2027

Join our Coverage Banking team and gain first-hand experience supporting some of the world’s leading corporates, financial institutions, investors and public sector clients. As part of the client-facing arm of Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB), you’ll work alongside experienced bankers to help deliver integrated banking solutions, build client relationships and support strategic growth opportunities across markets.

With our unique international footprint, you’ll gain exposure to cross-border business, global clients and real-world banking challenges. You’ll work across teams, products and geographies while developing the commercial, analytical and relationship-building skills that underpin a successful career in banking.

Join us if you’re curious about how businesses grow, how financial markets operate and how trusted client relationships are built.

About the Internship Programme – how you’ll learn and grow 

Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background. Over 10 weeks, you’ll work on real business challenges, build future-ready skills, and gain insight into how we support clients, facilitate trade and finance growth across our markets. Working alongside colleagues across our global network, you’ll develop the skills, confidence and connections to accelerate your career. For many interns, this is the first step towards a graduate role with us.

The Programme Will Support Your Development Through

  • A 10-week summer internship 
  • A structured induction and orientation 
  • Exposure to our products, clients and international network
  • Real projects and meaningful responsibilities from day one
  • Technical, professional and behavioural skills development
  • Support from managers, mentors and buddies
  • Opportunities to learn from senior leaders and industry experts
  • Community and volunteering initiatives.

Where you could work

You will be placed into one of the following Coverage Banking teams, working alongside experienced bankers to support client relationships, business development activities and transaction execution across our global franchise.

  • Corporate Coverage: Support relationship teams managing multinational corporations, large local corporates and mid-market clients. You’ll gain exposure to financing solutions, transaction banking, capital markets activities and strategic client engagement while learning how long-term client relationships are developed and managed.
  • Financial Institutions Coverage: Work with teams covering banks, insurance companies, asset managers, sovereign entities and other financial institutions. You’ll gain insight into how financial institutions access financing, manage risk and utilise the Bank’s global capabilities to support their businesses.
  • Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A): Gain exposure to landmark transactions including acquisitions, divestments, mergers and strategic partnerships. You’ll support research, analysis and deal execution activities while learning how clients navigate transformational business decisions.

Bring the skills - we’ll help you build your career

We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.

We’re Looking For People Who Can

  • Take ownership and show initiative.
  • Think critically and solve problems using logic and sound judgement.
  • Learn quickly, stay curious and seek opportunities to grow.
  • Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with others
  • Adapt and perform in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrate commercial curiosity and an interest in clients, industries and global markets.
  • Communicate confidently and work effectively across different cultures and backgrounds.

Eligibility   

To be eligible for this internship, you should be a penultimate year student, able to intern in June 2027, and start full time in July 2028. You should have the permanent legal right to work in the country you’re applying to.   

You can only submit one application within a six-month period, so take time to review our opportunities and apply for the role that best fits your interests, skills and career goals.

Key Dates

  • Assessment Centres: October 2026 onwards
  • Start Date: June 2027

About Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) 

We are a super-connector for many of the world’s largest companies across more than 50 markets, playing a central role in global trade, capital flows and economic growth. We work with governments, financial institutions, and some of the world’s most ambitious corporates to help them expand, invest, and navigate uncertainty across increasingly complex and fast-changing markets.

What makes us distinctive is our combination of deep local expertise with an extensive and unique global network. We support clients across risk management, financing, transaction services, advisory, and sustainable finance, helping move capital to where it’s needed most and supporting the real economy across our footprint.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

Job Description

Your role will be crucial in ensuring the accuracy, efficiency, and completeness of BAU transaction processing or regulatory reporting.

﻿As an Operations Transaction Analyst, you'll be assigned as transaction processing and reporting maker or checker. You'll be responsible to ensure the accuracy, efficiency and completeness of BAU transaction processing or regulatory reporting.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide Support and Control on RMB/FCY payment, deposit, account maintenance, liquidity, cash transactions, Trade products
  • Coordinate with both clients and remote processing hubs for Cash & Trade products
  • Administering defined procedures, analysis and report preparation, and exception processing
  • Prepare regulatory report and / or verification
  • Escalate unusual problems to manager
  • Ensure day to day operations to be in compliance with internal policies and procedures as well as local regulations
  • Support system testing and maintenance
  • Handle enquiries from internal business partners and external clients
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve operations efficiency and control

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Open to fresh graduates; 3+ years experience in Cash/Trade operations is preferred
  • Good understanding of internal controls and compliance in local regulations on cash operations
  • Detail oriented and methodical, good analytical skills
  • Good inter-personal and communication skills
  • Good time management skill, ability to work under pressure
  • Demonstrable self-motivation and initiation
  • Fluent written and oral communication skills in English and Mandarin

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

The Corporate & Investment Bank is a global leader across investment banking, wholesale payments, markets and securities services. The world's most important corporations, governments and institutions entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. We provide strategic advice, raise capital, manage risk and extend liquidity in markets around the world.

ln:4484076751.descriptionHtml:
Transaction Services Graduate Programme 2027

We partner with clients across Corporate & Investment Banking to deliver innovation solutions through cash management, trade and supply chain finance, and digital banking solutions. Leveraging data, technology and our global network, we help clients optimise liquidity, manage risk and unlock growth opportunities across borders.

About the Graduate Programme – how you’ll learn and grow

Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background. Over our two-year graduate programme, you’ll gain hands-on experience, build lasting relationships and grow your understanding of clients, markets and the wider business. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work and be supported to build a successful long-term career.

You’ll Benefit From

  • Real impact: Take ownership of meaningful work that contributes to business outcomes.
  • Future-ready capabilities: Build the technical, commercial and professional skills needed to succeed.
  • Global collaboration: Work with colleagues and clients across markets, products and functions
  • Continuous growth: Learn from structured development, mentoring and practical experience

Where you could work

During the assessment process, we’ll help match you to the role that best fits your strengths and interests:

  • Cash Management: Shape how global clients move money, optimising liquidity, powering real-time seamless payments, and driving innovation across markets.
  • Trade: Enable global trade by helping buyers and sellers transact securely and efficiently.
  • Implementation: Oversee the delivery of products and services to clients, ensuring seamless digital integration and execution.
  • Transaction Banking Sales: Drive business growth by identifying client needs, shaping product solutions, and building long-term relationships.
  • Digital Channel Solutions: Enable seamless client connectivity thorough innovative digital ecosystem of channels and platforms

Bring the skills - we’ll help you build your career 

We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.

We’re Looking For People Who Can

  • Take ownership and show initiative when tackling challenges
  • Think critically and solve problems using logic, analysis and sound judgement
  • Learn quickly and stay curious, seeking opportunities to grow and develop
  • Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with others
  • Adapt and perform under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrate commercial curiosity and an interest in clients, markets and global trends

Eligibility

To be eligible for this graduate programme, you need to be in your final year of study and graduating by July 2027. You must also have the permanent legal right to work in the country you’re applying to.

You can only submit one application within a six-month period, so take time to review our opportunities and apply for the role that best fits your interests, skills and career goals.

Key Dates

  • Assessment Centres: October 2026 onwards
  • Start Date: July 2027 

About Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) 

We are a super-connector for many of the world’s largest companies across more than 50 markets, playing a central role in global trade, capital flows and economic growth. We work with governments, financial institutions, and some of the world’s most ambitious corporates to help them expand, invest, and navigate uncertainty across increasingly complex and fast-changing markets.

What makes us distinctive is our combination of deep local expertise with an extensive and unique global network. We support clients across risk management, financing, transaction services, advisory, and sustainable finance, helping move capital to where it’s needed most and supporting the real economy across our footprint.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

ln:4484413939.descriptionHtml:
CIB COO (Corporate and Institutional Banking)

Our COO team delivers strategic execution for Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) across the globe. Through transformative data and digital solutions, customer servicing, and non-financial risk expertise, this team is where problems are solved, and careers are made.

CIB COO Focuses On These Key Priorities

  • Protecting the bank, our customers and stakeholders by enhancing our operational resilience, strengthen our control environment, and improve risk management.
  • Driving operational excellence and efficiency by optimising our processes and delivering the transition to net zero in our own operations.
  • Enabling business growth exceptional service by enabling our businesses to focus on our competitive advantage and deliver transformation and digitisation across the bank.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Handle account related services, e.g. corporate account opening, corporate account information update, Audit confirmation, Deposit related service, and etc.
  • Playing key role in Business enabling from Operations side to assist frontline in resolving account related inquiries raised by customers and frontline staff.
  • Take proper action to ensure all account service related instructions are processed within set turnaround time and full adherence to service level agreement. Monitor the accuracy and timeliness of account related regulatory system input to avoid operational error and loss and assist line manager to set up control mechanism within responsible area.
  • Monitor irregular/outstanding cases and handle exceptional cases within responsible area to avoid operational risk as well as to ensure no customer complaint. Scrutinize system reports within responsible area and take proper follow-up actions to ensure exception is monitored and rectified. Register and report errors and anomalies daily in the exception reports to relief manager while correcting errors to assure compliance and customer satisfaction.
  • Act as a coordinator between branch Operations Account Service Team and frontline staff, as well as with back office staff, to smooth the whole process and improve efficiency. Being an expertise in account services area to continuously provide professional solution towards internal and external customers' problems and inquiries.
  • Learn relative internal/external regulation. Identify the improvement need and act as a mentor to ensure their daily work complies with the bank principle.
  • Commitment and sense of responsibility. To maintain good attendance record without unjustifiable absence; to completes work assignment on schedule.
  • Keep high level of service standard for internal and external customers
  • Maintain HSBC internal control standards, implement and observe Group Compliance Policy and maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring
  • Take up backup tasks for other operations roles as assigned by line manager when necessary and work with team spirit.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor degree or above, working experience in operations field is preferable.
  • Demonstrate proactive attitude and able to work under pressure and have a ability to solve the problem with efficiency and meticulous to details.
