ln:4484406806.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Join JPMorgan, where you will have the opportunity to make real innovative impacts to our customers and be part of a dynamic environment where every day brings new challenges and opportunities.

As a Transactions Analyst within JPMorgan Chase, you will have a direct impact on our team and department, ensuring smooth and efficient transaction processes. You will leverage your knowledge of transaction management to identify and resolve issues, guided by established practices and procedures. Your role will involve providing management with data and analytics to assist with targeted coaching and mentoring of Specialists and enhancing customer experience. You will also be expected to think strategically, fostering innovation and team building. Your proficiency in artificial intelligence and automation will be crucial in optimizing our transaction processes. Furthermore, your ability to interpret and communicate data will help us make informed decisions that drive impact. Your role is essential in maintaining our commitment to providing top-notch service to our customers.

Job Responsibilities

  • Coordinate with Client Service and remote locations for trade finance products (including Supply Chain Financing, Guarantee/SBLC, BAD Discounting, Trade Loan) booking
  • Strictly follow Standard Operation Procedure to ensure the processing of all trade transactions are in compliance with law, ICC Rules, regulations, JPM's policy and Services Standard of the Division
  • Investigate and answer inquiries from both internal and external clients, and maintain proper record
  • Timely escalate for any issues with potential risk or loss
  • Assist operation manager in dealing with external & internal affairs and participate in relevant projects and other ad hoc events as required
  • Produce regulatory report
  • Utilize artificial intelligence and automation technologies to optimize transaction processes and improve efficiency

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • College graduate or above
  • Open to fresh graduates; 3+ years experience in Cash/Trade operations is preferred
  • Solid understanding of relevant PBOC/NFRA/SAFE regulation
  • Knowledge on URDG, AML and OFAC regulations
  • Ability to communicate effectively at all levels
  • Fluent in English and Mandarin
  • Able to handle multiple tasks at the same time
  • Demonstrated ability to utilize artificial intelligence and automation technologies to optimize processes and improve efficiency

About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

Job Summary

  • Manage data of HR system (employee portal and myHR).

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • To support HR Specialist Delivery (HRSD) and HR stakeholders in Country as per defined operating model.
  • Be able to apply in in-depth knowledge, process and product expertise and collaborate with the GPS Operations, Country HR Specialist Delivery and other HR Stakeholders for deliverables per requirement.

Processes

  • HR Data Analysis & Report (Employee Portal & myHR )
  • Manage/maintain data of overall HR operation to improve efficiency of HR operation.
  • Generate accurate data to secure transparency.
  • Ensure transparency through accurate data creation and validation in timely manner.
  • Before each month's payroll, deliver HR information related to salary changes to the payroll manager.
  • Provide accurate information and support work when requesting HR-related materials/work.
  • Monitor and address errors in HR system.
  • Build organic relationships with each business
  • Improve work efficiency through smooth communication with HR stakeholders and related businesses.
  • Respond accurately to inquiries and update requests related to HR data.

Risk Management

  • Maintain data confidentiality; during every interaction ensures data is only disclosed to validated individuals and that any data disclosure complies with the bank’s data protection standards.
  • Stays vigilant, proactive, risk aware and operates within the bank's risk management and compliance framework.
  • Manages risk with every interaction ensuring any advice provided is within the Bank’s guidelines and taking part of assessment on the Data confidentiality requirement.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Country Head of HR Specialist Delivery
  • Country Head of HR
  • Country HR Business Partners
  • Country PRB

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in GBS China & Guangzhou; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats)

Skills And Experience

  • Data Consolidation and Validation
  • Microsoft Applications
  • Standard Operating Procedures
  • Effective Communication
  • Human Resources Information Systems Operations

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor or above

Training

  • HR-related knowledge and basic understanding of businesses
  • Understanding of technical environment of overall HR system
  • Understanding of IT security policies and related standards and the system operation process in the bank
  • Close relationship with internal/external stakeholders and business/group counterparties and smooth communication skill (writing and oral communication skill)
  • Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, MS word and PC

Languages

  • Proficiency in Korean and English

Competencies

Action Oriented

Collaborates

Courage

Customer Focus

Decision Quality

Develops Talent

Drives Vision & Purpose

Gives Clarity & Guidance

Instills Trust

Manages Ambiguity

Nimble Learning

Strategic Mindset

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Development Lead to join our technology team and play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable trading control systems that power Standard Chartered's digital banking platform. The successful candidate will lead technical initiatives, build platform 0-1, and contribute to architectural decisions that with major business impact to our global financial market business.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Design and develop high-performance, scalable backend services and APIs using modern technologies
  • Implement microservices architecture patterns and distributed system design principles
  • Ensure system reliability, performance, and security across all backend services
  • Drive adoption of best practices in code quality, testing, and deployment
  • Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning

Development & Implementation

  • Build robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies
  • Implement secure, efficient database designs and optimize query performance
  • Develop event-driven architectures using messaging systems (Solace, Kafka)
  • Integrate with third-party systems and external APIs following banking industry standards
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with DEV, SRE, QA, BA, product managers, and business stakeholders
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Lead technical discussions and facilitate knowledge sharing sessions
  • Participate in technical interviews and contribute to team building initiatives

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure all backend systems comply with banking regulations and security standards
  • Implement comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and methodologies
  • Maintain high standards of documentation for systems and processes
  • Support production systems and participate in on-call rotations when required

People and Talent

  • Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  • Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
  • Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Application Design, Architecture
  • Software Development
  • Leadership

Other Skills

  • AI

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • 8+ years of experience in development with strong Java expertise, with at least 5+ years in a leadership role.
  • Proficiency in Spring Framework (Spring Boot)
  • Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (Redis)
  • Extensive experience with messaging systems (Solace, Apache Kafka)
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with API design and development (REST, GraphQL)
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to mentor and lead a team of engineers, fostering an environment of innovation and continuous learning.

Certifications/Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

Languages

  • English

Job Description

Job Summary

  • Conduct investigations into concerns allegations or risk events involving criminal conduct, dishonesty or deliberate breaches of policies or regulations.
  • Ensure investigations align with relevant laws, regulations, and Group standards, including escalation, case management, data capture, evidence management, electronic evidence review, reporting, interviewing, and attending internal disciplinary panels.
  • Prioritize multiple investigations, tasks, projects, and responsibilities while maintaining positive stakeholder relationships.
  • Keep relevant stakeholders and appropriate senior management informed of relevant investigative developments.
  • Assist in regulatory and government investigations, including data source identification and extraction.
  • Develop and disseminate data analytics, providing relevant management information to stakeholders.
  • Maintain relationships with law enforcement and coordinate the provision of responses to search warrants, local production orders, court orders, request for information from regulators or law enforcement agencies, and attend Court as required.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • To manage the conduct of appropriate investigations in order to minimise financial losses, reputational and regulatory risks, and operational risk events involving criminal conduct, dishonesty or deliberate breaches of policies or regulations.

Business

  • Provide reports and other Management Information in agreed and standardised format.
  • Coordinate identification of themes, trends and lessons learnt from investigations in China to support the continuous improvement of the Bank’s conduct and control environment.

Processes

  • Conduct and manage non-government investigations against the Bank and/or with employees that have potential material impact on the Bank from either a reputational, regulatory, financial or litigation perspective (or any combination of the same).
  • As required, investigate data leakage cases escalated for China and assist in promoting awareness of the importance of confidentiality of bank information. Support management and promote Speaking Up in country with assistance from Regional investigative team.
  • Adopt a flexible approach in supporting other areas within the Group Investigations structure (and in seeking inbound support when necessary) to promote effective and efficient allocation of investigative resources.

People & Talent

  • Establish, develop and maintain close collaboration with key internal functional stakeholders. including Legal, Compliance, Audit, Risk, FCC and HR, to fully embed the Group Investigations framework including the formalisation of policies, procedures, processes and controls.

Risk Management

  • Maintain close interaction with those Risk Owners to whom responsibility is delegated to ensure resolution of system and control improvements identified through the Group Investigations process. Ensure Head, Shared Investigative Services, China, is fully informed of all key risks and issues in area of responsibility and reported in line with Bank’s operational risk process.

Governance

  • Reinforce an effective and exemplary risk and control culture and further strengthen the control environment.
  • Act to minimise operational loss and audit failures and take proactive measures to respond to matters arising.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholders

  • Business and function representatives
  • HR
  • Compliance
  • Legal
  • Financial Crime Compliance
  • Audit
  • Risk

Skills and Experience

  • Interview
  • Investigation

Qualifications

Required

  • 8-10 years investigative, compliance, intelligence, consulting or audit experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to run end-to-end investigations, audits or relevant reviews.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Relevant degree holder, or comparable experience.
  • Native speaker fluency in Mandarin.
  • Business proficient English language speaking and writing skills.
  • Excellent judgement. Excellent collaborative and team playing skills. Diplomacy, empathy and a ‘can-do attitude’. Politeness, sensitivity and the ability to gently, but professionally stand your ground when needed.
  • An inquisitive approach to practices, procedures and specific transactions. Personal authority and integrity. Independence, creativity, resourcefulness and resilience.
  • Must possess ability to assess risk, strong leadership qualities, excellent interpersonal skills and multi-cultural awareness and sensitivity.

Desirable

  • Knowledge of banking systems.
  • Knowledge of law enforcement practices.

Job Type

Full Time

Job Reference #

344441BR

City

Shanghai

Key Responsibilities

Do you want to design and build attractive digital products and services? Do you want to play a key role in transforming our firm into an agile organization?

At UBS, we re-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other – our colleagues, clients and partners – and the way we deliver value. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable, and ultimately more innovative. We’re looking for a Software Engineer to:

  • design, develop, and improve the digital products and technology services we provide to our clients and employees
  • design and scale modern AI solutions, enabling the re‑write agenda and reducing reliance on manual processes.
  • position the function for sustained transformation as well as current and future demand.
  • accelerate delivery, increase throughput, and support measurable efficiency improvements across the stream by designing and implementing AI solutions
  • apply a broad range of software engineering practices, from analyzing user needs and developing new features to automated testing and deployment
  • ensure the quality, security, reliability, and compliance of our solutions by applying our digital principles and implementing both functional and non-functional requirements
  • build observability into our solutions, monitor production health, help to resolve incidents, and remediate the root cause of risks and issues
  • understand, represent, and advocate for client needs

The team

In the UBS Agile model, crews are aligned to larger products and services fulfilling client needs and encompass multiple autonomous pods. You’ll be working in the Connectivity team in China (Beijing or Shanghai) focusing on building a local AI instances and scaling AI solutions that drive automation, streamline processes, and accelerate delivery.

Your Skills And Experience

  • Experience in China Equities Market will be a plus, or in China Financial Services industry in general
  • Expertise in Rootnet or Hundson or Shengli or applications being used in China.
  • Strong experience in AI/ML engineering, including designing and scaling production‑grade solutions
  • Hands‑on knowledge of modern AI technologies (e.g. NLP, LLMs, automation frameworks)
  • Familiar with both China and overseas AI technology landscape
  • Proven ability to integrate AI solutions into existing systems and workflows
  • Experience with system integration across platforms and services
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with ability to translate business needs into AI solutions
  • interested in learning new technologies and practices, reuse strategic platforms and standards, evaluate options, and make decisions with long-term sustainability in mind
  • strong communicator, from making presentations to technical writing
  • Fluent in Chinese and English

About Us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

Join us

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.

Contact Details

UBS Business Solutions SA

UBS Recruiting

Disclaimer / Policy statements

UBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.

ln:4482515166.descriptionHtml:
The Salesperson is a senior-level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Director Salesperson also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities

  • Refine and implement sales/marketing strategy to improve Citi's client footprint and maximize associated revenue while working with management/colleagues to establish a clear marketing plan with defined priorities, market penetration and revenue goals
  • Leverage contact network to understand client needs, introduce the Citi offering, and convince clients to adopt it to increase client satisfaction/Citi revenue
  • Advise team in strategic positioning and closing transactions with various internal stakeholders (structuring, trading, legal, credit and risk etc.)
  • Forge a relationship with salespeople in order to leverage Citi's franchise and source relevant buying and selling opportunities for clients
  • Lead strong governance and controls
  • Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
  • Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
  • Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation
  • Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services
  • Adhere to all policies and procedures as defined by your role which will be communicated to you
  • Obtain and maintain all registrations/licenses which are required for your role, within the appropriate timeframe
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Recommended Qualifications

  • 15+ years of sales experience at a financial services organization
  • Experience in a client-facing role working with the buy-side community
  • Proven interpersonal and problem-solving skills
  • Consistently demonstrate clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Broad client relationships preferred


Education

  • Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master's degree preferred
  • Working Environment: office setting, minimal travelling and prolonged working hours in the office may be required during projects.
  • Effort: minimal physical effort required. High levels of prolonged and intense concentration may be required in front of computer.


Job Family Group

Institutional Sales

Job Family

Investor Sales

Time Type

Most Relevant Skills

Please see the requirements listed above.

Other Relevant Skills

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.

View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Handle all Int’l main trade finance transactions for DBS clients including import/export L/Cs, Bank Guarantee etc.

处理星展银行客户的所有国际贸易融资业务包括进出口信用证，银行保函等业务。

  • Back up handle all trade finance transactions for DBS clients including OA Finance and Draft transactions.

候补处理星展银行客户的所有应收应付账款融资业务和票据融资业务。

  • Support bank’s project management of the trade service product processing optimization, especially AI projects UR analysis, design, testing & launch

支持银行贸易服务产品及流程及系统优化项目，重点支持AI项目相关的需求分析、设计测试，上线等环节。

  • Check supporting docs according to bank’s guidance/trade finance procedure and ensure applications compliance with internal control requirement as well as compliance requirement.

根据银行的操作指引以及贸易融资的操作流程审核相关证明文件，以确保交易申请符合银行内控和合规要求。

  • Checking trade finance documents according to UCP/URDG/ISBP/URR and other international trade finance practice.

根据相关国际惯例审核贸易融资单据。

  • Booking trade finance and relevant funds disbursement in banking system and make data information verification. Process cash margin, BAD/CAD pledge on transactional basis.

将相关贸易融资以及资金的转移收付录入银行系统并确保数据准确性, 根据流程处理交易层面的客户保证金和质押票据的收付。

  • Conduct post checking/monitoring of trade related supporting documents which shall be align with “3 measures & 1 guideline”.

根据”3个办法一个指引” 的要求进行贷后文件的跟踪和审核。

  • Handle DBS client inquiry on trade finance related transactions.

处理星展客户关于贸易融资业务的查询/咨询。

  • Make sure any deviations/irregulars were raised to Team head, and obtain proper DOA approval on exceptions.

确保任何异常交易被上报给部门主管，并且在处理异例前得到相应的授权。

  • Conduct regulatory, MIS and other internal/external reporting for trade finance business i.e.SAFE/UPRR/RCPMIS/FTZMIS etc.

及时提交对内对外相关报表。

  • Assist team head to improve/maintain internal and external audit score, and make sure no significant finding during assessment.

协助部门主管/经理共同达到集团内部审计和外部审计的评定要求，并在规定时间内完成整改要求。

  • Participate in bank’s training if necessary.

积极参与银行相关培训。

Education And Relevant Experience

Bachelor degree holder or above.

本科学历或以上。

Minimum 3 years’ experience in Trade Finance operations including import/export trade finance, OA Finance and Draft etc.

3年以上银行贸易融资国际结算操作部门经验, 包括进出口贸易融资结算业务、应收/应付融资业务、票据融资业务等。

CDCS certificate/CSDG certificate

信用证单证专家证书（国际商会）或者保函备用证专家证书(国际商会)。

Good knowledge on trade finance related products, rules and regulations, International practice

熟识贸易融资业务和产品，以及相关规则, 国际惯例等。

Basic knowledge of accounting

熟悉会计基础知识。

Proficient in commonly used data analysis software e.g., Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, R, Python, etc.

熟悉常用的数据分析软件，例如：Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, R, Python 等。

Good data visualization skills: Ability to create clear, concise, and insightful charts and reports

具备良好的数据可视化能力，能够创建清晰易懂的图表和报告。

Good PC skills and good command of English and Mandarin.

熟练的电脑操作能力, 精通英语和普通话。

Good communication skill and problem solving skill.

良好的沟通技巧和解决问题的能力。

Capable to work effectively under pressure and tight deadline

工作效率高，愿意在压力下工作。

Location:

PRC - Shanghai

Job:

Operations

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

Android Application Development

  • Design, build, and maintain Android applications and reusable components aligned to agreed architecture and engineering best practices.
  • Develop customer-centric user experiences using modern Android UI frameworks (Jetpack Compose and/or XML Views) and implement robust application logic using current Android development approaches.
  • Integrate applications with backend services and APIs, ensuring reliability, performance, and secure data handling.
  • Contribute directly to feature delivery, bug fixing, and technical improvements across the mobile codebase.
  • Partner with product and design to translate requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions.

Engineering Quality and Governance

  • Ensure high-quality code through clean architecture, unit testing, and peer code reviews.
  • Follow governance processes to ensure long-view technical design is in place for robustness, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Drive performance optimisation, stability improvements, and secure coding practices appropriate for banking-grade applications.
  • Maintain and improve development standards, including coding guidelines, branching strategies, release readiness checks, and technical documentation.

Issue Resolution

  • Identify and diagnose complex technical issues across devices, Android OS versions, OEM variations, and integration points.
  • Develop and implement effective solutions in a timely manner, collaborating with other engineers where needed.
  • Maintain a clear log of issues and resolutions, providing structured updates to stakeholders (including risks, mitigations, and timelines).

Continuous Improvement

  • Gather feedback from users and internal teams to identify areas for improvement in the Android app and development lifecycle.
  • Work closely with platform and engineering teams to implement enhancements and optimisations based on feedback and data (e.g., crash analytics, performance metrics).
  • Stay up to date with Android ecosystem changes (SDK updates, Jetpack libraries, Play policies, security guidance), incorporating relevant advancements into the team’s approach.
  • Contribute to documentation, including developer guides, FAQs, and troubleshooting tips to support maintainability and onboarding.

Communication and Collaboration

  • Maintain open lines of communication with product, design, QA, security, and backend teams, providing regular updates on progress and risks.
  • Participate in cross-functional meetings to share insights and collaborate on mobile-related initiatives.
  • Foster a positive, supportive environment that encourages knowledge sharing, mentoring, and teamwork.

Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving abilities, with a proven track record of resolving complex technical issues.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple projects and priorities.
  • Strong experience with version control (Git) and modern branching/release practices.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins (or equivalent).
  • Good understanding of Android performance optimisation (startup time, rendering, memory, battery) and secure coding best practices.
  • Experience integrating mobile apps with cloud services and APIs (REST/GraphQL), including authentication and secure session handling.
  • Working knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
  • Minimum 3+ years of professional Android development experience, including recent experience delivering production apps.Proficiency in Kotlin (and understanding of Java where required).
  • Strong understanding of Android app architecture and patterns (e.g., MVVM, Clean Architecture), modularisation, and dependency injection (e.g., Hilt/Dagger/Koin).
  • Experience building UI with Jetpack Compose (preferred) and/or Android Views, including state management and complex UI rendering.
  • Experience with Android Jetpack libraries (e.g., ViewModel, Navigation, Room/DataStore, WorkManager).
  • Solid understanding of concurrency and async programming (Coroutines/Flow, threading).
  • Experience with testing practices: unit testing (JUnit), UI testing (Espresso/Compose UI), and testability by design.
  • Awareness of security expectations for mobile banking (e.g., secure storage, encryption, certificate pinning/transport security, OWASP MASVS concepts).

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Principal Engineer (Group AI Platforms)

Why join us?

The Group AI Platforms team sits within CTO Platforms, part of HSBC’s Chief Technology Office (CTO). We build shared AI foundations that enable teams across the Bank to deliver AI solutions faster, more safely and at scale.

Our platform provides a “paved road” for AI delivery, bringing together seamless access to AI models and infrastructure, a consistent Agent HUB to build, deploy and manage production-ready AI agents, reusable AI capabilities (such as knowledge management and document intelligence), and built-in controls including guardrails, evaluation and monitoring to support responsible adoption.

We’re a global team with an established footprint across Asia (Hong Kong, Mainland China, India) and Europe (Poland, UK), and we continue to expand to support delivery across regions. Joining the team means working at the centre of HSBC’s AI enablement—partnering with multiple lines of business and functions across regions to turn AI capabilities into reliable, repeatable services that deliver measurable business value.

ln:4484457510.descriptionHtml:
GCOO - Asia & Middle East COO

Our GCOO organisation is critical for HSBC. This team partners closely with business teams to drive simplification and deliver exceptional customer outcomes in Asia and the Middle East region which covers 26 markets, 600+ offices and branches, and more than 140,000 employees. By strengthening our control environment and enhancing risk management, we drive operational excellence and enable the bank to deliver focused and sustainable growth in this super-region.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

The role provides the Head of Performance with dedicated, forward thinking, strategic and operational management support, including but not limited to management of cross-GCOO and cross-department activities, interacting with and influencing senior leadership, providing operational management activities for GCOO in the market.

The Key Aspects Of This Role

    • Provides business management and operational management support to the Head of Performance (COO Office) and wide range of entity-level activities with continuous improvement across the market in related areas.
    • Ensures the operational strategies and initiatives are designed with strong customer centric focus, enhancing the overall customer experience while ensure the compliance.
    • Leading the team that provides business management / Performance utility services to the Global Business and Global Infrastructures including but not limited to Financial Management, Governance and Oversight, strategy execution, growth initiatives, branch network management and governance, third party management, Chop Management, fleet management, as well as strengthening client experience and staff development and engagement, this will include ensuring a consistent operating model; establishing a centralised client service utility.
    • Drive COO project execution of global / regional specific programs in the region, supporting Group COO strategic actions’ execution.
    • Ensure the operational efficiency, continuity and resilience of the internal operations, this is aligned with the overall Bank strategy.
    • Coordinate with the relevant teams to track and escalate to the appropriate governance forum.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Highly adaptable, able to thrive in a fast-paced and result oriented environment.
  • Strong relationship management, senior stakeholder management, interpersonal, communication skills; the ability to negotiate and influence across networks of matrixed stakeholders to manage stakeholders to one solution.
  • Understanding of CIB Banking proposition, the financial services landscape and competitor developments.
  • Knowledge and experience of being flexible and adaptable in an environment of constantly changing priorities, challenging bureaucracy and staying true to the values and strategy of the Group.
  • Ensuring priority change is driven forward with pace, whilst setting and managing realistic expectations, which often means having hard conversations up front.
  • Outstanding relationship management and influencing skills, with knowledge on when and how to re-prioritise, mitigate or escalate, and an ability to link themes, ideas and initiatives from across the Bank for optimal execution; and
  • Outstanding organizational and planning skills.
  • Strong sense of risk management and compliance.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4484458723.descriptionHtml:
Corporate and Institutional Banking

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Responsible for the delivery of Business Credit Office (BCO) tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs
  • Responsible for coordinating between stakeholders to ensure completion of tasks e.g. (but not limited to) credit monitoring and credit maintenance, documents review & submission, limit loading & drawdown
  • Engagement with customers where required
  • Manage the timely updates to bank systems and records for e.g. covenant

ln:4484452096.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

As a GLAM Relationship Specialist, you will help create a controlled and efficient experience for colleagues as they join, move within or leave the firm. You will build effective relationships with business stakeholders and partner teams to understand employee lifecycle needs and ensure timely resolution of requests. Working with Access Operations, Solutions teams and Technology partners, you will coordinate access to technology, applications, market data and buildings. The business will rely on you to help ensure each request is completed accurately, on time and in line with control standards. This role provides broad exposure to how the firm operates and an opportunity to improve the processes that support employee experience.

Job Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and track access needs for new hires, internal transfers, role changes and leavers.
  • Build effective relationships with business stakeholders and partner teams to understand employee lifecycle needs and keep requests moving.
  • Coordinate technology hardware, application, market data and building access requirements as needed.
  • Check requests against approved role requirements and confirm that the appropriate business and control approvals are in place.
  • Coordinate the prompt removal or amendment of access when employees leave or transfer.
  • Troubleshoot access and entitlement issues, working with Technology and support teams through to resolution.
  • Support regular access reviews and entitlement recertifications and coordinate the remediation of identified exceptions.
  • Maintain accurate and complete records of access requests, approvals and actions taken.
  • Partner with business managers and control functions to answer questions and support timely request completion.
  • Maintain a strong control and compliance environment and identify opportunities to reduce risk in daily processes.
  • Identify process gaps, escalate control concerns and contribute to improvements across access management and employee lifecycle processes.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

  • Experience in operations, administrative support, technology support, or a similar role.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple requests, set priorities and follow tasks through completion.
  • Demonstrated accuracy and attention to detail when handling records, approvals or control processes.
  • Possess SAC license (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities.
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English.
  • Experience handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with business and support partners.
  • Strong command of MS office suite of products

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

  • Experience in access management, employee onboarding or offboarding, technology provisioning or operational support.
  • Experience working in financial services or another regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with access controls, entitlement reviews, issue tracking and audit support.
  • A track record of proactive problem-solving and process improvement.

About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

Key Responsibilities

Are you a great people manager? Do you enjoy getting the most out of your team every day? We are looking for someone like you to join our team. As team lead, you will be managing a growing team responsible for transactional reporting to regulators across the world. Your focus will be excellence and you will drive yourself and your team to deliver consistent results in the constantly changing regulatory landscape. You will work together with the Regulatory Reporting regional management team as well as global stakeholders to ensure obligations to the regulatory authorities are met.

The team

While based full time in Wuxi, you'll be working in a global team responsible for functions supporting transactional reporting to global regulators within tight deadlines. In our collaborative culture, the team works closely with a number of other teams to ensure UBS' obligations are met. You will work with people from all walks of life making this team diverse, sharing ideas and experiences to achieve common goals.

Your Skills And Experience

– managed dynamic teams before, ideally global teams

– an understanding of what it takes to create, maintain and retain a successful and driven team with motivated individuals

– have experience of the regulatory operations, or banking operations at a minimum

– excellent communication skills, both in person and remotely

– a track record of delivery

UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

ln:4483899555.descriptionHtml:
The Salesperson is a senior-level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Director Salesperson also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Refine and implement sales/marketing strategy to improve Citi's client footprint and maximize associated revenue while working with management/colleagues to establish a clear marketing plan with defined priorities, market penetration and revenue goals
  • Leverage contact network to understand client needs, introduce the Citi offering, and convince clients to adopt it to increase client satisfaction/Citi revenue
  • Advise team in strategic positioning and closing transactions with various internal stakeholders (structuring, trading, legal, credit and risk etc.)
  • Forge a relationship with salespeople in order to leverage Citi's franchise and source relevant buying and selling opportunities for clients
  • Lead strong governance and controls
  • Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
  • Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
  • Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation
  • Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services
  • Adhere to all policies and procedures as defined by your role which will be communicated to you
  • Obtain and maintain all registrations/licenses which are required for your role, within the appropriate timeframe
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of sales experience at a financial services organization
  • Experience in a client-facing role working with the buy-side community
  • Proven interpersonal and problem-solving skills
  • Consistently demonstrate clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Broad client relationships preferred

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master's degree preferred
  • Working Environment: office setting, minimal travelling and prolonged working hours in the office may be required during projects.
  • Effort: minimal physical effort required. High levels of prolonged and intense concentration may be required in front of computer.

ln:4484719372.descriptionHtml:
Position Overview

 Details of the Division and Team

Financial and Regulatory Reporting is responsible for the timely and accurate delivery of complete and comprehensive financial and regulatory reporting and analysis, in line with applicable internal policies and external regulatory, statutory and control frameworks. The team will cover:

  • Managing accounting and financial risk and providing advice and guidance on strategic initiatives (driven by internal policies and/or external regulation) and new products that impact the entities /processes /utilities with their remit
  • Collaborating with relevant stakeholders to provide comprehensive financial reporting and analysis
  • Developing innovative business solutions and providing strategic advice and guidance to support the execution of business strategy, mitigation of risks and achievement of the bank’s/regions’/Division’s objectives


What We Will Offer You

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.

You can expect:

  • Supplemental Savings Plan on top of mandatory social security
  • 20 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
  • A range of competitive benefits to suit your needs
  • On-line family doctor consultation for both employee & family members
  • Employee Assistance Program for both employee & family members


Your Key Responsibilities

This role is to efficiently deliver Regulatory Reporting front to back. Accountable for all aspects of production of Reg Reports from report production to data submission to process efficiency to explain any queries arise internally and externally.

  • Responsible for regulatory reporting (1104), PBOC, SAFE and other reg reporting
  • Collaborate with business and infrastructure partners to deliver values to the bank
  • Deliver results on projects and initiatives through AI/Innovation
  • Has good understanding of regulatory reporting rules
  • Accountable for Reg Reporting quality, accuracy and timeliness


Your Skills And Experience

  • Has over 8 years qualified experiences in a Finance, Control or other Analytical area within a financial institution.
  • Hands-on experiences on local regulatory reporting / dealing with regulators' requests
  • Good working knowledge in managing process and validation
  • Good Chinese and English writing to identifying issues and problem solving
  • Data and Technology experience is a plus
  • Financial control and leadership
  • Project management to lead changes on process, systems, people, solution, sourcing
  • AI Automation & streamline the process
  • Interpreting local regulatory rules and market practices
  • Strategic thinking and realization

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business: Digital Platforms

Principal Responsibilities

Applied AI for Engineering Productivity (Design/Coding/Testing)

  • Identify high-impact opportunities to use AI to improve mobile engineering outcomes across design, coding, testing, release readiness, and incident response.
  • Build and operationalise AI-assisted workflows for engineers (e.g., code generation and refactoring support, test case generation, defect triage, documentation automation, release note drafting), ensuring strong governance and quality controls.
  • Develop AI-powered accelerators and reusable components (e.g., prompt patterns, evaluators, automation scripts, agentic workflows) that teams can adopt with minimal friction.
  • Establish practical guidance for “how we use AI here” for common engineering tasks—balancing speed with correctness, security, and maintainability.

Data Engineering & Mobile Data Products

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines and curated datasets using mobile-related data sources such as: app telemetry, crash logs, performance metrics, network traces, CI/CD signals, test execution, feature usage analytics, customer journeys, and support/incident data.
  • Define data models that enable consistent, trusted reporting and AI use cases (e.g., quality and stability KPIs, release health, funnel analysis, defect leakage, performance regression tracking).
  • Implement data quality checks, lineage, monitoring, and documentation so stakeholders can trust and reuse the data confidently.
  • Collaborate with security and risk partners to ensure compliant data handling, access controls, and responsible use of customer and operational data.

Dashboards & Decision Intelligence (Data-Driven Mobile)

  • Build dashboards and decision tools that make excellent use of mobile-related data—turning metrics into insights and insights into actions.
  • Create “single pane of glass” views for mobile engineering health (stability, performance, delivery, quality, customer impact), with clear definitions and drill-down paths.
  • Enable proactive management through leading indicators and alerting (e.g., early detection of regressions, risk signals before release, anomaly detection in crash/performance patterns).
  • Partner with mobile leadership to define KPIs that matter, establish targets, and drive measurable improvement over time.

AI Evangelism & Engineering Community Enablement

  • Evangelise practical AI usage across the engineering community: run enablement sessions, publish playbooks, demo reusable patterns, and mentor teams to adopt AI safely and effectively.
  • Build a culture of experimentation with discipline—encouraging rapid learning while maintaining engineering standards and auditability.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to squads: helping them select tools, structure workflows, evaluate outputs, and avoid common AI pitfalls (hallucinations, overconfidence, data leakage, bias).
  • Create internal documentation, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides to accelerate adoption and reduce repeated effort.

AI-Native Operating Model Support (Partnering with Mobile CTO)

  • Support the Mobile CTO in shaping an AI-native engineering strategy: identifying the right problems to solve, prioritising investments, and tracking value delivered.
  • Define lightweight governance that enables innovation while ensuring safe use (e.g., model/tool selection guidance, prompt/data handling standards, evaluation practices, human-in-the-loop controls).
  • Establish measurement frameworks to quantify impact: cycle time reduction, defect reduction, test coverage improvements, incident reduction, customer experience improvements, and cost efficiency.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure AI adoption aligns with architecture, security, compliance, and broader technology strategy.

Requirements

Essential

  • Proven ability to use AI effectively to solve real engineering problems (design, coding, testing, analysis, automation), with a pragmatic and outcomes-focused mindset.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, including diagnosing ambiguous issues and translating them into data/AI solutions that ship.
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), able to influence and enable engineers and leaders across teams.
  • Strong experience building production-grade data pipelines and datasets, with attention to reliability, observability, and data quality.
  • Proven ability to build dashboards/analytics products that drive action, not just reporting.
  • Strong understanding of secure data handling and engineering practices appropriate for a regulated environment.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating across product, engineering, and risk/security stakeholders.

Strong Technical Skills (AI/Data Engineering)

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data engineering and applied AI workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling (e.g., LLMs and prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation concepts, evaluation techniques, agentic/automation workflows), and the discipline to validate outputs.
  • Experience with analytics and visualisation tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or equivalent) and designing metrics that are well-defined and trustworthy.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and developer toolchains, and ability to integrate data/AI into engineering workflows (e.g., Git-based pipelines, test systems, build tooling).
  • Understanding of experimentation and measurement (A/B testing concepts, KPI definition, causal thinking, guardrails).

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4484905871.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Establish new Elite banking relationships and manage existing relationships in order to grow Assets Under Management and Revenue
  • Monitor clients’ portfolios on a regular basis to identify additional business opportunities and revenue growth potential
  • Ensure strict compliance with HSBC’s internal control standards, including areas of risk, regulatory compliance and financial crime compliance
  • Timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators
  • Minimize operational losses

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • At least 8/10 years’ relationship management experience, ideally in private banking, commercial banking or investment banking sectors
  • Proven track record in asset gathering, asset growth and revenue generation
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills
  • Strong focus on client servicing
  • Excellent understanding of financial markets and wealth management products
  • Attention to detail and the ability to think creatively to solve problems

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued By HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist.

Business: Digital Platforms

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design, build and support end-to-end solutions with Spec-driven development (SDD) approach across web, mobile, APIs, back-end services and data platforms. Own technical design, coding, integration, deployment and production support, ensuring security, performance and reliability.
  • Build Java microservices and RESTful APIs using Spring Boot. Use AWS, Kong Gateway, Docker/Kubernetes and data technologies such as PostgreSQL, Redis and Kafka to build reliable services. As well, the automation testing to validate the code is well functioning as per the requirement.
  • Build responsive, accessible web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS and React. Create reusable components, integrate APIs and improve browser performance and compatibility.
  • Understand and lead native Android and/or iOS apps and connect them to back-end APIs. Build reusable, testable components and improve app performance, reliability and build pipelines.
  • Build security and quality into development through secure access, encryption, data protection, automated testing and code reviews. Resolve vulnerabilities and follow HSBC engineering standards and controls.
  • Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews and mentoring. Work with product owners, designers and engineers to turn requirements into maintainable solutions and explain technical choices clearly.
  • Use AI-assisted coding, AI agents and clear specifications to improve development, testing and documentation. Review and test AI-generated outputs to maintain quality, security and data protection.
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Git and GitHub to automate builds, tests and deployments across web, mobile and back-end services. Monitor applications, resolve production issues and address root causes.

Requirements

  • Proven hands-on experience delivering end-to-end IT solutions across front ends, APIs, back-end services and data platforms. Understand architecture, interfaces, data flows and dependencies across multiple applications and systems, with technical ownership from design and coding through integration testing, deployment and production support.
  • Strong hands-on Java, Spring Boot and microservices, RESTful API experience, including Spring MVC, Spring Security, and the AWS and SHP.
  • Knowledge and experience in web (e.g. ReactJS, JS/TS) and/or mobile development (e.g. Kotlin, Swift, SwiftUI). Understand mobile architecture, application lifecycle, state management, secure API integration, automated testing, performance and build/release pipelines.
  • Experience with Git/GitHub, Jenkins and CI/CD for automated builds, tests and deployments. Familiarity with Maven/Gradle, JUnit, Mockito and Postman, alongside agile collaboration and technical documentation using Jira and Confluence.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted coding and rapid prototyping (“vibe coding”), AI agent development and integration, agentic workflows and spec-driven development (SDD). Define clear specifications and acceptance criteria, and validate AI-generated outputs through human review, automated testing and security and data-protection controls.
  • Handson end-to-end troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across front ends, APIs, microservices, databases and connected systems. Use logs, metrics, distributed tracing and debugging tools to resolve functional, integration and performance issues and prevent recurrence. Apply secure design, authentication, encryption, data protection, automated testing and code reviews.
  • Strong hands-on technical leadership and mentoring skills, coordinating implementation across engineering teams. Communicate clearly in spoken and written English, explain design trade-offs and produce solution designs, API specifications, technical documentation and incident analyses for global stakeholders.

ln:4484914372.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Global Process Owner Support

Support Global Process Owners (GPOs), delegates and Process Leads across the end-to-end CIB Client Lifecycle portfolio as part of the central GPOS Process Efficiency team. The role analyses cross-process issues, supports practical target-state design, coordinates agreed improvement initiatives and helps embed sustainable changes across people, process, technology, data, information and controls. Working under the direction of senior process efficiency lead/s, the role contributes to improved process governance, operational readiness, risk management, efficiency and client outcomes.

  • Partner with GPOs, delegates, Process Leads and subject-matter experts to document process pain points, risks, controls and improvement opportunities.
  • Perform cross-process analysis using data, stakeholder input, root-cause analysis and process mapping to identify duplication, bottlenecks, hand-off failures and manual activity.
  • Support practical and controlled target-state process design, including roles, decision points, controls, service standards, MI and implementation requirements.
  • Coordinate assigned workstreams from problem definition and impact assessment through approval, implementation, BAU handover and benefits tracking.
  • Prepare working-group materials, maintain actions and decisions, and provide clear progress updates.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Support delivery of prioritised process-efficiency, simplification and control-enhancement initiatives across Client Lifecycle processes.
  • Help translate strategic, regulatory, client and operational priorities into defined process improvements, requirements and implementation plans.
  • Promote globally consistent, scalable and client-focused solutions while capturing justified regional or country requirements.
  • Contribute analysis and design support to transformation programmes, aligned to GPO accountabilities and agreed standards.

Business

  • Build effective working relationships across GPO/s, Client Coverage, Operations, Product, Technology, Transformation, Risk and Control, Legal and CFCC.
  • Gather and validate stakeholder requirements, facilitate working-level decisions and escalate material issues or dependencies.
  • Maintain transparency on delivery status, actions, risks, dependencies, resource needs and expected benefits.
  • Prepare concise presentations, papers and updates for working groups and senior stakeholder review.

Processes

  • Document current-state processes and cross-process hand-offs using process maps, data and stakeholder insight.
  • Perform gap, impact and root-cause analysis; translate findings into prioritised, owned and time-bound actions.
  • Support target-state design across people, process, technology, data and information, including RACIs, controls, service standards and MI.
  • Develop or update process maps, Process Guidance, communications and user-facing implementation artefacts.
  • Co-ordinate with relevant Ops team to ensure the changes are appropriately embedded into the repective DOIs
  • Prepare and where required co-ordinate change-impact assessment, testing, operational readiness, training, communications, go-live support and post-implementation review.
  • Prepare materials and support workshops using Lean, A3 problem solving, Design Thinking, Dynamic Work Design, Scrum or Kanban.
  • Track delivery, adoption and realised benefits, and contribute to the GPOS efficiency toolkit and lessons learned.

People & Talent

  • Promote continuous improvement and consistent use of process-design and problem-solving practices.
  • Share knowledge and contribute to a collaborative, inclusive and delivery-focused team environment.

Risk Management and Governance

  • Ensure assigned analysis, designs and changes consider applicable laws, regulations, policies, standards and the Group Risk Management Framework.
  • Support assessment of change risk, control implications, critical-process impacts, dependencies and residual risk, escalating issues appropriately.
  • Maintain risk, issue, action and decision logs with clear ownership and follow-up.
  • Support control monitoring, audit and regulatory responses, and remediation activity relating to assigned process changes.
  • Prepare inputs for QPRs, NFRCs and other governance forums where required.
  • Use agreed metrics and service standards to support evidence-based decisions and sustained performance.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for complying, in letter and spirit, with applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Global Process Owners, GPO delegates, Process Leads and subject-matter experts across the CIB Client Lifecycle portfolio.
  • Client Coverage, Client Management, CDD Execution, CLM Ops, Orchestration teams, Financial Markets, Product and COO teams Country, regional and GBS Operations teams, including impacted frontline and operational users.
  • Technology, Transformation, Change Delivery, Data and Architecture teams.
  • CFCC, Legal, Group Operational Risk, Enterprise Risk Management and applicable second-line teams.
  • Business QPRs, Non-Financial Risk Committees, Group Internal Audit and external auditors, as required.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Banking Platform
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats)

Skills And Experience

  • Business process and target operating model design
  • Process analysis, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement
  • Programme, project and change delivery
  • Stakeholder management, facilitation and influencing
  • Risk, control and governance management
  • Data analysis, management information and benefits tracking

Qualifications

  • Degree or equivalent professional qualification in business, operations, project management a related discipline, with significant relevant experience in process design, operating-model design, business transformation or change delivery.
  • Relevant experience in process analysis, process improvement, operating-model design, project delivery or business change, preferably within Corporate and Investment banking or a complex regulated environment.

Knowledge of Client Lifecycle processes such as onboarding, KYC/CDD, tax, funds onboarding, account opening, maintenance, consent, offboarding, dormancy or reactivation is advantageous.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, written communication, presentation and Microsoft Office skills. Familiarity with Confluence, JIRA and process-mapping tools is desirable.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, Business Process Management, Agile, project management or change-management certification is desirable but not mandatory.
  • Languages: English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.
