Job Description

Job Summary

  • Oversee end-to-end banking regulatory reporting process including data collection and organization, understanding regulatory requirements, completing and submitting SCB China and branches regulatory reports. Ensure accurate, complete and on-time submission of all regulatory returns.
  • Support to identify and mitigate potential regulatory risks related to reporting errors, delays, or non-compliance, and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Support to act as the key liaison with external regulators, providing updates, responding to queries, and representing the company in regulatory discussions and inspections.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, work closely with legal, finance, risk, and IT departments to ensure consistency and completeness of data used in regulatory submissions and to address any compliance-related issues.
  • Support to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of reporting systems and tools to enhance efficiency and reduce manual processes through automation

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle regulatory (NFRA, PBOC, SAFE, the Bureau of Finance, the Bureau of Statistics etc.) returns preparation and submission, ensures that all regulatory submissions are accurate, complete, and submitted on time, as well as regulatory reporting instruction changes interpretation and implementation.
  • Support line manager to maintain robust quality control procedures to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all regulatory submissions, and reporting issues escalated through agreed governance channels.
  • Support PPG and China CA review and system upgrade project including end to end accounting flow review, upgrade the reporting logic, UAT support, regulatory reporting impact analysis to ensure compliance, accuracy and completeness.
  • Maintain good relationships with relevant internal departments, assist the line manager in coordinating with the finance department and other internal functional departments for discussions, such as establishing reporting procedures for new reporting requirements, and promptly and properly resolving related regulatory reporting issues.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Support line manager to drive process and system optimisation improvements in processes, reporting, data quality through reporting automation while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.

Skills and Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Solid knowledge of banking accounting and regulatory reporting rules
  • Hands-on experience in end-to-end regulatory reporting process
  • Strong data analysis and problem-solving abilities

Other Skills

  • High attention to detail and strict regulatory risk awareness
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Strong accountability and ability to work under high pressure

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, very stringent regulatory environment casts great pressure on regulatory reporting including tight local reporting deadline, continuous changing reporting requirements, energized by the fast-paced, deadline-driven nature of regulatory reporting, motivated by the challenge of meeting tight deadlines under pressure while maintaining accuracy and compliance.
  • Motivated by the opportunity to streamline regulatory reporting processes, reduce errors, and enhance efficiency, driven by outcomes such as improved reporting accuracy, more efficient reporting process, reduced compliance risks etc.
  • Performs best in environments that encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing, and professional growth, motivated by working with cross-functional teams build a strong, capable regulatory reporting function.
  • Continuous learning and adaptability required, motivated by the need to stay current with regulatory changes, emerging technologies, and industry best practices, enjoy learning and applying new automation tools and methodologies to improve reporting systems and outcomes.
  • Driven by a commitment to ethical standards and accountability, motivated by the responsibility to uphold the organization’s reputation and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience dealing complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure

Certifications/Qualifications

  • CICPA & ACCA is preferred

Languages

  • Chinese and English

ln:4484797003.descriptionHtml:
Global Markets Graduate Programme 2027

Our Markets team helps clients navigate complexity, seize opportunities, and manage risk across asset classes. From foreign exchange and interest rates to debt securities and commodities, we deliver bespoke solutions that power global trade and investment. Financial Markets sits at the heart of our Corporate and Investment Banking business, connecting clients to the capital they need and the opportunities that drive growth.

About the Graduate Programme – how you’ll learn and grow

Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background. Over our two-year graduate programme, you’ll gain hands-on experience, build lasting relationships and grow your understanding of clients, markets and the wider business. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work and be supported to build a successful long-term career.

You’ll Benefit From

  • Real impact: Take ownership of meaningful work that contributes to business outcomes.
  • Future-ready capabilities: Build the technical, commercial and professional skills needed to succeed.
  • Global collaboration: Work with colleagues and clients across markets, products and functions.
  • Continuous growth: Learn from structured development, mentoring and practical experience.

Where you could work

During the assessment process, we’ll help you explore which of the following areas best match your strengths and interests:

  • Sales: Build trusted relationships with institutional clients and deliver investment strategies tailored to their goals. Collaborate across teams to execute trades and manage risk.
  • Trading: Make markets and manage positions across asset classes. Use data, analytics, and instinct to navigate volatility and drive performance.
  • Structuring: Design and price complex financial products. Combine quantitative modelling with commercial insight to deliver innovative client solutions.
  • Financing Risk: Structure and distribute financing deals that support sustainable growth. Manage risk exposure and ensure regulatory alignment.
  • Research: Deliver differentiated insights across macroeconomics, FX, credit, ESG, commodities, and geopolitics. Help clients and internal stakeholders make smarter decisions.
  • Macro Portfolio Risk Management, Modelling and Analytics, Product Team & XVA: Join teams that work on risk analytics, quantitative modelling, product assessments and valuation adjustments. Work involves data analysis, scenario work, product review and supporting pricing or risk methodologies.

Bring the skills - we’ll help you build your career

We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.

We’re Looking For People Who Can

  • Take ownership and show initiative, thriving in fast-paced environments
  • Think critically and solve problems using logic, analysis and sound judgement
  • Learn quickly and stay curious, seeking opportunities to grow and develop
  • Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with others
  • Demonstrate resilience and adaptability when navigating challenge and change
  • Show curiosity about financial markets, global trends and how they shape businesses and economies.

For technical roles, we particularly value backgrounds in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, and Statistics.

Eligibility

To be eligible for this graduate programme, you need to be in your final year of study and graduating by July 2027. You must also have the permanent legal right to work in the country you’re applying to.

You can only submit one application within a six-month period, so take time to review our opportunities and apply for the role that best fits your interests, skills and career goals.

Key Dates

  • Assessment Centres: October 2026 onwards
  • Start Date: July 2027

About Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB)

We are a super-connector for many of the world’s largest companies across more than 50 markets, playing a central role in global trade, capital flows and economic growth. We work with governments, financial institutions, and some of the world’s most ambitious corporates to help them expand, invest, and navigate uncertainty across increasingly complex and fast-changing markets.

What makes us distinctive is our combination of deep local expertise with an extensive and unique global network. We support clients across risk management, financing, transaction services, advisory, and sustainable finance, helping move capital to where it’s needed most and supporting the real economy across our footprint.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global
  • Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

Principal Responsibilities

As an Application Developer within Institutional Bank Group, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and implementing innovative software solutions. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Software Development: Developing, testing, and deploying high-quality, scalable, and resilient applications, utilizing modern programming languages and frameworks.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases.
  • Solid programming skills in Python and PySpark, with experience in data processing frameworks.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of MANAGER, WSB PROCESS ENGINEERING.

Principal responsibilities

  • Plan and deliver LSS capability building by coordinating Lean Six Sigma (LSS) Belt training (e.g., aligning curricula, schedules, and target audiences) to strengthen continuous improvement capability in support of HSBC’s strategy.
  • Conduct process discovery at different levels of detail (from high-level value streams to deep-dive process mapping) to build a clear fact base on current ways of working.
  • Identify and prioritise improvement opportunities by analysing pain points, hand-offs, cycle times, rework, and control gaps, translating findings into a structured opportunity backlog.
  • Partner with stakeholders across the business to agree problem statements, scope, and measurable outcomes, ensuring alignment across teams and minimising delivery friction.

Requirements

  • Strong process improvement foundation: Working knowledge of Lean / Lean Six Sigma tools and concepts (e.g., SIPOC, value stream mapping, root cause analysis, standard work), with the ability to apply them in real business scenarios.
  • Experience in process discovery and analysis: Proven ability to run workshops, capture current-state processes at different levels of detail, identify bottlenecks and waste, and translate findings into clear improvement opportunities.
  • Stakeholder management and collaboration: Confidence working with diverse stakeholders across business, operations, technology, and support functions—able to influence, align priorities, and manage expectations effectively.
  • Structured problem-solving and data mindset: Ability to define problems clearly, analyse data and performance drivers, and develop evidence-based recommendations with measurable outcomes and benefits.
  • Communication and facilitation skills: Clear written and verbal communication in a business setting, plus strong workshop facilitation skills to drive engagement and reach decisions efficiently.
  • Delivery focus and accountability: Comfortable managing multiple workstreams, working at pace, and tracking actions, risks, dependencies, and benefits through to implementation.
  • Change and continuous improvement mindset: Curiosity, resilience, and a practical approach to embedding sustainable change—supporting teams to adopt new ways of working.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

ln:4484964041.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Business Analyst.

Business: Group DAO

Principal Responsibilities

The HK Reference Data Business Analyst role is required to deliver accurate, controlled migration of Customer Reference Data to support the delivery of CDMS HK. You’ll work with business and centralised migration execution teams to support migration activities end-to-end (analysis, mapping, cleansing, testing, reconciliation, cutover support), partnering closely with Technology, Operations, Data Owners, and Change teams to ensure data is complete, consistent, and fit for purpose. This is an individual contributor role (G5) with no people management responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities Include Some Of But Not Limited To

Migration analysis & planning

  • Analyse source-to-target data movements for customer reference/master data domains (e.g., customer identifiers, names, addresses, contact details, tax residency indicators, KYC-related reference attributes).
  • Produce and maintain migration deliverables such as data scope, mapping specifications, transformation rules, data lineage notes, and reconciliation approach.
  • Support estimation and sequencing of migration waves; identify dependencies, assumptions, and constraints early.

Data quality, profiling & remediation

  • Perform data profiling to identify duplicates, missing values, invalid formats, and policy breaches.
  • Define and execute cleansing/remediation steps with Data Owners and upstream teams; track issues to closure.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of data quality controls and repeatable migration playbooks.

Build support (requirements to engineering) & test execution

  • Translate business rules into clear requirements for ETL/configuration teams (or implement lightweight scripts where appropriate).
  • Create test scenarios and test data; execute SIT/UAT support activities focused on data outcomes.
  • Validate transformation logic through evidence-based checks (sampling + automated validations where possible).

Reconciliation, controls & cutover support

  • Run pre- and post-load reconciliations (record counts, key-field checks, exception reports, referential integrity checks).
  • Produce sign-off packs showing migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions with clear risk statements.
  • Support dress rehearsals and cutover weekend activities, including defect triage and rollback considerations.

Governance, risk & documentation

  • Ensure migration activities meet HSBC control expectations (audit trail, approvals, evidence retention, change controls).
  • Escalate risks/issues promptly with options and impact assessment.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation that can be understood by stakeholders across Hong Kong and global teams.

Stakeholder collaboration

  • Work effectively with Technology, Data Governance, Operations, Compliance/Financial Crime teams, and programme change resources.
  • Communicate progress, blockers, and decisions clearly—especially when trade-offs arise (time vs. quality vs. scope).

Key stakeholders

  • Technology (data engineering/ETL, application teams, testers)
  • Data Owners/Data Stewards
  • Operations/Customer Services teams (where data is originated/maintained)
  • Change/Programme Management
  • Risk & Compliance/Financial Crime (where data impacts controls and screening outcomes)

Requirements

  • Proven experience (typically 3–6 years) as a business and data analyst or similar in a complex, regulated environment (financial services preferred), working with large datasets and multiple data sources.
  • SQL (or equivalent) capability for data extraction, reconciliation and data analysis tasks.
  • Solid understanding of data quality management (profiling, controls, issue root-cause analysis) and working knowledge of data governance concepts (lineage, metadata, critical data elements).
  • Experience translating business requirements into analytical outputs (KPIs, metrics definitions, reporting packs), including documenting requirements and assumptions.
  • Exposure to reference/master data concepts and operating model practices (e.g., data standards, domain ownership, stewardship) is desirable.
  • Familiarity with Agile ways of working (user stories, sprint ceremonies) and collaborating effectively across business, operations and technology teams.
  • Strong communication skills: able to explain complex data findings clearly, challenge constructively, and influence outcomes with evidence.
  • Degree (or equivalent experience) in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics) or demonstrable applied analytical capability.
  • Experience working with operational teams to understand, map and improve end-to-end processes (e.g., SIPOC/process mapping), identifying data pain points, control gaps and opportunities for simplification/automation.
  • Proven involvement in data migration activities (e.g., legacy-to-target mapping, data profiling, transformation rules, reconciliation and post-migration validation), supporting cutover readiness and hypercare where required.
  • Working knowledge of process change governance (impacts, risks, controls, training/adoption considerations) and how process changes affect upstream/downstream data flows and reporting.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

About The Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 31 January 2027

Title Technical Consultant – Enterprise Network Security Services

Department Enterprise Network & Multimedia Services

Location Dalian

Reports To Senior Technical Manager – Enterprise Network Security Services

Level Grade 5

Fidelity International offers world class investment solutions and retirement expertise. As a privately owned, independent company, investment is our only business. We are driven by the needs of our clients, not by shareholders. Our vision is to deliver innovative client solutions for a better future.

Our people are passionate, engaged, smart and curious, and we give them the independence and the confidence to make a difference. While we take pride in the excellence of our investment solutions and client service, we know we can always do better. We are honest, respectful and make tough calls, challenging the status quo to achieve better outcomes through innovation. Above all else, we always put our clients first.

About Your Team

The Enterprise Network Security Services team is part of the Enterprise Network & Multimedia Services group, within the Enterprise Infrastructure Services technical division.

The Enterprise Infrastructure Services (EIS) division delivers secure, reliable, and globally accessible IT infrastructure (both on-premises and cloud) supporting Fidelity’s applications, services, and dynamic working environment. The Enterprise Network & Multimedia Services group provides global network connectivity solutions across 60+ office locations, core data centers, and cloud partners. It also delivers multimedia connectivity through telephony and conferencing systems both on-premises and in the cloud. The group aims to ensure resilient, high-performance network and multimedia services company-wide and on a global scale.

The Enterprise Network Security Services team is a dynamic global unit with members across APAC, India, and the UK. It is responsible for the full lifecycle of network security services, covering product strategy, architecture, implementation, operations, and lifecycle governance. The team manages and continuously evolves key security platforms including Palo Alto next-generation firewall technologies and Cisco Secure Workload (CSW) alongside identity-based access control and secure internet access services. Working closely with Cyber Security, Architecture, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams, the group continually enhances Fidelity's security posture through network segmentation, Zero Trust principles, automation, AI-assisted security capabilities, and continuous compliance improvement.

About Your Role

As a Technical Consultant within the Enterprise Network Security Services team, you will play a key role in the design, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Fidelity's global network security platforms and services. You will work closely with Engineering teams, Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders to deliver and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient network security solutions.

The role combines deep technical expertise with solution design, project delivery, operational excellence, and technology modernization. You will contribute to strategic initiatives, support major transformation programs, and help evolve the network security portfolio through automation, cloud adoption, zero-trust architectures, and AI-enabled security capabilities.

About You

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in enterprise network security engineering and architecture, with a proven track record of delivering complex security solutions and supporting large-scale technology transformation initiatives within enterprise environments. Experience within financial services or other highly regulated industries is highly advantageous. You should be comfortable working across architecture, engineering, operations, and project delivery, ensuring security solutions are effectively designed, implemented, and transitioned into service.

You should have strong experience translating business and security requirements into practical technical solutions and operational processes. This includes developing and reviewing solution designs, supporting technology roadmaps, defining technical standards, and ensuring solutions meet requirements for security, resilience, compliance, and operational efficiency. Experience participating in major programs, technology migrations, vendor engagements, and cross-functional delivery projects will be highly valued.

You are expected to demonstrate strong technical expertise across enterprise network security domains, including next-generation firewalls, network segmentation, Zero Trust architectures, identity-based security controls, secure internet access, threat prevention, and security operations. In particular, hands-on experience with Palo Alto next-generation firewalls and Cisco Secure Workload (CSW) or equivalent workload segmentation platforms is highly desirable. The ideal candidate should also possess solid networking fundamentals across routing and switching, data center networking, DNS, load balancing, VPN technologies, and cloud networking, enabling effective design and troubleshooting of end-to-end enterprise solutions. Knowledge of cloud security, security automation, DevOps-aligned practices, AI-assisted security operations, and regulatory frameworks such as the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) would be advantageous. Strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to influence technical decisions across multiple teams are essential.

Technical Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience supporting and operating enterprise security platforms, particularly Palo Alto next-generation firewalls and Cisco Secure Workload (CSW) or equivalent segmentation technologies.
  • Proven experience delivering security solutions within large-scale enterprise or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience participating in complex infrastructure transformation, security modernization, or regulatory compliance initiatives.
  • Good understanding of security automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), DevOps practices, and modern operational models.
  • Professional certifications such as CCNP Security, PCNSE, CISSP, CCIE Security, TOGAF, as well as recognized certifications in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code technologies (such as Terraform or Kubernetes), and AI-related technologies are highly desirable.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will contribute to the delivery, operation, and continuous evolution of Fidelity's network security services while supporting strategic initiatives and maintaining operational excellence.

Network Security Solution Design & Engineering

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise network security solutions across on-premises and cloud environments, with particular focus on Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco Secure Workload (CSW), network segmentation, Zero Trust controls, and security policy enforcement.
  • Develop and review High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), standards, and implementation documentation.
  • Support security architecture reviews and provide technical guidance on network security best practices.
  • Contribute to network segmentation, Zero Trust, identity-based access control, and secure connectivity initiatives.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and assist with Proof of Concept (PoC) activities and technical assessments.

Project Delivery & Technical Leadership

  • Participate in major infrastructure and security transformation programs from design through production deployment.
  • Support end-to-end project delivery activities including requirements gathering, design, testing, implementation, and operational handover.
  • Coordinate with Product Owners, Engineering teams, and project managers to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
  • Provide technical leadership for complex changes and support resolution of technical challenges throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Contribute to technology roadmaps and continuous service improvement initiatives.

Operational Excellence & Service Governance

  • Ensure operational stability, performance, and security of network security platforms and services.
  • Support incident management, problem management, root-cause analysis, and technical escalations.
  • Maintain compliance with security policies, regulatory requirements, audit controls, and operational standards.
  • Support vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, and platform currency initiatives.
  • Drive continuous improvement of operational processes, monitoring, alert quality, documentation, and service reliability.

Automation, Innovation & Security Modernization

  • Promote adoption of automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, and DevOps-aligned practices within network security services.
  • Support integration of AI-assisted capabilities to improve operational efficiency, threat detection, and service intelligence.
  • Contribute to cloud security networking initiatives and modernization programs.
  • Drive improvements in observability, automation maturity, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for innovation and measurable business value from new technologies.

What You'll Participate In During Your First 12 Months

  • Support delivery of DORA-related network security initiatives, including segmentation, access control, resilience, and security governance improvements.
  • Contribute to Zero Trust and identity-based segmentation programs across enterprise and cloud environments.
  • Participate in security modernization initiatives involving firewalls, secure internet access, authentication, and policy governance.
  • Enhance automation, operational visibility, and security monitoring capabilities to improve service quality and effectiveness.
  • Build strong working relationships across Global Cyber & Information Security, Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Product Groups, and key business stakeholders.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

ln:4482591173.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Job Summary

Provide general administrative support to RGM/CGM and RGM Office/CGM Office and ensure smooth running of the office. Principle driven and act discreetly in managing confidential and sensitive information and uphold high ethical standard.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide general administrative support to CGM including but not limited to: Calendar management, key records and files filing, expense claims, office maintenance, G&E registration, maintain gift distribution list for the visits made by the Group Executives and CEO/RGM/CGM.
  • Day-to-day CGM’s schedule management, organize and prepare for meetings, including gathering documents and taking care of the logistics
  • Arrange and support key activities and projects that would help CGM drive region/branch and business objectives, including but not limited to: explore business opportunities, other external forum/event
  • Financial related: Support preparation of budgets and stretch targets, current performance and forecast for the year, cost centre reconciliation report and monthly FCS maintenance. Support CGM to operate within budget for the all responsible cost centre(s). Implement cost savings initiatives
  • Administration related: Driver / Keys / Email & Bridge Distribution list / Gifts storage & Distribution list maintenance / Initiate PO and Payment when required / Vendor sourcing when required / submit and reconcile expense and medical claims.
  • Be familiar with company policy/regulations and strictly comply, including but not limited to: T&E, G&E, OBI, as well as the relevant system.
  • Build and update CGM contact database to capture relevant information on important contacts for CGM.
  • Assist CGM office on internal communication when required.
  • Document Filing: Ensure that CGM office related documents are properly archived and recorded

Business/业务表现

On branch planning

  • Conduct market research on local business potential, considering the strategy and business plans of the branch;
  • Collate branch level reports for review by Branch Management Committee (Branch MANCO) and Regional Heads, consolidate updates from different Businesses and Functions in the branch;
  • Organize meetings on behalf of Branch Manager (internal and external, including but not limited to Branch Manco, Risk Session and Regional governance meeting), prepare meeting pack, take meeting minutes and support follow up actions as needed.

People & Talent/人员管理

  • People related – Support CGM on people management/engagement, i.e. Staff on boarding, off boarding and movement process / Talent engagement activities. File and maintain the most updated CGM’s JO/ JD / RP/ CV/ OBI. Maintain the most updated reportee’s handover letters; Verify & maintain the most updated CGM / DCGM rotation status in Panda system.

Branch Administration and Conduct, Compliance, Risk and Internal Control Management/分行行政及行为、合规、风险 及内部控制管理

  • Coordinate local visit itineraries for China Executive Committee (EXCO) members and Group senior leaders, working closely with the relevant offices of the visitors on activity schedule, communication with local government and regulator offices, local travel logistics, as well as meal and gift arrangements.
  • Strictly follow the bank chop policy to manage the branch chop and sub-branch chops;
  • Strictly follow the bank license management policy and procedures to manage all branch licenses well;
  • Perform KSCA support when required (including but not limited to Panda, Record, Chop), to Support CGM on the robust controls of internal and external
  • Assist in BCP/Business Resilience planning and execution in the branch.
  • Act as local risk manager to assist City GM in controlling the level of operational risk exposure that results from business / function unit activities in city branches (optional, if the PA taking the role as city UORM, pls keep this item; if not, can be removed);
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML and Fraud Prevention requirements when performing duties.

Governance/内部管理

Additional support to Branch Manager

  • Handle business correspondences for the Branch Manager in line with branch priorities, in particular verbal and written correspondences with local government and regulatory officials.
  • Support presentations to be conducted by the Branch Manager, including drafting presentation content and providing onsite support.
  • Routinely perform a wide variety of support duties

Local Support to Functions

  • Coordinate local activities for Functions that do not have onsite presence, serving as these Function’s key contact point in the branch and facilitating functional activities, as required, across Business and Functions in the branch.
  • Provide local support to HR team for the branches without HR onsite presence, mainly including Labor contract sign-off, onboarding and offboarding procedures, certification issuing, flexible Working application and other necessary support as needed. (optional, if the PA providing such local support to HR team, pls keep this item; if not, can be removed).
  • Perform any other tasks assigned by RGM/CGM.

Accountability Review/问责

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求
  • 根据本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查

Regulatory & Business Conduct/监管 & 业务合规

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Internal senior management team
  • Business/function team in the city
  • Local regulators and government officers (if applicable and authorised)
  • External associations

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Shenyang branch; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats);

Skills and Experience

  • Strong planning and organization skills with good ability in identifying and managing different priorities in a dynamic, fast-changing business environment
  • Solid team player with effective interpersonal and communication skills - able to interact with and engage staff and managers at all levels
  • Able to deliver under tight time pressure, with strong personal drive and willingness to go the extra mile to ensure work is done efficiently together with good quality.
  • Good awareness of business trends in the local marketplace and of the Bank’s priorities across Business and Functions.
  • Strong language skills in both English and Mandarin (verbal and written)
  • Solid computer skills particularly Microsoft Office related software programs.
  • Knowledge of the banking industry in China is preferred; moreover, bachelor’s degree from a reputable university and work exposure to financial data are considered as assets.
  • Other than the above roles, job holder should follow other job duties and responsibilities assigned by line manager from time to time.
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when perform duties.

Qualifications

  • Academic or Professional Education/Qualifications;
  • Principle driven and act discreetly in managing confidential and sensitive information and uphold high ethical standard;
  • Good communication skills and stakeholder engagement manner with internal and external customers, government at all levels;
  • Highly organized and meticulous, with an eye for details;
  • Systematically database management skills;
  • Enthusiastic with a drive to work in a flexible, fast-paced work environment;
  • Knowledge of PRC legal and regulatory environment is a plus;
  • Fluent English and Chinese Mandarin, presentable;
  • Bank training, i.e. mandatory & developmental – as per agreed development plan with line manager.

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Profile Description

Standard Chartered Bank

- Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Key stakeholders
- Internal senior management team
- Business/function team in the city
- Local regulators and government officers (if applicable and authorised)
- External associations
Other Responsibilities
- Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Shenyang branch; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats);
Skills and Experience
- Strong planning and organization skills with good ability in identifying and managing different priorities in a dynamic, fast-changing business environment
- Solid team player with effective interpersonal and communication skills - able to interact with and engage staff and managers at all levels
- Able to deliver under tight time pressure, with strong personal drive and willingness to go the extra mile to ensure work is done efficiently together with good quality.
- Good awareness of business trends in the local marketplace and of the Bank’s priorities across Business and Functions.
- Strong language skills in both English and Mandarin (verbal and written)
- Solid computer skills particularly Microsoft Office related software programs.
- Knowledge of the banking industry in China is preferred; moreover, bachelor’s degree from a reputable university and work exposure to financial data are considered as assets.

- Principle driven and act discreetly in managing confidential and sensitive information and uphold high ethical standard;
- Good communication skills and stakeholder engagement manner with internal and external customers, government at all levels;
- Highly organized and meticulous, with an eye for details;
- Systematically database management skills;
- Enthusiastic with a drive to work in a flexible, fast-paced work environment;

Job Summary

Scope of Role:

Account for branch’s operations; counter transactions including system operations to ensure execution accuracy, compliance, and completeness in line with bank internal and external rules/procedures/manuals/standards/group requirements/regulatory requirement/laws as well as to keep high class level of services to our clients

职责范围：

负责分支行的业务操作及各项与分支行有关的营运工作，包括柜台交易的办理及系统处理，确保各项分支行工作执行的准确性，合规性和完整性，执行中必须始终遵守并严格按照银行的内外部准则/操作流程/操作手册/标准/集团要求/监管要求/法规等要求，同时始终保持高水准的客户服务质量与体验

Key Responsibilities

General 总则

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.
  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Business Performance 业务表现

  • Support to achieve business objective at the respective branch
  • Drive or support cost optimization initiatives to achieve cost saving target
  • 协助分支行实现工作目标
  • 主动倡议或协助银行推进各项成本优化创新方案的实现

Service 客户服务质量

  • Embed client centric mind in daily operation as well as to maintain up best in class front-line service
  • Continue to advocate human banker and client centric service mindset in service staff for enriching internal and external customer experience
  • Achieve client satisfaction in daily branch services and operations
  • Build SCB a great place to work
  • 在日常工作中始终倡导“以客户为中心”的服务理念，给客户提供最优质的服务
  • 在服务中始终秉承“以人为本，以客户为中心”的服务理念，保持并提升内外部客户的服务体验
  • 在分支行日常对外服务中，始终以客户满意为服务宗旨
  • 始终立志于共同将渣打银行构建成一个员工和客户都喜欢的公司

Operations, Conduct and Risk Control 营运操作，行为规范和风险控制

  • Handle all counter operations, branch transactions in good result to ensure all bank internal and external rules/standards/procedures/manual are strictly followed
  • Perform bank required due diligence in branch start of day and end of day work on daily base to ensure no exception in execution
  • Complete regulatory required reporting timely and accurately to ensure the report follows regulatory requirements with no exception
  • Support Line Manager achieve good MCA rating in branch audit
  • Escalate for any exception detected or observed in daily work to minimize potential negative impact on the bank
  • Ensure all required certifications are obtained per internal and external requirements
  • Acknowledge and follow bank job rotation policy/procedure that working location will be subject to detail arrangement on due with no objection
  • Adhere to bank Conduct Plan, and all control and assurance mechanisms to comply with all internal and external standards and policies in executions
  • Adhere to laws and regulations, internal risk (including FCC risks as anti-money laundry, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption), compliance policies and the Group Code of Conduct; well manage client complaints & CDD
  • 负责分支行交易（含柜台业务）的办理及系统操作，确保执行结果完全符合银行内外部各项规定、准则、集团政策，操作手册/规定、外部法规及法律等
  • 严格遵守银行在分支行营运起始、营运中、营运日终的各项业务开展及审核的尽职要求，确保营运工作没有纰漏及差错
  • 认真履行监管报表的报送，确保报送内容、报送时间均符合监管及银行内部操作要求，没有差错或纰漏
  • 协助主管在银行内部审计中取得良好的MCA (management control approach)成绩
  • 及时汇报或发现任何异常的操作现象或问题确保营运风险最低化
  • 根据银行的内外部要求，确保获得岗位就职需要的各项有效证书
  • 知晓并严格执行银行轮岗制度及操作规定，认真执行并服从银行就轮岗做出的通知及安排
  • 遵守银行的行为规范守则，在执行中始终遵守银行内控及风险管理机制中要求员工执行的内外部各项规定及政策
  • 遵守法律法规，内部风险(包括反洗钱，受制裁，反贿赂和腐败等风险)合规政策和集团行为准则的要求，妥善处理客户投诉及客户尽职调查

Self Development 自我发展与提升

  • Actively participate in various training programs arranged by the bank and keep self-learning on the laid down procedures/manuals and local regulation
  • Actively participate in various campaigns related to service team and achieve the target
  • Develop multi-product knowledge and job skills to support different segments and sales channels
  • Complete new joiner training program if new to the position (new hire or internal transfer) base on bank policy, and pass all required assessment by training timeline
  • 积极参与完成银行安排的各项培训项目，主动学习银行内部流程/操作手册以及当地法规
  • 积极参与与服务团队相关的各项竞赛活动并达到预期目标
  • 深入学习银行各产品知识及职业技能，确保业务及产品知识可以支持不同业务线发展需要
  • 根据银行政策完成新入职人员(新员工或内部调动)的培训计划，并在要求时间内通过所有评估测试

Customer Right Protection 消费者权益保护

  • Fully understand the importance of Consumer Rights Protection, prevent damage to consumers’ best interest
  • Implement regulatory requirements related to Consumer Rights Protection, ensure to complete relevant trainings
  • Always embed Consumer Rights Protection mindset when performing daily work
  • 在日常营运工作中，充分理解保护消费者权益的重要性，防止损害消费者的利益
  • 在日常营运工作中，始终遵守与消费者权益保护相关的法规要求，且确保完成相关培训
  • 在日常营运工作中，始终谨记以保护消费者权益为基础执行工作

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Financial Skills

Qualifications

Selection Criteria 职位要求

  • A university degree with 1-2 years of related banking experience prevails
  • Solid knowledge of bank products and services and banking procedures, equities markets, unit trusts and other personal investment services
  • A team player who shows initiative and assertiveness
  • Self-motivator who is keen to upgrade, improve personal knowledge and skills to meet job requirements
  • Good command of both spoken and written English and Mandarin
  • 大学本科学历，1-2年银行从业相关经验优先考虑
  • 熟悉银行产品、营运及服务要求、理财保险产品
  • 具有良好的团队合作精神、主动坚定
  • 有上进心，自我激励，不断提高知识储备和技巧，以满足工作要求
  • 具有良好的中英文写作和口语能力

Other then above roles, job holder should follow other job duties and responsibilities assigned by line manager from time to time.

除上述工作职责外，员工应遵循直属经理随时指派的任何工作职责和任务。

Above key responsibilities and selection criteria are the major assessment to assess the staff if qualified during probation and competent after probation. Failing to satisfy any of the aforesaid requirements, or failing to pass related new jointer training (including but not limited to the CPBB Essentials and Financial Solutions training), the employee will be deemed not meet the recruitment requirement for passing probation, and the Bank is entitled to terminate the employee’s employment contract immediately. For employee who has passed the probation, failing to pass the related new joiner trainings (including but not limited to the CPBB Essentials and Financial Solutions training) and will be taken as assessment basis for job incompetency.

以上的主要工作职责和岗位聘任要求是用于考核试用期是否符合录用条件和工作胜任与否的标准。倘若员工未能满足前述要求，或未能通过入职相关培训测试（包括但不限于CPBB Essentials入职培训及金融解决方案培训等），则该员工将被视为不符合试用期的录用条件，银行有权立即终止员工的劳动合同；对于已过试用期的员工，未能通过入职相关培训测试（包括但不限于CPBB Essentials入职培训及金融解决方案培训等），将作为不胜任工作岗位的考核依据。

Before attend and pass the related new jointer training and assessment (including but not limited to CPBB Essentials and Financial Solutions training) the employee should not perform any kind of business.

对于还没有参与并通过入职相关培训与测试（包括但不限于CPBB Essentials入职培训及金融解决方案培训等）的员工，禁止办理任何业务。

Please note that the job description above will be reviewed during the Job Objective setting every year, which may be amended and agreed where necessary by the employee and the line manager.

请注意以上本工作描述将于每年制定年度工作目标时予以审核，如有必要将由直属经理和员工予以修订并达成一致。

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

- Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
- Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
- Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
- All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Key Responsibilities

We are looking for a SMID Research Associate to support senior analysts in delivering high-quality, differentiated research to institutional clients.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop and maintain detailed financial models, including forecasts and scenario analysis, to support stock coverage
  • Perform fundamental analysis, including earnings drivers, regulatory frameworks, and sector-specific dynamics across different value chains within China’s SMID sector
  • Produce high-quality research reports, notes, and thematic pieces with clear investment recommendations (Buy/Sell/Hold)
  • Generate differentiated investment insights by combining industry knowledge with valuation frameworks (DCF, multiples, sum-of-the-parts, etc.)
  • Monitor sector developments, including high-frequency industrial data, technological developments and policy changes to identify investment opportunities
  • Engage with corporate management, industry experts, and internal stakeholders to enhance research perspectives
  • Support client interactions by preparing materials and responding to investor inquiries

The team

You'll be working in the Equity Research team in Shanghai. We are open and energetic team. We work closely with corporates and clients.

Diversity helps us grow, together. That’s why we are committed to fostering and advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion. It strengthens our business and brings value to our clients.

  • Solid understanding of accounting and financial statements
  • Strong interests in various sectors/industries
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; Leveraging AI to boost efficiency is a plus
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate investment views clearly and concisely in English

Key Responsibilities

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, someone who can balance the demands to support business growth versus the need for rigorous control? Do you have an appetite to understand the front-to-back flow to come up with creative ways to manage risk and improve processes? We're looking for someone who can:

  • Be part of our Collateral and Margin Management team
  • Understand the F2B operational risks and responsible for the service delivery of daily margin and collateral management for Asia Pacific
  • Work closely with Traders to facilitate margin calls, recalls, pledging activities and to meet tight market deadlines.
  • Perform front-to-back controls to ensure collateral position and trades are properly reconciled
  • Engage with external clients and internal partners (Trading, Account Managers, Settlements & Confirmation, Finance, etc...) to provide operational support and independent advice on margin flow and operational risks
  • Participate in process enhancements initiatives and new business roll-out, and the associated testing on system changes

The team

You’ll be working in the Global Collateral and Margin Management team in China WX. We are primarily responsible for the service delivery of margin and collateral management for Asia Pacific across wide range of products in including Centrally Cleared and Non-Centrally Cleared OTC derivatives, Exchange Traded Derivative with the purpose of covering UBS' exposure which could have the potential for counterparty default, and also fulfilling margin rules and regulatory requirements.

Your Skills And Experience

You have:

  • At least 1+ years of banking experience
  • The ability to pick up new tasks quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Good working knowledge of MS Office 365 apps. Practical AI usage preferred.
  • Full accountability to take ownership and drive improvements

You are:

  • A self-starter who can learn and apply new knowledge very quickly
  • Able to work under pressure, adaptable and with strong interpersonal skills
  • A dedicated team player who collaborates well with different functions from different locations

345221BR

Beijing

Key Responsibilities

We are looking for an Investment Research Sector Analyst to join our Equity Research team, with responsibility for covering companies across the Oil, Gas & Chemicals sector.

In this role, you will develop differentiated investment insights through rigorous fundamental analysis of companies, commodities and industry trends. You will combine detailed financial modelling with an understanding of oil, gas, & chemical markets, company strategy, asset quality, capital allocation and valuation to help investors make informed investment decisions.

You will work closely with senior research analysts and colleagues across the broader research platform, while developing relationships with company management teams, investors and industry participants.

  • Conduct fundamental research on listed Oil, Gas & Chemical companies, including integrated energy companies, exploration and production companies, refiners and other relevant parts of the energy value chain.
  • Build, maintain and enhance detailed company financial models, including earnings forecasts, cash-flow analysis, balance-sheet analysis and valuation.
  • Analyze key sector drivers including crude oil and natural gas prices, production volumes, realized pricing, operating costs, capital expenditure, reserve development, refining margins and industry supply-demand dynamics.
  • Develop investment views at both company and sector level, identifying differentiated insights, catalysts, risks and potential changes in market expectations.
  • Apply appropriate valuation frameworks, including discounted cash flow, NAV, trading multiples and other sector-relevant methodologies.
  • Monitor company results, operational updates, commodity-market developments, regulatory changes and geopolitical events, and assess their implications for earnings and valuations.
  • Contribute to high-quality research publications, including company updates, earnings analysis, industry thematic work and investment strategy pieces.
  • Engage with corporate management teams and other industry participants to deepen fundamental understanding of companies and market dynamics.
  • Support discussions with institutional investors by clearly communicating investment theses, industry trends, valuation frameworks and key risks.
  • Collaborate effectively with research colleagues across sectors, regions and disciplines to develop broader thematic and cross-sector insights.
  • Maintain high standards of accuracy, intellectual independence, risk awareness and compliance in all research activities.

The team

You'll be working in the Equity Research team in Beijing. We are open and energetic team. We work closely with corporates and clients.

Diversity helps us grow, together. That’s why we are committed to fostering and advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion. It strengthens our business and brings value to our clients.

A successful analyst will combine deep fundamental research, disciplined financial analysis and commercial investment judgement. You will develop a strong understanding of the companies and assets you cover, anticipate changes in earnings and industry fundamentals, and translate those insights into clear and differentiated investment conclusions for institutional investors.

You will also contribute to a collaborative research culture where analytical quality, constructive challenge, integrity and client relevance are central to how the team works.

Your Skills And Experience

You have:

  • Strong experience in equity research, investment analysis, asset management, investment banking, corporate finance, consulting or a relevant Oil, Gas & Chemical industry role.
  • A strong understanding of financial statements, corporate finance, accounting and equity valuation.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and interpret detailed financial models and translate analysis into actionable investment conclusions.
  • Knowledge of the Oil, Gas & Chemical industry and its key operational and financial drivers. Experience covering energy companies is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to identify the variables that matter most to earnings, cash flow and valuation.
  • Intellectual curiosity and the ability to develop independent, evidence-based investment views rather than simply describe industry developments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex industry and financial issues clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment, particularly during earnings seasons and periods of commodity or market volatility.
  • Strong attention to detail, sound judgement and a collaborative working style.
  • A university degree in finance, economics, accounting, engineering, or another relevant discipline. CFA qualifications or progress toward the CFA designation would be advantageous.

About Us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

Join us
