Job Type
Full Time
Job Reference #
345221BR
City
Beijing
Key Responsibilities
We are looking for an Investment Research Sector Analyst to join our Equity Research team, with responsibility for covering companies across the Oil, Gas & Chemicals sector.
In this role, you will develop differentiated investment insights through rigorous fundamental analysis of companies, commodities and industry trends. You will combine detailed financial modelling with an understanding of oil, gas, & chemical markets, company strategy, asset quality, capital allocation and valuation to help investors make informed investment decisions.
You will work closely with senior research analysts and colleagues across the broader research platform, while developing relationships with company management teams, investors and industry participants.
- Conduct fundamental research on listed Oil, Gas & Chemical companies, including integrated energy companies, exploration and production companies, refiners and other relevant parts of the energy value chain.
- Build, maintain and enhance detailed company financial models, including earnings forecasts, cash-flow analysis, balance-sheet analysis and valuation.
- Analyze key sector drivers including crude oil and natural gas prices, production volumes, realized pricing, operating costs, capital expenditure, reserve development, refining margins and industry supply-demand dynamics.
- Develop investment views at both company and sector level, identifying differentiated insights, catalysts, risks and potential changes in market expectations.
- Apply appropriate valuation frameworks, including discounted cash flow, NAV, trading multiples and other sector-relevant methodologies.
- Monitor company results, operational updates, commodity-market developments, regulatory changes and geopolitical events, and assess their implications for earnings and valuations.
- Contribute to high-quality research publications, including company updates, earnings analysis, industry thematic work and investment strategy pieces.
- Engage with corporate management teams and other industry participants to deepen fundamental understanding of companies and market dynamics.
- Support discussions with institutional investors by clearly communicating investment theses, industry trends, valuation frameworks and key risks.
- Collaborate effectively with research colleagues across sectors, regions and disciplines to develop broader thematic and cross-sector insights.
- Maintain high standards of accuracy, intellectual independence, risk awareness and compliance in all research activities.
The team
You'll be working in the Equity Research team in Beijing. We are open and energetic team. We work closely with corporates and clients.
Diversity helps us grow, together. That’s why we are committed to fostering and advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion. It strengthens our business and brings value to our clients.
A successful analyst will combine deep fundamental research, disciplined financial analysis and commercial investment judgement. You will develop a strong understanding of the companies and assets you cover, anticipate changes in earnings and industry fundamentals, and translate those insights into clear and differentiated investment conclusions for institutional investors.
You will also contribute to a collaborative research culture where analytical quality, constructive challenge, integrity and client relevance are central to how the team works.
Your Skills And Experience
You have:
- Strong experience in equity research, investment analysis, asset management, investment banking, corporate finance, consulting or a relevant Oil, Gas & Chemical industry role.
- A strong understanding of financial statements, corporate finance, accounting and equity valuation.
- Demonstrated ability to build and interpret detailed financial models and translate analysis into actionable investment conclusions.
- Knowledge of the Oil, Gas & Chemical industry and its key operational and financial drivers. Experience covering energy companies is highly desirable.
- Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to identify the variables that matter most to earnings, cash flow and valuation.
- Intellectual curiosity and the ability to develop independent, evidence-based investment views rather than simply describe industry developments.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex industry and financial issues clearly and concisely.
- Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment, particularly during earnings seasons and periods of commodity or market volatility.
- Strong attention to detail, sound judgement and a collaborative working style.
- A university degree in finance, economics, accounting, engineering, or another relevant discipline. CFA qualifications or progress toward the CFA designation would be advantageous.

ln:4485314007.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Manager - Data and Analytics.

Principal responsibilities

Who You Are

  • An analytical problem-solver with an interest in applying data and analytics to business challenges.
  • A proactive contributor who can structure ambiguous problems and develop practical recommendations.
  • Comfortable working with business and technical stakeholders across different teams.
  • Able to translate complex analysis into clear insights and actionable next steps.
  • Curious about emerging analytics tools, methodologies and industry practices.
  • Willing to challenge existing approaches constructively and test new ideas.
  • A collaborative communicator who can build effective working relationships.
  • Conscious of the importance of data quality, privacy and sound governance.

Roles And Responsibilities

Strategic analytics and business integration

  • Work with business units to identify opportunities where data analytics can support business objectives.
  • Help develop analytical frameworks, tools and insights aligned with customer needs, market trends and regulatory requirements.
  • Support analysis relating to retail banking strategy, channel optimisation, customer experience and competitive positioning.
  • Translate business questions into analytical requirements, hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
  • Help define KPIs and metrics to assess the impact of analytics initiatives.
  • Contribute to the development of reusable analytical approaches and reporting materials.

Data-driven decision-making

  • Analyse data to identify trends, patterns, opportunities and areas for improvement.
  • Support the development and application of predictive models, segmentation, portfolio analysis and scenario modelling.
  • Interpret analytical outputs and translate them into practical business recommendations.
  • Prepare clear reports, presentations and dashboards for business stakeholders and management.
  • Validate assumptions, data quality and analytical results before sharing conclusions.
  • Support senior colleagues in presenting insights and recommendations to relevant stakeholders.

Business strategy and process improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve operational effectiveness, resource allocation and decision-making through analytics.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to support the implementation of data-driven solutions.
  • Help embed analytics into business processes and management routines.
  • Assess the potential impact of proposed solutions on customers, colleagues and operating processes.
  • Support continuous improvement by reviewing performance data and stakeholder feedback.

Stakeholder engagement and collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with analytics, technology, business, finance, risk, compliance, legal and data-governance teams.
  • Build effective relationships with stakeholders and maintain clear communication throughout delivery.
  • Explain analytical findings and technical concepts in an accessible way to non-technical audiences.
  • Prepare meeting materials, status updates, management information and decision papers.
  • Support workshops and discussions to clarify requirements, resolve issues and agree next steps.
  • Promote the value of evidence-based decision-making across relevant business areas.

Governance and data management

  • Follow applicable internal standards, governance processes and regulatory expectations for data and analytics.
  • Support appropriate documentation of data sources, assumptions, methodologies, limitations and outcomes.
  • Work with relevant control functions to identify and manage data, privacy, security and implementation risks.
  • Help ensure that analytical solutions are appropriately monitored and maintained.
  • Escalate material risks, control concerns or delivery issues promptly.
  • Maintain high standards of confidentiality, data handling and professional conduct.

Continuous improvement and industry alignment

  • Keep up to date with developments in analytics, banking technology and financial-services practices.
  • Research relevant tools, techniques and industry examples from Hong Kong, China and international markets.
  • Support benchmarking against leading financial institutions.
  • Evaluate emerging analytical tools and methodologies based on business value, maturity, security and practical application.
  • Share relevant insights and recommendations with the wider team.
  • Contribute to experimentation and continuous improvement while maintaining appropriate governance.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Quantitative Finance, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, Analytics, Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Experience with data analysis, business analytics, strategy, product development, transformation or a related area.
  • Understanding of analytical techniques such as segmentation, portfolio analytics, pricing analysis, predictive modelling and scenario analysis.
  • Ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches and clear recommendations.
  • Experience using tools such as Python, SQL, Tableau, Qlik Sense or Looker Studio.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS or Google Cloud Platform is advantageous.
  • Basic understanding of data governance, privacy, information security and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • A proactive, detail-oriented and collaborative approach to problem-solving.
  • Foundational knowledge of banking or financial services, preferably including retail banking, wealth management or customer analytics.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Platforms

Req ID： 65288

Principal responsibilities

  • Provide support across the end-to-end delivery and run lifecycle, utilising their skills and expertise to carry out software development, testing and operational support activities with the ability to move between these according to demand.
  • End to end accountability for a product or service, identifying and developing the most appropriate Technology solutions to meet customer needs as part of the Customer Journey
  • Liaise with other engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to understand and drive the product or service’s direction.
  • Establish a digital environment and automate processes to minimize variation and ensure predictable high quality code and data.
  • Create technical test plans and records, including unit and integration tests, within automated test environments to ensure code quality.
  • Provide support to DevOps teams working at all stages of a product or service release/change with a strong customer focus and end to end journeys, ensuring they have an excellent domain knowledge.
  • Working with Ops, Dev and Test Engineers to ensure operational issues (performance, operator intervention, alerting, design defect related issues, etc.) are identified and addressed at all stages of a product or service release / change.
  • Provide support in identification and resolution of all incidents associated with the IT service, as directed by leadership of the DevOps team
  • Ensure service resilience, service sustainability and recovery time objectives are met for all the software solutions delivered.
  • Responsible for automating the continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline within a DevOps Product/Service team driving a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Keep up to date and have expertise on current tools, technologies and areas like cyber security and regulations pertaining to aspects like data privacy, consent, data residency etc. that are applicable

Requirements

  • Extensive IT software engineering experience in software development with Agile methodologies. Experience with frontend and testing is an advantage.
  • Proficient knowledge in GCP and Ali Cloud is essential.
  • Knowledge of “Talk is cheap. Show me the code” --- Linus Torvalds (2000) Hands-on engineering capabilities in state-of-the-art technologies is a must
  • In-depth knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Proficient in containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
  • Solid grasp of software engineering principles, including scalable design patterns, security, and performance optimization.
  • Strong analytical, design, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent team player with the ability to work under pressure with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of working in a fast-paced, globally distributed team environment.
  • Experience in leading a team, conducting code reviews, and test case reviews.
  • Ability to rapidly build and set up PoC environments with Cloud, Container, etc.
  • Proficiency in at least two programming languages, such as Java, Python, Golang, or Node.js.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Be responsible for successful implementation of Premier Acquisition strategies
  • Acquire new-to-bank customers via central or self-generated leads.
  • In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to complete simple retail sales.

The Network Analyst is an intermediate level role responsible for assisting with network related activities, including network installation, maintenance, technical guidance, and security in coordination with the Citi standard.

The overall objective is to support new company setup and continue to provide network support for securities company in BAU.

Responsibilities

  • Be responsible for the operational support of network for Citi China securities company, which includes multiple platforms, manufacturers, and technologies.
  • Participates in collaborating with various internal groups and external vendors to ensure all installations meet specifications.
  • Provide fast response to network problems of high priority, severity, and impact, escalating as appropriate.
  • Act directly on incidents and tasks of greater complexity or priority assigned to the team.
  • Excellent interpersonal relations and communication and persuasive skills; be able to manage communication with multiple audiences during problem-solving and crisis management.
  • Keep up with the Citi network/infra standard, act as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
  • Collect business requirement and interpret to proper technical components and support business to follow proper process
  • Assist project team on service ensure timely project delivery
  • Manage vendor on proper service delivery
  • Support and assist regional operation team on incident handling
  • Communicate with relevant teams to provide frequent status updates regarding the technical issue, status of the remediation efforts, and ongoing business impact
  • Exchange ideas and information in a concise and clear manner
  • Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
  • Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of experience in a network engineer role (education/professional) with demonstrated knowledge of operational process change and improvement
  • CCNA or above
  • Experience in networks and telecommunications in large-scale environments, such as Carrier, Manufacturers, Multi-Account Global Services, or a large-scale enterprise environment.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills.
  • Effective diagnostic and analysis skills. Mature analytical and communications skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
  • Experience in Financial Services or a broad global or complex environment preferred.
  • Ability to provide rapid response to problems, leading multidisciplinary teams virtually.
  • Ability to work with personal and virtual teams and work under pressure or for rapid resolution of critical incidents
  • Hands on experience on China Securities industry


Education

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience


This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Principal Data Engineer Data Technology.

 Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID ： 57085

The Role

As Principal Engineer for the Data Technology Platform you will set technical strategy, architecture and engineering standards across core enterprise data capabilities. The platform estate spans Enterprise Data Assets (EDA), Reference Data, Big Data and Movement and Data Decisioning engineering that underpin data democratisation, AI enablement, customer insight and regulatory compliance. You will shape how distributed data platforms are designed, built and run in hybrid cloud environments so they remain enterprise-ready and future-fit. This role combines deep hands-on engineering direction with influence across product and delivery teams in a global matrixed organisation. Success means clear reference engineering standards, consistent platform patterns and measurable improvements in scalability, observability and cost. You will also strengthen the developer experience so teams can discover, adopt and build on shared data services at pace.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve reference engineering standards for core data provisioning platforms aligned to Group Data Strategy and Data Future State Architecture
  • Set technical direction across Enterprise Data Assets (EDA) including APIs for standardised data provisioning
  • Establish engineering approaches for Reference Data Services including golden source alignment and hierarchy management
  • Oversee architecture and engineering patterns for big data ingestion, streaming and transformation at scale
  • Shape decisioning infrastructure including real-time feature stores and orchestration
  • Govern peer reviews to improve consistency, reusability and compliance with enterprise standards
  • Champion DevSecOps, CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code across engineering teams
  • Advance observability, performance engineering, cost optimisation and scalability in hybrid cloud environments
  • Guide teams on data pipelines, APIs, metadata-driven controls and automated testing frameworks
  • Represent the domain in cross-platform technology councils and architecture forums

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bring substantial hands-on experience in data platform engineering, architecture or software development in a scaled enterprise environment
  • Build large-scale data pipelines, APIs and event-driven systems using modern frameworks and technologies such as Spring, Kafka and Spark
  • Apply strong architectural knowledge of data mesh, data lakehouse and real-time customer-facing operational and analytics platforms
  • Use cloud platforms including AWS and GCP alongside containerisation and infrastructure-as-code tooling
  • Implement modern development tooling and automation for modelling, observability, resilience and governance patterns
  • Create reusable platform services that accelerate delivery for data consumers and AI and ML initiatives
  • Communicate complex technical decisions clearly to engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders to align outcomes to strategic objectives

/LP/WX

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering (Knowledge & RAG Platform Engineering Lead).

Business: CTO Platforms (AI Platforms)

Job ID: 56078

Location: Guangzhou / Xi'an

Principal Responsibilities

  • Senior technical IC leadership for knowledge intelligence: Act as a hands-on senior technical expert in knowledge intelligence and knowledge management, shaping architecture, technical direction, and implementation approach for an enterprise-grade knowledge platform.
  • Knowledge platform architecture & delivery ownership: Lead the design and build of scalable platform capabilities across ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification, knowledge asset management, discovery, reuse, governance, and controlled downstream consumption.
  • Industry best practice adoption & engineering standards: Evaluate knowledge management, knowledge engineering, ontology/taxonomy, graph, and AI-assisted curation practices, and translate them into engineering standards, reusable patterns, reference architectures, APIs/SDKs, and runbooks.
  • Knowledge refinement & intelligence workflows: Lead workflows that extract, refine, summarize, classify, deduplicate, consolidate, and contextualize fragmented information into trusted, structured, traceable, and business-aligned knowledge assets.
  • Knowledge graph & semantic layer leadership: Architect and evolve ontology/taxonomy management, entity/relation extraction, entity resolution, graph modeling, graph traversal, lineage-aware context assembly, and graph-based reasoning support for AI and search scenarios.
  • Knowledge lifecycle, governance & self-checking: Establish mechanisms for ownership, validation, versioning, publishing, freshness monitoring, deprecation, retention, rollback, quality scoring, duplication/contradiction detection, and citation/provenance validation.
  • Optimisation & operational readiness: Define SLOs/SLAs, observability, alerting, capacity planning, cost controls, incident response, troubleshooting playbooks, resilience patterns, and continuous production improvement for knowledge platform services.
  • Cross-team influence & enablement: Partner with AI engineering, data platforms, cybersecurity, architecture, product, and domain SMEs to drive adoption, mentor engineers, review designs, unblock complex issues, and communicate trade-offs to senior stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Management, Data Engineering, AI, or a related technical discipline; 7+ years of hands-on engineering experience in backend, data, AI, knowledge, search, or enterprise information platforms.
  • Proven experience as a senior technical IC or platform technical lead, owning architecture, engineering standards, design review, implementation quality, optimisation, and production readiness for complex platform capabilities.
  • Deep knowledge of knowledge intelligence and management practices, including taxonomy/ontology design, metadata standards, knowledge refinement, lifecycle management, governance, lineage, and enterprise content operations.
  • Hands-on experience with knowledge graph, semantic search, RAG, agentic AI, or data enrichment systems, plus strong engineering foundations in distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, observability, CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Strong security, compliance, production, and stakeholder mindset, with the ability to adopt industry best practices, mentor engineers, influence cross-functional teams, and apply AI-native approaches to improve quality, productivity, and decision-making.

ln:4485353026.descriptionHtml:
HSBC Qianhai

HSBC Qianhai Securities Limited (HSBC Qianhai), a joint venture securities company, was incorporated on 28 August 2017, pursuant to Supplementary Agreement X to the Closer Economic Partnership Arrangements (CEPA) between the mainland and Hong Kong.

The registered capital of HSBC Qianhai is RMB1.8 billion. The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited (HSBC) holds 90% of the shares, while Qianhai Financial Holdings Co., Ltd. (QFH) holds the remaining 10%. Our headquarters are located in Qianhai, Shenzhen. We have branch offices in Beijing and Shanghai, and a trading outlet in Qianhai, Shenzhen.

By combining solid expertise in the domestic capital market with the global competitive advantage of the HSBC Group, we are committed to providing our customers with comprehensive securities services and a diverse range of products, aspiring to be your unique partner in China's onshore capital markets.

Our purpose – ‘Opening up a world of opportunity’ – explains why we exist. For information about our purpose and values, please visit HSBC.com.

HSBC Qianhai is part of one of the world’s largest financial services organisations. Whether you are an experienced professional, looking for your first job, or are interested in one of our student and graduate programmes, we provide many ways for you to develop your skills and achieve your career ambitions in a diverse and inclusive environment.

We offer opportunities across our organisation to build a fulfilling career and work with colleagues and customers around the world. We have roles available in business areas including Investment Banking, Securities Brokerage, Investment Advisory, Securities Proprietary Trading, Asset Management and Private Wealth Management, and Functions, Digital Business Services.

We look for people who are ambitious and want to develop their career and contribute to HSBC’s long-term, sustainable growth. We want employees who can help us achieve our strategy, balance social, environmental and economic considerations and manage risk accordingly.

To ensure we achieve this growth in the right way, we place great emphasis on our values. We are committed to applying the highest standards throughout the company, everywhere we do business.

Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of our business. Joining HSBC will give you the opportunity to work in a collegiate and supportive environment in which we seek to develop and promote you based on merit.

We also have a strong commitment to sustainability and encourage employees to participate in our community projects and other activities.

Responsibilities Of The Role Holder

  • Set the strategic direction of the investment and wealth solutions for clients, especially in the areas of Brokerage, Investment Advisory and Investment Banking referral
  • Provide investment support, education and guidance to external clients, prospects and Investment Counsellors
  • Develop comprehensive investment strategy and asset allocation proposal appropriate to clients, and coordinate execution with appropriate products and services
  • Provide input and support for the development of new business initiatives and product enhancement in the covered areas
  • Manage the life cycle of the onboarded products/services including authorities reporting, product/service training, performance monitoring and communication, risk and compliance issues follow up, etc.
  • Provide regular and timely updates on investment opportunities to clients, prospects and Investment Counsellors
  • Coordinate with relevant departments to complete the policy and procedure write up
  • Other projects or initiatives assigned by line manager

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Master Degree and/or CFA, minimum 7 years’ experience in product related role in financial institutions, and minimum 5 years’ experience in Securities houses
  • SAC qualifications is pre-requisite, esp Investment Advisory Qualification
  • Good business acumen with understanding of the Securities house’s businesses including Brokerage, Investment Advisory, Investment Banking, Asset Management, Derivatives, etc.
  • Extensive knowledge of wealth management business (onshore and offshore), and competitive and regulatory environment
  • Highly independent and a good team player
  • Strong analytical skill with strategic thinking ability and good project management skills
  • Client-focused, with strong negotiation, communication and presentation (written and oral) skills
  • Able to work under pressure and solve complex problems
  • Fluent in both English and Chinese writing and speaking

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Delivery Management.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

Product strategy and roadmap

  • Define the product vision, strategy and roadmap for technology capabilities related to financial market.
  • Translate investment, operations, client and regulatory requirements into prioritised product outcomes.
  • Maintain a transparent backlog and make trade-offs based on client value, business impact, risk and delivery capacity.
  • Track market and technology developments relevant to asset management.

Discovery and requirements

  • Partner with investment teams, portfolio managers, traders, bankers, operations, risk, compliance, finance, data and engineering colleagues.
  • Understand current processes, pain points, dependencies and control gaps.
  • Lead discovery workshops, user research and process analysis.
  • Create clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and operating-model documentation.
  • Ensure requirements are inclusive and reflect the needs of different users and locations.

Delivery and execution

  • Lead products through the full lifecycle: discovery, design, build, testing, launch and continuous improvement.
  • Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, data and delivery teams.
  • Establish delivery milestones, success measures and release plans.
  • Remove blockers and communicate progress, decisions, risks and dependencies clearly.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing, implementation readiness and post-launch reviews.

Asset-management domain alignment

Depending On The Product Area, Support Capabilities Such As

  • Portfolio and investment management workflows.
  • Order and trade management.
  • Performance and attribution.
  • Risk and compliance monitoring.
  • Investment book of record or accounting data.
  • Market, reference and security-master data.
  • Client, fund and regulatory reporting.
  • Workflow automation and straight-through processing.
  • APIs, data platforms and integration with internal or third-party systems.

Risk, controls and regulatory obligations

  • Build security, resilience, privacy, auditability and regulatory requirements into product design.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Information Security, Architecture and Operational Resilience teams.
  • Maintain appropriate product documentation, controls, approvals and evidence.
  • Identify and manage product risks, technical debt and operational dependencies.
  • Ensure solutions are designed for responsible use of data and emerging technologies.

Stakeholder and vendor management

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and subject-matter experts.
  • Align priorities across business lines, technology teams and geographic locations.
  • Manage relevant third-party vendors and technology partners.
  • Prepare concise updates for governance forums and senior leadership.
  • Explain complex technology topics in clear business language.

Requirements

Essential experience and skills

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, Technology Product Manager or equivalent in asset management, investment management, securities company, investment banks, commercial banks or financial services.
  • Strong understanding of trading, asset-management processes and technology.
  • Experience taking products from concept through delivery and live operation.
  • Ability to define product strategy, roadmaps, outcomes and prioritisation principles.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile product-delivery practices.
  • Experience working with engineering, data, architecture, security and control functions.
  • Excellent stakeholder-management, communication and influencing skills.
  • Ability to analyse complex problems and make sound, evidence-based decisions.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment with strong risk and control expectations.
  • Comfortable operating across business, technology and operational teams.Success measures

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

  • Deliver a clear and outcome-focused product roadmap.
  • Improve user experience, process efficiency and data quality.
  • Reduce manual work, operational risk and avoidable rework.
  • Deliver products safely, reliably and within agreed commitments.
  • Increase adoption and user satisfaction.
  • Strengthen controls, auditability and regulatory readiness.
  • Improve transparency across product performance, risks, dependencies and investment.

Key relationships

The Role Will Work Closely With

  • Financial market business and investment teams.
  • Portfolio managers, bankers, traders and research colleagues.
  • Operations, fund administration and client-service teams.
  • Engineering, architecture, data and infrastructure teams.
  • Risk, Compliance, Legal and Information Security.
  • Finance, Procurement and third-party technology providers.
  • Regional and global product and transformation teams.

Personal attributes

  • Customer- and user-focused.
  • Pragmatic, structured and delivery-oriented.
  • Comfortable making decisions in ambiguity.
  • Collaborative and inclusive, with the confidence to challenge constructively.
  • Accountable for outcomes rather than simply outputs.
  • Curious about technology and its practical application.
  • Calm and effective when managing competing priorities.
  • Clear, concise and credible with both technical and senior business audiences.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4485350148.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Supporting tasks to establish new business relationships and strengthening existing ones, whilst ensuring fair outcomes for all types of customers
  • Providing support to the communication new products, propositions and relevant market information to customers
  • Supporting distribution channel business development strategies
  • Supporting plans and strategies to generate new business as well as increase revenue for existing ones
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders, which may include relationship mangers and product specialists, to maximise cross-selling opportunities for the bank
  • Participating in events, initiatives and activities to develop business opportunities
  • Protect the bank's reputation and ensuring an acceptable risk profile, whilst deepening your understanding of the client through credit and customer due diligence reviews

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Proven ability in mobile sales / channel developing and maintaining
  • Current product/market knowledge
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Managerial experience
  • At least 3 years’ experience in supervisory role of sales function
  • Excellent interpersonal, leadership and motivation skills
  • Strong sales and organization ability and problem solving skills
  • Result driven and able to work under pressure
  • Good spoken and written English

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Delivery Management.

Business: IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

Product strategy and roadmap

  • Define the product vision, strategy and roadmap for technology capabilities related to financial market.
  • Translate investment, operations, client and regulatory requirements into prioritised product outcomes.
  • Maintain a transparent backlog and make trade-offs based on client value, business impact, risk and delivery capacity.
  • Track market and technology developments relevant to asset management.

Discovery and requirements

  • Partner with investment teams, portfolio managers, traders, bankers, operations, risk, compliance, finance, data and engineering colleagues.
  • Understand current processes, pain points, dependencies and control gaps.
  • Lead discovery workshops, user research and process analysis.
  • Create clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and operating-model documentation.
  • Ensure requirements are inclusive and reflect the needs of different users and locations.

Delivery and execution

  • Lead products through the full lifecycle: discovery, design, build, testing, launch and continuous improvement.
  • Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, data and delivery teams.
  • Establish delivery milestones, success measures and release plans.
  • Remove blockers and communicate progress, decisions, risks and dependencies clearly.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing, implementation readiness and post-launch reviews.

Asset-management domain alignment

Depending On The Product Area, Support Capabilities Such As

  • Portfolio and investment management workflows.
  • Order and trade management.
  • Performance and attribution.
  • Risk and compliance monitoring.
  • Investment book of record or accounting data.
  • Market, reference and security-master data.
  • Client, fund and regulatory reporting.
  • Workflow automation and straight-through processing.
  • APIs, data platforms and integration with internal or third-party systems.

Risk, controls and regulatory obligations

  • Build security, resilience, privacy, auditability and regulatory requirements into product design.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Information Security, Architecture and Operational Resilience teams.
  • Maintain appropriate product documentation, controls, approvals and evidence.
  • Identify and manage product risks, technical debt and operational dependencies.
  • Ensure solutions are designed for responsible use of data and emerging technologies.

Stakeholder and vendor management

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and subject-matter experts.
  • Align priorities across business lines, technology teams and geographic locations.
  • Manage relevant third-party vendors and technology partners.
  • Prepare concise updates for governance forums and senior leadership.
  • Explain complex technology topics in clear business language.

Requirements

Essential experience and skills

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, Technology Product Manager or equivalent in asset management, investment management, securities company, investment banks, commercial banks or financial services.
  • Strong understanding of trading, asset-management processes and technology.
  • Experience taking products from concept through delivery and live operation.
  • Ability to define product strategy, roadmaps, outcomes and prioritisation principles.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile product-delivery practices.
  • Experience working with engineering, data, architecture, security and control functions.
  • Excellent stakeholder-management, communication and influencing skills.
  • Ability to analyse complex problems and make sound, evidence-based decisions.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment with strong risk and control expectations.
  • Comfortable operating across business, technology and operational teams.Success measures

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

  • Deliver a clear and outcome-focused product roadmap.
  • Improve user experience, process efficiency and data quality.
  • Reduce manual work, operational risk and avoidable rework.
  • Deliver products safely, reliably and within agreed commitments.
  • Increase adoption and user satisfaction.
  • Strengthen controls, auditability and regulatory readiness.
  • Improve transparency across product performance, risks, dependencies and investment.

Key relationships

The Role Will Work Closely With

  • Financial market business and investment teams.
  • Portfolio managers, bankers, traders and research colleagues.
  • Operations, fund administration and client-service teams.
  • Engineering, architecture, data and infrastructure teams.
  • Risk, Compliance, Legal and Information Security.
  • Finance, Procurement and third-party technology providers.
  • Regional and global product and transformation teams.

Personal attributes

  • Customer- and user-focused.
  • Pragmatic, structured and delivery-oriented.
  • Comfortable making decisions in ambiguity.
  • Collaborative and inclusive, with the confidence to challenge constructively.
  • Accountable for outcomes rather than simply outputs.
  • Curious about technology and its practical application.
  • Calm and effective when managing competing priorities.
  • Clear, concise and credible with both technical and senior business audiences.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Business: Cybersecurity

Job ID ： 65326

Principal Responsibilities

 Impact on the Business/Function

  • Deliver security research and testing projects focused on HSBC critical services and projects to ensure that design, quality and implementation of controls do not expose the bank to a significant level of risk.
  • Achieve excellence by driving performance, compliance and security.
  • Provide oversight and control over third party Threat-led Penetration Tests in line with the varied regional regulatory requirements and the organizations risk appetite.
  • Work with key stakeholders to proactively drive the reduction in Cybersecurity risks and to improve the security risk posture of HSBC within the business risk appetite.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and guidance to a broad range of stakeholders across global business and functions.

Customers / Stakeholders

  • Engage with relevant programmes that are critical to the bank.
  • Understand the financial services industry security and threat landscape.
  • Engage with a diverse set of stakeholders in order to achieve CROS objectives, including Group leadership, Business and Functions CIOs, CISOs, Cybersecurity leads and Control Owners.
  • Engage with specialist technology functions such as, HSBC Digital, Innovation and Technology Centres.

  • Establish and maintain productive relationships across the bank in the client facing role.

  • The jobholder will also continually reassess the Cybersecurity and operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology.

 Observation of Internal Controls (Compliance Policy / FIM requirements)

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Conduct product training to support and deliver new product launches and lead client education events to help client gain better knowledge of financial markets and financial solutions.
  • Follow the needs-based sales process, give clients a meaningful and consistent wealth experience and ultimately provide an outstanding client experience
  • Support RMs to gain more client trust and commitment in broadening and deepening their relationship with HSBC, and increase the effectiveness and quality of needs fulfilled for target clients
  • Strengthen HSBC’s image as a leading wealth provider by providing clients with access to advanced technical product expertise
  • Conduct portfolio reviews with RMs, assess product suitability and market and regulatory change impact to products held by clients as appropriate, identify opportunities and manage risks
  • Join RMs in meeting clients and provide advice, input based on technical knowledge while acting as a second point of contact to RMs for specific products and solutions
  • Improve RMs product specific technical knowledge by effective on-job coaching and training
  • Activity: (Joint) meeting, Training, Coaching, Client Seminar, Portfolio Review, Policy Review
  • 提供新产品培训，帮助客户获得更好的理财市场信息和解决办法。
  • 根据客户财务需求，分享合适的财富管理经验和提供良好的客户体验
  • 帮助客户经理获得并加深客户信任，提高满足客户财务需求的有效性和质量
  • 利用先进的技术专长，加强客户对汇丰在财富管理市场上的领先形象
  • 帮助客户经理梳理客户财务组合，根据市场和政策变化，判断潜在机会并管理风险，对客户持有产品进行相应调整
  • 陪同客户经理约见客人，并基于产品和解决方法提供专业建议
  • 利用专长给客户经理提供辅导和培训
  • 财务安全规划经理的活动包括客户会见、培训、辅导、客户沙龙、客户资产组合回顾及保单回顾等。

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Accumulated extensive working experience as a product specialist or financial advisor or hands-on working experience as Sub-branch Manager in IWPB
  • Strong client skills with the ability to deliver a strong client experience and provide needs-based solutions
  • Deep knowledge of specific complex financial solutions and products including the knowledge of financial markets, social-economic dynamics, and regulatory requirement relevant to the products
  • Extensive external market awareness of market conditions, new product solutions, and an understanding of current financial market activities
  • Demonstrated ability and experience to correctly identify client needs
  • Solid skills to manage consultative sales process
  • A solid understanding of global Anti-money Laundering standards
  • Team player with collaborative skills
  • Knowledge of local and Group compliance regulation
  • Specialisation in one or more product categories e.g. /Estate Planning/Retirement/Protection/ Education.
  • 相关领域丰富的工作经验，如保险专家或财富管理专家,或有对私支行行长经验
  • 良好客户沟通能力，能基于客户需求提供建议
  • 熟悉财富管理相关产品知识以及相关政策规定
  • 熟悉外部市场包括市场环境，新产品推出以及对目前产品市场的理解
  • 能够深度挖掘客户需求
  • 熟悉销售流程
  • 熟悉国际反洗钱规则
  • 具有团队合作精神
  • 熟悉国际和国内相关法律规定
  • 在某一领域特别擅长优先，比如房地产规划/退休规划/家庭保障/教育规划等。

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test and maintain reliable software applications and services.
  • Build solutions supporting areas such as:
    • Portfolio management and investment operations
    • Client onboarding and servicing
    • Portfolio reporting and performance analytics
    • Order management and trade processing
    • Risk, suitability and regulatory controls
    • Digital banking and relationship-manager tools
  • Translate business and user needs into clear technical designs and deliverable solutions.
  • Develop secure APIs, data services and user interfaces where appropriate.
  • Integrate applications with internal platforms, market-data providers and other financial systems.
  • Write clean, maintainable and well-documented code, supported by automated testing.
  • Contribute to code reviews, technical standards and engineering best practices.
  • Investigate production issues, identify root causes and implement sustainable fixes.
  • Support continuous improvement in application resilience, performance, observability and scalability.
  • Work within applicable information-security, data-protection, risk-management and change-control requirements.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across technology, asset management, private banking, operations, risk and compliance.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, planning, estimation and delivery activities.
  • Contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing, inclusion and responsible technology delivery.
Requirements

  • Professional experience in software engineering or application development.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more relevant languages, such as: Java, C++
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with distributed systems.
  • Good knowledge of relational databases and SQL; experience with NoSQL technologies is useful.
  • Familiarity with version control, automated testing and CI/CD practices.
  • Understanding of software-development life cycles and Agile delivery methods.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Sound understanding of secure coding, access control and data-protection principles.
  • A collaborative approach and a strong sense of ownership.

- Build solutions supporting areas such as:
- Portfolio management and investment operations
- Client onboarding and servicing
- Portfolio reporting and performance analytics
- Order management and trade processing
- Risk, suitability and regulatory controls
- Digital banking and relationship-manager tools
- Translate business and user needs into clear technical designs and deliverable solutions.
- Develop secure APIs, data services and user interfaces where appropriate.
- Integrate applications with internal platforms, market-data providers and other financial systems.
- Write clean, maintainable and well-documented code, supported by automated testing.
- Contribute to code reviews, technical standards and engineering best practices.
- Investigate production issues, identify root causes and implement sustainable fixes.
- Support continuous improvement in application resilience, performance, observability and scalability.
- Work within applicable information-security, data-protection, risk-management and change-control requirements.
- Collaborate with colleagues across technology, asset management, private banking, operations, risk and compliance.
- Participate in Agile ceremonies, planning, estimation and delivery activities.
- Contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing, inclusion and responsible technology delivery.
Requirements
- Professional experience in software engineering or application development.
- Strong proficiency in one or more relevant languages, such as: Java, C++
- Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with distributed systems.
- Good knowledge of relational databases and SQL; experience with NoSQL technologies is useful.
- Familiarity with version control, automated testing and CI/CD practices.
- Understanding of software-development life cycles and Agile delivery methods.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.
- Sound understanding of secure coding, access control and data-protection principles.
- A collaborative approach and a strong sense of ownership.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of CCSS Representative II.

Principal responsibilities

Impact on the Business

  • Handles contacts with our HSBC customers in a polite and friendly way, instilling customer confidence and resolving customer’s issues at first contact where possible.
  • Delivers what is promised in line with customer expectations.
  • Offers value added products and services based on customer needs analysis and ensures customer understanding of those products.
  • 日常工作包括通过电话联系客户或相关部门获取资料信息，进行客户筛选及风险评估；
  • 建立与保持良好的客户关系并改善客户服务质素；
  • 按规定时间完成分配的任务，紧跟公司程序监控工作流程。

Requirements

  • Must have education standard to at least high school diploma and be of a legal working age
  • Must be proficient in language(s) required by the process
  • Open to working flexible shifting schedules
  • Must be flexible, customer centric and have the ability to thrive in a team environment seeking feedback and open to development
  • Takes pride in delivering what is promised in line with the customer and service expectations
  • Wants to do a good job,is concerned about getting it right for the customer and checks everything is in order
  • Ability to work in a high-volume, fast paced environment is required
  • Proficiency with personal computers and basic software packages and specialised applications
  • Excellent communication skills and is polite and friendly at all times
  • Displays patience and empathy
  • 大学本科以上及1年以上金融或会计相关工作经验;
  • 熟悉金融工具或投资相关的产品和术语以及基金的运营服务;
  • 具备良好的中英文阅读及写作能力;
  • 掌握基本的计算机技能（例如微软办公软件），打字速度快;
  • 口齿清晰，粤语，普通话及英语流利，有较强的沟通能力;
  • 能对客户的疑难问题展开调查并解决，或根据情况提出合理方案，向客户提供专业及优质的服务;
  • 恪守汇丰集团的合规要求和环球标准，具备高度责任感.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

ln:4485337198.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Customer sales and service

职责范围：

客户销售与服务

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.
  • Deliver allocated performance targets for various product VSs;
  • Maintain relationship with customers and deliver superior customer service to ensure customers’ needs are met;
  • Enhance bank-customer relationships by expanding existing customers’ portfolio holdings;
  • Actively participate in Priority Banking / other Bank’s marketing and promotional activities to acquire NTB customers, as well as cross-selling to existing customers;
  • Proactively engage with Personal Clients hidden affluent and advise to approach bank with complex investment needs;
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
  • Ensure compliance of Management Manual, Operating Manuals and Bank’s laid down knowledge of the various products offered by all departments;
  • Learn and understand all relevant regulations and internal Risk & Compliance policies and procedures;
  • Keep updated on the events in the financial industry;
  • Participate actively in training programs, meetings, briefings organized by the bank and ensure skills & knowledge acquired is applied to daily work;
  • Ensure timeliness & managing customer’s complaint;

主要工作职责/挑战：

  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。
  • 实现领导安排的各个产品的业绩指标；
  • 维护与客户的关系并提供卓越的客户服务以确保满足客户需求；
  • 通过扩大现有客户的投资组合加强客户与我行的关系；
  • 积极参与优先理财/其它银行营销项目，以获取新客户。另外，向现有客户进行交叉销售；
  • 主动发现具有“优先理财”资质的个人理财客户, 并发掘其投资理财需求；
  • 负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
  • 遵循银行的管理手册，操作手册和所有部门相关产品的既定政策；
  • 学习并了解一切相关条例以及内部风险与合规的政策与程序；
  • 保持对金融行业相关动向的敏感；
  • 积极参与银行组织的培训项目，会议和简报会，并保证将学习到的技能和知识运用到日常工作中；
  • 确保客户投诉的时效与管理；

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Financial skills
  • Analytical skills

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • Full time Bachelor’s degree, or AMAC Fund Qualification Certificate Holder.
  • 1 year or above working experience in financial industry, acting in good faith and professional ethics. Have a good command of knowledge about wealth management sales activities related regulations
  • Sound knowledge of financial products and services and banking procedures, equities markets, unit trusts and other personal investment services are preferred.
  • Good investment counseling and analytical skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to deal with all levels of people, often in complex and difficult situations.
  • Team player who shows initiative and assertiveness.
  • Self-motivator who is keen to upgrade, improve personal knowledge and skills to meet job requirements.
  • Good command of both spoken and written English and Mandarin

职位要求：

  • 全日制大学本科学历，或持有基金从业资格证书。
  • 从事金融工作1年以上，具备良好的诚信记录及职业操守
  • 熟悉理财业务活动及理财产品销售相关的法律法规
  • 熟悉银行产品、服务、银行程序、股票市场、单位信托以及其它个人投资服务。
  • 具备良好的投资咨询和分析技巧。
  • 出色的人际关系能力和沟通能力，能在复杂场合应付自如。
  • 具有团队意识，主动坚定。
  • 有上进心，能自我激励，不断提高人际交流能力和技巧，以满足工作要求。

Other then above roles, job holder should follow other job duties and responsibilities assigned by line manager from time to time.

除上述工作职责外，员工应遵循直属经理随时指派的任何工作职责和任务。

Above key responsibilities and selection criteria are the major assessment to assess the staff if qualified during probation and competent after probation. - 确保客户投诉的时效与管理；

Business
- Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates
Processes
- Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

- Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
- Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
- Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

- 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。
- 实现领导安排的各个产品的业绩指标；
- 维护与客户的关系并提供卓越的客户服务以确保满足客户需求；
- 通过扩大现有客户的投资组合加强客户与我行的关系；
- 积极参与优先理财/其它银行营销项目，以获取新客户。另外，向现有客户进行交叉销售；
- 主动发现具有“优先理财”资质的个人理财客户, 并发掘其投资理财需求；
- 负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
- 遵循银行的管理手册，操作手册和所有部门相关产品的既定政策；
- 学习并了解一切相关条例以及内部风险与合规的政策与程序；
- 保持对金融行业相关动向的敏感；
- 积极参与银行组织的培训项目，会议和简报会，并保证将学习到的技能和知识运用到日常工作中；
- 确保客户投诉的时效与管理；
Strategy
- Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.
Business
- Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates
Processes
- Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.
- Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
- Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
- Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
- Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
- Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
- Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.
Risk Management
- Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
- All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the Process risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for Liquidity risk.
Governance
- Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
- Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
- Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
- Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Skills And Experience
- Financial skills
- Analytical skills
Qualifications
Selection Criteria:
- Full time Bachelor’s degree, or AMAC Fund Qualification Certificate Holder.
- 1 year or above working experience in financial industry, acting in good faith and professional ethics. Have a good command of knowledge about wealth management sales activities related regulations
- Sound knowledge of financial products and services and banking procedures, equities markets, unit trusts and other personal investment services are preferred.
- Good investment counseling and analytical skills.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to deal with all levels of people, often in complex and difficult situations.
- Team player who shows initiative and assertiveness.
- Self-motivator who is keen to upgrade, improve personal knowledge and skills to meet job requirements.
- Good command of both spoken and written English and Mandarin
职位要求：
- 全日制大学本科学历，或持有基金从业资格证书。
- 从事金融工作1年以上，具备良好的诚信记录及职业操守
- 熟悉理财业务活动及理财产品销售相关的法律法规
- 熟悉银行产品、服务、银行程序、股票市场、单位信托以及其它个人投资服务。
- 具备良好的投资咨询和分析技巧。
- 出色的人际关系能力和沟通能力，能在复杂场合应付自如。
- 具有团队意识，主动坚定。
- 有上进心，能自我激励，不断提高人际交流能力和技巧，以满足工作要求。
- Other than above roles, job holder should follow other job duties and responsibilities assigned by line manager from time to time.
除上述工作职责外，员工应遵循直属经理随时指派的任何工作职责和任务。

Failing to satisfy any of the aforesaid requirements, or failing to pass the CPBB Essentials or WM Introduction Certification, the employee will be deemed not meeting the recruitment requirement for passing probation, and the Bank is entitled to terminate the employee’s employment contract immediately. For employee which have passed the probation, failing to pass the CPBB Essentials or WM Introduction Certification will be taken as assessment basis for job incompetency.
以上的主要工作职责和岗位聘任要求是用于考核试用期是否符合录用条件和工作胜任与否的标准。倘若员工未能满足前述要求，或未能通过CPBB Essentials测试或理财产品介绍资格认证测试的，则该员工将被视为不符合试用期的录用条件，银行有权立即终止员工的劳动合同；对于已过试用期的员工，未能通过CPBB Essential测试或理财产品介绍资格认证测试的，将作为不胜任工作工作岗位的考核依据。

请注意以上本工作描述将于每年制定年度工作目标时予以审核，如有必要将由直属经理和员工予以修订并达成一致。
