Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Business QA Lead.

Business: Global IWPB COO

Req ID: 65691

Locaiton: Yuexiu Financial Tower

Principal Responsibilities

AI Platform Test Planning:

  • Develop test plans, scenarios and cases for AI platform features based on business requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Define test scope, approach, resources, schedule and coverage for functional, integration, regression and AI-related testing.

QA Team Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate QA team members to ensure timely and effective execution of testing activities.
  • Mentor junior testers and promote consistent QA standards, processes and documentation.

AI Platform Test Execution

  • Oversee manual and automated testing of AI platform functionality, workflows, integrations and user outcomes.
  • Assess AI-specific quality considerations, including accuracy, reliability, consistency, usability and exception handling.
  • Review test evidence and ensure results are accurately documented.

Defect Management And Reporting

  • Manage defect identification, prioritization, tracking, retesting and closure.
  • Collaborate with developers, data specialists and product stakeholders to investigate issues and verify fixes.
  • Prepare and present testing progress, risks, issues and summary reports to stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in retrospectives and identify improvements to QA processes, test coverage and automation.
  • Stay current with AI technologies, AI testing practices, QA tools and industry trends.
  • Ensure testing remains aligned with business objectives, platform risks and quality expectations.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in software quality assurance, test leadership or a similar QA role.
  • Hands-on experience testing AI, Agent, machine-learning, generative AI, or data-driven platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of test planning, test case design, defect management and test reporting.
  • Experience with manual and automated testing approaches.
  • Ability to lead, coach and coordinate QA team members.
  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Understanding of AI quality risks, including model accuracy, bias, explainability, data quality and performance, is desirable.
  • Fluent English, good collaboration & strong communication skills with WW stakeholders & teams.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

  • Conduct company, industry and market research, and synthesise findings into clear insights and implications for clients.
  • Prepare client materials, including pitch books, teasers, information memoranda, management presentations and internal committee papers.
  • Assist with valuation work, scenario analysis and return/impact assessments to support recommendations.
  • Support the origination and execution of Investment Banking assignments.
  • Coordinate with product and coverage partners, including ECM, DCM, Leveraged Finance, Risk, Legal and Compliance.

  • Ability to explain analysis and conclusions clearly and concisely.
  • High attention to detail and a strong ownership mindset.
  • Proactive, organised and able to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Team-oriented, with the ability to work effectively with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4486339580.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

This role exists to ensure the effective, controlled and customer-focused execution of operational processes across retail banking liabilities products. The role is accountable for delivering accurate transaction processing, maintaining operational controls, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies that safeguard the Bank and its clients.

The role oversees day-to-day delivery across liabilities operations, ensuring service standards, risk controls and operational performance are consistently achieved. Working across Operations, Business, Risk, Compliance, Technology and Service teams, the role identifies operational risks, resolves service issues and drives process improvements that enhance efficiency, customer experience and operational resilience.

By monitoring performance, strengthening controls and improving workflows, the role contributes to sustainable operational outcomes, regulatory compliance, reduced operational risk and scalable service delivery that supports business growth and customer confidence.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Delivery & Service Performance

  • Deliver liabilities operations processes that ensure accurate, timely and controlled execution of customer and account servicing activities.
  • Monitor operational performance, service levels and workflow effectiveness to maintain consistent delivery of agreed business and customer outcomes.
  • Resolve operational exceptions and service issues that minimise disruption and improve customer experience.
  • Implement operational priorities and resource plans that support volume fluctuations and service continuity.

Process Optimisation & Continuous Improvement

  • Review operational workflows and controls to identify opportunities that improve efficiency, productivity and service quality.
  • Drive operational improvement initiatives that reduce manual intervention, processing errors and operational bottlenecks.
  • Analyse operational data and performance metrics to support informed decision-making and continuous process enhancement.
  • Partner with technology and support functions to implement sustainable process and system improvements.

Risk, Control & Regulatory Compliance

  • Maintain operational controls that ensure compliance with regulatory obligations, internal policies and risk management standards.
  • Monitor operational risks, control effectiveness and exception trends to identify and mitigate potential issues proactively.
  • Escalate material operational risks, control weaknesses and compliance concerns through appropriate governance channels.
  • Support audit, regulatory review and control testing activities by ensuring evidence, documentation and remediation actions are effectively managed.

Stakeholder & Customer Service Management

  • Collaborate with business, service, technology and support teams to deliver effective end-to-end customer outcomes.
  • Manage stakeholder relationships to resolve operational challenges, service dependencies and process issues.
  • Contribute operational insights and recommendations that support business objectives and customer service improvements.
  • Support customer-focused initiatives that enhance service quality, responsiveness and operational effectiveness.

Operational Governance & Performance Insights

  • Produce and maintain operational reporting that provides visibility of service performance, risk indicators and process outcomes.
  • Use data analysis and profiling techniques to identify trends, performance gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Support governance forums with accurate management information, operational updates and risk reporting.
  • Track delivery of operational improvement actions to ensure expected benefits and control outcomes are achieved.

Motivations

  • Motivated by improving operational processes that enhance customer experience, service quality and operational resilience.
  • Energised by solving complex operational challenges involving multiple stakeholders, risks and service dependencies.
  • Thrives in environments that value accountability, continuous improvement, strong controls and collaborative problem-solving.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Liability Management
  • Accounting Transaction Analysis
  • Capital Management
  • Regulatory Compliance

Other Skills

  • Talent Development
  • Communication
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Inquiry Processing
  • Integrity Management
  • Investigation Management
  • Stakeholder Engagement

Qualifications

  • Exposure to high-volume retail banking or financial services operations where accuracy, service quality and control effectiveness are critical.
  • Exposure to regulated environments requiring adherence to compliance standards, operational controls and risk management practices.
  • Exposure to process improvement initiatives focused on enhancing operational efficiency, customer outcomes and operational resilience.
  • Experience working across business, operations, technology, risk and compliance teams to deliver effective operational solutions.
  • Exposure to operational performance management using service metrics, reporting and data-driven decision-making.
  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Job Summary

The Control, Process & Governance Specialist strengthens the COO function’s control environment by designing, governing, and continuously improving end-to-end processes, operational controls, and risk governance routines.

The role ensures key COO activities are resilient, well-controlled, audit-ready, and aligned with regulatory expectations, while enabling process efficiency through standardisation, automation, and data-driven monitoring. Acting as a connector across COO, Risk, Compliance, Technology, Audit and business stakeholders, this role drives control effectiveness, issue remediation, and sustainable operating discipline.

Key Responsibilities

Process Design and Control Enablement

  • Design, implement and maintain fit-for-purpose processes and control frameworks that support safe, efficient, and compliant delivery of business activities
  • Translate policy, regulatory, and governance requirements into practical operational processes embedded within business workflows
  • Ensure controls are proportionate, clearly defined, and aligned to business activities, risk exposure and control standards

Governance Frameworks and Standards

  • Establish and maintain governance frameworks, standards, and operating procedures that promote consistency, transparency, and accountability
  • Support the effective application of governance standards across functions, including documentation, approvals, and decision-making forums
  • Enable clear ownership and escalation pathways for process, control and governance matters

Data, Reporting and Control Monitoring

  • Implement continuous control monitoring approaches and automate evidence capture where possible
  • Develop dashboards / MI for control effectiveness, issue ageing, incident trends, and operational performance
  • Support oversight and assurance activities by providing clear evidence, reporting, and analysis on control design and operation
  • Partner with stakeholders to remediate control issues and strengthen process effectiveness where required

Continuous Improvement and Operational Excellence

  • Drive continuous improvement in processes, controls, and governance practices to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and resilience
  • Leverage insights from incidents, reviews, and operational feedback to strengthen frameworks and prevent recurrence
  • Promote disciplined execution and consistent application of controls across the organisation

Stakeholder, Change and Capability Enablement

  • Act as a trusted partner to COO leaders and operational teams, translating governance expectations into day-to-day execution
  • Drive communications, training and adoption plans to embed new standards, controls and process changes
  • Influence cross-functional stakeholders (Risk/Compliance/Technology/Audit) and major change programmes to align on risk outcomes and practical implementation

People and Talent

  • Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  • Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
  • Lead by example by role-modelling strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture where diverse perspectives are valued and accountability is owned.

Motivations

  • Energised by building strong, well‑controlled environments where risks are understood, managed and prevented.
  • Motivated by improving how organisations operate over time by making controls practical, proportionate and embedded in the way work is done.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Cross Functional Collaboration
  • Business Acumen
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Financial Risk Management
  • Change Management
  • Problem Solving

Other Skills

  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Process Optimisation
  • Performance Monitor
  • Policy Development
  • Operational Risk Management
  • Negotiating
  • Strategic Planning
  • Trend Analysis

Qualifications

  • Designing and embedding effective processes, controls and governance to support safe, compliant business delivery.
  • Translating regulatory and policy requirements into practical, auditable ways of working.
  • Improving control and process effectiveness through data, insight and cross‑functional collaboration.
  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Job Summary

  • Working closely with all stakeholders in the bank to promote China FM service/products to SCB clients, in both China onshore and global footprints, primarily in China, HK and SG
  • Expand our China FM business with reasonable balance between risk and business growth aspiration.
  • Stay highly vigilant on the control and conduct matters to ensure the high standard of the team in this area.
  • Follow through with the Sales strategy and align it to CIB Strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Working closely with regional FM Sales team to implement and expand the Sales distribution platform for Financial Markets products to Financial Markets clients in the region.
  • Follow through with the Sales strategy and align it to SCB’s overall CCIB Strategies.
  • Work closely with other product specialists.

Business

  • Develop full understanding of a wide range of products and processes.
  • Continually develop client’s coverage model that optimizes in respective region revenue generation and encourages cross-selling opportunities.
  • Provide feedback on the market and the business to clients and internal business partners.

Processes

  • Ensure all deal transactions are in compliance with the Bank’s internal policies and local regulatory requirements and also the Anti-Money Laundering policies/measures.
  • Establish and maintain a network of relationships with key partners in the bank.

Risk Management

  • Adherence to all Group Policies and relevant legislation covering credit, operational, reputational risk among others.
  • Commitment to Group Code of Conduct
  • Timely completion of all e-learning, attestations and requests for information.

Governance

  • Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas.
  • Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
  • Willingness to ‘speak up’ in the event of any realized or perceived breach of group conduct rules or laws by colleagues
  • Willingness to work with any local regulators in an open and cooperative manner.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities.
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections.
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review

Key stakeholders

  • FM Country Head
  • FM Corporate Sales Head
  • FM COO team members
  • Business colleagues (including RM, FM Trading, TM, Capital Markets, FMO etc…)
  • Risk function colleagues (including Compliance, TRM, OR etc..)

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in China FM corporate sales team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats);
  • Other then above roles, job holder should follow other job duties and responsibilities assigned by line manager from time to time.
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties.
  • Please note that the job description above will be reviewed during the Job Objective setting every year, which may be amended and agreed where necessary by the employee and the line manager.

Motivations

  • Self realization and impact to others
  • Career growth and social recognition
  • Material reward

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Action Oriented
  • Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, energy and enthusiasm.
  • Collaborates
  • Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  • Customer Focus
  • Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Courage
  • Stepping up to address difficult issues and saying what needs to be said.
  • Instils Trust
  • Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity and authenticity.
  • Nimble Learning
  • Actively learning from experimentation, success, and failures. Applying lessons learned to new problems.
  • Decision Quality
  • Making good and timely decisions that keep the organisation moving forward.
  • Develops Talent
  • Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organisation’s goals
  • Drives Vision & Purpose
  • Painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others to action.
  • Gives Clarity and Guidance
  • Providing direction, delegating and removing obstacles to get work done.
  • Manages Ambiguity
  • Operating effectively even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
  • Strategic Mindset
  • Seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into strategies that address changing needs while leveraging the bank’s strengths.

Other Skills

  • Data Science
  • Understanding of FM products
  • Computer Science

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor or above
  • Languages: CET-4 or above

About Standard Chartered

Job Description

Job Summary

  • The relevant IT risk and outsourcing regulations require the bank to retain effective internal IT management, including IT project initiation and management, and prohibit outsourcing of IT management responsibilities and other core IT capabilities. They also require formal processes for project prioritisation, initiation, approval and control, with major project progress reported to the IT Management Committee.
  • The local PMO is the governance mechanism through which China demonstrates these controls. This role leads a team responsible for country investment demand governance, the Country Project Governance Forum, reporting to CITGF and EXCO, localisation of Group project standards, and oversight of major programmes including ATLAS, SCPay, Catalyst and CIPS.
  • The role therefore provides local regulatory accountability and control rather than simply project delivery capacity.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Responsible for the overall management and governance of change initiatives run in China, ensuring business and strategic priorities and effective delivery of the work;
  • Support Country CTOO for the management of assigned new and enhanced product/projects throughout their development life cycle and on-going maintenance within China;
  • Represent Country CTOO to provide signoff on all aspects for assigned Project Implementation within China;
  • Represent Country CTOO to governance and control changes on ATLAS applications

Business

  • Leading a team to run Program Management Office (PMO) in China;
  • Leading a team to run Project Management (PM) in China;
  • To ensure Regional, Group and regulatory standards for project management and implementation are properly complied with and all the projects risks and issues are escalated and managed effectively;
  • Support the needs of the China Exco, and Regional MT in their duties with regards Project Governance Compliance for China;
  • Support China Business and Functional stakeholder requirement with respect to Project Investment Portfolio;
  • Support the needs and actions of the respective Quarterly Performance Review (QPR) with respect to China change initiated by country’s Business and Functions;
  • Provide supports to Ops-BAU functions for production problems, whenever necessary;
  • Team BAU Actual can be fully recovered from initiatives / projects.

Processes

  • Project Management (PM) – leading a team of PM to:
  • manage and to control project scope, duration, budget and risk within the appropriate methodology and with a view to quick scaling up of capacity while reconciling with the business and financial needs of the product programs;
  • ensure the business requirements for assigned products have been translated into specific functional and capability attributes;
  • provide appropriate level of project cost and resourcing estimates, starting at a high level during early definition and ultimately with the accuracy necessary for investment initiative and product program;
  • manage the end-to-end project plan, coordinating activities across all resources necessary to deliver projects and change management activities;
  • ensure integration of project architecture, process and procedure with overall SCB environment;
  • ensure all the documentation are in place with proper signoff & approval, follow Project Management Standards (PMS), New ways of Working Investment Management Standard (nWOWs) and System Delivery Framework (SDF) / Enterprise system delivery lifecycle framework (E-SDLC) to compliance with Bank’s Change Governance Policy;
  • ensure the project closure and handover to the BAU is completed successfully
  • achieve of project rollout targets and budget
  • Change Management (ATLAS) – as consultant to:
  • support analyzing the development requirements and requests from Business, Functions & Ops, assessing the impact of changes and validating the solutioning, throughout the e2e change delivery;
  • guide user acceptance testing (UAT) and user verification testing (UVT), recommend testing scenario / requirement and clarifying solutioning;
  • support BAU functions, perform feasibility study, investigation & reconciliation, identify solutions & conduct fixes for production problems, whenever necessary.
  • Program Management Office (PMO) -- leading a team of PMO to:
  • oversight of status of projects impacting China not originated by the China team, specifically including:
  • liaising with Group and Regional project teams in identifying, raising and resolving risks as they relate to China;
  • ensuring ‘One Bank’ approach to support successful implementation of those projects;
  • support local business and functional teams develop their project priorities;
  • support the local business and functional teams adhere to necessary project governance for project approval and delivery;
  • support local project managers via providing training, support and ad-hoc assistance to maintain required levels of governance;
  • support refresh and implementation of the Project Management Standards (PMS), New ways of Working Investment Management Standard (nWOWs) and System Delivery Framework (SDF)/ Enterprise system delivery lifecycle framework (E-SDLC) to compliance with Bank’s Change Governance Policy;
  • monitoring the progress of the portfolio of projects within China;
  • provide strategic direction and guidance to projects;
  • allocation of resources across projects to optimise usage;
  • ensure that the required approval for the project is obtained at each stage;
  • help steer project into the organisation by harnessing and managing the appropriate business support and ensuring there is proper information on flow to all stakeholders;
  • creating a centre of expertise of project management standards and best practices in China;
  • assist in removing project obstacles that may arise and help remediate project issues and risks;
  • provide quality assurance through monitoring the project’s progress, stakeholder’s commitment and quality of the results achieved;
  • control the overall project scope and oversee expenditure of project funds.

Risk Management

  • Balance business performance delivery and cost management with risk and control matters in projects to ensure that it does not materially threaten the Group, remaining within risk appetite;
  • Act quickly and decisively when any risk and control weakness become apparent in projects and ensure they are addressed within an appropriate timeframe and escalated through the relevant committees

Governance

  • Ensure awareness and full compliance of all laid down rules, regulations, policies, guidelines, procedures, practices and code of conduct imposed by the Group;
  • Ensure Business System in compliance with Audit, Securities, Operation Guidelines;

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Lead team to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: [Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.] *
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • NFRA/ PBOC / SAFE and other local Regulators in China.

Accountability

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review;
  • Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control;
  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of the event over which the employee has the duties of management and/or leadership;
  • Be responsible for significant losses due to failure of effectiveness of internal control

Other responsibility

  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures

People and Talent

  • Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  • Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
  • Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.
  • Coach team members through effective communication/coaching to deliver business goal;
  • Motivate team members to ensure a high morale and positive attitude to implement projects

Skills and Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Action Oriented
  • Collaborates
  • Courage
  • Instils Trust
  • Nimble Learning
  • Project Management

Other Skills

  • Decision Quality
  • Develops Talent
  • Drives Vision & Purpose
  • Gives Clarity and Guidance

Motivations

  • In China, navigating local regulatory complexities and market dynamics requires aligning global priorities with local business needs. The involvement in critical transformation programmes deliver measurable strategic value rather than just operational outputs.
  • Ensuring robust frameworks, processes, and governance structures that bring clarity, predictability, and efficiency to complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Fostering a high-performance culture and empowering teams across diverse, functional and geographic boundaries for better collaboration and greater efficiency.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Minimum of 10+ year experience in Banking field, with proven track record in leadership role under Project Management & Change Management, or Project Portfolio Governance Management

Certifications/Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree from a reputable university
  • A project management qualification is preferable (PMP, PRINCE2, PO, SCRUM Master)
  • Ability to work in a matrix organisation, working with resources across the organisation to complete deliverables and maintain effective working relationship
  • Strong analytical skills and project management skills
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Strong influencing skills with strong team orientation
  • Able to handle multi-tasks, manage time effectively and perform under pressure
  • Able to work at flexible hours and travel

Languages

  • Good command of spoken and written Chinese and English

Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Job Summary

  • This role is responsible for ensuring the efficient, accurate and compliant delivery of lending operations across the retail banking lending lifecycle. The role safeguards operational performance by overseeing loan processing, documentation, controls and service delivery activities that support lending products and customer needs.
  • The role is accountable for maintaining operational integrity, managing risk and regulatory compliance, and ensuring customer outcomes are delivered within agreed service standards. It works closely with risk, product, technology, frontline banking and compliance teams to resolve operational challenges, improve end-to-end processes and strengthen operational resilience.
  • By leveraging operational insights, performance metrics and continuous improvement practices, the role contributes to improved customer experience, reduced operational risk, enhanced productivity and sustainable business growth. The position influences the effectiveness of lending operations through process optimisation, governance oversight and data-driven decision making, while supporting the delivery of strategic and regulatory priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Lending Operations Delivery

  • Lead lending operations activities that ensure accurate, timely and efficient processing of loan applications, approvals, disbursements and servicing transactions.
  • Maintain operational controls that minimise processing errors, operational losses and customer impacts across the lending lifecycle.
  • Monitor service performance against operational and customer service standards, implementing corrective actions where required.
  • Ensure operational capacity and workflow management practices support business volumes and service commitments.

Risk, Control & Regulatory Compliance

  • Implement and maintain operational controls that support compliance with lending policies, regulatory requirements and internal standards.
  • Identify, assess and mitigate operational risks arising from lending processes, customer activities and process exceptions.
  • Strengthen fraud prevention and detection practices through effective monitoring, escalation and control frameworks.
  • Support regulatory reporting obligations by ensuring accuracy, completeness and audit readiness of operational data.

Process Optimisation & Operational Excellence

  • Analyse operational performance data to identify process inefficiencies, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
  • Drive workflow optimisation initiatives that improve productivity, turnaround times and customer outcomes.
  • Enhance process standardisation and control effectiveness to support scalable and sustainable operations.
  • Collaborate with technology and transformation teams to implement process improvements and operational enhancements.

Customer & Stakeholder Outcomes

  • Deliver operational support that contributes to positive customer experiences throughout the lending journey.
  • Partner with business, risk, product and service teams to resolve operational issues and improve service delivery.
  • Escalate material operational, customer or control issues to appropriate stakeholders and support timely resolution.
  • Provide operational insights and recommendations that support business decision-making and customer outcomes.

Data, Reporting & Performance Insights

  • Develop and use operational performance metrics that enable effective monitoring of service, risk and productivity outcomes.
  • Analyse lending and customer data to identify trends, emerging risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Produce management information and operational reporting that supports governance, decision making and regulatory requirements.
  • Use data-driven insights to prioritise operational improvement initiatives and support business objectives.

Motivations

  • Motivated by improving operational processes that enhance customer outcomes, service quality and operational resilience.
  • Energised by solving complex operational challenges through collaboration, analysis and practical problem-solving.
  • Thrives in environments that value accountability, continuous improvement, risk discipline and customer focus.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Loan Operations
  • Retail Banking
  • Consumer Lending
  • Regulatory Compliance

Other Skills

  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Team Leadership
  • Risk Management
  • Project Management
  • Talent Development
  • Loan Documentation
  • Resource Allocation
  • Incident Analysis

Qualifications

  • Experience operating within regulated financial services environments where risk, compliance and customer outcomes are critical.
  • Exposure to high-volume operational functions that require strong controls, service delivery management and operational governance.
  • Experience working across multiple stakeholder groups, balancing customer, business, risk and regulatory priorities.
  • Exposure to process transformation, workflow optimisation or operational excellence initiatives that improve efficiency and control effectiveness.
  • Experience using operational data and performance insights to identify trends, manage risks and drive decision-making.
  • Business English (required)

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

Job Summary

  • To ensure accurate calculation and posting entries in relation to valuation including management fee, expenses, performance fee…etc in accordance with Service Level Memorandum, and as appropriate the Fund Offering Memorandum and related documents such as fund’s SLM.
  • To ensure accurate capturing of trades / prices / Corporate Actions/ FX rates data and relevant accounting entries for the purpose of providing accurate Net Asset Value calculation.
  • Responsible for the daily maintenance of full accounting and client records of several investment funds books including general ledgers, cash positions, distribution records, investment records and pricing records of investments and support in fund administration related matters, such as recording and processing transactions, obtaining and verification of relevant documentation thereof and ensuring that investments are correctly recorded and priced, and accounted for Purchase and sale of listed or unlisted securities, Corporate Actions, Forward FX deals, OTC deals (Swaps, Options etc) and relevant accounting entries for the purpose of providing accurate Net Asset Value calculation.
  • Perform detailed review of the reports to CPC/clients including: Verification trades to relevant supporting, Ensure valuation of investments being checked to third party sources, Ensure appropriate accounting for complex investment, Ensure compliance with internal investment restrictions, external regulations and international accounting standards, if applicable. Identify issues and report to senior/supervisor with suggested solutions.
  • Responsible for fundamental cash monitoring for the assigned clients, i.e. monitoring cash positions of clients and prepare cash projection reports.
  • To be responsible for daily activities, cash & trade reconciliation.
  • Preparing Portfolio Valuations, investment compliance reports or other reporting, as required.
  • To calculate the Net Asset Value (on a daily, weekly, monthly or other basis as agreed) and deliver service / reports to CPC/clients in accordance with requirement and timeline as agreed in Services Level Memorandum.
  • To ensure proper and accurate calculation and posting of management fee, expenses, performance fee…etc in accordance with Service Level Memorandum, and as appropriate the Fund Offering Memorandum.
  • Recording and disbursing dividends either by payment or re-investment.

  • Manage and avoid risks to clients, Bank/Group by ensuring prompt and accurate reporting to clients/management, timely rectification and /or monitoring of any discrepancies.

  • Awareness and understanding of the wider business, securities markets in which the FMO operates

- To ensure accurate calculation and posting entries in relation to valuation including management fee, expenses, performance fee…etc in accordance with Service Level Memorandum, and as appropriate the Fund Offering Memorandum and related documents such as fund’s SLM.
- To ensure accurate capturing of trades / prices / Corporate Actions/ FX rates data and relevant accounting entries for the purpose of providing accurate Net Asset Value calculation.
- Responsible for the daily maintenance of full accounting and client records of several investment funds books including general ledgers, cash positions, distribution records, investment records and pricing records of investments and support in fund administration related matters, such as recording and processing transactions, obtaining and verification of relevant documentation thereof and ensuring that investments are correctly recorded and priced, and accounted for Purchase and sale of listed or unlisted securities, Corporate Actions, Forward FX deals, OTC deals (Swaps, Options etc) and relevant accounting entries for the purpose of providing accurate Net Asset Value calculation.

Identify issues and report to senior/supervisor with suggested solutions.
- Responsible for fundamental cash monitoring for the assigned clients, i.e. monitoring cash positions of clients and prepare cash projection reports.
- To be responsible for daily activities, cash & trade reconciliation.
- Preparing Portfolio Valuations, investment compliance reports or other reporting, as required.
- To calculate the Net Asset Value (on a daily, weekly, monthly or other basis as agreed) and deliver service / reports to CPC/clients in accordance with requirement and timeline as agreed in Services Level Memorandum.

- To ensure all control/operating procedure and documentations are properly followed.
- To ensure daily working volumes to be recorded accuracy and timely

Strategy
- Awareness and understanding of the Group's business strategy and model appropriate to the role.
Business
- Awareness and understanding of the wider business, securities markets in which the FMO operates
Processes
- Responsible for ensuring the accuracy of Net Asset Value of the fund in each valuation
- Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values.
- Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
Risk Management
- The ability to interpret the reconciliation breaks, prices fluctuations, ledger imbalances, valuation checking exception, identify key issues or potential risk based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures.
Governance
- Responsible for complying to the group’s governance requirement, oversight and controls in the business
- Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.

- Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in China / Fiduciary and Fund Services Team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Support group’s operation transformation roadmap.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO AI Platforms

Job ID：65894

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end frontend delivery, from requirements clarification and technical solution design through implementation, testing, release, and production support.
  • Design and continuously evolve the frontend architecture and shared foundational capabilities of the AI Platform Portal, balancing consistency, extensibility, maintainability, and delivery efficiency.
  • Build high-quality product workflows for platform capabilities such as model services, RAG, Agents, and MCP, including backend API integration and asynchronous or streaming interactions where needed.
  • Align frontend interfaces, API contracts, and integration plans with backend, AI, and platform teams, identifying dependencies and risks early.
  • Establish and continuously improve frontend engineering practices, including component design, code reviews, automated testing, accessibility, and release quality.
  • Diagnose and improve user-perceived performance, reliability, and usability; provide appropriate loading, empty, error, and recovery states, and use telemetry and production feedback to drive improvements.
  • Work with product and design teams to refine requirements and deliver accessible, responsive experiences across supported browsers and devices.
  • Share technical knowledge and mentor teammates to improve frontend implementation quality and team effectiveness.

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

  • 6+ years of frontend engineering experience, with a strong track record of delivering and maintaining production-grade web applications.
  • Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript, including component architecture, Hooks, reusable design patterns, and performance-conscious rendering.
  • Experience designing frontend architectures that are scalable and maintainable for the needs of the product; experience designing or implementing micro-frontend architectures.
  • Proficient with frontend build and development tools such as Vite or Webpack, as well as package management, linting, formatting, and CI workflows.
  • Experience analyzing and optimizing frontend performance, including using browser performance tools to identify issues and optimize rendering, asset loading, and bundle size.
  • Experience managing client-side state and server-side data, with familiarity with tools such as Redux Toolkit, Zustand, and React Query.
  • Strong understanding of modern JavaScript, browser behavior, semantic HTML, CSS, responsive layouts, and accessibility fundamentals.
  • Experience integrating frontend applications with REST or GraphQL APIs, with the ability to handle asynchronous operations, authentication flows, network issues, and service failures reliably.
  • Solid testing experience across unit/component and end-to-end levels; familiarity with tools such as Jest or Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.
  • Ability to own complex work independently, make sound technical trade-offs, communicate risks proactively, and collaborate effectively with product, design, and engineering teams.
  • Good English communication skills for day-to-day cross-functional collaboration.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Conduct product training to support and deliver new product launches and lead client education events to help clients gain better knowledge of financial markets and financial solutions.
  • Follow the needs-based sales process, give clients meaningful and consistent wealth experience and ultimately provide an outstanding client experience
  • Support RMs to gain more client trust and commitment in broadening and deepening their relationship with HSBC, and increase the effectiveness and quality of needs fulfilled for target clients
  • Strengthen HSBC’s image as a leading wealth provider by providing clients with access to advanced technical product expertise
  • Conduct portfolio reviews with RMs, assess product suitability and market and regulatory change impact to products held by clients as appropriate, identify opportunities and manage risks
  • Join RMs in meeting clients and provide advice, input based on technical knowledge while acting as a second point of contact to RMs for specific products and solutions
  • Improve RMs product specific technical knowledge by effective on-job coaching and training
  • Activity: (Joint) meeting, Training, Coaching, Client Seminar, Portfolio Review, Policy Review
  • 提供新产品培训，帮助客户获得更好的理财市场信息和解决办法。

  • 帮助客户经理获得并加深客户信任，提高满足客户财务需求的有效性和质量

Job Summary

Scope of Role:

To pro-actively promote designated Retail Clients products and services and acquire new customers.

工作范畴：

主动推广指定的个人银行产品和服务及开发新客户。

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in sales promotions and activities to achieve/exceed defined sales targets;
  • Engage NTB Affluent clients via leads sourced from varies channels;
  • A well thought-through, creative approach to satisfy customers, improve competitive advantage and improve performance;
  • Actively cross-sell the bank other products / services and ensure annual financial budget is met;
  • To provide quality, efficient before and after sales services;
  • To prepare and consolidate accurate reports on sales activities;
  • Based on a “shared sense” of purpose and approach within CB;
  • Based on a clear division of roles (and no duplication of effort) within MD;
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

主要工作职责/挑战：

  • 参与促销活动，完成或超额完成指定的销售目标；
  • 跟进销售机会，开发新客户；
  • 以周全、创新的方法使客户满意，提升竞争优势及业绩表现；
  • 主动销售银行其它产品和服务，确保达到年度销售业绩指标；
  • 提供高质量、高效的售前和售后服务；
  • 编写和维护有关销售活动的准确报告；
  • 负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example- The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • List all responsibilities associated with the management of stakeholders e.g. regulators, other bank teams

Skills And Experience

  • Credit appraisal and marketing skills

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • College/diploma degree or above;
  • 1 year working experience or above in financial or mortgage / real estate Industry is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in banking experience is preferred
  • Good knowledge of bank products, policies, and business strategy
  • Good credit appraisal and marketing skills with the ability to interpret financial information
  • Strong personal integrity with zero disciplinary record in any previous job
  • Good communication and presentation skills
  • Presentable, good personality with good business etiquette

职位要求：

  • 大专及以上学历。
  • 一年以上金融或房贷或房产行业工作经验优先。
  • 有相关银行行业销售经验者优先
  • 了解银行产品、政策及经营策略。
  • 良好的信用评价与营销技能，对金融市场有敏锐触角。
  • 良好的个人诚信，无任何纪律处分纪录
  • 良好的沟通，表达及学习能力。
  • 优良的个性品质，勇于销售及解决业务过程中的问题。
  • Other then above roles, job holder should follow other job duties and responsibilities assigned by line manager from time to time.

除上述工作职责外，员工应遵循直属经理随时指派的任何工作职责和任务。

  • Above key responsibilities and selection criteria are the major assessment to assess the staff if qualified during probation and competent after probation. Failing to satisfy any of the aforesaid requirements, or failing to pass the “CPBB Essentials”, the employee will be deemed not meeting the recruitment requirement for passing probation, and the Bank is entitled to terminate the employee’s employment contract immediately. For employees who have passed the probation, failing to pass the “CPBB Essentials”, will be taken as assessment basis for job incompetency.

以上的主要工作职责和岗位聘任要求是用于考核试用期是否符合录用条件和工作胜任与否的标准。倘若员工未能满足前述要求，或未能通过“CPBB Essentials 入职培训”的，则该员工将被视为不符合试用期的录用条件，银行有权立即终止员工的劳动合同；对于已过试用期的员工，未能通过“CPBB Essentials 入职培训”的，将作为不胜任工作工作岗位的考核依据。

  • Before attend and pass the “CPBB Essentials” class, the employee should not perform any kind of business communication / engagement to customers.

对于还没有参与并通过“CPBB Essentials 入职培训”的员工, 禁止跟客户有任何业务上的交流。

Please note that the job description above will be reviewed during the Job Objective setting every year, which may be amended and agreed where necessary by the employee and the line manager.

请注意以上本工作描述将于每年制定年度工作目标时予以审核，如有必要将由直属经理和员工予以修订并达成一致。

In this document, Chinese version shall prevail over English version.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do

Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits

A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4486373691.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The role exists to ensure the efficient, controlled and client-focused execution of operational activities that support Wealth Management products, services and client transactions. The role is accountable for delivering operational excellence across core processes while maintaining strong risk and control standards, service quality and regulatory compliance.

Working closely with Front Office teams, Product partners, Risk and Compliance functions, the role oversees operational processes that enable the end-to-end client lifecycle, including onboarding, transaction processing, account maintenance, investment servicing and operational issue resolution. The role ensures service commitments are met while managing operational risks and supporting business growth objectives.

Through effective governance, process optimisation and stakeholder engagement, the role contributes to client satisfaction, operational resilience, regulatory compliance and the scalability of Wealth Management operations.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Transaction Operations

  • Manage Wealth Management operational processes to ensure accurate, timely and controlled execution of client transactions and servicing activities.
  • Oversee transaction processing, account maintenance and operational support activities to meet agreed service levels and client expectations.
  • Resolve operational exceptions, enquiries and escalations to minimise client impact and maintain service quality.
  • Monitor operational performance and capacity to ensure sustainable support for business growth and changing client needs.

Client Lifecycle & Service Delivery

  • Lead operational activities across client onboarding, account opening, maintenance and closure processes to support a seamless client experience.
  • Ensure client records, documentation and account information remain accurate, complete and compliant with regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate with Front Office, Compliance and Risk teams to facilitate timely completion of client lifecycle activities.
  • Identify and address service gaps to improve operational efficiency and client outcomes.

Risk, Control & Regulatory Compliance

  • Maintain effective controls across Wealth Management operations to mitigate operational, regulatory and conduct risks.
  • Ensure operational activities comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements and established control standards.
  • Investigate operational incidents, root causes and control weaknesses, implementing corrective actions where required.
  • Support audits, reviews and regulatory examinations through accurate documentation, reporting and remediation tracking.

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

  • Analyse operational performance data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation and efficiency improvements.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance productivity, reduce risk and improve service delivery outcomes.
  • Establish and monitor key operational metrics, service indicators and management information to support decision-making.
  • Drive adoption of standardised processes and best practices across Wealth Management Operations.

Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership

  • Partner with Wealth Management, Product, Technology, Risk and Compliance teams to support effective operational delivery.
  • Provide operational insights and recommendations that inform service improvements, risk mitigation and business decisions.
  • Facilitate governance forums, operational reviews and stakeholder discussions to drive accountability and action.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations through clear communication, issue resolution and proactive engagement.

Change Delivery & Operational Readiness

  • Support implementation of new products, regulatory changes and strategic initiatives by assessing operational impacts and readiness requirements.
  • Coordinate testing, process updates and operational transition activities to ensure successful implementation.
  • Embed new controls, procedures and operating models to maintain operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor post-implementation outcomes and address operational issues arising from change initiatives.

Motivations

  • Driving operational excellence through process improvement, data-driven insights and scalable solutions that enhance client experience, service quality and risk management.
  • Solving complex operational challenges by balancing client needs, regulatory requirements and stakeholder expectations while maintaining strong controls and service standards.
  • Leading high-performing teams and change initiatives that build capability, strengthen operational resilience and support sustainable business growth.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Investment Management
  • Account Reconciliation
  • Custodial Services
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Mutual Funds
  • Product Management
  • Settlement Management
  • Tax Management
  • Financial Services
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Talent Development

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Experience managing Wealth Management, Private Banking, Investment Operations or related financial services operations.
  • Experience overseeing client lifecycle, transaction processing, account servicing or investment operations activities.
  • Demonstrated success implementing operational improvements, productivity enhancements or control strengthening initiatives.
  • Experience managing operational risk, audit findings, regulatory requirements and remediation activities.
  • Experience working with Front Office, Product, Technology, Risk and Compliance stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
  • Proven ability to manage operational performance, service levels, governance forums and stakeholder expectations.
  • Experience leading teams, developing talent and driving a culture of accountability and continuous improvement

Languages

  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.
