Job Summary

The GCNA Cluster Lead, Global Markets Operations (GMO) is a senior leadership role with full accountability for driving the end-to-end Markets Operations agenda across HK, China, Taiwan, Korea and Japan. The role is critical to ensuring the cluster operates with strong control discipline, commercial alignment, operational resilience and consistent execution across multiple markets, products and stakeholder groups.

The role provides strategic and day-to-day leadership across GMO functions in-country, while maintaining clear oversight and governance over all operational activities delivered through GBS, including confirmations, settlements, margining, reporting and related post-trade processes. It requires strong ownership of service quality, risk management, capacity, escalation discipline and delivery standards across both in-country and offshore-supported activities.

The role holder will act as the primary senior Operations partner to Markets Heads, Trading, Sales and Country COOs in each market. They will be expected to provide trusted leadership, effective challenge and proactive business partnership, ensuring that operational priorities are aligned to business growth, regulatory expectations, client outcomes and the Bank’s control standards. This is a highly visible leadership role requiring strong execution, stakeholder influence and the ability to lead through complexity across a diverse GCNA franchise.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Define and execute the GCNA Global Markets Operations strategy across HK, China, Taiwan, Korea and Japan, ensuring the operating model supports business growth, product complexity, regulatory expectations and operational resilience.
  • Build a scalable, well-governed and client-focused operations platform across in-country teams and GBS-supported processes, with clear ownership, consistent standards and disciplined execution.
  • Act as a trusted senior Operations advisor to Markets Heads, Trading, Sales and Country COOs, providing effective challenge on operational readiness, control standards, capacity, service performance and new business initiatives.
  • Drive alignment between country priorities, regional/global Operations strategy and transformation programmes, ensuring GCNA requirements are represented and delivered with pace and quality.

Business

  • Lead the end-to-end Markets Operations agenda across GCNA, ensuring effective support for Trading, Sales, COO and client-facing business priorities across all relevant Global Markets products.
  • Provide leadership across in-country functions, while maintaining robust oversight of GBS-supported confirmations, settlements, margining, reporting and related post-trade processes.
  • Enable business growth by ensuring strong operational readiness for new products, increased volumes, platform changes, regulatory developments and market structure changes.
  • Strengthen business partnership through proactive issue resolution, transparent service management, clear escalation and outcome-focused engagement with senior stakeholders.

Processes

  • Own the GCNA Markets Operations process universe and service catalogue, covering trade support, lifecycle management, onboarding, client and sales support, exception management, investigations, reporting and post-trade controls.
  • Drive simplification, standardisation and automation of high-volume, high-risk and manually intensive processes to improve service quality, reduce operational risk and create sustainable capacity.
  • Ensure end-to-end process ownership across country and GBS teams, with clear hand-offs, documented procedures, measurable service standards and robust control points.
  • Use data, metrics and root-cause analysis to identify recurring process weaknesses, remove friction and improve execution quality across the operating model.

People & Talent

  • Provide visible and accountable leadership across GCNA Markets Operations, building a high-performing, risk-aware and client-focused culture.
  • Develop leadership depth, succession strength and technical capability across Middle Office, Client Support, Onboarding and post-trade Operations teams.
  • Lead teams through change with clarity, transparency and discipline, ensuring colleagues understand priorities, ownership, expected standards and how their work contributes to business and client outcomes.
  • Foster collaboration across countries, functions and GBS locations, promoting a “one team” culture with strong conduct, inclusion and continuous improvement.

Risk Management

  • Maintain a strong and preventative control environment across in-country and GBS-supported Markets Operations activities, with proactive identification, escalation and remediation of risks and control gaps.
  • Ensure operational risks from new products, volume growth, platform changes, regulatory requirements and business transformation are assessed, understood and appropriately mitigated.
  • Strengthen issue management, incident response, root-cause analysis and control remediation to prevent recurrence and improve resilience.
  • Provide effective challenge to business and functional stakeholders where operational risk, service quality, control standards or client outcomes may be compromised.

Governance

  • Establish clear and effective governance across GCNA Markets Operations, including country teams and GBS-supported activities, with defined ownership, performance indicators, risk indicators and escalation pathways.
  • Represent Markets Operations in country, regional and business forums, ensuring decisions are informed by operational risk, regulatory commitments, client impact and control outcomes.
  • Maintain transparency over service performance, capacity, resilience, incidents, audit/regulatory matters and material operational issues across the cluster.
  • Provide strong oversight over outsourced, offshored and hubbed activities, ensuring service delivery, control accountability and governance remain clearly owned and actively managed.
  • Live and breathe the #NeverSettle value.

Transformation

  • Lead GCNA Operations input into global and regional transformation programmes, ensuring country requirements, client impact, operational controls and implementation risks are fully understood and addressed.
  • Drive measurable improvements in productivity, control effectiveness, service quality and operational resilience through process simplification, digitisation and automation.
  • Partner with Technology, Product, COO, GBS, Risk and Change teams to deliver sustainable transformation outcomes that reduce manual dependency and improve scalability.
  • Champion continuous improvement by using data-led insights to prioritise opportunities, track benefits and embed lasting change across the cluster.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Provide leadership within the Middle Office organisation to comply with the highest standards of regulatory and business conduct and practices as defined by internal and external requirements.
  • Takes a proactive approach to implementing Just Culture and emphasising the importance of the groups’ valued behaviours regularly through retrospective sessions with the team and Channels townhall sessions.
  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Embed the Group’s Values and Group Code of Conduct to ensure adherence with the highest standards of ethics. Comply with relevant policies, processes, and regulations, as part of the culture.

Key stakeholders

  • GCNA Markets Heads across HK, China, Taiwan, Korea and Japan
  • Trading, Sales and Country COO teams in each market
  • Global Markets Operations leadership and product / process heads
  • Middle Office, Client Support and Onboarding teams
  • GBS Operations teams supporting confirmations, settlements, margining, reporting and related activities
  • Business Risk Management, Compliance, Operational Risk, Finance, Product Control, Technology and Change / Transformation teams
  • Regulators, auditors and external service providers, as applicable Trading, Sales, Middle Office and Product Operations

Other Responsibilities

  • Leverage the opportunity provided by Corporate Social Responsibility to enhance the Group’s internal and external reputation and indirectly influence the bottom line.
  • Promote the Group’s brand and Here for good with employees, clients and regulators.
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.
  • Maintain effective communication with key stakeholders, including regulators and staff.

Skills And Experience

  • Markets Operations and Financial Markets product lifecycle
  • Middle Office, Client Support and Onboarding
  • Post-trade controls: confirmations, settlements, margining and reporting
  • Operational Risk, Controls and Governance
  • Stakeholder Management and Senior Business Partnership
  • Transformation, Process Simplification and Automation
  • Markets Operations and Financial Markets product lifecycle
  • Deep understanding of settlements across products, currencies, markets, legal entities and market infrastructures.
  • Strong ability to manage settlement risk, aged fails, claims, funding dependencies, deadlines and market penalties.
  • Proven ability to simplify settlement processes, reduce manual work and improve control outcomes.
  • Strong use of data to identify recurring issues, settlement risk themes and root causes.
  • Ability to lead large location-based teams with clear accountability and strong escalation discipline.

Qualifications

  • University degree preferred, ideally in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting, Operations, Technology, Data, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Strong experience in Global Markets Operations, Post Trade Operations, Middle Office, Settlements, Confirmations, Reconciliations, Client Data, Fees, Controls, Risk Management, Change or Transformation.
  • Proven experience leading large teams across multiple locations, preferably including GBS, offshore or regional hub environments.
  • Strong understanding of Global Markets products, trade lifecycle, post-trade processes, legal entity requirements and operational risk.
  • Demonstrated track record in strengthening controls, improving service delivery, resolving complex issues and leading sustainable change.
  • Experience engaging senior stakeholders across Front Office, COO, Finance, Product Control, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Audit and country teams.
  • Ability to operate in a high-volume, time-sensitive and risk-sensitive environment with strong judgement and clear escalation discipline.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Proven senior leadership experience managing large or complex global functions with direct accountability for risk, people, performance and transformation.

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Job Summary

Scope of Role:

Account for branch’s operations; counter transactions including system operations to ensure execution accuracy, compliance, and completeness in line with bank internal and external rules/procedures/manuals/standards/group requirements/regulatory requirement/laws as well as to keep high class level of services to our clients

职责范围：

负责分支行的业务操作及各项与分支行有关的营运工作，包括柜台交易的办理及系统处理，确保各项分支行工作执行的准确性，合规性和完整性，执行中必须始终遵守并严格按照银行的内外部准则/操作流程/操作手册/标准/集团要求/监管要求/法规等要求，同时始终保持高水准的客户服务质量与体验

Key Responsibilities

General 总则

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets.   • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Job Type

Full Time

Job Reference #

345787BR

City

Shanghai

Key Responsibilities

Are you excited by the prospect of engineering solutions in across Global Markets? Do you want to design, build and help deliver production systems across the front-office? Are you passionate about building and delivering AI solutions?

We’re looking for a Quant/AI Developer to:

participate in the design, development, and implementation of quantitative models and analytics across the Global Markets business

play a key role in designing and implementing the next generation of AI-powered systems, partnering closely with Trading, Structuring and Sales from idea generation through to production launch

build and maintain strong working relationships with Trading, Structuring, Sales, Quant, IT, and Risk partners in London and across regions

The team

You’ll be working in our Quantitative Analytics team in London — a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We build the tools, models, and workflows that drive the Front Office across asset classes, working side-by-side with them to architect solutions to real problems.

You’ll develop models, applications, and workflows within UBS’s proprietary cloud-based quantitative analytics platform (ACQA), working closely with Trading, Structuring, Sales, Quant, and IT partners globally. Clean code, curiosity and the ability to build relationships and communicate ideas is crucial to the team delivering across a broad range of problems.

Required

Your skills and experience

An ambitious and intellectually curious individual, keen to combine your technical experience with a clear desire to solve practical problems

Proficient in Python with experience delivering production changes to large complex systems

Able to communicate your ideas clearly and build strong relationships globally within the front office

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and architectural design skills, with an ability to operate effectively in a front-office environment

An academic background in Quantitative Finance, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related STEM discipline

Preferred

Strong knowledge of AI/ML techniques with experience delivering related work into production

Previous experience of agentic design (harnesses), MCP servers, and related AI/ML python libraries

Strong understanding of data fundamentals and their python implementations (numpy, polars, scipy)

About Us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

Join us

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.

Contact Details

UBS Business Solutions SA

UBS Recruiting

Disclaimer / Policy statements

UBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.

ln:4487522664.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Product Owner.

Business:CTO

Principal Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the product vision, strategy and roadmap for AI Tools & Capabilities for the Group AI Platform.
  • Translate strategy into a multi-quarter roadmap with clear priorities across group capabilities.
  • Partner with engineering, design, security and compliance to deliver incremental products to the bank.
  • Gather requirements from internal stakeholders and manage the backlog, translating them into scalable platform solutions with clear success criteria.
  • Run discovery across AI Platform stakeholders to identify friction points that are limiting adoption.
  • Prioritise features based on business value, user needs, technical feasibility and strategic goals.
  • Stay current on AI industry trends, emerging technologies and competitive offerings.
  • Ensure responsible AI practices, including transparency, fairness, privacy and regulatory compliance are factored into the platform.

Requirements

  • Act as a Product lead with experience building B2B Products, ideally in a Financial setting using AI or ML, demonstrating excellent problem-solving as well as strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Hold a university degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Bring 10+ years of experience in ML/AI or related field.
  • 5+ years as a Product Leader for Products and/or Platforms.
  • Experienced in leveraging coding assistants, OpenClaw, Claude.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Job Description

Job Summary

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;

理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；

  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;

跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；

  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;

审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；

  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;

对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；

  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Coverage of CMPS products (structured products) to deliver the proper solutions under the framework of Business Strategy to meet the needs across from Retail Banking and Business Banking clients.

覆盖资本市场产品及解决方案部的产品（结构性产品），在业务战略框架下提供适当的解决方案，以满足零售银行和中小企业银行客户的需求。

  • Manage and develop strong product solutions and smooth workflow to deliver differentiated product proposition and brand identity. 开发并管理强大的产品解决方案和顺畅的工作流程；提供独特的产品主张和品牌标识。
  • To develop and manage the full range of structured products with reference to the overall Wealth Solution Strategy.
  • Manage and maintain the development of the strong and differentiated product proposition and brand identity.

Business

  • Collaborate with Wealth Management and [Retail/Business] Banking to bring the best values to our clients through: 与财富管理和零售银行/中小企业部门合作，通过以下方式为客户带来最佳价值：
  • Product ideation and innovation产品构思与创新
  • Product pipeline planning产品受众规划
  • Provision of best execution for CMPS products资本市场产品及解决方案部的产品的最佳执行
  • Infrastructure implementation to ensure a seamless workflow基础架构的维护与执行
  • To manage end to end structured product business and drive digital adoption
  • Deliver new products to market to grow customer base and revenue
  • Collaborate with key country stakeholders in Wealth Management, Retail Banking, Technology and Operations to deliver the best value to our customers
  • Actively work with Product & Segment, Treasury Specialist and Sales to make continuous improvement and innovation to develop better product advisory solutions.

积极与 Product & Segment部门、资金产品销售和其他销售人员合作，不断改进和创新，以开发更好的产品咨询解决方案。

  • Keep refreshed mindset on market change and industry trend to ensure product innovation.

持续关注市场变化和行业趋势，力争产品创新。

Processes

  • Assist in system integration and implementation in order to ensure the streamlining and increase in productivity.

协助系统整合和升级，以确保高效运作。

  • Consistently review and upgrade existing product features, services, workflows to improve client experiences and make sure full compliance with local regulatory requirements and group policy.

根据当地法规要求和集团政策，持续检测和升级现有产品的功能、服务和工作流程，以改善客户体验。

People & Talent

  • Conduct training to Treasury Specialist and Sales team to enhance product knowledge and market sense.

对资金产品销售和其他销售人员进行培训，以提高其产品知识和市场知识。

  • Established professional code and communication skills when collaborating with other teams.

与其他团队进行专业地合作和沟通。

Risk Management

  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties.

在履行职责时执行和遵守反洗钱要求。

  • Comply with the respective Money Laundering Prevention Procedures and be alert at all times to unusual or possibly suspicious customer activity and should report any suspicious activity to AML Surveillance Team and line manager as well as directly to the Country MLPO in urgent or exceptional circumstances.

遵守预防洗钱的规定，随时警惕异常或可疑的客户活动，并应向反洗钱监督小组和直线经理报告任何可疑活动，在紧急或特殊情况下应直接向国家反洗钱办公室报告。

  • Mitigation of risks and resolution of issues in a timely manner including developing suitable controls and measuring their effectiveness.

制定适当的风险控制措施并衡量其有效性，缓解风险，解决问题。

  • Proactive identification and reporting of risks and concerns.

主动识别和报告风险问题

Governance

  • Adherence to laws and regulations, internal risk and compliance policies (including anti-money laundry, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption and relevant FCC risks) and the Group Code of Conduct.

遵守法律法规、内部风险和合规政策（包括反洗钱、制裁、反贿赂和腐败以及相关的FCC风险）和集团行为准则。

  • Timely completion of all mandatory risk and compliance training, including e-learning by the set deadlines.

及时完成所有风险和合规强制性培训，包括在规定的截止日期前进行e-learning课程。

  • Fully understand the importance of consumer rights protection, prevent damage to consumer’s best interest, implement regulatory requirements related to consumer rights protection, ensure to complete relevant trainings and to always embed consumer rights protection mindset when performing daily work.

充分理解消费者权益保护的重要性，防止损害消费者的最佳利益，执行与消费者权益保护相关的监管要求，确保完成相关培训，并在日常工作中始终嵌入消费者权益保护意识。

  • Fully understand the importance of fraud prevention, prevent fraud risks, maintain safe and steady operation of the position, implement regulatory requirements of fraud prevention, strictly execute DOIs of the department, ensure to complete relevant trainings and embed fraud prevention in daily work.

充分认识防欺诈的重要性，防范欺诈风险，维护岗位安全稳定运行，落实防欺诈监管要求，严格执行部门管理文件，确保完成相关培训，将防欺诈融入日常工作。

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • WRB/SME/WS Product 产品部
  • WRB/SME/WS Segment 客群部
  • WRB/SME/WS HO 总部
  • WRB/SME/WS Process team 政策及流程部
  • WRB/SME/WS Business Finance 财务部
  • WRB/SME/WS Operation team 营运部
  • OR 操作风险部
  • BORM 业务风险管控部
  • Legal & Compliance 法务部和合规部
  • CMPS Treasury Specialist Team 资金产品销售团队
  • WRB/SME/WS Sales 零售银行和中小企业银行销售团队
  • WFX and CNSD Project Team WFX和CNSD项目团队
  • External Counterparties for SD 结构性存款产品交易对手方
  • FM金融市场部

Other Responsibilities

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies.

理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；

  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities.

跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控;

  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank.
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections.

对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；

  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

  • Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control.

正确履行管理职责，并确保内控的效率；

  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of the event over which the employee has the duties of management and/or leadership.

对负有管理和或领导责任的事项引起或相关的违反监管规定事件或风险，承担相应责任.

  • Be responsible for significant losses due to failure of effectiveness of internal control.

为内控失效造成的重大损失负责。

Skills And Experience

  • Education: University graduate with 5+ years of working experience in banking and related financial institutions. Deep understanding of structured products pricing; familiar with derivatives with underlying of equity, fixed income and currency;
  • Certifications: Post-graduate degree holder or CFA are preferred.
  • Languages: Excellent written and spoken English and Mandarin.

Qualifications

  • Microsoft Excel
  • Microsoft PowerPoint
  • Microsoft Word
  • Capital Markets Products Skills

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Profile Description

Standard Chartered Bank

- To manage end to end structured product business and drive digital adoption

对资金产品销售和其他销售人员进行培训，以提高其产品知识和市场知识。

与其他团队进行专业地合作和沟通。

在履行职责时执行和遵守反洗钱要求。

及时完成所有风险和合规强制性培训，包括在规定的截止日期前进行e-learning课程。

  • Certifications: Post-graduate degree holder or CFA are preferred.
  • Languages: Excellent written and spoken English and Mandarin.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4485550893.descriptionHtml:
The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities

  • Leverage past investment banking or related experience to enhance Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) execution and capital raising capabilities and contribute to building Citi's franchise
  • Meet revenue and other financial goals by establishing and maintaining a pipeline of episodic deals
  • Ensure that proposed client solutions meet or exceed internal risk and return standards, including stringent ethical standards,
  • Anticipate future changes in the marketplace
  • Identify and anticipate all types of risks (e.g. industry, portfolio, diversification, sovereign, commercial, currency, etc.)
  • Serve as a mentor to junior Bankers, execute staffing models that support business needs and career trajectories for junior staff
  • Build client relationships by providing sophisticated financial solutions tailored to the clients’ needs and acting as a content provider on market trends
  • Serve as the expert on regulatory, financial and complex strategic issues relating to corporate finance transactions
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Recommended Qualifications

  • 15+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience in people management
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration preferred
  • Master's degree in Business Administration preferred
  • Experience working in an investment banking institution(s)
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Demonstrated ability to remain unbiased in a diverse working environment
  • Series 79 and 63 licenses


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred
  • Engage in the buildout of China equity capital markets team and design internal deal process, policy and procedures
  • Lead origination and execution of global ECM transactions with a strong focus on China A-share transactions Lead and manage end-to-end execution of ECM transactions including A-share IPOs, follow-on offerings, rights issues, convertible bonds, and equity-linked products on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), Shenzhen Stock Exchange (SZSE), and STAR Market (科创板)
  • Drive origination of new ECM mandates through proactive client engagement, sector expertise, and market intelligence
  • Coordinate cross-border equity transactions including H-share listings, A+H dual listings, and HKEX IPOs for China-based issuers
  • Oversee preparation of prospectuses, offering memoranda, regulatory filings, and investor marketing materials to the highest standard of accuracy and compliance
  • 10+ years of relevant ECM origination and execution experience with a deep understanding of China A-share market as well as good knowledge of global capital markets
  • Solid understanding of local financial markets and ECM product knowledge
  • Preferably also equipped with DCM product knowledge
  • Familiarity with CSRC/Exchanges/SAC rules
  • Experience of covering local institutional investors
  • Secure and maintain all necessary CSRC licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English
  • Preference for HK SFC Type 6 licenses / qualifications

    • Deep understanding of the regulatory landscape governing China's technology sector, including data security, VIE structures, and cross-border listing considerations
  • Industrials
    • Experience covering China's advanced manufacturing, aerospace & defense, engineering, logistics, and industrial conglomerates, with a focus on domestic consolidation, outbound M&A, and capital raising mandates
    • Familiarity with China's industrial policy priorities, including "Made in China 2025," dual circulation strategy, and state-owned enterprise (SOE) reform
  • Financial Institutions Group (FIG)
    • Strong relationships with Chinese banks, insurance companies, asset managers, securities firms, and fintech players, with experience advising on capital optimization, M&A, and regulatory-driven transactions
    • Understanding of CBIRC/PBOC regulatory frameworks and their implications for FIG deal structuring and execution
  • Healthcare & Life Sciences
    • Coverage experience across pharmaceuticals, biotech, medical devices, CROs/CDMOs, and hospital groups, with a strong grasp of China's healthcare reform agenda and NMPA regulatory environment
    • Track record on healthcare IPOs, licensing deals, and cross-border partnerships involving Chinese and multinational healthcare companies
  • Natural Resources & Energy
    • Advisory experience in oil & gas, mining, metals, chemicals, and new energy (solar, wind, EV battery supply chain), with knowledge of China's energy transition policies and resource security strategy
    • Established relationships with major Chinese state-owned energy and resources enterprises (e.g., CNOOC, Sinopec, CNNC, Chinalco) as well as private sector players
  • Consumer & Retail
    • Deep sector knowledge across food & beverage, luxury goods, e-commerce, consumer staples, and lifestyle brands, with experience advising on brand acquisitions, retail consolidation, and cross-border consumer transactions
    • Understanding of evolving Chinese consumer trends, domestic brand emergence ("国潮"), and the competitive dynamics between domestic and international players
  • Additional Sector Considerations
    • Real Estate & Infrastructure: Experience with China's property developers, REITs, and infrastructure funds, navigating the post-deleveraging regulatory environment
    • Education & Government Services: Advisory background in the evolving regulatory landscape post-2021 sector restructuring
    • Automotive & New Energy Vehicles (NEV): Coverage of OEMs, EV supply chain, and smart mobility companies amid China's global NEV leadership push
  • 7+ years of China A-share sponsor-related experience in an investment banking front office role
  • Possess China sponsor representative license

  • Experience with large corporate clients, capital markets products, derivatives, credit, cash management, trade, finance and securities products
  • Series 7 and 63 preferred

  • Master’s degree preferred

The overall objective of this role is to coordinate the promotion of products to develop new markets, increase share of market and obtain competitive position.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of professional to accomplish established goals and conduct personnel duties for team (e.g. performance evaluations, hiring and disciplinary actions) as well as negotiate and make decisions on issues/activities having critical impact/influence on company revenues, capital, or business operations
  • Lead strategic product roadmaps, product development, program launches, and program marketing to gain maximum benefit from each product, as well as survey and analyze competitive industry landscapes to identify relative trends, threats, and opportunities for product managers
  • Manage day-to-day product marketing for core products such as product delivery, client experience, and client communication strategies as well as help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results
  • Drive client valued propositions, positioning, segmentation, pricing, targeting, channel strategies, and competitive differentiation to achieve preferred status as a partner to Citi clients
  • Develop plans and execute functional strategies for a country, group of countries, region, or business requiring coordination and integration across units as well as provide input into strategic decisions affecting job family or function within region or business
  • Manage client and competitor market research, develop product innovation roadmap, and address fundamental trials of product commoditization to create an advanced set of solutions
  • Oversee all aspects of program life cycle management including market demands, technology trends, and the competitive field as well as drive innovation by working with external partners/alliances to develop products, manage ongoing relationships, and prepare agreements
  • Manage acquisition targets, product financial performance, revenue performance, and expense management goals as well as oversee identification and execution of opportunities and gaps business plans
  • Define and launch new products, features, and capabilities including defining the product/feature and go-to-market strategy, and participate in technology development and market launch activities
  • Develop and communicate a business plan to approach the marketplace, and coordinate and implement team procedures, client problem resolutions and client management
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.


Qualifications

  • 15+ years of relevant experience
  • 8-10+ years of managerial experience
  • Experience managing in a global and matrixed environment including managing cross functional areas with direct and indirect reports (e.g. risk, finance, decision management, marketing, operations)
  • Working knowledge of the different systems, theories, and practices relevant to a function as well as practical experience of multiple business cycles
  • In-depth knowledge of industry and competitor products/services


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred

ln:4485564323.descriptionHtml:
• Citibank China Company Ltd. (‘CCCL’) is Citibank’s locally incorporated subsidiary with full-fledged banking license serving the Mainland China market. Second Line of Defense (‘2LoD’) oversight for Liquidity Risk, Non-Trading Market Risk (Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book - IRRBB), and Balance Sheet Risks is executed by Finance CRO (FinCRO).
  • The Treasury Risk Vice President (C13) leads independent 2LoD oversight, risk limit framework design/recalibration, quantitative risk analysis, and credible challenge for Non-Trading Market Risk and Liquidity Risk across CCCL.
  • The role ensures robust governance across risk appetite, intraday liquidity, internal/regulatory liquidity stress testing, IRRBB supervisory frameworks (including Supervisory Outlier Tests), behavioral modeling assumptions, and regulatory compliance with PBOC/NFRA and Basel standards.


Job Background / Context

CCCL’s Independent Risk Management acts as the second line of defense for the holistic management of risk across all business lines and entities in China. Within Independent Risk Management, the Finance CRO team provides independent oversight, review, and credible challenge to 1LoD functions (Corporate Treasury, Market Treasury, and Global Markets).

The team ensures CCCL maintains an adequate liquidity profile, resilient intraday payment/settlement capacity, and an optimized balance sheet structure that operates strictly within Board-approved Risk Appetite thresholds for Liquidity, IRRBB, Capital Adequacy, and Investments. The VP serves as a senior subject matter expert driving quantitative risk analytics, limit calibrations, and regulatory engagements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Risk Limit Setting, Calibration & Risk Appetite Framework
  • Limit Setting & Recalibration: Lead the periodic and ad-hoc review, establishment, and quantitative recalibration of CCCL’s Treasury Risk Limit Framework covering Liquidity, IRRBB, and balance sheet structure.
  • Risk Appetite & Triggers: Formulate and recalibrate Board-approved Risk Appetite Statements (RAS), Early Warning Indicators (EWIs), and management triggers to reflect balance sheet changes, business strategy, and market dynamics.
  • Methodology Challenge: Provide formal 2LoD challenge on underlying limit methodologies, allocation waterfalls, buffer sizing, and scenario severity parameters.
  • Liquidity Risk Management & Intraday Liquidity Oversight
  • Intraday Liquidity Oversight: Drive 2LoD monitoring and independent oversight of intraday liquidity risk, time-critical payment/clearing obligations (CNAPS/CIPS), and intraday collateral mobilization.
  • Payment Buffer & Collateral Adequacy: Assess and challenge CCCL’s intraday liquidity buffers, credit lines, central bank pledged collateral, and overdraft facilities under normal and stressed conditions.
  • Contingency Funding Planning (CFP): Review and challenge the operational feasibility of CCCL’s Contingency Funding Plan, liquidity escalation triggers, and asset monetization capabilities.
  • Liquidity Stress Testing (LST) & Scenario Modeling
  • Internal Stress Testing (ILST): Lead 2LoD review and credible challenge of CCCL’s Internal Liquidity Stress Testing frameworks, Resolution Liquidity Adequacy (RLAP/RLEN), and survival horizon metrics.
  • Scenario Design & Assumptions: Assess the severity and relevance of idiosyncratic, systemic, and combined stress scenarios; review cash flow projections, deposit runoff assumptions, contingent liquidity draws, and wholesale funding rollovers.
  • HQLA Buffer Sizing: Evaluate the sizing, composition, currency mix, and unencumbered status of CCCL’s High-Quality Liquid Assets buffer.
  • Regulatory Compliance & Standards (Liquidity & IRRBB)
  • Liquidity Regulatory Ratios: Ensure continuous 2LoD monitoring and compliance with PBOC and NFRA regulatory ratios, including Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR), Liquidity Ratio (LR), and Net Cumulative Outflow metrics.
  • IRRBB Regulatory Frameworks: Ensure strict compliance with NFRA IRRBB Guidelines for Commercial Banks, PBOC macroprudential requirements, and Basel BCBS 368 standards.
  • Supervisory Outlier Tests (SOT): Lead the 2LoD assessment, validation, and monitoring of regulatory SOT for
  • Regulatory Reporting & Exams: Oversee and validate local regulatory IRRBB returns, interest rate repricing gap schedules, and supervisory stress test submissions; provide technical risk support for PBOC/NFRA examinations and inquiries.
  • Regulatory Change: Track, interpret, and drive the implementation of evolving prudential standards across IRRBB, Credit Spread Risk in the Banking Book (CSRBB), and liquidity metrics (BCBS 248 / Basel III/IV).
  • Non-Trading Market Risk (IRRBB) & Modeling Assumptions
  • IRRBB Metrics Oversight: Review, analyze, and challenge banking book interest rate risk metrics, including Economic Value of Equity (EVE) sensitivity, Earnings at Risk (EaR), and Net Interest Income (NII) sensitivity.
  • Behavioral Assumptions: Review and challenge behavioral modeling assumptions for non-maturity deposits (NMDs), loan prepayments, deposit early redemptions, and Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) rules.
  • Variance & P&L Attribution: Supervise detailed variance analysis and driver attribution explaining balance sheet metric movements.
  • Governance, Committee Presentation & Risk Culture
  • Senior Governance Forums: Prepare risk analytics and actively participate in the Asset and Liability Committee (ALCO), Country Risk Management Committee (RMC), and Country Coordination Committee (CCC).
  • ICAAP & Resolution Planning: Provide critical 2LoD input and independent challenge for Non-Trading Market Risk (IRRBB) and Liquidity Risk sections of the ICAAP and Recovery & Resolution Plans.
  • Audit & Control Remediation: Serve as primary risk contact for Internal Audit and external regulatory examinations; drive the timely remediation of Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) and Manager's Control Assessments (MCA).
  • Conduct & Ethics: Uphold the highest standards of conduct, ethics, and compliance, transparently managing and escalating risk and control issues.


Development Value

  • Direct Franchise Impact: High-visibility role managing and defending the treasury, IRRBB, and liquidity risk profile of Citi's onshore China banking franchise (CCCL).
  • Senior Stakeholder Exposure: Strategic interface with senior franchise leadership (CCCL CRO, Treasurer, CFO, and Regional FinCRO heads).
  • Regulatory & Technical Mastery: Advanced exposure to onshore PBOC/NFRA and Basel regulatory regimes, leading limit recalibration, stress testing, and supervisory outlier evaluations.
  • Career Growth: High-impact leadership track offering clear progression into broader regional Treasury Risk and Country CRO roles.


Person Specification

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Quantitative Risk Management, Financial Engineering, or Accounting. Master’s degree or professional certifications (FRM, CFA) strongly preferred.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: In-depth technical mastery of Liquidity Risk (LCR, NSFR, ILST, intraday liquidity, collateral management) and IRRBB / ALM (EVE, EaR, NII sensitivity, yield curve modeling, CSRBB).
  • Experience: 6–10+ years of relevant experience in Treasury Risk Management, Liquidity Risk, Balance Sheet / ALM Risk, or Non-Trading Market Risk in banking or financial institutions.
  • Limit Calibration & Analytics: Proven expertise in designing, quantitatively calibrating, and backtesting risk limits, stress scenarios, and early warning trigger frameworks.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of PBOC and NFRA regulatory rules, reporting standards, Basel III/IV frameworks, BCBS 248 intraday metrics, and BCBS 368 IRRBB standards.
  • Credible Challenge: Confident executive presence with the ability to provide robust, credible challenge to 1LoD Corporate Treasury, Market Treasury, and business heads.
  • Legal Entity Risk: Experience working within a locally incorporated bank subsidiary or material legal entity environment.
  • Technical Tools: High proficiency in Advanced Excel/VBA, SQL, and financial risk engines; experience with Python or BI tools and applying AI/automation to streamline workflows.
  • Language Skills: Full professional fluency in written and spoken English and Mandarin (Putonghua) is mandatory.
  • Communication & Governance: Strong communication and memo-writing skills to articulate complex balance sheet, liquidity, and rate risk dynamics clearly to senior governance committees (ALCO/RMC/Board).
  • Examinations & Audits: Prior experience participating in regulatory examinations, risk assessments, and internal audits.
  • Execution & Resilience: Self-driven, highly organized, and capable of prioritizing and delivering under tight timelines.

ln:4485550891.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Head of Operations to establish and lead the entire operational framework for our new brokerage in China. This is a unique opportunity to build a world-class operations department from scratch. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader with deep expertise in China's securities market, regulatory landscape, and operational best practices. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing all operational processes, systems, and teams to ensure efficiency, scalability, and full compliance with Chinese regulations.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Strategy & Setup

  • Develop and execute the end-to-end operational strategy for the new brokerage.
  • Lead the setup of all operational infrastructure, including clearing, settlement, custody, and client services.
  • Select, implement, and integrate key operational systems and technologies (e.g., OMS, PMS, back-office systems, Rootnet)


Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all operations are fully compliant with regulations from the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), and other relevant authorities.
  • Establish and maintain robust internal controls, policies, and procedures (e.g., for AML/KYC, trade processing, and data privacy).
  • Develop and oversee the firm's operational risk management framework to identify, mitigate, and report risks.


Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, train, and lead a high-performing operations team.
  • Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Set performance goals and provide ongoing coaching and development for team members.


Core Operations Management

  • Oversee daily operations including trade capture, confirmation, clearing, and settlement for equities.
  • Manage cash management, and securities financing operations.
  • Establish and manage the client onboarding process, ensuring efficient and compliant KYC and account opening procedures.


Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Act as the primary liaison with key external partners, including local exchanges (SSE, SZSE), clearing houses (CSDC, SHCH), custodian banks, and technology vendors.
  • Collaborate closely with internal departments, including Front Office, Compliance, Finance, and Technology, to ensure seamless business integration.


Financial & Performance Management

  • Develop and manage the operations department's budget.
  • Define, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive efficiency and service quality.
  • Lead projects aimed at process optimization and automation.


Qualifications

  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 15+ years of experience in securities brokerage operations, with at least 7 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., Head/Director of Operations).
    • Proven track record of setting up and managing operations for a securities firm in mainland China is essential.
    • Extensive experience in a start-up or new business launch environment is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge & Skills:
    • In-depth knowledge of China's A-share market, fixed income market, and related financial products.
    • Expert understanding of the Chinese regulatory environment, including rules set by CSRC, PBOC, and SAFE.
    • Strong familiarity with local market infrastructure, including CSDC, CFETS, and major exchanges.
    • Demonstrated ability in process design, re-engineering, and implementing operational systems.
    • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Education & Language:
    • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA or other advanced degree is a plus.
    • Fluency in Mandarin Chinese is mandatory.
    • Professional proficiency in English is highly preferred.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader with deep expertise in China's securities market, regulatory landscape, and operational best practices. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing all operational processes, systems, and teams to ensure efficiency, scalability, and full compliance with Chinese regulations.
Key Responsibilities
Operational Strategy & Setup
- Develop and execute the end-to-end operational strategy for the new brokerage.
- Lead the setup of all operational infrastructure, including clearing, settlement, custody, and client services.
- Select, implement, and integrate key operational systems and technologies (e.g., OMS, PMS, back-office systems, Rootnet)
Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management
- Ensure all operations are fully compliant with regulations from the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), and other relevant authorities.
- Establish and maintain robust internal controls, policies, and procedures (e.g., for AML/KYC, trade processing, and data privacy).
- Develop and oversee the firm's operational risk management framework to identify, mitigate, and report risks.
Team Leadership & Development
- Build, train, and lead a high-performing operations team.
- Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
- Set performance goals and provide ongoing coaching and development for team members.
Core Operations Management
- Oversee daily operations including trade capture, confirmation, clearing, and settlement for equities.
- Manage cash management, and securities financing operations.
- Establish and manage the client onboarding process, ensuring efficient and compliant KYC and account opening procedures.
Stakeholder & Vendor Management
- Act as the primary liaison with key external partners, including local exchanges (SSE, SZSE), clearing houses (CSDC, SHCH), custodian banks, and technology vendors.
- Collaborate closely with internal departments, including Front Office, Compliance, Finance, and Technology, to ensure seamless business integration.
Financial & Performance Management
- Develop and manage the operations department's budget.
- Define, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive efficiency and service quality.
- Lead projects aimed at process optimization and automation.
Qualifications
- Experience:
- Minimum of 15+ years of experience in securities brokerage operations, with at least 7 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., Head/Director of Operations).
- Proven track record of setting up and managing operations for a securities firm in mainland China is essential.
- Extensive experience in a start-up or new business launch environment is highly desirable.
- Knowledge & Skills:
- In-depth knowledge of China's A-share market, fixed income market, and related financial products.
- Expert understanding of the Chinese regulatory environment, including rules set by CSRC, PBOC, and SAFE.
- Strong familiarity with local market infrastructure, including CSDC, CFETS, and major exchanges.
- Demonstrated ability in process design, re-engineering, and implementing operational systems.
- Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Education & Language:
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA or other advanced degree is a plus.
- Fluency in Mandarin Chinese is mandatory.
- Professional proficiency in English is highly preferred.

ln:4485570075.descriptionHtml:
The Mid-Corp Relationship Manager is a strategic professional who stays abreast of developments within own field and contributes to directional strategy by considering their application in own job and the business. Recognized technical authority for an area within the business. Requires basic commercial awareness. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Significant impact on the area through complex deliverables. Provides advice and counsel related to the process or operations of the business. Work impacts an entire area, which eventually affects the overall performance and effectiveness of the sub-function/job family.

Responsibilities

  • Calls on clients to deepen relationships and proactively owns, responds to, uncovers and anticipates future needs, roadblocks or risks and expectations
  • Introduces solutions to clients in building and strengthening an effective portfolio;
  • Works with product specialists and subject matter experts to structure innovative and customized solutions that meet clients’ individual needs
  • Works closely with Case Manager on the on-boarding and retention of clients, ensuring the appropriate “Know Your Client” (KYC) and other compliance deliverables are met;
  • Identifies cross-sell opportunities to deepen and increase share of wallet;
  • Maximizes client experience by proactive sharing markets updates, trend and intelligence;
  • Drives innovation in the solutions we provide clients and further developing our business where necessary and appropriate
  • Execution of strategic initiatives launched centrally at all levels (Group, Bank, commercial market and EIB)
  • Networks with clients to identify avenues for new business opportunities;
  • New client acquisiitons to actively expand client portfolio;
  • Administrate the credit relationship of the client, coordinating and supervising the entire process, ensuring the proper application of policies and institutional processes
  • Ensures compliance with regulatory requirements and Citi's policies / guidelines at all time
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications

  • 6-10 years of experience
  • Sound knowledge of banking and investment products and process as well as a track record of providing sound banking and financial advice and solutions to clients
  • Demonstrates sound credit skills by being able to structure more complex deals, which can include capital market transactions
  • Demonstrates advanced level of Early Warning Detection skills
  • Demonstrates advanced credit skills; able to structure all type of credit deals
  • Ability to work effectively in team setting
  • Ability to coordinate multi-functional teams to provide an exceptional client experience.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and influencing skills (e.g. negotiation, consultative skills, leadership)
  • Ability to work under pressure while making sound decisions
  • Highly focused, able to rapidly identify key priorities, clearly communicate the priorities
  • A proactive approach in looking for ways in strengthening business relationship with clients, delivers a simple, secure and seamless client experience
  • Passion for creating new business opportunities with existing clients and able to demonstrate innovative approaches to meeting clients’ needs.
  • Ability to embrace new technology and understand the role digital plays in the experience we deliver for our clients
  • Able to quickly adapt priorities based on the latest data insights


Education

  • Bachelor’s/University degree, Masters degree preferred

The Ops Sup Sr. Manager is a senior management level position responsible for accomplishing results through the management of a team or department in an effort to provide operations support services in coordination with the Operations - Core team. The overall objective of this role is to ensure the seamless delivery of operations support services in alignment with Citi operations support infrastructure and processes.

Responsibilities

  • Manage professional teams and departments through delegation of tasks and responsibilities
  • Conduct performance evaluations, compensations, hiring, disciplinary actions, and terminations of team members as well as maintain appropriate staffing requirements
  • Monitor the team’s quality and efficiency of end results and manage all training and development needs of assigned personnel
  • Create and develop budget, policy formation and short-term resource planning
  • Manage occasionally complex and varied issues with significant departmental impact
  • Apply in-depth knowledge of how areas integrate within the sub function as well as coordinate and contribute to the goals of the entire function
  • Provide evaluative judgment based on analysis of information in complicated and unique situations
  • Ensure essential procedures are followed and contribute to the defining standards
  • Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
  • Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
  • Acts as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
  • Ability to manage teams.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.


Qualifications

  • 6-10 years of experience with background in Financial Services Industry (Commercial Banking related experience is an advantage)
  • Extensive knowledge of the Client Onboarding processes
  • Working knowledge of Commercial Liability Account Opening, Maintenance & Anti Money Laundering (AML) Requirements
  • Working knowledge of Systematics, Filenet, Citi Know Your Client (KYC), Workforce Management (WFM) and Commercial Liability Products
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements
  • Proven organization and time management skills
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred

ln:4485550888.descriptionHtml:
The Salesperson is a senior-level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Director Salesperson also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities

  • Refine and implement sales/marketing strategy to improve Citi's client footprint and maximize associated revenue while working with management/colleagues to establish a clear marketing plan with defined priorities, market penetration and revenue goals
  • Leverage contact network to understand client needs, introduce the Citi offering, and convince clients to adopt it to increase client satisfaction/Citi revenue
  • Advise team in strategic positioning and closing transactions with various internal stakeholders (structuring, trading, legal, credit and risk etc.)
  • Forge a relationship with salespeople in order to leverage Citi's franchise and source relevant buying and selling opportunities for clients
  • Lead strong governance and controls
  • Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
  • Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
  • Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation
  • Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services
  • Adhere to all policies and procedures as defined by your role which will be communicated to you
  • Obtain and maintain all registrations/licenses which are required for your role, within the appropriate timeframe
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Recommended Qualifications

  • 15+ years of sales experience at a financial services organization
  • Experience in a client-facing role working with the buy-side community
  • Proven interpersonal and problem-solving skills
  • Consistently demonstrate clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Broad client relationships preferred


Education

  • Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master's degree preferred
  • Working Environment: office setting, minimal travelling and prolonged working hours in the office may be required during projects.
  • Effort: minimal physical effort required. High levels of prolonged and intense concentration may be required in front of computer.

ln:4485560496.descriptionHtml:
The Business Execution and Control role is a senior level position responsible for the overall Business Execution and In-Business Risk Management of Equity Brokerage Business (EQB).

Working as part of the Equity Brokerage team, this role supports Equity Sales and Execution in Agency Activities to ensure successful delivery of strategic initiatives, compliance with local regulations and Citigroup requirements, as well as a strong governance and control framework maintained.

As such this role not only requires an understanding of the Equity business, but also needs regulatory and control knowledge to identify and mitigate risks for the business by working with support functions such as Legal, Risk, Finance, Operations, Technology and Compliance.

Responsibilities

  • Work with Equity Brokerage Head to drive strategic initiatives related to risk, people, capital and coordinate across product groups, regions, sectors and functional partners.
  • Lead and coordinate the implementation of New Product capabilities from planning to execution and ensure compliance of Reg/Citi requirements.
  • Drive the Business Requirements Documentation (BRD) for new business or change requirements.
  • Partner with Product and Tech to build out of Electronic Trading capabilities.
  • Lead the implementation of program trading, trading controls etc.
  • Manage risk and control assessments in line with Electronic trading (E-trading) standards, and compliance with laws, rules, and regulations.
  • Work with front-to-back partners to streamline processes and build consistent policies and procedures with considerations of local rules and regulations as well as Citi Standards.
  • Drive efficiency / productivity initiatives in partnership with the senior management team and other functional partners.
  • Act as the business contact for regulatory authority and compliance department and actively track and implement business related Reg/Group compliance requirements.
  • Drive compliance with laws, rules, regulations, and policy, apply ethical judgment, and manage control issues with transparency.
  • Implement risk strategies and monitor the controls’ effectiveness regularly.
  • Takes accountability for escalating, identifying, and managing potential risk; implements controls that enhance the client experience and operational effectiveness.
  • Anticipates problems and proactively identifies solutions that address the root causes and result in meaningful improvements.


Recommended Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in financial industry.
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of business management, risk and control, technology experience or knowledge is preferred.
  • Have Equities’ product knowledge and Strong front to back understanding of trades and booking flows.
  • Proven experience successfully driving day-to-day execution and strategic projects across a large matrixed organization.
  • Highly self-driven, ability to independently own work and operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
  • Excellent communication skills for internal negotiations and some external communications.
  • Proficiency in managing compliance policies, driving compliance with laws and managing control issues.
  • Experience in assessing risks and evaluating controls in collaboration with various teams.
  • Proven ability to design and lead projects to enhance processes.


Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree/University degree or equivalent experience, Master’s degree preferred
  • Technology degree is preferred.

The Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst is a senior level position responsible for establishing and implementing new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team.
