ln:4486569891.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

This role drives sustainable growth of the WRB franchise by identifying, developing and converting commercial opportunities into long-term client relationships and business value.

The role expands the Bank's presence within target markets by understanding client needs, originating business opportunities and connecting clients with solutions that support their financial objectives and the Bank's growth ambitions. Working across client acquisition, relationship development and commercial execution, the role builds market connectivity, develops qualified opportunities and works with internal partners to deliver solutions that create value for clients and sustainable growth for the business.

Key Responsibilities

Client Acquisition & Relationship Growth

  • Develop new client relationships and convert business opportunities that contribute to sustainable growth across target customer segments.
  • Strengthen client engagement by understanding customer objectives, financial needs and growth opportunities.
  • Expand share of wallet by identifying opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and solution adoption.
  • Build long-term client value through trusted relationships and consistent delivery of customer outcomes.

Revenue Growth & Commercial Performance

  • Drive sustainable revenue growth through effective acquisition, relationship expansion and opportunity conversion.
  • Apply commercial judgement to balance customer value, profitability and long-term relationship outcomes.
  • Monitor business performance, pipeline effectiveness and conversion outcomes to identify actions that improve growth performance.
  • Translate market opportunities into targeted commercial strategies that support customer acquisition, retention and franchise growth.

Commercial Performance & Revenue Growth

  • Drive revenue growth through disciplined pipeline management, opportunity conversion and proactive customer engagement.
  • Monitor sales performance, pipeline quality and conversion outcomes to identify areas requiring additional focus or intervention.
  • Apply sound commercial judgement when pursuing opportunities, ensuring effort is directed towards activities with the greatest potential impact.
  • Support business growth objectives through consistent execution of sales and acquisition strategies.

Client Solutions & Value Creation

  • Understand customer priorities and business objectives to identify opportunities where the Bank can create value.
  • Connect customers with relevant banking solutions that address financial needs and support growth ambitions.
  • Partner with product specialists and stakeholders to develop customer propositions that improve commercial and customer outcomes.
  • Strengthen client confidence through solution-led engagement, responsiveness and effective delivery.

Risk, Conduct & Customer Outcomes

  • Protect customers and the Bank by conducting business development activities in line with regulatory requirements and responsible selling practices.
  • Promote fair customer outcomes by ensuring recommendations remain appropriate to customer needs and circumstances.
  • Identify and escalate conduct, reputational and commercial risks arising from acquisition or relationship activities.
  • Maintain accurate records and appropriate governance throughout the client acquisition and relationship lifecycle.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Business Execution

  • Partner with product, servicing, risk and operational teams to support effective delivery of customer solutions.
  • Coordinate stakeholders to progress opportunities from initial engagement through implementation and onboarding.
  • Improve customer outcomes through effective collaboration across teams that influence the customer experience.
  • Build internal networks that strengthen responsiveness, solution delivery and business development effectiveness.

Motivations

  • Enjoy building relationships and creating opportunities that drive business growth and customer value.
  • Thrive in commercial environments where initiative, networking and customer engagement influence outcomes.
  • Find satisfaction in identifying customer needs and connecting them with solutions that support their ambitions and the Bank's objectives.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Business Relationship Management
  • Client Development
  • Client Negotiation
  • Commercial Management
  • High Impact Sales Strategy
  • Financial Services
  • Financial Performance Analysis
  • Strategic Analysis
  • Compliance Monitoring
  • Financial Risk Analysis
  • Sales Management
  • Mortgage Sales
  • Regulatory & Compliance
  • Mortgage Lending
  • Talent Development

Qualifications

  • Developing new business opportunities and growing client portfolios within banking, financial services or relationship-based commercial environments.
  • Building and managing client relationships across acquisition, onboarding, relationship expansion and retention activities.
  • Identifying customer needs and connecting clients with suitable financial solutions, products or services.
  • Managing commercial pipelines, revenue growth initiatives or sales opportunities to achieve business targets.
  • Collaborating with product, risk, servicing and operational stakeholders to deliver customer solutions while operating within risk and conduct frameworks.
  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Job Summary
This role drives sustainable growth of the WRB franchise by identifying, developing and converting commercial opportunities into long-term client relationships and business value.
The role expands the Bank's presence within target markets by understanding client needs, originating business opportunities and connecting clients with solutions that support their financial objectives and the Bank's growth ambitions. Working across client acquisition, relationship development and commercial execution, the role builds market connectivity, develops qualified opportunities and works with internal partners to deliver solutions that create value for clients and sustainable growth for the business.
Key Responsibilities
Client Acquisition & Relationship Growth
- Develop new client relationships and convert business opportunities that contribute to sustainable growth across target customer segments.
- Strengthen client engagement by understanding customer objectives, financial needs and growth opportunities.
- Expand share of wallet by identifying opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and solution adoption.
- Build long-term client value through trusted relationships and consistent delivery of customer outcomes.
Revenue Growth & Commercial Performance
- Drive sustainable revenue growth through effective acquisition, relationship expansion and opportunity conversion.
- Apply commercial judgement to balance customer value, profitability and long-term relationship outcomes.
- Monitor business performance, pipeline effectiveness and conversion outcomes to identify actions that improve growth performance.
- Translate market opportunities into targeted commercial strategies that support customer acquisition, retention and franchise growth.
Commercial Performance & Revenue Growth
- Drive revenue growth through disciplined pipeline management, opportunity conversion and proactive customer engagement.
- Monitor sales performance, pipeline quality and conversion outcomes to identify areas requiring additional focus or intervention.
- Apply sound commercial judgement when pursuing opportunities, ensuring effort is directed towards activities with the greatest potential impact.
- Support business growth objectives through consistent execution of sales and acquisition strategies.
Client Solutions & Value Creation
- Understand customer priorities and business objectives to identify opportunities where the Bank can create value.
- Connect customers with relevant banking solutions that address financial needs and support growth ambitions.
- Partner with product specialists and stakeholders to develop customer propositions that improve commercial and customer outcomes.
- Strengthen client confidence through solution-led engagement, responsiveness and effective delivery.
Risk, Conduct & Customer Outcomes
- Protect customers and the Bank by conducting business development activities in line with regulatory requirements and responsible selling practices.
- Promote fair customer outcomes by ensuring recommendations remain appropriate to customer needs and circumstances.
- Identify and escalate conduct, reputational and commercial risks arising from acquisition or relationship activities.
- Maintain accurate records and appropriate governance throughout the client acquisition and relationship lifecycle.
Stakeholder Collaboration & Business Execution
- Partner with product, servicing, risk and operational teams to support effective delivery of customer solutions.
- Coordinate stakeholders to progress opportunities from initial engagement through implementation and onboarding.
- Improve customer outcomes through effective collaboration across teams that influence the customer experience.
- Build internal networks that strengthen responsiveness, solution delivery and business development effectiveness.
Motivations
- Enjoy building relationships and creating opportunities that drive business growth and customer value.
- Thrive in commercial environments where initiative, networking and customer engagement influence outcomes.
- Find satisfaction in identifying customer needs and connecting them with solutions that support their ambitions and the Bank's objectives.
Skills And Experience
Priority Skills
- Business Relationship Management
- Client Development
- Client Negotiation
- Commercial Management
- High Impact Sales Strategy
- Financial Services
- Financial Performance Analysis
- Strategic Analysis
- Compliance Monitoring
- Financial Risk Analysis
- Sales Management
- Mortgage Sales
- Regulatory & Compliance
- Mortgage Lending
- Talent Development
Qualifications
- Developing new business opportunities and growing client portfolios within banking, financial services or relationship-based commercial environments.
- Building and managing client relationships across acquisition, onboarding, relationship expansion and retention activities.
- Identifying customer needs and connecting clients with suitable financial solutions, products or services.
- Managing commercial pipelines, revenue growth initiatives or sales opportunities to achieve business targets.
- Collaborating with product, risk, servicing and operational stakeholders to deliver customer solutions while operating within risk and conduct frameworks.

Job Summary

Customer sales and service

职责范围：

客户销售与服务

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.
  • Deliver allocated performance targets for various product VSs;
  • Maintain relationship with customers and deliver superior customer service to ensure customers’ needs are met;
  • Enhance bank-customer relationships by expanding existing customers’ portfolio holdings;
  • Actively participate in Priority Banking / other Bank’s marketing and promotional activities to acquire NTB customers, as well as cross-selling to existing customers;
  • Proactively engage with Personal Clients hidden affluent and advise to approach bank with complex investment needs;
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
  • Ensure compliance of Management Manual, Operating Manuals and Bank’s laid down knowledge of the various products offered by all departments;
  • Learn and understand all relevant regulations and internal Risk & Compliance policies and procedures;
  • Keep updated on the events in the financial industry;
  • Participate actively in training programs, meetings, briefings organized by the bank and ensure skills & knowledge acquired is applied to daily work;
  • Ensure timeliness & managing customer’s complaint;

主要工作职责/挑战：

  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。
  • 实现领导安排的各个产品的业绩指标；
  • 维护与客户的关系并提供卓越的客户服务以确保满足客户需求；
  • 通过扩大现有客户的投资组合加强客户与我行的关系；
  • 积极参与优先理财/其它银行营销项目，以获取新客户。另外，向现有客户进行交叉销售；
  • 主动发现具有“优先理财”资质的个人理财客户, 并发掘其投资理财需求；
  • 负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
  • 遵循银行的管理手册，操作手册和所有部门相关产品的既定政策；
  • 学习并了解一切相关条例以及内部风险与合规的政策与程序；
  • 保持对金融行业相关动向的敏感；
  • 积极参与银行组织的培训项目，会议和简报会，并保证将学习到的技能和知识运用到日常工作中；
  • 确保客户投诉的时效与管理；

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Financial skills
  • Analytical skills

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • Full time Bachelor’s degree, or AMAC Fund Qualification Certificate Holder.
  • 1 year or above working experience in financial industry, acting in good faith and professional ethics. Have a good command of knowledge about wealth management sales activities related regulations
  • Sound knowledge of financial products and services and banking procedures, equities markets, unit trusts and other personal investment services are preferred.
  • Good investment counseling and analytical skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to deal with all levels of people, often in complex and difficult situations.
  • Team player who shows initiative and assertiveness.
  • Self-motivator who is keen to upgrade, improve personal knowledge and skills to meet job requirements.
  • Good command of both spoken and written English and Mandarin

职位要求：

  • 全日制大学本科学历，或持有基金从业资格证书。
  • 从事金融工作1年以上，具备良好的诚信记录及职业操守
  • 熟悉理财业务活动及理财产品销售相关的法律法规
  • 熟悉银行产品、服务、银行程序、股票市场、单位信托以及其它个人投资服务。
  • 具备良好的投资咨询和分析技巧。
  • 出色的人际关系能力和沟通能力，能在复杂场合应付自如。
  • 具有团队意识，主动坚定。
  • 有上进心，能自我激励，不断提高人际交流能力和技巧，以满足工作要求。

Other then above roles, job holder should follow other job duties and responsibilities assigned by line manager from time to time.

除上述工作职责外，员工应遵循直属经理随时指派的任何工作职责和任务。

Above key responsibilities and selection criteria are the major assessment to assess the staff if qualified during probation and competent after probation. Failing to satisfy any of the aforesaid requirements, or failing to pass the CPBB Essentialsor WM Introduction Certification, the employee will be deemed not meeting the recruitment requirement for passing probation, and the Bank is entitled to terminate the employee’s employment contract immediately. For employee which have passed the probation, failing to pass the CPBB Essentials or WM Introduction Certification will be taken as assessment basis for job incompetency.

以上的主要工作职责和岗位聘任要求是用于考核试用期是否符合录用条件和工作胜任与否的标准。倘若员工未能满足前述要求，或未能通过CPBB Essentials测试或理财产品介绍资格认证测试的，则该员工将被视为不符合试用期的录用条件，银行有权立即终止员工的劳动合同；对于已过试用期的员工，未能通过CPBB Essential测试或理财产品介绍资格认证测试的，将作为不胜任工作工作岗位的考核依据。

Before attend and pass the CPBB Essentials and WM Introduction Certification course, the employee should not perform any kind of business communication / engagement to customers.

对于还没有参与并通过CPBB Essential入职培训或理财产品介绍资格认证测试的员工, 禁止跟客户有任何业务上的交流。

Please note that the job description above will be reviewed during the Job Objective setting every year, which may be amended and agreed where necessary by the employee and the line manager.

请注意以上本工作描述将于每年制定年度工作目标时予以审核，如有必要将由直属经理和员工予以修订并达成一致。

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do

Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits

A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Key Accountabilities

  • Achieving the goal being set-up including client prospecting, marketing plan, new client acquisition and revenues generating

ln:4487759399.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business: Digital Platforms

Principal Responsibilities

Applied AI for Engineering Productivity (Design/Coding/Testing)

  • Identify high-impact opportunities to use AI to improve mobile engineering outcomes across design, coding, testing, release readiness, and incident response.
  • Build and operationalise AI-assisted workflows for engineers (e.g., code generation and refactoring support, test case generation, defect triage, documentation automation, release note drafting), ensuring strong governance and quality controls.
  • Develop AI-powered accelerators and reusable components (e.g., prompt patterns, evaluators, automation scripts, agentic workflows) that teams can adopt with minimal friction.
  • Establish practical guidance for “how we use AI here” for common engineering tasks—balancing speed with correctness, security, and maintainability.

Data Engineering & Mobile Data Products

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines and curated datasets using mobile-related data sources such as: app telemetry, crash logs, performance metrics, network traces, CI/CD signals, test execution, feature usage analytics, customer journeys, and support/incident data.
  • Define data models that enable consistent, trusted reporting and AI use cases (e.g., quality and stability KPIs, release health, funnel analysis, defect leakage, performance regression tracking).
  • Implement data quality checks, lineage, monitoring, and documentation so stakeholders can trust and reuse the data confidently.
  • Collaborate with security and risk partners to ensure compliant data handling, access controls, and responsible use of customer and operational data.

Dashboards & Decision Intelligence (Data-Driven Mobile)

  • Build dashboards and decision tools that make excellent use of mobile-related data—turning metrics into insights and insights into actions.
  • Create “single pane of glass” views for mobile engineering health (stability, performance, delivery, quality, customer impact), with clear definitions and drill-down paths.
  • Enable proactive management through leading indicators and alerting (e.g., early detection of regressions, risk signals before release, anomaly detection in crash/performance patterns).
  • Partner with mobile leadership to define KPIs that matter, establish targets, and drive measurable improvement over time.

AI Evangelism & Engineering Community Enablement

  • Evangelise practical AI usage across the engineering community: run enablement sessions, publish playbooks, demo reusable patterns, and mentor teams to adopt AI safely and effectively.
  • Build a culture of experimentation with discipline—encouraging rapid learning while maintaining engineering standards and auditability.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to squads: helping them select tools, structure workflows, evaluate outputs, and avoid common AI pitfalls (hallucinations, overconfidence, data leakage, bias).
  • Create internal documentation, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides to accelerate adoption and reduce repeated effort.

AI-Native Operating Model Support (Partnering with Mobile CTO)

  • Support the Mobile CTO in shaping an AI-native engineering strategy: identifying the right problems to solve, prioritising investments, and tracking value delivered.
  • Define lightweight governance that enables innovation while ensuring safe use (e.g., model/tool selection guidance, prompt/data handling standards, evaluation practices, human-in-the-loop controls).
  • Establish measurement frameworks to quantify impact: cycle time reduction, defect reduction, test coverage improvements, incident reduction, customer experience improvements, and cost efficiency.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure AI adoption aligns with architecture, security, compliance, and broader technology strategy.

Requirements

Essential

  • Proven ability to use AI effectively to solve real engineering problems (design, coding, testing, analysis, automation), with a pragmatic and outcomes-focused mindset.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, including diagnosing ambiguous issues and translating them into data/AI solutions that ship.
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), able to influence and enable engineers and leaders across teams.
  • Strong experience building production-grade data pipelines and datasets, with attention to reliability, observability, and data quality.
  • Proven ability to build dashboards/analytics products that drive action, not just reporting.
  • Strong understanding of secure data handling and engineering practices appropriate for a regulated environment.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating across product, engineering, and risk/security stakeholders.

Strong Technical Skills (AI/Data Engineering)

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data engineering and applied AI workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling (e.g., LLMs and prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation concepts, evaluation techniques, agentic/automation workflows), and the discipline to validate outputs.
  • Experience with analytics and visualisation tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or equivalent) and designing metrics that are well-defined and trustworthy.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and developer toolchains, and ability to integrate data/AI into engineering workflows (e.g., Git-based pipelines, test systems, build tooling).
  • Understanding of experimentation and measurement (A/B testing concepts, KPI definition, causal thinking, guardrails).

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

- Create “single pane of glass” views for mobile engineering health (stability, performance, delivery, quality, customer impact), with clear definitions and drill-down paths.
- Enable proactive management through leading indicators and alerting (e.g., early detection of regressions, risk signals before release, anomaly detection in crash/performance patterns).

Essential
- Proven ability to use AI effectively to solve real engineering problems (design, coding, testing, analysis, automation), with a pragmatic and outcomes-focused mindset.

- Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), able to influence and enable engineers and leaders across teams.
- Strong experience building production-grade data pipelines and datasets, with attention to reliability, observability, and data quality.
- Proven ability to build dashboards/analytics products that drive action, not just reporting.
- Strong understanding of secure data handling and engineering practices appropriate for a regulated environment.
- Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating across product, engineering, and risk/security stakeholders.

Business: SecSvcs & Digital Assets Tech

Job ID: 66089

Principal Responsibilities

  • Drive a proactive risk culture, shifting focus from remediation to prevention through thematic reviews and departmental training.
  • Support the departmental external Assurance obligations, including ISAE 3402.
  • Consult on projects, providing subject matter expertise during audits
  • Share best practise with the CIB Risk and Control Organisation
  • Provide training sessions for key staff to uplift risk awareness
  • Provide guidance and help to delivery teams in regards to security solutions to enable faster delivery of Systems
  • Collaborating with project teams working closely in a DevOps and agile development processes
  • Partner with the CIB business areas and Risk Functions to promote and provide guidance to relevant policies, standards and governance within CIB
  • Provide regional stakeholder updates with respect to Control uplift programs
  • Support engagement with internal / external / client audit and Regulatory Exams, including oversight of field work, collation of artefacts and partnership with CCO to remediate issues
  • Attend relevant regional governance forums and where applicable provide appropriate MI
  • Communicate residual risk through reporting, business governance processes and forums
  • Own the risk & control agenda for region
  • Lead the delivery of risk & control projects and programmes for the region
  • Assist service/project owners in responding appropriately and effectively to firm-wide risk, cyber and corporate control initiatives
  • Partner with service owners and Asset Class RCOs to identify and assess controls, determine mitigating actions and remediation activities, and understand the overall risk profile
  • Advocate and support initiatives to improve accuracy across all Enterprise Golden Source data repositories
  • Provide visibility of status of action plans and external/internal audit issues
  • Drive ownership and accountability for Risk Issue and Action Plan Ownership within region
  • Challenge where appropriate, decisions made on control implementation
  • Review allocation of issues to SSV sectors and agree categorization of high/medium/low
  • Approve the raising and closure of regional IT issues, action plans, but look to automate process
  • Fulfil DBIRO responsibilities for the region
  • Advocate security policies and standards to the respective region
  • Integrate into the development process, attending scrums and owning security use cases and stories
  • Support initial risk assessment process and providing consultancy and guidance
  • Support where necessary key CIB security uplift initiatives
  • Contribute to review of security standards and procedures

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Proven experience in technology risk and controls within a complex, regulated environment.
  • Strong background in third party risk management, including oversight of internal service agreements and associated controls/monitoring.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and influence stakeholders up to executive level.
  • Extensive client-facing experience, including due diligence, assurance, and audit activities.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex risk topics to diverse audiences.
  • Experience acting as a deputy or second-in-command within a risk, assurance, or due diligence function is highly desirable.
  • Influencing skills.
  • Stakeholder management.
  • General interest in Technology including awareness of trends.

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Consult on projects, providing subject matter expertise during audits and regulatory exams.
  • Share best practices with the wider Risk and Control Organisation.
  • Support engagement with internal/external/client audit and regulatory exams, including oversight of fieldwork and remediation.
  • Advocate for continuous improvement in data accuracy and control effectiveness across all enterprise data repositories.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
  • Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
  • Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
  • Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
  • Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
  • Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
  • Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
  • Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
  • Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
  • Fluency in Mandarin and English

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

Business: Fin, Supervision and TR Tech

Job ID: 66095

Principal Responsibilities

  • Modern engineering & platform transformation
  • Continuously improve stability, scalability, and operability (SRE-style focus).
  • Align the application with CCR FSA standards and engineering guardrails.
  • Adopt and embed advanced engineering practices across the pod (quality, automation, secure-by-design).
  • Full delivery lifecycle ownership
  • Implement solutions end-to-end: impact assessment, performance tuning, testing, deployment.
  • Move fluidly between development, testing, and production support based on demand.
  • Reduce operational pain (TOIL reduction) via automation and better diagnostics.
  • DevSecOps and controls
  • Improve OKRs such as release cadence, incident reduction, and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with IT risk and controls (including secure configuration, auditability, change discipline).
  • Engineering leadership & collaboration
  • Lead/guide developers where needed; drive consistent standards across the team.
  • Operate effectively in a global, distributed environment with strong spoken English.
  • Performance tuning basics (indexes, query plans, connection pooling, latency analysis)
  • Ways of working
  • Strong problem-solving under pressure, good documentation habits, and delivery against multiple deadlines
  • Ability to lead developers and land “meaningful changes” that improve business outcomes sustainably

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

Java (Spring / Spring Boot / Spring Cloud)

RESTful API design and implementation

Linux/UNIX + shell scripting for diagnostics/automation

Container & CI/CD ecosystem

  • Docker + Kubernetes
  • Jenkins, GitHub, Ansible and CI/CD patterns (build, test, deploy, rollback)

Observability / reliability tooling

  • Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, Tempo
  • Practical ability to define SLIs/SLOs, dashboards, alerts, tracing strategies, and to use these in incident resolution

Data

  • Oracle (or equivalent enterprise RDBMS) and PostgreSQL
  • Performance tuning basics (indexes, query plans, connection pooling, latency analysis)

Ways of working

  • Strong problem-solving under pressure, good documentation habits, and delivery against multiple deadlines
  • Ability to lead developers and land “meaningful changes” that improve business outcomes sustainably

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • HSBC ITSO experience (controls, governance, risk awareness in delivery)
  • Investment banking / CCR domain familiarity
  • Architecture experience (especially microservices, gRPC, cloud-native patterns)
  • GCP/AWS experience or certifications
  • Python/Jupyter (often useful for analysis, tooling, automation)
  • Evidence of engineering community contribution (open source, GitHub, blogs)

汇丰保险经纪业务成立于2022年，作为我们在中国内地保险和财富产品分销的经纪渠道。作为汇丰集团的一部分，我们在中国内地致力于通过财富规划服务业务助力人们提高抵御风险能力、为他们自己及其亲人提供保障，实现他们的人生目标。

汇丰保险经纪为“汇丰财富规划服务”客户提供财富规划以及保险经纪服务，是国内首家持有保险经纪和基金销售双牌照的财富管理机构, 帮助客户实现资产多元化布局，也是汇丰集团100%全资持有的子公司，为不同类型的客户提供相关保障计划及财富配置服务。

汇丰财富规划服务作为汇丰全球重点战略项目之一，以客户的需求为中心，提供更灵活的财富配置体验，

通过创新数字解决方案，在客户指定的时间、地点，一对一量身定制资产配置方案。基于您人生不同阶段需求, 我们通过财富规划：

  • 厘清客户需求，搭建财富金字塔
  • 匹配保障性底层资产：精选保险产品，带来健康保障，规划传承
  • 代销优质基金产品*，多元配置资产
  • 产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型等；

工作职责

主要工作包括：

  • 拓展与服务于高净值个人客户，运用财富规划理念及数字工具，为高净值客户提供专业全面、量身打造的投资及保险保障等资产配置服务，包括但不限于保障、投资、子女教育、退休计划等；
  • 代理销售精选优质基金产品，产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型；为客户提供精选优质代销基金产品，带来高品质投资产品。
  • 通过高质量服务，为客户一对一量身定制财富规划，不断提高客户口碑推荐；
  • 确保个人与团队活动遵守相关法律法规的要求，且符合汇丰的标准和规程。

任职要求

  • 本科或以上学历，财务、商业等或相关专业为佳
  • 8年及以上金融销售和财富管理行业者
  • 善于沟通，较强的人际交往能力及表达能力
  • 积极进取，有自律意识，目标导向、能高效和独立地工作
  • 渴望学习和成长、有事业心，具备创业精神及商业思维及抗压能力
  • 具备较强的中文口头及书面沟通能力
  • 具有基金从业资格、国际金融理财师（CFP）或相关证书（AFP，EFP，CFA等）者优先考虑

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Company relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Insurance Brokerage Company Limited

汇丰保险经纪为“汇丰财富规划服务”客户提供财富规划以及保险经纪服务，是国内首家持有保险经纪和基金销售双牌照的财富管理机构, 帮助客户实现资产多元化布局，也是汇丰集团100%全资持有的子公司，为不同类型的客户提供相关保障计划及财富配置服务。

汇丰财富规划服务作为汇丰全球重点战略项目之一，以客户的需求为中心，提供更灵活的财富配置体验，

通过创新数字解决方案，在客户指定的时间、地点，一对一量身定制资产配置方案。基于您人生不同阶段需求, 我们通过财富规划：

  • 厘清客户需求，搭建财富金字塔
  • 匹配保障性底层资产：精选保险产品，带来健康保障，规划传承
  • 代销优质基金产品*，多元配置资产
  • 产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型等；

工作职责

主要工作包括：

  • 拓展与服务于高净值个人客户，运用财富规划理念及数字工具，为高净值客户提供专业全面、量身打造的投资及保险保障等资产配置服务，包括但不限于保障、投资、子女教育、退休计划等；
  • 代理销售精选优质基金产品，产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型；为客户提供精选优质代销基金产品，带来高品质投资产品。
  • 通过高质量服务，为客户一对一量身定制财富规划，不断提高客户口碑推荐；
  • 确保个人与团队活动遵守相关法律法规的要求，且符合汇丰的标准和规程。

任职要求

  • 本科或以上学历，财务、商业等或相关专业为佳
  • 5-8年及以上金融销售和财富管理行业者
  • 善于沟通，较强的人际交往能力及表达能力
  • 积极进取，有自律意识，目标导向、能高效和独立地工作
  • 渴望学习和成长、有事业心，具备创业精神及商业思维及抗压能力
  • 具备较强的中文口头及书面沟通能力
  • 具有基金从业资格、国际金融理财师（CFP）或相关证书（AFP，EFP，CFA等）者优先考虑

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Company relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Insurance Brokerage Company Limited

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Data Engineering Intern .

Business: Chief AI Office

Principal Responsibilities

  • Review relevant literature and emerging approaches in event extraction, knowledge graphs, and event-enhanced financial analytics;
  • Support prototype development for event representation, event-to-product exposure scoring, and reverse lookup from events to potentially affected customers;
  • Explore methods for connecting events to financial products and customer portfolios;
  • Design and run experiments using synthetic customer profiles, event references, and consistency checks to validate proposed methods;
  • Document findings, technical approaches, and evaluation results for project review;
  • Collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and business stakeholders to iterate on methods and prototypes.

Requirements

  • Current student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Financial Engineering, Economics, or related fields;
  • Strong interest in NLP, machine learning, knowledge graphs, event analytics, or financial intelligence;
  • Familiarity with Python and common data analysis libraries; SQL experience preferred;
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus:
    • Event extraction / topic detection / text mining
    • Knowledge graph construction and querying
    • Graph analytics / graph neural networks
    • Financial text analysis / product exposure analysis
    • ML model development and evaluation
  • Good analytical thinking, research capability, and communication skills;
  • Ability to work in a team and contribute to project execution.

ln:4486705326.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • The Head of FX Trade Processing Technology is accountable for the end-to-end technology strategy, investment planning, platform governance and delivery of the FX Trade Processing capability across Financial Markets. The role provides senior leadership for engineering, resilience, controls, AI innovation and organisational effectiveness across a globally distributed technology organisation, ensuring platforms support business growth, operational excellence and regulatory compliance.
  • The role leads a critical portfolio of FX trade processing platforms covering booking, validation, enrichment, workflow orchestration, lifecycle event processing, ensuring timely, accurate and resilient processing across the FX trade lifecycle.
  • The role provides senior technology and engineering leadership across a globally distributed organisation, partnering closely with Markets business, Operations, Product, Risk and Infrastructure teams to ensure technology platforms support business growth, operational efficiency, platform resilience and regulatory compliance.
  • As a member of the Trade Capture & Lifecycle Technology leadership team, the role balances strategic transformation with platform stability, driving modernisation, simplification, engineering excellence across the FX technology estate.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Own the end-to-end FX Trade Processing technology capability and target architecture, ensuring consistent platform strategy, engineering standards and delivery execution across all constituent applications and services.
  • Define and own the technology strategy and roadmap for FX Trade Processing Technology, aligning investment decisions with business priorities, regulatory requirements and platform health objectives.
  • Lead the evolution of FX trade processing capabilities, including trade capture, validation, enrichment, workflow orchestration, state management and lifecycle event processing.
  • Drive platform simplification and convergence, reducing duplicate capabilities, technical complexity and operational risk across the FX estate.
  • Establish target architectures and modernisation roadmaps that improve scalability, resiliency, maintainability and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure platforms support future business growth, product expansion and increased automation.
  • Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning

Technology & Engineering

Trade Capture & Lifecycle Event Management

  • Lead platforms supporting FX trade booking, validation, enrichment and trade state management.
  • Ensure accurate, scalable and resilient processing of FX transactions across the trade lifecycle.
  • Drive reduction of manual intervention, operational exceptions and processing breaks through automation and platform improvements.
  • Ensure lifecycle events are accurately generated, orchestrated and propagated across downstream platforms.
  • Maintain trade state integrity, risk consistency and data quality throughout the lifecycle process.
  • Improve event processing efficiency, transparency and traceability.

AI & Innovation

  • Lead the adoption of AI-enabled software engineering, platform operations and production support practices across FX Trade Processing Technology, delivering measurable improvements in engineering productivity, software quality, resiliency and operational efficiency.
  • Act as the senior technology lead for AI innovation within the FX processing domain, identifying opportunities to apply AI to trade processing workflows, exception management, controls, observability and operational decision-making. Drive automation opportunities across development, testing, support and operational workflows.
  • Ensure responsible adoption of AI technologies through appropriate governance, security, model risk controls, observability and regulatory compliance standards.
  • Support broader Markets Technology AI initiatives and contribute to enterprise engineering standards and best practices.

Business Leadership

  • Act as the primary technology partner for FX business, Operations and Product stakeholders.
  • Translate business strategy into technology outcomes and prioritised delivery roadmaps.
  • Influence investment decisions by balancing business value, platform health, regulatory commitments and risk reduction.
  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Markets, Operations, Risk, Finance and Architecture teams.

Delivery & Execution

  • Lead delivery of strategic programmes, regulatory change, control remediation and platform modernisation initiatives.
  • Ensure engineering teams execute with strong Agile, DevOps and software engineering disciplines.
  • Establish measurable outcomes around platform availability, processing efficiency, defect reduction and delivery performance.
  • Drive adoption of standard engineering practices, automation and reusable platform services.

Executive Governance Authority

  • Act as the accountable executive for material platform investment, architecture, resilience and control decisions within the FX Trade Processing estate, balancing business growth, risk appetite, regulatory obligations and engineering sustainability.
  • Provide executive representation for FX Trade Processing Technology at investment, governance, architecture, audit and regulatory forums.

Financial Accountability

  • Accountable for technology investment, workforce planning, vendor spend and overall cost efficiency across the FX Trade Processing estate, ensuring resources are aligned to strategic priorities and regulatory obligations.
  • Drive productivity and cost optimisation through platform simplification, automation, cloud adoption and AI-enabled engineering practices.

Risk & Controls

  • Maintain strong oversight of operational, technology and regulatory risks across the FX estate.
  • Ensure timely identification, escalation and remediation of control weaknesses and service risks.
  • Embed risk management considerations into platform design, delivery and operational processes.
  • Partner with audit, compliance and control functions to maintain an effective control environment.

People and Talent

  • Lead and develop a globally distributed organisation of engineering, platform and delivery professionals.
  • Build high-performing teams with strong technical expertise, domain knowledge and engineering discipline.
  • Develop future leaders and establish robust succession plans across critical technology functions.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Champion engineering excellence, DevOps adoption, AI-enabled delivery and platform ownership.

 

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Software Product Business Knowledge
  • Software Development
  • Leadership
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Develop Talent
  • Drives Vision and Purpose

Other Skills

  • AI

Motivations

The ideal candidate is motivated by the opportunity to shape the future of FX Trade Processing Technology and deliver strategic outcomes at enterprise scale. They are energised by owning business-critical platforms, influencing technology direction, and leading large-scale transformation that improves business performance, operational resilience and control effectiveness.

They Are Driven By

  • Building market-leading technology capabilities that directly enable business growth, client outcomes and competitive advantage.
  • Leading complex transformation journeys that simplify technology landscapes, modernise platforms and create sustainable long-term value.
  • Solving large-scale operational, processing and control challenges where technology can materially improve efficiency, risk management and resilience.
  • Influencing senior business and technology stakeholders to align strategic priorities, investments and execution outcomes.
  • Creating high-performing engineering organisations with a strong culture of accountability, innovation, continuous improvement and engineering excellence.
  • Developing future leaders and building enduring organisational capability that extends beyond individual platforms or programmes.
  • Delivering measurable outcomes through platform industrialisation, automation, AI adoption and operational simplification.
  • Operating at the intersection of business strategy, technology innovation and execution excellence, turning ambitious objectives into tangible results.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Extensive experience in Markets Technology with strong knowledge of FX trading and post-trade processing.
  • Proven leadership of large-scale engineering teams and mission-critical technology platforms.
  • Strong understanding of trade processing, lifecycle management and regulatory expectations.
  • Experience leading technology transformation, platform modernisation.
  • Demonstrated success delivering strategic change while maintaining operational stability.
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

Certifications / Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

Languages

  • English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

- Drive platform simplification and convergence, reducing duplicate capabilities, technical complexity and operational risk across the FX estate.
- Establish target architectures and modernisation roadmaps that improve scalability, resiliency, maintainability and cost efficiency.
- Ensure platforms support future business growth, product expansion and increased automation.
- Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning
Technology & Engineering
Trade Capture & Lifecycle Event Management
- Lead platforms supporting FX trade booking, validation, enrichment and trade state management.
- Ensure accurate, scalable and resilient processing of FX transactions across the trade lifecycle.
- Drive reduction of manual intervention, operational exceptions and processing breaks through automation and platform improvements.
- Ensure lifecycle events are accurately generated, orchestrated and propagated across downstream platforms.
- Maintain trade state integrity, risk consistency and data quality throughout the lifecycle process.
- Improve event processing efficiency, transparency and traceability.
AI & Innovation
- Lead the adoption of AI-enabled software engineering, platform operations and production support practices across FX Trade Processing Technology, delivering measurable improvements in engineering productivity, software quality, resiliency and operational efficiency.
- Act as the senior technology lead for AI innovation within the FX processing domain, identifying opportunities to apply AI to trade processing workflows, exception management, controls, observability and operational decision-making. Drive automation opportunities across development, testing, support and operational workflows.
- Ensure responsible adoption of AI technologies through appropriate governance, security, model risk controls, observability and regulatory compliance standards.
- Support broader Markets Technology AI initiatives and contribute to enterprise engineering standards and best practices.
Business Leadership
- Act as the primary technology partner for FX business, Operations and Product stakeholders.
- Translate business strategy into technology outcomes and prioritised delivery roadmaps.
- Influence investment decisions by balancing business value, platform health, regulatory commitments and risk reduction.
- Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Markets, Operations, Risk, Finance and Architecture teams.
Delivery & Execution
- Lead delivery of strategic programmes, regulatory change, control remediation and platform modernisation initiatives.
- Ensure engineering teams execute with strong Agile, DevOps and software engineering disciplines.
- Establish measurable outcomes around platform availability, processing efficiency, defect reduction and delivery performance.
- Drive adoption of standard engineering practices, automation and reusable platform services.
Executive Governance Authority
- Act as the accountable executive for material platform investment, architecture, resilience and control decisions within the FX Trade Processing estate, balancing business growth, risk appetite, regulatory obligations and engineering sustainability.
- Provide executive representation for FX Trade Processing Technology at investment, governance, architecture, audit and regulatory forums.
Financial Accountability
- Accountable for technology investment, workforce planning, vendor spend and overall cost efficiency across the FX Trade Processing estate, ensuring resources are aligned to strategic priorities and regulatory obligations.
- Drive productivity and cost optimisation through platform simplification, automation, cloud adoption and AI-enabled engineering practices.
Risk & Controls
- Maintain strong oversight of operational, technology and regulatory risks across the FX estate.
- Ensure timely identification, escalation and remediation of control weaknesses and service risks.
- Embed risk management considerations into platform design, delivery and operational processes.
- Partner with audit, compliance and control functions to maintain an effective control environment.
People and Talent
- Lead and develop a globally distributed organisation of engineering, platform and delivery professionals.
- Build high-performing teams with strong technical expertise, domain knowledge and engineering discipline.
- Develop future leaders and establish robust succession plans across critical technology functions.
- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
- Champion engineering excellence, DevOps adoption, AI-enabled delivery and platform ownership.
Skills And Experience
Must-have Skills
- Software Product Business Knowledge
- Software Development
- Leadership
- Stakeholder Management
- Develop Talent
- Drives Vision and Purpose
Other Skills
- AI
Motivations
The ideal candidate is motivated by the opportunity to shape the future of FX Trade Processing Technology and deliver strategic outcomes at enterprise scale. They are energised by owning business-critical platforms, influencing technology direction, and leading large-scale transformation that improves business performance, operational resilience and control effectiveness.
They Are Driven By
- Building market-leading technology capabilities that directly enable business growth, client outcomes and competitive advantage.
- Leading complex transformation journeys that simplify technology landscapes, modernise platforms and create sustainable long-term value.
- Solving large-scale operational, processing and control challenges where technology can materially improve efficiency, risk management and resilience.
- Influencing senior business and technology stakeholders to align strategic priorities, investments and execution outcomes.
- Creating high-performing engineering organisations with a strong culture of accountability, innovation, continuous improvement and engineering excellence.
- Developing future leaders and building enduring organisational capability that extends beyond individual platforms or programmes.
- Delivering measurable outcomes through platform industrialisation, automation, AI adoption and operational simplification.
- Operating at the intersection of business strategy, technology innovation and execution excellence, turning ambitious objectives into tangible results.
Qualifications
Key Experiences
- Extensive experience in Markets Technology with strong knowledge of FX trading and post-trade processing.
- Proven leadership of large-scale engineering teams and mission-critical technology platforms.
- Strong understanding of trade processing, lifecycle management and regulatory expectations.
- Experience leading technology transformation, platform modernisation.
- Demonstrated success delivering strategic change while maintaining operational stability.
- Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
Certifications / Qualifications

Job Summary

  • Lead the global Trading Control & Supervision Technology organisation, owning technology capabilities that enable trade review, control assessment, exception management, supervisory oversight and operational risk management across Financial Markets.
  • Own the strategy, architecture and delivery roadmap for resilient, scalable and configurable control platforms, ensuring effective identification, assessment, management and supervision of trade processing risks and control exceptions across asset classes.
  • Drive the evolution of strategic Trading Control & Supervision capabilities, enabling greater automation, proactive risk detection, management transparency and control effectiveness across the trade lifecycle.
  • Lead platform modernisation, AI-enabled risk analytics, workflow automation, observability and data-driven supervision capabilities to reduce operational risk, improve control outcomes and strengthen regulatory readiness.
  • Provide senior engineering leadership across a global organisation, ensuring architecture, security, data, risk and operational design decisions translate into reliable, auditable and well-governed control outcomes.
  • Act as the senior technology partner for Markets COO, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Regulatory Programmes and Markets Technology leadership on control transformation, supervisory capabilities and control effectiveness strategy.

Key Responsibilities

The role holder leads others and is accountable for strategy, delivery outcomes, technology risk management, stakeholder alignment, investment prioritisation and organisational capability across the global Trading Control & Supervision Technology organisation.

Strategy and Transformation

  • Define and execute the multi-year Trading Control & Supervision technology strategy, aligned to Markets control objectives, operational resilience priorities, regulatory expectations and enterprise architecture standards.

End-to-End Capability Ownership

  • Own control assessment, trade review, exception management and supervisory technology capabilities end-to-end, with accountability for control effectiveness, workflow efficiency, data quality, traceability and auditability.

Platform Ownership and Business Outcomes

  • Lead resilient, standardised and scalable control platforms and services that improve operational transparency, risk identification, exception resolution effectiveness, supervisory oversight and management decision making.

Architecture and Platform Modernisation

  • Drive simplification and convergence of fragmented control tooling toward strategic enterprise control capabilities, reducing duplication, technical debt and operational complexity while improving agility and scalability.

Controls, Risk and Regulatory Readiness

  • Lead technology capabilities supporting trade review, control execution, exception detection, case management, workflow orchestration, escalation management and remediation tracking, ensuring consistent governance and accountability across Markets.

Risk Analytics, AI and Supervisory Intelligence

  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled supervision, intelligent exception analysis, predictive risk monitoring, control analytics and management insight capabilities to improve control effectiveness, accelerate root-cause identification and support proactive risk management.

Portfolio Governance and Investment Management

  • Strengthen control governance, data lineage, auditability, entitlement controls, evidencing capabilities and regulatory reporting support, ensuring platforms operate within the Bank's risk appetite and supervisory expectations.

Enterprise Leadership and Stakeholder Management

  • Influence senior stakeholders across Markets, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Architecture and Technology leadership to align strategic priorities, regulatory requirements and control transformation initiatives.

People and Talent

  • Lead a global engineering and product organisation with accountability for talent development, succession planning and organisational effectiveness, fostering a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Software Product Business Knowledge
  • Technology Strategy, Innovation and AI Enablement
  • Technology Platform and Engineering Leadership

Other Skills

  • People Leadership and Team Culture
  • Strategic Stakeholder and Portfolio Management
  • Operational Resilience and Service Management

Motivations

  • The ideal candidate is motivated by strengthening the safety, integrity and effectiveness of Financial Markets operations through technology-driven controls and supervision. They are energised by building strategic platforms that improve transparency, risk management and regulatory readiness at enterprise scale.
  • They thrive on solving complex control and operational risk challenges, influencing enterprise-wide governance outcomes, and delivering measurable improvements through data, automation, AI and modern engineering practices.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Extensive experience in Markets Technology with strong knowledge of trade control processing.
  • Proven leadership of large-scale engineering teams and mission-critical technology platforms.
  • Experience leading technology transformation, platform modernisation.
  • Demonstrated success delivering strategic change while maintaining operational stability.
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

Certifications / Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

Languages

  • English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Job Summary

  • Participate in sales promotions and activities to achieve/exceed defined sales targets;
  • Engage NTB Affluent clients via leads sourced from varies channels;
  • A well thought-through, creative approach to satisfy customers, improve competitive advantage and improve performance;
  • Actively cross-sell the bank other products / services and ensure annual financial budget is met;
  • To provide quality, efficient before and after sales services;
  • To prepare and consolidate accurate reports on sales activities;
  • Based on a “shared sense” of purpose and approach within CB;
  • Based on a clear division of roles (and no duplication of effort) within MD;
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Other Responsibilities

  • Understand, acknowledge, and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review

Skills And Experience

  • College/diploma degree or above;
  • 1 year working experience or above in financial or mortgage / real estate Industry is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in banking experience is preferred
  • Good knowledge of bank products, policies, and business strategy
  • Good credit appraisal and marketing skills with the ability to interpret financial information
  • Strong personal integrity with zero disciplinary record in any previous job
  • Good communication and presentation skills
  • Presentable, good personality with good business etiquette

Qualifications
