ln:4488150669.descriptionHtml:
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Supporting tasks to assist in maintaining and strengthening distribution channel relationships, whilst coordinating the relevant business initiatives.
  • Deliver one-on-one coaching to help relationship managers translate knowledge into practical skills, enhance insurance sales capabilities, and achieve sustained performance growth.
    • Train core competencies across the full sales process, implementing insurance sales competency development, including execution of phone appointments, in-depth KYC, case solution and closing.
    • Train and coach RM to how complete Policy Review and analyse Policy Review Reports to customers
    • Participate in customer events and training sessions, assist with pre-event preparations, provide on-site support, and conduct post-event evaluations and follow-ups.
  • Support relationship managers in analyzing and diagnosing client needs, designing tailored solutions, and preparing for client meetings. Enhance practical capabilities through role-play and rehearsals focused on solution presentation and deal closing.
  • Provide coaching on sales strategies for INSH proprietary products, building on the foundational training delivered by Business Development Managers. Help relationship managers improve practical product skills, including aligning product features with client needs and integrating relevant service resources.
  • Analyze market trends and competitor products to identify and articulate the core strengths of INSH products. Develop sales strategies aligned with client profiles, incorporating sales logic and applicable scenarios. Continuously refine strategies through case reviews to improve sales effectiveness
  • Deliver one-on-one coaching to help relationship managers translate knowledge into practical skills, assisting RM to complete pre-case/pre-meeting.
  • Supporting the development and execution of channel development plans and strategies, continuously optimizing existing cooperation models.
  • Collaborating with stakeholders, which may include relationship managers and product team, to maximise empowerment for distribution channels.
  • Assisting in execution of compliance review processes and due diligence to ensure all operations adhere to risk control requirement.
  • 协助建立并维护与分支行及相关业务部门的良好合作关系，确保合作顺畅及内部服务体验。
  • 负责提供一对一教练式的陪跑辅导，实现知识向技能转化，提升保险销售能力，以实现绩效持续稳定的增长。
    • 训练全销售流程的核心技能，实施保险销售能力养成，包含电话约访、深度KYC、解决方案呈现及成交等。
    • 培训并指导客户经理如何完成保单检视，并指导如何为客户分析保单检视报告。
    • 参与行所沙龙及内部培训等活动，配合做好活动前相关准备工作，提供现场赋能支持，并做好活动后的评估及。活动效果的跟进。
  • 协助客户经理完成客户需求分析与诊断，设计解决方案；并做好相应面谈准备，通过演练、预演递交解决方案及成交过程，提升客户经理的实战作业能力。
  • 负责产品强化训练辅导，针对INSH自有产品在由业务发展经理完成的销售资质培训基础上开展产品销售策略的训练辅导，帮助客户经理提升产品相关的实战能力，包含产品功能与客户需求的匹配分析，以及与产品功能相关的服务资源整合。
  • 负责市场及同业产品对比分析，通过分析提炼INSH产品核心优势，结合销售逻辑及应用场景，整理与客户概貌相匹配的产品销售策略，并通过典型案例复盘持续优化策略，提升销售有效性。
  • 支持制定并执行新业务拓展计划与策略，持续优化现有合作模式。
  • 与产品部门、客户经理及相关团队保持紧密协作，最大化赋能合作渠道。
  • 严格协助执行相关客户尽职调查及合规审查工作，做好风险控制。
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Reasonable experience in sales force (5 years )
  • Possess board-based knowledge of the Insurance business and China practices
  • Good influential skills – able to influence people of different cultures and backgrounds
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and Chinese. Must be able to communicate effectively in Putonghua.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills – excellent customer relationship management
  • Able to lead, inspire, motivate and develop the teams to deliver business performance and a team player.
  • 具备5年以上销售或业务相关工作经验，有银行渠道或金融机构合作经验者优先
  • 熟悉保险业务及金融产品，了解国内银行渠道业务模式及监管要求
  • 具备良好的沟通协调能力及影响力，能够与不同层级的银行人员建立有效合作
  • 中英文口头与书面沟通能力优秀，必须能流利使用普通话进行商务沟通
  • 具备较强的客户服务意识及关系维护能力，能妥善处理渠道合作中的各项事务
  • 具备团队协作精神，能配合内部团队共同推动业务发展，达成整体目标

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Company relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Life Insurance Company Limited

ln:4488164131.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

Business: Equities & X Asset Fin Tech

Job ID: 66243

Principal Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with business users provide high quality requirements with proper DoR & DoD (DoR should include proper business flow scenarios).
  • Collaborate with dev team and deeply engage in the SDLC, especially in pre-dev stage to justify requirements to dev and post-dev stage to identify test results for business delivery.
  • Analyse end-to-end customer journeys, business processes and system flows covering domestic, international, and real-time price calculation for repo business.
  • Facilitate workshops and align stakeholders across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance in different markets and locations.
  • Understand the automation test framework and could support dev team to verify the automation test results and provide feedback. Could also verify the manual test results.
  • Take responsibility for business delivery sign off
  • Take responsibility for post release issue identification, could provide business justification for dev team’s trouble shooting
  • Could work on different time zone to adopt the business team’s working time (Could switch daily working time period)

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Get positive feedback from business team to support their requirements
  • Get positive feedback from tech team to support their delivery to business team
  • Build good knowledge in the tech team to better support business delivery with good documentation as assets
  • Take ownership of project delivery
  • Take ownership of knowledge gap resolution

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Strong Capital Market business knowledge is MUST
  • Professional English Communication is MUST
  • Full comprehension of SDLC is MUST
  • Agile model development process experience is MUST
  • Professional documentation of business requirement is MUST
  • CCBA/CBAP/CFA certification is PLUS++
  • Agile or SAFe certification is PLUS
  • English Communication (IELTS / TOEFL / Cambridge English / PTE with high score) is PLUS
  • Hands-on experience of DoR/DoD is PLUS
  • Hands-on experience of Automation test framework is PLUS
  • Hands-on experience of TDD/BDD/DDD/SDD is PLUS
  • Hands-on experience of AI agentic engineering is PLUS
  • Hands-on experience of coding is PLUS

ln:4488145798.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • To acquire customers through self-generated leads or all channel/resources to expand the customer base.
  • To acquire HML drawdown targets in accordance with the FRP plan.
  • To deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets.
  • As a branch level role, the position also requires to take the branch duties if requires.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Over 3 years of experiences in the HML business.
  • Full knowledge of relevant IWPB products, policies, regulations, and laws.
  • Good knowledge of local property market
  • Proven sales skills and channel development skills.

ln:4488148016.descriptionHtml:
Responsibility

JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Build clean historical datasets, and maintain point-in-time data to ensure that research uses information that was accurate and fully traceable.
  • Run backtests and statistical checks, and study how factor performance varies across market regimes.
  • Automate monthly signal production and suggest improvements to the process.
  • Develop HMM, regime-switching and reinforcement learning models where appropriate.
  • Build dashboards to keep track of data quality and strategy performance.
  • 构建干净的历史数据集，并维护时间点数据，以确保研究使用准确且完全可追溯的信息。
  • 运行回溯测试和统计检查，并研究因素表现如何因市场制度而异。
  • 实现每月信号产生的自动化，并提出流程改进建议。
  • 在适当的情况下，开发 HMM、体制转换和强化学习模型。
  • 构建仪表板以跟踪数据质量和战略绩效。

Requirement

  • Master's degree or PhD in machine learning, computer science, statistics or a related quantitative discipline. Specialization in reinforcement learning is highly desirable.
  • Experience in quantitative research, data science, or a related field (industry or academic).
  • Strong programming skills in Python; experience with machine learning libraries.
  • Quantitative Modeling: Familiarity with quantitative modeling, portfolio construction, and equity markets.
  • Data Handling: Experience working with large, complex, and alternative datasets.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to present complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and intellectual curiosity; ability to drive research projects independently.
  • 硕士学位或博士学位，机器学习、计算机科学、统计学或相关定量学科专业。
  • 具有定量研究、数据科学或相关领域（行业或学术）的工作经验。
  • 具有优秀的技术能力，在Python中拥有较强的编程技能并拥有机器学习库的经验。
  • 熟悉定量建模、投资组合构建和股票市场。
  • 拥有处理大型、复杂和替代数据集的经验。
  • 优秀的英文口头和书面沟通技巧，能够向技术和非技术受众提出复杂的想法。
  • 展现出在团队环境中有效工作的能力。
  • 强大的解决问题的技能和智力好奇心；独立推动研究项目的能力。

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

ln:4486979337.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Lead the global Securities & Secondary Loan Trade Processing Technology organisation, owning trade processing capabilities across securities, repo, financing and secondary loan products, including trade capture, lifecycle processing, settlement integration, asset servicing, financing events, controls, exception management and operational resilience.

  • Own the strategy, architecture and delivery roadmap for resilient, scalable and well-controlled trade processing platforms, ensuring accurate and timely processing from trade capture through settlement, servicing and lifecycle completion.
  • Drive platform modernisation, application simplification, AI-enabled engineering, automation, data quality improvement and observability to increase processing efficiency, reduce operational risk and improve platform resilience.
  • Lead the evolution of strategic securities and financing processing capabilities, enabling business growth, product expansion, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
  • Provide senior engineering leadership across a global organisation, ensuring architecture, security, data, risk and operational design decisions translate into accurate, scalable and well-governed business outcomes.
  • Act as the senior technology partner for Markets Product, Markets COO, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Architecture and Markets Technology leadership on securities and financing processing strategy, transformation and service performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • The role holder leads others and is accountable for strategy, delivery outcomes, technology risk management, investment prioritisation, stakeholder alignment and organisational capability across the global Securities & Secondary Loan Trade Processing Technology organisation.

Strategy and Transformation

  • Define and execute the multi-year Securities & Secondary Loan Trade Processing technology strategy, aligned to Markets priorities, enterprise architecture standards, regulatory obligations and business growth objectives.

End-to-End Capability Ownership

  • Own securities and secondary loan trade processing capabilities from trade capture and enrichment through settlement, financing lifecycle events, asset servicing, accounting integration, exception management and completion, with accountability for processing accuracy, timeliness and control effectiveness.

Platform Ownership and Business Outcomes

  • Lead resilient, standardised and scalable trade processing platforms and services, improving settlement efficiency, lifecycle processing effectiveness, control integrity, platform stability, service quality and business responsiveness.

Architecture and Platform Modernisation

  • Drive simplification of legacy application estates and convergence toward strategic trade processing capabilities, reducing fragmentation, technical debt and operational complexity while improving agility and long-term sustainability.

Controls, Risk and Regulatory Readiness

  • Strengthen processing controls, reconciliation, data quality, auditability, entitlement governance, observability and cyber resilience, ensuring platforms operate within regulatory expectations and the Bank's risk appetite.

AI, Automation and Engineering Excellence

  • Lead adoption of AI-enabled engineering, intelligent automation, workflow technologies and observability capabilities to improve software quality, engineering productivity, operational efficiency and root-cause resolution effectiveness.

Portfolio Governance and Investment Management

  • Partner with Technology and Business leadership to prioritise investment, manage run and change spend, address platform risks and technical debt, and provide transparent executive reporting on delivery, resilience, regulatory and platform health outcomes.

Enterprise Leadership and Stakeholder Management

  • Influence senior stakeholders across Markets, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance and Architecture to align strategic priorities, investment decisions and transformational outcomes.

People and Talent

  • Lead a globally distributed engineering organisation spanning engineering, platform services, architecture and delivery leadership.
  • Build a high-performing, engineering-led culture focused on accountability, innovation, continuous improvement and business ownership.
  • Develop future leaders and establish strong succession pipelines across critical technology capabilities.
  • Champion AI-enabled software engineering, platform ownership, DevOps excellence and modern engineering practices.
  • Create an inclusive environment that attracts, develops and retains exceptional technical talent.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Software Product Business Knowledge
  • Technology Strategy, Innovation and AI Enablement
  • Technology Platform and Engineering Leadership

Other Skills

  • People Leadership and Team Culture
  • Strategic Stakeholder and Portfolio Management
  • Operational Resilience and Service Management

Motivations

  • The ideal candidate is motivated by building strategic platforms that safeguard the integrity of securities, financing and loan processing across Financial Markets. They are energised by leading complex transformation initiatives, modernising critical platforms and delivering measurable improvements in operational resilience, risk management and business outcomes.
  • They thrive on solving large-scale processing, settlement and servicing challenges, influencing enterprise-wide technology decisions and building high-performing engineering organisations that deliver lasting business value through innovation, automation and AI-enabled transformation.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Extensive experience in Markets Technology with strong knowledge of Securities & Loan trading and post-trade processing.
  • Proven leadership of large-scale engineering teams and mission-critical technology platforms.
  • Strong understanding of trade processing, lifecycle management and regulatory expectations.
  • Experience leading technology transformation, platform modernisation.
  • Demonstrated success delivering strategic change while maintaining operational stability.
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

Certifications / Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

Languages

  • English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

ln:4486989205.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java Full-stack Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in React, Java 17, frameworks like Spring Boot or Quarkus, and microservices architecture. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining backend services that are robust, scalable, and efficient.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy

Business

  • Design, develop, and maintain frontend services using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Front-end frameworks.
  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 17 and Spring Boot / Quarkus.
  • Implement microservices architecture to ensure scalability and maintainability.
  • Develop REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Integrate with databases using ORM frameworks and ensure efficient DB connectivity.
  • Develop and maintain messaging services using JMS and Solace.
  • Ensure seamless API connectivity using platforms such as Kong or Axway.
  • Manage project dependencies and build processes using Maven.
  • Collaborate with the team using Git for version control.
  • Containerize applications using Docker for consistent deployment.
  • Utilize Azure DevOps (ADO) for CI/CD pipelines and project management.
  • Deploy and manage applications on OpenShift and AWS.
  • Implement service virtualization for testing and development.
  • Write and maintain unit tests using JUnit.
  • Conduct integration testing to ensure seamless interaction between components.
  • Document APIs using Swagger.
  • Perform performance testing and scripting to ensure application efficiency using tools like JMeter.
  • Ensure adherence and continuous improvement of Agile practices, coaching and teaching new techniques to the team as needed to achieve optimum productivity.
  • Engage and collaborate with a wide group of technology teams from upstream TP systems, integration, modeling team, database administrators, messaging teams, and architecture.
  • Engage Code Analysis, Debugging Scenarios, Analytical Problem Solving, System Thinking, Practical Debugging and Log Analysis.

Processes

  • Challenge the “as is” way of working across delivery, governance, operational model/structure
  • Apply depth of analytical understanding of a variety of New Ways of Working such as problem solving, Extreme Programming, Behaviour Driven Development, DevOps,.
  • Understand what practice, tool or technique to apply given the environment and the situation is the challenge that you will need to demonstrate mastery in using a show/tell/do approach

People & Talent

  • Lead by example and build the appropriate culture and values.
  • As expert developer, you will coach other team members “on the job” and manage by influence, as you will not have any direct reports assigned to you.

Risk Management

  • Lead to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholders

  • Product Owners, Chief Product Owners

Skills And Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in frontend (React) and microservice API development using Java frameworks.
  • Experience in developing and deploying cloud-native applications, with a focus on Function as a Service (FaaS) and Dev-in-a-box solutions.
  • Strong skills in API integration with in-house and third-party vendor applications, including Trading Networks.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift container platforms.
  • Preferred experience in the banking domain.
  • Knowledge of Postgres or Oracle relational databases.
  • Proficient in Spring Boot and API development.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile Development (CI/CD, TDD/BDD, SCRUM, KanBan).
  • Minimum 10 years of software development experience.
  • Experience with advanced features and tools in the Atlassian software suite.
  • Passion for technology and a collaborative, consultative work environment.
  • Proven skills in coordination, staff management, and leadership with vendors and internal teams.
  • Strong knowledge of risk and regulatory delivery.
  • Comprehensive understanding of software design and development.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong analytical skills on Code Analysis, Debugging Scenarios, Analytical Problem Solving, Practical Debugging and Log Analysis

Qualifications

  • Willingness to work on both development and project management.
  • Contribute to the creation of standards and frameworks for the project.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Prepare architectural solutions documents and technical audits for the project.
  • Prepare high/low-level technical design documents.
  • Learn and understand relevant application functional and technical architecture for effective development.
  • Follow documented SDLC life cycle as per quality management standards.
  • Participate in requirement gathering and solution meetings.
  • Track overall development and project management.
  • Support developers with technical assistance and improve technical competency levels among team members.
  • Design modules based on technical specifications.
  • Implement best practices.
  • Languages: Fluent in spoken and written English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

- Challenge the “as is” way of working across delivery, governance, operational model/structure
- Apply depth of analytical understanding of a variety of New Ways of Working such as problem solving, Extreme Programming, Behaviour Driven Development, DevOps,.
- Understand what practice, tool or technique to apply given the environment and the situation is the challenge that you will need to demonstrate mastery in using a show/tell/do approach
- Lead by example and build the appropriate culture and values.
- As expert developer, you will coach other team members “on the job” and manage by influence, as you will not have any direct reports assigned to you.
Risk Management
- Lead to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles
- Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
- Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. - Strong skills in API integration with in-house and third-party vendor applications, including Trading Networks.
- Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift container platforms.
- Preferred experience in the banking domain.
- Knowledge of Postgres or Oracle relational databases.
- Proficient in Spring Boot and API development.
- Strong knowledge of Agile Development (CI/CD, TDD/BDD, SCRUM, KanBan).
- Minimum 10 years of software development experience.
- Experience with advanced features and tools in the Atlassian software suite.
- Passion for technology and a collaborative, consultative work environment.
- Proven skills in coordination, staff management, and leadership with vendors and internal teams.
- Strong knowledge of risk and regulatory delivery.
- Comprehensive understanding of software design and development.
- Excellent oral and written communication skills.
- Strong analytical skills on Code Analysis, Debugging Scenarios, Analytical Problem Solving, Practical Debugging and Log Analysis
Qualifications

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role

Business

  • Support service management and business in driving service performance in term of productivity, execution quality and process risk management
  • Find service improvement opportunity for better working efficiency and effectiveness

Processes

  • Ensure all required certifications are obtained per internal and external requirements
  • Acknowledge and follow bank job rotation policy/procedure that working location will be subject to detail arrangement on due with no objection
  • Embed client centric mind in daily operation as well as to maintain up best in class front-line service
  • Continue to advocate human banker and client centric service mindset in service staff for enriching internal and external customer experience
  • Achieve client satisfaction in daily services and operations
  • Build SCB a great place to work
  • Fully understand the importance of Consumer Rights Protection, prevent damage to consumers’ best interest
  • Implement regulatory requirements related to Consumer Rights Protection, ensure to complete relevant trainings
  • Always embed Consumer Rights Protection mindset when performing daily work

People & Talent

  • Actively participate in various training programs arranged by the bank and keep self-learning on the laid down procedures/manuals and local regulation
  • Actively participate in various campaigns related to service team and achieve the target
  • Develop multi-product knowledge and job skills to support different segments and sales channels
  • Complete new joiner training program if new to the position (new hire or internal transfer) base on bank policy, and pass all required assessment by training timeline

Risk Management

  • Perform bank required due diligence on daily base to ensure no exception in execution
  • Support Line Manager achieve good MCA rating in branch audit
  • Escalate for any exception detected or observed in daily work to minimize potential negative impact on the bank

Governance

  • Complete regulatory required reporting timely and accurately to ensure the report follows regulatory requirements with no exception
  • Adhere to bank Conduct Plan, and all control and assurance mechanisms to comply with all internal and external standards and policies in executions
  • Adhere to laws and regulations, internal risk (including FCC risks as anti-money laundry, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption), compliance policies and the Group Code of Conduct; well manage client complaints & CDD

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Country Conduct, Financial Crime and Compliance team, CPBB Ops & Onboarding Ops GBS teams, CPBB Product and Segment, CPBB Sales team, Business Risk Management team

Other Responsibilities

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies

  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities

跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；

  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank

审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；

  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections

对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；

  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review

配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Skills And Experience

  • Information Capture
  • Document Management
  • Operational Risk
  • Understanding Customer Needs

Qualifications

  • University degree preferably in Economics/Finance/Technology with 2-5 years related banking experience;
  • Be able to provide cross city onsite support upon bank request
  • Solid knowledge and experience in bank products and customer service;
  • Good understanding of banking and local regulations;
  • Good command of both written and spoken English/Mandarin;
  • Self-motivator who is keen to upgrade, improve, and develop;
  • Pleasant and cooperative personality, initiative, hardworking, and able to work independently;
  • Team player with strong communication skills and commitment to quality work

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4486982317.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The role exists to ensure the efficient, controlled and client-focused execution of operational activities that support Wealth Management products, services and client transactions. The role is accountable for delivering operational excellence across core processes while maintaining strong risk and control standards, service quality and regulatory compliance.

Working closely with Front Office teams, Product partners, Risk and Compliance functions, the role oversees operational processes that enable the end-to-end client lifecycle, including onboarding, transaction processing, account maintenance, investment servicing and operational issue resolution. The role ensures service commitments are met while managing operational risks and supporting business growth objectives.

Through effective governance, process optimisation and stakeholder engagement, the role contributes to client satisfaction, operational resilience, regulatory compliance and the scalability of Wealth Management operations.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Transaction Operations

  • Manage Wealth Management operational processes to ensure accurate, timely and controlled execution of client transactions and servicing activities.
  • Oversee transaction processing, account maintenance and operational support activities to meet agreed service levels and client expectations.
  • Resolve operational exceptions, enquiries and escalations to minimise client impact and maintain service quality.
  • Monitor operational performance and capacity to ensure sustainable support for business growth and changing client needs.

Client Lifecycle & Service Delivery

  • Lead operational activities across client onboarding, account opening, maintenance and closure processes to support a seamless client experience.
  • Ensure client records, documentation and account information remain accurate, complete and compliant with regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate with Front Office, Compliance and Risk teams to facilitate timely completion of client lifecycle activities.
  • Identify and address service gaps to improve operational efficiency and client outcomes.

Risk, Control & Regulatory Compliance

  • Maintain effective controls across Wealth Management operations to mitigate operational, regulatory and conduct risks.
  • Ensure operational activities comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements and established control standards.
  • Investigate operational incidents, root causes and control weaknesses, implementing corrective actions where required.
  • Support audits, reviews and regulatory examinations through accurate documentation, reporting and remediation tracking.

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

  • Analyse operational performance data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation and efficiency improvements.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance productivity, reduce risk and improve service delivery outcomes.
  • Establish and monitor key operational metrics, service indicators and management information to support decision-making.
  • Drive adoption of standardised processes and best practices across Wealth Management Operations.

Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership

  • Partner with Wealth Management, Product, Technology, Risk and Compliance teams to support effective operational delivery.
  • Provide operational insights and recommendations that inform service improvements, risk mitigation and business decisions.
  • Facilitate governance forums, operational reviews and stakeholder discussions to drive accountability and action.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations through clear communication, issue resolution and proactive engagement.

Change Delivery & Operational Readiness

  • Support implementation of new products, regulatory changes and strategic initiatives by assessing operational impacts and readiness requirements.
  • Coordinate testing, process updates and operational transition activities to ensure successful implementation.
  • Embed new controls, procedures and operating models to maintain operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor post-implementation outcomes and address operational issues arising from change initiatives.

Motivations

  • Driving operational excellence through process improvement, data-driven insights and scalable solutions that enhance client experience, service quality and risk management.
  • Solving complex operational challenges by balancing client needs, regulatory requirements and stakeholder expectations while maintaining strong controls and service standards.
  • Leading high-performing teams and change initiatives that build capability, strengthen operational resilience and support sustainable business growth.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Investment Management
  • Account Reconciliation
  • Custodial Services
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Mutual Funds
  • Product Management
  • Settlement Management
  • Tax Management
  • Financial Services
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Talent Development

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Experience managing Wealth Management, Private Banking, Investment Operations or related financial services operations.
  • Experience overseeing client lifecycle, transaction processing, account servicing or investment operations activities.
  • Demonstrated success implementing operational improvements, productivity enhancements or control strengthening initiatives.
  • Experience managing operational risk, audit findings, regulatory requirements and remediation activities.
  • Experience working with Front Office, Product, Technology, Risk and Compliance stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
  • Proven ability to manage operational performance, service levels, governance forums and stakeholder expectations.
  • Experience leading teams, developing talent and driving a culture of accountability and continuous improvement

Languages

  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Job Summary

This role exists to ensure the accurate, timely and controlled execution of cash management activities across payment processing, clearing, client instructions, account maintenance and static data services. The role is responsible for delivering reliable operational outcomes that support client transactions, safeguard financial assets and maintain the integrity of the Bank's cash management services.

The role is accountable for processing and validating transactions, maintaining critical customer and product data, identifying and escalating operational exceptions, and ensuring service delivery aligns with agreed service levels, regulatory obligations and internal control standards. Through disciplined execution and strong operational risk management, the role contributes to client satisfaction, operational resilience and sustainable business growth.

Working closely with Operations teams, Service Delivery partners, Risk and Compliance functions, Technology teams and business stakeholders, the role helps convert operational requirements into consistent service outcomes. The role supports process efficiency, client experience and operational excellence but does not own product strategy, client relationship management or enterprise-wide operational policy.

Key Responsibilities

Service Delivery & Transaction Processing

  • Execute payment, clearing and cash management activities accurately and within agreed turnaround times to support uninterrupted client servicing.
  • Validate customer instructions, transaction data and processing requirements to ensure operational accuracy and minimise processing risk.
  • Resolve operational exceptions and processing breaks through timely investigation, escalation and corrective action.
  • Deliver service outcomes that consistently meet productivity, quality and client service standards.

Cash Management Operations & Data Integrity

  • Maintain customer, account and product static data to ensure completeness, accuracy and operational readiness across cash management services.
  • Apply established operational controls when performing account maintenance, pricing, billing and related operational activities.
  • Ensure transaction and client records are accurately captured and maintained to support operational, regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Identify data quality issues and drive corrective actions that improve operational effectiveness and minimise service disruptions.

Risk Management & Control Effectiveness

  • Apply operational risk controls that safeguard the Bank against transaction errors, operational losses and control breakdowns.
  • Conduct independent validation activities in accordance with segregation of duties, authority limits and control requirements.
  • Identify, assess and escalate operational risk events, control weaknesses and emerging risks through appropriate governance channels.
  • Support remediation activities that strengthen control effectiveness and reduce recurring operational issues.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance

  • Apply regulatory requirements, internal policies and operational procedures consistently across all cash management activities.
  • Perform AML, sanctions and other financial crime-related checks in line with Bank standards and escalation requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records and evidence that support audit reviews, governance reporting and regulatory inspections.
  • Promote adherence to conduct, compliance and risk standards that protect the Bank and its clients.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve service quality and enhance operational efficiency across the end-to-end workflow.
  • Contribute to operational change initiatives, testing activities and business continuity readiness to support resilient service delivery.
  • Support the implementation of digitisation, automation and process enhancement initiatives that improve operational outcomes.
  • Share process insights and improvement opportunities to strengthen team effectiveness and service performance.

Stakeholder & Client Service Management

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve service issues and ensure effective delivery of cash management services.
  • Communicate operational issues, risks and service impacts clearly to relevant stakeholders to support timely resolution.
  • Build trusted working relationships that facilitate effective issue management and service improvements.
  • Support a client-focused culture by delivering responsive, accurate and professional operational services.

Motivations

  • Motivated by delivering accurate and reliable operational outcomes in a high-volume, time-sensitive environment.
  • Energised by solving operational challenges, improving processes and enhancing service quality.
  • Thrives in environments that value collaboration, accountability, strong controls and continuous improvement.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Payment Processing
  • Cash Management
  • Certification and Accreditation
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Operations Management
  • Project Management
  • Service Delivery
  • Settlement Management

Other Skills

  • Transaction Management
  • Issue Management
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Service Recovery

Qualifications

  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

Our Business

The Head of Trade in China is responsible for driving the growth agenda of trade in China at Bank of America. This includes the development and execution of the Trade Strategy in China from an end-to-end product management and product sales perspective in collaboration with Treasury Sales, Corporate Bank and the rest of the franchise. The Head of Trade will be leading a team of product and program management team as well as coordinate the specialized product sales team in China to deliver these results.

China is an important growth market for Global Payment Solutions GPS) at Bank of America and Trade and Supply Chain Finance is a critical component of GPS. Trade and Supply Chain Finance serve our financial institutions and corporate clients through a wide range of trade finance products ranging from traditional trade documentary trade to supply chain solutions and short-term export credit agency backed financing.

Responsibilities:

  • Development and execution of the China Trade Strategy in alignment with the Global and Regional Trade Strategies to achieve the Trade growth plans for China
  • Responsibility of the Trade Revenue plan, Trade Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet in China to ensure that the trade business meets all its required revenue and return targets. This also includes supporting regular revenue, balance sheet, and asset projections across Trade products in China.
  • Drive the Trade Specialized Product Sales (SPS) agenda in China overseeing the trade sales activity, pipeline development and execution in the market.
  • Partnering closely with Treasury Sales Officers, Corporate Bankers and regional SPS to identify priority clients and opportunities, manage client planning, originate new business and accelerate deal progression from origination through execution and revenue realization
  • Promote solutions-led approach to Trade Sales connecting traditional trade capabilities with broader working capital, payments, liquidity and foreign exchange considerations where relevant to deliver more holistic client solutions
  • End-to-end product development ensuring that all new product build and enhancements have a viable business case, built in the framework of our risk discipline and tracked for commercialization in collaboration with all business partners
  • Partner with Operations, Technology and other risk partners to maintain the on-going end-to-end product delivery model of existing products with discipline to ensure such products are continuously delivered with improved client experience and ease of doing business
  • Keep abreast of regulatory developments and changes in the China operating environment, assessing implications and opportunities for clients and the Trade business and communicating these to country and regional stakeholders. Work with risk partners on the implementation of required changes arising from such regulatory developments
  • Represent GPS Trade in relevant in-country governance forums, including business controls and risk management committees, and ensure appropriate oversight of matters affecting the Trade business
  • Coordinate Trade related regulatory and internal audit, compliance testing activity, working with relevant control and functional partners to ensure issues are addressed appropriately
  • Represent the bank as a Trade thought leader in external forums, industry discussions and client events, bringing perspectives on working capital, supply chains, trade flows and evolving market developments
  • Maintain competitive benchmarking of our trade products with our key competitors in order to identify product gaps, enhancements and plan to market
  • Act as the conduit between China and the regional and global Trade organization, sharing market opportunities and client insights, leveraging expertise across markets and supporting consistent regional and global sales execution on multinational opportunities.

Skills:

  • Strong leadership skills with over 10-15 years relevant trade finance experience in China who will be able to independently grow the trade business agenda.
  • Critical and strategic mindset required to develop a Trade China Strategy and Business Plan
  • Extensive sales and client management knowledge with clients operating in China and strong sales pipeline management discipline
  • Strong understanding of the whole spectrum of Trade Finance products across the working capital cycle and how to leverage such products to provide holistic solutions across cash and liquidity management, risk mitigation and FX.
  • Extensive analytical and financial acumen with experience in forecasting, balance sheet management, and performance reporting.
  • Knowledge of regulatory governance, risk management, and control frameworks affecting Trade products with experience in handling regulatory inspections and examinations and regulatory reporting
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate across Product, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Sales, and Technology teams locally, regionally and globally.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Fluent written and spoken English and Chinese.

- End-to-end product development ensuring that all new product build and enhancements have a viable business case, built in the framework of our risk discipline and tracked for commercialization in collaboration with all business partners
- Partner with Operations, Technology and other risk partners to maintain the on-going end-to-end product delivery model of existing products with discipline to ensure such products are continuously delivered with improved client experience and ease of doing business
- Keep abreast of regulatory developments and changes in the China operating environment, assessing implications and opportunities for clients and the Trade business and communicating these to country and regional stakeholders. Work with risk partners on the implementation of required changes arising from such regulatory developments
- Represent GPS Trade in relevant in-country governance forums, including business controls and risk management committees, and ensure appropriate oversight of matters affecting the Trade business
- Coordinate Trade related regulatory and internal audit, compliance testing activity, working with relevant control and functional partners to ensure issues are addressed appropriately
- Represent the bank as a Trade thought leader in external forums, industry discussions and client events, bringing perspectives on working capital, supply chains, trade flows and evolving market developments
- Maintain competitive benchmarking of our trade products with our key competitors in order to identify product gaps, enhancements and plan to market
- Act as the conduit between China and the regional and global Trade organization, sharing market opportunities and client insights, leveraging expertise across markets and supporting consistent regional and global sales execution on multinational opportunities.
Skills:
- Strong leadership skills with over 10-15 years relevant trade finance experience in China who will be able to independently grow the trade business agenda.
- Critical and strategic mindset required to develop a Trade China Strategy and Business Plan
- Extensive sales and client management knowledge with clients operating in China and strong sales pipeline management discipline
- Strong understanding of the whole spectrum of Trade Finance products across the working capital cycle and how to leverage such products to provide holistic solutions across cash and liquidity management, risk mitigation and FX.
- Extensive analytical and financial acumen with experience in forecasting, balance sheet management, and performance reporting.
- Knowledge of regulatory governance, risk management, and control frameworks affecting Trade products with experience in handling regulatory inspections and examinations and regulatory reporting
- Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate across Product, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Sales, and Technology teams locally, regionally and globally.
- Strong communication, presentation, and problem-solving capabilities.
- Fluent written and spoken English and Chinese.

ln:4488719866.descriptionHtml:
About This Role

About BlackRock CCB Wealth:

BlackRock’s purpose is to help more and more people experience financial well-being and the firm has a long history of investing in and serving investors in China. BlackRock aspires to become the leading global asset management firm operating in China and is committed to contributing to the long-term development of the local asset management industry. BlackRock CCB Wealth Management Limited - a Shanghai-based joint venture between BlackRock, China Construction Bank and Temasek - aims to deliver investment excellence by offering customer-centric, diversified and innovative wealth management products and solutions to help Chinese people build savings that serve them throughout their lives.

Responsibilities：

  • Asset and Strategy Sourcing & Development
  • Formulate overall strategies and plans for asset sourcing and development to fulfill the company's strategy and product requirements.
  • Based on the overall plan, primarily focuses on identifying and building standard assets/strategies from onshore and offshore capital markets to meet portfolio management needs.
  • Assist in sourcing high-quality non-standard assets and help establish/maintain stable asset sourcing channels.
  • Coordinate across different functions (incl. RQA, L&C, Operations, etc.) to drive efficient and smooth process for asset and strategy implementation.
  • undefined
  • Portfolio Management Support
  • Work closely with portfolio managers across different product lines to understand their needs and match them with suitable assets and strategies.
  • Track the performance of allocated assets and strategies and provide ongoing support to portfolio managers for further adjustments per needed.
  • undefined

Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant work experience in WMS industry, with accumulated experience from asset and strategy sourcing/development.
  • Bachelor's degree and above with major in Finance, Economics, Financial Engineering, or related fields preferred.
  • Solid understanding of various asset classes including bonds, non-standard assets, and equities.
  • Build a strong/broad professional network with excellent business communication skills.
  • Able to capture the cooperation opportunities and establish/maintain strong partnerships.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills, with the ability to effectively build the connection between asset and investment strategy.
  • Able to take lead/thrive in a fast-paced/start-up organization environment, with a can-do attitude.
  • Results-oriented, with strong capabilities in project management.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

This second line role within Global Financial Crimes Compliance will play a critical role in supporting the Bank's Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Financial Crime Compliance program.

The role works closely with the MLRO to investigate into complex financial crimes cases that may require reporting of suspicious activity. The role is also responsible for conducting post-investigation reviews and case closure assessments to identify root causes, emerging financial crime risks, control gaps, and thematic trends. Insights from these reviews will be used to recommend enhancements to AML controls, monitoring scenarios, customer due diligence processes, and risk management practices to strengthen the effectiveness of the AML program. The role also includes managing and investigating into complex financial crime cases escalated to the MLROs, assess suspicious activity, and prepare Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to the relevant regulatory and law enforcement authorities.

In addition, the role will support broader AML risk management and governance activities in Asia Pacific (APAC), including financial crime risk assessments, regulatory change implementation, policy and procedure enhancements, management reporting, and regulatory examination support. The successful candidate will work closely with business, operations, compliance, and regional stakeholders to ensure financial crime risks are appropriately identified, assessed, managed, and escalated, while contributing to the continuous improvement of the Bank's AML and Financial Crime Compliance framework.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct end-to-end investigations of AML and financial crime cases escalated to the MLRO.
  • Support MLRO in assessing suspicious activity and preparing STRs to the relevant authorities in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Provide guidance and challenge to stakeholders on financial crime risk matters, investigation outcomes, and reporting obligations.
  • Conduct post-investigation reviews and case closure assessments to identify root causes, control weaknesses, emerging risks, and thematic financial crime trends.
  • Recommend and support implementation of enhancements to AML controls, transaction monitoring, customer due diligence processes, and investigation procedures based on lessons learned from completed cases.
  • Track and report recurring themes, risk indicators, and regulatory concerns arising from investigations to support MLRO oversight and ongoing program improvement.
  • Support AML risk management activities, including Customer Risk Assessments (CRA), enterprise financial crime risk assessments, and thematic reviews.
  • Monitor emerging AML, sanctions, fraud, and financial crime risks and recommend appropriate mitigating actions.
  • Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, and responses to regulatory inquiries.
  • Assist in the development, enhancement, and implementation of AML policies, procedures, controls, and governance frameworks.
  • Prepare management reporting and risk metrics to support MLRO oversight and decision-making.
  • Partner with local, regional, and global stakeholders to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and enterprise financial crime standards.
  • Escalating financial crimes concerns to the Global Financial Crimes Manager or Executive

Required Skills:

  • 5+ Years of relevant work experience in Anti-Money Laundering, Fraud and/or Economic Sanctions
  • Ability to read and interpret regulatory guidance
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate and work with all levels within the organization
  • Sound risk management skills and an ability to apply discernment, take decisions when required and to escalate concerns when necessary
  • Must possess excellent time-management, problem solving, and critical thinking capabilities
  • Ability to handle multiple projects in a dynamic environment Proficiency with MS Office programs – including strong Excel expertise and Copilot
  • Ability to work across a matrix organization

Desired Skills:

  • Subject matter knowledge and experience in financial crimes compliance
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) certification;
  • Understanding of Banking products and Financial Crimes vulnerabilities
  • Bachelor's Degree
