ln:4488278476.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Job Summary

Provide general administrative support to RGM/CGM and RGM Office/CGM Office and ensure smooth running of the office. Principle driven and act discreetly in managing confidential and sensitive information and uphold high ethical standard.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide general administrative support to CGM including but not limited to: Calendar management, key records and files filing, expense claims, office maintenance, G&E registration, maintain gift distribution list for the visits made by the Group Executives and CEO/RGM/CGM.
  • Day-to-day CGM’s schedule management, organize and prepare for meetings, including gathering documents and taking care of the logistics
  • Arrange and support key activities and projects that would help CGM drive region/branch and business objectives, including but not limited to: explore business opportunities, other external forum/event
  • Financial related: Support preparation of budgets and stretch targets, current performance and forecast for the year, cost centre reconciliation report and monthly FCS maintenance. Support CGM to operate within budget for the all responsible cost centre(s). Implement cost savings initiatives
  • Administration related: Driver / Keys / Email & Bridge Distribution list / Gifts storage & Distribution list maintenance / Initiate PO and Payment when required / Vendor sourcing when required / submit and reconcile expense and medical claims.
  • Be familiar with company policy/regulations and strictly comply, including but not limited to: T&E, G&E, OBI, as well as the relevant system.
  • Build and update CGM contact database to capture relevant information on important contacts for CGM.
  • Assist CGM office on internal communication when required.
  • Document Filing: Ensure that CGM office related documents are properly archived and recorded

Business/业务表现

On branch planning

  • Conduct market research on local business potential, considering the strategy and business plans of the branch;
  • Collate branch level reports for review by Branch Management Committee (Branch MANCO) and Regional Heads, consolidate updates from different Businesses and Functions in the branch;
  • Organize meetings on behalf of Branch Manager (internal and external, including but not limited to Branch Manco, Risk Session and Regional governance meeting), prepare meeting pack, take meeting minutes and support follow up actions as needed.

People & Talent/人员管理

  • People related – Support CGM on people management/engagement, i.e. Staff on boarding, off boarding and movement process / Talent engagement activities. File and maintain the most updated CGM’s JO/ JD / RP/ CV/ OBI. Maintain the most updated reportee’s handover letters; Verify & maintain the most updated CGM / DCGM rotation status in Panda system.

Branch Administration and Conduct, Compliance, Risk and Internal Control Management/分行行政及行为、合规、风险 及内部控制管理

  • Coordinate local visit itineraries for China Executive Committee (EXCO) members and Group senior leaders, working closely with the relevant offices of the visitors on activity schedule, communication with local government and regulator offices, local travel logistics, as well as meal and gift arrangements.
  • Strictly follow the bank chop policy to manage the branch chop and sub-branch chops;
  • Strictly follow the bank license management policy and procedures to manage all branch licenses well;
  • Perform KSCA support when required (including but not limited to Panda, Record, Chop), to Support CGM on the robust controls of internal and external
  • Assist in BCP/Business Resilience planning and execution in the branch.
  • Act as local risk manager to assist City GM in controlling the level of operational risk exposure that results from business / function unit activities in city branches (optional, if the PA taking the role as city UORM, pls keep this item; if not, can be removed);
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML and Fraud Prevention requirements when performing duties.

Governance/内部管理

Additional support to Branch Manager

  • Handle business correspondences for the Branch Manager in line with branch priorities, in particular verbal and written correspondences with local government and regulatory officials.
  • Support presentations to be conducted by the Branch Manager, including drafting presentation content and providing onsite support.
  • Routinely perform a wide variety of support duties

Local Support to Functions

  • Coordinate local activities for Functions that do not have onsite presence, serving as these Function’s key contact point in the branch and facilitating functional activities, as required, across Business and Functions in the branch.
  • Provide local support to HR team for the branches without HR onsite presence, mainly including Labor contract sign-off, onboarding and offboarding procedures, certification issuing, flexible Working application and other necessary support as needed. (optional, if the PA providing such local support to HR team, pls keep this item; if not, can be removed).
  • Perform any other tasks assigned by RGM/CGM.

Accountability Review/问责

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求
  • 根据本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查

Regulatory & Business Conduct/监管 & 业务合规

ln:4489077681.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • We are seeking an experienced Development Lead to join our technology team and play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable trading control systems that power Standard Chartered’ s digital banking platform. The successful candidate will lead technical initiatives, build platform 0-1, and contribute to architectural decisions that with major business impact to our global financial market business.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Design and develop high-performance, scalable backend services and APIs using modern technologies
  • Implement microservices architecture patterns and distributed system design principles
  • Ensure system reliability, performance, and security across all backend services
  • Drive adoption of best practices in code quality, testing, and deployment
  • Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning

Development & Implementation

  • Build robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies
  • Implement secure, efficient database designs and optimize query performance
  • Develop event-driven architectures using messaging systems (Solace, Kafka)
  • Integrate with third-party systems and external APIs following banking industry standards
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with DEV, SRE, QA, BA, product managers, and business stakeholders
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Lead technical discussions and facilitate knowledge sharing sessions
  • Participate in technical interviews and contribute to team building initiatives

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure all backend systems comply with banking regulations and security standards
  • Implement comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and methodologies
  • Maintain high standards of documentation for systems and processes
  • Support production systems and participate in on-call rotations when required

Skills And Experience

  • Application Design, Architecture
  • Software Development
  • Leadership
  • AI

Qualifications

  • [8+ years of experience in development with strong Java expertise, with at least 5+ years in a leadership role.
  • Proficiency in Spring Framework (Spring Boot)
  • Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (Redis)
  • Extensive experience with messaging systems (Solace, Apache Kafka)
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with API design and development (REST, GraphQL)
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to mentor and lead a team of engineers, fostering an environment of innovation and continuous learning.]
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Languages: English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Description

Job Summary

  • Oversee end-to-end banking regulatory reporting process including data collection and organization, understanding regulatory requirements, completing and submitting SCB China and branches regulatory reports. Ensure accurate, complete and on-time submission of all regulatory returns.
  • Support to identify and mitigate potential regulatory risks related to reporting errors, delays, or non-compliance, and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Support to act as the key liaison with external regulators, providing updates, responding to queries, and representing the company in regulatory discussions and inspections.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, work closely with legal, finance, risk, and IT departments to ensure consistency and completeness of data used in regulatory submissions and to address any compliance-related issues.
  • Support to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of reporting systems and tools to enhance efficiency and reduce manual processes through automation

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle regulatory (NFRA, PBOC, SAFE, the Bureau of Finance, the Bureau of Statistics etc.) returns preparation and submission, ensures that all regulatory submissions are accurate, complete, and submitted on time, as well as regulatory reporting instruction changes interpretation and implementation.
  • Support line manager to maintain robust quality control procedures to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all regulatory submissions, and reporting issues escalated through agreed governance channels.
  • Support PPG and China CA review and system upgrade project including end to end accounting flow review, upgrade the reporting logic, UAT support, regulatory reporting impact analysis to ensure compliance, accuracy and completeness.
  • Maintain good relationships with relevant internal departments, assist the line manager in coordinating with the finance department and other internal functional departments for discussions, such as establishing reporting procedures for new reporting requirements, and promptly and properly resolving related regulatory reporting issues.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Support line manager to drive process and system optimisation improvements in processes, reporting, data quality through reporting automation while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.

Skills and Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Solid knowledge of banking accounting and regulatory reporting rules
  • Hands-on experience in end-to-end regulatory reporting process
  • Strong data analysis and problem-solving abilities

Other Skills

  • High attention to detail and strict regulatory risk awareness
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Strong accountability and ability to work under high pressure

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, very stringent regulatory environment casts great pressure on regulatory reporting including tight local reporting deadline, continuous changing reporting requirements, energized by the fast-paced, deadline-driven nature of regulatory reporting, motivated by the challenge of meeting tight deadlines under pressure while maintaining accuracy and compliance.
  • Motivated by the opportunity to streamline regulatory reporting processes, reduce errors, and enhance efficiency, driven by outcomes such as improved reporting accuracy, more efficient reporting process, reduced compliance risks etc.
  • Performs best in environments that encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing, and professional growth, motivated by working with cross-functional teams build a strong, capable regulatory reporting function.
  • Continuous learning and adaptability required, motivated by the need to stay current with regulatory changes, emerging technologies, and industry best practices, enjoy learning and applying new automation tools and methodologies to improve reporting systems and outcomes.
  • Driven by a commitment to ethical standards and accountability, motivated by the responsibility to uphold the organization’s reputation and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience dealing complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure

Certifications/Qualifications

  • CICPA & ACCA is preferred

Languages

  • Chinese and English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

ln:4490311963.descriptionHtml:
Key Responsibilities

  • Digitalization & Process Automation
  • Digital Transformation: Drive the rollout of digital-first solutions, automation tools, and paperless workflows across retail branches to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
  • Workflow Re-engineering: Evaluate existing branch workflow and identify opportunities to replace manual processes with smart digital channels and automated self-service tools.
  • System Integration: Partner with IT and product teams to pilot, test, and implement new retail banking applications and digital platforms at the branch level.
  • Project Management & Transformation
  • Project Delivery: Lead and manage end-to-end strategic initiatives, transformation projects, and operational rollouts across the branch network within scope, time, and budget.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Act as the primary bridge between front-line branch staff, regional management, product owners, and technology teams to align project objectives and deliverables.
  • Change Management: Design and execute comprehensive change management strategies, including training programs, user guides, and communication plans for branch staff during system or process upgrades.
  • Reporting & Performance Tracking
  • Metrics & Analytics: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to track the success and adoption of branch projects and operational improvements.
  • Management Reporting: Prepare regular status reports, dashboards, and executive presentations highlighting project milestones, risks, and operational performance metrics.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 3–5 years of working experience in retail / consumer banking, with hands-on experience in branch operations, or branch management.
    • Proven track record in project management, business analysis, or operational transformation (PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications are a strong plus).
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English and Chinese (Mandarin), both written and verbal, with the ability to conduct presentations and write professional reports in English.
  • Skills & Competencies:
    • In-depth knowledge of consumer banking products, branch workflow systems, and regulatory compliance frameworks.
    • Strong project management capabilities with proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Confluence).
    • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a keen attention to detail.
Location:

PRC - Shanghai

Job:

Digital

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

Deutsche Bank China, Shanghai Cash Operations mainly focus on payment clearing services to cooperate customers. ln:4490340343.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
  • Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
  • Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
  • Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
  • Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
  • Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
  • Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
  • Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
  • Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
  • Fluency in Mandarin and English

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4489215242.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

This role is responsible for ensuring the efficient, accurate and compliant delivery of lending operations across the retail banking lending lifecycle. The role safeguards operational performance by overseeing loan processing, documentation, controls and service delivery activities that support lending products and customer needs.

The role is accountable for maintaining operational integrity, managing risk and regulatory compliance, and ensuring customer outcomes are delivered within agreed service standards. It works closely with risk, product, technology, frontline banking and compliance teams to resolve operational challenges, improve end-to-end processes and strengthen operational resilience.

By leveraging operational insights, performance metrics and continuous improvement practices, the role contributes to improved customer experience, reduced operational risk, enhanced productivity and sustainable business growth. The position influences the effectiveness of lending operations through process optimisation, governance oversight and data-driven decision making, while supporting the delivery of strategic and regulatory priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Lending Operations Delivery

  • Lead lending operations activities that ensure accurate, timely and efficient processing of loan applications, approvals, disbursements and servicing transactions.
  • Maintain operational controls that minimise processing errors, operational losses and customer impacts across the lending lifecycle.
  • Monitor service performance against operational and customer service standards, implementing corrective actions where required.
  • Ensure operational capacity and workflow management practices support business volumes and service commitments.

Risk, Control & Regulatory Compliance

  • Implement and maintain operational controls that support compliance with lending policies, regulatory requirements and internal standards.
  • Identify, assess and mitigate operational risks arising from lending processes, customer activities and process exceptions.
  • Strengthen fraud prevention and detection practices through effective monitoring, escalation and control frameworks.
  • Support regulatory reporting obligations by ensuring accuracy, completeness and audit readiness of operational data.

Process Optimisation & Operational Excellence

  • Analyse operational performance data to identify process inefficiencies, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
  • Drive workflow optimisation initiatives that improve productivity, turnaround times and customer outcomes.
  • Enhance process standardisation and control effectiveness to support scalable and sustainable operations.
  • Collaborate with technology and transformation teams to implement process improvements and operational enhancements.

Customer & Stakeholder Outcomes

  • Deliver operational support that contributes to positive customer experiences throughout the lending journey.
  • Partner with business, risk, product and service teams to resolve operational issues and improve service delivery.
  • Escalate material operational, customer or control issues to appropriate stakeholders and support timely resolution.
  • Provide operational insights and recommendations that support business decision-making and customer outcomes.

Data, Reporting & Performance Insights

  • Develop and use operational performance metrics that enable effective monitoring of service, risk and productivity outcomes.
  • Analyse lending and customer data to identify trends, emerging risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Produce management information and operational reporting that supports governance, decision making and regulatory requirements.
  • Use data-driven insights to prioritise operational improvement initiatives and support business objectives.

Motivations

  • Motivated by improving operational processes that enhance customer outcomes, service quality and operational resilience.
  • Energised by solving complex operational challenges through collaboration, analysis and practical problem-solving.
  • Thrives in environments that value accountability, continuous improvement, risk discipline and customer focus.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Loan Operations
  • Retail Banking
  • Consumer Lending
  • Regulatory Compliance

Other Skills

  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Team Leadership
  • Risk Management
  • Project Management
  • Talent Development
  • Loan Documentation
  • Resource Allocation
  • Incident Analysis

Qualifications

  • Experience operating within regulated financial services environments where risk, compliance and customer outcomes are critical.
  • Exposure to high-volume operational functions that require strong controls, service delivery management and operational governance.
  • Experience working across multiple stakeholder groups, balancing customer, business, risk and regulatory priorities.
  • Exposure to process transformation, workflow optimisation or operational excellence initiatives that improve efficiency and control effectiveness.
  • Experience using operational data and performance insights to identify trends, manage risks and drive decision-making.
  • Business English (required)

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

ln:4489207450.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Scope of Role:

To lead BDE team to achieve the team sales target by maximizing existing customers/acquisition/referral opportunities and providing quality customer service.

职责范围：

领导BDE团队开拓新客户，并通过提供优质客户服务进行交叉销售最终实现团队销售目标。

Key Responsibilities

  • To manage the day-to-day planning, operations and problem-solving of Salesperson
  • To ensure that Salespersons achieve specified sales targets and service standards.
  • To conduct staff meetings and provide support / updates for sales promotion and activities, procedural changes, management directives, etc.
  • To ensure Salesperson meets with internal control, compliance and audit standards.
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties.
  • To train and develop new sales staff.
  • To develop action plans to improve team performance.
  • To provide coaching and mentoring to Salesperson to facilitate staff retention.
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control
  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of the event over which the employee has the duties of management and/or leadership
  • Be responsible for significant losses due to failure of effectiveness of internal control

主要职责/挑战：

  • 管理销售人员的日常计划、运营和问题解决
  • 确保销售人员达到规定的销售目标和服务标准。
  • 召开员工会议，为促销和活动、程序变更、管理指令等提供支持/更新。
  • 确保销售人员符合内部控制、合规和审计标准。
  • 在履行职责时负责执行和遵守反洗钱要求。
  • 培训和培养新的销售人员。
  • 制定行动计划以提高团队绩效。
  • 为销售人员提供指导，以促进员工的稳定性。
  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。
  • 正确履行管理职责，并确保内控的效率；
  • 对负有管理和/或领导责任的事项引起或相关的违反监管规定事件或风险，承担相应责任。
  • 为内控失效造成的重大损失负责。

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Financial skills

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • University / College degree, or equivalent / better.
  • Good English speaking as well as in writing.
  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in a sales in a financial services.
  • Highly motivated and drove by number, strong interpersonal skills and demonstrate leadership attributes.

选择标准：

  • 大学/大学学位或同等/更好。
  • 良好的英语口语和书面表达能力。
  • 至少2年金融服务销售相关经验。
  • 积极性强，人际交往能力强，具有领导能力。

Other then above roles, job holder should follow other job duties and responsibilities assigned by line manager from time to time.

除上述工作职责外，员工应遵循直属经理随时指派的任何工作职责和任务。

Above key responsibilities and selection criteria are the major assessment to assess the staff if qualified during probation and competent after probation. Failing to satisfy any of the aforesaid requirements, or failing to pass the “CPBB Essentials”, the employee will be deemed not meeting the recruitment requirement for passing probation, and the Bank is entitled to terminate the employee’s employment contract immediately. For employee who has passed the probation, failing to pass the “CPBB Essentials” will be taken as assessment basis for job incompetency.

以上的岗位聘任要求和主要工作职责是用于考核员工试用期是否符合录用条件和工作胜任与否的标准。倘若员工未能满足前述要求，或未能通过“CPBB Essentials 入职培训”测试的，则该员工将被视为不符合试用期的录用条件，银行有权立即解除与该员工的劳动合同；对于已过试用期的员工，未能通过“CPBB Essentials 入职培训”测试的，将作为该员工不胜任工作岗位的考核依据。

Please note that the job description above will be reviewed during the Job Objective setting every year, which may be amended and agreed where necessary by the employee and the line manager.

请注意以上本工作描述将于每年制定年度工作目标时予以审核，如有必要将由直属经理和员工予以修订并达成一致。

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

ln:4489212089.descriptionHtml:
Job Type

Full Time

Job Reference #

345218BR

City

Shanghai

Key Responsibilities

Join a global research platform that turns rigorous analysis into clear, actionable investment insights.

As a Research Associate, you will support high-quality equity strategy research through financial modeling, data management, and the development of clear investment insights. You will work closely with senior equity strategists and equity research analysts across teams and regions.

What you’ll do

  • Monitor China A-share market developments, earnings trends, economic data releases, and investors’ flows.
  • Conduct quantitative and fundamental analysis of China A-share markets, sectors, styles, and themes.
  • Build, maintain, and enhance financial models and databases that support research publications.
  • Support senior strategist in authoring high-quality research reports, thematic notes, marketing materials, and stakeholder discussions.
  • Respond to research requests and collaborate effectively across teams and regions.

The team

You will be working in the China research team. We are an open and energetic team. We work close with corporates and clients.

Diversity helps us grow, together. That’s why we are committed to fostering and advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion.

Your Skills And Experience

You have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a relevant discipline.
  • Typically one to four years of experience in China A-share strategy research, macro-economic research, asset allocation research or a related analytical role.
  • Strong financial-analysis, modeling, valuation, and Excel skills.
  • Familiar with financial data platforms and large datasets.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in Chinese and English, with strong attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with AI tools for research, analysis, or workflow improvement is a plus.
  • Relevant professional qualifications are advantageous.

What will help you succeed

  • Analytical, curious, accurate, and commercially minded.
  • Organized and effective under tight deadlines.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning.

About Us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

Join us

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.

Contact Details

UBS Business Solutions SA

UBS Recruiting

Disclaimer / Policy statements

UBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering (Agent Hub UI UX Tech Lead).

Business:CTO Platform

Location: Shenzhen

Job ID：62747

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end UX: discovery, user flows, IA, wireframes, prototyping, usability testing
  • Deliver polished UI: responsive layouts, interaction design, visual hierarchy, micro-interactions
  • Apply accessibility standards, inclusive design, content and contrast best practice
  • Partner with Product and Engineering: translate requirements into build-ready designs and acceptance criteria
  • Contribute to UI implementation: collaborate on component libraries/design systems; code UI where required (e.g., React/CSS)
  • Measure and improve outcomes: analytics-informed iteration, experiment support, continuous optimisation
  • Provide senior leadership: mentor peers, run critiques/workshops, drive consistency and quality across products

Requirements

  • 6+ years’ experience in UX/UI design, product design, design engineering, or similar roles.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end work (discovery → design → delivery) with measurable outcomes.
  • Strong in interaction design, visual design, and designing complex journeys (forms, onboarding, dashboards, transactional flows).
  • Strong proficiency with design tools (Figma preferred) and collaborative workflows.
  • Solid understanding of front-end constraints and modern UI implementation approaches (even if you’re not hands-on coding daily).
  • Practical experience designing for accessibility and inclusive design.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; able to influence decisions with evidence.

/51/LP/WX

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4490539981.descriptionHtml:
Ready to shape cross-border investment strategy in China?

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity

This role sits at the intersection of global capital markets and China's onshore economy, offering a unique platform to design and manage sophisticated multi-asset portfolios. You will leverage HSBC's global reach alongside deep local expertise to identify investment opportunities across equities, fixed income, and alternatives. Success in this position means delivering tailored investment solutions that meet complex client mandates while navigating the evolving regulatory landscape. You will play a pivotal part in connecting international market trends with domestic opportunities, directly impacting how clients access and grow their wealth in China. The role demands a strategic approach to portfolio construction and dynamic rebalancing in response to shifting macroeconomic indicators. Your work will support the broader goal of establishing HSBC Qianhai as a unique partner in China's capital markets.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Evaluate diverse asset classes including global equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, and alternatives to inform investment decisions.
  • Conduct global macro research to identify cross-border market trends and emerging investment opportunities.
  • Construct and manage diversified, multi-asset portfolios tailored to client mandates.
  • Rebalance portfolios dynamically based on shifting macroeconomic indicators and evolving risk-return profiles.
  • Partner with the sales team to conduct roadshows and pitch investment strategies to internal and external clients.
  • Ensure strict adherence to international regulatory requirements and internal compliance guidelines across all activities.
  • Interpret complex market data to provide actionable insights that drive portfolio performance and client value.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align investment strategies with broader business objectives and client needs.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 3 years of professional overseas experience in investment management, portfolio management, or asset allocation. (Mandatory stipulation for QDII regulation) .
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of the asset management business with direct experience in regulatory requirements for cross-border investment in China.
  • Apply solid research and investment experience across major asset classes to drive strategic decision-making.
  • Hold a CFA designation or bring equivalent demonstrable experience and expertise in the field.
  • Navigate complex regulatory environments and market practices specific to cross-border investment structures.
  • Synthesise global macroeconomic indicators into clear, actionable investment theses and portfolio adjustments.
  • Communicate complex investment strategies effectively to diverse audiences including clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain the highest standards of compliance and risk management in all portfolio activities and client interactions.

Shaping China's onshore capital markets

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of investment management within one of the world's fastest-growing economies. You will work within a diverse and inclusive environment that values merit and supports professional development at every stage. Your expertise will help clients navigate the complexities of cross-border investing while contributing to HSBC's long-term sustainable growth. We invite you to bring your skills and experience to a team committed to excellence and innovation. Join us to make a tangible impact on how global capital flows into China's markets.

The Group AI Platform team sits within CTO Platforms, part of HSBC’s Chief Technology Office (CTO). We build shared AI foundations that enable teams across the Bank to deliver AI solutions faster, more safely and at scale.

  • Define and govern architecture for the AI Platform: reference architectures, standards, guardrails, patterns and roadmaps across cloud and also on‑prem environments.

  • Ensure production-grade non-functionals: availability, disaster recovery, monitoring/alerting, SLOs, incident readiness, and automation (IaC, CI/CD enablement where relevant).

  • Hands-on experience building and delivering platform capabilities across both cloud and on-premises environments, with a strong understanding of production engineering and operational considerations.
  • Good knowledge of one or more major cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or Alibaba Cloud, including core services, data, networking, identity, and security principles.
  • Demonstrate expertise in more than one of the following areas including LLM inferencing, GPU management, agent runtime framework, RAG, MCP processing and skill management etc.
  • Experience with modern platform engineering practices, including APIs, containerisation, Kubernetes, CI/CD, automation, and observability.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code, policy as code, and reusable platform patterns.
  • Experience evaluating and adopting vendor products/services (e.g., Kubernetes distributions, GPU solutions, observability tooling) and aligning them to enterprise support, lifecycle, and operational models.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering (Group AI Platform Architecture).

Business: CTO Platforms

Principal Responsibilities

  • Define and govern architecture for the AI Platform: reference architectures, standards, guardrails, patterns and roadmaps across cloud and also on‑prem environments.
  • Provide technical direction and design authority for engineering teams, including solution reviews, design approvals, and delivery oversight.
  • Lead vendor/product evaluation and adoption (e.g. GPU platforms, Kubernetes distributions, storage and networking solutions, observability stacks), ensuring fit with HSBC infrastructure requirements, support models, and lifecycle management.
  • Partner closely with other HSBC platform teams on on‑prem platform development, integration with existing data center capabilities, and operational readiness.
  • Design and guide implementation of infrastructure for AI/ML workloads (capacity planning, scheduling, tenancy/isolation, performance, reliability, cost controls).
  • Embed security, compliance, and operational controls by design, working with Cyber Security, Data, Model Risk Management (MRM), and other stakeholders (e.g., identity, encryption, logging, vulnerability management, auditability).
  • Ensure production-grade non-functionals: availability, disaster recovery, monitoring/alerting, SLOs, incident readiness, and automation (IaC, CI/CD enablement where relevant).

Requirements

  • Proven architecture leadership for large-scale platforms, including defining reference architectures, standards, guardrails, and roadmaps across cloud and on‑prem.
  • Proven ability to produce clear, practical designs that translate business and technical requirements into secure, scalable, reusable and maintainable platform solutions.
  • Hands-on experience building and delivering platform capabilities across both cloud and on-premises environments, with a strong understanding of production engineering and operational considerations.
  • Good knowledge of one or more major cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or Alibaba Cloud, including core services, data, networking, identity, and security principles.
  • Demonstrate expertise in more than one of the following areas including LLM inferencing, GPU management, agent runtime framework, RAG, MCP processing and skill management etc.
  • Experience with modern platform engineering practices, including APIs, containerisation, Kubernetes, CI/CD, automation, and observability.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code, policy as code, and reusable platform patterns.
  • Experience evaluating and adopting vendor products/services (e.g., Kubernetes distributions, GPU solutions, observability tooling) and aligning them to enterprise support, lifecycle, and operational models.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills: able to build trusted relationships with engineering, product, and control functions; translate complex requirements into pragmatic platform designs.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist.

Business: CCM and Fin Resource Mgt Tech

Job ID: 66072

Job Board Tags:/WX/51/LP

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead and participate in System Architecture & Design reviews (both High-Level and Low-Level Design), solving complex technical blockers with strong logical thinking.
  • Design, refine, and enforce engineering and SDLC processes to improve team efficiency, code quality, and delivery resilience.
  • Champion the exploration and implementation of AI / GenAI tools and practices into software delivery workflows and business process automation.
  • Lead engineering and delivery teams, providing mentorship, project management oversight, resource planning, and technical direction.
  • Act as the technical/service lead for ITSO duties, overseeing IT Risk Management, regulatory compliance, and driving end-to-end Vulnerability Remediation.
  • Review and govern Incident, Problem, Change, Event, and Capacity management; lead major production incident triage and ensure robust Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to prevent recurrence.
  • Drive Cloud (GCP) and infrastructure review, capacity planning, application optimization, and service resiliency governance.
  • Manage certificate renewal ownership, system health, and technical currency governance.
  • Drive effective stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration across global teams

Requirements

  • Strong Technical Background & System Design: Proven track record in enterprise-grade software development, distributed system design, microservices, and modern architectural patterns.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Exceptional logical thinking and structured problem-solving capabilities in resolving complex engineering and production challenges.
  • SDLC & Process Optimization: Deep expertise across the full Software Development Life Cycle (build, test, deploy, run), with proven experience designing robust delivery processes and testing frameworks.
  • Team Leadership & Project Management: Proven experience in managing, mentoring software engineering teams and delivering multi-stream projects end-to-end.
  • AI Knowledge & Practical Adoption: Strong awareness of modern AI technologies, with the vision and hands-on ability to apply AI into daily team delivery, automation, and business use cases.
  • ITSO, IT Risk & Vulnerability Management: In-depth knowledge of ITSO functions, IT risk control frameworks, security governance, and end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle remediation.
  • Cloud & Modern Tech Stack: Strong hands-on experience with Cloud platforms (especially Google Cloud Platform / GCP), Java API development, microservices, databases, and middleware (MQ, Redis, API Gateway).
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Excellent cross-team collaboration skills and proven track record in managing both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Operational Excellence: Solid experience in Incident, Problem, Change, and Capacity Management within an enterprise DevOps/Agile environment.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Technology Management (VP - AI Strategic Transformation).

Business:CTO Innov & Digital Part

Job ID: 63971

Location: Shenzhen

Principal Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream: Own the programme management of IDP's partnerships workstream feeding the Group AI programme – building and maintaining the plan, milestones, dependencies, RAID log and financials, and ensuring the workstream delivers against the commitments made into the wider programme.
  • Programme governance and reporting: Run the governance and reporting cycle for the workstream – preparing status reporting, steering and programme board submissions, and ensuring a single, accurate and timely view of progress, risk and value is available to the Group AI programme and to IDP leadership.
  • Cross-workstream integration: Act as IDP's interface into the Group AI programme, managing dependencies with other workstreams, escalating blockers, and ensuring partnership commitments, timelines and benefits are reflected consistently in the overall programme view.
  • Strategy development and execution: Support the Director of IDP in shaping and refreshing the function's strategy – conducting analysis, developing options and recommendations, translating agreed direction into objectives, roadmaps and measurable outcomes, and tracking delivery against them.
  • Operating rhythm and governance: Run the operating rhythm for the Director of IDP and the leadership team – setting agendas, preparing materials, capturing decisions and actions, and driving follow-through to closure.
  • Team effectiveness and organisational health: Support the Director of IDP on organisational and team matters, including onboarding, colleague engagement, internal communications, capability planning and cultural initiatives that sustain a high-performing global team.
  • Special initiatives: Lead strategic initiatives and analyses on behalf of the Director of IDP where dedicated focus is required, from framing the problem through to a decision-ready recommendation and implementation.

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Lead the Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream through matrix leadership of contributors across partnership, innovation and technology teams in multiple jurisdictions, without direct line authority.
  • Bring cohesion to the IDP China leadership team – connecting agendas, surfacing tensions early, and holding colleagues to the commitments they have made

Requirements

  • Programme management: Proven track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder programmes or workstreams in a large organisation – planning, dependency and risk management, governance, and reporting into senior programme structures.
  • Strategic analysis: Ability to structure ambiguous problems, conduct rigorous analysis, and develop clear, decision-ready recommendations for a senior audience.
  • Executive communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with demonstrable experience producing materials for executive and Board-level audiences.
  • Stakeholder engagement: Strong grasp of engaging with diverse stakeholders, covering business, technology and external partnerships, to align innovation efforts with bank priorities.
  • AI: Working knowledge of artificial intelligence and its practical application in financial services – sufficient to engage credibly with technical colleagues and strategic partners, and to translate technical progress into business terms.
  • Partnerships: Understanding of how strategic technology and AI partnerships are structured, governed and commercially realised within a large, regulated organisation.
  • Strategic: Proven track record in translating strategy into executable plans and measurable outcomes.

/WX/LP

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering (Productivity Suite).

Business:CTO Platforms (AI Platform)

Job ID：58138

Location: Guangzhou

Why join us?

HSBC Productivity Suite is our AI-powered workspace used by 250,000 colleagues across the bank. We’re moving beyond conversational generative AI to build intelligent agents and integrations that connect colleagues with trusted enterprise knowledge, services and workflows.

You’ll join a global engineering team solving complex problems at significant scale. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how artificial intelligence is designed, governed and used across HSBC, with real influence over architecture, engineering standards and product direction.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who wants to progress through engineering depth, delivery and influence.

The Opportunity

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系

根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门

配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline

At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳

至少5年以上客户经理经验

具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系

具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣

成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧

普通话及英语流利

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment.   • Architect and implement solutions using Java, Spring Framework, and Spring Integration.
  • Design and integrate secure authentication mechanisms using OAuth 2.0.
  • Develop and maintain robust data storage solutions using MongoDB.

Cloud And DevOps

  • Leverage AWS services to build and deploy cloud-native applications.
  • Implement containerized solutions using Kubernetes for scalability and reliability.
  • Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins to ensure smooth deployment processes.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, QA engineers, and operations teams.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders, providing updates on project progress and technical challenges.

Leadership Skills

  • Proven experience leading a team of multiple teams of developers, providing technical guidance and fostering a collaborative environment.
  • Ability to mentor junior developers and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.

Product Ownership

  • Strong product owner mentality, with a focus on understanding technical and customer needs while aligning with the product vision.
  • Experience in delivering greenfield projects from concept to production release.

Problem-Solving And Communication

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of articulating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

(Grade: GCB4 )

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

We are seeking a visionary Senior Digital Product Manager to lead the strategic evolution of our Wealth Management solutions within the HSBC Mobile App. In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and tangible digital execution. You will own the product roadmap, drive the delivery of transformative initiatives, and cultivate a high-performing, agile team culture that places our customers and risk management at the heart of everything we do. This is an on-site role based in our Shanghai office, fostering close collaboration and rapid innovation.

  • Strategic Vision & Roadmap Development
  • Define the Future: Leverage strategic foresight to design and own a comprehensive product roadmap that significantly enhances the competitiveness of HSBC’s Wealth Management capabilities on our Mobile App.
  • Customer-Centric Growth: Identify market trends and customer pain points to deliver solutions that drive measurable business growth and elevate the client experience.
  • Strategic Alignment: Ensure all product initiatives align with HSBC’s global wealth management objectives, digital transformation goals, and the strategic direction of the Digital Platform.
  • Execution, Delivery & Continuous Improvement
  • From Vision to Reality: Translate the strategic roadmap into a clear, actionable list of initiatives with well-defined OKRs (Objectives and Key Results).
  • Agile Leadership: Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, design, risk, operations) to deliver high-quality features efficiently. Ensure all delivery adheres to HSBC’s rigorous risk and compliance frameworks.
  • Iterative Excellence: Champion a culture of continuous improvement. Utilize data-driven insights and regular retrospectives to refine product direction, optimize user journeys, and accelerate time-to-market.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development
  • Inspire and Empower: Act as a catalyst for team growth, fostering an environment of psychological safety, innovation, and accountability.
  • Talent Cultivation: Identify potential within the team, provide mentorship, and create development plans to nurture the next generation of digital product leaders.
  • Collaborative Culture: Promote "We Succeed Together" by breaking down silos and encouraging diverse perspectives to solve complex product challenges.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of product management experience, with a strong track record in Wealth Management, Fintech, or Digital Banking.
  • Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to build and execute long-term roadmaps that deliver significant business impact.
  • Delivery Excellence: Deep understanding of Agile methodologies, OKR frameworks, and the ability to manage complex delivery cycles in a fast-paced environment.
  • Risk Awareness & Governance: Proactive Risk Management: Possess a robust understanding of operational, conduct, and reputational risks inherent in digital wealth products. You must be able to identify potential risks early in the product lifecycle and embed mitigation strategies into the design. Regulatory & Compliance Alignment: While distinct from pure compliance, you must demonstrate a keen awareness of the regulatory landscape (e.g., suitability, appropriateness, data privacy) and ensure all product features are designed to meet these standards without compromising user experience. Risk Culture: Champion a "Risk-Aware" culture within the product team, ensuring that risk considerations are a standard part of every sprint planning, review, and retrospective. You will work closely with the Risk and Compliance functions to ensure seamless governance.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated experience in leading, mentoring, and scaling high-performing product teams.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Finance, or a related field; MBA or relevant certification is a plus.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
