Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO

Job ID：66425

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead the internal frontend team in developing, delivering, and maintaining CDMS Teller X frontend modules, ensuring engineering quality and alignment with business priorities.
  • Partner with the outsourced delivery partner, to clarify requirements, align technical solutions, manage dependencies, and jointly deliver Teller X enhancements.
  • Lead the phased transition of all frontend development and maintenance responsibilities within the agreed handover scope from deliverty partner to the internal team, ensuring effective knowledge transfer, complete technical documentation, and continuity of delivery and support.
  • Build the internal team’s technical and operational capabilities to independently develop, maintain, and support the frontend functionality transitioned from delivery vendor.
  • Review frontend deliverables from vendor against agreed architecture, coding, testing, and security standards to support a sustainable transition to internal ownership.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with outsourced delivery partners and align internal and external teams on technical standards and delivery commitments.
  • Ability to lead technical knowledge transfer and ownership transitions, enabling internal teams to independently manage ongoing development and production support.
  • Strong hands-on frontend engineering experience, with a proven ability to lead developers and deliver enterprise applications.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with practical expertise in modern frontend frameworks such as React.
  • Solid experience with frontend architecture, component-based development, state management, routing, and reusable UI patterns.
  • Hands-on expertise in Node.js for supporting services, development tooling, automation, and application integration.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and implementing authentication, authorization, and robust error handling.
  • A strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility, browser compatibility, and frontend security principles.
  • Practical experience with automated testing, code reviews, static analysis, and engineering quality controls.
  • Strong proficiency in Git, including collaborative branching strategies, pull-request workflows, and release management.
  • Confident, practical use of AI-assisted engineering tools for development, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation, with appropriate validation and responsible handling of enterprise data.
  • Experience with frontend build tooling and CI/CD platforms, such as Webpack, Jenkins, and SonarQube, and familiarity with containerized deployment environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting and performance optimization skills, including browser profiling, rendering efficiency, and bundle optimization.
  • Experience delivering solutions from technology selection and design through implementation, deployment, and production support.
  • Ability to understand business requirements and technical documentation in English and translate them into clear, maintainable solutions.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills, with the ownership needed to manage cross-team handovers and lead independent delivery.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

汇丰保险经纪业务成立于2022年，作为我们在中国内地保险和财富产品分销的经纪渠道。作为汇丰集团的一部分，我们在中国内地致力于通过财富规划服务业务助力人们提高抵御风险能力、为他们自己及其亲人提供保障，实现他们的人生目标。

汇丰保险经纪为“汇丰财富规划服务”客户提供财富规划以及保险经纪服务，是国内首家持有保险经纪和基金销售双牌照的财富管理机构, 帮助客户实现资产多元化布局，也是汇丰集团100%全资持有的子公司，为不同类型的客户提供相关保障计划及财富配置服务。

汇丰财富规划服务作为汇丰全球重点战略项目之一，以客户的需求为中心，提供更灵活的财富配置体验，

通过创新数字解决方案，在客户指定的时间、地点，一对一量身定制资产配置方案。基于您人生不同阶段需求, 我们通过财富规划：

  • 厘清客户需求，搭建财富金字塔
  • 匹配保障性底层资产：精选保险产品，带来健康保障，规划传承
  • 代销优质基金产品*，多元配置资产
  • 产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型等；

工作职责

主要工作包括：

  • 拓展与服务于高净值个人客户，运用财富规划理念及数字工具，为高净值客户提供专业全面、量身打造的投资及保险保障等资产配置服务，包括但不限于保障、投资、子女教育、退休计划等；
  • 代理销售精选优质基金产品，产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型；为客户提供精选优质代销基金产品，带来高品质投资产品。
  • 通过高质量服务，为客户一对一量身定制财富规划，不断提高客户口碑推荐；
  • 确保个人与团队活动遵守相关法律法规的要求，且符合汇丰的标准和规程。

任职要求

  • 本科或以上学历，财务、商业等或相关专业为佳
  • 3年及以上金融销售和财富管理行业者或其他行业5年以上销售或销售管理经验
  • 善于沟通，较强的人际交往能力及表达能力
  • 积极进取，有自律意识，目标导向、能高效和独立地工作
  • 渴望学习和成长、有事业心，具备创业精神及商业思维及抗压能力
  • 具备较强的中文口头及书面沟通能力
  • 具有基金从业资格、国际金融理财师（CFP）或相关证书（AFP，EFP，CFA等）者优先考虑

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Company relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4490559251.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening

up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Be responsible for successful implementation of Premier Acquisition strategies
  • Acquire new-to-bank customers via central or self-generated leads.
  • In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to complete simple retail sales.
  • Development of strong working relationships with relevant business areas (e.g., WPB, Marketing, etc)
  • Delivery high standard customer service to meet customer satisfactory

Qualifications - External

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of one year proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
  • Sound knowledge of various forms of deposits, WEM product, mortgage, etc.
  • Knowledge of the constantly changing laws/regulations governing banks/finance industry, consumer trends, competitor offerings, economic and foreign currency markets
  • Strong presentation and sales skills
  • Objection handling techniques and work under pressure
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Customer service orientation
  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
  • Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

www.hsbc.com.cn/careers

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

Job ID: 63352

Job Board Tags:/WX/51/LP

Principal Responsibilities

Financial management

  • Manage ASP CTO financials including direct cost booking, recharge and recovery.
  • Ensure timely and accurate cost recognision, complete monthly Cadency reconciliations in line with accounting policy and adherence to operational risk control framework
  • Review direct cost monthly, perform variance analysis, and proactively raise insights, risks and corrective actions.

Support PO Centraliation process.

  • Provide clear executive summaries and management updates, supporting decision-making .
  • nfluence stakeholders to implement new policies/guidelines, using strong coordination, negotiation and judgement.

Stakeholder engagement (local customers & global teams)

  • Act as the primary Finance interface for China Technology stakeholders, partnering closely with global teams.
  • Coordinate across Finance, Procurement, Vendor Management and CTO teams to deliver end-to-end finance outcomes.
  • Translate finance requirements into practical actions for Technology teams, ensuring alignment to governance, timelines and deliverables.

Local regulatory & governance fulfilment (China)

  • Ensure finance operations meet local statutory/regulatory requirements, including audit readiness and documentation standards.
  • Maintain strong controls in Risk/Compliance to remediate issues on time.
  • Maintain evidence packs and governance artefacts to support audits, inspections and internal reviews.

Process simplification & continuous improvement

  • Identify pain points, duplication and manual activities across CTO Infrastructure finance processes.
  • Drive simplification, standardisation and automation (where feasible) to improve efficiency, strengthen controls and enhance transparency.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in Finance, accounting, financial control, planning and analysis.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • A continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to simplify and standardise processes and support the adoption of AI and new tools.

ln:4490559197.descriptionHtml:
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking(CIB)

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Co-ordinate origination and execution of in-country activities across the spectrum of banking products/service.
  • Build the Banking franchise value/reputation in the market place.
  • Drive achievement against targets for revenue generation, product alignment, customer satisfaction and cost containment.
  • Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk.
  • Identify event driven opportunities on an opportunistic basis, bringing in sector/country expertise as appropriate.
  • Aggressively grow HSBC's share of client wallet involving product specialists to ensure product capabilities are in line with client/sector requirements.
  • By critically assessing the exposures of each customer through vigorous review processes, active communications with CST members and frequent update of market intelligence. Such reviews are to be completed on time as required by the account review cycle and also where deemed necessary.
  • By working closely with Credit Risk Management to ensure that all credits are in compliance of both internal and external requirements and to formulate / implement exit or rehabilitation strategies for substandard credits. The primary goals are to safeguard the Bank for any material loss and to obtain an optimal balance between risk and return.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Ability to provide marketing support to senior relationship managers
  • Ability to establish rapport with members of client's management team
  • Ability to provide good analytical support to senior relationship managers
  • Strong PC skills (excel, powerpoint etc)
  • Good team player
  • Knowledge of HSBC Group structures and products
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Knowledge of the spectrum of banking products and services
  • Understanding of risk management and credit mitigants
  • Good level of financial analysis ability

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4490547776.descriptionHtml:
CIB - Markets Operations

This team is the backbone of our Global Markets business (one of the largest of its kind in the world) and combines sophisticated 24-hour global coverage with a detailed knowledge of local markets and specialises in foreign exchange, credits and rates, structured derivatives, equities and debt, equity and equity-linked capital markets.

Markets Operations is responsible for driving every part of the trade lifecycle post-execution. This team manages settlement activity, risk and control, adherence to regulatory compliance, and seamless operational client service across 58 countries and territories.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Ensure the successful processing of daily margin payments, & that all FIM, Audit and regulatory controls and requirements are met at all times.
  • Ensure that we know and understand the business, organisation structure and contacts of all our clearing clients & internal clients.
  • Ensure that we act as an effective point of contact for our clearing and collateral clients on any transaction, account, margin static or market / product related query.
  • Ensure that client queries are handled in a professional manner by acknowledging, owning to resolution and demonstrating turnaround in line with what has been agreed.
  • Act as a second level check when not conducting margin call processing or inputting.
  • Daily review of bank reconciliation items and clearance of these items within agreed timeframes
  • Implement a strong client profiling process.
  • Active participation in the design, testing and rollout of new processes and strategic systems.
  • Provide support & share knowledge on markets, products, procedures and core operating platforms for team-members.
  • Ensure that you subscribe to formal objectives & personal development program with your manager.
  • Ensure that you actively seek regular 1:1 meetings and commit to written minutes and follow-up actions.
  • Participate actively to teamwork & leadership training & initiatives provided by the Bank.
  • Participate readily in operations and business related projects.
  • Safeguards the Company from potential loss and ensures that all procedures are strictly adhered to.
  • Constantly reviewing procedures and workflows, identifying necessary changes or enhancement and escalating to the line managers.
  • Ensure that daily controls & checklists are completed accurately and on a timely manner, providing appropriate policing and enforcement within the team.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

The Candidate Must Demonstrate a Strong Understanding Of

  • Global Markets products
  • Margin and Collateral
  • Clients and operational processing risk
  • HSBC FIM and risk requirements around generic practices

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Fraud Investigator Specialist.

Principal responsibilities

  • Handle inbound/outbound customer calls in English and Mandarin for fraud verification, lost card cases, and fraud reporting.
  • Monitor and action fraud alerts across cards and payments, verifying suspicious activity with customers.
  • Take immediate prevention actions (e.g., stop/decline transactions, block/replace cards, apply account safeguards).
  • Document case outcomes accurately and escalate higher-risk or complex cases for investigation.
  • Work closely with China and India teams to deliver consistent coverage and service standards.

Requirements

  • Fluency in Mandarin and English with confident, customer-friendly phone communication skills.
  • Strong judgement and ability to make timely, risk-based decisions while following defined procedures and controls.
  • High attention to detail with accurate case documentation and system updating.
  • Ability to manage high call volumes, prioritise workloads, and work effectively in a fast-paced, shift-based environment.
  • A collaborative mindset and comfort working across locations (China and India) and with multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience in fraud operations, financial crime operations, cards/payments operations, or a customer contact centre risk role will be a plus.
  • Willingness to work 24/7 rotating shifts, including weekends and public holidays, as required.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Be responsible for successful implementation of Premier Acquisition strategies
  • Acquire new-to-bank customers via central or self-generated leads.
  • In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to complete simple retail sales.
  • Development of strong working relationships with relevant business areas (e.g., WPB, Marketing, etc)
  • Delivery high standard customer service to meet customer satisfactory
  • 负责中高端客户的开发，发掘关于银行服务的需求并发展为汇丰客户
  • 通过银行渠道或者自己开发的渠道成功获取新客户
  • 为客户提供优良的服务，完成基本的零售销售指标
  • 与相关业务领域建立牢固的工作关系（如：财富管理及个人银行业务部，市场部）
  • 提供高标准的客户服务，提高客户满意度

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of one year proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
  • Sound knowledge of various forms of deposits, WEM product, mortgage, etc.
  • Knowledge of the constantly changing laws/regulations governing banks/finance industry, consumer trends, competitor offerings, economic and foreign currency markets
  • Strong presentation and sales skills
  • Objection handling techniques and work under pressure
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Customer service orientation
  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
  • Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN
  • 本科以上或同等学历
  • 至少一年金融服务或零售经验，或同等工作经验
  • 对各种形式的存款，WEM产品，抵押贷款等产品有充分的了解
  • 对行业法规，消费趋势，竞争对手的产品，经济和外汇市场趋势有较好的了解
  • 较好的演讲和销售技巧
  • 较好的异议处理技巧，能在高压下工作
  • 良好的人际交往和沟通能力
  • 以客户服务为导向

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Fraud Investigator Specialist.

Principal responsibilities

  • Handle inbound/outbound customer calls in English and Mandarin for fraud verification, lost card cases, and fraud reporting.
  • Monitor and action fraud alerts across cards and payments, verifying suspicious activity with customers.
  • Take immediate prevention actions (e.g., stop/decline transactions, block/replace cards, apply account safeguards).
  • Document case outcomes accurately and escalate higher-risk or complex cases for investigation.
  • Work closely with China and India teams to deliver consistent coverage and service standards.

Requirements

  • Fluency in Mandarin and English with confident, customer-friendly phone communication skills.
  • Strong judgement and ability to make timely, risk-based decisions while following defined procedures and controls.
  • High attention to detail with accurate case documentation and system updating.
  • Ability to manage high call volumes, prioritise workloads, and work effectively in a fast-paced, shift-based environment.
  • A collaborative mindset and comfort working across locations (China and India) and with multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience in fraud operations, financial crime operations, cards/payments operations, or a customer contact centre risk role will be a plus.
  • Willingness to work 24/7 rotating shifts, including weekends and public holidays, as required.

Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AVP, Investigative Tooling.

Principal responsibilities

Impact on the Business

  • Support agreed use cases from discovery through controlled production release by completing assigned analysis, prototyping, engineering, testing and deployment activities. Translate defined user needs into practical technical outputs and provide evidence against agreed measures for investigation quality, decision consistency, detection effectiveness, investigator capacity, risk reduction, safety, control, reliability and supportability.
  • Contribute to reusable templates, libraries, evaluation harnesses and reference implementations, following established standards and documenting work so it can be maintained and reused by other squads.

Customer / Stakeholders

  • Work with Product Owners, investigators, Financial Crime subject-matter experts, Technology teams and control functions to understand defined use cases, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes. Gather field evidence, support workflow testing, prepare user guidance and training materials, and raise observed workarounds, automation bias, control degradation or adoption issues to the Senior Forward Deployment Engineer and relevant owner.

Leadership and Teamwork

  • Deliver assigned forward-deployment work under the technical direction of the Senior Forward Deployment Engineer. Apply agreed engineering, evaluation and safety standards; clarify ambiguous requirements; document assumptions and decisions; raise risks, blockers and failed assumptions early; and share learning and reusable work with engineers and analysts across Investigative Tooling.
  • Demonstrate inclusive collaboration across geographies, roles and backgrounds, welcoming different perspectives to reach better outcomes faster.
  • Communicate progress, technical options, trade-offs, dependencies and risks clearly, seeking guidance and escalating early where decisions or additional support are required.

Operational Effectiveness and Control

  • Build, test and support capabilities using agreed engineering practices, proportionate controls and defined evaluation methods. Produce the technical evidence required for release and confirm that ownership, support, monitoring, incident response, change, rollback and decommissioning arrangements have been documented by the accountable owners. Support production monitoring and promptly escalate breaches of agreed quality, safety, performance, cost or control thresholds.

Management of Risk

  • For each assigned deployment, identify and document relevant operational, conduct, data, model, cybersecurity and financial crime risks using approved methods. Provide evidence for required reviews and approvals, implement agreed human-review, monitoring, rollback and suspension controls, and escalate gaps or concerns to the Senior Forward Deployment Engineer and accountable control owner. Follow approved architecture, engineering and governance standards and support remediation of audit or regulatory findings.

Requirements

  • Hands-on engineering experience in Python and exposure to PyTorch or an equivalent machine-learning framework, gained through employment, internships, academic work or substantial personal projects. Working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, API integration, evaluation, cloud technologies, automated testing, deployment practices and observability, with the ability to apply secure engineering principles under guidance.
  • Experience contributing to the development or delivery of software or AI capabilities through several stages of the lifecycle, such as user discovery, prototyping, testing, release or operational support. Familiarity with enterprise integration, data pipelines, production monitoring, incident management, resilience and controlled change is desirable; direct ownership of each stage is not required.
  • An interest in financial crime investigations and the ability to learn relevant workflows, evidence standards and case-management practices. Able to work with business stakeholders to understand use cases and acceptance criteria, explain technical work clearly, collaborate in a multidisciplinary team, respond constructively to challenge, and escalate competing delivery, operational or control priorities.
  • Desirable: Exposure to agentic AI systems, model or platform evaluation, latency and cost optimisation, reusable engineering components, embedded product-delivery models, or integration with Spring Boot or React applications. Deep implementation expertise in these areas is not required.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.

Apply agreed engineering, evaluation and safety standards; clarify ambiguous requirements; document assumptions and decisions; raise risks, blockers and failed assumptions early; and share learning and reusable work with engineers and analysts across Investigative Tooling.
- Demonstrate inclusive collaboration across geographies, roles and backgrounds, welcoming different perspectives to reach better outcomes faster.
- Communicate progress, technical options, trade-offs, dependencies and risks clearly, seeking guidance and escalating early where decisions or additional support are required.
Operational Effectiveness and Control
- Build, test and support capabilities using agreed engineering practices, proportionate controls and defined evaluation methods. Produce the technical evidence required for release and confirm that ownership, support, monitoring, incident response, change, rollback and decommissioning arrangements have been documented by the accountable owners. Support production monitoring and promptly escalate breaches of agreed quality, safety, performance, cost or control thresholds.
Management of Risk
- For each assigned deployment, identify and document relevant operational, conduct, data, model, cybersecurity and financial crime risks using approved methods. Provide evidence for required reviews and approvals, implement agreed human-review, monitoring, rollback and suspension controls, and escalate gaps or concerns to the Senior Forward Deployment Engineer and accountable control owner. Follow approved architecture, engineering and governance standards and support remediation of audit or regulatory findings.
Requirements
- Hands-on engineering experience in Python and exposure to PyTorch or an equivalent machine-learning framework, gained through employment, internships, academic work or substantial personal projects. Working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, API integration, evaluation, cloud technologies, automated testing, deployment practices and observability, with the ability to apply secure engineering principles under guidance.
- Experience contributing to the development or delivery of software or AI capabilities through several stages of the lifecycle, such as user discovery, prototyping, testing, release or operational support. Familiarity with enterprise integration, data pipelines, production monitoring, incident management, resilience and controlled change is desirable; direct ownership of each stage is not required.
- An interest in financial crime investigations and the ability to learn relevant workflows, evidence standards and case-management practices. Able to work with business stakeholders to understand use cases and acceptance criteria, explain technical work clearly, collaborate in a multidisciplinary team, respond constructively to challenge, and escalate competing delivery, operational or control priorities.
- Desirable: Exposure to agentic AI systems, model or platform evaluation, latency and cost optimisation, reusable engineering components, embedded product-delivery models, or integration with Spring Boot or React applications. Deep implementation expertise in these areas is not required.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

ln:4490558270.descriptionHtml:
CIB - Global Trade Solutions (GTS)

Trade has been the foundation of HSBC since 1865, it is evolving fast and so are we. With our network, expertise, and solutions we’re placed to help clients make sense of emerging trends, risks, and opportunities by being the global connectors, innovative problem solvers and strategic partners.

We connect the world through trade. Our footprint gives clients access to roughly 90% of world trade flows providing a powerful mix of local, regional, and global knowledge to help them spot new growth opportunities. We are innovative problem solvers that provide a safer, smoother digital trade experience. We solve business challenges through growth, disruption, or uncertainty, and we bring clients insights and ideas to enable grow and protect their business.

Our comprehensive suite of products and services can be combined into global solutions that help make it easier for businesses to manage trade risk, process trade transactions, and fund trade activities.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Grow business volume through delivering an exceptional customer experience and proactively engaging customers for business.
  • Retain business through addressing customer issues and feedback/complaints related to GTS transactions.
  • Refer new business opportunities to Sales and RM teams.
  • Provide customer feedback to applicable GTS teams when propositions impact the customer experience.
  • Provide an industry-leading customer experience for high-value GTS customers, with a view to increasing and retaining business.
  • Provide value-added service to customers, including advice on GTS products, processes, and transaction documentation, Service Reviews, Trade Academies, and other events.
  • Liaise with GTS Services, Sales, Relationship Managers, WCOO and other stakeholders to ensure customer issues are addressed and urgent transactions are processed in a timely manner.
  • Maintain visibility of customer feedback, errors, and complaints received, addressing and remediating them where addressable and providing feedback to other teams where applicable.
  • Provide customers with technical advisory and clarification on transactional issues.
  • Actively follow urgent transactions from key customers to completion.
  • Prioritise activities efficiently, according to the value provided to customers and the bank.
  • Ensure adherence to all applicable laws, regulations, Group policies, procedures and standards.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University degree and/or experience relevant to customer service, sales, or operations
  • Solid knowledge of Core Trade, Guarantees, Supply Chain and/or Receivables Finance
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including verbal and written communication skills (in

English and local language) and the ability to negotiate and influence others

  • Ability to use strong judgement to identify and resolve problems whilst maintaining

service performance

  • Demonstrated ability to multitask and work independently, as well as work

collaboratively

  • Ability to manage crises; making good and timely decisions in tough situations
  • Desirable: knowledge of HSBC’s organization structure, business products/ solutions

particularly GTS and eChannel’s, operations and systems/processes

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4490559390.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Customer Relations Manager.

Principal responsibilities

  • Handle escalated complaints from various channels via an end-to-end process from complaint classification, review, investigation, resolution recommended to communications with customers concerned.
  • Resolve customer complaints and build customer loyalty to ensure relationship retention and uphold the Bank integrity and good reputation
  • Maintain service excellence and effectiveness in interacting with customers in a professional manner including verbal and written communications
  • Ensure the complaint handling meeting the internal quality and control standards plus regulatory requirements
  • Leverage AI Technology to optimize the complaint handling process and support the execution of a range of complaint-related tasks.
  • Collect and report on customer pain points and recommend customer journey enhancements to uplift customer experience and preempt customer complaints
  • Share best practices of complaint handling with other customers facing colleagues
  • Undertake speedy actions to minimize impacts of incidents affecting respective daily operations and business activities
  • Proactively instill HSBC core values and business principles

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, business or related discipline;
  • University degree in related discipline or relevant experience
  • Work experience in financial institutions including good exposure to complaint handling tasks and customer-facing experience
  • Familiar with retail and wealth management products and services plus and related operations preferred
  • Customer centric mindset, strong business sense plus positive and sincere work attitude
  • High degree of personal drive and resilience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills including fluent in English, Cantonese, and Putonghua

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

  • Minimum of one year proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
  • Sound knowledge of various forms of deposits, WEM product, mortgage, etc.
  • Knowledge of the constantly changing laws/regulations governing banks/finance industry, consumer trends, competitor offerings, economic and foreign currency markets
  • Strong presentation and sales skills
  • Objection handling techniques and work under pressure
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Customer service orientation
  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
  • Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN

  • 对行业法规，消费趋势，竞争对手的产品，经济和外汇市场趋势有较好的了解
  • 较好的演讲和销售技巧
  • 较好的异议处理技巧，能在高压下工作
  • 良好的人际交往和沟通能力

This role supports one or more Relationship Managers to deepen high net worth or ultra high net worth individual client relationships and improve income generation through focused business development activities.

  • Prompt and appropriate action taken to address client feedback/complaints.
  • Build and maintain positive and productive working relationships internally and externally
  • Ensure smooth coordination with processing departments

  • Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, related field or equivalent experience
  • Proven and progressive private banking experience or equivalent
  • Proven customer service, communications, sales, mathematical, analytical, organizational, and planning skills
  • Good understanding of the major products/services available in the private banking industry
  • IT Skills – knowledge of Microsoft Office Applications
  • Excellent communication skills
  • A good team player with drive for success and achievement

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

  • Lead the collaboration with group digital sales team and execute long-term strategy of digital channel wealth sales by leveraging the existing digital presence and capabilities to formulate and implement strategies.
  • Target and achieve digital wealth products (e.g. LUT) and customer penetration and expand sales volume and AUM.
  • Lead digital sales proposition development and develop a coherent and executable partnership strategy to drive new digital leads, content partnerships and realize new commercial benefits from the delivered platforms.
  • Develop a deep understanding of existing and target client segments, markets and regulatory requirements, keep highly sensitive to industry trends and gain new business opportunities.
  • Lead daily sales material (article, video, etc.) post process and quality control, work close with product team and marketing team on digital communications e.g. promotion webpage, display ad, etc.
  • Manage interactions with internal and external parties regularly for on-time, in-budget campaign implementations.
  • Embracing customer centricity in every decision and action of our business.
  • Ensuring the conduct of business complies with all regulatory requirements and internal policies.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • At least 8 years working experience for digital channel wealth operation.
  • Proven track record of developing business and meeting sales targets.
  • Strategic Thought Leadership: Creative and proactive in proposing new business opportunities and solving complex customer or operational challenges.
  • Project Management: Competent in project planning, reporting, and managing shifting or competing priorities with flexibility.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Proven ability to build strong relationships and influence large, cross-functional teams, including those with direct leadership authority.
  • Good understanding of asset management and solid knowledge of financial markets, mutual fund products, rich experience of influencing retail investor psychology and behavior.
  • Solid Chinese and English article writing skills, strong interpersonal, influencing and communication skills and able to be written communication in English.
  • Knowledge or ability to navigate the industry and local regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to be a self-starter and work independently as well as part of a team.
  • Holding the Fund Practitioner Qualification Certification.
  • Prefer majoring in Economics and Marketing.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. ln:4490540977.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of FINANCIAL SERVICES CLERK.

Principal responsibilities

  • Calculation and disbursement of management, advisory, administration, performance and custody fees;基金净值计算 （每日，每周或每月）；
  • Prepare financial statements and other financial related reports (as agreed) with the clients; 管理，咨询，资产服务，业绩和托管费用的计算和支付 ；
  • Clearing reconciliation breaks between Broker and our books of records;账目核对，检查并处理账目系统与银行流水中的缺失科目；
  • File records of correspondences and processed instructions for audit purposes;记录通信和客户指令的文件用于审计目的的；
  • Accounting and accrual of fund expense;基金相关费用的会计分录及支付；
  • Delivery of accurate and timely report to Clients;客户定制报告服务。

Requirements

  • University graduate or above and Financial/accounting internship experience is preferable ;大学本科及以上学历,有财务/会计实习经验者优先；
  • Good knowledge of institutional funds and financial/investment related instruments / terms / fund services operations;熟悉金融工具或投资相关的产品和术语以及基金的运营服务
  • Excellent communication skills in spoken and written English;英语听说读写流利
  • Excellent team worker and Good interpersonal skill;;良好的团队合作精神和人际交往能力
  • Sound PC knowledge in Excel and MS Word; 熟练电脑操作（包括Word/Excel）
  • High integrity and professionalism;高度的正直和专业精神
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines;能够承受一定的工作压力和在规定时间内完成日常工作
  • Accept morning shift; 接受早班的上班制
  • The internship period can be three to six months, with three working days a week (part-day work is acceptable) and weekends off.实习期能三至六个月，每周满足三天的上班时间（可接受半天上班），周末双休

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist.

Business:Group Functions Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Provide technical consultation to development team members with guidance of department principles. Lead teams or projects of high complexity. Initiates and conducts feasibility studies of new and modified business requirement.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Proactively manage a complex portfolio of clients, becoming a trusted advisor to lead strategic dialogues with clients at a portfolio level through the understanding of specific business requirements and delivering creative and flexible customer solutions
  • To hand over customer relationship properly to their relationship managers after closing sales
  • To provide excellent services to customers and ensure all enquiries and complaints are accurately and effectively resolved to customers' satisfaction- To participate actively in team building activities to share information/ideas while contributing suggestions for work improvement- Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University degree or above (recognized by the state)
  • Strong interpersonal skills and effective presentation skills
  • Well-developed service and sales attitude with ability to work under pressure- Presentable, Outgoing and Persuasive- Good oral and written English is preferable

主要职责

  • 主要负责中高端客户的开发，向潜在客户介绍汇丰的服务，发掘关于银行服务的需求并发展为汇丰客户
  • 负责销售渠道的开发以及维护, 负责前期客户关系的维护和客户关系的交接
  • 为客户提供优良的服务，确保客户的询问得到准确有效的回复，提高客户满意度- 主动接洽合作渠道、持续跟踪潜在客户名单直至成功开户，完成银行设定的工作目标- 确保有高标准的专业知识，与潜在客户进行更好的沟通

岗位要求

  • 本科或以上学历(国家认可)；
  • 优秀的人际交往和有效的沟通技巧；- 能够在高压下工作，良好的服务和销售态度；- 得体, 外向和具有说服力；- 有良好的英语口语和书写能力

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Job Summary

This role could be based in Singapore or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop-down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you only select a country where the role is based

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
  • Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
  • Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
  • Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
  • Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.

Business

  • Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
  • Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
  • Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
  • Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
  • Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.

Governance

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 6+ years’ experience in software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
  • Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
  • Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
  • Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
  • Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
  • Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
  • Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Software Engineering
  • Software Development
  • Application Design,
  • Architecture

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory and Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 6+ years’ experience in software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
  • Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
  • Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
  • Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
  • Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
  • Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
  • Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Software Engineering
  • Software Development
  • Application Design
  • Architecture

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

Job Summary

  • Accountable to ensure regulated role requests are processed within the agreed timelines.
  • Accountable for day-to-day production planning for regulated regime operations team.
  • The collation and reporting of management information.
  • Identify any gaps, process enhancements and implement the agreed process changes.
  • Effective change management adoption.
  • Ensure all process DOI’s are up to date, with regular reviews and signoff.
  • Challenging the MI and ensure that it is accurate and up to date.
  • Lead CR Operations Projects end to end and ensuring compliance with the obligations timely (including UAT, UVT etc.)
  • Should be good in advance excel skills.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Stakeholder management.
  • Change management.
  • Establish data standards, definitions and documentation to ensure consistency and comparability across reports.

Processes

  • Accountability for issuance/completion of certification for eligible New/Existing regime roles.
  • Ensure periodic activities are proactively planned and executed timely.
  • Ensure all regime ops related documents are maintained in repository.
  • Records retention and timely destruction as per the documented process.
  • Timely communication to the stakeholders as applicable.
  • To identify and capture the list of High-Risk Exceptions (HRE) scenarios from the of processes managed within operations.
  • To consolidate the appropriate MI exception and its evidence.

Regulatory Submission

  • Timely submission of up-to-date records for regulatory purpose.

Risk Management

  • Ensure 100% accuracy in all operational activities.
  • Identifying, reporting, and escalating issues, risks to ops lead.
  • Accountability for any audit and compliance issues to be resolved in timely manner.
  • Effective processes are established and maintained to identify, manage, monitor, and report risk.
  • Systems and procedures to safeguard the security, integrity, and confidentiality of information.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • The People Leaders, Business Assistant’s, SMR BPM’s, CFCR, Resourcing Team, GSSP Team, PRB Ops team, HR Ops, PSS Team, SharePoint Team.

Skills And Experience

  • Influencing Through Expertise
  • Data Governance
  • Data Gathering and Analysis
  • Relationship Management
  • Effective Communications
  • Regulatory Reporting and Filing
  • Project Management

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

ln:4490703608.descriptionHtml:
职位目标

  • 借助行内各种渠道,进行新客户开发,参与行内外组织的客户推介活动,积累客户资源
  • 为支行或分行营业部新客户提供客户开户服务和维护,日常咨询方面的需求,增加客户在我行的资产占比,以达到银行预期的业务和服务目标
  • 发展成为银行的丰盛理财经理储备人才

主要职责

渠道开发和拓展合格丰盛理财客户

  • 开拓挖掘新客户获取渠道（如战略合作伙伴，客户推荐，行内活动等），为我行新增合格丰盛理财客户。
  • 维护和优化现有渠道质量，主动探索深化与渠道合作伙伴关系，在拓展新客工作中实现高效协同。
  • 负责新客户开发的全流程：对潜在客户进行定向触达和资质筛选，为新客户开立账户，完成申请和相关文档。
  • 达成银行下达的各项销售任务，达到销售目标，为团队整体增长指标做出贡献。

协作式客户关系管理

  • 与客户经理紧密合作，与潜在客户积极互动，主动收集客户洞察（如风险偏好，财务目标等），确保客户交接顺畅和持续支持。
  • 向客户引介我行全球财富管理解决方案，突出贴合其财务目标的价值主张。
  • 主动处理和跟进客户的要求和查询，按照银行服务标准提供及时有效的解决方案，维持良好的客户满意度和留存率。

审计和合规控制

  • 遵守银行的政策、标准、操作准则/规程、安保及内部控制和合规措施，尤其是分支机构当地的操作规程。
  • 遵守由当地监管机构做出的规则和规定，尤其是那些适用于销售过程的规则和规定。

职责管辖范畴

  • 丰盛理财业务发展经理向丰盛理财业务发展团队经理汇报，并需负责达到和超越本行所分配之各项销售指标。

教育背景和相关工作经验要求

教育经历

  • 拥有正规学历，商务或财务相关专业优先考虑
  • 对外资银行工作抱有热忱

工作经验

  • 有相关销售经验和客户开发经验者优先

专业技能要求

  • 技术知识: 具备主动高效的客户沟通技巧，擅长通过专业化，场景化沟通话术
  • 多重任务: 能够驾驭多个优先事务，保持敏锐的关注和精力水平，管理时间，以获得积极的成果
  • 产品知识: 具备银行有关产品和服务知识者优先

Location:

PRC - Beijing

Job:

Schedule:

Contract (Fixed Term)

Employee Status:

Full time

ln:4490704917.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Technology Management.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • You will be leading the architecture design, governance, implementation and support of the Private Banking integrated service platform.
  • Work closely with the technology, delivery and business outcome leads to design and implement solutions aligned with the OKRs.
  • You will be an experienced capable software engineer who is looking to build on your development skills to contribute more to the strategic direction and design of technology solutions across different technology platforms.
  • Define the current state, target state and transition state architectures for specific business domain.
  • Review and discuss technical solutions and decisions with the architecture working group, identifying where formal governance and signing off is required.
  • Collaborate with the product feature teams (pods) of your business domain to help develop the product using your experience to help guide the team through the whole development lifecycle
  • Ensure governance requirements are captured, and audit requirements are met. Demonstrating adherence to controls
  • Ensure that technical decisions and information are reviewed and agreed with the security teams.

Requirements

  • A background in financial services, ideally in a large organization
  • Experience of API and service-based architectures using REST APIs, micro-services and utilizing JSON for web or mobile applications.
  • Track record architecting cloud solutions, particularly with AWS and EKS.
  • Experience of security concepts and building internet security solutions.
  • Experience in business process workflow management and optimization.
  • A software engineering background ideally in java or similar technologies.
  • Experience working in or with agile product feature teams using methodologies like Scrum.
  • Use of collaboration tools and agile ways of working with Confluence, Jira, etc.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Knowledge Management Enablement Manager.

As Knowledge Management Enablement Manager within Risk and Compliance and the Chief AI Officer function, you’ll support the adoption of HSBC’s enterprise knowledge and knowledge-intelligence layer across R&C Value Streams. This is a transformation and change role focused on enablement and adoption rather than building the underlying platform, which is delivered by a separate BAU knowledge and data team. You’ll work with Value Streams and the AI Enablement Lead to connect knowledge foundations to the agentic AI migration agenda. Success means supporting the onboarding of workflows and use cases onto the knowledge-intelligence layer, with clear data and knowledge readiness coverage across Value Streams. You’ll also help improve how Value Stream requirements are translated into governed, build-ready designs and how adoption is measured and reported.

Principal responsibilities

  • Support the change and adoption of knowledge management and knowledge-intelligence standards across R&C Value Streams.
  • Work with Value Streams to understand and help translate knowledge and unstructured-data needs into governed, build-ready designs
  • Coordinate with the BAU knowledge and data engineering team to support the prioritisation and delivery of the knowledge-intelligence layer, including FIBO-aligned ontology, semantic layer, hybrid search and GraphRAG foundations
  • Help maintain clear scope boundaries and RACI with the BAU team so that build and operational accountability is not duplicated
  • Support the interface between knowledge management delivery and the agentic AI migration agenda, helping to ensure knowledge foundations are fit for purpose for AI migration and Value Stream AI workflows
  • Help track and report adoption of the knowledge layer across Value Streams
  • Support the Head of AI Monitoring and Governance with evidence and data-quality standards relevant to knowledge management

Requirements

  • Bring experience or a strong interest in knowledge management, information architecture, or data and content strategy
  • Demonstrate familiarity with RAG, semantic search or related knowledge-intelligence concepts
  • Help translate business needs into governed delivery designs across business and technical teams
  • Build effective working relationships with stakeholders across Value Streams, product owners, AI leads and central enablement teams
  • Support change or transformation activity, including the use of clear adoption measures and reporting
  • Work comfortably with unstructured data requirements and knowledge standards in a governed environment
  • Bring financial services experience, with exposure to Risk and Compliance desirable but not essential
  • Demonstrate a willingness to learn, collaborate and develop expertise in knowledge management enablement and emerging AI-related capabilities

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment.
