We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AI Migration Lead

Principal responsibilities

  • Own the R&C AI portfolio strategy and prioritisation, working closely with the R&C CAIO to translate top-down strategy and target outcomes into an executable, portfolio-level roadmap.
  • Aggregate value and delivery progress from across Value Streams to portfolio level, and instrument the relevant benefit metrics (efficiency & capacity, adoption & maturity) feeding the R&C CAIO's overall benefit-tracking framework.
  • Own the prioritisation and escalation mechanism across Value Streams: chair a regular portfolio prioritisation forum with Value Stream Product Owners and Value Stream AI Leads, and escalate unresolved conflicts to the R&C CAIO.
  • Lead the AI Migration team: a central, flexible technical pool deployed into Value Streams on a solid-line basis to this role, with a dotted-line working relationship into the Value Stream while deployed.
  • Ensure the AI Migration team operates as the bridge between business SMEs and agentic architecture translating and migrating manual or semi-manual tasks into governed, agentic and automated workflows.
  • Partner with Group Technology and the Group AI Platform function, including the Architecture Lead capability, to ensure portfolio delivery aligns to Group tooling, platform and architecture standards.
  • Partner with the Re-engineering team and the Knowledge Management Enablement Lead as shared capabilities supporting the migration agenda.
  • Enable, R&C Value Streams Product Owners and Leads to deliver against set targets.

Requirements

  • Technical leadership: Background in analytics, data, engineering, AI or a closely related technical discipline, with credibility to lead multidisciplinary technical delivery teams. Able to challenge technical approaches, delivery plans, dependencies and trade-offs with credibility.
  • AI-enabled process transformation: Demonstrable experience re-engineering complex business processes and translating them into automation or AI-enabled solutions, ideally within Risk, Compliance, Financial Crime or Controls.
  • Scaled technical delivery: Proven experience leading multiple technical pods across concurrent delivery streams, bringing together engineering, product, data/AI and business SMEs to deliver complex outcomes.

Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We’re currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AI Migration Engineer.

AI is reshaping how regulated organisations run and evidence controls and Risk and Compliance is no exception. This role focuses on simplifying and re-engineering Risk & Compliance processes end to end then rebuilding them as governed agentic AI workflows running in production. You’ll work closely with process owners to map current-state journeys and design target-state workflows that make clear where humans stay in the loop. Success means safer faster processes with measurable improvements in cycle time error rate and cost and with documentation that stands up to audit and regulatory scrutiny. You’ll also contribute reusable patterns and shared components across the Chief AI Officer function in Risk & Compliance.

Principal responsibilities

  • Map Risk & Compliance processes end to end with process owners including inputs hand-offs data lineage controls and exceptions
  • Simplify processes before automation by removing redundant steps duplicate controls manual reconciliations and rework loops
  • Re-engineer target processes around agentic patterns with explicit human-in-the-loop decisions and control points
  • Build and integrate agentic workflows using LLMs tool calling and MCP connecting to Risk & Compliance systems data platforms and document stores
  • Implement retrieval patterns including RAG GraphRAG and hybrid search grounded in Risk & Compliance policy regulatory and risk data
  • Replace or wrap legacy components such as spreadsheets macros scripts and EUCs with maintainable version-controlled code
  • Build evaluation harnesses for accuracy faithfulness robustness and regression using golden datasets agreed with the business
  • Embed controls and deploy via LLMOps pipelines with monitoring for drift quality cost and latency plus parallel runs cutover and rollback plans

Requirements

  • Bring substantial hands-on experience in software data or ML engineering including proven delivery of LLM-based applications into production
  • Demonstrate strong Python engineering with experience across APIs containers CI/CD and cloud platforms such as Azure GCP or AWS
  • Build RAG pipelines and retrieval approaches including vector and hybrid search and apply agent orchestration frameworks in production settings
  • Create evaluation and monitoring approaches that cover accuracy faithfulness robustness regression drift quality and guardrails
  • Show proven depth in at least one of these areas with working knowledge across the others - skills and monitoring or orchestration and MCP or tools refactoring or deployment and GUI
  • Apply strong engineering practice including automated testing code review Git and reliable CI/CD ways of working
  • Handle data confidently across structured and unstructured sources including documents PDFs and emails with strong SQL capability
  • Deliver within a regulated environment with experience evidencing controls for audit and regulators and working within model risk data protection and change governance

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

We’re currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AI Monitoring and Governance Manager

As AI adoption accelerates across Risk and Compliance, consistent governance and monitoring standards are essential to ensure controls keep pace with innovation. This role sets 1st Line of Defence standards for AI governance, monitoring, evidence and control across all AI deployments in Risk and Compliance, working closely with the independent 2nd Line of Defence AI Risk team. You’ll define how Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) operating modes are governed and evidenced as workflows mature from shadow use through to exception-only. Success means clear, practical standards that sub-functions can apply consistently without duplicating independent oversight. You’ll maintain an AI use case and agent inventory with robust evidence to support audit and regulatory readiness. Over time you’ll help progress a roadmap that embeds these standards within each domain as it matures.

Principal responsibilities

  • Own the Risk and Compliance 1LoD framework for AI governance, monitoring, evidence and controls
  • Define and maintain operating standards for HITL modes from Shadow through to Exception-Only
  • Set criteria and evidence requirements to progress AI workflows between HITL modes
  • Anchor AI governance and monitoring standards to relevant internal and regulatory frameworks for R&C AI deployments
  • Provide central guidance, support and monitoring across Risk and Compliance sub-functions during the maturity phase
  • Maintain the R&C AI use case and agent inventory and the associated evidence repository for audit and regulatory readiness
  • Partner closely with the 2LoD AI Risk team to align standards and avoid duplicating independent risk oversight
  • Escalate control gaps or governance breaches to the R&C CAIO and relevant Value Stream or sub-function owners

ln:4490711686.descriptionHtml:
Ready to streamline client onboarding in China's capital markets?

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity

This role sits at the heart of HSBC Qianhai's client onboarding operations, ensuring a seamless and compliant entry experience for new customers in China's onshore capital markets. You will manage the end-to-end client engagement and account setup process, balancing operational efficiency with strict adherence to local regulations and internal policies. Success in this position means delivering accurate, timely outputs that enable the business to grow while maintaining the highest standards of risk management. You will coordinate effectively with stakeholders to enhance the operational effectiveness of business-as-usual activities. The role offers a chance to contribute to a diverse and inclusive environment where merit drives development and promotion.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Support the client service onboarding team with client engagement activities to ensure a smooth start for new customers.
  • Execute Know Your Customer (KYC) services and credit checks in line with regulatory requirements.
  • Manage system execution tasks related to client onboarding to maintain data integrity and process flow.
  • Conduct regular account checkups and perform information entry or modification to keep records current.
  • Coordinate communication with stakeholders to monitor and improve the operational effectiveness of BAU processes.
  • Produce timely and accurate outputs to support efficient service delivery across the team.
  • Ensure all operation process implementations follow established procedures and company policies.
  • Complete all mandatory training and attend nominated training programs to maintain professional competence.

What We're Looking For

  • University graduate or above, ideally in Finance, Business, or Accounting.
  • Demonstrate excellent communication skills in both spoken and written Chinese and English.
  • Apply sound PC knowledge with proficiency in Excel and MS Word.
  • Bring experience with Excel Macro, VBA, or Python to support process automation and efficiency.
  • Show proven experience in KYC processes or Account Management within a financial services context.
  • Work effectively as part of a team to achieve shared operational goals.
  • Uphold high standards of integrity and professionalism in all daily tasks.
  • Manage workload effectively under pressure to meet strict deadlines.

Building a secure foundation for growth

This role is pivotal in maintaining the operational backbone of our securities services in Shenzhen. By ensuring every client onboarding step is executed with precision and compliance, you directly enable the business to expand its reach in China's dynamic market. We invite you to bring your skills to a supportive environment where your contributions make a tangible difference. Join us to help shape the future of our client services and drive sustainable growth.

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

  • Proactively manage a complex portfolio of clients, becoming a trusted advisor to lead strategic dialogues with clients at a portfolio level through the understanding of specific business requirements and delivering creative and flexible customer solutions
  • To hand over customer relationship properly to their relationship managers after closing sales
  • To provide excellent services to customers and ensure all enquiries and complaints are accurately and effectively resolved to customers' satisfaction
  • To participate actively in team building activities to share information/ideas while contributing suggestions for work improvement
  • Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

  • 为客户提供优良的服务，确保客户的询问得到准确有效的回复，提高客户满意度
  • 主动接洽合作渠道、持续跟踪潜在客户名单直至成功开户，完成银行设定的工作目标
  • 确保有高标准的专业知识，与潜在客户进行更好的沟通

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University degree or above (recognized by the state)
  • Strong interpersonal skills and effective presentation skills
  • Well-developed service and sales attitude with ability to work under pressure
  • Presentable, Outgoing and Persuasive
  • Good oral and written English is preferable
  • 本科或以上学历(国家认可)；

ln:4490723129.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of STUDENT WORK PLACEMENT INTERN.

Principal responsibilities

  • Conduct Targeted Research: Investigate emerging technologies, particularly in the Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) space, and summarize their potential impact on our business.
  • Develop Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs): Use Python and other modern tools to build small, functional prototypes that test new ideas and demonstrate their value to senior stakeholders.
  • Create the ""Tech Radar"": Assist in the creation and maintenance of a quarterly ""Tech Radar"" report, our internal guide to the most promising new technologies.
  • Collaborate and Present: Work closely with senior data scientists and engineers, and present your research findings and PoC demonstrations to the wider analytics team.
  • Problem-Solve: Tackle challenging, open-ended problems and contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous learning

Requirements

  • Bachelor (3rd/4th year students) or master degree (1st/2nd year students) in Statistics/Maths/Computer Science
  • Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with common data science libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
  • A demonstrable interest in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or frameworks like LangChain is a significant plus.
  • A natural curiosity and a passion for learning and experimenting with new technologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently on research tasks.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to different audiences.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4489555554.descriptionHtml:
About The Role

We’re seeking someone to join our Finance team as a Finance Controller in Global Corporate Controllers to ensure the integrity of relevant legal entity’s general ledger, financial disclosures and regulatory submission.

In the Finance division, we act as a partner to business units around the globe by providing management, review, analysis and advisory services of the Firm’s financial and capital resources. This is an Associate level position within our Corporate Controllers, Reporting & Accounting Job Family which is responsible for the accuracy and control of the Firm’s books and records to produce the consolidated firm, segment and legal entities financial statements, including development, management and oversight of financial accounting & reporting systems as well as database management, including capital and liquidity reporting and external reporting functions.

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

What You’ll Do In The Role

  • Collaborate with a varied group of colleagues in Finance and across the Firm
  • Responsible for both individual and team deliverables and projects, leveraging knowledge of Finance functional area, tools and/or products
  • Adhere to the Firm’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls
  • Act as a culture carrier; embody the Firm's values and hold yourself accountable to Firm standards
  • Support China IM entities, including PE fund entities/QDLP WOFEs, related financial controls, and guardianship
  • Perform local and Morgan Stanley Group financial accounting and reporting of supported entities
  • Ensure compliance with the applicable Accounting Standards and regulatory rules and regulations as well as Morgan Stanley’s internal policies and requirements
  • Manage statutory audits, annual inspection, and regulatory filings
  • Provide Finance support to Business Units and Senior Management, and advice on new business initiatives and projects

What You’ll Bring To The Role

  • Working knowledge of Finance functional area, industry and competitive environment
  • Good communication skills in English and Mandarin, with ability to communicate clearly and concisely, and adapt to various audiences
  • Willingness to seek guidance and provide feedback to further develop self and peers
  • Familiar with China Accounting Standards. Knowledge of International Accounting Standards and/or US GAAP would be an advantage
  • Detail oriented, high accuracy with integrity with good analytical mind
  • A proactive, self-motivated and dynamic person
  • At least 2 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role
  • Qualification from recognized accounting body, CICPA and AICPA preferred

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please visit https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

ln:4489565590.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

This role exists to ensure the accurate, timely and controlled execution of cash management activities across payment processing, clearing, client instructions, account maintenance and static data services. The role is responsible for delivering reliable operational outcomes that support client transactions, safeguard financial assets and maintain the integrity of the Bank's cash management services.

The role is accountable for processing and validating transactions, maintaining critical customer and product data, identifying and escalating operational exceptions, and ensuring service delivery aligns with agreed service levels, regulatory obligations and internal control standards. Through disciplined execution and strong operational risk management, the role contributes to client satisfaction, operational resilience and sustainable business growth.

Working closely with Operations teams, Service Delivery partners, Risk and Compliance functions, Technology teams and business stakeholders, the role helps convert operational requirements into consistent service outcomes. The role supports process efficiency, client experience and operational excellence but does not own product strategy, client relationship management or enterprise-wide operational policy.

Key Responsibilities

Service Delivery & Transaction Processing

  • Execute payment, clearing and cash management activities accurately and within agreed turnaround times to support uninterrupted client servicing.
  • Validate customer instructions, transaction data and processing requirements to ensure operational accuracy and minimise processing risk.
  • Resolve operational exceptions and processing breaks through timely investigation, escalation and corrective action.
  • Deliver service outcomes that consistently meet productivity, quality and client service standards.

Cash Management Operations & Data Integrity

  • Maintain customer, account and product static data to ensure completeness, accuracy and operational readiness across cash management services.
  • Apply established operational controls when performing account maintenance, pricing, billing and related operational activities.
  • Ensure transaction and client records are accurately captured and maintained to support operational, regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Identify data quality issues and drive corrective actions that improve operational effectiveness and minimise service disruptions.

Risk Management & Control Effectiveness

  • Apply operational risk controls that safeguard the Bank against transaction errors, operational losses and control breakdowns.
  • Conduct independent validation activities in accordance with segregation of duties, authority limits and control requirements.
  • Identify, assess and escalate operational risk events, control weaknesses and emerging risks through appropriate governance channels.
  • Support remediation activities that strengthen control effectiveness and reduce recurring operational issues.
  • Motivated by delivering accurate and reliable operational outcomes in a high-volume, time-sensitive environment.
  • Energised by solving operational challenges, improving processes and enhancing service quality.
  • Thrives in environments that value collaboration, accountability, strong controls and continuous improvement.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Payment Processing
  • Cash Management
  • Certification and Accreditation
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Operations Management
  • Project Management
  • Service Delivery
  • Settlement Management

Other Skills

  • Transaction Management
  • Issue Management
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Service Recovery

Qualifications

  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

  • Conduct independent validation activities in accordance with segregation of duties, authority limits and control requirements.
  • Identify, assess and escalate operational risk events, control weaknesses and emerging risks through appropriate governance channels.
  • Support remediation activities that strengthen control effectiveness and reduce recurring operational issues.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance

  • Apply regulatory requirements, internal policies and operational procedures consistently across all cash management activities.
  • Perform AML, sanctions and other financial crime-related checks in line with Bank standards and escalation requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records and evidence that support audit reviews, governance reporting and regulatory inspections.
  • Promote adherence to conduct, compliance and risk standards that protect the Bank and its clients.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve service quality and enhance operational efficiency across the end-to-end workflow.
  • Contribute to operational change initiatives, testing activities and business continuity readiness to support resilient service delivery.
  • Support the implementation of digitisation, automation and process enhancement initiatives that improve operational outcomes.
  • Share process insights and improvement opportunities to strengthen team effectiveness and service performance.

Stakeholder & Client Service Management

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve service issues and ensure effective delivery of cash management services.
  • Communicate operational issues, risks and service impacts clearly to relevant stakeholders to support timely resolution.
  • Build trusted working relationships that facilitate effective issue management and service improvements.
  • Support a client-focused culture by delivering responsive, accurate and professional operational services.

Motivations

  • Motivated by delivering accurate and reliable operational outcomes in a high-volume, time-sensitive environment.
  • Energised by solving operational challenges, improving processes and enhancing service quality.
  • Thrives in environments that value collaboration, accountability, strong controls and continuous improvement.

ln:4489573352.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The Payment Operations Specialist ensures the accurate, timely, and controlled execution of payment processing, clearing, cash management, and account maintenance activities that support the bank's transaction banking services. The role is accountable for delivering reliable operational outcomes, maintaining data integrity, and supporting seamless transaction processing across client and internal service channels.

The role contributes to business performance by ensuring payment transactions are processed in accordance with regulatory requirements, operational procedures, and service-level commitments. It plays a key role in managing operational risk, maintaining effective controls, resolving transaction exceptions, and safeguarding the integrity of customer and account information.

Working closely with Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Service Delivery teams, the role supports operational resilience, client satisfaction, and continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, strengthen controls, and improve service quality.

Key Responsibilities

Payment Processing & Transaction Delivery

  • Execute payment, clearing, and cash management transactions accurately and within agreed service standards to support reliable client outcomes.
  • Validate transaction instructions and customer information to ensure processing accuracy and reduce operational risk.
  • Investigate, resolve, and escalate payment exceptions, reconciliation breaks, and processing issues to minimise service disruption.
  • Deliver consistent operational performance against quality, productivity, and turnaround-time objectives.

Cash Management & Data Integrity

  • Maintain customer, account, product, and operational reference data to support accurate transaction processing and service delivery.
  • Execute account maintenance, billing, pricing, and related operational activities in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Ensure transaction records are complete, accurate, and appropriately documented to support auditability and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify, investigate, and address data-quality issues that may affect operational performance or client service.

Risk, Compliance & Control Management

  • Apply operational controls that mitigate financial, regulatory, and operational risks across payment-processing activities.
  • Execute activities in accordance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and operational procedures.
  • Escalate incidents, control weaknesses, processing errors, and potential breaches promptly to support risk mitigation.
  • Support internal audits, regulatory reviews, and control assessments by providing accurate operational evidence and documentation.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve transaction-processing efficiency, service quality, and operational effectiveness.
  • Support automation, digitisation, and workflow-enhancement initiatives that simplify operations and reduce manual effort.
  • Contribute to process reviews that strengthen controls, reduce processing risks, and improve client outcomes.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging operational risks and recommend practical improvements to operating procedures.

Stakeholder & Service Management

  • Collaborate with Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Service Delivery teams to ensure effective operational support.
  • Communicate operational issues, service impacts, and resolution progress to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Support a client-focused service culture by responding effectively to operational enquiries and service requests.
  • Contribute to resolving cross-functional issues that affect transaction processing or service performance.

Skills And Experience

Priority skills

  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Settlement Management
  • Operations Management
  • Quality Assurance
  • Regulatory Compliance

Other Skills

  • Cash Management
  • Payment Processing
  • Payment Schedule
  • Service Delivery
  • Data Management
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Risk Management

Motivations

  • Building trusted, long‑term relationships that deliver sustainable, risk‑adjusted growth.
  • Aligning products, regions and stakeholders around clear strategic priorities.
  • Applying sector‑ and segment‑specific knowledge and judgment to solve complex client problems and create value, leveraging data and AI‑enabled insights to deepen client understanding, sharpen focus and drive commercial impact.

Qualifications

  • Experience in transaction banking, cash management, payments, or financial services environments with high transaction volumes.
  • Exposure to regulated operational environments with strong control, compliance, and risk-management requirements.
  • Experience working across operational teams and stakeholder groups to resolve processing issues and service impacts.
  • Exposure to process improvement, automation, or operational-efficiency initiatives within banking or financial operations.
  • Experience balancing operational priorities while maintaining service quality, accuracy, and service-level commitments.
  • Business English

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

ln:4489560668.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Customer sales and service

职责范围：

客户销售与服务

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.
  • Deliver allocated performance targets for various product VSs;
  • Maintain relationship with customers and deliver superior customer service to ensure customers’ needs are met;
  • Enhance bank-customer relationships by expanding existing customers’ portfolio holdings;
  • Actively participate in Priority Banking / other Bank’s marketing and promotional activities to acquire NTB customers, as well as cross-selling to existing customers;
  • Proactively engage with Personal Clients hidden affluent and advise to approach bank with complex investment needs;
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
  • Ensure compliance of Management Manual, Operating Manuals and Bank’s laid down knowledge of the various products offered by all departments;
  • Learn and understand all relevant regulations and internal Risk & Compliance policies and procedures;
  • Keep updated on the events in the financial industry;
  • Participate actively in training programs, meetings, briefings organized by the bank and ensure skills & knowledge acquired is applied to daily work;
  • Ensure timeliness & managing customer’s complaint;

主要工作职责/挑战：

  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。
  • 实现领导安排的各个产品的业绩指标；
  • 维护与客户的关系并提供卓越的客户服务以确保满足客户需求；
  • 通过扩大现有客户的投资组合加强客户与我行的关系；
  • 积极参与优先理财/其它银行营销项目，以获取新客户。另外，向现有客户进行交叉销售；
  • 主动发现具有“优先理财”资质的个人理财客户, 并发掘其投资理财需求；
  • 负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
  • 遵循银行的管理手册，操作手册和所有部门相关产品的既定政策；
  • 学习并了解一切相关条例以及内部风险与合规的政策与程序；
  • 保持对金融行业相关动向的敏感；
  • 积极参与银行组织的培训项目，会议和简报会，并保证将学习到的技能和知识运用到日常工作中；
  • 确保客户投诉的时效与管理；

Strategy

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.

  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Customer sales and service
职责范围：
客户销售与服务
Key Responsibilities
- Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
- Deliver allocated performance targets for various product VSs;
- Maintain relationship with customers and deliver superior customer service to ensure customers’ needs are met;
- Enhance bank-customer relationships by expanding existing customers’ portfolio holdings;
- Actively participate in Priority Banking / other Bank’s marketing and promotional activities to acquire NTB customers, as well as cross-selling to existing customers;
- Proactively engage with Personal Clients hidden affluent and advise to approach bank with complex investment needs;
- Ensure compliance of Management Manual, Operating Manuals and Bank’s laid down knowledge of the various products offered by all departments;
- Learn and understand all relevant regulations and internal Risk & Compliance policies and procedures;
- Keep updated on the events in the financial industry;
- Participate actively in training programs, meetings, briefings organized by the bank and ensure skills & knowledge acquired is applied to daily work;
- Ensure timeliness & managing customer’s complaint;
主要工作职责/挑战：
- 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
- 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
- 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
- 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；

- 维护与客户的关系并提供卓越的客户服务以确保满足客户需求；

- 学习并了解一切相关条例以及内部风险与合规的政策与程序；
- 保持对金融行业相关动向的敏感；

- 确保客户投诉的时效与管理；

Business
- Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates
Processes
- Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.
- Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
- Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
- Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
- Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
- Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
- Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

- All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

- Financial skills

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to deal with all levels of people, often in complex and difficult situations.

- Self-motivator who is keen to upgrade, improve personal knowledge and skills to meet job requirements.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Responsible to monitor, motivate and manage RMs for achieve financial and non-financial outcome for the sales team.
  • Lead, develop and manage the sales team to ensure achievement of the business objectives with the responsibility for customer growth, Wealth and Retail product growth etc. in order to fulfill customer needs. .
  • The management scope of an business director is to in charge of a team of 10 RMs to 12 RMs.
  • Achieve results by working with the whole sales team, local market and wider community.
  • Ensure the sales team to deliver a consistently excellent customer experience
  • Coach and train staff not only for building employees' sales knowledge and skills, but also other guidance and refreshment training bank requires, and also effectively management of employee attrition rates.
  • Manage the sales quality for the team.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Knowledge / Experience
  • Proven ability in team leadership and management
  • Proven ability in Wealth and Retail distribution
  • Proven and progressive management experience.
  • Proven ability in relationship management in the Retail sector
  • Demonstrate behaviours consistent with HSBC Values
  • Proven adherence to controls and compliance with no significant breaches
  • Expertise in financial planning and related systems and processes
  • Skills
  • Strong marketing, sales, management planning, financial, leadership, project management and communication skills
  • and good knowledge and control of risk management.
  • Strong planning and organising skills.
  • Ability to use numerical data to effectively manage sales team performance.
  • Excellent industry and sector knowledge.
  • Good knowledge of Wealth and Retail distribution techniques and models.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with a particular emphasis upon inspiring, influencing and negotiating
  • Coaching sales techniques, best practice and sales management on a team and one to one basis
  • Planning and organising skills
  • Analytical skills
  • Problem solving skills
  • Qualifications and Certificates (add local requirements)
  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by the local market
  • Attain any internal standards as required by market

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4489595705.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

SABRE is Standard Chartered’s Analytics Booking and Risk Engine and is the strategic risk and PnL platform for Financial Markets. The development team is a world class technology group in Standard Chartered bank to provide technical solutions to support the bank’s Financial Markets business as well as support requirements from other projects with a wider scope such as regulatory books of work.

The successful candidate will play a key role in the implementation of highly visible strategic programmes with the primary responsibilities around building components within the SABRE Market Risk Platform. Any developed solution must be scalable, robust and fault tolerant catering to the existing and future business needs in a timely manner. In addition, the successful candidate will be expected to develop innovative solutions with a view to these being released quickly to gain feedback before advising on the full scale roll out.

The candidate will be a natural technology enthusiast with a driven yet pragmatic, delivery focused mindset and a desire to deliver constant business value through the effective and innovative use of technology. The candidate will be expected to take ownership, responsibility and accountability for critical components, and will have come from a mature and demonstrable agile background and be comfortable dealing with the resistance that comes with change. The candidate is expected to work in a dynamic global team with business analysts, project managers, business stakeholders and other technical experts across multiple locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Development Manager, Project Manager, and a team of developers to deliver Java components to internal business users
  • Demonstrate a systematic and disciplined architectural, system design and programming approach
  • Deeply passionate about best-practice software design principles, you will write robust code along with a high-level of test coverage
  • Self-starter who can drive/facilitate requirements and development effort
  • Design smart and scalable solutions following the bank standards
  • Coordinate with other teams in Technology
  • Develop, prepare and maintain system documentation, including program descriptions and operational procedures
  • Act as the second line of support during production problems.

Skills And Experience

  • Java Development
  • Concurrency
  • Strong analytical & problem solving and creative skills
  • Ability to be organised and multi-task on different requirements across various stakeholders, and to work independently and under pressure
  • Data and compute grid, analytical OLAP databases
  • Distributed architecture and system design
  • Bash or Python scripting

Motivations

  • We bring a deep understanding of the market, a scientific approach, and innovative technologies to bear on the challenges of profitable trading in the world's highly competitive environment.
  • This is a rare opportunity to get into an organization working with smart, great technologists globally in financial markets domain.
  • The culture in SABRE is open, intellectual, and fun.
  • Learning opportunities are plentiful: organized classes and seminars; freewheeling discussions; intensive one-on-one mentorships.
  • Career advancement is always waiting for those high-energized talents to pursue.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years hands on development with investment banking IT experience
  • 8+ years Java development experience working in a performance focused concurrent environment
  • Experience with Hadoop/Spark/Kafka/Scala could be advantageous
  • Strong hands-on experience with Bash or Python scripting is essential
  • Development experience on functional language, such as Haskell, is a plus
  • Development experience on functional language, such as Haskell, is a plus
  • Bachelor degree in Computer Science or similar

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Director Group AI Platform Engineering .

Business: CTO Platforms

Job ID ： 47494

Principal Responsibilities

  • Set the strategy and technical direction for the AI gateway and broader Group AI Platform, defining architecture, standards, and guardrails that scale consistently bank-wide.
  • Lead optimization of the AI gateway to improve performance, scalability, resilience and cost efficiency, enabling Generative and Agentic AI use cases across HSBC.
  • Own end-to-end delivery from design through rollout and continuous improvement, ensuring low-latency performance and reliability.
  • Establish and evolve engineering best practices across CI/CD, automated testing, and observability/monitoring for AI platform services.
  • Partner across business lines and infrastructure team to align priorities, integrate requirements and unblock delivery across regions and time zones
  • Provide strong technical leadership through hands-on architecture/design reviews, performance engineering, incident learnings and mentoring to raise engineering standards.
  • Build and lead a high-performing global team, ensuring capabilities and delivered fit-for-purpose with consistent quality.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 15+ of experience delivering enterprise software/platform solutions including 5+ years in senior engineering leadership roles.
  • Proven track record designing, building, and operating large-scale, low-latency, highly available, resilient platforms and shared services (API gateway/service gateway experience strongly preferred)
  • Strong architecture expertise across distributed systems, microservices, cloud/container platforms, and performance engineering (capacity planning, tuning, benchmarking)
  • Hands-on engineering capability with modern language and tooling (e.g. Python and/or Java), plus strong CI/CD, automated testing and observability practices.
  • Experience building secure-by-design platforms in regulated environments, with strong understanding of non-functional requirements (security, resilience, data protection, auditability)
  • Strong knowledge of AI capabilities and their applications in financial services, including working knowledge of Generative AI/LLM platform patterns (model access, prompt/tooling services, guardrails, evaluation/monitoring) and how to enabler safe consumption at scale.
  • Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing global teams spanning AI SMEs and full stack engineers across multiple regions and time zones.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, able to align business lines, infrastructure and control functions; clearly articulate AI capabilities and influence senior technology and business leaders.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery models with strong collaboration and execution discipline.

/WX

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系

根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门

配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline

At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳

至少5年以上客户经理经验

具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系

具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣

成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧

普通话及英语流利

ln:4491294476.descriptionHtml:
CIB - Corporate Banking

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Corporate Banking provides international financial services solutions that support businesses ranging from mid-market enterprises to large corporates across industries and sectors. Leveraging the strength, scope, and expertise of our global product network, Corporate Banking is positioned as an essential partner to firms seeking to maximise their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Identify sales opportunities that address specific needs for our clients and managing from identification to point of sale and through post trade process
  • Serve an international portfolio of Strategic and/or Focus multinational clients, including Transactional clients where required.
  • Manage and develop relationships with transactional clients, including those serviced over e-platforms for flow based business.
  • Provide day to day sales coverage using the full suite of Corporate Sales offerings and support team members to do the same
  • Deliver services and solutions that meet client needs and where necessary leverage the bank’s depth of product expertise and Thought Leadership
  • Develop trusted relationships with clients to drive revenue growth and greater product penetration
  • Collaborate with other internal stakeholders, including Relationship Managers, Global Payments Solutions (GPS), and Global Trade Solutions (GTS) , to service client needs and improve share of wallet
  • Drive efficiency and profitability by championing adoption and use of relevant service offerings to meet client needs, for example migrating transactional business to the self-service e-capability, coordinating with Corporate Risk Solutions (CRS) for more complex balance sheet structuring solutions, or identifying further opportunities for the offshore capability to support Corporate Sales
  • Manage changes to processes as technology platforms evolve
  • Work with Corporate Sales team to ensure all activities for their set of Strategic and Focus clients are executed in line with their agreed principles
  • Work through Corporate Sales for ensuring all Global Service Centre outsourced activities are executed in line with the agreed SLA’s and requirements for servicing clients
  • Identify and originate cross-sell opportunities (cross-border, Corporate Sales /CRS, and cross-selling the Bank)
  • Where appropriate and responsibility has been assigned, act as Global Sales Captain for specified clients
  • Grow deep and broad customer relationships to enhance the HSBC franchise and generate value added business
  • Build and maintain business relationships with clients in assigned area of responsibility

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's or equivalent University degree, minimum 5 years' relevant experience as a Global Markets corporate sales
  • Well versed with Global Markets and relevant Global Markets products, local regulations, regulatory requirements, market practices and business trends
  • Experienced in handling and dealing with local commercial banking or corporate clients in South China will be preferred
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills both in Chinese and English with very strong people interaction ability, Cantonese speaker will be preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, open minded, be able to present best-fit solutions for client needs
  • Ability to explore business network, acquire and on-board new client names
  • Strong sense of operational risk management and ability to adhere to the Bank's operational risk requirements
  • Attention to detail and ability to ensure that transactions, business information is captured in a timely and highly accurate manner
  • Able to work independently with limited supervision, proactive and willing to run job duties under pressure against multiple deadlines
  • Business Travels will be required

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business

Principal responsibilities

  • Provide technical consultation to development team members with guidance of department principles. Lead teams or projects of high complexity. Initiates and conducts feasibility studies of new and modified business requirement.
  • Provide technical analysis and solutions to business issues, provide consultation, research and implement technical alternatives, and maintain awareness of business technology strategies.
  • Be responsible for user requirement gathering, detailed requirement documentation by working closely with the project stakeholders including IT and business users. Ensure the business need can be translated into executable artefacts for development team.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, architects, and a variety of end users to ensure technical compatibility and user satisfaction.
  • Work with development team to clarify the user requirements, conduct system testing, prepare test plan and test cases.
  • Work with business users on the UAT execution, defects follow-up with application development team.
  • Designing, coding, and debugging modernized applications
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Developing and maintaining scalable and secure cloud-based solutions utilizing either open-source technologies or cloud native service.

Requirements

  • University Degree (or above) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English is a must.
  • Demonstrable 7-10 years of commercial experience on developing software, applications, or solution for large-scale system with Java/Spring.
  • Good experience in Cloud native technologies, including but not limited to those popular ones on GCP, AWS, and Alicloud. Experience at GCP is essential.
  • Good understanding and knowledge of the micro service design pattern, proven experience of using coding level design patterns to solve business problems.
  • Good hands-on experience in multiple languages and technologies in the team, including but not limited to, Java, Spring cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Spark/Flink and more.
  • Deep understand on DevSecOps and capable of developing CI/CD from scratch and applying it into daily development.
  • Experience of SOLID coding principle and proven experience of applying clean code principle into daily development work.

ln:4490268474.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on and commercially minded Senito shape and accelerate the practical adoption of artificial intelligence across Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB). The role operates as a forward-deployed AI discovery and prototyping lead, embedding with business and operations teams to rapidly understand business workflows, user needs, data, systems and constraints.

The role owns the journey from problem discovery to validated prototype and deployable system design. It translates ambiguous business problems into testable AI hypotheses, builds working AI and agent prototypes, evaluates value, feasibility and risk, and provides engineering teams with a clear evidence-based handover for production build, industrialisation and scale. The role also identifies reusable AI assets and product patterns that can be applied across CIB.

Why This Role Matters

  • AI at the Core of Strategy: Shape and validate high-impact AI opportunities that support revenue growth, client engagement, productivity and operational effectiveness across CIB.
  • Rapid Discovery to Production Path: Turn business workflows into working AI and agent prototypes, prove feasibility and value quickly, and define a clear path for engineering teams to take validated solutions into production.
  • Reusable AI Assets and Patterns: Identify common prompts, agents, tools, connectors, evaluation methods and architectural patterns, and convert them into reusable and governed assets for CIB.
  • Embedded, High-Agency Delivery: Work directly with product, business and operations teams, operate effectively in ambiguity, and maintain delivery momentum through rapid experimentation and hands-on problem solving.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Use evidence from discovery and prototyping to shape the CIB AI opportunity pipeline, identify reusable capabilities and inform AI product, platform and engineering priorities.

Business

  • Partner with CIB product, frontline and operations teams to prioritise business problems where AI can deliver measurable client, revenue, productivity or control outcomes. Establish baseline measures and define success criteria before prototyping.

Processes

  • Own rapid AI discovery and prototyping: Embed with CIB product, frontline and operations teams to understand business problems, workflows, users, data, systems and constraints. Translate these into prioritised AI opportunities, testable hypotheses and time-bound discovery plans.
  • Translate workflows into deployable system designs: Define the target workflow, human and AI responsibilities, user experience, data and integration needs, solution architecture, controls, non-functional requirements and measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Build hands-on AI and agent prototypes: Create working solutions using appropriate models, retrieval, APIs, tools, orchestration and enterprise data. Use rapid experimentation to validate feasibility, usability, AI quality, business value and key risks before production investment.
  • Evaluate and prove before scaling: Define evaluation datasets, baselines, graders and success thresholds. Assess accuracy, grounding, tool-use reliability, latency, cost, safety, adoption potential and business-process outcomes, and use the evidence to support proceed, pivot or stop decisions.
  • Provide an evidence-based engineering handover: Transition validated prototypes to engineering teams with clear prototype code, architecture, backlog, data and integration requirements, evaluation results, control requirements, production acceptance criteria and known limitations.
  • Identify reusable AI assets and product patterns: Look beyond individual use cases to identify common prompts, agents, tools, connectors, workflow components, evaluation methods and architecture patterns that can be standardised and reused across CIB.
  • Productise successful patterns: Convert proven prototypes into reusable code components, AI assets, reference architectures, evaluation suites, implementation playbooks and governed solution patterns that accelerate subsequent CIB use cases.
  • Deliver with pace and pragmatism: Make informed trade-offs across business value, scope, speed, AI quality, risk and maintainability. Identify blockers early and maintain delivery momentum through clear decisions, rapid experimentation and hands-on problem solving.

People & Talent

  • Experience: Typically 7+ years across business analysis, digital product delivery, applied AI, data or technology consulting, including hands-on experience translating complex workflows into working digital or AI solutions. Strong Corporate and Institutional Banking domain knowledge is highly desirable.
  • Applied AI and agent prototyping: Demonstrated ability to build working AI or agent prototypes using Python, model APIs, prompting, structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, tool/function calling, workflow orchestration and enterprise data.
  • AI solution and system design: Ability to define user workflows, architecture, data flows, APIs and integration needs, human-in-the-loop controls, security considerations, non-functional requirements and production acceptance criteria.
  • AI evaluation and quality: Experience defining test datasets, baselines, evaluation metrics, graders and acceptance thresholds across accuracy, grounding, tool use, latency, cost, safety and business outcomes.
  • Embedded stakeholder delivery: Proven ability to work directly with business, operations, engineering, risk and compliance teams; navigate ambiguity; communicate trade-offs; and influence senior stakeholders with evidence from prototypes and evaluations.

A plus point

  • Experience with agentic AI frameworks and enterprise AI platforms, for example LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel or equivalent orchestration approaches
  • Experience applying Responsible AI, model risk, information security, data privacy and technology risk requirements to AI solutions in a regulated environment
  • Experience converting successful prototypes into reusable code components, AI assets, reference architectures, evaluation suites and implementation playbooks

Risk Management

  • Identify and manage risks during discovery and prototyping, including data leakage, hallucination, prompt injection, inappropriate tool execution, access control, model limitations, operational resilience and human oversight. Ensure key risks, assumptions, limitations and required controls are documented in the engineering handover.

Governance

  • Maintain traceable documentation covering intended use, user workflow, solution design, data flows, evaluation results, limitations, control requirements and production acceptance criteria. Engage architecture, Responsible AI, information security, data, model risk and relevant governance forums at the appropriate stage.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • CIB platform teams
  • Group AI Architect
  • Technology
  • Group Chief Data Officer
  • Group AI enablement team
  • Business and function stakeholders

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Singapore, CIB platform team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats);

Skills And Experience

  • AI Product and Business Discovery
  • Applied AI and Agent Prototyping
  • AI Solution and System Design
  • AI Evaluation, Safety and Quality
  • Reusable AI Assets and Product Patterns
  • Stakeholder and Engineering Translation

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree
  • Certifications: Relevant AI/ML, cloud, data or product certification is advantageous but not mandatory (for example Azure AI Engineer, AWS Machine Learning, Google Professional ML Engineer, CSPO or PMI-ACP).
  • Languages: English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.
