Job Summary
We are looking for a hands-on and commercially minded Senito shape and accelerate the practical adoption of artificial intelligence across Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB). The role operates as a forward-deployed AI discovery and prototyping lead, embedding with business and operations teams to rapidly understand business workflows, user needs, data, systems and constraints.
The role owns the journey from problem discovery to validated prototype and deployable system design. It translates ambiguous business problems into testable AI hypotheses, builds working AI and agent prototypes, evaluates value, feasibility and risk, and provides engineering teams with a clear evidence-based handover for production build, industrialisation and scale. The role also identifies reusable AI assets and product patterns that can be applied across CIB.
Why This Role Matters
- AI at the Core of Strategy: Shape and validate high-impact AI opportunities that support revenue growth, client engagement, productivity and operational effectiveness across CIB.
- Rapid Discovery to Production Path: Turn business workflows into working AI and agent prototypes, prove feasibility and value quickly, and define a clear path for engineering teams to take validated solutions into production.
- Reusable AI Assets and Patterns: Identify common prompts, agents, tools, connectors, evaluation methods and architectural patterns, and convert them into reusable and governed assets for CIB.
- Embedded, High-Agency Delivery: Work directly with product, business and operations teams, operate effectively in ambiguity, and maintain delivery momentum through rapid experimentation and hands-on problem solving.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy
- Use evidence from discovery and prototyping to shape the CIB AI opportunity pipeline, identify reusable capabilities and inform AI product, platform and engineering priorities.
Business
- Partner with CIB product, frontline and operations teams to prioritise business problems where AI can deliver measurable client, revenue, productivity or control outcomes. Establish baseline measures and define success criteria before prototyping.
Processes
- Own rapid AI discovery and prototyping: Embed with CIB product, frontline and operations teams to understand business problems, workflows, users, data, systems and constraints. Translate these into prioritised AI opportunities, testable hypotheses and time-bound discovery plans.
- Translate workflows into deployable system designs: Define the target workflow, human and AI responsibilities, user experience, data and integration needs, solution architecture, controls, non-functional requirements and measurable acceptance criteria.
- Build hands-on AI and agent prototypes: Create working solutions using appropriate models, retrieval, APIs, tools, orchestration and enterprise data. Use rapid experimentation to validate feasibility, usability, AI quality, business value and key risks before production investment.
- Evaluate and prove before scaling: Define evaluation datasets, baselines, graders and success thresholds. Assess accuracy, grounding, tool-use reliability, latency, cost, safety, adoption potential and business-process outcomes, and use the evidence to support proceed, pivot or stop decisions.
- Provide an evidence-based engineering handover: Transition validated prototypes to engineering teams with clear prototype code, architecture, backlog, data and integration requirements, evaluation results, control requirements, production acceptance criteria and known limitations.
- Identify reusable AI assets and product patterns: Look beyond individual use cases to identify common prompts, agents, tools, connectors, workflow components, evaluation methods and architecture patterns that can be standardised and reused across CIB.
- Productise successful patterns: Convert proven prototypes into reusable code components, AI assets, reference architectures, evaluation suites, implementation playbooks and governed solution patterns that accelerate subsequent CIB use cases.
- Deliver with pace and pragmatism: Make informed trade-offs across business value, scope, speed, AI quality, risk and maintainability. Identify blockers early and maintain delivery momentum through clear decisions, rapid experimentation and hands-on problem solving.
- Experience: Typically 7+ years across business analysis, digital product delivery, applied AI, data or technology consulting, including hands-on experience translating complex workflows into working digital or AI solutions. Strong Corporate and Institutional Banking domain knowledge is highly desirable.
- Applied AI and agent prototyping: Demonstrated ability to build working AI or agent prototypes using Python, model APIs, prompting, structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, tool/function calling, workflow orchestration and enterprise data.
- AI solution and system design: Ability to define user workflows, architecture, data flows, APIs and integration needs, human-in-the-loop controls, security considerations, non-functional requirements and production acceptance criteria.
- AI evaluation and quality: Experience defining test datasets, baselines, evaluation metrics, graders and acceptance thresholds across accuracy, grounding, tool use, latency, cost, safety and business outcomes.
- Embedded stakeholder delivery: Proven ability to work directly with business, operations, engineering, risk and compliance teams; navigate ambiguity; communicate trade-offs; and influence senior stakeholders with evidence from prototypes and evaluations.
A plus point
- Experience with agentic AI frameworks and enterprise AI platforms, for example LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel or equivalent orchestration approaches
- Experience applying Responsible AI, model risk, information security, data privacy and technology risk requirements to AI solutions in a regulated environment
- Experience converting successful prototypes into reusable code components, AI assets, reference architectures, evaluation suites and implementation playbooks
Risk Management
- Identify and manage risks during discovery and prototyping, including data leakage, hallucination, prompt injection, inappropriate tool execution, access control, model limitations, operational resilience and human oversight. Ensure key risks, assumptions, limitations and required controls are documented in the engineering handover.
Governance
- Maintain traceable documentation covering intended use, user workflow, solution design, data flows, evaluation results, limitations, control requirements and production acceptance criteria. Engage architecture, Responsible AI, information security, data, model risk and relevant governance forums at the appropriate stage.
- Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
- Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
- Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Key stakeholders
- CIB platform teams
- Group AI Architect
- Technology
- Group Chief Data Officer
- Group AI enablement team
- Business and function stakeholders
Other Responsibilities
- Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Singapore, CIB platform team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats);
Skills And Experience
- AI Product and Business Discovery
- Applied AI and Agent Prototyping
- AI Solution and System Design
- AI Evaluation, Safety and Quality
- Reusable AI Assets and Product Patterns
- Stakeholder and Engineering Translation
Qualifications
- Education: Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree
- Certifications: Relevant AI/ML, cloud, data or product certification is advantageous but not mandatory (for example Azure AI Engineer, AWS Machine Learning, Google Professional ML Engineer, CSPO or PMI-ACP).
- Languages: English

ln:4490270392.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

We are looking for a highly creative and strategic experience designer to join our Insights & Analytics team. This role goes beyond designing dashboards — it focuses on shaping the end-to-end design experience across our analytics products, communication materials, and digital platforms. You will drive efforts to define and elevate the design language and experience standards for how data, insights, and digital touchpoints are presented across the network.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Develop and implement design systems, style guides, and UI/UX standards to drive consistency and quality across all analytics and communication products.
  • Design and enhance user experiences for analytics dashboards, internal platforms, and digital products, ensuring clarity, usability, and visual appeal.
  • Stay ahead of trends in UI/UX, data visualization, and digital product design, bringing innovative ideas to improve our design practices.
  • Provide thought leadership on solutions and collaborating across teams and functional lines.

Business

  • Champion user-centred design principles to ensure all products are easy to use, accessible, and aligned with stakeholder needs.
  • Drive design reviews, provide guidance to wider teams, and uplift the overall design maturity within the organization.
  • Drive the innovation of visual design and the improvement of user experience
  • Serve as a critical partner to the business in delivering actionable insights & data/ analytics-based solutions to business needs and problems

Processes

  • Collaborate with data developers, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand user needs, identify design opportunities to translate complex insights into intuitive and impactful designs.
  • Create visual communication assets (presentations, infographics, storyboards) that effectively tell the story behind data and insights.
  • Prepare and/or contribute to regular updates for various committees and governance forums

People & Talent

  • Lead through example; engage in peer-to-peer leadership
  • Provide effective orientation/ guidance to new joiners on the bank’s policies/ procedures/ processes to ensure their successful assimilation into the team and the bank
  • Develop and implement a personal learning plan with team manager, to attain necessary competencies
  • Successfully complete milestones as laid out in implemented personal learning plan

Risk Management

  • Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role remit
  • Proactively manage risks and establish/ monitor controls to improve the overall state of the risk management and operating framework
  • Ensure a clear and uniform approach towards implementation of the global operating model for all related processes and adherence to DOIs

Governance

  • Ensure, lead, and monitor strict adherence to regulatory requirements
  • Ensure strong due diligence on document safekeeping and data confidentiality
  • Ensure risks are clearly identified, quantified, and escalated
  • Ensure compliance with relevant internal & external policies and procedures, regulatory and statutory requirements

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Displaying exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Valued Behaviours and Code of Conduct.
  • Taking personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: Financial Crime Prevention; The Right Environment.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identifying, escalating, mitigating and resolving risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Group CDO
  • CIB Operations Central team & Network
  • Client Coverage
  • Transaction Banking
  • Markets
  • Global Banking Operations (GBS)
  • CFCC
  • PSS
  • Technology

Other Responsibilities

  • Embedding Here for good and the Group’s brand and valued behaviours
  • Performing other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures

Motivations

  • Creating intuitive, high-impact experiences that transform complex data and insights into clear, engaging and user-friendly products.
  • Solving meaningful business problems through creativity, combining design thinking, visual storytelling and emerging technologies to deliver innovative solutions.
  • Shaping standards and influencing at scale, establishing reusable design systems, raising quality and driving adoption across diverse teams and stakeholders.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • UI Design
  • UX Design / Design Thinking
  • Gen-AI / prompt engineering
  • Figma
  • PPT

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UI/UX or Product Design, ideally with exposure to analytics or data-driven environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) educational background in User Experience Design, Interactive Media, Usability, or Information design preferred.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating experience in digital product design, visualization, and user experience.
  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design tools.
  • Solid understanding of design systems, interaction design, and visual storytelling.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; able to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled design, productivity, or analytics tools will be an advantage.
  • Strong content writing skills to create impactful materials for management presentation or newsletters.
  • Highly driven and motivated with an eager-to-learn attitude and actively seek out ways to improve processes, people, and products.
  • Strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and ability to balance creativity with usability.
  • Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing demands.
  • Experience driving continuous improvement, standardisation, and capability uplift initiatives across teams.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority and foster adoption of standards across a diverse stakeholder landscape.

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Job Summary

This role exists to ensure the accurate, timely and controlled execution of trade transactions across the end-to-end trade lifecycle. The role safeguards operational integrity by overseeing trade documentation, transaction processing, compliance controls and exception management while supporting efficient trade servicing for clients and stakeholders.

The role is accountable for delivering consistent operational outcomes that meet regulatory requirements, internal policies and client expectations. It works closely with front office, compliance, risk, technology and operations teams to ensure trade transactions are executed with appropriate controls, risks are identified and mitigated, and operational issues are resolved effectively.

Through ongoing workflow analysis, process optimisation and operational governance, the role contributes to improved service quality, stronger risk management, enhanced client satisfaction and a scalable operating environment that supports business growth across trade products and markets.

Key Responsibilities

Trade Transaction Execution & Operations Control

  • Manage the end-to-end processing of trade transactions to ensure accuracy, timeliness and adherence to operational standards.
  • Oversee trade documentation and transaction records to support effective execution and audit readiness.
  • Maintain operational controls that minimise processing errors and support consistent trade settlement outcomes.
  • Resolve transaction-related issues and exceptions to reduce operational disruption and client impact.

Trade Documentation & Verification

  • Govern trade documentation processes to ensure completeness, accuracy and compliance with applicable requirements.
  • Verify trade-related information and supporting documentation to facilitate efficient transaction processing.
  • Strengthen document validation controls that reduce operational risks and prevent processing delays.
  • Maintain high-quality record management practices that support regulatory, audit and internal review requirements.

Risk, Compliance & Fraud Prevention

  • Apply regulatory and policy requirements to trade activities to ensure compliant operational execution.
  • Identify, assess and escalate operational risks, control weaknesses and compliance concerns in a timely manner.
  • Support fraud detection and prevention activities through effective transaction monitoring and investigation.
  • Partner with risk and compliance teams to strengthen controls and address emerging regulatory requirements.

Operational Efficiency & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyse operational workflows to identify improvement opportunities that enhance productivity and reduce cycle times.
  • Drive operational process enhancements that improve service delivery, control effectiveness and scalability.
  • Monitor operational performance metrics and exception trends to support informed decision-making.
  • Implement sustainable solutions that improve process consistency and reduce recurring issues.

Stakeholder & Client Service Management

  • Collaborate with business, risk, compliance and technology partners to support seamless trade execution.
  • Manage stakeholder engagement to ensure effective resolution of operational issues and service requests.
  • Contribute to positive client outcomes through efficient transaction handling and responsive issue management.
  • Support business objectives by providing operational insights and recommendations on trade process performance.

Motivations

  • Motivated by delivering accurate, controlled and reliable operational outcomes in complex environments.
  • Energised by solving operational challenges and collaborating with diverse stakeholders to achieve shared objectives.
  • Thrives in environments that value accountability, continuous improvement and high standards of client service.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Trade Finance
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Trade Reconciliation
  • Quality Assurance
  • System Implementation
  • Banking Operations Management
  • Business Communications

Other Skills

  • Change Management
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Talent Development
  • Project Coordination

Qualifications

  • Exposure to regulated financial services environments where accuracy, control and compliance are critical.
  • Exposure to complex trade processing activities involving multiple stakeholders, systems and operational dependencies.
  • Experience managing operational risks, transaction exceptions and process control requirements within high-volume environments.
  • Exposure to operational improvement initiatives focused on enhancing efficiency, service quality and risk management.
  • Experience collaborating across business, risk, compliance and technology teams to support effective trade execution.
  • Business English (required)

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Job Summary

This role exists to deliver a consistent, responsive and high-quality service experience for Securities Services clients, ensuring their transactional enquiries, service issues and incidents are managed effectively in line with agreed service standards, client tiering and regulatory requirements.

The role acts as the internal voice of the client, working closely with Business Account Managers, Operations, Product, Technology, Compliance and other stakeholders to coordinate issue resolution, identify underlying causes and translate client feedback and service insights into practical improvements. It supports proactive client engagement through structured service reviews, service metrics and regular client interactions to strengthen relationships and improve the overall client experience.

The role also strengthens service resilience by ensuring effective incident and complaint management, appropriate escalation, root cause analysis and preventative actions, while identifying opportunities to improve digital adoption, operational efficiency and service quality.

Key Responsibilities

Client Service & Relationship Management

  • Deliver consistent and responsive client service that strengthens client satisfaction, retention and confidence in Securities Services.
  • Build effective client relationships through proactive engagement, regular pulse checks and structured service reviews aligned to client needs and service priorities.
  • Act as the internal voice of the client, translating feedback and service insights into clear actions across relevant internal teams.
  • Coordinate timely responses to client enquiries, service requests and due diligence requirements while maintaining professional and transparent communication.

Client Incident & Complaint Management

  • Coordinate the timely resolution of client incidents and complaints, ensuring issues are accurately captured, appropriately escalated and progressed through to closure.
  • Drive root cause analysis and follow-through on preventative and corrective actions to reduce recurring service issues.
  • Provide clear and timely updates to clients and internal stakeholders, particularly where resolution requires extended investigation or cross-functional action.
  • Leverage GEMS and established incident protocols to strengthen issue tracking, escalation, accountability and resolution effectiveness.

Service Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyse service metrics, client feedback and recurring issues to identify opportunities to improve service quality, efficiency and client outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to increase straight-through processing and optimise digital channel usage through analysis of client interactions and service patterns.
  • Translate client insights into practical service, process and product improvements in partnership with Operations, Product, Technology and other stakeholders.
  • Promote effective practices and service improvements across Securities Services to strengthen consistency and operational efficiency.

Client Insights & Business Outcomes

  • Use client insights and service data to identify emerging needs, service improvement opportunities and potential product or relationship opportunities.
  • Partner with Business Account Managers and Sales to support client retention, relationship development and relevant cross-sell or up-sell opportunities.
  • Provide meaningful market and service information through structured client reviews, supported by relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain awareness of relevant market and regulatory developments to support informed client conversations and service responses.

Risk, Controls & Governance

  • Apply the Bank’s operational risk and control requirements across client identification, enquiry handling, complaints and incident management.
  • Ensure client incidents and complaints are appropriately recorded, escalated, monitored and closed in line with established procedures.
  • Adhere to applicable regulatory, compliance, anti-money laundering, conduct and escalation requirements.
  • Maintain high standards of professional conduct, ensuring client service activities operate within relevant policies, procedures and controls.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Account Optimization
  • Customer Service
  • Review Procedure
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Service Development
  • Analytics Strategy

Other Skills

  • Strategy Development
  • Team Assessment
  • Project Management
  • Communication
  • Client Management
  • Client Coordination

Motivations

  • Energised by creating a branch environment where customers receive trusted, responsive and consistently high-quality service, and where colleagues understand the part they play, in building lasting customer relationships.
  • Motivated by leading a branch to achieve sustainable commercial success, balancing revenue growth and customer retention with responsible risk management and positive customer outcomes.
  • Thrives on developing people, improving branch capabilities and leading change that strengthens customer experience, operational effectiveness and long-term business performance.

Qualifications

  • Experience operating in a complex, regulated financial services environment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Exposure to institutional client servicing, preferably within Securities Services, custody, transaction banking or a comparable financial services environment.
  • Experience working across Operations, Product, Technology, Sales and control functions to coordinate client outcomes and resolve complex issues.
  • Exposure to client service metrics, incident management, root cause analysis and service improvement in a high-volume operational environment.
  • Experience engaging with institutional clients through structured service reviews, issue resolution and ongoing relationship interactions.
  • Business English

Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Client Incident & Complaint Management

  • Drive root cause analysis and follow-through on preventative and corrective actions to reduce recurring service issues.
  • Provide clear and timely updates to clients and internal stakeholders, particularly where resolution requires extended investigation or cross-functional action.
  • Leverage GEMS and established incident protocols to strengthen issue tracking, escalation, accountability and resolution effectiveness.

Service Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure client incidents and complaints are appropriately recorded, escalated, monitored and closed in line with established procedures.
  • Adhere to applicable regulatory, compliance, anti-money laundering, conduct and escalation requirements.
  • Maintain high standards of professional conduct, ensuring client service activities operate within relevant policies, procedures and controls.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Account Optimization
  • Customer Service
  • Review Procedure
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Service Development
  • Analytics Strategy

Other Skills

  • Strategy Development
  • Team Assessment
  • Project Management
  • Communication
  • Client Management
  • Client Coordination

Motivations

  • Energised by creating a branch environment where customers receive trusted, responsive and consistently high-quality service, and where colleagues understand the part they play, in building lasting customer relationships.
  • Motivated by leading a branch to achieve sustainable commercial success, balancing revenue growth and customer retention with responsible risk management and positive customer outcomes.
  • Thrives on developing people, improving branch capabilities and leading change that strengthens customer experience, operational effectiveness and long-term business performance.

Qualifications

  • Experience operating in a complex, regulated financial services environment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Exposure to institutional client servicing, preferably within Securities Services, custody, transaction banking or a comparable financial services environment.
  • Experience working across Operations, Product, Technology, Sales and control functions to coordinate client outcomes and resolve complex issues.
  • Exposure to client service metrics, incident management, root cause analysis and service improvement in a high-volume operational environment.
  • Experience engaging with institutional clients through structured service reviews, issue resolution and ongoing relationship interactions.
  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

ln:4489742995.descriptionHtml:
The Investment Banking Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Investment Banking Analyst also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as a strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities

  • Work with senior Corporate & Investment Bank (CIB) officers and professionals and participate in particular client transactions, projects or assignments as the junior member of the Investment Banking team
  • Responsible for organizing and analyzing sophisticated financial data used in client proposals and strategic plans
  • Prepare written recommendations, valuation materials and statistical exhibits for pitches and live deals
  • Conduct economic/financial research
  • Evaluate company’s financial performance compared to overall industry and market trends
  • Build complex financial models for valuation purposes
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of relevant experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration
  • Series 79 and 63 licenses
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work under pressure in a rapidly changing environment in order to meet deadlines


Education

  • Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience


This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

ln:4490661246.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist

Business: CTO AI Platforms

Job ID: 67329

Principal Responsibilities

  • Build core components for Document Intelligence to enable enterprise AI use cases, delivering standardised, robust, and scalable solutions that meet growing business demand.
  • Develop and maintain scalable APIs and integration services to support AI products, workflows, and platform capabilities end-to-end.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical governance by conducting design/architecture reviews and enforcing engineering standards, coding practices, documentation, and quality assurance.
  • Deliver hands-on engineering including API development, unit/integration testing, defect resolution, and partnering with testers on test cases and test data preparation.
  • Able to communicate with stakeholders across systems (upstream/downstream) to define requirements and design effective, well-governed API interfaces.
  • Strengthen DevOps and engineering processes to improve delivery and support efficiency while ensuring adherence to established standards.
  • Deploy and scale on cloud platforms by leveraging GCP and Kubernetes to manage applications effectively in enterprise environments.
  • Ensure reliability, performance, and compliance through monitoring, load/performance testing, optimisation, and incident response to maintain low latency, high throughput, and stable operations (including onsite/offsite production support).

Requirements

  • Act as a senior individual contributor with strong solution design and hands-on coding expertise, demonstrating excellent technical problem-solving as well as strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Hold a university degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Bring 7+ years of IT experience (preferably in enterprise application or platform development) with 4+ years’ hands-on proficiency in Java and Python for backend and platform engineering.
  • Show exposure to all stages of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and a solid working knowledge of Agile methodology.
  • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, micro-frontend architecture, and LLM new solutions a strong advantage.
  • Experienced in leveraging coding assistants (e.g., AI pair-programming tools) to accelerate software development, enhance code quality, and support engineering best practices.

/WX/51/ZP/LP

ln:4490649564.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Conduct product training to support and deliver new product launches and lead client education events to help clients gain better knowledge of financial markets and financial solutions.
  • Follow the needs-based sales process, give clients meaningful and consistent wealth experience and ultimately provide an outstanding client experience
  • Support RMs to gain more client trust and commitment in broadening and deepening their relationship with HSBC, and increase the effectiveness and quality of needs fulfilled for target clients
  • Strengthen HSBC’s image as a leading wealth provider by providing clients with access to advanced technical product expertise
  • Conduct portfolio reviews with RMs, assess product suitability and market and regulatory change impact to products held by clients as appropriate, identify opportunities and manage risks
  • Join RMs in meeting clients and provide advice, input based on technical knowledge while acting as a second point of contact to RMs for specific products and solutions
  • Improve RMs product specific technical knowledge by effective on-job coaching and training
  • Activity: (Joint) meeting, Training, Coaching, Client Seminar, Portfolio Review, Policy Review
  • 提供新产品培训，帮助客户获得更好的理财市场信息和解决办法。
  • 根据客户财务需求，分享合适的财富管理经验和提供良好的客户体验
  • 帮助客户经理获得并加深客户信任，提高满足客户财务需求的有效性和质量
  • 利用先进的技术专长，加强客户对汇丰在财富管理市场上的领先形象
  • 帮助客户经理梳理客户财务组合，根据市场和政策变化，判断潜在机会并管理风险，对客户持有产品进行相应调整
  • 陪同客户经理约见客人，并基于产品和解决方法提供专业建议
  • 利用专长给客户经理提供辅导和培训
  • 活动包括客户会见及陪同销售、培训、辅导、客户沙龙、客户资产组合回顾及保单回顾等。

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Accumulated extensive working experience as a product specialist or financial advisor or hands-on working experience as Sub-branch Manager in IWPB
  • Strong client skills with the ability to deliver a strong client experience and provide needs-based solutions
  • Deep knowledge of specific complex financial solutions and products including the knowledge of financial markets, social-economic dynamics, and regulatory requirement relevant to the products
  • Extensive external market awareness of market conditions, new product solutions, and an understanding of current financial market activities
  • Demonstrated ability and experience to correctly identify client needs
  • Solid skills to manage consultative sales process
  • A solid understanding of global Anti-money Laundering standards
  • Team player with collaborative skills
  • Knowledge of local and Group compliance regulation
  • Specialization in one or more product categories e.g. /Estate Planning/Retirement/Protection/ Education.
  • 相关领域丰富的工作经验，如保险专家或财富管理专家,或有对私支行行长经验
  • 良好客户沟通能力，能基于客户需求提供建议
  • 熟悉财富管理相关产品知识以及相关政策规定
  • 熟悉外部市场包括市场环境，新产品推出以及对目前产品市场的理解
  • 能够深度挖掘客户需求
  • 熟悉销售流程
  • 熟悉国际反洗钱规则
  • 具有团队合作精神
  • 熟悉国际和国内相关法律规定
  • 在某一领域特别擅长优先，比如房地产规划/退休规划/家庭保障/教育规划等

Corporate and Institutional Banking

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Co-ordinate origination and execution of in country activities across the spectrum of banking products/service.

Build the Banking franchise value/reputation in the market place.

Drive achievement against targets for revenue generation, product alignment, customer satisfaction and cost containment.

Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk.

Identify event driven opportunities on an opportunistic basis, bringing in sector/country expertise as appropriate.

Aggressively grow HSBC's share of client wallet involving product specialists to ensure product capabilities are in line with client/sector requirements.

By critically assessing the exposures of each customer through vigorous review processes, active communications with CST members and frequent update of market intelligence. Such reviews are to be completed on time as required by the account review cycle and also where deemed necessary.

By working closely with Credit Risk Management to ensure that all credits are in compliance of both internal and external requirements and to formulate / implement exit or rehabilitation strategies for substandard credits. The primary goals are to safeguard the Bank for any material loss and to obtain an optimal balance between risk and return.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

Ability to provide marketing support to senior relationship managers

Ability to establish rapport with members of client's management team

Ability to provide good analytical support to senior relationship managers

Strong PC skills (excel, PowerPoint etc.)

Good team player

Knowledge of HSBC Group structures and products

Good verbal and written communication skills

Knowledge of the spectrum of banking products and services

Understanding of risk management and credit mitigants

Good level of financial analysis ability

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4490608493.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Develop and implement communications strategy and programs to continuously protect and promote the Bank's brand and bring to life the Bank's business strategy and core values via multiple external/internal touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Play a pivot role in developing and implementing communications strategy consistent with the Bank’s business strategies and priorities in China
  • Continuously build profile and uplift visibility for the bank in areas relating to Corporate & Investment Banking, Branding initiatives and Corporate Social Responsibilities

Business

  • Sound knowledge of the Bank’s global franchise, China market and a good understanding of the opportunities opening up for CIB business
  • Develop and implement strategic communications plan and roadmap, focusing on the Bank's strategy and business priorities
  • Focus on the following areas of CIB business from strategy to communications programmes & execution:
  • Coverage – Corporates & Financial Institutions
  • CIB Products – TB & FM
  • Initiatives such as China Opening-up, Chinese Enterprises Going Global, RMB Internationalisation, Belt & Road, Financial Connectivity Schemes, Sustainable and Transition Finance, Digitalisation
  • Executive profiling for senior executives' thought leadership in line with respective business focuses
  • Develop press releases, executive speeches, Op-Ed, WeChat articles and LinkedIn posts for corporate and business communications related programs
  • Arrange media interviews on proactive basis for major business developments/milestones and the Bank's focus areas
  • Lead media relations for China East region and provide communications support for reputational risk management for incidents in East

Risk Management

  • Adherence to laws and regulations, internal risk and compliance policies (including anti-money laundering, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption and relevant FCC risks) and the Group Code of Conduct
  • Work closely with media monitoring agency to be aware of related media voice on potential issues and provide sound judgement and mitigation plan from communications perspective
  • Play a key role in reputational risk management for the Bank, and work as a key CABM contact window for China East Region

Governance

  • Ensure adherence to the Risk Management Framework, Group Code of Conduct and various Policies, Procedures and Guidelines of the Bank by the Group and China CABM teams
  • Play a pivotal role in guiding relevant stakeholders on communications-related guidelines and best practices
  • Maintain high awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the business operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role
  • Completion of all mandatory training needed including e-learning within stated timeframes to support the understanding of the roles for delivering effective governance

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

Internal

  • China EXCO members
  • CIB China Head Office & CIB Business
  • East CGMs
  • China & Group CABM

External

  • Media
  • Communications counterparts at regulatory/ governmental authorities
  • Key financial analysts & opinion leaders
  • General public

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in CABM
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures;
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

Skills And Experience

  • Communications Strategy & Planning
  • Copywriting & Content Development
  • Media Engagement & Management
  • Reputational Risk Management
  • Strategic & Creative Thinking

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of communications experience, preferably with experience related to the financial services industry
  • Proven communications expertise, with the ability to develop and execute integrated communications strategies across earned, owned, and paid media channels
  • Strong writing, editing, and content development skills in both Chinese and English
  • Sound judgment and experience in issues and reputational risk management
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across businesses and functions
  • Strong self-motivation, strategic thinking, adaptability, and a high-level attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word and Outlook); familiarity with digital communications platforms, social media analytics and AI-enabled productivity tools is an advantage

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Description

Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead product planning and design for AI / LLM initiatives across internal scenarios: operations, compliance, customer service, office automation and business support.
  • Own end-to-end AI project lifecycle, coordinate cross-functional teams, and ensure on-time, high-quality delivery and iteration.
  • Identify business pain points and translate requirements into actionable AI solutions to boost operational efficiency.
  • Independently deliver prototypes, process/functional designs and product documentation, defining business rules, permissions, exception handling and acceptance criteria.
  • Gather user feedback, iterate product experience, and build best practices for AI rollout.
  • Monitor AI technology trends, explore compliant use cases, and work with technical and compliance teams to mitigate project risks.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above, 3+ years of B2B product experience. Prior AI delivery experience in fund / asset management is preferred.
  • Hands-on track record building AI products from 0 to 1, covering requirement definition, design and project governance.
  • Understand LLM strengths and limitations, able to collaborate effectively with algorithm and engineering teams and assess solution feasibility.
  • Strong structured thinking, capable of managing multiple concurrent projects and controlling timeline and quality.
  • Skilled in common product tools with solid documentation skills.
  • Responsible, execution-driven, good at cross-team collaboration, and passionate about AI applications in financial industry.

About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

ln:4490906615.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

An Engineer –Test Automation is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated test scripts and frameworks to ensure the quality and reliability of software Roles and Responsibilities products. They conduct risk-based independent reviews of the Group ICS control efficacy, material attestation oversight (SWIFT), control testing oversight, and manage issues raised in assurance activities.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of test automation strategies aligned with business goals and software development processes. This involves selecting appropriate testing tools, frameworks, and methodologies to ensure efficient and effective test coverage

Business

  • Understanding software requirements and translating them into test cases and automation scripts
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to define acceptance criteria and quality standards for software products and features

Process

  • Designing and implementing automated testing processes and workflows to accelerate testing cycles and improve software quality. This includes developing automated test scripts, configuring test environments, and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and deployment
  • Operational management of iTrack/M7 platform (inc. system changes, onboarding of new users, information sources, reporting and data quality governance)
  • Conducting risk-based independent reviews of the Group ICS control efficacy in 1LoD and CISRO, using the Second Line Assurance Methodology
  • Reviewing control library and 1LoD control testing, including associated artefacts. People & Talent
  • Overseeing, challenging, and reviewing / assuring material attestations, particularly SWIFT, ensuring that Bank responses are evidence-based
  • Assuring 1LoD control testing approach
  • Overseeing control testing by 1LoD to assure risk reduction
  • Identifying and managing control gaps effectively during 1LoD control testing
  • Full issue lifecycle management to closure, for findings identified in reviews (inc. Assurance Reviews, Red Team Exercises, Control Testing, Regulatory findings and COSMOS findings)
  • Reviews and edits AI-generated test cases, creates additional manual and automated tests where needed, and ensures quality and compliance of solutions built

People & Talent

  • Building and nurturing a skilled test automation team capable of developing and maintaining automated test suites
  • Providing training, mentorship, and support to enhance team members' expertise in test automation tools, techniques, and best practices

Risk Management

  • Identifying and mitigating risks associated with software defects and quality issues
  • Implementing automated regression tests, performance tests, and security tests to detect and prevent defects early in the development lifecycle and minimize the risk of production failures

Governance

  • Establishing and enforcing governance frameworks to ensure consistency and compliance in test automation practices. This involves defining standards, guidelines, and processes for test case management, version control, and reporting to maintain transparency and accountability in testing activities

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Scripting Language
  • Database Development
  • Information Security Management
  • Operating Systems
  • Network Infrastructure Security
  • Prompt Engineering
  • Contextual Design
  • AI Testing
  • API testing
  • Banking domain
  • Critical Thinking
  • Systems Design
  • AI Augmented Workflow Design

Other Skills

  • DevOps
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • System Testing
  • CI/CD
  • Web Application Security
  • Web Testing
  • Mobile Testing
  • Performance Testing

Qualifications

  • Languages: Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

ln:4490978119.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
  • Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
  • Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
  • Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
  • Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
  • Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
  • Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
  • Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
  • Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
  • Fluency in Mandarin and English

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4490400117.descriptionHtml:
The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team.The Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients.The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities

  • Leverage past investment banking or related experience to enhance Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) execution and capital raising capabilities and contribute to building Citi's franchise
  • Meet revenue and other financial goals by establishing and maintaining a pipeline of episodic deals
  • Ensure that proposed client solutions meet or exceed internal risk and return standards, including stringent ethical standards,
  • Anticipate future changes in the marketplace
  • Identify and anticipate all types of risks (e.g. industry, portfolio, diversification, sovereign, commercial, currency, etc.)
  • Serve as a mentor to junior Bankers, execute staffing models that support business needs and career trajectories for junior staff
  • Build client relationships by providing sophisticated financial solutions tailored to the clients’ needs and acting as a content provider on market trends
  • Serve as the expert on regulatory, financial and complex strategic issues relating to corporate finance transactions
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Recommended Qualifications

  • 15+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience in people management
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration preferred
  • Master's degree in Business Administration preferred
  • Experience working in an investment banking institution(s)
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Demonstrated ability to remain unbiased in a diverse working environment
  • Series 79 and 63 licenses


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred

  • Series 79 and 63 licenses
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work under pressure in a rapidly changing environment in order to meet deadlines

ln:4490189846.descriptionHtml:
The Securities & Derivatives Analyst 2 is an intermediate level position responsible for processing orders and transactions originating from trading desks and branch offices in coordination with the Operations - Transaction Services team. The overall objective of this role is to facilitate the clearance, settlement and investigation of client securities and derivatives transactions.

Responsibilities

  • Process securities transactions, provide analytic input for traders and aid in review of derivative products
  • Identify and resolve securities and derivative settlement issues, and make process improvement recommendations to leadership
  • Analyze moderately complex reports to satisfy management requirements, aid in control activities, and contribute to the launch of product services
  • Monitor and suggest solutions to errors to minimize risk to the bank, through an intermediate knowledge of procedural requirements
  • Escalate transaction processing issues to the appropriate department and collaborate on a solution
  • Design and analyze moderately complex reports, in coordination with standards set by direct leadership
  • Assist with control activities, and the launch of new products and services
  • Ensure processes adhere to audit and control policies
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications

  • 0-2 years of relevant experience
  • Fundamental understanding of Treasury products, accounting and regulatory policies
  • Proven ability to perform various concurrent activities/projects in a high-risk environment
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated knowledge of macros


Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree/University degree or equivalent experience in Business, Accounting, or Finance


This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

About The Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 28 February 2027

Job Description

Title Testing Technical Lead

Department DPS DL

Location Dalian

Reports To Technical Manager

Level 4

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

About Your Team

You’ll join a passionate mobile engineering team dedicated to building intuitive, high-performance apps that enhance user experiences. Our work impacts thousands of customers in Unite Kindom who is using Fidelity pension business and personal investment as well as driving engagement and business growth.

About Your Role

As a Technology Quality Assurance our mobile team, you will work as a key member of implementation of robust end-to-end automation testing solutions that ensure the quality and in reliability of our mobile applications. Your work will directly impact user experience by enabling faster releases and reducing defects through scalable test automation. You’ll develop and maintain frameworks using mobile automation framework like WebdriverIO (WDIO) or Cucumber, while leveraging JavaScript/TypeScript for scripting and integration. Beyond building tests, you’ll collaborate with developers and QA engineers to define best practices, optimize pipelines, and drive automation coverage across the product lifecycle—making a measurable difference in delivering high-quality apps to our customers.

About You

You have proven expertise in end-to-end automation testing in mobile application with hands-on experience in mobile automation framework like WebdriverIO (WDIO) or Cucumber frameworks.

  • Proficient in JavaScript/TypeScript and have a strong understanding of test automation principles, including BDD and CI/CD integration.
  • With at least 3+ years of experience in test automation.
  • Excel at building scalable frameworks and writing maintainable test scripts.
  • Experience in mobile app testing and API validation is essential.
  • Thrive in collaborative environments and take ownership of delivering reliable, automated solutions.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business: IWPB Technology

Job ID：63476

Principal Responsibilities

  • Accountable and responsible for mobile applications development (Android / iOS) for our everyday banking & wealth view mobile apps.
  • Write clean, highly maintainable, testable, scalable and efficient code following best practices.
  • Debug and resolve technical production issues, ensuring app stability and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in mobile development.
  • Contribute to documentation and knowledge sharing articles.
  • Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, designers, architects, and other stakeholders to ensure that we can deliver world-class mobile applications to our customers.
  • Understanding the functional and non-functional requirements through regular interactions with the Business Analysts, SMEs and Solution Architects.
  • Provides accurate estimates and status to management, raising issues appropriately.
  • Manage a squad teams of developers performing system development work and system analysis.
  • Work with Scrum master to prioritize the items from the product backlog in the sprint planning.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Passionate about mobile application development with extensive experience delivering high-quality apps.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical fields.
  • Proficiency in:Android: Kotlin and Java, Android SDK, Android Studio, Jetpack Compose;iOS: Swift and Objective-C, Xcode, UIKit/SwiftUI.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile architecture e.g.: MVVM.
  • Strong knowledge on object-oriented programming, functional programming, and reactive programming.
  • Strong knowledge and have practical experience with Redux (or similar state management patterns).
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs concepts and integration mechanisms.
  • Strong understanding of Apple / Google mobile development principles & best practices.
  • Strong understanding of Behavior-Driven-Development (BDD), including writing & maintaining BDD test scripts for Android and/or iOS.
  • Proficiency in building composable UI components using Jetpack Compose (Android) or SwiftUI (iOS).
  • Familiar with version control systems: Git.
  • Familiar on DevOps tooling: Jenkins, Splunk, , Nexus, Jira, Confluence etc.
  • Able to work effectively with cross region, multi-cultural development teams.
  • Ability to explain complex technical problems / solutions to audiences at different technical background / knowledge.
  • Strong problem solving and analytic skills, able to work independently and under pressure.
  • Strong work ethic and team player experienced working with Scrum/Agile development methodologies
  • Strong analytical, design and problem solving skills; excellent team player with ability to work under pressure with minimal supervision
  • Real passion for elegance and efficiency in software engineering and always strive for continuous improvements via automated processes
  • Work closely with both local and global teams on the project delivery with agile/DevOps manners.
  • A good team player with strong analytical/troubleshooting skills, and self-motivated
  • Flexible and adaptable in accommodating change of requirement and willing to take new responsibilities when necessary.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills and fluent in English. Proficient in Mandarin / Cantonese is desirable.

/WX/LP

We develop, implement and support software and IT services and processes that allow HSBC to remain at the forefront of high-quality banking systems.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
