ln:4491111777.descriptionHtml:
Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB)

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Business: To maximize the revenues of customer portfolio and increase the Bank's share of customer wallets. To maintain a high level of credit quality in the jobholder's customer portfolio and to mitigate the hidden risks of the evolving Banking products.

Assist Associate Director/ Director To

  • Co-ordinate origination and execution of in country activities across the spectrum of banking products/service.
  • Build the Banking franchise value/reputation in the market place.
  • Drive achievement against targets for revenue generation, product alignment, customer satisfaction and cost containment.
  • Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk.
  • Identify event driven opportunities on an opportunistic basis, bringing in sector/country expertise as appropriate.
  • Aggressively grow HSBC's share of client wallet involving product specialists to ensure product capabilities are in line with client/sector requirements.
  • By critically assessing the exposures of each customer through vigorous review processes, active communications with Customer Service Team (CST) members and frequent update of market intelligence. Such reviews are to be completed on time as required by the account review cycle and also where deemed necessary.
  • By working closely with Credit Risk Management to ensure that all credits are in compliance of both internal and external requirements and to formulate / implement exit or rehabilitation strategies for substandard credits. The primary goals are to safeguard the Bank for any material loss and to obtain an optimal balance between risk and return.

Customers and Stakeholders: To build effective customer relationships and to become the customers' preferred financial partner and trusted advisor.

  • By ensuring customers' experiences with the Bank in all front exceed their expectations, i.e. first class services are provided promptly and professionally; solutions presented are competitive and innovative.
  • By keeping abreast of the customer's business development through frequent contacts in both official and social occasions.
  • By providing advisory-led value added services to customers with the jobholder's updated sector knowledge and market intelligence.
  • To assist senior bankers in ensuring focused relationship building programs are carried out regularly.

Leadership & Teamwork: To coordinate the CST to ensure the clients' needs are covered in a proactive and efficient manner. To support the senior bankers in operational issues.

  • By effectively utilizing customer relationship management tool (i.e. CME).
  • By managing client meetings and ensuring that product partners actively participate in discussions concerning client requirements and needs.
  • By working closely with customers to identify macro operating issues and to satisfy their requirements on a regional /local basis.
  • Understand and ensure compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business in which the jobholder is involved.
  • Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators.
  • Demonstrate leadership on Regulatory & Compliance matters. Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Ability to provide marketing support to senior relationship managers
  • Ability to establish rapport with members of client's management team
  • Ability to provide good analytical support to senior relationship managers
  • Strong PC skills (excel, PowerPoint etc.)
  • Good team player
  • Knowledge of HSBC Group structures and products
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Knowledge of the spectrum of banking products and services
  • Understanding of risk management and credit mitigants
  • Good level of financial analysis ability

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4491111458.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java Full-stack Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in React, Java 17, frameworks like Spring Boot or Quarkus, and microservices architecture. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining backend services that are robust, scalable, and efficient.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy

Business

  • Design, develop, and maintain frontend services using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Front-end frameworks.
  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 17 and Spring Boot / Quarkus.
  • Implement microservices architecture to ensure scalability and maintainability.
  • Develop REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Integrate with databases using ORM frameworks and ensure efficient DB connectivity.
  • Develop and maintain messaging services using JMS and Solace.
  • Ensure seamless API connectivity using platforms such as Kong or Axway.
  • Manage project dependencies and build processes using Maven.
  • Collaborate with the team using Git for version control.
  • Containerize applications using Docker for consistent deployment.
  • Utilize Azure DevOps (ADO) for CI/CD pipelines and project management.
  • Deploy and manage applications on OpenShift and AWS.
  • Implement service virtualization for testing and development.
  • Write and maintain unit tests using JUnit.
  • Conduct integration testing to ensure seamless interaction between components.
  • Document APIs using Swagger.
  • Perform performance testing and scripting to ensure application efficiency using tools like JMeter.
  • Ensure adherence and continuous improvement of Agile practices, coaching and teaching new techniques to the team as needed to achieve optimum productivity.
  • Engage and collaborate with a wide group of technology teams from upstream TP systems, integration, modeling team, database administrators, messaging teams, and architecture.
  • Engage Code Analysis, Debugging Scenarios, Analytical Problem Solving, System Thinking, Practical Debugging and Log Analysis

Skills And Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in frontend (React) and microservice API development using Java frameworks.
  • Experience in developing and deploying cloud-native applications, with a focus on Function as a Service (FaaS) and Dev-in-a-box solutions.
  • Strong skills in API integration with in-house and third-party vendor applications, including Trading Networks.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift container platforms.
  • Preferred experience in the banking domain.
  • Knowledge of Postgres or Oracle relational databases.
  • Proficient in Spring Boot and API development.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile Development (CI/CD, TDD/BDD, SCRUM, KanBan).
  • Minimum 10 years of software development experience.
  • Experience with advanced features and tools in the Atlassian software suite.
  • Passion for technology and a collaborative, consultative work environment.
  • Proven skills in coordination, staff management, and leadership with vendors and internal teams.
  • Strong knowledge of risk and regulatory delivery.
  • Comprehensive understanding of software design and development.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong analytical skills on Code Analysis, Debugging Scenarios, Analytical Problem Solving, Practical Debugging and Log Analysis

Qualifications

  • Languages: Fluent in spoken and written English
  • Willingness to work on both development and project management.
  • Contribute to the creation of standards and frameworks for the project.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Prepare architectural solutions documents and technical audits for the project.
  • Prepare high/low-level technical design documents.
  • Learn and understand relevant application functional and technical architecture for effective development.
  • Follow documented SDLC life cycle as per quality management standards.
  • Participate in requirement gathering and solution meetings.
  • Track overall development and project management.
  • Support developers with technical assistance and improve technical competency levels among team members.
  • Design modules based on technical specifications.
  • Implement best practices.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Summary

Customer sales and service

职责范围：

客户销售与服务

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.
  • Deliver allocated performance targets for various product VSs;
  • Maintain relationship with customers and deliver superior customer service to ensure customers’ needs are met;
  • Enhance bank-customer relationships by expanding existing customers’ portfolio holdings;
  • Actively participate in Priority Banking / other Bank’s marketing and promotional activities to acquire NTB customers, as well as cross-selling to existing customers;
  • Proactively engage with Personal Clients hidden affluent and advise to approach bank with complex investment needs;
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
  • Ensure compliance of Management Manual, Operating Manuals and Bank’s laid down knowledge of the various products offered by all departments;
  • Learn and understand all relevant regulations and internal Risk & Compliance policies and procedures;
  • Keep updated on the events in the financial industry;
  • Participate actively in training programs, meetings, briefings organized by the bank and ensure skills & knowledge acquired is applied to daily work;
  • Ensure timeliness & managing customer’s complaint;

主要工作职责/挑战：

  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。
  • 实现领导安排的各个产品的业绩指标；
  • 维护与客户的关系并提供卓越的客户服务以确保满足客户需求；
  • 通过扩大现有客户的投资组合加强客户与我行的关系；
  • 积极参与优先理财/其它银行营销项目，以获取新客户。另外，向现有客户进行交叉销售；
  • 主动发现具有“优先理财”资质的个人理财客户, 并发掘其投资理财需求；
  • 负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
  • 遵循银行的管理手册，操作手册和所有部门相关产品的既定政策；
  • 学习并了解一切相关条例以及内部风险与合规的政策与程序；
  • 保持对金融行业相关动向的敏感；
  • 积极参与银行组织的培训项目，会议和简报会，并保证将学习到的技能和知识运用到日常工作中；
  • 确保客户投诉的时效与管理；

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Financial skills
  • Analytical skills

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • Full time Bachelor’s degree, or AMAC Fund Qualification Certificate Holder.
  • 1 year or above working experience in financial industry, acting in good faith and professional ethics. Have a good command of knowledge about wealth management sales activities related regulations
  • Sound knowledge of financial products and services and banking procedures, equities markets, unit trusts and other personal investment services are preferred.
  • Good investment counseling and analytical skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to deal with all levels of people, often in complex and difficult situations.
  • Team player who shows initiative and assertiveness.
  • Self-motivator who is keen to upgrade, improve personal knowledge and skills to meet job requirements.
  • Good command of both spoken and written English and Mandarin

职位要求：

  • 全日制大学本科学历，或持有基金从业资格证书。
  • 从事金融工作1年以上，具备良好的诚信记录及职业操守
  • 熟悉理财业务活动及理财产品销售相关的法律法规
  • 熟悉银行产品、服务、银行程序、股票市场、单位信托以及其它个人投资服务。
  • 具备良好的投资咨询和分析技巧。
  • 出色的人际关系能力和沟通能力，能在复杂场合应付自如。
  • 具有团队意识，主动坚定。
  • 有上进心，能自我激励，不断提高人际交流能力和技巧，以满足工作要求。

Other then above roles, job holder should follow other job duties and responsibilities assigned by line manager from time to time.

除上述工作职责外，员工应遵循直属经理随时指派的任何工作职责和任务。

Above key responsibilities and selection criteria are the major assessment to assess the staff if qualified during probation and competent after probation. Failing to satisfy any of the aforesaid requirements, or failing to pass the CPBB Essentialsor WM Introduction Certification, the employee will be deemed not meeting the recruitment requirement for passing probation, and the Bank is entitled to terminate the employee’s employment contract immediately. For employee which have passed the probation, failing to pass the CPBB Essentials or WM Introduction Certification will be taken as assessment basis for job incompetency.

以上的主要工作职责和岗位聘任要求是用于考核试用期是否符合录用条件和工作胜任与否的标准。倘若员工未能满足前述要求，或未能通过CPBB Essentials测试或理财产品介绍资格认证测试的，则该员工将被视为不符合试用期的录用条件，银行有权立即终止员工的劳动合同；对于已过试用期的员工，未能通过CPBB Essential测试或理财产品介绍资格认证测试的，将作为不胜任工作工作岗位的考核依据。

Before attend and pass the CPBB Essentials and WM Introduction Certification course, the employee should not perform any kind of business communication / engagement to customers.

对于还没有参与并通过CPBB Essential入职培训或理财产品介绍资格认证测试的员工, 禁止跟客户有任何业务上的交流。

Please note that the job description above will be reviewed during the Job Objective setting every year, which may be amended and agreed where necessary by the employee and the line manager.

请注意以上本工作描述将于每年制定年度工作目标时予以审核，如有必要将由直属经理和员工予以修订并达成一致。

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Job Summary

This role exists to ensure the accurate, timely and controlled execution of cash management activities across payment processing, clearing, client instructions, account maintenance and static data services. The role is responsible for delivering reliable operational outcomes that support client transactions, safeguard financial assets and maintain the integrity of the Bank's cash management services.

The role is accountable for processing and validating transactions, maintaining critical customer and product data, identifying and escalating operational exceptions, and ensuring service delivery aligns with agreed service levels, regulatory obligations and internal control standards. Through disciplined execution and strong operational risk management, the role contributes to client satisfaction, operational resilience and sustainable business growth.

Working closely with Operations teams, Service Delivery partners, Risk and Compliance functions, Technology teams and business stakeholders, the role helps convert operational requirements into consistent service outcomes. The role supports process efficiency, client experience and operational excellence but does not own product strategy, client relationship management or enterprise-wide operational policy.

Key Responsibilities

Service Delivery & Transaction Processing

  • Execute payment, clearing and cash management activities accurately and within agreed turnaround times to support uninterrupted client servicing.
  • Validate customer instructions, transaction data and processing requirements to ensure operational accuracy and minimise processing risk.
  • Resolve operational exceptions and processing breaks through timely investigation, escalation and corrective action.
  • Deliver service outcomes that consistently meet productivity, quality and client service standards.

Cash Management Operations & Data Integrity

  • Maintain customer, account and product static data to ensure completeness, accuracy and operational readiness across cash management services.
  • Apply established operational controls when performing account maintenance, pricing, billing and related operational activities.
  • Ensure transaction and client records are accurately captured and maintained to support operational, regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Identify data quality issues and drive corrective actions that improve operational effectiveness and minimise service disruptions.

Risk Management & Control Effectiveness

  • Apply operational risk controls that safeguard the Bank against transaction errors, operational losses and control breakdowns.
  • Conduct independent validation activities in accordance with segregation of duties, authority limits and control requirements.
  • Identify, assess and escalate operational risk events, control weaknesses and emerging risks through appropriate governance channels.
  • Support remediation activities that strengthen control effectiveness and reduce recurring operational issues.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance

  • Apply regulatory requirements, internal policies and operational procedures consistently across all cash management activities.
  • Perform AML, sanctions and other financial crime-related checks in line with Bank standards and escalation requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records and evidence that support audit reviews, governance reporting and regulatory inspections.
  • Promote adherence to conduct, compliance and risk standards that protect the Bank and its clients.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve service quality and enhance operational efficiency across the end-to-end workflow.
  • Contribute to operational change initiatives, testing activities and business continuity readiness to support resilient service delivery.
  • Support the implementation of digitisation, automation and process enhancement initiatives that improve operational outcomes.
  • Share process insights and improvement opportunities to strengthen team effectiveness and service performance.

Stakeholder & Client Service Management

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve service issues and ensure effective delivery of cash management services.
  • Communicate operational issues, risks and service impacts clearly to relevant stakeholders to support timely resolution.
  • Build trusted working relationships that facilitate effective issue management and service improvements.
  • Support a client-focused culture by delivering responsive, accurate and professional operational services.

People and Talent

  • Build team capability through coaching, knowledge sharing and ongoing support that strengthens operational expertise and control awareness.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement while upholding the Bank's values and conduct expectations.
  • Support the development of colleagues through constructive feedback, training and opportunities to build operational competence.
  • Lead by example in demonstrating strong risk management, compliance discipline and service excellence.

Motivations

  • Motivated by delivering accurate and reliable operational outcomes in a high-volume, time-sensitive environment.
  • Energised by solving operational challenges, improving processes and enhancing service quality.
  • Thrives in environments that value collaboration, accountability, strong controls and continuous improvement.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Payment Processing
  • Cash Management
  • Certification and Accreditation
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Operations Management
  • Project Management
  • Service Delivery
  • Settlement Management

Other Skills

  • Transaction Management
  • Issue Management
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Service Recovery

Qualifications

  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

ln:4490441634.descriptionHtml:
The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The VP Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as a strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities

  • Assume significant levels of responsibility for the various phases of project and transaction execution, new business development and overall growth of the firm
  • Work closely with clients on financing transactions and guide them through the capital raising process, including leading due diligence and drafting sessions and preparing them for an equity or debt offering
  • Work with clients, senior-level team members and outside professional advisors on M&A and special situation transactions
  • Responsible for drafting situation analyses, pitch materials, information memoranda, investor and management presentations and oversee work being performed by analysts & associates assigned to projects


Recommended Qualifications

  • 6-10 years of experience
  • Experience in the Financial Services industry, specifically within Banking
  • Degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration
  • MBA or Master's Degree in Business preferred
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the corporate banking business and its related products, pertinent regulations and lending and credit approval processes
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience with large corporate clients, capital markets products, derivatives, credit, cash management, trade, finance and securities products
  • Series 7 and 63 preferred


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred

ln:4490452065.descriptionHtml:
The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team.The Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients.The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities

  • Leverage past investment banking or related experience to enhance Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) execution and capital raising capabilities and contribute to building Citi's franchise
  • Meet revenue and other financial goals by establishing and maintaining a pipeline of episodic deals
  • Ensure that proposed client solutions meet or exceed internal risk and return standards, including stringent ethical standards,
  • Anticipate future changes in the marketplace
  • Identify and anticipate all types of risks (e.g. industry, portfolio, diversification, sovereign, commercial, currency, etc.)
  • Serve as a mentor to junior Bankers, execute staffing models that support business needs and career trajectories for junior staff
  • Build client relationships by providing sophisticated financial solutions tailored to the clients’ needs and acting as a content provider on market trends
  • Serve as the expert on regulatory, financial and complex strategic issues relating to corporate finance transactions
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Recommended Qualifications

  • 15+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience in people management
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration preferred
  • Master's degree in Business Administration preferred
  • Experience working in an investment banking institution(s)
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Demonstrated ability to remain unbiased in a diverse working environment
  • Series 79 and 63 licenses


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred

ln:4490451146.descriptionHtml:
职位目标

  • 借助行内各种渠道, 进行新客户开发, 参与行内外组织的客户推介活动, 积累客户资源
  • 为支行或分行营业部新客户提供客户开户服务和维护, 日常咨询方面的需求, 增加客户在我行的资产占比, 以达到银行预期的业务和服务目标

发展成为银行的丰盛理财经理储备人才

主要职责

  • 渠道开发和拓展合格丰盛理财客户
  • 开拓挖掘新客户获取渠道（如战略合作伙伴，客户推荐，行内活动等），为我行新增合格丰盛理财客户。
  • 维护和优化现有渠道质量，主动探索深化与渠道合作伙伴关系，在拓展新客工作中实现高效协同。
  • 负责新客户开发的全流程：对潜在客户进行定向触达和资质筛选，为新客户开立账户，协助完成申请和相关文档。
  • 达成银行下达的各项销售任务，达到销售目标，为团队整体增长指标做出贡献。
  • 依托团队提供的线上渠道及客户留资，落实全国范围内潜客的沟通与需求挖掘。并且完成线上客户转化全流程。

ln:4491565228.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系

根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门

配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline

At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳

至少5年以上客户经理经验

具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系

具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣

成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧

普通话及英语流利

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

l ocation : Shanghai/Shenzhen/Guangzhou

Global Private Banking & Wealth

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. HSBC Private Banking helps high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients manage, grow, and preserve their wealth for generations to come. Our network of global experts helps clients access investment opportunities around the world, plan for future with wealth and succession planning, manage their portfolio with tailored solutions, and find the right support for their philanthropy.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • To maximize HSBC's network in CIB, BB, IWPB, HK Business and UK Business to grow quality clients for PB;
  • To develop the collaboration strategies, and align interest with other line of businesses and other PB booking centers;
  • To manage collaboration activities between GPB China and other Global Businesses across markets including but not limited to Hong Kong, Singapore, United Kingdom, UAE and United States;
  • To establish attractive internal marketing programs and scheme to contribute prospecting and relationship building with internal partners and stakeholders;
  • To track and review collaboration effort, and provide insights to GPB management;
  • To ensure support from the partners from other Global Businesses and GPB market teams by proactively managing and strengthening the relationship with key stakeholders.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Relevant qualifications and over 6 years of relevant experience in financial institutions;
  • Broad knowledge of universal banking model, with preference in corporate banking, investment banking and wealth management;
  • Strong data analytics and interpretation capabilities, and proficient in various MS office applications (ppt, excel etc.);
  • Fluent in English and Chinese speaking, and professional English writing;
  • Ability to think innovatively, shaping and communicating new concepts;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, in order to engage internal and external business stakeholders;
  • Experience in complex stakeholder management across organization is preferred – influencing, negotiating and partnering.

ln:4491542948.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business:CTO Data Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test and maintain reliable, secure and scalable backend services and software functions using Python.
  • Deliver independent software functions from technical analysis and design through to implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support.
  • Apply system-design thinking to develop solutions that meet functional, performance, scalability and maintainability requirements.
  • Collaborate with global Product Owners, Tech Leads, engineers and other stakeholders to plan and deliver high-quality software functions across locations and time zones.
  • Contribute to the integration and effective use of Large Language Models (LLMs) within backend services and technology solutions.
  • Investigate and resolve technical issues, contribute to code reviews and promote engineering best practices, including automated testing, documentation, security and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
  • More than five years’ professional experience in backend or software development, with a proven record of delivering production-ready software functions using Python.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, object-oriented design, data structures, APIs, databases and service integration.
  • Demonstrated system-design thinking, including the ability to design solutions that are scalable, resilient, maintainable and fit for purpose.
  • Experience working with LLM models or LLM-enabled applications, including model integration, prompt-based services or related backend implementation.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with global teams and deliver high-quality software across different locations and time zones

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Global Private Banking & Wealth

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. HSBC Private Banking helps high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients manage, grow, and preserve their wealth for generations to come. Our network of global experts helps clients access investment opportunities around the world, plan for future with wealth and succession planning, manage their portfolio with tailored solutions, and find the right support for their philanthropy.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • To maximize HSBC's network in CIB, BB, IWPB, HK Business and UK Business to grow quality clients for PB;
  • To develop the collaboration strategies, and align interest with other line of businesses and other PB booking centers;
  • To manage collaboration activities between GPB China and other Global Businesses across markets including but not limited to Hong Kong, Singapore, United Kingdom, UAE and United States;
  • To establish attractive internal marketing programs and scheme to contribute prospecting and relationship building with internal partners and stakeholders;
  • To track and review collaboration effort, and provide insights to GPB management;
  • To ensure support from the partners from other Global Businesses and GPB market teams by proactively managing and strengthening the relationship with key stakeholders.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Relevant qualifications and over 6 years of relevant experience in financial institutions;
  • Broad knowledge of universal banking model, with preference in corporate banking, investment banking and wealth management;
  • Strong data analytics and interpretation capabilities, and proficient in various MS office applications (ppt, excel etc.);
  • Fluent in English and Chinese speaking, and professional English writing;
  • Ability to think innovatively, shaping and communicating new concepts;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, in order to engage internal and external business stakeholders;
  • Experience in complex stakeholder management across organization is preferred – influencing, negotiating and partnering.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business: IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Drive the end-to-end product delivery, from requirements and solution design through to development, testing, deployment and production.
  • Dedicate your time to hands-on Java coding, including the design and development of database, Linux, microservices and cloud solutions, in the mean time, should have the knowldege of GCP/AWS cloud engieering.
  • Translate business needs into practical technical solutions, provide recommendations, facilitate decisions and build trusted stakeholder relationships.
  • Lead the Second/Third Line production support, including incident resolution and overnight batch support for critical business processes.
  • Define the product vision and technical roadmap, including technical debt reduction and platform improvements.
  • Break programmes into manageable deliveries, remove team impediments and lead retrospectives across teams.
  • Provide expertise in DevOps, security, accessibility, Agile and production governance, including stepping into the Production Support Management role when required.
  • Develop team capability by communicating clearly, coaching junior colleagues and supporting their career growth.

Requirements

Education:

  • A master degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related business field.
  • 10+ years’ experience in Java, Node.js, databases, Linux and open-source frameworks, with strong hands-on Java development experience.
  • Proficiency in Java EE, Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Spring Integration, Spring MVC, Hibernate/JPA and MyBatis.
  • Strong experience in microservices, live-live architecture, Spring Cloud, API gateways, authentication and cloud implementation.
  • Experience with CI/CD and delivery tools, including Jenkins, Maven, Gradle, NPM, Nexus, G3 and Ansible.
  • Strong database expertise, including SQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, H2, database design, performance tuning and optimisation.
  • Knowledge of JavaRx, Vert.x, Netty, WebFlux and NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Redis and InfluxDB.
  • Experience with object-oriented design, design patterns, Agile methods, scripting and application development across all tiers; willing to learn emerging technologies such as cloud and big data.
  • Strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills; able to work independently, follow HSBC standards, and communicate fluently in English and Chinese.
  • Knowledge or experience in cloud technology adoption such as AWS/Azure /GCP is a plus.
  • Experience in LLM Agent Engineering, including coaching the team's conding with AI capabilities/enabling any posible AI Agent in our product is a plus.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

CIB - Global Trade Solutions (GTS)

Trade has been the foundation of HSBC since 1865, it is evolving fast and so are we. With our network, expertise, and solutions we’re placed to help clients make sense of emerging trends, risks, and opportunities by being the global connectors, innovative problem solvers and strategic partners.

We connect the world through trade. Our footprint gives clients access to roughly 90% of world trade flows providing a powerful mix of local, regional, and global knowledge to help them spot new growth opportunities. We are innovative problem solvers that provide a safer, smoother digital trade experience. We solve business challenges through growth, disruption, or uncertainty, and we bring clients insights and ideas to enable grow and protect their business.

Our comprehensive suite of products and services can be combined into global solutions that help make it easier for businesses to manage trade risk, process trade transactions, and fund trade activities.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Manage a client portfolio in order to maintain existing and generate new income for the business. Undertake sector/portfolio planning and client monitoring/contact
  • Manage portfolio customers and follow end to end Client Management process ensuring superior client experience
  • Manage costs within plan with effective and proactive Client Management activities
  • Work closely with colleagues to promote awareness of Receivables Finance (RF) products, strategies and competitor information
  • Maintain awareness of the applicable regulatory and business environment: understand audit, tax and legal implications and changes as they affect the customers and the Bank

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Manage key relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Strive for class-leading customer experience by cultivating a consistent selling and relationship management culture
  • Deepen customer relationships through driving and supporting the championing of business cooperation with key stakeholders
  • Maintain close liaison with region colleagues/ stakeholders to provide input into the strategic direction of GTS
  • Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Analyst.

Principal responsibilities

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Head of Wealth Digital Engineering.

 Business: Wealth & Prem Solutions Tech IWPB Technology

Job ID ： 61756

The Role

As Head of Digital Engineering, Wealth you’ll be accountable for the technology strategy, architecture, engineering and delivery across a suite of Wealth Digital products, platforms and services that support customers and colleagues. These platforms underpin Wealth propositions spanning Retail Wealth through to HSBC Private Bank and are central to how we compete in key markets. This role sets technical direction while staying close to delivery - shaping designs, reviewing critical changes and guiding teams through complex build-and-run decisions. You’ll strengthen our shift from project to product and improve the end-to-end delivery pipeline from idea to production. You’ll also champion practical AI adoption across the SDLC to improve throughput, quality and operational effectiveness while balancing innovation with resilience, security and control expectations. Success looks like measurable improvements in delivery flow, reliability and customer experience across globally distributed teams.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Bring deep Wealth domain knowledge across investment lifecycles and digital propositions from direct-to-consumer to advisory and discretionary offerings
  • Demonstrate substantial software engineering leadership experience delivering secure resilient digital platforms end-to-end
  • Show a track record building and operating high-availability high-scale high-performance systems including production support and operational resilience
  • Evidence delivery of strategic global solutions including legacy platform migrations and platform demise
  • Apply strong technical judgement across observability incident response performance engineering capacity management release engineering and dependency management
  • Demonstrate AI and automation engineering literacy including taking practical AI-enabled use cases from concept to production with appropriate risk controls
  • Embed DevOps DevSecOps SRE and Agile practices in complex global environments with exposure to scaled agile approaches such as SAFe as a plus
  • Influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex technical topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Manage financial stewardship in a fixed-capacity environment including budgeting forecasting and vendor management

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bring deep Wealth domain knowledge across investment lifecycles and digital propositions from direct-to-consumer to advisory and discretionary offerings
  • Demonstrate substantial software engineering leadership experience delivering secure resilient digital platforms end-to-end
  • Show a track record building and operating high-availability high-scale high-performance systems including production support and operational resilience
  • Evidence delivery of strategic global solutions including legacy platform migrations and platform demise
  • Apply strong technical judgement across observability incident response performance engineering capacity management release engineering and dependency management
  • Demonstrate AI and automation engineering literacy including taking practical AI-enabled use cases from concept to production with appropriate risk controls
  • Embed DevOps DevSecOps SRE and Agile practices in complex global environments with exposure to scaled agile approaches such as SAFe as a plus
  • Influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex technical topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Manage financial stewardship in a fixed-capacity environment including budgeting forecasting and vendor management

/LP/WX

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Engineering Lead for COS.

 Business: Wealth & Prem Solutions Tech IWPB Technology

Job ID ： 61283

The Role

As Engineering Lead for Customer Onboarding Solutions (COS) you’ll own the technical direction and end-to-end delivery of our customer onboarding engineering capabilities across frontend, mobile, backend and integration services. This role is accountable for engineering excellence, predictable delivery and production stability in a highly regulated financial services environment. You’ll translate product and business priorities into executable delivery plans and ensure each sprint produces measurable, deployable outcomes. You’ll set the standard for secure, resilient and scalable onboarding journeys and reusable platform capabilities that support multiple products, markets and customer journeys. Success means safer releases, stronger reliability in production and simpler customer journeys built on consistent engineering patterns.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own engineering delivery across the build-test-release-run lifecycle from design through production operation
  • Shape delivery plans with clear scope, milestones, dependencies, risks and target dates aligned to business priorities
  • Establish measurable sprint outcomes that result in usable and deployable customer or platform capabilities
  • Coordinate dependencies across Product, Operations, Architecture, Platform, control functions and downstream engineering teams
  • Set technical direction for COS web and mobile journeys, backend microservices and integration services with Architecture and Principal Engineers
  • Govern API-first development including API lifecycle management, backward compatibility and contract testing
  • Embed engineering standards for coding, code review, testing and release practices aligned to enterprise frameworks
  • Strengthen production operability through monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards and runbooks plus clear SLIs/SLOs for critical services
  • Guide incident response and root-cause analysis and ensure permanent corrective actions are implemented
  • Ensure secure SDLC practices and evidence, controls and documentation to support governance and regulatory review

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bring proven experience managing and coaching cross-functional engineering teams delivering enterprise-scale customer systems
  • Demonstrate full-lifecycle delivery experience in Agile and continuous delivery environments across build-test-release-run
  • Show a track record translating business objectives into structured engineering plans with milestones, dependencies, risks and outcomes
  • Bring strong knowledge of modern frontend and mobile engineering alongside enterprise backend technologies such as Java/Spring Boot, .NET or Node.js
  • Demonstrate expertise in REST APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures and distributed integration patterns
  • Apply strong software engineering fundamentals including OO design, SOLID principles, design patterns, automated testing and performance engineering
  • Bring hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and engineering quality gates
  • Demonstrate cloud-native engineering capability including observability, incident management and SLI/SLO-based reliability practices
  • Show experience designing and operating highly available, resilient enterprise applications in regulated environments
  • Communicate technical complexity, delivery risks and trade-offs clearly to technical and business stakeholders while managing cross-team dependencies

/LP/WX

ln:4491566249.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
  • Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
  • Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
  • Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
  • 扩大卓越理财客户群，并与卓越理财客户建立长期关系
  • 根据客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富
  • 向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
  • 配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
  • Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
  • Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
  • Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
  • Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
  • Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
  • Fluency in Mandarin and English
  • 本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳
  • 具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系
  • 具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流
  • 以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务
  • 了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣
  • 成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现
  • 具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧
  • 普通话及英语流利

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4490430825.descriptionHtml:
Morgan Stanley Investment Management China (MSIM China), strives to provide diverse investment management services to a full spectrum of clients across both individual and institutional investors. Established as a joint venture in 2008, MSIM China became fully owned by Morgan Stanley Investment Management in 2023.

Benefiting from the global perspective and risk management capability of Morgan Stanley, MSIM China has established a variety of mutual fund and private fund portfolios covering fixed income, active equity, quantitative equity, multi-asset and sustainable investing strategies. Our portfolios have won many prestigious awards, including Morningstar Awards and Golden Bull Awards, which is a testament to our expertise and capabilities.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for the development, maintenance and daily service of institutional clients in China, including client visits, providing financial management/investment advisory, providing post-sales service, etc., to improve client satisfaction and stickiness.
  • Responsible for gauging in-depth understanding of the needs of various bank and non-bank institutional clients with respects to their asset allocation, organizing client service activities, and promoting the company's products and brands.
  • Responsible for maintaining & updating CRM database in accordance with the company's requirements, including potential investors, collecting, sorting and analyzing client investment preferences, etc., to ensure that client information data is refreshed and briefed timely, effectively and completely.
  • Referencing to the sales tasks and targets assigned, formulate and strictly implement the sales plan for China area and individuals to ensure that the sales target is achieved.

What You’ll Bring

  • Full-time bachelor's degree or above, with more than 8 years of institutional sales experience in fund management companies.
  • Solid client relationship with in-depth knowledge of the industry and various types of products and have a strong sense of risk compliance.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, good communication and coordination skills.
  • Positive and proactive working attitude, able to accept appropriate business trips, overtime, etc.
  • Have a strong sense of teamwork, adherence to various work arrangements, and have strong execution ability.
  • Possess China fund practitioner qualifications (AMAC).
  • Proficiency in English and Chinese.

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo

ln:4491170209.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • The role exists to ensure integrity, availability, control, and continuous improvement of critical Finance and Treasury data platforms and supporting infrastructure within the GFS Data Management portfolio. The role is accountable for maintaining robust information management capabilities that support financial reporting, regulatory obligations, operational decision-making, and business performance across the Bank.
  • The role develops and executes platform and data management roadmaps, ensuring that data controls, reconciliation processes, validation frameworks, and data quality standards operate effectively and consistently. It serves as the central point of accountability for service stability, infrastructure optimisation, risk management, and operational governance, enabling trusted and timely information for stakeholders.
  • Working across technology, finance, treasury, risk, and operational teams, the role influences strategic improvements to operating models, controls, and service management practices. Success is achieved through resilient information management capabilities, strong stakeholder partnerships, effective risk mitigation, and sustainable processes that support business continuity and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Information Management Strategy & Infrastructure Governance

  • Develop and maintain information management roadmaps that align data infrastructure capabilities with Finance and Treasury business priorities and regulatory requirements.
  • Govern the lifecycle of data management platforms, ensuring infrastructure resilience, scalability, performance, and long-term sustainability.
  • Drive the implementation of data quality, reconciliation, validation, and control frameworks that improve the reliability of critical financial information.
  • Evaluate emerging business requirements and control changes to enhance information management capabilities and service effectiveness.

Data Quality, Controls & Operational Integrity

  • Establish and maintain effective control frameworks that detect, prevent, and remediate data quality, reconciliation, and processing issues.
  • Monitor control effectiveness through metrics, KRIs, KCSAs, testing activities, and governance reviews to strengthen operational integrity.
  • Analyse control weaknesses, exceptions, and recurring issues to implement sustainable remediation and reduce operational risk.
  • Ensure dispensations, control deviations, and risk events are appropriately assessed, documented, escalated, and managed.

Service Management & Operational Resilience

  • Deliver stable and continuously available information management services through effective service management, monitoring, and operational support models.
  • Design and maintain business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resilience plans to minimise service disruption and data availability risks.
  • Optimise infrastructure performance through proactive monitoring, diagnostics, tuning, and capacity planning activities.
  • Manage configuration controls and operational dependencies to support service reliability and change readiness.

Stakeholder Engagement & Business Partnership

  • Build trusted relationships with Finance, Treasury, Technology, Risk, and Operations stakeholders to ensure information management services meet business needs.
  • Provide insight-driven recommendations using operational and performance data to support informed decision-making and prioritisation.
  • Communicate service performance, risks, issues, and improvement opportunities through clear governance and reporting mechanisms.
  • Influence stakeholders to drive standardisation, control enhancements, and consistent adoption of information management practices.

Risk, Compliance & Governance

  • Embed regulatory, operational, and conduct risk requirements into information management processes and services.
  • Ensure adherence to applicable policies, governance standards, financial control requirements, and risk management frameworks.
  • Identify, assess, escalate, and mitigate operational, technology, and information risks impacting business services.
  • Maintain effective governance processes that provide transparency, accountability, and assurance over information management activities.

Continuous Improvement & Operating Model Effectiveness

  • Drive process standardisation and operational improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, service quality, and control effectiveness.
  • Leverage performance metrics and management information to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
  • Improve operating models through business process re-engineering, automation opportunities, and streamlined control execution.
  • Establish sustainable practices that improve service outcomes while reducing complexity and operational risk.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
  • Configuration Management
  • Infrastructure Optimization
  • Risk Management
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Progress Reporting
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Strategic Planning

Motivations

  • Motivated by protecting customer and organisational data through practical, proportionate and sustainable privacy solutions.
  • Energised by solving complex risk and control challenges with stakeholders from different business, legal, compliance and technology disciplines.
  • Thrives in environments that value sound judgement, continuous improvement, collaboration and personal accountability.

Qualifications

  • Experience operating in complex financial services environments where data integrity, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience are critical.
  • Exposure to enterprise data management platforms supporting Finance, Treasury, Risk, or regulatory reporting functions.
  • Experience working across technology and business teams to balance service stability, control requirements, and evolving business needs.
  • Exposure to governance frameworks involving risk management, control assessment, service assurance, and operational oversight.
  • Experience leading organisational change, process standardisation, and infrastructure optimisation initiatives in large-scale operating environments.
  • Business English (required)

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.
